Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Wolbert over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over een in de thuiszorg werkzame verpleegkundige

MPs Mei Li Vos and Wolbert asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling treating a home-care nurse as a self-employed entrepreneur for income tax, asking about enforcement consequences for VAR-wuo declarations in care, the impact on about 1,200 freelancers who received a VAR-loon, and the relation to the eight criteria for entrepreneurship. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is not a generic rule for care in kind, that VAR declarations depend on the facts presented, that the affected group was offered a pilot-based new VAR-wuo, and that the Tax Administration applies the same criteria set out in case law.
The Tax Administration does not give such a generic interpretation to this court ruling.
Een dergelijke generieke uitleg geeft de Belastingdienst niet aan deze uitspraak van het hof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jan Vos over hoge vastrechtkosten in de energiesector

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about high fixed connection charges (vastrecht) in the energy sector, which they said could mislead consumers, and about abolishing them, linearising tariffs and improving price transparency. The minister replied that tariff structure is left to suppliers in a free market, that fixed charges preserve consumer choice and competition so abolition would be undesirable, and that improving transparency via ACM-supervised 'Aanbod op Maat' and harmonised terminology is the preferred route.
I see making the tariff structure more transparent as the most effective way to safeguard consumer choice and to stimulate competition and market functioning in the energy sector.

Ik zie het transparanter maken van de tariefopbouw als de meest effectieve manier om de keuzevrijheid van de consument te borgen en de concurrentie en de marktwerking binnen de energiesector te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over het telecombedrijf Pretium en het schriftelijkheidsvereiste

MPs Mei Li Vos and Oosenbrug asked whether telecom company Pretium complies with the written-confirmation requirement for telephone sales in force since 13 June 2014, and asked the minister to ensure compliance. The minister said supervision lies with the ACM, which has informed businesses and consumers about the rules and will act against non-compliance.
It is up to her to assess whether individual companies comply with this requirement.
Het is aan haar om te beoordelen of individuele bedrijven zich aan dit vereiste houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht

An MP asked ministers whether the ECHR ruling on inheritance tax exemptions for businesses versus individuals closed the door on claims by the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht, and whether such foundations using false expectations for financial gain are permissible, and what ACM and the Reclame Code Commissie can do without consumer complaints. The Minister answered that the ECHR ruling is final and inadmissible, that the civil courts and ACM would judge the foundation's conduct, that no new complaints have reached ACM, and that ACM and the RCC have enforcement tools, with the RCC cautious about acting ex officio.
The Court answers the question put to it in the negative and declares the applicants inadmissible.
Het Hof beantwoordt de voorgelegde vraag ontkennend, en verklaart de verzoekers niet-ontvankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over verboden gokreclames

An MP asked the State Secretary about online gambling advertising and illegal online gambling providers that continue to target the Netherlands despite warnings and a motion to exclude them from licences. The State Secretary answered that enforcement rests with the Gambling Authority, which investigates without disclosing individual cases, and that he intends to exclude persisting providers from licensing with details to follow in autumn.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Gambling Authority makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de ksa geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het toekomstig Nederlands kansspelbeleid en de Belgische ervaringen daarmee

An MP asked the State Secretary about Belgian experience with legal online gambling, including caps on licences, youth gambling and enforcement, and how Dutch gambling policy will respond. The State Secretary answered that Belgian, Danish and French experience informed the draft Remote Gambling Act, that no cap on licences is needed since a non-capped licensing system achieves channelling, and that strict licence conditions and enhanced enforcement powers for the gambling authority address youth and excessive gambling.
The bill provides for strict requirements for providers, both before and after the licence is granted.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in het stellen van strikte eisen aan aanbieders, zowel voorafgaand als na verlening van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Vos Mei Li over het bericht 'Sporter is straks meer kwijt als gemeente niet oplet'

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked whether the Market and Government Act forces municipalities to pass on full costs of sports facilities to clubs, and whether municipalities can instead designate facilities as services of general economic interest (DAEB) to avoid this. The minister answered that the Act aims to prevent unfair competition, that a DAEB designation is possible but subject to supervisory review, and declined to send municipalities a model DAEB decision, relying instead on information sessions organised with the VSG and VNG.
A municipality can, if in its judgement the general interest opposes passing on the full integral cost, refrain from doing so by qualifying the activity as an activity carried out under a DAEB.

Een gemeente kan, indien het algemeen belang zich naar haar oordeel verzet tegen doorberekening van de integrale kostprijs, hiervan afzien door de activiteit te kwalificeren als een activiteit ter uitvoering van een DAEB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li  Vos en Hamer over het bericht "TNT bespreekt reorganisatie pakketdienst"

Two MPs asked ministers about TNT Express's plan to replace permanent drivers and parcel couriers with subcontractors, and whether this constitutes bogus self-employment and whether the Tax Authority should refuse VAR declarations. The minister answered that such replacement is undesirable if used to evade employment protection, that UWV will judge any dismissals, that the Tax Authority cannot verify VAR applications by former employees, and that the Inspectorate SZW's sector exploration is being followed up with planned talks with the sector.
If employees in permanent employment are replaced by self-employed contractors in order to cut costs, that is extremely undesirable.
Als werknemers in vaste dienst worden vervangen door zzp’ers om op die manier de kosten te drukken, dan is dat uiterst onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de overname van BEB door Gasunie

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Finance Ministry knew of the regulatory risks behind a 1.5 billion euro write-down on the BEB/Gasunie acquisition and whether the 2005 Gasunie share purchase overpaid. The minister answered that Finance was aware regulatory risk was important but judged its materialisation very unlikely, that the earlier denial was incorrect, and that the 2005 price was a negotiated outcome not an overpayment.
The Ministry of Finance was aware at the time of the acquisition that regulatory risk was an important risk.
Het Ministerie van Financiën was ten tijde van de overname op de hoogte van het feit dat het reguleringsrisico een belangrijk risico was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de mogelijke postcodediscriminatie bij energiebedrijf Oxxio

Two MPs asked the ministers whether energy company Oxxio's creditworthiness checks and deposit demands amount to postcode discrimination under the Equal Treatment Act, and whether the minister would act against Oxxio or other energy firms. The minister replied that Oxxio does not decide on postcode alone, that the postcode plays only a limited role, that no direct discrimination was found, and that the ACM and the Equal Treatment bodies are the proper channels, so no further steps were planned.
Oxxio states that no increased risk is established on the basis of the postcode alone.
Oxxio geeft aan dat er geen verhoogd risico vastgesteld wordt op basis van enkel de postcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over het onderzoek van Panteia naar het bezit van een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering onder zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Panteia study showing most self-employed without staff lack disability insurance, whether this is undesirable, its cause (premium levels), whether they would require social assistance, and whether mandatory insurance should be reintroduced. The minister answered that choice is free, that a broad interdepartmental policy study on self-employed social security will report by year-end, and that data on benefit recipients is unavailable.
Based on the IBO, I want to examine, among other things, whether there is reason and scope to increase the insurance rate.
Op basis van het IBO wil ik onder meer bezien of er aanleiding is en mogelijkheden zijn om de verzekeringsgraad te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Netbeheerder Alliander wil hoger loon topman dan nu is toegestaan’

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander, which falls under the WNT pay cap, should be exempt, why state-owned TenneT and Gasunie are outside the WNT, and whether Alliander's German expansion is a loophole. The minister replied that Alliander remains under the WNT, that the draft bill keeps regional grid operators covered, that state holdings follow a separate pay framework, and that international activity is not a loophole.
Alliander falls under the WNT. As a result, it is not permitted to offer a salary above the WNT pay maximum.
Alliander valt onder de WNT. Daardoor is het niet toegestaan om een bezoldiging boven het bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over de loonverdubbeling bij het overheidsbedrijf Enexis

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked the government about a reported salary doubling for the Enexis board, whether Enexis faces competition, whether it is a fully public company, and whether the WNT pay cap applies. The minister answered that Enexis falls under the 130% WNT cap, that the board letter was a consultation response on lowering the cap that some read as a pay-doubling proposal (which Enexis denies), that the grid operator is a regulated monopoly with tariffs set by the ACM, and that the company is a regular private-law NV owned by provinces and municipalities.
In any case, under the WNT it is not possible to set a salary increase that exceeds the maximum remuneration norm.
Het is op basis van de WNT in ieder geval niet mogelijk om een loonsverhoging vast te stellen waarmee de maximale bezoldigingsnorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Dutch telecom and data-protection rules, including the opt-in cookie provision, apply to data Samsung collects from smart TVs, and whether new rules are needed. The government answered that existing law is adequate, that opt-in consent already applies, that compliance is for the independent regulators ACM and CBP to assess, and that it will bring the case to their attention.
Whether Samsung complies with this provision is not for me to assess, but for the two independent regulators, the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the Data Protection Authority (CBP).

Of Samsung deze bepaling naleeft staat niet ter beoordeling aan mij, maar aan beide onafhankelijke toezichthouders, Autoriteit consument en markt (ACM) en het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aukje de Vries en Mei Li Vos over premieverhogingen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor ZZP’ers

MPs Ziengs, Aukje de Vries and Mei Li Vos asked about insurers raising disability insurance premiums for self-employed workers via en-bloc clauses, including questions on legal limits, complaint routes, switching options and AFM oversight. The minister answered that insurers must apply such clauses reasonably and sparingly, that the AFM and DNB oversee communication and solvency, and that the AFM will explore the product's cost-efficiency and en-bloc use.
The AFM will, from its product oversight and product development process supervision, start an exploration into the use of the en bloc clause in disability insurance.

In het licht hiervan zal de AFM vanuit het toezicht op producten – en productontwikkelingsproces (PPP) een verkenning starten naar het gebruik van de en bloc clausule bij arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de stichting collectief onrecht

An MP asked the government about the Stichting Collectief Onrecht's advertising that taxpayers must join to keep rights to refunds of inheritance and gift tax, its fees and 'no cure no pay' claim, and its conduct toward consumers. The government answered that joining has no bearing on rights, that fee arrangements are a matter of private contract, that the ACM and civil courts handle misleading advertising, and that the Staatsloterij case is still pending before the Supreme Court.
There is therefore no connection between registering with the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht and retaining or losing rights.
Er is dan ook geen relatie tussen een aanmelding bij de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht en een behoud of verlies van rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Zembla uitzending “Woede in de winkelstraat”

An MP asked the ministers whether franchisees need stronger legal protection after a Zembla broadcast on abuses in franchising, such as forced purchasing and wrong sales forecasts, and whether a new statutory franchise contract is needed. The minister answered that franchisees should negotiate more critically, that information for aspirant franchisees will be improved, and that new legislation is unnecessary because existing rules and criminal law suffice.
As previously indicated, I intend to improve the information for aspiring franchisees on Ondernemersplein.nl.
Zoals eerder aangeven, ben ik voornemens de voorlichting aan aspirant-franchisenemers op Ondernemersplein.nl te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Albert de Vries over de aansturing van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

MPs Mei Li Vos and Albert de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the governance of the Port of Rotterdam Authority, including whether public interests are safeguarded, whether statutes should be amended, comparisons with neighbouring countries, land control and dividend levels. The minister replied that the state as shareholder already protects public interests through the statutes and the Nota Deelnemingenbeleid, rejected changes such as restricting shareholders to governments, and explained that dividend payments follow fixed agreements, giving a payout ratio of around 36-46% rather than 20%.
Where that is still insufficiently the case, I will adjust the statutory purpose in consultation with the co-shareholder Municipality of Rotterdam and the company.
Waar dat nog onvoldoende het geval is, zal ik de doelomschrijving in overleg met de medeaandeelhouder Gemeente Rotterdam en de onderneming aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over topinkomens bij goede doelen loterijen

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked about top incomes at lottery operators for good causes, whether lottery revenue flows to founders, whether licensing imposes pay conditions, and the enforcement against an unlicensed British lottery and illegal operators. The Secretary of State answered that the statutory 50% pay-out to good causes is met, that the regulator sets no pay conditions yet, that the British site could not be verified, and that persistent illegal operators will be excluded from licences.
The gambling authority has informed me that, when granting licences, it currently sets no requirements regarding the remuneration policy of lotteries that finance good causes.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten bij het verlenen van vergunningen momenteel geen eisen te stellen ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid van loterijen die goede doelen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over knelpunten voor franchisenemers

An MP asked the Economics and Justice ministers about problems franchisees face, including the NFV's organisation, representation of franchisees, the VAKcentrum's identified knelpunten and calls for new legislation, an updated EIM study, and better information on the Ondernemersplein portal. The minister answered that franchising mostly works, that stakeholder talks are ongoing, that extra legislation is unlikely to solve the problems, that an EIM update is not needed, and that the Ondernemersplein information will be expanded.
However, it is not plausible that additional legislation will be able to solve the outlined problems.
Het is evenwel niet aannemelijk dat extra wetgeving de geschetste problemen zal kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het tegengaan van online kansspelen gericht op de Nederlandse markt

An MP asked the State Secretary whether several foreign online gambling websites aimed at the Dutch market comply with the Betting and Gaming Act, whether referral sites are lawful, and how the Gambling Authority sets enforcement priorities and recovers fines from foreign operators. The State Secretary said the Gambling Authority is responsible for enforcement and does not comment on individual cases, that referral may be prohibited, and that new bills would add enforcement powers.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Ksa makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de ksa geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat Britse wedkantoren azen op de Nederlandse onlinegokmarkt

MP Mei Li Vos asked whether the government helped set up the gambling industry body Speel Verantwoord, how the Kansspelautoriteit engages with prospective online licence applicants, and whether illegal Dutch online casinos taken over by firms could escape the exclusion policy. Staatssecretaris Teeven denied government involvement in founding the body, said consultation with stakeholders is normal, and stated that persistent illegal providers will be excluded from licences, while declining to comment on individual enforcement cases and noting that takeovers do not affect the integrity assessment.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the gambling authority does not make statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het gedoogbeleid ten aanzien van online casino’s

MP Mei Li Vos asked the State Secretary about lobbying by a former state secretary, alleged agreements with illegal online gambling operators, and the Gambling Authority's enforcement priorities, which she framed as tolerance policy. The State Secretary denied any agreements or lobbying influence, said the Gambling Authority prioritises enforcement against operators targeting the Dutch market, and reported several fines with more investigations ongoing.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Gambling Authority does not make announcements about individual cases or operators.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over zijn aanwezigheid bij de doop van een reddingsboot

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether his attendance at the christening of a lifeboat sponsored by Oranje Casino signals legitimacy for an online gambling operator and whether online gambling is still prohibited in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answers that online gambling without a licence remains prohibited under current law, that enforcement belongs to the Kansspelautoriteit, that his attendance signals nothing, and that any future licence would be assessed independently by that authority.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the gambling authority makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Maij over het niet benutten van mogelijkheden ter ondersteuning van bedrijven die de EU biedt

MPs Vos and Maij asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands is failing to use the room EU state aid rules offer, whether the Commission advises on designing aid measures, and what will be done about it. The Minister confirmed the Commission can advise confidentially, said the Netherlands uses this in cases such as Nedcar and Pallas, and promised to strengthen contacts with Commission services and internal coordination on state aid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Samsung smart TVs may track viewing behaviour under accepted terms, whether consent is explicit, and whether the TVs' terms of use are lawful, citing a CBP ruling. The State Secretary answered that consent or contract grounds under the Wbp could justify collection, that the Cbp is the independent supervisor and the government will not judge Samsung's lawfulness itself.
Supervision of compliance with the Wbp rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Het toezicht op de naleving van de Wbp berust bij het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked ministers about postal delivery in the Caribbean Netherlands, including e-commerce access, postcodes, whether the ACM supervises the islands, and the change of ownership of concession holder Flamingo Communications. Minister Kamp answered that e-commerce is a market matter outside the postal concession, that postcode costs are unknown, that the ACM's tasks are set by the Wet post BES with no general competition oversight on the islands, and that the ownership change did not affect Flamingo's assessment.
In the Caribbean Netherlands the ACM has no tasks in general competition supervision, as laid down in the Mededingingswet in the European Netherlands.
In Caribisch Nederland heeft de ACM geen taken in het kader van generiek mededingingstoezicht, zoals dat in Europees Nederland is neergelegd in de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over gokbedrijven die vooruitlopend op niet bestaande wetgeving investeren in Nederland

An MP asked whether foreign gambling firms signing contracts with Dutch partners ahead of uncertain online gambling legislation bear entrepreneurial risk, and about Holland Casino buying online casino software. The government answered that firms may prepare for market opening at their own risk, that licence conditions on addiction prevention will apply, and that Holland Casino's procurement is responsible given planned regulation and privatisation.
Gambling operators, including current licence holders, are free to prepare for a possible opening of the Dutch online gambling market.
Het staat kansspelaanbieders, waaronder ook de huidige vergunninghouders, vrij zich voor te bereiden op een eventuele opening van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Dikkers over het zeer trage betaalgedrag van een aantal grootbedrijven ten koste van het MKB

MPs Mei Li Vos and Dikkers asked whether large firms such as DE Master Blenders lengthening payment terms to 180-200 days complies with the 60-day statutory limit, and whether enforcement should be strengthened, including by the ACM. The minister replied that civil contracts are not subject to government enforcement, that public supervision is undesirable due to administrative burden, and that suppliers can go to civil court, collective action, or the ACM.
Civil-law contracts are not a subject of government enforcement.
Civielrechtelijke overeenkomsten zijn geen onderwerp van handhaving van overheidswege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over misstanden in franchiseland en de mogelijke aanpassing van de franchiseovereenkomst

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether franchise abuses are increasing, whether the franchise agreement should be made a named contract in the Civil Code, and whether franchisees can get legal aid for business disputes. The minister denied clear signs of a sharp rise, said no new research is planned, did not prioritise codifying franchise agreements, and explained that legal aid for business disputes is generally excluded with narrow exceptions.
At this moment I see no reason to commission new research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vos over de inzet van de kansspelautoriteit tegen gokverslaving

An MP asked the State Secretary whether enforcement against illegal foreign online gambling operators and the Gambling Authority's preventive capacity effectively reduce gambling addiction. The State Secretary answered that licensed operators face strict prevention conditions, that the Authority has about 15 FTE on supervision and enforcement, and that a bill on remote gambling is planned to strengthen enforcement powers, including against foreign operators who refuse to pay fines.
In developing the remote gambling bill, I am therefore examining which additional powers could further strengthen the effectiveness of the Authority's enforcement.
Bij de ontwikkeling van het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand bekijk ik dan ook welke aanvullende bevoegdheden de effectiviteit van de handhaving van de ksa verder kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘BTW-nummer moet wel op de website, ook voor de ZZP-er’

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the government about conflicting Tax Authority guidance on whether sole traders must publish their VAT number online, and about the use of the citizen service number (BSN) as the basis for VAT numbers. The State Secretary answered that no tax rule requires a VAT number on a website, but civil law (Article 3:15d BW) requires easy, direct and permanent access to it for online services, and that a motion asking for VAT numbers not linked to the BSN is being assessed with a letter to follow.
I am currently having the consequences of this motion mapped out and will inform the House about this in a separate letter.
Ik laat op dit moment in kaart brengen wat de consequenties van deze motie zijn en zal uw Kamer hierover bij separate brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether Dutch law can reach directors of foreign legal entities in cases of pauline acts or bankruptcy fraud, whether the cross-border director-liability rules and the civil director ban are effective, and what was done after a 2011 Supreme Court ruling. The minister answered that cross-border cases are inherently complex, that the Netherlands raised the issue in the EU insolvency regulation review, that foreign director liability is governed by the law of the company's home state, and that the director-ban bill is still pending at the Council of State.
Precisely because of the inherent cross-border aspects, we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level.
Juist vanwege de inherente grensoverschrijdende aspecten achten wij het overigens van belang om over dit vraagstuk op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Mei Li Vos over de perverse prikkels in de wetenschap

MPs Van Meenen and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary about the Science in Transition pamphlet on perverse incentives in academia, including publication pressure, business-science entanglement, and proposed reforms. The government acknowledged the concerns, defended quality and international rankings, said it will consider stakeholder involvement and await the IBO Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek before deciding on funding changes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked about the new postal concession for Caribbean Netherlands, including the tender outcome, service changes, the 10-year term, enforcement tools, price rise and street addressing. The minister answered that Flamingo Communications was designated concessionaire, that the government can enforce via ACM orders, fines or withdrawal, and that addressing and postcode plans are progressing, without promising new oversight mechanisms.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises whether the concession holder complies with its obligations.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) ziet er op toe dat de concessiehouder zijn verplichtingen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei li Vos over het bericht dat SBS een “gokzender” wil beginnen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether plans for a TV gambling channel and online gambling licences conflict with preventing gambling addiction, and whether licences should be limited or TV advertising banned. The State Secretary answered that TV gambling is not ruled out in principle, depends on the design, that current TV advertising rules apply, and that the number of licences will not be capped in advance.
The bill on remote gambling in principle leaves room for offering games of chance via television.
Het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand geeft in beginsel ruimte voor de mogelijkheid kansspelen aan te bieden via televisie
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de bekendheid en toepassing van het Besluit bijstandsverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz) voor zzp’ers

An MP asked whether ZZP self-employed workers know about the Bbz assistance scheme and what the government will do to raise awareness. The state secretary answered that data on financial distress is lacking, that awareness is only indicative, and listed existing and planned outreach measures with municipalities and Divosa/VNG.
From this department I intend to grant subsidy to Divosa and VNG to organise various activities in autumn 2013 and the first and second quarters of 2014 that will raise awareness of the Bbz.

Ik ben vanuit dit departement voornemens subsidie te verlenen aan Divosa en VNG om in het najaar van 2013 en het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2014 diverse activiteiten te organiseren die meer bekendheid aan het Bbz zullen geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over privacyschendingen door middel van de bonuskaart van Albert Heijn

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Albert Heijn's loyalty card exposes customers' purchase histories to privacy risks, whether such data counts as personal data under the Wbp, and whether other retailers face similar risks. The state secretary answered that purchase data is personal only when traceable to a person, that the card number gives access only to purchase history without identifying details, that the first five digits are no longer printed on receipts, and that he lacks an overview of other retailers' safeguards, leaving the final legal judgement to the Data Protection Authority.

The final judgement on whether consumers' purchase data must be regarded as personal data and whether shops such as Albert Heijn must protect it accordingly rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Het finale oordeel over de vraag of aankoopgegevens van consumenten als persoonsgegevens moeten worden beschouwd en of winkels als Albert Heijn deze dienovereenkomstig moeten beschermen is aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Oosenbrug over de onmogelijkheid om over te stappen bij glasvezel abonnementen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether fibre-optic internet customers can only switch providers when they have no other fibre subscription, causing gaps in service, and whether providers agreed to create switching barriers that may breach the cartel ban. The minister acknowledged operational problems, denied any agreement to create switching barriers, and declined to instruct the competition authority ACM to start an investigation, citing its independence.
However, I cannot instruct the ACM to start an investigation.
Ik kan de ACM echter niet opdragen om een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether foreign-company directors of Dutch companies can escape joint liability under Dutch law, and whether EU legislation is needed to change this. The minister replied that liability depends on the foreign law of the company's seat, that the Netherlands will raise harmonisation in the Commission's consultation, and that the upcoming civil director-ban bill will address misuse of foreign legal entities.
Because we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level as well, we will raise this in the consultation the European Commission is currently holding.

Omdat wij het van belang achten om over dit vraagstuk ook op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen, zullen wij dit opbrengen in het kader van de consultatie die de Europese Commissie momenteel houdt

Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos(beiden PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe publicatieregeling voor freelance journaliste

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about Sanoma Media's new exclusive licensing and resale terms for freelance journalists, the 30% fee share, possible abuse of market power, the Mededingingswet, and whether the Auteurscontractenrecht bill should apply retroactively. The state secretary answered that contract disputes are for civil courts, that the ACM handles abuse-of-dominance complaints, and that the bill's fair-remuneration rule will not apply retroactively to existing contracts.
It is also not for us to pronounce on a provision in a specific private-law relationship.
Het is ook niet aan ons om ons uit te spreken over een bepaling in een specifieke privaatrechtelijke rechtsverhouding.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei LiVos (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over doodsbedreigingen door gefrustreerde sportgokkers (ingezonden 12 juli 20

MPs Van Dekken and Mei LiVos asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about death threats against athletes by frustrated sports bettors, and about matchfixing research and enforcement. The minister answered that the matchfixing study will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, declined to comment on a preliminary judicial investigation, and pointed to the new gambling authority and planned policy response.
Regarding a preliminary investigation, I make no statements in the context of the possible interest of criminal investigation.
Over een voorbereidend onderzoek doe ik – in het kader van het mogelijke opsporingsbelang – geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over onduidelijke regels omtrent identificatieplicht voor zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether self-employed workers (zzp'ers) face unclear and contradictory identification rules when accepting assignments, and how their privacy is protected. Minister Kamp replied that identification is only required when a client demands a Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie, that the client must keep copies for seven years, and that the Chamber of Commerce only shares business addresses unless legal exceptions apply.
Self-employed workers are not obliged to identify themselves when accepting assignments.
Zzp'ers zijn niet verplicht zich te identificeren bij het aannemen van opdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Mei Li Vos over de btw-vrijstelling die geldt voor PostNL

Two MPs asked the government about the VAT exemption for universal postal services that benefits PostNL, including its origins, its size and revenue cost, and whether the government would push for its abolition in Europe. The State Secretary confirmed the exemption covers only universal service parcels, explained its historical basis, declined to give volumes or revenue loss citing confidentiality, and said the Netherlands supports abolition, which the Commission withdrew, with a possible future proposal to be notified to parliament.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of the data, the exact size of the UPD share of the total market cannot be stated.
Door de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens, kan de exacte grootte van het UPD-aandeel in de totale markt niet worden aangegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (EC) naar een vermeend Europees oliekartel

MPs Kuiken, Jan Vos and Mei Li Vos asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's investigation into a suspected European oil cartel, including its evidence, duration, scope, Dutch consumer harm, and the role of the ACM competition authority. The minister replied that the Commission has been very restrained and gave no concrete evidence beyond its press release, that the ACM can assist and must decide independently whether to investigate, and summarized Germany's Bundeskartellamt fuel-market study.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the European Commission is very restrained in giving statements that touch on the content of its investigations.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang is de Europee Commissie zeer terughoudend in het geven van mededelingen die de inhoud van haar onderzoeken raken.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Mei Li Vos over de doorvoer van walvisvlees via de haven van Rotterdam

MPs Jacobi and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the government would block transit of whale meat through Rotterdam, citing a petition and earlier commitments to pursue an EU or IWC transit ban. The state secretary replied that no formal transit ban is legally feasible because of Iceland's and Japan's CITES reservations, but said she would pursue a West-European port and industry code of conduct and approach EU colleagues.
As I reported above, a formal transit ban is not feasible.
Zoals ik u hierboven meldde, is een formeel doorvoerverbod niet haalbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over het verband tussen het verstrekken van vergunningen voor online kansspelen en gokverslaving

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked whether licensing online gambling would increase gambling addiction and what safeguards and measurement exist. The government answered that it does not expect an explosive rise, citing strict licence conditions (warnings, limits, a national exclusion register, a duty of care), monitoring every five years, and enforcement powers of the Kansspelautoriteit.
I do not have data on the private addiction care sector.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens van de «particuliere» verslavingszorgsector.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de biermarkt en het markt- en procedeergedrag van Heineken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about alleged aggressive market and litigation conduct by Heineken towards cafe owners and rivals, including whether it breaches competition law, whether the ACM is investigating abuse of dominance, and whether unfair trading rules should extend to businesses. The minister declined to comment on private disputes, said the ACM is analysing the horeca beer market and will report soon, and opposed extending consumer unfair-practice rules to business relations, favouring self-regulation.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the ACM makes no statements about (possible) ongoing investigations into infringements of the Competition Act.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang doet de ACM geen uitspraken over (mogelijke) lopende onderzoeken naar overtredingen van de Mededingingswet.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de mogelijkheid voor financieel dienstverleners om adviezen van het Klachteninstituut financiële dienstverlening (Kifid) als niet-bindend te aanvaarden

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked the Finance Minister about reports that financial firms can opt out of binding Kifid complaint rulings, and whether the list of non-binding firms and the scope of Kifid access should change. The minister answered that binding force cannot be enshrined in law under the Constitution, announced that Kifid will limit withdrawal of binding acceptance to new contracts, and said he is willing to examine extending access to small businesses.
Kifid plans to amend its rules so that withdrawal of acceptance of the binding force of its rulings applies only to contractual relationships entered into after that date.

Het Kifid is van plan haar reglementen zo aan te passen dat een intrekking van de aanvaarding van de bindendheid van haar uitspraken alleen geldt voor contractuele verhoudingen die na deze datum zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Öztürk en Mei Li Vos over de heffing door het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel voor het jaar 2013

MPs Öztürk and Mei Li Vos asked why the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its 2013 levy above the previous year's level, how this relates to the planned abolition of the product and trade boards, and whether levy payers are properly informed. Minister Kamp replied that the increase reflects provisioning for the wind-down, higher purchasing costs and lost subsidies, that the board holds reserves insufficient to cover closure costs including a social plan, and that existing information duties suffice so no additional measures are needed.
I am of the view that, beyond the applicable statutory obligations and the supervision exercised over them, no additional measures are necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat er, naast de geldende wettelijke verplichtingen en het daarop gehouden toezicht, geen aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de plannen van Holland Casino om online gokken aan te bieden

An MP asked the state secretary whether Holland Casino's plans to offer online gambling, including a tender for an online platform, mean it will obtain a licence and whether insider knowledge risks are being avoided. The government answered that a European tender is underway, that no licence is guaranteed, that the licensing rules will be set out in a draft bill for internet consultation, and that Holland Casino has been consulted on regulation.
I aim to put this draft bill into internet consultation at the end of April, so that everyone is informed about it at the same time.
Ik streef ernaar dit concept-wetsvoorstel eind april in internetconsultatie te brengen, zodat een ieder daarover tegelijk wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vos Mei Li en Vos Jan over het bericht ”Brandgevaar bij 650 duizend zonnepanelen”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked about reports of fire hazards in 650,000 solar panels, whether all systems can be tested before summer, whether the company was obliged to report known defects, whether other manufacturers' panels are linked to fires, whether certification registers should be mandatory and linked to subsidies, and who is liable for buyers of a bankrupt manufacturer's panels. The minister answered that testing is the producers' responsibility, that the NVWA advises owners to switch off the affected system, that failure to report known dangers is an economic offence, that no other fires are known, that certification is voluntary and mandating it is not desirable, and that liability is a civil matter handled by the curator and insurer.
Testing of solar panel systems is the responsibility of the companies that place the products on the market, not of the NVWA.
Keuring van zonnepaneelsystemen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven die de producten in de handel brengen en niet van de NVWA.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Wolbert over de btw-heffing bij zelfstandigen in de zorg

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT treatment of self-employed nurses in healthcare, including whether unclear rules create unfair competition and why inspectors allegedly apply rules inconsistently. The State Secretary answered that self-employed nurses working under a hospital's supervision are VAT-liable, denied inconsistent enforcement, and said the Tax Administration has informed the sector and updated its public guidance.
I do not recognise the criticism that tax inspectors apply the rules inconsistently.
Ik herken de kritiek niet dat belastinginspecteurs de regels niet eenduidig zouden hanteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Kerstens en Hamer over ‘het onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden in de Nederlandse pakketdienstensector’.

MPs Mei Li Vos, Hamer and Kerstens asked ministers about working conditions and bogus self-employment among parcel couriers, including PostNL subcontracting, VAR certificates, and whether the Inspectorates and competition authority should intervene. The government acknowledged the problems are undesirable, said bogus self-employment should be prevented and an action plan would follow, announced inspections and an exploratory study, and declined to disclose details of agreements with specific taxpayers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over fraude bij Holland Casino

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Holland Casino staff suspected of fraud were given time to self-report in exchange for job guarantees, and about whether crimes should be reported to police, the number of criminal complaints filed since 2012, existing government supervision, and the plans to privatise the casino. The government answered that Holland Casino handles integrity matters through internal procedures, that seven complaints were filed since 2012, that several oversight bodies supervise the casino, and that privatisation plans are being prepared with a letter to parliament promised before summer.
The company has both confidential advisers and a whistleblower scheme.
Het bedrijf kent zowel vertrouwenspersonen als een klokkenluidersregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over reclame voor kansspelen

An MP asks the state secretary whether gambling advertisements comply with the statistical-odds and responsible-gambling warning requirements of article 4a of the Gambling Act, and whether the Gambling Authority has imposed sanctions. The state secretary answers that the Gambling Authority is responsible for supervision, is examining some advertisements, has not yet imposed sanctions, and that an investigation is ongoing and could lead to a sanction.
The Gambling Authority informs me upon request that it is examining some advertisements.
De Ksa laat mij desgevraagd weten dat zij enkele reclame-uitingen onderzoekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de aanpak van illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op internet

An MP asks the State Secretary about enforcement against illegal online gambling operators targeting the Dutch market, including banks facilitating payments and whether licensing should wait until illegal operators are gone. The State Secretary says the Gaming Authority has warned about 40 operators, more than half complied, enforcement against non-compliers is ongoing, no fines or orders have yet been imposed, and bank blacklisting awaits a legal basis.
During the investigation the Gaming Authority cannot address the specific cases.
Gedurende het onderzoek kan de ksa niet op de concrete zaken ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de aanpak van illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op internet

An MP asked the state secretary about enforcement against illegal online gambling operators, including advertising by 7Red.com and Royaalcasino.com and the Gaming Authority's ability to detect illegal ads and collect fines from foreign operators. The state secretary said the Gaming Authority is responsible for enforcement, that it monitors ads and receives reports, and that foreign fines are hard to collect administratively, while promising to examine additional powers in the forthcoming online gambling bill.
In developing the online gambling bill, I am examining which additional powers could further strengthen the effectiveness of the Gaming Authority's enforcement.
Bij de ontwikkeling van het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand bekijk ik welke aanvullende bevoegdheden de effectiviteit van de handhaving van de ksa verder kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het stimuleren van innovatie en concurrentie bij aanbestedingen

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about a court ruling on a government ICT tender for SAP licences, the legal unity of the state in procurement, reuse of systems, vendor lock-in and openness to innovative suppliers. The minister answered that the ruling gives no reason to revise procurement policy, that the tender was lawfully split into two lots, that the state's procurement decision levels follow EU criteria, and that the government aims to avoid lock-in and engage the market.
The ruling in this case gives no reason to revise the Dutch central government's current procurement policy, whether or not for ICT.
De uitspraak in deze zaak geeft geen aanleiding het huidige aanbestedingsbeleid van de Rijksoverheid, al dan niet ten aanzien van ICT, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Mei Li Vos over afspraken tussen spooraannemers over de prijs van onderhoud van het spoor

MPs Hoogland and Mei Li Vos asked whether rail contractors Volker Rail, BAM Rail and Strukton Rail were engaging in unlawful price agreements on track maintenance, whether the competition authority should be consulted, and how the government would respond to a pending court ruling on performance-based maintenance (PGO) tenders and the experience with those contracts. The state secretary replied that there were no concrete indications of cartel behaviour, that the NMa supervises competition and may investigate, that ProRail was vindicated and may proceed with the Eemland award, and that PGO contracts have raised quality and lowered costs according to ProRail, with further inspection research underway.
At this moment I have no concrete indications that this is the case regarding the agreements between rail contractors.
Op dit moment heb ik geen concrete aanwijzingen dat daarvan in het geval van de afspraken tussen spooraannemers sprake is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de kosten verbonden aan creditcardbetalingen

MPs Nijboer and Mei Li Vos asked about the high cost of credit card payments for retailers, whether card companies may charge above cost, whether the EU consumer rights directive will curb fees, whether Dutch action should not await EU payment services rules, and whether the regulators should investigate. The minister answered that retailers negotiate with their payment provider, that no action is warranted now, that the directive limits surcharges to actual costs, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and may start its own investigation.
I currently see no reason to take action in this area.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om actie op dit vlak te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Nijboer en Mei Li Vos over de hoge betalingskosten voor verkopende partijen bij PayPal

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about high PayPal fees charged to sellers, whether a legal cap applies, and whether the EU consumer rights directive or a regulator investigation would change this. The minister answered that no legal maximum exists, that consumers are protected from excessive surcharges by the directive, and that the competition authority NMa is independent and has been informed of the concerns.
The NMa is an independent regulator, so it is not for me to ask it to investigate certain markets.
De NMa is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder, het is dan ook niet aan mij om haar te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar bepaalde markten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Mei Li Vos over onduidelijkheid bij het terug verkrijgen van het CBF keurmerk voor goede doelen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the unclear withdrawal and later reinstatement of the CBF quality mark for a cancer research charity without public explanation, and about progress on a convenant with the charity sector for more transparency. The State Secretary said the CBF is independent and he does not judge individual decisions, but that a public explanation would help transparency, and he described the ongoing work on a validation system due by Q4 2013.
I do not intervene in individual assessments by the CBF.
Ik treed niet in individuele beoordelingen van het CBF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over misleidende reclame voor kansspelen

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Vriendenloterij scratch-card advertisement complies with the new gambling-advertising rules in Article 4a of the Gambling Act, and whether the regulator has fined any operator. The secretary answered that the regulator is monitoring compliance, has no signals of violations, has not fined anyone, and that the implementing decree is planned for 1 July 2013.
When asked, the gambling authority informs me that it will not comment on individual cases, except where there is, for example, a public sanction decision.
Desgevraagd laat de kansspelautoriteit mij weten geen mededeling te doen over individuele zaken, behalve wanneer bijvoorbeeld sprake is van een openbaar sanctiebesluit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over multi level marketing

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice about multi-level marketing practices (including ACN's telecom sales), whether they are misleading or illegal pyramid schemes, and whether consumer and gambling authorities are informed. The government answered that MLM is a lawful sales method, that the Consumer Authority and Gambling Authority supervise compliance with existing law, that no change to legislation is currently needed, and that it will not judge individual companies.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.

Vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken over schadevergoeding aan consumenten die gedupeerd zijn door kartelvorming met betrekking tot tv’s van Philips (i

An MP asked ministers how Dutch consumers overcharged for Philips TVs due to a cartel could recover damages, and whether collective redress through interest organisations should be enabled. The government explained individual civil claims and collective alternatives, and committed to consulting stakeholders on implementing the Dijksma motion and expects a draft bill after summer 2013.
I expect that a draft bill will be made public after the summer of 2013.
Ik verwacht dat na de zomer van 2013 een voorontwerp van wet openbaar zal zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over onredelijke schuldeisers waardoor er onnodig bedrijven failliet gaan

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Dutch bankruptcy law gives creditors too strong a position, causing firms to fail unnecessarily or relocate abroad, and whether a court could bind unreasonable creditors before bankruptcy. Minister Opstelten acknowledged the problem, announced a bankruptcy law reform programme with stakeholder consultation and comparative research, but gave no firm commitment to a quick bill and said fraud prevention currently has priority.
That is why I have also announced legislation providing for the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.
Daarom heb ik ook wetgeving aangekondigd die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de inkomenspositie van zzp’ers

An MP asked the ministers whether self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) are increasingly turning to food banks, which municipalities are affected, whether they are informed about social assistance and local tax relief, and how their income has changed. The minister replied that food-bank client data is not kept by government, pointed to information portals and municipal duties, noted that the rules for local-tax relief for small entrepreneurs are being amended, and cited CBS and EIM data showing a diverse group with a small average income decline in 2011.
Data on the client base of food banks are not kept by the government.
Gegevens over het klantenbestand van voedselbanken worden door de overheid niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Recourt over identiteitsfraude door slecht bewaarde paspoortkopieën

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked about identity fraud risks from copies of passports that self-employed contractors must give each client and clients must keep for seven years. The minister replied that the retention duty is legally required, that the government lacks data on fraud involving such copies, suggested contractors write purpose and date on copies, and said the VAR web module will not change the identification requirement.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will start a campaign at the end of this year to point people to this option.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties start eind dit jaar een campagne om mensen op deze mogelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer en Vos over de hoge additionele kosten bij het gebruik van een creditcard voor betalingen en specifiek voor boekingen bij vliegtuigmaatschappijen

MPs Nijboer and Vos asked about high credit-card surcharges on payments, especially airline bookings, and whether UK-style rules should apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the EU consumer rights directive caps surcharges at actual costs, including for passenger transport, that a Dutch implementing bill is expected soon, and that the Payment Services Directive revision will be pursued, while consumer-authority enforcement on hidden fees is noted.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de tarieven voor bluswater

An MP asked the minister about the sharply higher fire-water connection tariffs charged by Oasen to businesses in eastern South Holland, whether this constitutes abuse of market power, and what businesses can do. The minister replied that drinkwater rules do not apply to fire water, so companies set these tariffs freely, but the competition law ban on abuse of dominance applies, that the NMa is independently competent to investigate, and that businesses may use alternatives or complain to the NMa or municipalities.
I have informed the NMa of recent developments regarding Oasen's fire-water tariffs.
Ik heb de NMa op de hoogte gebracht van de recente ontwikkelingen aangaande de bluswatertarieven van Oasen.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over aardgasinkomsten en een staatsfonds

Two MPs asked whether the minister knew of a press report on a sovereign fund from gas revenues, what share of Groningen gas proceeds goes to Shell and ExxonMobil and whether the MOR agreement could be terminated, and how the government followed up a 2008 letter on studying the optimal design of wealth preservation. The minister replied that the MOR profit split gives the state about 90% of proceeds at current prices so no change is planned, and that the 13th Studiegroep Begrotingsruimte advised on the FES feeding mechanism, which the cabinet has frozen with the related bill withdrawn.
I therefore see no reason to terminate this agreement or change it.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze overeenkomst op te zeggen dan wel te veranderen.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Plasterk over strengere eisen aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf bij het verstrekken van kredieten

MPs Mei Li Vos and Plasterk asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance why SME credit is riskier and more expensive than large-firm credit, whether banks will tighten lending criteria, and what alternative financing and Innovation Fund instruments exist. The minister replied that SME rates reflect structural risk and transaction costs, that credit has broadly held up, and outlined existing and planned financing instruments, while declining to assign BNG a direct SME lending role and leaving the transformation of the Innovation Fund into a national investment bank to a future cabinet.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments regarding credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen Vos over het bericht dat Duitsland 300 miljard euro verdient met duurzame producten en diensten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Germany earns large sums from green technology and whether the Netherlands should seek a fully renewable energy supply by 2050. The minister agreed that investment brings benefits, described the two-track energy and innovation policy, declined to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on the revenue side, and said the energy supply should be CO2-neutral by 2050 while keeping fossil fuels, emissions trading and all energy options open.
I therefore see no reason at this time to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on this.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding de Algemene Energieraad om advies te vragen hierover.
Vragen van de leden Vos en Timmer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de compensatie van bedrijven die door kartels schade geleden hebben (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Vos and Timmer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether companies harmed by cartels should be compensated, whether a Dutch whistleblower reward scheme like a UK experiment would be introduced, and whether results of that experiment are known. The minister answered that liable parties should bear damages, pointed to the EU-level approach and the Dutch collective settlement act, said the UK scheme is discretionary and results are not published, and declined to introduce a whistleblower fund.
The OFT does not provide information on the results of this reward system, because recipients of rewards could be identified, endangering their safety and deterring potential informants.
Over de resultaten van dit beloningssysteem verstrekt de OFT geen informatie, omdat daardoor de ontvangers van beloningen achterhaald kunnen worden
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Justitie en van Economische Zaken over de vergunning van een restaurant (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

MP Vos asks the ministers about a Amsterdam Italian restaurant denied a Drank- en Horecawet license because part of the premises falls below the 2.40 m ceiling height requirement, which leads it to close at 17.00. Minister Klink confirms the licence refusal on height grounds, states the height rules are independent of ventilation and smoking rules, and refuses to loosen the requirements, citing stress and fire-safety risks.
We do not intend to loosen the height requirements in the Besluit eisen inrichtingen Drank- en Horecawet.
Wij zijn niet voornemens de hoogte-eisen in het Besluit eisen inrichtingen Drank- en Horecawet te versoepelen.

Vragen van de leden Vos, Heijnen en Vermeij (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Belastingdienst als slechte werkgever (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MPs Vos, Heijnen and Vermeij (PvdA) asked the Finance and Interior ministers whether the Belastingdienst is a poor employer, questioning lower pay, the lack of permanent contracts for agency workers at Belastingdienst Toeslagen, and their costs. The minister denied the pay gap claim, said agency work is tied to temporary tasks that will end once the new benefits system is rolled out, and gave cost figures per hour.
The answer to this question depends on the nature of the work.
Het antwoord op deze vraag hangt af van het karakter van de werkzaamheden.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de weigering van de DSB-top van het conceptrapport Scheltema (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister why DSB's former management is denied the full draft Scheltema report for hearing and rebuttal while AFM and DNB receive it, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replies that the independent commission sets its own procedure under its establishing decree, that AFM and DNB were consulted on confidentiality, that the minister will not intervene, and that the commission's response deadline was too ambitious.
If I were to intervene in the procedure that the Commission has autonomously established, I would in fact act contrary to this establishing decree and undermine the Commission's independence.

Als ik zou interveniëren in de procedure die de Commissie op autonome wijze heeft vastgesteld, zou ik juist handelen in strijd met dit instellingsbesluit en afbreuk doen aan de onafhankelijkheid van de Commissie.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over implementatie van Europese richtlijnen over consumentenbescherming in Nederland (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

MP Vos (PvdA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice whether the Netherlands correctly implemented EU Directive 97/7/EC on distance selling against aggressive sales practices, why cold-calling 'cowboys' persist, how Germany's implementation differs, and whether complaint data and transparency should improve. The ministers replied that the Dutch implementation is adequate, that enforcement tools are being strengthened, that complaint information is published via annual reports, and that consumer policy stays at Economic Affairs.
Information provision, for example by ConsuWijzer, plays an important role in warning consumers.
Voorlichting, door bijvoorbeeld ConsuWijzer, vervult een belangrijke rol bij het waarschuwen van consumenten.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de liberalisering van de postsector en de aangekondigde verkoop van TNT Post (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about EU postal liberalisation, the possible sale or flotation of TNT Post, implications for workers, universal service and state ownership. The minister answers that the 2010 liberalisation deadline stands, that TNT's split or sale is a company matter with the universal service obligation remaining in the Postal Act, and that the state will not take a stake.
It is the responsibility of the State to ensure that the universal postal service is delivered with good quality and at an affordable price.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Staat om te zorgen dat de universele postdienst wordt geleverd met een goede kwaliteit en tegen een betaalbare prijs.
Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Vos (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de besteding van scholingsgelden (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment why EVC/Ervaringscertificaat funds for training of workers at risk of dismissal are largely unused, and why action was not taken earlier. The minister acknowledged the low uptake, cited about 667 certificates issued by UWV and about 10,000 estimated per year, and listed awareness campaigns and the broadening of the scheme as remedies.
The use of the Ervaringscertificaat/Ervaringsprofiel measure has so far been limited. I regret this.
Het gebruik van de maatregel Ervaringscertificaat/Ervaringsprofiel is tot nu toe beperkt. Dat betreur ik.

requests the government to be generous in handling these exceptional situations

Asks the government to allow branches where a 1.5-metre distance is impractical to devise their own safe solutions with government consultation during COVID measures.
requests the government, for branches where the 1.5-metre society is impractical, to allow each branch to arrange its own safe solution in consultation with government

Asks the government to check before payment whether a company has gone bankrupt before paying out NOW wage subsidy funds.
requests the government from now on to check, before the moment of payment, whether the company in question has gone bankrupt

Asks the government to suspend until 31 December 2020 the requirement that self-employed people with old unemployment benefit rights must liquidate their business to claim them.
to suspend this liquidation requirement until 31 December 2020

I am committed to building 100,000 homes per year, two-thirds of all new construction to be affordable housing.
Ik zet mij er voor in dat er 100.000 woningen per jaar worden gebouwd, waarvan twee derde van alle nieuwbouw moet bestaan uit betaalbare woningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over onderzoeken of (voormalige) regeringspartijen of politici verbonden aan (voormalige) regeringspartijen zijn gefinancierd met geld uit Oekraïne of de Verenigde Staten

An MP (Baudet, FVD) asked whether state actors such as Ukraine, the United States or Russia might influence Dutch politics, including through funding, awards or think tank roles, and whether the government would have the Algemene Rekenkamer investigate Dutch party politicians since 2014. The minister answered that foreign influence is monitored mainly by the intelligence services, that foreign party donations have been banned since 2023, and that the government will not request such an audit.
She considers it very important that we further arm ourselves against undesirable influence and strengthen the public debate.
Zij vindt het van groot belang dat we ons verder wapenen tegen ongewenste beïnvloeding en het publieke debat versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het besluit van het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie om zes talentontwikkelings-organisaties in de klassieke muzieksector niet langer te subsidiëren

MP Baudet asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie's decision to stop funding six classical music talent development organisations from 2025 despite positive advice, including the composition of the assessment committees and the shift in funding criteria. The Minister acknowledges the negative impact, calls the outcome undesirable, and announces 1.9 million euros per year for 2025–2028 to support classical talent development, while defending the fund's independent committee process.

I have confidence that the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie has shaped the decision-making and allocation procedure in a well-considered and lawful manner, based on its professionalism and knowledge of the sector.

Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie de besluitvorming en toekenningsprocedure op een weloverwogen en rechtmatige manier heeft vormgegeven, op basis van zijn professionaliteit en kennis van het werkveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de totstandkoming van de 25 kilometer maximale rekenafstand

Baudet (FvD) asked the minister to provide all documentation on the origins of the 25-kilometre maximum calculation distance around Natura 2000 areas, including the RIVM analysis cited in the 2021 letter. The minister replied that the documents were already published in June 2024 as part of a Woo decision on AERIUS Calculator version 2021.
As part of this decision, all documentation concerning the establishment of the maximum calculation distance of 25 kilometres has been published.
Als onderdeel van dit besluit is alle documentatie aangaande de totstandkoming van de maximale rekenafstand van 25 kilometer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de dreiging van een nucleaire oorlog tussen Nederland en Rusland

MPs Baudet and Van Houwelingen asked the government about the risk of nuclear war with Russia, including whether troops would be sent to Ukraine, the effects of nuclear weapons, and whether Ukraine could join NATO and the EU. The ministers answered that Russia's invasion is illegal, that Nederland is not at war with Russia, that deterrence is maintained, and that no decision on troop deployment can be anticipated, while several questions were answered jointly or left to later decisions.
The cabinet cannot elaborate further on the nature of the discussions due to confidentiality.
Het kabinet kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid niet verder op de aard van de besprekingen in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de bilaterale veiligheidsovereenkomst tussen Nederland en Oekraïne

An MP from FVD asked the Dutch government about the bilateral security agreement with Ukraine, including its similarity to other countries' agreements, the lack of parliamentary consultation, Ukraine's obligations, and the Nord Stream sabotage. The minister answered that the agreement follows the G7+ declaration, commits to ten years of support, and that Nord Stream questions are under investigation, with some answers partial and the Nord Stream question left to the investigation.

Since the signing of the G7+ declaration on 12 July 2023, the cabinet has frequently and consistently informed the House about its efforts to conclude a security arrangement for multi-year support to Ukraine.

Het kabinet heeft de Kamer sinds het ondertekenen van de G7+-verklaring van 12 juli 2023 veelvuldig en consequent geïnformeerd over de inzet van het kabinet om een veiligheidsarrangement voor meerjarige steun aan Oekraïne af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de Kamerbrief betreffende de staat van de oorlog in Europa d.d. 23 februari jl

Two MPs from FVD asked the government to substantiate claims in its letter on the war in Europe, including Russian territorial ambitions, Ukraine's role in peace talks, and whether the 2022 talks failed due to Boris Johnson. The government answered that Russian officials' statements and past conduct support its assessment, that Ukraine decides when conditions for negotiations exist, that the Johnson claim is Russian disinformation, and that NATO enlargement strengthens deterrence.
Questions 3 and 4 follow on from each other, and are therefore answered together.
Vragen 3 en 4 liggen verder in het verlengde van elkaar, en zijn daarom gezamenlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het NPO-programma Sekspedia voor jongvolwassenen

An MP asked the government about the NPO program Sekspedia, its content, public funding, whether the NPO should give sexual education to youth, and whether the program presents a representative view of sex. The state secretary declined to judge the program's content or conservatism, said she did not know the production cost, and pointed to the Mediawet and the Commissariaat voor de Media, saying educational content is part of the public broadcaster's remit.
As State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science, I do not give personal assessments of specific programmes.
Als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap geef ik geen persoonlijke beoordelingen over specifieke programma's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ngo’s diede oversteek van illegale immigranten over de Middellandse Zee faciliteren

Baudet (FVD) asked whether NGOs conducting sea rescues in the Mediterranean are subsidised by the Dutch government, where rescued migrants are landed, and whether rescues encourage irregular crossings. The government replied that it funds no such NGOs, that SAR rules place landing responsibility with the coordinating rescue centre, that it values rescue work while seeking clearer EU landing arrangements, and it did not provide the total number rescued.
The cabinet does not have the total number of persons rescued by vessels operated by NGOs.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over het totaal aantal personen dat gered is door schepen in beheer van ngo's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het openbaarmaken van de brief van de Europese Commissie van 24 oktober 2000

An MP from FvD asked why a 2000 European Commission letter referred to in a 2001 parliamentary document is not public, and whether the minister will publish and share it with the House. The minister confirmed knowledge of the letter, explained it is released only on request and with Commission consent, and said it will be sent to the House once the Commission agrees, with the request already in progress.
I am willing to make the letter public as soon as the European Commission agrees to this.
Ik ben bereid de brief openbaar te maken zodra de Europese Commissie daarmee instemt.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures.
