The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de totstandkoming van de kritische depositiewaarden en de rol van het Coordination Center for Effects

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about the origins of Dutch critical deposition values, the role and legal status of the UNECE Coordination Center for Effects (CCE), its financing and relation to RIVM, and the TFIAM chair and protocol obligations. Minister van der Wal-Zeggelink answered at length that CCE advice is non-binding, that Dutch values derive partly from CCE work, and that the Netherlands took on the CCE and TFIAM roles in 1990 as part of international cooperation, with the answers largely restating historical policy and referring to UNECE documentation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Week van de Lentekriebels en ander onderwijs gericht op seksuele voorlichting en vorming van jonge kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about sexual education for young children, the Week van de Lentekriebels, Rutgers' materials, and whether these sexualise children. The minister replied that schools freely choose materials, that relational and sexual education is a legal obligation since 2012, and that the Inspectorate received only a few dozen calls, with no central registration of complaints.
I will share the requested communication as soon as possible after sending these answers.
Ik zal de door u opgevraagde communicatie zo snel mogelijk delen na verzending van deze antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over contacten tussen de AIVD en de Nederlandse pers

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about AIVD contacts with the Dutch press, including what information the AIVD shares with journalists and whether it had contact with other newspapers and broadcasters. The minister answered that the AIVD may share information with media without personal data or state secrets, and refused to provide all communication between the AIVD, MIVD, NCTV and media because no integral overview exists.
There is no legal basis to keep records of all communication with the media.
Er is geen juridische grondslag om alle communicatie met media bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Dekker over de militaire steun aan Oekraïne

MPs Baudet and Dekker asked for an overview of Dutch military aid to Ukraine, its legal conditions, possible violations of the laws of war, Ukraine's compliance with agreements, Dutch troop involvement, and disclosure of related documents under Article 68 of the Constitution. The government answered that deliveries are donations reported in periodic letters, that no signals of misuse exist, that each delivery is vetted under EU arms export criteria with end-user certificates, and that operational security limits full public disclosure.
Operational security nonetheless remains the overriding consideration in deciding whether to inform the House publicly.
De operationele veiligheid blijft echter te allen tijde leidend in de afweging uw Kamer in het openbaar te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de arrestatie van Steve Bannon

The MP Baudet asked the Dutch foreign minister whether the arrest of Steve Bannon in the US, and related remarks by Biden advisers, raise concerns about political prosecution and the rule of law. The minister answered that the government has confidence in the American rule of law, declined to characterise Bannon's role, and said asylum requests from the US are assessed individually while the US is a designated safe country of origin.
I have confidence in the American rule of law.
Ik heb vertrouwen in de Amerikaanse rechtstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ‘Coronavirus tijdlijn’ op de website van de rijksoverheid

An MP asks why the government's Coronavirus timeline has not been updated since June 2021 despite promising quarterly updates, and requests a visual, searchable timeline showing measures, durations, vaccinations and ICU capacity. The Minister answers that the timeline is a chronological reference work updated quarterly with a lag, that the requested interactive tool and searchable features do not fit its purpose, and that the information is available elsewhere (Coronadashboard, Wettenbank) while committing to publish the Q3 2021 update in Q1 2022.
Because the timeline is a chronological reference work, it is drawn up afterwards, coordinated and published every quarter.
Vanwege het feit dat de tijdlijn een chronologisch naslagwerk is, wordt deze naderhand opgesteld, afgestemd en elk kwartaal gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Kerseboom over het niet informeren van de FVD-fractie over de aankoop van De Vaandeldrager

Two FvD MPs asked why the FVD faction alone was not informed in advance of the planned purchase of Rembrandt's De Vaandeldrager, and questioned the Rothschild family's role, the price and related dealings. The state secretary replied that the faction had the same information as others when the supplementary budget was submitted, that the decision to inform was a personal political judgement, and that the purchase is a commercial transaction with no commitments or conditions attached, while withholding some details such as family member names for privacy and the sale not being finalised.
I see no reason for that at this time.
Ik zie daarvoor nu geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over oversterfte sinds mei 2021

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about excess mortality reported by Statistics Netherlands since May 2021, its explanation, and how it compares internationally. The Minister said the excess is almost entirely attributable to COVID-19 deaths and that an international comparison is not reliable due to differing methods.
Statistics Netherlands states that the excess mortality, meaning the difference between observed and expected deaths, is almost entirely caused by deaths from COVID-19.
Het CBS stelt dat de oversterfte, ofwel het verschil tussen het waargenomen aantal en het verwachte aantal overledenen, bijna in z’n geheel wordt veroorzaakt door sterfte aan COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de rechtvaardiging van de vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen ter bestrijding van het coronavirus

An MP asks the Health Minister for the criteria used to classify infectious diseases under the Public Health Act, why COVID-19 was placed in category A, whether the OMT advice will be published, and under what conditions it would leave category A. The minister explains the classification criteria, points to the public OMT advice and Kamerstukken, and says downgrading is not yet possible given uncertain developments and new variants.
This OMT advice was sent to the House of Representatives and is therefore publicly available.
Dit OMT-advies is gestuurd aan de Tweede Kamer en daarmee openbaar te raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat vleesrunderen op vergiftigde grond hebben gegraasd

The MP asked the ministers about reports that beef cattle grazed on contaminated floodplain land, whether a national overview of such areas exists, whether the meat reached consumers or foreign buyers, whether dioxin and other toxins are tested, whether grazing should be banned, and about granulite dumping and sanitation. The government answered that responsibility is shared across departments, that an NVWA investigation is ongoing with results expected in 2021, that affected meat was sold only to individual online consumers, and that granulite poses no proven harm and does not warrant sanitation.
Following this, NVWA-BuRO carried out a desk study, after which it was decided to start an investigation into dioxin and other contaminants.
Naar aanleiding hiervan heeft NVWA-BuRO een deskstudie uitgevoerd, waarna is besloten een onderzoek te starten naar dioxine en andere contaminanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over openbaarmaking van alle documenten die betrekking hebben op 'Build Back Better'

An MP (Baudet, FvD) asked the Prime Minister to publish all government documents mentioning or relating to 'Build Back Better'. The Prime Minister answered by listing already-public Kamerstukken, cabinet and Council minutes passages, and internal briefing notes, explaining that diplomatic confidentiality prevents publishing full notes, so only the relevant passages are provided.

Confidentiality of conversations with international representatives is crucial for the proper functioning of international diplomatic relations, and it is not consistent with that to make such notes public.

Vertrouwelijkheid van gesprekken met internationale vertegenwoordigers, is cruciaal voor het goed functioneren van het internationale diplomatieke verkeer en het is niet in lijn daarmee dergelijke aantekeningen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de misstanden rondom de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe RIVM gebouw

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about vibration-sensitivity problems, cost overruns, delays and contractor withdrawals in the construction of the new RIVM/CBG headquarters in Utrecht. The government answered each question, acknowledging the vibration-requirement problems, roughly 36.5 million euro in extra costs shared with the contractor, and a delayed handover, while stating it complied with procurement rules and that the building will meet the requirements.
The House will be informed separately by letter about the new handover date.
De Kamer wordt middels een brief separaat geïnformeerd over de nieuwe opleverdatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over psychologische oorlogsvoering om burgers een lockdown te laten accepteren

MP Baudet asked the Prime Minister whether the government used psychological manipulation or fear-inducing techniques to win public acceptance of lockdown measures, and whether it would release related internal documents. The Prime Minister denied using techniques to create fear, said manipulation is not justified, referred to a separate letter on communication, and said the cabinet already meets its information duty toward parliament.
The cabinet has an information duty towards the House of Representatives. Within the agreements made with the House on this, this duty is already being fulfilled.
Het kabinet heeft een informatieplicht richting de Tweede Kamer. Daaraan wordt – binnen de afspraken die daarover met de Tweede Kamer zijn gemaakt – reeds voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de onafhankelijkheid van de organisatie die de beveiliging van de verkiezingssoftware heeft onderzocht

An FvD MP asked the Interior Minister whether the independence of Hackdefense, which audited the election software OSV2020 commissioned by the Kiesraad, was compromised given its sole shareholder's alleged D66 membership and politics. The minister said the Kiesraad ran a European tender under public procurement rules, that the ministry (via UBR/HIS) only advised on the procurement process and had no role in the audits, and that the Kiesraad is responsible for commissioning security tests.
The Ministry of the Interior has had no involvement in the investigations and/or tests that the Kiesraad had carried out.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft geen betrokkenheid gehad bij de onderzoeken en/of testen die de Kiesraad heeft laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het verloop van het verkiezingsproces inzake de komende Tweede Kamerverkiezing

Baudet (FvD) asked the Interior Minister about fraud risks, storage and counting of postal ballots, the handling of ballots lacking signatures on voting passes, the suspension of counting, screening of election officials, and mask rules for the March 2021 Tweede Kamer election. Minister Ollongren answered every question in substance, explaining the safeguards in the Temporary COVID-19 elections law and its regulations while acknowledging some residual risks.
I will assess during the evaluation of the election to what extent it has occurred that no signature was placed on the voting pass.
Ik zal bij de evaluatie van de verkiezing bezien in welke mate het is voorgekomen dat er geen handtekening is gezet op de stempluspas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het inzichtelijk maken en heroverwegen van alle trajectcontroles in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for a full overview of all active traffic-section (trajectcontrole) speed cameras in the Netherlands, showing fine revenue and effects on road safety, and whether all such systems should be reconsidered. The government provided fine revenue per section for 2018 and 2019, explained that the cameras aim at speed compliance rather than revenue, and declined to reconsider them, citing their contribution to compliance and the difficulty of isolating road-safety effects.
Precisely stating the number of traffic accidents and casualties before and after introduction of these traffic-section controls would require extensive separate research.
Het precies aangeven van het aantal verkeersongevallen en -slachtoffers vóór en ná invoering van deze trajectcontroles zou een uitgebreid separaat onderzoek vergen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de beveiliging van joodse gemeenschappen in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Jewish community in the Netherlands faces a heightened terror threat, whether Austria's tripled security spending should be matched, and why the government should or should not better protect Jewish institutions. The minister confirmed the threat level is 3 of 5, said Jewish institutions are a potential target, and stated that security measures are appropriate, that the 2014 extra funding ended in 2017, that responsibility lies primarily with organisations and locally, and that no reconsideration of funding is planned.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about which security measures are being taken.
Over welke beveiligingsmaatregelen getroffen worden, kan ik zoals bij uw Kamer bekend geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het model waar het stikstofbeleid op gebaseerd is

An MP from FvD asked the minister why nitrogen policy relies solely on the AERIUS/OPS model rather than LOTOS-EUROS, and whether Germany uses LOTOS and the Hordijk committee's advice was followed. The minister answered that OPS is the only model giving the detailed one-hectare local deposition calculations needed for permits, that LOTOS-EUROS cannot do this, and that Germany uses LOTOS only for less detailed policy purposes, while declining to commit to running the policy with LOTOS.
This level of detail is needed to calculate nitrogen deposition for nature permit granting.
Dit detailniveau is nodig om ten behoeve van natuurvergunningverlening de depositie van stikstof te kunnen berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over het opgelaaide conflict in Nagorno-Karabach

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Nagorno-Karabakh escalation, including Turkish involvement, Syrian fighters, Turkish President Erdogan's rhetoric and possible sanctions. The minister declined to attribute responsibility yet, called for de-escalation via the OSCE Minsk Group, said Turkey's military involvement was very likely and that Syrian fighters were confirmed, and ruled out sanctions for now.
At this moment the cabinet makes no statements on attribution; the facts must first be established.
Op dit moment doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over attributie, daarvoor moeten de feiten eerst vaststaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gezondheidsschade van windturbines

Mr Baudet (FvD) asked whether wind turbine noise, especially low-frequency noise, causes serious health problems for residents, citing a Danish 20 dB indoor limit, a German 1,000 m distance rule, and the precautionary principle, and asked for a halt to nearby turbine projects. The State Secretary answered that no conclusive evidence exists yet, that Dutch noise norms cover the full spectrum and are about as strict as the Danish norm, that the RIVM will review the unpublished LUMC study, that a low-frequency research programme will be reported by summer 2021, and that existing projects will not be halted.
I will ask the RIVM to look at the research results when they are published.
Ik zal het RIVM vragen naar de onderzoeksresultaten te kijken wanneer deze gepubliceerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de huidige visie van het kabinet op het gebruik van hydroxychloroquine in de strijd tegen COVID-19

Two MPs asked the minister about a Dutch study reporting reduced ICU admission with early hydroxychloroquine and whether the government will keep hydroxychloroquine available and follow up on the findings. The minister answered that the government will leave the judgement on hydroxychloroquine to experts, monitor developments and keep supply under review, and that an advisory panel will assess further research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse digitale veiligheid en de ontmoeting met de Chinese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the government about the Dutch digital security implications of university research cooperation with Huawei and about the PM's and Foreign Minister Blok's meeting with Chinese FM Wang Yi. The government answered that the research is civilian (multilingual search), results are open access, universities are responsible for their own partner choices, and a neutral framework for telecom suppliers applies.

The cabinet will inform the House this autumn in more detail about the state of affairs in the process toward additional measures to counter unwanted knowledge and technology transfer through education and research.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer dit najaar nader informeren over de stand van zaken bij het proces om te komen tot aanvullende maatregelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over de herijking van de relatie met Suriname

Two FvD MPs asked the foreign minister about the reset of relations with Suriname: current stance on the new government, conditions on aid, financial support and IMF/IDB debt talks, business opportunities, COVID aid and medical staff, diaspora role, and institution-building. The government answered in general terms, pointing to a prior letter, stating that aid carries risk-based conditionality and that Nederland may withhold aid, declining any precedent for a state guarantee, and committing to a business forum and a second aid package still being defined.
With every form of aid the Netherlands provides, risks are weighed, donor conditionalities are set and mitigating measures are taken where there is reason to do so.
Bij iedere vorm van hulp die Nederland levert worden risico’s meegewogen en donorconditionaliteiten gesteld alsook eventuele mitigerende maatregelen genomen indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse stilte ten aanzien van het historische vredesakkoord in het Midden-Oosten

An MP from FvD asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands was silent on the Israel-UAE-Bahrain peace accords, whether they are historic, why no Dutch representative attended the Washington ceremony, and why a Dutch minister visited Iran. The minister welcomed the accords as historic and reported EU statements, explained US-led diplomacy, and said the Netherlands was not invited at ministerial level, defending dialogue with Iran.
The United States determined the invitation policy, whereby a cross-section of EU member states was invited, of which only Hungary at ministerial level.
De Verenigde Staten bepaalden het uitnodigingsbeleid, waarbij een dwarsdoorsnede van de EU-lidstaten was uitgenodigd, waarvan alleen Hongarije op ministerieel niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over hydroxychloroquine

Two MPs (Van Haga and Baudet) asked the health minister about the status of national hydroxychloroquine trials for COVID-19 after the Lancet paper was retracted, and why no extra efforts were made to keep the drug available for early use. The minister said inclusion in the trials was stopped, that there is still no objective reason for extra efforts, and that interpreting clinical research is for experts.
It is for experts to interpret clinical research.
Het is aan de deskundigen om klinisch onderzoek te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gang van zaken rondom de demonstratie d.d. 21 juni 2020 op het Malieveld tegen de anderhalvemetersamenleving

MP Baudet asked the Interior and Justice ministers about the handling of the 21 June 2020 Malieveld demonstration against the 1.5-metre society, including the ban, police conduct and differential treatment of protests. Minister Ollongren answered that the local authority (the safety region chair) is responsible for demonstration decisions and must account to the municipal council, so ministers decline substantive answers, while stating the 1.5m rule is not a restriction of the right to demonstrate.
The local authority is accountable for that decision to the municipal council and, where appropriate, to the courts.
Het lokale gezag legt over die beslissing verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad en eventueel aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP from FvD asked the ministers of health, interior and justice about second-wave preparedness, IC capacity, AstraZeneca conflict-of-interest concerns, hydroxychloroquine research, social media censorship, face-mask experiments and a minister's holiday in Sweden. The government answered that capacity expansion and PPE stockpiles are underway, denied any conflict of interest, and defended the local face-mask experiments as proportionate.
I see no risks in the fact that we have entered into a deal with AstraZeneca.
Ik zie geen risico's in het feit dat we met AstraZeneca in zee zijn gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de aanhouding van tientallen boeren bij vreedzame demonstratie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of 62 farmers at a demonstration in Wijster, the regional ban on tractor protests, the detention of minors, the handling of arrestees and corona measures. The minister answered that the ban decisions belong to the safety-region chairs, arrests were made for breaching the demonstration rules under local tolerance limits, and withheld details on individual fingerprinting cases.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the temporary blanket bans on demonstrating with tractors in the three northernmost safety regions that you mention.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de door u genoemde tijdelijke algehele verboden om met tractoren te demonstreren in de drie meest noordelijke veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gemeenschappelijke schuld die ontstaat door het ‘herstelfonds’

An MP asks whether the Netherlands agreed to the EU borrowing of 750 billion euros for the recovery fund, whether 390 billion of it amounts to common debt repaid collectively, what Dutch interests and costs are, what happens if a member state leaves, and why the government agreed despite a Kamer motion against debt mutualisation. The minister confirms agreement, argues the conditions (conditionality, emergency brake, temporary structure) make the framework acceptable, and gives estimated additional Dutch payments of about 1 billion euro in 2028 falling to about 0.8 billion by 2058.
There is no question of taking over (mutualising) the debts of member states.
Er is geen sprake van het overnemen (mutualiseren) van schulden van lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de rekenmethode achter de nieuwe eiwitmaatregel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the calculation method behind the new feed protein limits for dairy cattle was documented and reproducible, and why the basis was not disclosed before a summary-proceedings case. The minister answered that all underlying documents were made public, the method rests on CBS data and a Wageningen notitie validated by the CDM, and that the team-based work does not depend on a single official.
That is why I have made all documents underlying the feed measure public, insofar as they were not already public.
Vandaar dat ik alle stukken die ten grondslag liggen aan de veevoermaatregel openbaar heb gemaakt, voor zover die niet al openbaar waren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Baudet over de uitgestelde verbreding van de N35

An MP asks the minister why the widening of the N35 road to two lanes each way is delayed, what the timeline is, and what action will follow letters from regional bodies urging urgency. The minister says the province's widening plan is not automatically the most efficient option, that talks with the province will take place before the autumn MIRT meeting, and that no commitment on the timing or the solution can yet be given.
Based on the outcomes of the study, I will in the coming months engage in discussion with the province to discuss the conclusions and see what follow-up steps may be possible.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek ga ik de komende maanden het gesprek met de provincie aan om de conclusies te bespreken en om te zien wat er eventueel voor vervolgstappen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over biomassa

Baudet (FVD) asked the minister about biomass power plants: whether burning biomass emits more CO2 than coal, how permit and subsidy responsibilities are divided among national, provincial and municipal government, and whether the government will reconsider calling biomass sustainable. The minister answered that biomass is climate-neutral when sustainable, that an integral sustainability framework is being prepared, that permitting is decentralised, and that the government will not reconsider its position, while declining to provide data on pending permit applications.
I do not have this information: permit, extension and amendment applications are submitted locally and are not centrally recorded.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie: vergunning-, verlengings- en wijzigingsaanvragen worden decentraal ingediend en niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat de president van de Verenigde Staten de banden met de WHO verbreekt

An FvD MP asked the minister about the US withdrawal from the WHO and alleged WHO failures in favour of China early in the COVID-19 crisis, and whether Dutch funding should be suspended. The minister supported an independent evaluation after the crisis, noted the WHO's own oversight committee's view that inquiry now would weaken the response, and said funding could be reconsidered only if clear evidence of serious failings emerged.
The Netherlands supports an independent evaluation of the international corona response, including the conduct of the WHO, at an appropriate moment once the situation is under control.
Nederland steunt een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de internationale corona response, inclusief het handelen van de WHO, op een daarvoor geëigend moment wanneer de situatie onder controle is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet en Moorlag over de tariefverhogingen van Rendac

MPs Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet and Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Rendac's 2020 carcass-collection tariff increases, the lack of transparency in tariff calculations, and the status of the destruction-market review. The minister defended the tariffs as cost-based, said the ADR and the external auditor check compliance, and withheld Rendac's confidential figures from the Chamber while promising renegotiated agreements with Rendac.
The confidential business information obtained cannot be shared with third parties.
De verkregen bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik niet delen met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over rechterlijke uitspraken over de PAS

An MP asked the ministers about court rulings on the PAS nitrogen programme after 29 May 2019, including how many concern farm housing, grazing, manure and enforcement, and why some rulings were not published. The minister answered that the courts themselves decide on publication under the Rechtspraak criteria, that no integrated system counts PAS rulings, that the Council of State published all its PAS rulings, and that the Noord-Nederland court has now published some rulings after media attention.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over Nederlandse kritiek op vermeende onderdelen van het Israëlische regeerakkoord

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about Dutch criticism of the Israeli coalition plans, embassy involvement, the location of diplomats' residences, and funding of Israeli and Palestinian NGOs including Al-Mezan and projects marked confidential. The ministers defended the criticism as consistent with international law, stated they do not withhold funding from organisations merely supporting BDS, and declined to name some confidential projects.
This concerns one of the reconciliation projects through which the cabinet implements the coalition agreement's commitment to improving relations between Israelis and Palestinians.

Dit betreft een van de verzoeningsprojecten waarmee het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan het regeerakkoord om zich in te zetten voor verbetering van de onderlinge relaties tussen Israëliërs en Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het ECB-beleid

An FvD MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB bond-buying, Italian debt sustainability, potential losses for the Netherlands, and whether ECB purchases amount to monetary financing or eurobonds. The minister answered that the IMF and Commission do not deem Italian debt unsustainable, that Dutch exposure to losses is limited, that ECB purchases are not monetary financing per CJEU rulings, and that joint debt issuance is undesirable.
The total amount of Italian government bonds currently on the Eurosystem's balance sheet under the PEPP is therefore not yet known.
De totale hoeveelheid Italiaanse staatsobligaties die momenteel op de balans van het Eurosysteem onder het PEPP staat is daarom nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Haga over hydroxychloroquine

MPs Baudet and Van Haga asked the health minister about Dutch research on hydroxychloroquine for COVID-19, stockpiling, international cooperation, the minister's 'quackery motion' remark, and reports of prescribing abroad. The minister replied that Dutch trials were paused after a Lancet study, that SWAB and CBG advise against first-line use since efficacy is unproven and risks exist, that about 17,000 packs were secured for hospitals, and that the motion was rightly characterised.
I will closely monitor developments in order to, in consultation with parties across the whole medicines chain, take additional efforts where necessary.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen om in overleg met de partijen in de gehele geneesmiddelenketen 5 waar nodig over te gaan tot extra inspanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het controleren van de Nederlandse grenzen inzake de coronacrisis

Two MPs from FvD asked the Health and Justice ministers how Dutch border controls operate during the COVID-19 crisis, including checks on arrivals, flight bans, and border checks with Germany and Belgium. The government answered that policy aims to control COVID-19 maximally, that travellers from high-risk countries must quarantine for 14 days, that border checks are sample-based and arrival numbers are not tracked, and that no land-border controls or travel bans are currently needed.
Insight into the number of persons travelling from abroad to the Netherlands cannot be provided.
Inzicht in het aantal personen dat vanuit het buitenland naar Nederland reist, is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over een terugkeerder uit Somalië

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister about a terror suspect returned from Oman to the Netherlands, including how he was brought back, what charges apply, and how the risk he poses will be managed. The minister refused to discuss case details because of the ongoing criminal case, but explained the general policy on controlled return, prosecution, and possible citizenship withdrawal.
Because of the ongoing criminal case against this person, I cannot go into the details of this specific case.
In verband met de lopend strafzaak naar deze persoon kan ik niet ingaan op de details van deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het verkeerd informeren van de Kamer omtrent het bombardement in Hawija

An MP asks the Defence Minister why the House was misinformed about the 2017 Dutch air strike in Hawija, including whether US warnings of civilian deaths were withheld and why a US investigation was not shared. The minister mostly refers back to earlier letters, admits an administrative error in counting civilian casualties, and denies having misinformed the House or planning consequences.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het voortdurende tekort aan mondkapjes

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister about shortages of face masks, the role of the national procurement consortium (LCH), certification, quality control, and logistics, in 18 numbered questions. The minister answered that the LCH centrally procures scarce protective equipment on the ministry's mandate, with RIVM quality checks, and that shortages will remain fragile for now.
The LCH acts on the assignment of the Ministry of VWS. This means the LCH's working method is determined by VWS.
Het LCH handelt in opdracht van het Ministerie van VWS. Dat betekent dat de werkwijze van het LCH door VWS wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de voortgang van het stikstofbeleid

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the progress of nitrogen policy, including farmers' opposition, the feed measure, the effect of COVID-19 emission reductions, and the demonstration ban during the crisis. The minister answered that the government will present a structural nitrogen approach with measures to reduce emissions and restore nature, that the feed measure is necessary and will not be reconsidered, and that citizens can still express their views despite the gathering ban.
The Advisory Council on Nitrogen Issues will present its advice on the longer term before the summer.
Het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek zal voor de zomer haar advies over de langere termijn presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de 100 miljoen euro extra aan de WHO

An MP asked whether the Netherlands was giving an extra 100 million euro to the WHO, where the money goes, why it is spent abroad rather than at home, and whether the government will criticise the WHO over China and Taiwan. The minister replies that the 100 million is a multi-purpose budget for the poorest countries, of which only 7.5 million goes to the WHO, that the Netherlands always serves its own interest, and that a broad evaluation of the response will follow, while several questions on domestic spending are answered only by reference to an accompanying letter.
The cabinet of course supports a broad evaluation of the international corona response, as the standard procedure prescribes.
Het kabinet steunt vanzelfsprekend een brede evaluatie van de internationale coronabestrijding, zoals de standaardprocedure voorschrijft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota

An MP asked the minister when the draft Aviation Policy Document (ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota) would be available and whether it would precede the Lelystad airport decree. The minister answered that the draft is expected this spring, subject to possible delays from COVID-19, and that it will precede the Lelystad decree.

I aim to present the decision-making on the draft Aviation Policy Document, the approach for Schiphol, and information for the pre-consultation procedure for the amendment of the Lelystad Airport decree to the House of Representatives this spring.

Ik streef ernaar om dit voorjaar de besluitvorming over de ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota, de aanpak voor Schiphol, en informatie voor de voorhangprocedure voor de wijziging van het Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad aan de Tweede Kamer voor te kunnen leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de RVU-boete

The MP asked the State Secretary of Defence how many soldiers since 2010 used the early retirement scheme (RVU), the total amount Defence has had to pay in RVU levy, and how much the 2008 Marine Air Service merger saved. The government answered that 6,971 soldiers left under compulsory age dismissal since 2010, gave the levy paid across the FLO, UGM and AOW-gap schemes, and stated that the merger had no savings targets and its efficiency cannot be assessed.
The merger of the Marine Air Service into the Defence Helicopter Command (DHC) in 2008 had no savings targets.
Het opgaan van de Marine Luchtvaartdienst in het Defensie Helikopter Commando (DHC) in 2008 had geen bezuinigingsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het fysiek bijwonen van Provinciale Statenvergaderingen gedurende de coronacrisis

Baudet asked the Minister of BZK about the Flevoland commissioner's call for MPs to attend a physical Provincial States meeting during the COVID-19 crisis, including the reappointment of the commissioner, and whether digital decision-making should be enabled. The minister said decentral bodies should meet physically only when strictly necessary, that provincial states decide for themselves, and that a temporary legal provision for digital decision-making would be proposed to Parliament.
Ultimately, the decision whether or not to meet rests with the provincial states, as a democratically elected body, and not with the commissioner of the King or the Minister of BZK.
Uiteindelijk is de beslissing om al dan niet te vergaderen aan provinciale staten, als democratisch gekozen orgaan, en niet aan de commissaris van de Koning of de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het gehanteerde beleid met betrekking tot het testen op COVID-19 (corona) besmettingen

Two FvD MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing policy, including who is tested, testing capacity, lysis buffer supply, and imports. The minister answered that testing is restricted due to global shortages, that about 2000 tests run daily across 35 labs, and that a special COVID-19 envoy and taskforce will coordinate production and distribution.
At present, approximately 2000 COVID-19 tests are carried out daily in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment worden dagelijks ongeveer 2000 COVID-2019 tests uitgevoerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over nieuwe Nederlandse kritiek op het Israëlische woningbouwbeleid

MP Baudet asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands joined EU partners in criticising Israeli housing plans in East Jerusalem and the West Bank, and why Dutch diplomats live in East rather than West Jerusalem. The minister defended the demarche as consistent with the two-state policy and Dutch embassy location in Tel Aviv, while committing to no change in position.
The cabinet does not recognise that picture.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de wijziging van historische temperatuurdata door het KNMI

An MP from FvD asked the minister why 1947–1950 parallel measurements at De Bilt were not used in homogenisation, whether KNMI overcorrected warm days, why only Eelde was used as reference, who supervises KNMI and why it would not respond substantively to CLINTEL, and asked for publication of the R code. The minister denied overcorrection, defended the method and Eelde choice, pointed to supervision by a Raad van toezicht and open data, and committed to publishing the R scripts within weeks.
KNMI will make the source code (in the form of R scripts) used for the homogenisation publicly available within a few weeks.
Het KNMI zal de broncode (in de vorm van de R-scripts) die is gebruikt voor de homogenisatie binnen enkele weken publiek beschikbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de correspondentie tussen het KNMI en CLINTEL

The MP Baudet asked the minister whether the KNMI should continue its discussion with the CLINTEL group about climate science, what areas the KNMI finds its own expertise insufficient in, and whether KNMI public communication should reflect scientific uncertainty. The minister answered that the KNMI is willing to discuss peer-reviewed work, that climate advice rests on a broad international IPCC-based scientific foundation, and that KNMI communication already includes uncertainties.
Climate policy advice has a broad, internationally validated scientific basis.
De beleidsadvisering op het gebied van klimaat heeft een brede internationale gevalideerde wetenschappelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het onderbrengen van IS-kinderen bij IS-aanhangers

MP Baudet asked whether placing IS-returnee children with grandparents flagged as IS sympathisers risks transmitting extremist ideology, how the child protection council and the national extremism support point missed the warning, and whether the council neglected its statutory duty. The minister answered that no radicalisation indicators were found at placement, that procedures were followed, and referred to a separate evaluation letter for the details and improvement points.
The Child Protection Council followed the agreed procedure.
De RvdK heeft de afgesproken procedure doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het  brandveiligheidsrisico van elektrische auto’s

An FvD MP asked the Justice and Security and Housing ministers about fire safety risks of electric cars, including blaze-fighting difficulty, parking garage rules and research. The government answered that no extra fire risks are known, that electric cars are at least as safe as combustion cars per TNO, and that updated research and building norms are underway.
There are so far no known additional fire safety risks.
Er zijn vooralsnog geen extra brandveiligheidsrisico’s bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het rapport 'Politiek en Sociale Media Manipulatie'

An FvD MP asks the Interior Minister whether the government endorses a commissioned report that labels news sites as junk versus mainstream and calls a commenter suspicious, and whether it will refrain from interfering with media, algorithms and Russian election interference claims. The minister replies that the report is independent academic research, that the government does not qualify media and will not restrict press freedom, and that no evidence of state-sponsored disinformation in recent elections was found, while still citing ongoing Russian influence activity and noting ongoing transparency efforts.
It is not for the government to determine which media reporting is true or false.
Het is niet aan de overheid om te bepalen welke berichtgeving door media waar of niet waar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het advies van de commissie-Remkes over de stikstofkwestie

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the German and Belgian nitrogen approaches, the costs of keeping the Dutch norm, lowering the livestock herd, the reliability of the AERIUS model and lowering motorway speed limits are justified. The minister answered that Dutch nitrogen norms cannot follow the German approach because the Council of State ruled the PAS threshold legally untenable, that AERIUS is the best available model, and that speed-limit reductions will be studied regionally.
In view of the Council of State ruling, the Dutch nitrogen norms will not be adjusted to the German example.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de Raad van State worden de normen in Nederland voor het stikstofbeleid niet aangepast aan het Duitse voorbeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het vereenvoudigen van het belastingsysteem

An FvD MP asked whether the Dutch tax, premium, allowance and benefit system could be replaced by a near flat tax plus a household standard allowance, and whether the CPB should check the author's calculations and extend them to self-employed, pensioners and students. The minister acknowledged the complexity and cited a marginal-pressure study and ongoing reform work, but said simplification always has a trade-off and that parties may ask the CPB to model proposals themselves.
Political parties are free to have proposals costed by the CPB.
Het staat politieke partijen vrij om voorstellen door het CPB te laten doorrekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het Democratiefestival in Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the cost and visitor numbers of the Democracy Festival in Nijmegen, whether the minister supports binding referendums, and what steps are taken to renew democracy. The minister reported a ministry subsidy of about €767,000 to the VNG plus smaller contributions, roughly 6,417 participants and about €158 per person, and said the binding corrective referendum is being studied carefully in a phased approach without anticipating a final decision.
The cabinet attaches importance to not anticipating the definitive policy position for now.
Het kabinet hecht eraan nu niet vooruit te lopen op de definitieve standpuntbepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de politie

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked the Justice Minister about police diversity policy, including how diversity is defined and measured, recruitment targets, and a Muslim slaughter-offering meat sale. The Minister defends diversity as necessary for police legitimacy, explains the 25% recruitment target and CBS measurements, and largely answers on substance while declining to provide breakdowns by religion or ethnicity citing lack of legal basis.
There is no legal basis for linking personnel data to cultural background.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag om personeelsgegevens te koppelen aan culturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers whether citizens are entitled to full information on the costs of climate policy, including PBL and CPB cost figures for the Klimaatakkoord, the effects of road pricing on remote residents, and whether existing climate policy should be included in the calculations and a second opinion obtained. Minister Wiebes answered that PBL puts national extra costs at 1.6 to 1.9 billion euros in 2030, CPB puts household burdens of the draft accord at 0.3 billion and total household energy and climate burdens at 3.3 billion, that road-pricing effects cannot yet be assessed, and that the planning bureaus themselves decide on their work programmes and no separate budget was set aside.
Because it is not yet clear whether and in what form road pricing will be introduced in the future, this question cannot be answered.
Omdat het nog niet duidelijk is of en welke vorm van rekeningrijden op termijn wordt ingevoerd is deze vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de problemen inzake het asielbeleid

Baudet (FvD) asks the state secretary for Justice and Security about alleged failures of asylum policy, including mass immigration, asylum backlogs, penalty payments, criminality and safety in reception centres, Syrian residence permits, illegal residents, pardons and border controls. The state secretary rejects the claim of a failing asylum policy, answers most questions in general terms, withholds or does not provide several figures, and points to ongoing reviews and the integrated migration agenda.
No, I do not acknowledge that there is a failing asylum policy.
Nee, dat er sprake is van een falend asielbeleid erken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de massale kap van Nederlandse bossen

An MP from FvD asked the ministers about mass deforestation in the Netherlands, the amount of wood harvested, and the use of forest biomass for energy despite KNAW and RIVM warnings. The minister said there is no overall list of forests slated for felling, that provinces are inventorying conversions under Natura 2000 and PAS, and that biomass is considered sustainable under international criteria, while promising a forest strategy with the provinces and a review of ISDE and emission standards.
No, I do not have such an overview.
Nee, ik beschik niet over zo’n overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Baudet over de twijfels van het bedrijfsleven over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

MPs Stoffer and Baudet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about business doubts over the costs of climate policy, including PBL and Navigant cost estimates, the affordability of home insulation and industry investment, and public support for the energy transition. The minister largely defended the PBL analysis, citing methodological differences, promised cost reduction efforts and further transparency on models, and gave no commitment to new parliamentary oversight measures.
I share the importance of open and testable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat China geen zonne- en windenergieprojecten meer zal steunen

Baudet asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that China will stop supporting solar and wind projects unless they are cheaper than coal, and about the implications for global CO2 emissions and Dutch coal plant closures. Minister Wiebes answers that China's subsidy cuts aimed to slow grid-overloading growth, that global emissions effects depend on many factors, and gives Dutch and Chinese coal and CO2 figures, plus an estimate of the Dutch coal ban's modest effect.
The proposed ban on the use of coal makes an important contribution to this.
Het voorgenomen verbod op het gebruik van kolen levert hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij EUROGENDFOR

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether EUROGENDFOR was involved in suppressing the yellow vest protests in France, how many Dutch officials serve in it, and whether the Macron government acted excessively. The minister denied EUROGENDFOR involvement, explained it operates only in third countries after unanimous decisions, reported eight Dutch staff, and declined to judge a French internal matter.
Nee, dit kan ik niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het voornemen van de Staatssecretaris tot ondertekenen namens de Nederlandse regering van het Global Compact for Migration (“Marrakesh Immigratiepact”)

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Netherlands' planned signing of the UN Global Compact for Migration, its legal status, its binding effect, and its implications for migration policy. The government answers that the Compact is non-binding, that Dutch policy freedom is preserved, and that the optional measures largely fit existing policy, while defending its position on migration, detention, smuggling and integration.
The GCM is not a legally binding document. It is also not a treaty and is therefore not ratified by member states.
Het GCM is geen juridisch bindend document. Het is ook geen verdrag en wordt daarom ook niet geratificeerd door lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Baudet, De Roon en Voordewind over de Nederlandse instemming met een Palestijns voorzitterschap van de G77

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN resolution granting the Palestinian delegation rights to chair the G77, given the resolution's reference to a "Palestinian State" and the Netherlands not recognising such a state. The minister answered that the rights are temporary and limited to the 2019 chairmanship, that the Netherlands reaffirmed its non-recognition in a vote explanation, and that the Kingdom will keep clarifying its position where needed.
At the same time, the Kingdom reaffirmed its long-standing consistent position on the non-recognition of the "State of Palestine" in a vote explanation.
Tegelijkertijd heeft het Koninkrijk zijn jarenlange consistente positie ten aanzien van de niet-erkenning van de «Staat Palestina» in een stemverklaring herbevestigd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over voedingskosten van militairen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about new rules requiring soldiers to register their own food costs, including whether daily clocking-in and attendance tracking are needed and what is being done about bureaucracy fatigue among personnel. The government answered that the new allowance regulation removes the own-household condition, introduces a declaration scheme, requires only a monthly check on a self-chosen time that takes about ten minutes, and that rules are being simplified and powers delegated to lower commanders.
The soldier can check the pre-filled declaration for accuracy once a month, at a self-chosen time.
De militair kan één keer per maand, op een zelfgekozen tijdstip, de reeds voor hem ingevulde declaratie op juistheid controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de inkoop van materieel

Baudet (FvD) asked why Defence's clothing and equipment bureau KPU failed to buy enough winter jackets before an exercise in Norway, whether soldiers must buy equipment themselves, and how procurement is supervised. The Secretary of State answered that the underwear layer was delivered, that soldiers buy items themselves only in exceptional cases with permission, and described existing internal oversight and budget figures without committing to new structural measures beyond referring to earlier letters.
It is not known how often this exactly happens because it is not registered.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dit precies gebeurt omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de asielindustrie

An MP asked the State Secretary about asylum procedure length, backlogs, child cases, subsidies to refugee organisations, a discretionary residence permit for Armenian children, and appeal procedures. The government answered with figures, stated it would not grant a general pardon, and said it will set up an independent inquiry and streamline procedures.
The figures you requested cannot be generated from the IND data warehouse.
De door u gevraagde cijfers zijn niet te genereren uit het datawarehouse van de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over in AZC’s gescheiden Christenen en Moslims

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that asylum centre staff separate Christians and Muslims in rooms to prevent problems, and about the scale of nuisance by some residents. The State Secretary said mixed rooming is the standard, separate placement is not structural, COA may tailor rooms in tension situations, and data on religion and ethnicity are not systematically registered so the requested overview cannot be given.
Data on, among other things, ethnicity and religion are not systematically recorded in COA's automated systems.
Gegevens over onder meer etniciteit en religie worden niet structureel geregistreerd in de geautomatiseerde systemen van het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de legionella uitbraak op de kazerne te Schaarsbergen

An MP from FvD asked the State Secretary of Defence about a Legionella finding in building 107 at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the lack of working toilets and showers, complaints from soldiers, and budget for remediation. The State Secretary answered that a standard precautionary test found non-pneumophila Legionella without a health risk, that affected taps were taken out of use and thermally flushed, and that remediation is handled by the property agency under standard procedures.
However, with every exceedance of the norm, Defence takes measures.
Bij elke overschrijding van de norm neemt Defensie echter maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over kosten van de klimaatmaatregelen en de energietransitie

MP Baudet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the total costs of climate and energy transition measures, household burdens to 2030, staffing, and the expected climate effects. The minister said no total figure can be given, listed budget clusters for 2018 and noted that the 2030 national cost is estimated at 3 to 4 billion euro per year, with household costs to be clarified after the Klimaatakkoord is costed.
A total amount for all costs of climate- and energy-related measures cannot simply be given.
Een totaalbedrag voor alle kosten van klimaat- en energiegerelateerde maatregelen is niet zomaar te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over op welke punten de minister-president overtuigd is in het debat over de Algemene Beschouwingen van dit jaar

Baudet (FvD) asked the Prime Minister on which points he had changed his mind during the 2018 Algemene Beschouwingen debate, what his prior position was, and which arguments and speakers persuaded him. Rutte replied that he addressed questions and positions extensively in the debate and gave the cabinet's view on motions, referring to the parliamentary record without naming any changed positions.
I responded extensively during the debate to the questions and positions of the members.
Ik ben tijdens het debat uitvoerig ingegaan op de vragen en standpunten van de leden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de uitspraken van Duitse Minister Altmaier inzake de Energiewende

An MP asked the ministers about German Minister Altmaier's claims that renewable energy is costly, that the EU target is unreachable and that subsidies could end within five years, plus a critical report on wind-energy cost sharing. The minister rejected the cost claims as based on outdated feed-in tariffs and flawed assumptions, agreed subsidies may phase out in four to five years at the optimistic end, and defended the gas and nuclear positions.
With the intentions in its own coalition agreement, Germany is one of the most ambitious EU member states regarding the share of renewable energy in the total energy mix.
Met de voornemens in haar eigen regeerakkoord is Duitsland één van de meest ambitieuze EU-lidstaten als het gaat om het aandeel hernieuwbare energie als onderdeel van de totale energiemix.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hiddema en Baudet over het bericht 'extreemlinkse activisten blijven meestal onbestraft'

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether left-wing extremist activists enjoy de facto impunity, as suggested by a WODC report, and what the government will do about it. The minister disagreed with that conclusion, citing difficulties of proof and that in three of seven cases the suspect was convicted, and said extremism of any kind is prosecuted case by case.
Where extremist conduct constitutes a criminal offence, the Public Prosecution Service will investigate as far as possible and assess whether to prosecute.

Wanneer er sprake is van extremistische gedragingen die een strafbaar feit opleveren, zal het OM voor zover mogelijk onderzoek instellen en beoordelen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het financiële fiasco rondom het Haagse Institute for Global Justice (IGJ)

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked about the financial collapse of the Hague Institute for Global Justice (IGJ), its government subsidies, the oversight failures of its supervisory board chair Dick Benschop, and whether his nomination as Schiphol CEO should be suspended. The government answered that the subsidy was properly spent on the basis of accountability documents, that the Rijk is not liable for debts, that IGJ was declared bankrupt, and that it sees no reason for an investigation or to suspend Benschop's appointment.
Based on the accountability documents, there are no indications that the subsidy was not spent in accordance with its purpose and conditions.
Op basis van de verantwoordingsdocumenten zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de subsidie niet conform het doel waarvoor en de voorwaarden waaronder deze verleend is, is besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over nepnieuws

MPs Baudet asked the Minister of Interior about the EU East StratCom Task Force's labelling of Dutch articles as fake news, its membership, funding, criteria, and the planned NU.nl/Facebook fake-news cooperation. The Minister answered that the government does not assess article content, that it targets state-sponsored disinformation rather than 'fake news', that the Task Force's budget is EU-funded, and that there is no legal agreement or register, while declining to judge specific media outlets.
Legal proceedings have been brought regarding three of the articles in this database. I do not wish to comment on those.
Ten aanzien van drie van de berichten uit deze database is een rechtszaak aangespannen. Daar wil ik niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over Wifi op de kazerne in Schaarsbergen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about alcohol, drug, prostitution and bullying problems at the Schaarsbergen barracks, linked to boredom and poor internet, TV and mobile reception there. The state secretary acknowledged the problems and said boredom is no excuse for misconduct, while describing ongoing measures to improve bandwidth, mobile coverage and evening activities, with broadband upgrades planned for Schaarsbergen within six months.
Boredom can never be an excuse for misconduct.
Verveling kan nooit een excuus zijn voor normoverschrijdend gedrag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de intrekking van het Nederlanderschap

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether concrete steps had been taken to revoke Dutch nationality from jihadists under the new article 14(4), and why prosecution might be preferred over administrative revocation. The Minister replied that nationality has been revoked in four cases and a further intention announced in one, that revocation is weighed case by case against criminal enforcement, and that the Public Prosecution Service decides on criminal investigations.
I have revoked Dutch nationality in four cases under article 14, paragraph 4, of the Nationality Act.
Ik heb in vier gevallen het Nederlanderschap ingetrokken op grond van artikel 14, vierde lid, Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht ‘Op geluidsopnamen is te horen hoe dit reddingsschip contact heeft met mensensmokkelaars’

An MP asks whether NGO rescue missions in the Mediterranean facilitate people smuggling, whether Dutch-flagged NGO ships and subsidies exist, and about Dutch responsibility and cooperation with Italy. The government answers that most NGOs act under maritime law at Italy's request, that only one ship (Iuventa) is on the Dutch register, that no subsidies are paid for Mediterranean operations, and that Italian investigation findings should be awaited.
No statements are made about ongoing (criminal) investigations.
Over lopende (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken worden geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht 'Stationsschip Zr. Ms. Zeeland gerepareerd en bevindt zich weer op zee in Caribisch gebied'

Baudet (FvD) asked the Defence Minister whether the Zeeland station ship should be redeployed to the Mediterranean given the migration flows from Africa, and what measures the government takes against those flows. The minister answered that the ship is needed in the Caribbean for coast guard tasks, that Dutch navy ships already serve Mediterranean operations, and that the EU-wide approach and NATO support to EUNAVFOR MED Sophia address the migration problem.
Defence makes a station ship available to the Coast Guard in the Caribbean for 92 sea days per year to carry out law enforcement tasks.
Defensie stelt voor 92 vaardagen per jaar een stationsschip beschikbaar aan de Kustwacht in het Caribisch gebied voor de uitvoering van rechtshandhavingstaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het artikel ‘Akzo en ministerie spanden samen tegen PPG, blijkt uit mails’

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that AkzoNobel and the ministry coordinated against PPG, and whether two VVD-linked AkzoNobel supervisory board members created a perception of conflict of interest. The minister acknowledged the board composition and declined to see any conflict of interest or harm to political integrity, without addressing the substance of the coordination reports.
I do not see why conflict of interest or harm to the standing of politics would be at issue in any way.
Ik zie niet waarom belangenverstrengeling of het schaden van het aanzien van de politiek op enigerlei wijze aan de orde zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.

m: Motie van de leden Yücel en Ulenbelt over het vierogenprincipe als verplicht onderdeel van het veiligheidsplan
Motion asking government to make the four-eyes principle a mandatory part of childcare safety plans and fix it in the implementing decree.
requests the government to make the four-eyes principle a mandatory part of the safety plan in line with the Gunning committee advice
verzoekt de regering om, het vierogenprincipe conform advies commissie-Gunning een verplicht onderdeel te maken van het veiligheidsplan
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over gelijktrekken van de regels voor ouderparticipatiecrèches
Asks the government to equalise childcare allowance rules for parent-participation crèches that meet the same safety and quality standards.
requests the government to equalise the childcare allowance rules for all parent-participation crèches that meet the same safety and quality conditions
verzoekt de regering, de regels rondom kinderopvangtoeslag voor alle opc's, nu en in de toekomst, die bewezen aan dezelfde veiligheids- en kwaliteitsvoorwaarden voldoen, gelijk te trekken
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Yücel ter vervanging van nr. 8 over kennis van houders, management en toezichthouders
Replaces an earlier amendment to require that childcare providers, management and supervisory board members have adequate knowledge of responsible childcare, set by general administrative order.
Rules will also be set on how the provider ensures that directors and members of the supervisory body have sufficient knowledge
Tevens worden regels gesteld ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de houder verzekert dat bestuurders en leden van het toezichthoudende orgaan
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over kennis van houders, management en toezichthouders
Amendment would require rules ensuring that board members and supervisory directors of childcare providers have sufficient knowledge of quality childcare.
Rules will also be set on how the provider ensures that board members and supervisory board members have sufficient knowledge.
Tevens worden regels gesteld ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de houder verzekert dat bestuurders en leden van het toezichthoudende orgaan
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ulenbelt ter vervanging van nr. 15 dat het wettelijk minimumloon vanaf 18 jaar instelt (NU) en tevens een staffel introduceert vanaf 15 jaar
Amends the minimum wage bill to set the statutory minimum wage from age 18 with a graduated scale from age 15 onward, and aligns related laws.
In subsection 1, '22 years' is replaced by: 18 years.
In onderdeel 1 wordt «22 jaar» vervangen door: 18 jaar.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ulenbelt ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een verbod op stukloon
Replaces an earlier amendment to ban piece-rate pay entirely, requiring wages to be set by time and limiting piece-rate arrangements in the Civil Code.
Wages in money are set only on the basis of time.
Het loon in geld wordt alleen naar tijdruimte vastgesteld.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ulenbelt ter vervanging van nr. 8 dat het wettelijk minimumloon vanaf 18 jaar instelt (NU) en tevens een staffel introduceert vanaf 15 jaar
Amends the minimum wage bill so the statutory minimum applies from age 18 and introduces age-based percentages for 17, 16 and 15 year olds.
In item 1, '22 years' is replaced by: 18 years.
In onderdeel 1 wordt «22 jaar» vervangen door: 18 jaar.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over een verbod op stukloon
Amends Book 7 of the Civil Code to ban piece-rate wages, requiring time-based pay except for seafarers' fishing, a labour-law change affecting private employers and workers.
Wages in money shall only be fixed by time.
Het loon in geld wordt slechts naar tijdruimte vastgesteld.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat het wettelijk minimumloon vanaf 18 jaar instelt (NU) en tevens een staffel introduceert vanaf 15 jaar
Amendment introducing a statutory minimum wage from age 18 with a graduated scale from age 15, and adjusting related laws and benefit rules.
the employee who has reached age 15 is entitled to wages of at least 70 percent of the minimum wage
