De werknemer die de leeftijd van 15 jaar heeft bereikt heeft voor de arbeid door hem in dienstbetrekking verricht, jegens de werkgever recht op een loon ten minste tot 70 procent
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor werknemers uit Midden- en Oost-Europa
Asks the government to reintroduce work permits for workers from Central and Eastern European countries, citing exploitation, underpayment and displacement.
requests the government to introduce work permits for workers from Central and Eastern European countries
verzoekt de regering, tewerkstellingsvergunningen in te voeren voor werknemers uit Midden- en Oost-Europese landen
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over definitief schrappen van de kostendelersnorm in de AOW
Asks the government to permanently scrap the cost-sharer norm (kostendelersnorm) in the AOW pension, which had been postponed to 2019.
requests the government to definitively scrap the introduction of the cost-sharer norm in the AOW
verzoekt de regering, de invoering van de kostendelersnorm in de AOW definitief te schrappen
Motie van het lid Karabulut  c.s. over handhaven van het verbod op doorbrengen van de weekendrust in de vrachtwagen
Asks the government to actively enforce the ban on truck drivers spending their weekly rest period in their vehicle and to report results to parliament.
requests the government to actively enforce the rules on the ban on spending the weekend rest in the lorry and to inform the House of Representatives of the results
verzoekt de regering, de regels omtrent het verbod op het doorbrengen van de weekendrust in de vrachtauto actief te handhaven en de Tweede Kamer van de resultaten op de hoogte te stellen
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over aanpassing van de Overbruggingsregeling AOW
Motion asking the government to adjust the AOW bridging scheme so that people without prior work and without an benefit bridging to AOW age receive a benefit equal to the AOW level.
requests the government to adjust the bridging scheme
verzoekt de regering, de overbruggingsregeling aan te passen
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over maatregelen tegen verdringing en uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten
Asks the government to inventory national measures against displacement and exploitation of migrant workers and send them to the House before the elections.
requests the government to inventory which national measures the Netherlands can still take before the elections and send these proposals to the House
verzoekt de regering, te inventariseren welke nationale maatregelen Nederland nog voor de verkiezingen kan nemen en deze voorstellen naar de Kamer te zenden
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over afschaffing van de kostendelersnorm voor alle doelgroepen voor 2017
Asks the government to abolish the cost-sharing rule (kostendelersnorm) for all benefit groups before 2017.
requests the government to abolish the cost-sharing rule for all target groups before 2017
verzoekt de regering, de kostendelersnorm voor alle doelgroepen voor 2017 af te schaffen
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over structurele middelen voor nieuwe banen voor langdurig bijstandsgerechtigden
Asks government to make 254 million euro structurally available to municipalities for jobs for long-term welfare recipients at 110% of minimum wage.
requests the government to structurally make 254 million euro from the social domain integration grant available to municipalities
verzoekt de regering om, structureel 254 miljoen euro uit de integratie-uitkering Sociaal domein beschikbaar te stellen voor gemeenten
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Kerstens ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het recht op een second opinion
Requires occupational physicians to always honour an employee's request for a second opinion from another occupational physician.
We must prevent an occupational physician from being able to block the route to a second opinion.
We moeten voorkomen dat een bedrijfsarts de weg naar een second opinion kan blokkeren.
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Kerstens ter vervanging van nr. 10 over de meldingsplicht over beroepsziekten
Shifts the duty to report occupational diseases to employers and makes the employer's failure to report an offence.
The health of employees on the shop floor is the responsibility of the employer.
De gezondheid van werknemers op de werkvloer is een verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever.
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Tanamal ter vervanging van nr. 8 over verplichte advisering over preventieve maatregelen
Amendment requires company doctors to advise on preventive occupational health measures as a minimum element of the basic contract.
the company doctor advises on preventive measures concerning general occupational health policy
de bedrijfsarts adviseert over preventieve maatregelen betreffende het algemeen arbeidsomstandighedenbeleid
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over verplichte advisering over preventieve maatregelen
Adds preventive occupational health advice by the company doctor to the mandatory basic contract on working conditions policy.
the company doctor advises on preventive measures concerning general working conditions policy
de bedrijfsarts adviseert over preventieve maatregelen betreffende het algemeen arbeidsomstandighedenbeleid
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over het recht op een second opinion
Gives workers an unconditional right to a second opinion from another occupational physician, removing the exception for serious counter-arguments.
With this amendment workers always get the right to a second opinion from another occupational physician.
Met dit amendement krijgen werknemers altijd het recht op een second opinion bij een andere bedrijfsarts.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over de meldingsplicht over beroepsziekten
Amendment shifting the duty to report occupational diseases to the employer, who reports to the designated supervisor, with non-compliance made an offence.
The employer reports occupational diseases to the designated supervisor and to an institution designated by the Minister.
De werkgever meldt beroepsziekten aan de daartoe aangewezen toezichthouder, en een door Onze Minister hiertoe aangewezen instelling.
Motie van het lid Pieter Heerma c.s. over de capaciteit van de Inspectie SZW

Asks the government to examine whether the capacity of the Inspectie SZW is still sufficient given rising pressure in risk sectors and growing legal complexity, and to present this analysis before the budget debate.
Requests the government to examine to what extent the capacity of the Inspectie SZW is still sufficient.
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken in hoeverre de capaciteit van de Inspectie SZW nog toereikend is
Motie van het lid Schut-Welkzijn c.s. over de bestrijding van ouderenwerkloosheid
Motion asking the government to record and report the reach, costs and measured effectiveness of measures against older-worker unemployment in the 2017 budget.
requests the government to ensure that, not only for the future but also for current policy against older-worker unemployment, as much as possible is recorded
verzoekt de regering, ervoor zorg te dragen dat niet alleen voor de toekomst, maar ook voor het huidige beleid ter bestrijding van ouderenwerkloosheid zo veel mogelijk vast te leggen
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat beoogt het instemmingsrecht ten aanzien van de arbeidsvoorwaarde pensioen te verbreden naar ondernemingen met tussen de 10 en 50 werknemers
Amendment extending works council co-decision rights on the pension employment condition to firms with 10 to 50 employees, including personnel meetings where no council exists.
This amendment aims to extend the consent right to companies with between 10 and 50 employees.
Dit amendement beoogt het instemmingsrecht te verbreden naar ondernemingen met tussen de 10 en 50 werknemers.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat voorziet in een compensatie van de onzekerheid van seizoenwerkers in verband met de kortere tussenpoos tussen arbeidsovereenkomsten voor bepaalde tijd
Gives seasonal workers in sectors using shorter gaps between fixed-term contracts a payment of one third of monthly wage at the start of each gap.
This amendment provides compensation for employees' uncertainty.
Dit amendement voorziet in een compensatie voor de onzekerheid van werknemers
Motie van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Weyenberg over de capaciteit van de Inspectie SZW
Asks the government to monitor that new tasks of the Inspectie SZW do not reduce its inspection capacity and to propose remedies to the House if they do.
requests the government to closely monitor that the additional tasks do not lead to a reduction in inspection capacity
verzoekt de regering, scherp in de gaten te houden dat de extra taken niet leiden tot een vermindering van de inspectiecapaciteit
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat regelt dat bij detachering ook het verblijfadres in Nederland en het bankrekeningnummer van de gedetacheerde werknemer worden doorgegeven aan de Inspectie SZW
Requires employers of posted workers to also report the worker's Dutch residence address and bank account number to the Inspectie SZW.
an obligation to pass on the residence address in the Netherlands and the bank account number to the Inspectie SZW
een verplichting om het verblijfadres in Nederland en het bankrekeningnummer door te geven aan de Inspectie SZW

Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat regelt dat een pensioenfonds verplicht is aanspraken over te nemen, indien aanspraken worden overgedragen aan een (beroeps)pensioenfond en de deelnemer reeds aanspr
Amendment obliges a pension fund to accept transferred entitlements when the member already holds entitlements with that fund.
the pension fund is obliged to act as receiving pension administrator
is het pensioenfonds gehouden als ontvangende pensioenuitvoerder op te treden
Motie van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over opschorten van de sollicitatieplicht voor 60-plussers
Asks the government to suspend the job-search obligation for people aged 60 and over.
requests the government to suspend the job-search obligation for people aged 60 and over
verzoekt de regering om de sollicitatieplicht voor mensen van 60 jaar en ouder op te schorten
Motie van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over proeven met anoniem solliciteren
Asks government to start trials with anonymous job applications and mystery guests in recruitment to tackle labour market discrimination.
requests the government, together with one or more municipalities, to start trials with anonymous job applications
verzoekt de regering om, samen met een of meerdere gemeenten te starten met proeven met anoniem solliciteren
Motie van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over aanbieden van een kindpakket door alle gemeenten

Motie Ulenbelt over voortzetting van de regeling voor werktijdverkorting in 2009
Asks the government to continue the short-time working scheme in 2009, possibly adjusted.
requests the government to continue the short-time working scheme in 2009
verzoekt de regering om de regeling voor werktijdverkorting in 2009 voort te zetten
Motie Van Hijum c.s. over overdragen van de verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiering van de REA-scholingsinstituten
Asks the government to transfer financing responsibility for REA training institutions from SZW to the education ministry by 2011.
requests the government, in line with the SER advice, to transfer responsibility for financing the REA training institutions to the education ministry by 1 January 2011

verzoekt de regering om – conform het advies van de SER – de verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiering van de REA-scholingsinstituten uiterlijk per 1 januari 2011 over te dragen aan het ministerie van OCW
Motie Ulenbelt over aanwending van het vermogen van OPTAS voor de pensioenen van havenwerkers
Asks the government to have state commissioners at AEGON ensure the OPTAS fund assets go fully to port workers' pensions.
requests the government to instruct the state commissioners at AEGON to ensure the assets fully benefit the port workers' pensions
verzoekt de regering om de commissarissen van de overheid bij AEGON opdracht te geven, te bewerkstelligen dat het vermogen volledig ten goede komt aan de pensioenen van de havenwerkers
Motie Ulenbelt over openstelling van de regeling voor werktijdverkorting voor uitzendkrachten
Asks the government to open the short-time working scheme to temporary agency workers at firms using the scheme.
requests the government to also open the short-time working scheme to employees working under an agency contract
verzoekt de regering om de regeling voor werktijdverkorting ook open te stellen voor werknemers die op basis van een uitzendovereenkomst werken
Motie Ulenbelt over aanpassing van de herbeoordelingseisen voor WAO'ers
Asks the government to adjust the re-assessment criteria for WAO recipients and to finance this by cutting the re-integration budget.
requests the government to adjust the re-assessment requirements
verzoekt de regering de herbeoordelingseisen aan te passen
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Lempens om het budget voor de Sociale Werkvoorziening structureel te verhogen
Shifts €200 million structurally from the re-integration budget to the sheltered employment budget (Sociale Werkvoorziening).
This amendment provides for a structural increase in the budget for Sociale Werkvoorziening of 200 million, charged to the re-integration budget.
Dit amendement regelt een structurele verhoging van het budget voor de Sociale Werkvoorziening met 200 miljoen ten laste van het re-integratie budget.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ulenbelt ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het schrappen van de mogelijkheid om loonkostensubsidies te gebruiken voor uitzendwerk
Amends the participation act to remove the possibility of using wage-cost subsidies for temporary agency work.
This amendment removes the possibility of using wage-cost subsidies for temporary agency work.
Dit amendement schrapt de mogelijkheid om loonkostensubsidies te gebruiken voor uitzendwerk.
Motie Ulenbelt over aanhouding van het wetsvoorstel over de invoering van een premiekorting
Motion asking the government to hold back (aanhouden) the premium discount bill until research shows it achieves its intended effect without unwanted effects.
requests the government to hold the bill back until it has been examined whether the premium discount leads to the desired effect
verzoekt de regering het wetsontwerp aan te houden totdat is onderzocht of premiekorting leidt tot het gewenste effect
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over het schrappen van de mogelijkheid om loonkostensubsidies te gebruiken voor uitzendwerk
Amends the participation act to delete the option of using wage-cost subsidies for temporary agency work.
Article I, part A, article 78a, second paragraph, is deleted.
Artikel I, onderdeel A, artikel 78a, tweede lid, vervalt.
Motie Ulenbelt over onderbrengen van de pensioenregeling van alle UWV-medewerkers bij het ABP
Asks the government to promote placing the pension scheme of all UWV employees with the ABP pension fund.
requests the government to promote placing the pension scheme of all UWV employees with pension fund ABP
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat de pensioenregeling van alle UWV-medewerkers wordt ondergebracht bij het pensioenfonds ABP
Motie Ulenbelt over overleg met gemeenten die een LWI-vestiging binnen de gemeentegrenzen willen houden
Asks the government to consult municipalities that want to keep a LWI office within their borders and help keep UWV branches there.
requests the government to enter into consultation with municipalities that want to keep an LWI office within their municipal borders
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met gemeenten die een LWI-vestiging binnen de gemeentegrenzen willen houden
Motie Ulenbelt over maximeren van de salarissen bij het UWV
Asks the government to cap salaries of the UWV management board at the average taxable pay of ministers.
requests the government to cap the salaries at the UWV at the average taxable pay of our ministers
verzoekt de regering de salarissen bij het UWV te maximeren op het gemiddelde belastbare loon van onze ministers
Motie Ulenbelt over vergoeden van de reiskosten naar een Locatie Werk en Inkomen buiten de grenzen van de eigen gemeenten
Asks the government to ensure reimbursement of travel costs at second-class public transport rates for people who must travel outside their municipality to a Locatie Werk en Inkomen.
receive reimbursement of travel costs based on second-class public transport
de reiskosten vergoed krijgen op basis van tweede klas openbaar vervoer
Motie van het lid Ulenbelt over uitvoeren van de activiteiten van UWV onder de naam Arbeidsbureau
Asks the government to have UWV carry out its mediation and reintegration activities under the name Arbeidsbureau.
requests the government to carry out the mediation and reintegration activities of UWV under the name Arbeidsbureau
verzoekt de regering de bemiddelings- en re-integratieactiviteiten van het UWV uit te voeren onder de naam Arbeidsbureau
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over het niet langer verplichten van het UWV om re-integratiebedrijven in te schakelen
Removes the obligation for UWV to use reintegration companies, except where specialist expertise is lacking, widening UWV's discretion over its reintegration budget.
Through this amendment the UWV is no longer obliged to engage reintegration companies.
Door dit amendement wordt het UWV niet langer verplicht om re-integratiebedrijven in te schakelen.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over het handhaven van het verbod op nevenfuncties van secretarissen van de SER
Deletes the bill's removal of the ban on side jobs for SER secretaries, keeping the ban that protects the independence of the advisory body.
This amendment ensures that the ban on side jobs remains in place.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat het verbod op nevenfuncties blijft bestaan.
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt over een draagvlakonderzoek
Would require professional bodies to test support among all entrepreneurs every four years instead of using a sample of 400 firms.
The support survey is conducted among a sample of 400 firms
Het draagvlakonderzoek wordt gehouden onder een steekproef van 400 ondernemingen
Amendement van het lid Ulenbelt dat voorziet in de handhaving van de korting op de bestemmingsheffingen
Amendment keeps the discount on trade-body levies by deleting a provision that would phase out the discount on the bestemmingsheffingen.
This amendment provides for maintaining the discount.
Dit amendement voorziet in handhaving van de korting.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat kinderopvangorganisaties ouders lokken met cadeaus

An SP MP asked the minister whether childcare providers' use of welcome gifts to attract parents, and their possible indirect use of public childcare allowance funds, was acceptable and should be investigated. The minister said gifts are not a problem if within the rules, declined to investigate or guarantee no public funds were used, and pointed to the quality reform bill and planned quality pilots instead.
No, I cannot do that. I have no insight into the internal business operations of private parties.
Nee, dat kan ik niet. Ik heb geen zicht op de interne bedrijfsvoering van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat DuPont honderden kilo’s formaldehyde heeft gelekt

Two SP MPs asked the government about a reported leak of 2,730 kg of carcinogenic formaldehyde at DuPont, whether it was allowed to keep using the substance despite a claimed European ban, what the effects on workers, residents and the environment are, and how the company's safety culture would be addressed. The state secretary answered that no ban exists but a minimisation duty applies, that a criminal complaint and joint provincial and Inspectie SZW investigations are underway, that an initial indication shows no harm to health or environment, and that some production lines were halted at the province's urging, while declining to pre-judge the investigation outcomes.

Because a criminal complaint about this incident has been filed with the Public Prosecution Service on behalf of the province of Zuid-Holland, the competent authority for this company, I do not consider it appropriate to give a further judgment at this time.

Omdat er van dit incident namens de provincie Zuid-Holland, het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, aangifte is gedaan bij het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet gepast op dit moment een nader oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat de financiën van toekomstige gepensioneerden zorgwekkend zijn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about Nibud/PwC findings that a quarter of future pensioners may have too little pension, and about related housing and care cost concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government wants all workers to build adequate pensions, points to existing financial-planning tools, and says care costs are cushioned by income-dependent contributions and compensation.

In the perspective note on the future of the pension system, the cabinet has indicated that it considers it important that all workers build up an adequate pension so that there is no major drop in spending power at retirement.

In de perspectiefnota over de toekomst van het pensioenstelsel heeft het kabinet aangegeven het van belang te vinden dat alle werkenden een toereikend pensioen opbouwen om bij pensionering geen grote terugval te hebben in bestedingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitstoot van kankerverwekkende stof door Chemours

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Chemours plant emits a carcinogenic substance (FRD-903/GenX) and whether animal tests showing effects like PFOA require consequences. The state secretary replied that FRD-903 is classified as toxic and persistent but not as carcinogenic, that RIVM is studying it further, and that workers' exposure falls under employers' duty of care supervised by the Inspectorate SZW.
I have therefore asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ulenbelt over de politie die actievoerende brandweerlieden intimideert

MPs Kerstens and Ulenbelt asked whether police contacting, phoning or visiting firefighters ahead of a union action intimidates them and whether this is acceptable given the right to strike. The government confirmed that police may seek information about planned actions as part of public order duties, denied that the approach was intimidation, and condemned any intimidation of strikers as a breach of the right to strike.
Actively contacting the persons involved in response to such signals by the police is one of the possibilities for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over “grote onrust bij Tata Steel"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment how he would respond to reports that a merger between Tata Steel Nederland and ThyssenKrupp could cause large job losses, whether he shared union and staff concerns, and what he would do to preserve jobs and the blast furnaces. The minister answered that the outcome of the talks is unclear, that the company is responsible for its personnel policy, and that the Ministry of Economic Affairs now acts as the government's contact point.
First of all, every company is responsible for its business operations and personnel policy.
Voorop staat dat iedere onderneming verantwoordelijk is voor zijn bedrijfsvoering en personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over asbest bij Bakkersland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos in bakery ovens at Bakkersland, raised by a Zembla broadcast, including inspection timing, inspection coverage, sanitation duties and support for victims. The minister answered that the Inspectorate SZW was informed in 2012 and 2014, that the ILT inspects companies with pre-1994 installations that report them, that there is no legal duty to remove asbestos from ovens, and that victims can turn to the Instituut Asbestslachtoffers.
Regarding the first incident, which occurred in 2011 at a Bakkersland branch in Wateringen, a municipal inspector contacted the Inspectorate SZW on 1 February 2012.
Over het eerste incident, dat in 2011 plaatsvond bij een vestiging van Bakkersland in Wateringen, nam op 1 februari 2012 een gemeentelijke inspecteur contact op met de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Gelijke rechten voor Poolse truckers’

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a court ruling granting equal pay to Polish truck drivers would lead UWV and the Tax Authority to collect premiums and taxes, and whether there is a standard procedure for recovering premiums after wage-claim judgments. The minister declined to comment on the merits of the FNV case, stated that higher wages lead to higher wage and premium liability, and explained that premium collection lies with the Tax Authority, which handles it through the normal payroll process.
I will not go further into the substance of the case brought by the FNV based on the Inspectorate SZW investigation supporting collective agreement compliance.
Op de inhoud van de zaak die de FNV heeft aangespannen op basis van onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW ter ondersteuning van cao-naleving, ga ik verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat de extreem lage rente ook bij de specialisten hard aan komt

MP Ulenbelt asked the State Secretary whether the very low interest rate hurting pension specialists means DNB and the AFM are wholly responsible for problems at their pension funds, and what the causes are and how they will be solved. The State Secretary answered that social partners and fund boards choose their ambitions, premiums and investment risks, that low rates tighten the trade-off between premium, risk and ambition, and that the government will not discuss individual funds but will respond to the SER exploration of alternative pension contracts before summer.
I do not want to go into the situation of individual pension funds.
Ik wil niet ingaan op de situatie van individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Zwangerschapsproblemen bij oud-medewerkers DuPont’

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of pregnancy problems among former DuPont workers, the role of the company health service and the labour inspectorate, whether to commission investigations, and whether to ask the Safety Board to investigate. The minister said the situation is serious, that he wants the facts laid out first with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved, and that a Safety Board investigation is not currently appropriate.
I now want to lay out the facts and will involve the Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) in this.
Ik wil nu de feiten op een rij zetten en zal de Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) daarbij betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht “dat er onderzoek komt naar de Arbeidsinspectie inzake DuPont”

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the minister whether the Labour Inspectorate's handling of the DuPont Lycra plant is being investigated and what the inquiry covers. The minister answered that the inquiry examines the use of DMAC, work processes and risk controls from the 1970s until the substances were no longer used, with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved and results due in November 2016.
In November 2016 you will receive the results of the investigation.
In november 2016 ontvangt u de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat basisartsen worden ingezet om personen met een WIA uitkering te herbeoordelen

The SP MP Ulenbelt asks whether deploying inexperienced junior doctors at UWV to clear the WIA re-assessment backlog compromises assessment quality, how they are recruited, and what responsibilities they carry. The minister answers that junior doctors receive a two-month WIA training, are supervised and co-signed by registered insurance physicians, and are not trained to full insurance-physician status for this operation.
A junior doctor receives a two-month training specifically aimed at carrying out WIA re-assessments.
Een basisarts krijgt een opleiding van twee maanden die specifiek gericht is op het doen van WIA-herbeoordelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat pensioenen steeds vaker naar België gaan om de kosten te drukken

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Dutch company pensions are increasingly moved to Belgium to cut costs, asking about reasons, consequences, governance, taxation and whether this exposes weaknesses in the Dutch system. The State Secretary answered that Belgian arrangements allow cheaper sponsor-guarantee treatment, that Dutch labour law, works council consent, DNB and AFM oversight still apply, that tax effects are limited, and that the IORP review aims to protect members while indexation remains a Dutch policy goal.
First, Dutch social and labour law remains applicable to this arrangement, so safeguards such as the prohibition on buy-out and the right to transfer value remain in force.
Ten eerste blijft het Nederlandse sociaal en arbeidsrecht van toepassing op deze regeling, waardoor waarborgen als het verbod op afkoop en het recht op waardeoverdracht van toepassing blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Honderden Tilburgers mogelijk blootgesteld aan chroom-6’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved in a Tilburg reintegration project where workers may have been exposed to chromium-6, and whether protective measures were checked. The Minister said the Inspectorate was not involved, that inspection on site is no longer possible, and that the Inspectorate will approach relevant sectors this year and provide guidance on chromium-6 protection.
The Labour Inspectorate was not active in this project.
De Inspectie SZW is niet actief geweest bij dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de berichten over een kwikvergiftiging bij AkzoNobel

MPs Ulenbelt asked the minister whether Inspectie SZW or the occupational health service had investigated mercury exposure at AkzoNobel in Hengelo, what led to a settlement over suspected mercury poisoning, and whether such settlements should be registered against the company. The minister answered that the Inspectie had no specific investigation beyond a 2003 routine inspection with a record-keeping warning, that the facts of the settlement were unknown to him, and that settlements are private matters for the government.
A company can reach a settlement with an injured party to avoid a lengthy procedure that may be burdensome for both parties.
Een bedrijf kan met een benadeelde tot een schikking komen om een lange procedure te vermijden die voor beide partijen belastend kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ulenbelt en Van Raak over riante beloning van de top van UWV

MPs Voortman, Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked why UWV top officials earn above the WNT pay cap, whether transitional rules and side jobs can be stopped, and whether the transitional arrangement should end. Minister Asscher answered that UWV complies with the WNT, that remaining above-cap pay is protected by transitional law and European property rights, and that side functions are permitted if done in own time.
UWV has informed me that it will enter into discussion with the non-top officials concerned about their remuneration relative to the WNT maximum.
UWV heeft mij laten weten met betrokken niet-topfunctionarissen het gesprek aan te gaan over hun bezoldiging in verhouding tot het vastgestelde bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitspraak van de rechter over het dagloonbesluit

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asks the minister of Social Affairs whether the government will close the 'WW-lek' after the court ruled the daily-wage decree (Dagloonbesluit) conflicts with the WW income-loss principle, and whether it will drop an appeal and admit the change was careless. The minister acknowledges the interim ruling but declines to react because the case is still before the court and appeal remains possible.
Because the case is still before the court (it is not a final ruling and appeal is still possible), I refrain, as is customary, from any response.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter ligt (het is geen einduitspraak en daarna is nog hoger beroep mogelijk) onthoud ik me, volgens goed gebruik, van elke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht "Sjoemeltransporten bij Mercedes blootgelegd"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of cheating transport arrangements at Mercedes involving low pay, per-kilometre pay and deductions for a damage fund, and whether the state would investigate and act. The minister said enforcement largely rests with workers and social partners, that the Inspectorate SZW does not comment on ongoing investigations, and promised legislative changes on piece-rate pay and deductions while committing to European-level action.
In line with normal practice, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate SZW.
Conform de normale werkwijze doe ik geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het langer doorwerken voor veel zestigplussers niet mee valt

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the state secretary for Social Affairs and Employment how the government responds to reports that working longer is hard for many people aged 60 and over, including the anger this causes, its effects on sick leave, unemployment among young and older workers, and widening inequality. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, defended the pension age increase as necessary due to ageing and the crisis, and pointed to existing measures and a forthcoming action plan for older workers.
In the spring an action plan should be ready with measures to further improve the labour market position of older people.
In het voorjaar moet er een actieplan gereed zijn met maatregelen die de arbeidsmarktpositie van ouderen verder moet verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de afrekencultuur en slechte arbeidsomstandigheden bij Pegatron in Breda

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a penalty-point system, a sudden dismissal of 86 agency workers and poor working conditions at Pegatron in Breda. The minister answered that the company must follow the law, that penalty points for sick leave are undesirable, that the Inspectorate found no current violations, and that the Inspectorate will assess any complaint carefully.
At the most recent inspection, no shortcomings were found.
Bij de laatste recente inspectie waren geen tekortkomingen geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat 2.000 chauffeurs in het streekvervoer dreigen met stakingen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether drivers' threatened strikes over volunteers replacing paid bus drivers in regional transport are justified, and how provinces handle the Brede doeluitkering and bus line cuts. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for public transport concessions, that volunteer arrangements are possible where no employment relationship or cao applies, and that she will consult provinces and metropolitan regions before reporting back to parliament.
Specifically regarding public transport, the provinces are responsible for the supply and the concession contract.
Specifiek met betrekking tot het openbaar vervoer (OV) zijn de provincies verantwoordelijk voor het aanbod en het concessiecontract.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het manifest van de gezamenlijke ouderenorganisaties

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the government takes seriously the joint elderly organisations' manifesto on pension funds and will act on it. The State Secretary acknowledged broad concern about pension fund coverage ratios, promised a May update to parliament including the elderly organisations' concerns, and noted the government repaired purchasing power for elderly and benefit recipients for 2016.
In May I will send you an update on the financial position of the pension funds, including an assessment by the cabinet.
In mei zal ik u een update sturen van de financiële positie van de pensioenfondsen, inclusief een appreciatie van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de sluiting van een parkeerplaats voor vrachtwagenchauffeurs bij Venlo

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the municipality of Venlo's closure of a truck parking area (Keulse Barrière), the blocked access road, the loss of a function for handing over escorts of exceptional transports, and whether the minister would seek a solution with the municipality. The minister replied that the municipality owns the site and decides on it, that the access was closed for safety reasons, that the exceptional-transport handover can take place at a dedicated site near the border, and that finding an alternative is not primarily the minister's responsibility, though regional parties are cooperating on parking solutions.
Proposing an alternative to the planned closure of the Keulse Barrière is not primarily my responsibility.
Het aandragen van een alternatief voor de voorgenomen sluiting van de Keulse Barrière zie ik niet primair als mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over problemen bij verrekening pensioen na echtscheiding

An SP MP asked about problems dividing pensions after divorce, including pre-1995 divorces, miscalculation by funds and insurers, and claims exceeding 100% of pension. The State Secretary answered that pre-1995 cases fall under case law (reasonableness and fairness), that no legal rules exist for calculation dates, that she knows of no such over-100% cases, and that she sees no need for new measures, pointing to the courts.
These divorces are governed by the case-law rule of reasonableness and fairness.
Deze scheidingen worden beheerst door de jurisprudentiële regeling van redelijkheid en billijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Klokkenluider aan de grond’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on a whistleblower blacklisted after exposing unpaid wages on the A2 tunnel project, and about whether affected workers received what they were owed. The minister said the misconduct is undesirable, that the Belastingdienst is in contact with the whistleblower, that the blacklisting is a matter between employer and employee for civil proceedings, and that the employer has not yet paid the court-ordered back wages under appeal.
This concerns a matter between employer and employee. It is therefore up to the employee to assess whether there are sufficient grounds to start civil proceedings against Rimec/Mecra's conduct.

Het betreft hier een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer. Het is dan ook aan de werknemer om de afweging te maken of er voldoende aanknopingspunten zijn om tegen de handelwijze van de Rimec/Mecra een civielrechtelijke procedure te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat veel beginnende ggz-krachten werken voor een onkostenvergoeding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether young mental health professionals working only for an expense allowance are owed the minimum wage or collective agreement wage, with retroactive effect, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The minister answered that whether wage is owed depends on the facts, that retroactive payment would apply if it is, and that the Inspectorate will investigate the institution and report when finished.
The Labour Inspectorate will investigate the institution concerned.
De Inspectie SZW gaat onderzoek doen naar de betrokken instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de misstanden bij distributiecentra

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions at distribution centres exposed by a current-affairs broadcast, including whether the Labour Inspectorate would stop work over immediate danger, whether it knew of the complaints, and whether it would check other centres. The minister answered that the inspectorate can act on its own observations or complaints, that the broadcast's cases were not reported to it, that an accident investigation at a Jumbo site started in December 2015, and that broadcast signals will feed into planned inspections.
The signals from the EenVandaag broadcast will be taken into account in preparing the upcoming (re)inspections.
De signalen uit de uitzending van EenVandaag worden meegenomen bij de voorbereiding van de komende (her) inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitvoering van de aanpassing van het Schattingsbesluit arbeidsongeschiktheidswetten

An SP MP asked the minister about the first experiences with the amended Schattingsbesluit, the income losses for disability benefit recipients, possible compensation, and notification timing. The minister answered that few people are affected so far, that UWV notifies recipients individually with a transition period to 1 July 2016, and that no additional compensation will be provided because the change saves UWV administration costs.
This means that only after 1 July 2016 could it be examined what the actual income loss has been.
Dit betekent dat pas na 1 juli 2016 onderzocht zou kunnen worden wat de feitelijke inkomensachteruitgang is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over FNV referendum over Loonruimteakkoord

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister to respond to the FNV referendum rejecting the public-sector wage deal and to detail how the other unions consulted their members. The minister regretted FNV's rejection but said union consultation procedures are internal matters and gave only general statements about a majority in favour.
The procedure for consulting the membership is an internal matter for the unions, and as usual the cabinet and employers do not interfere in it.
De procedure van achterbanraadpleging is een interne aangelegenheid van de bonden, zoals gebruikelijk mengen kabinet en werkgevers zich daar niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman en Ulenbelt over onveiligheid en beroepsziekten bij de brandweer

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on a broadcast reporting that about 130 fire stations fail safety requirements and that occupational cancer risks among firefighters are poorly monitored. The minister answered that the safety regions as employers are responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has given them six months to remedy shortcomings, and that a national 'clean work' guideline and further research are underway, while further action rests with the regions.
The Labour Inspectorate has given the safety regions 6 months to remedy the shortcomings.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de veiligheidsregio’s 6 maanden de tijd gegeven om de tekortkomingen op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over de omstandigheden bij het Europees octrooibureau in Rijswijk en de inzet van Nederland

SP MPs asked why the Dutch representative on the EPO Administrative Council supported 2013 strike restrictions and 2015 sick-leave rules, whether Dutch privacy and labour inspection apply to the EPO, and what Netherlands is doing about labour conflict. The State Secretary answered that the rules were modelled on ILO standards, that Netherlands pushed for safeguards and review, that the Netherlands joined the Supreme Court appeal on EPO immunity, and that the social dialogue has so far produced no concrete results.
However, if it turns out that intervention by a third party, for example through mediation, is indeed desirable, I would like to commit to that, in consultation with other countries.
Als echter blijkt dat interventie door een derde, bijvoorbeeld via mediation, inderdaad wenselijk wordt, dan wil ik mij daar graag, in samenspraak met andere landen, voor inzetten.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het meerekenen van stakingsdagen bij vaststelling van het dagloon (ingezonden 11 september 2015)

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV will stop automatically counting strike days when setting the daily wage after a court ruling, and whether the rule should be changed. The minister answered that the court confirmed the wage was correctly calculated, that the ruling only bars retroactive reductions of WW benefits, and that he intends to amend the Dagloonbesluit while assessing implementation consequences with UWV and the Tax Authority.
During the General Consultation of 23 September on WW daily wages, I informed the House that I intend to amend the Dagloonbesluit on this point.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 23 september jl. over WW-daglonen heb ik uw Kamer gemeld dat ik voornemens ben om het dagloonbesluit hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat sommige werkgevers zieke werknemers onbetaald in dienst houden om de ontslagvergoeding te ontlopen

An SP MP asked the minister whether employers keeping sick workers unpaid on payroll to avoid transition payments is a problem, what measures will be taken, whether UWV can track such cases, and whether the law should let such workers terminate and claim the transition payment. The minister found this not decent employment practice but considered existing rules (re-integration duties and the court route under the Wwz) sufficient, said UWV lacks data to identify such cases, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for question 4.
I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Aanvullende maatregelen acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ulenbelt en Krol over de aanpassing in de Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) voor pensioenfondsen

MPs Omtzigt, Ulenbelt and Krol asked the state secretary about the change to the Ultimate Forward Rate for pension funds, including its effects on contributions, wages, recovery plans and transfers of value. The state secretary answered that the UFR was set by DNB following the advice of an independent committee, and gave estimates of effects while stating that many outcomes remain uncertain.
I expect that I can inform you at the end of September about the outcomes of this study.
Ik verwacht dat ik u eind september over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het wegvallen van inkomsten als gevolg van een uitspraak van KiFiD over een WAO-gat verzekering

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether insurers must close the AOW gap for already-sick WAO-gap policyholders after a KiFiD ruling, and about the resulting income losses of up to EUR 10,000. The state secretary said the OBR bridging scheme covers those who were already receiving private disability benefits on 1 January 2013 and refused further compensation or investigation.
No. These people can, provided they meet the conditions, apply for the temporary AOW bridging benefit scheme (OBR).
Nee. Deze mensen kunnen mits zij aan de voorwaarden voldoen een beroep doen op de tijdelijke regeling overbruggingsuitkering AOW (OBR).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Ulenbelt over het feit dat Inretail een principeakkoord fashion en sport heeft gesloten met Alternatief voor vakbond

MPs Dijkgraaf and Ulenbelt asked whether a collective agreement between Inretail and the small union Alternatief voor vakbond could set terms for most workers in the sector, how extension (avv) is assessed, and how disproportionate effects can be prevented. The minister answered that such agreements bind non-members only indirectly, that membership numbers play little role in representativeness, that extension is discretionary and can be refused, and that the government does not decide which unions should sign.
In principle it is not for the Minister to "intervene" in collective agreements or to have a view on their content.
Het is in principe niet aan de Minister om «in te grijpen» in cao’s of om een oordeel te hebben over de inhoud daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over zieke werknemers die samen met de FNV aangifte doen tegen hun werkgever

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick workers filing criminal complaints against their employer over occupational health rules, and whether the Labour Inspectorate had investigated the company over the past ten years and would make its findings available. The minister answered that workers may report to police, that the Inspectorate visited the company three times in ten years, that its findings can be viewed confidentially by the House, and that it has now started an investigation into how workers are protected against hazardous substances.
The Inspectorate has now started an investigation into how workers are currently protected against the hazardous substances present.
De Inspectie is inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de wijze waarop werknemers nu worden beschermd tegen de aanwezige gevaarlijke stoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over een uitspraak van de rechter over het al dan niet korten van de ZVW-premie op de WW-uitkering

MP Ulenbelt asked whether a court ruling on whether ZVW contributions should be deducted from a WW benefit gives reason to change the law. The minister declined to amend the law, arguing gross income netting is standard and a change would increase administrative costs.
I see no reason to change this gross-gross offsetting.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze brutobruto-verrekening te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Ulenbelt over ongelukken in praktijklokalen op vmbo-scholen

MPs Siderius and Ulenbelt asked why safe machine use in vmbo practical rooms remained non-compliant in 64% of inspections since 2009, what measures were taken, how many pupils and teachers were harmed, how many fines and closures occurred, and whether unsafe rooms would be closed directly. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, listed sector support measures, reported fines (6 in vmbo, 2010-2014), and said inspections show schools improving, so immediate closure was not planned.
According to the Inspectorate, schools that did not have health and safety in order are now on the right track in improving safety.
Volgens de Inspectie zijn de scholen die de gezondheid en veiligheid niet op orde hadden inmiddels op de goede weg bij het verbeteren van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over het niet respecteren van de rechten van vakbonden

MPs Van Nispen and Ulenbelt asked whether the European Patent Organisation in The Hague violates union rights, and why Dutch bailiffs were ordered not to enforce a court ruling against it because of its immunity. The minister said he cannot confirm the alleged conflict, that immunity rules mean the court ruling cannot be enforced in the Netherlands, that internal appeal routes exist, and that the Netherlands will raise the matter with the organisation and its governing council.
The cabinet cannot make substantive statements about court rulings.
Het kabinet kan inhoudelijk geen uitspraken doen over gerechtelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over rentegevoeligheid als molensteen om nek pensioenen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether low interest rates and the ECB bond-buying programme are a burden on pension funds, and what this means for indexation and for protective measures, and whether social partners will be consulted. The State Secretary acknowledged the pressure on pensions, said the ECB effect cannot be separately quantified, that the new funding framework cushions the impact in the short term, and that she is willing to discuss a new perspective with social partners.
The separate effect of the ECB programme on fund-specific coverage ratios therefore cannot be quantified.
Het afzonderlijke effect van het ECB-programma op fondsspecifieke dekkingsgraden kan daarom niet worden gekwantificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat vier vijfde van de verplichte veiligheids- en gezondheidsplannen (V&G) niet op orde is bij de aanbesteding van infraprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that most safety and health plans (V&G-plannen) for infrastructure tenders are inadequate, and whether the minister would address contracting authorities and ask the Labour Inspectorate to prioritise them. The minister called the reports disappointing, said the Inspectorate checks clients on risk-based grounds and that employers bear primary responsibility, and promised to inform parliament by mid-2015 on a chain approach to safe work.
Where there is cause for this, in supervising compliance with the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW holds clients to their obligations.
Als daar, bij het toezicht op naleving van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, aanleiding toe is, worden opdrachtgevers door de inspectie SZW op hun verplichtingen aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het conflict over pensioengeld bij woningcorporaties

SP MPs asked whether housing corporations keep the pension premium reduction instead of passing it on to employees, and whether the government will ensure the reduction reaches workers. The minister replied that wage and pension arrangements are for social partners, that the government is not a party to the corporation-sector talks, and that the wider enquiry does not concern this matter.
Employers and employees, and their organisations, are themselves responsible for making working-conditions agreements.
Werkgevers en werknemers, en hun organisaties, zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken van arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over eerste deelnemer aan de “Meesterbeurs”

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked about the 'Meesterbeurs', a Tilburg work-with-benefit scheme for over-50s, including employer costs, insurance coverage, training, displacement of regular workers and whether a systematic study of work-experience placements should be commissioned. The State Secretary answered that re-integration policy and instrument choice lie with municipalities, that the scheme is lawful work-with-benefit without an employment contract, that vacancies are checked for displacement, and that she supports municipalities commissioning effectiveness research without committing to such a study herself.
Responsibility for re-integration policy lies with municipalities, as does the choice of instruments.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het re-integratiebeleid ligt bij gemeenten, net als de instrumentskeuze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over de brand in Roermond van 16 december, waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked the state secretary about the Roermond fire that released asbestos, including responders' protective equipment, the lack of a dedicated asbestos disaster plan, and whether the Netherlands should systematically become asbestos-free. The state secretary replied that the safety region judged the response adequate, that evaluations are underway, that a 2006 asbestos fire plan is being updated, and that policy stays risk-based with a planned 2024 ban on asbestos roofs.
The plan of approach is currently being updated by the Institute for Physical Safety.
Het plan van aanpak wordt momenteel geactualiseerd door het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het College van de Rechten van de Mens dat er sprake is van leeftijdsdiscriminatie als een uitkering van functioneel leeftijdsontslag stopt op

MPs Ulenbelt asked how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that ending the UGM military disability benefit at 65 while the AOW age has risen amounts to age discrimination, and what it will do about the resulting income gap. The minister says the ruling concerns UGM benefits, that Defence is negotiating a fix with unions and a temporary ABP bridging scheme runs to 2016, and that the AOW gap is a deliberate sustainability measure with a temporary OBR bridging benefit; no structural change is promised.
Until then, the Minister of Defence is obliged to apply the existing terms of employment and no individual deviating arrangements will be made.
Tot die tijd is de Minister van Defensie gehouden de bestaande rechtspositieregeling toe te passen en worden geen individuele afwijkende regelingen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het aanbieden van vacatures voor de functie van softdrugs verkoper door het UWV

An MP asks whether the UWV sent job vacancies for a cannabis-shop seller to jobseekers, how it treats jobseekers who refuse such posts on conscience grounds, and how it handles such objections generally. The minister answers that such vacancies are not actively offered as suitable work, that the post was wrongly included and has been removed, and that jobseekers with conscientious objections are handled case by case with UWV.
UWV filters these functions out of the offer to jobseekers.
UWV filtert genoemde functies uit het aanbod aan werkzoekenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat mensen met terminale kanker door het UWV worden goedgekeurd voor werk

An SP MP asked the minister whether UWV pressures terminally ill cancer patients to return to work and whether specific policy exists for them. The minister said terminally ill patients (expected to die within months) are not approved for work, that prognosis-based guidelines and the Schattingsbesluit apply, and that UWV does not aim to pressure patients.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele gevallen kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het mislukken van het zoveelste ICT-project bij het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the halted UWV ICT project with supplier Be Informed after its bankruptcy, including money spent, recovery, procurement and timeline. The minister answered in detail: the project was ended early due to supplier bankruptcy, about €10.2m was paid for the licence and €5.9m for the WW sub-project, recovery was judged not promising, and UWV will not re-tender for now.
UWV terminated the project early because the relevant ICT supplier went bankrupt.
UWV heeft het project vroegtijdig afgebroken vanwege faillissement van de betrokken ICT-leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat Sociale Zaken mogelijk de privacywetgeving schond

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked who authorised linking personal data for fraud detection without a legal basis, whether the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) supervised this, and why a statutory basis was only created in 2013. Minister Asscher answers that the Wbp and the WWB/SUWI provided a basis for data linking, that the CBP was consulted and informed parliament via letters in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2011, and that the 2013 SUWI amendment (SyRI) was chosen for transparency rather than because the earlier practice was unlawful.

Although the bureau concludes that the Wbp provides a sufficient legal basis to work within a 'Black Box' environment, a separate statutory basis is chosen for reasons of transparency and a clear division of tasks and responsibilities.

Ofschoon het bureau concludeert dat de Wbp voldoende juridische basis heeft om binnen een «Black Box» omgeving te werken, wordt er om redenen van transparantie en heldere taak- en verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling voor gekozen een aparte wettelijke basis te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het ministerie het lek in asbestregels erkent

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a certificate-holding asbestos removal firm could continue its work through a related BV after its certificate was withdrawn, and how certification bodies handled such cases. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because procedures were ongoing, acknowledged loopholes in the certification rules, and promised to tighten the certification schemes and information-sharing with Ascert and certification bodies, with measures under discussion.
The problem identified makes clear that the certification schemes need to be adjusted.
Het gesignaleerde probleem maakt duidelijk dat aanpassing nodig is van de certificatieschema's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mogelijk chloortrein van AkzoNobel door Overijssel vanwege staking Rotterdam’

Two SP MPs asked whether AkzoNobel's planned chlorine train transport through Overijssel, during a strike at its Rotterdam Botlek plant, is permitted under a 2002/2006 convenant and amounts to strike-breaking, and whether the government will intervene or press the employer on labour conditions. The Secretary of State answered that the convenant allows incidental transport to meet contracts, that the strike is a matter between employer and employees for the courts, that there is no legal basis to stop the transport, and that the ministry does not deal with labour relations.
In such cases it is for the court to rule on whether this constitutes strike-breaking.
Het is in voorkomende gevallen aan de rechter om een uitspraak te geven of dit stakingsbreking betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer buschauffeurs worden vervangen door vrijwilligers

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether replacing bus drivers with volunteers constitutes job displacement and whether volunteers should be used on regular bus lines. The minister said displacement is only unacceptable when caused by unfair competition, that local and provincial governments are responsible for public transport, and that he is working with the UWV on defining volunteer work under the WW unemployment rules.
I speak of job displacement when employees lose their jobs through unfair competition.
Ik spreek van werkverdringing als werknemers door oneerlijke concurrentie hun baan verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat IKEA de Nederlandse wet omzeilt met Slowaakse chauffeurs

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on reports that IKEA circumvents Dutch law using Slovak drivers, and whether the inspectorate will check the Slovak carrier's operations. The minister says the inspectorate supervises Dutch carriers, has met the FNV about its reports, and cannot itself investigate a foreign company but could request action from the foreign authority.
The ILT has no authority to conduct its own investigation at a company established abroad.
De ILT heeft geen bevoegdheid om zelf onderzoek te doen bij een in het buitenland gevestigd bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ’Poolse chauffeurs raken op’

An MP asked whether non-EU lorry drivers are being brought in while Dutch drivers are unemployed, and whether weekend rest in lorry cabs at parking areas should be banned. The ministers answered that enough EU labour is available, very few work permits for drivers were issued, and a bill against sham constructions is planned, while stating that weekend rest at service areas is undesirable but not prohibited by EU rules and that the inspectorate will act against structural violations.
No more work permits are issued for drivers, because there is sufficient priority-entitled supply available.
Voor chauffeurs worden geen tewerkstellingsvergunningen meer afgegeven, omdat er voldoende prioriteitgenietend aanbod aanwezig is.

Vragen van de leden Smaling, Van Nispen, Bashir en Ulenbelt (allen SP) aan de Minister en de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vanwege berichten «Inspectie kondigt be

SP MPs asked whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport announcing inspections in advance, and the resulting internal discontent, is acceptable, and about related questions on inspector status, coordination among inspectorates, budgets and merging supervision. The minister defended announcing routine inspections as efficient under a trust-unless approach, said unannounced inspections happen where warranted, attributed staff tensions to reorganisation, and rejected merging inspectorates for now.
Where there is reason to suspect that rules are repeatedly or deliberately violated, companies can be inspected unannounced.
Waar aanleiding bestaat om te veronderstellen dat regels herhaaldelijk of moedwillig worden overtreden, kunnen bedrijven onaangekondigd geïnspecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de overdracht van de pensioenen van oud-mijnwerkers aan Aegon

The SP MP Ulenbelt asked the minister how she judges transferring the pensions of former miners from the Mijnfonds AFM and BFM to insurer Aegon, whether this is necessary, what it means for members, and how the age profile, benefit levels and indexation history look. The State Secretary answered that social partners decide on the pension provider, that she declines to judge individual cases, and that the ministry lacks fund-level data, which DNB cannot disclose under the Pensioenwet.
Because supplementary pensions are a matter of employment conditions, social partners decide which pension provider the scheme is placed with.
Vanwege het arbeidsvoorwaardelijke karakter van de aanvullende pensioenen besluiten sociale partners bij welke pensioenuitvoerder de pensioenregeling wordt ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over ongewenste gevolgen van de premiekorting voor oudere werknemers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about possible adverse effects of the wage-tax premium discount for older workers, including whether employers dismiss older staff to replace them with subsidised older jobseekers and whether a taxi-sector vacancy form asking about benefit status is acceptable. The Minister answered that the discount is meant to help older benefit recipients find work, that data on individual employers are unavailable, that dismissals for subsidy purposes are unlikely to be rational, and that no regulatory change or new evaluation is planned beyond the 2019 review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Siderius over "zorgmedewerkers die na ontslag als vakantiekracht bij hun oude werkgever aan de slag moeten gaan"

SP MPs asked whether care workers dismissed by employers are rehired as cheaper holiday staff, questioning UWV's dismissal permits, the lower pay, and the consequences for care quality. The minister replied that UWV grants permits only for structural job loss, that no evidence of wrongful permits exists, that counts are not held, and that employers and UWV bear responsibility, pointing to new transition measures.
I have no indications that UWV wrongly granted dismissal permits.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat UWV ten onrechte ontslagvergunningen heeft verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat tientallen oud-medewerkers van Defensie ernstig ziek zijn geworden omdat zij zijn blootgesteld aan giftige stoffen

MPs Van Dijk and Ulenbelt asked whether Defence commissioned studies in 1999 and 2002 showing toxic chromium exposure at POMS depots that were kept secret, and what was known, when, about former staff falling ill. The minister replied that the studies were not concealed and staff were informed, and announced an internal historical inventory, an independent assessment and a GGD study, with liability to be decided after the findings.
Defence did not conceal the outcomes of the research at the POMS sites Vriezenveen and Brunssum.
Defensie heeft de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bij de POMS-sites Vriezenveen en Brunssum niet verzwegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Ojik over "het bericht dat een gezin de dupe is geworden van een bedrag aan teveel ontvangen kinderopvangtoeslag dat terugbetaald dient te worden”

MPs Van Ojik and Ulenbelt asked about a family forced to repay childcare allowance after an administrative error, and whether repayment is applied for mere paperwork gaps. The government answered that missing address data alone does not trigger repayment, that parents can supplement data before repayment, and that individual cases cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I, the State Secretary of Finance, cannot address the situation of the people from the Hart van Nederland report.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik, de staatssecretaris van Financiën, hier niet ingaan op de situatie van de mensen uit de reportage van Hart van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Raak over de uitkering voor voormalig politici

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior about the Appa pension benefit for former political office holders, covering numbers, regional differences, re-employment times, job-search exemptions, total payments, and enforcement of the job-search obligation. Minister Plasterk answered that much of the data is held decentrally or is not broken down as requested, gave central-contract figures for 2011–2013, and said evaluations are forthcoming.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many Appa benefits there are at provinces, municipalities and/or water boards.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel Appa-uitkeringen er zijn bij provincies, gemeenten en/of waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over de inzet van stakingsbrekers door de NS

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked whether the labour inspectorate is investigating alleged strikebreaking by NS (Dutch Railways) and whether it approved another firm cleaning trains. Minister Asscher answered that the inspectorate has received an FNV complaint but needs more information before investigating, that it never grants permission to break strikes, and that no strikebreaking by NS has been established.
The Inspectorate SZW received a report from the FNV that there would be strikebreaking.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een melding ontvangen van de FNV dat er sprake zou zijn van stakingsbreking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat ambtenaren gegevens van bekende Nederlanders bekijken

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Weyenberg asked about reports that municipal staff looked up records of well-known Dutch people in the Suwinet system without need, and what measures had been taken since November 2013. The state secretary called such access unacceptable, outlined VNG and CBP measures, a planned escalation protocol to cut off access from early 2015, and further technical measures, but gave few new firm commitments.
I find it unacceptable that employees of municipalities and social services consult data of well-known Dutch people without any necessity.
Ik vind het niet acceptabel dat medewerkers van gemeenten en sociale diensten zonder enige noodzaak gegevens van bekende Nederlanders raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de informatievoorziening van pensioenfondsen, met name over gebruikmaking aanvullingsregelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether pension funds deliberately omitted from their communication that contributions to early-retirement supplementary schemes could also be used to top up the final pension, and whether funds should be required to disclose all interests of participants. The State Secretary said the case was ruled on by a court with the appeal declared unfounded, that information must be complete on relevant parts but need not address every individual interest, and that a planned Wet pensioencommunicatie will require balanced communication.
I intend to forward the pension communication bill to the Council of Ministers and the Council of State soon.
Ik ben voornemens het wetsvoorstel pensioencommunicatie binnenkort door te geleiden naar de ministerraad en de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse uitzendkrachten worden genept met goedkope zorgpolis”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that employment agencies deduct health insurance costs from foreign temp workers' wages, possibly benefiting employers and insurers, and whether this is lawful. The minister answered that employers may negotiate shares of collective discounts, that acting as an insurer without a licence would be unlawful and was referred to De Nederlandsche Bank, that the SNA certification does not check such deductions, and that the minister lacks the requested insurer data but will talk with sector parties.
I have brought the CNV note to the attention of De Nederlandsche Bank.
Ik heb de notitie van de CNV onder de aandacht gebracht van De Nederlandsche Bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over asbestsanering in Louweshoek te Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the ministers about the asbestos removal in Louweshoek, Amsterdam, covering inspection, certification, residents' relocation and costs. The government answered that the matter is locally responsible, described the inspections and the stop order, and said Woonzorg Nederland and the municipality decide on relocation and resumption, without quantifying social costs.
However, this is a local matter with local responsibility, so I do not know all the details of the removal.
Het gaat hier overigens om een lokale kwestie met lokale verantwoordelijkheid waardoor bij mij niet alle details van de sanering bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de controle op kwartsstofemissies op bouwplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked how the Inspectorate SZW checks compliance with the quartz dust exposure limit on construction sites, including inspection frequency, filter and vacuum rules, and the value of real-time dust monitoring. The minister describes about 2,000 yearly site inspections with attention to hazardous substances, a six-week 2013 inspection campaign with 441 checks and 23 fines, reliance on general performance-based rules rather than equipment specifications, and rejects portable fine-dust meters as unsuited for quartz exposure assessment.

In doing so, the Inspectorate SZW checks, based on a visual inspection, whether the nature, extent and duration of quartz dust exposure has been assessed and whether the appropriate measures have been taken on the basis of that assessment.

Daarbij controleert de Inspectie SZW op basis van een visuele inspectie of de aard, mate en duur van de blootstelling aan kwartsstof is beoordeeld en of op basis van die beoordeling de juiste maatregelen zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Situatie rond gastouderopvang is onveilig’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of unsafe childcare by host parents (gastouders), including inspection rates, employment status, and whether host parents should be employed by agencies. The minister says safety measures have been strengthened, inspection rates meet legal requirements, and he sees no need to raise minimum inspection percentages or require employment contracts.
At present I see no reason to raise the minimum percentage of host parents to be inspected.
Momenteel zie ik geen aanleiding voor het verhogen van het minimale percentage te controleren gastouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het vrijkomen van asbest bij bakkersbedrijf Bakkersland

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos incidents at bakery company Bakkersland, including inspection follow-up, a worker's mesothelioma, exposure risks for oven workers, and whether ingesting asbestos fibres poses health risks. The minister answered that three incidents were known, that Bakkersland removed asbestos from affected ovens and planned remediation of the rest, and that the RIVM found no clear link between ingestion and cancer, while noting the causal link cannot be excluded.
However, I am not aware whether the occupational health service made a report of an occupational disease to the NCvB in this individual case.
Mij is evenwel onbekend of de arbodienst in deze individuele casus een melding heeft gedaan als beroepsziekte bij het NCVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en –omstandigheden van buitenlandse werknemers die aan de A4 werken

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working and housing conditions of Portuguese and Spanish workers on the A4 motorway project, including unpaid wages, housing oversight and the government's role as client. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, that employers are responsible for housing with municipalities and a private certification body supervising, and that the Inspectorate can impose penalties for unpaid minimum wage while no separate Rijk investigation into the contractor is planned.
The investigation is currently in full swing.
Het onderzoek is op dit moment in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over jongeren die stage lopen na het afronden van een opleiding

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about young graduates doing unpaid or low-paid 'internships' that may in fact be regular jobs, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate. The minister says whether a placement is a stage depends on the facts, that the Inspectorate uses criteria and enforces minimum wage, and that it has started three investigations, one of which found no violations.
Will you have the Inspectorate SZW investigate the occurrence of underpayment and violation of labour law in the case of internships after completing an education, and take enforcement action?
Wilt u de Inspectie SZW onderzoek laten doen naar het voorkomen van onderbetaling en schending van het arbeidsrecht in het geval van stages na het afronden van een opleiding en handhavend optreden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitzending van Kassa ‘Kwaliteit holt achteruit in de kinderopvang’
