An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a Kassa broadcast on falling quality in childcare, including staff-child ratio breaches, possible concealment from inspectors, budget cuts and staff workload. The minister answers that the GGD and municipalities enforce the ratio, that more risk-based inspection and quality supervision are planned, that the 100 million euro investment is intended to restore demand, and that the government will not accept lower quality standards.
I am ultimately responsible for the supervision and enforcement system. Within that system I want to move more towards quality supervision.
Ik ben eindverantwoordelijk voor het systeem van toezicht en handhaving. Binnen dat systeem wil ik meer toe naar kwaliteitstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht van FNV en Voor Werkende Ouders: ‘Uitval kinderopvang niet door crisis’

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the minister to respond to an FNV and Voor Werkende Ouders survey claiming parents are leaving the labour market because of childcare cuts, and to explain plans to reinvest in childcare. The minister disputes the survey's conclusions citing CBS figures, notes a EUR 100 million structural reinvestment in childcare allowance, says informal childcare falls under parental choice, and promises a childcare policy letter this autumn.
The SCP, commissioned by the Ministry of SZW, is conducting research examining the reasons parents enter and exit childcare and how they then organise work and care.
Het SCP voert, in opdracht van het Ministerie van SZW, een onderzoek uit waarin naar de instroom- en de uitstroomredenen van ouders in de kinderopvang wordt gekeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer Nederlanders twee banen hebben

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that more Dutch people hold two jobs, the reasons behind it, the working poor, and long-term trends. The state secretary said about 8.5% of workers hold multiple jobs, mostly for investment or extra income, that minimum wage is relatively high, and that the CBS will publish further analysis on working poor in early 2014.
I have already asked the CBS to carry out additional analyses of the composition and, where possible, the background of the group of long-term working poor.
Ik heb het CBS reeds gevraagd om aanvullende analyses uit te voeren op de samenstelling en zo mogelijk achtergronden van de groep langdurig werkende armen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over gesprek met verzekeraars over schending van persoonlijke levenssfeer bij overdracht van medische gegevens bij verzuimbegeleiding

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the minister had met insurers about privacy violations in sharing medical data for sickness absence management and what concrete steps would follow. The minister reports a meeting with the Verbond van Verzekeraars where excuses were offered, an informal consultation with stakeholders and a commitment that insurers will bring their procedures in line with privacy rules, though implementation is left to the sector.
I expect them to put matters in order so that employers and employees no longer encounter violations of the laws and regulations on medical data.
Ik verwacht van hen dat zij zodanig de zaken op orde stellen dat werkgevers en werknemers niet meer met schending van de wet- en regelgeving omtrent medische gegevens te maken krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het sluiten van sociale werkplaatsen "

An SP MP asked the state secretary about closing sheltered workplaces (sociale werkplaatsen), their effects on unemployment, the lack of regional data on jobs and waiting lists, and why intake fell. The state secretary said the Participatiewet closes new intake from 2015 without closing existing sw-bedrijven, that regional data is unavailable or only available at macro level, and that many begeleid-werken jobs ended for mixed reasons.
I have no insight into the regional distribution of committed jobs.
Ik heb geen zicht op de regionale spreiding van toegezegde arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over armoede onder huurders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about rising poverty among tenants, the effect of the landlord levy and rent increases, and whether the government would improve rent allowance or moderate rent policy. The State Secretary said the government takes the signal seriously, is strengthening poverty and debt policy with extra funds for municipalities, and that the landlord levy has no direct link to low-income households' spending, citing rent allowance.
I do not have that data at my disposal.
Die gegevens heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over armoede en de toenemende vraag naar schuldhulpverlening

Member Ulenbelt (SP) asked the state secretary about poverty, rising demand for debt assistance, the adequacy of the debt-relief budget, and the impact of cuts on low incomes. The state secretary answered that municipalities are primarily responsible, announced extra funds and a prevention focus, and described the purchasing power decline as caused by recession and austerity.
Municipalities are primarily responsible for this policy and the cabinet helps them with it.
Gemeenten zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor dit beleid en het kabinet helpt hen hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over Polen die in de sociale werkplaatsen werken

MP Ulenbelt asks whether the Rotterdam sheltered workshop Robedrijf Groen employs Polish agency workers while over 15,000 people wait for sheltered jobs, and about their pay, the numbers nationally, and whether such workshops should be for indicated persons. The state secretary answers that no Polish employees with a Wsw indication work there, only temporarily hired regular workers placed by a client, paid under the horticulture CAO, that national figures are not held, and that municipalities decide how to organise sheltered employment.
Municipalities are responsible for sheltered employment.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de sociale werkvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren gratis stage lopen

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the growing number of unpaid internships taken by young graduates displaces paid work, whether employers can avoid paying minimum wage, and whether such employers should be tackled. The minister answered that unpaid internships are not displacement since places are additional, that interns need not receive minimum wage because learning is central, and that employers are not obliged to pay internship allowances; he pointed to the SBB internship offensive instead.
There is no displacement because it generally concerns additional places.
Er is geen sprake van verdringing omdat het doorgaans gaat om additionele plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het persbericht van het asbestverwijderingsbedrijf ASB in Veenendaal met de kop «Specialisten luiden noodklok over misstanden in

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press release from asbestos removal firm ASB alleging conflicts of interest and quality problems in the asbestos sector, including laboratory testing. The minister rejected the claim that control should fall entirely to government, said Inspectorate enforcement is being intensified, and promised targeted inspections of laboratories in 2014 and a forthcoming study of certification bodies.
The Inspectorate SZW will carry out targeted inspections in 2014 on how laboratories perform final measurements and clearances.
De Inspectie zal in 2014 gerichte inspecties uitvoeren op de wijze waarop bij eindmetingen/vrijgaven door laboratoria worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "over het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV leases offices owned by foreign investors such as Fortress and whether UWV should run integrity checks on landlords. Minister Asscher confirmed the landlords are registered owners in the Netherlands and Germany, said UWV can now use the Bibob integrity law and is drafting a policy, and said no integrity screening of buyers happens when public property is sold.
UWV is currently drawing up a Bibob policy line and will apply this policy when leasing premises.
UWV stelt hiervoor momenteel een Bibob-beleidslijn op en zal deze beleidslijn toepassen bij de huur van panden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het keurmerk eerlijke teelt champignons

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Fair Produce certification for mushroom farms, the difference with the Grasp assessment, and whether labour inspection would expand scrutiny of the sector. The minister stood by Fair Produce, said Grasp is only a first administrative check, committed to continued cooperation with the sector, and reported that the inspectorate had visited 54 non-certified farms and was already intensifying enforcement in the sector.
The intervention team carried out various types of inspections at the growing companies that are not certified according to the Fair Produce list.
Het interventieteam heeft verschillende soorten inspecties uitgevoerd bij de teeltbedrijven die volgens de lijst van Fair Produce niet zijn gecertificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het UWV te traag is met het uitbetalen van loon bij faillissementen in Noord-Holland

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the minister whether UWV was too slow paying wage claims after bankruptcies in Noord-Holland, and about the causes, prevention and staffing cuts. Minister Asscher confirmed about 500 late payments were made good via advances, attributed the delay to an unexpected surge in bankruptcies, and said UWV would improve early signalling and redeploy staff.
UWV will in future pay more attention to signalling such large increases so that the necessary extra staff can be deployed in good time.
UWV zal in het vervolg nog beter aandacht besteden aan het signaleren van dergelijke grote stijgingen zodat vroegtijdig het benodigde extra personeel kan worden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Leijten over braille leesregels voor blinden en slechtzienden

MPs Ulenbelt and Leijten asked why blind and partially sighted people with a job must often buy two braille displays, one funded by the health insurer and one by UWV, when one could serve both settings. The government answered that the insurer-funded display may be used at work and at home, and that UWV only funds a second device when the first is unsuitable for the job, so no change or consultation is planned.
A braille display provided by the health insurer may be used both privately and in the work situation.
Een braille leesregel die is verstrekt door de zorgverzekeraar mag zowel in de privé als de werksituatie worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Leijten en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat zorginstelling Aafje uit voorzorg ontslag heeft aangevraagd voor honderden thuiszorgmedewerkers

MPs Kooiman, Leijten and Ulenbelt asked whether care provider Aafje's precautionary dismissal request for hundreds of home-care workers was premature and whether the UWV should grant it, and about municipal tendering practices. The state secretary replied that the dismissal request is not expected to proceed, explained the UWV's approach to dismissal permits tied to tenders, the rules on taking over staff, and that municipalities are responsible for tendering and must follow the law.
I have since understood that the dismissal request will not go ahead, at least for the time being.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat de ontslagaanvraag er – in ieder geval voorlopig – niet gaat komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "de mededeling op de site van de Sociale verzekeringsbank dat na 2015 een eenmalige uitkering zoals een afkoopsom kan leiden tot intrekking van de partnertoeslag AOW"

Ulenbelt (SP) asked why the SVB website stated that a one-off payment such as a lump sum to the partner after 2015 could end the AOW partner allowance permanently, and whether this was premature given the pending bill. Secretary of State Klijnsma answered that the notice was separate from the pending bill, was premature because incidental income was not explicitly addressed, and that the SVB has since amended the notice.
The notice on the SVB website was in that sense premature.
Het bericht op de SVB-site was in die zin voorbarig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over werknemers van PostNL die tijdens de staking het werk van de zelfstandige pakketbezorgers overnemen

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether PostNL was right to call on its staff to deliver parcels with private cars during the strike by self-employed couriers, whether this breaches the right to strike, and how staff were insured. The minister said the parties reached an agreement, that the right to strike is for courts to weigh case by case, and that PostNL insures its staff and would be held liable as client in case of third-party damage.
It is therefore not for me but, where applicable, for the court to judge any possible conflict with the right to strike.
Het is dus niet aan mij maar in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen over eventuele strijdigheid met het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over scholen die laks zijn met asbestcontrole

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether schools' failure to carry out asbestos inventories is acceptable, and whether a statutory inventory duty should be introduced. The state secretary replied that schools' boards remain responsible for health, that inspection will sample non-responding schools with findings due end 2013, and that permanent attention is preferred to a one-off obligation.
I announced at the committee meeting of 20 June that the ILT will carry out a sample among schools that did not respond.
Ik heb in het AO d.d. 20 juni aangekondigd dat de ILT een steekproef gaat uitvoeren onder scholen die niet hebben gereageerd.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Ulenbelt ver over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers massaal ontslagen worden

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked why UWV granted dismissal permits for about 1,100 home-care workers at Thuishulp Sensire and whether the state will intervene. The state secretary answered that the dismissals are the employer's own business decision on economic grounds, that UWV acted within its rules, that most work should remain in 2014 and that he will contact the parties and report on transition plans.
UWV acted in accordance with the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld in overeenstemming met de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV should avoid renting offices from landlords that may avoid Dutch tax, and whether the government will investigate the ownership and tax residence of those landlords' groups. The minister answered that UWV's role is limited to concluding a lawful lease, that investigating the landlord's corporate structure is the landlord's responsibility, and that fraud falls to police, prosecutors and the FIOD, so no investigation is planned.
The design of the organisational and financing structure is the responsibility of the landlord.
De inrichting van de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verhuurder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ulenbelt over nieuwe technieken voor asbestverwijdering

MPs Van Gerven and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how the new Foamshield asbestos-containment technique was assessed, whether workers and residents will be protected, who supervises the trial, and what the products and costs are. The government answered that the work meets existing Arbo rules, that exposure will stay below limit values, that Inspectie SZW will inspect alongside local bodies, and that the certification body Ascert is still studying whether the technique can be validated.
Yes, I am aware of the planned application in Zeist of a new technique, under the name Foamshield.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de voorgenomen toepassing in Zeist van een nieuwe techniek, onder de naam Foamshield.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door UWV van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn

Mr Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether UWV rents offices from landlords with foreign, possibly tax-avoiding structures and how much tax the state loses as a result. The minister replied that UWV does not investigate the ownership chains of landlords, that 132 buildings are rented from Dutch and five German owners at about 81 million euro a year, that rental income from Dutch property is taxed in the Netherlands, and that tax information on individuals cannot be disclosed.
UWV does not investigate the organisational and financing structure of the group to which a landlord may belong.
UWV voert geen onderzoek uit naar de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur van de groep waartoe een verhuurder eventueel behoort.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over het onderzoek van FNV naar het functioneren van Werk.nl

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about FNV research finding that users rate the Werk.nl job-matching website poorly, and about UWV's shift to digital services, automatic sanctions, job-vacancy coverage, staff cuts and closure of regional offices. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said UWV is improving digital services and that sanctions are preceded by a warning, a werkcoach assessment and a right to respond, and said the office reduction is needed for budget cuts and aligns with the Werkbedrijven.
Before a sanction is imposed, the client always first receives a pre-notification with an opportunity to respond.
Voordat een sanctie wordt opgelegd krijgt de klant altijd eerst een vooraankondiging met mogelijkheid tot verweer.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Ulenbelt over gesjoemel met lonen in de bouw

MPs Bashir and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how foreign construction firms use constructions to underpay social premiums, which controls apply, whether the NMa, FIOD and Belastingdienst are involved, and what measures will follow. The minister answered that inspectorates are cooperating and have broad powers, pointed to an action plan on sham constructions with intensified supervision, and withheld Belastingdienst findings citing confidentiality.
As you have seen in the action plan, we will intensify this supervision.
Zoals u heeft gezien in het actieplan zullen we dit toezicht gaan intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het niet controleren van werkgevers en opleiders door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) bij het plaatsen van een vacature

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister why UWV refers jobseekers to a driving instructor training run by a dubious provider, whether all providers should be vetted, what requirements apply to post vacancies on werk.nl, and whether such training should be subsidised. Minister Asscher answered that an investigation into the provider is ongoing, that pre-listing checks exist (account verification, the 2011 Inkoopkader scholing) but no ongoing checks of business conduct, and that the offending courses have been removed from the site.
UWV has started an investigation at the company concerned to establish whether there has been action in breach of the general terms and conditions.
UWV is een onderzoek gestart bij het betrokken bedrijf om vast te stellen of er sprake is van handelen in strijd met de algemene voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over de verhoogde verplichte heffing van het af te schaffen van het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel (HBD)

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he knows the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its compulsory levy from €79 to €110, whether this rise is unwelcome, and whether a levy could still be imposed in 2014. The minister confirmed the increase, explained it as covering the wind-down costs and higher purchasing costs, and said levies may still be imposed until the bodies are formally abolished, while promising to inform parliament this spring.
I will, as promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, inform your House this spring about the process to abolish the product and industry boards.

Ik zal uw Kamer, zoals toegezegd tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, dit voorjaar informeren over het traject tot opheffing van de product- en bedrijfschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smits en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer gemeenten honderden euro’s vragen voor het registeren van gastouders

MPs Smits and Ulenbelt asked minister Asscher about municipalities charging hundreds of euros in fees to register childminders. The minister said excessive fees are undesirable, that three municipalities charge about 1000 euros, he is banning fees for mutations in the register, he will evaluate the financial arrangements with the VNG, and he will examine the one-childminder-per-address rule.
Excessively high fees of about 1,000 euros, such as those charged by the three aforementioned municipalities, I consider undesirable.
Excessief hoge leges van circa € 1.000, – zoals de drie hiervoor genoemde gemeenten heffen, acht ik ongewenst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Gerven over het bericht  “met vaststellen van nieuwe blootstellingsnormen voor asbest per 1 juli 2013 de bestaande voorzorgsmaatregelen onvoldoende bescherming bieden”

Two SP MPs asked whether new asbestos exposure limits effective 1 July 2013 would leave existing precautions insufficiently protective, and questioned the sector's safety awareness, respirator adequacy, and inspection compliance. The minister acknowledged that current methods will need adjustment, postponed the new limits to 1 January 2014, committed to a TNO study and an Inspectorate report around summer, and reported high rates of enforcement at asbestos removal sites.
Because I attach importance to a careful implementation, I have decided in response to postpone the introduction of the new limit values until 1 January 2014.
Omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige uitwerking heb ik naar aanleiding daarvan besloten de invoering van de nieuwe grenswaarden uit te stellen tot 1 januari 2014.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over angst onder AOW’ers dat zij onbewust uitkeringsfraude plegen

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked the state secretary about widespread fear among AOW pensioners that they unknowingly commit benefit fraud through cohabitation rules, and asked for clearer criteria, suspension of sanctions, and an end to random checks. The state secretary replied that the SVB's objective criteria and case-by-case assessment are sufficient, that existing rules and sanctions will not change, and that the SVB will verify through administrative checks and home visits, which residents may refuse without consequence.
It is up to the person concerned to demonstrate how his actual situation is put together.
Het is aan de belanghebbende om aan te tonen hoe zijn feitelijke situatie in elkaar steekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het invoeren van arbeidstijdverkorting om werkloosheid te bestrijden

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether working-time reduction should be introduced to fight unemployment, whether work should be shared more fairly, whether encouraging older workers to keep working harms young people, and whether the government will address the abolition of ADV days. The minister answered that past evidence shows working-time reduction did not raise employment, that employment and participation should rise instead, and that working time and ADV days are primarily for social partners, while he will discuss the labour market with them.
It is primarily up to the social partners to make agreements on working hours and pay, and therefore also on whether ADV days are abolished or not.
Het is primair aan de sociale partners om afspraken te maken over werktijden en beloning, en dus ook over het al dan niet afschaffen van ADV-dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over “premieshoppen op Cyprus”

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked about Dutch lorry drivers employed through Cypriot agencies to pay social premiums in Cyprus, and about SVB and inspectorate controls. The minister says the SVB applies EU coordination rules, has had slow information exchange with Cyprus, will ask Cyprus to investigate, and promises an integrated approach to sham constructions by 1 May.
By 1 May at the latest I will inform you about an integrated approach to curbing sham constructions.
Uiterlijk 1 mei zal ik u informeren over een integrale aanpak voor het terugdringen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "het bericht dat nul-urencontracten zo snel mogelijk tot het verleden moeten gaan behoren"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that zero-hour contracts should be abolished quickly, including whether flex workers should have pension accrual and social security and whether the minister would legislate. The minister agreed flex workers' position should be strengthened, said they already have equal statutory social security and pension rights, and will present a policy outline in spring rather than commit to a bill.
In the cabinet's consultations with social partners on the social agenda, options for better balancing flexible and permanent work are also being discussed.
In het overleg van het kabinet met sociale partners over de sociale agenda wordt ook gesproken over de mogelijkheden om flexibele en vaste arbeid beter met elkaar in balans te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de beveiliging van de website van het UWV

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked about an expired security certificate on the UWV complaints webpage, its risks, whether data was intercepted, and UWV's security policy. Minister Asscher answered that the outdated certificate was in use from 21 January to 1 February 2013, was fixed once discovered, that no misuse or intrusion was found, and that UWV's security measures are regularly audited.
Unfortunately, the outdated certificate was mistakenly used in that process.
Helaas is daarbij abusievelijk het verouderde certificaat gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen Karabulut en Ulenbelt over arbeidsmarktbeleid in de Rotterdamse haven

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked minister Asscher about collective dismissals at Rotterdam Port Services, precarious temporary contracts for port workers, the ketenregeling, on-call work, and whether ILO convention 137 should be re-ratified. The minister answered that the ketenbepaling is not automatically circumvented, that the government is consulting social partners on flexible work protection, and that re-ratifying ILO 137 is not warranted, while many youth-employment answers were referred to municipalities.
The outcome of these talks will be presented to the House in a main-lines memorandum in the spring.
De uitkomst van deze gesprekken zal in het voorjaar in een Hoofdlijnennotitie aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister whether affected people should be compensated for call costs during the UWV website outage and whether calls to the UWV call centre should be free in future outages. The minister said he is satisfied with UWV's handling, has asked UWV to limit inconvenience from future disruptions, and considers compensation of the small call costs unrealistic given administrative costs.

Although I am satisfied with the way UWV handled the recent calamities, I have asked UWV to consider how to prevent customers from experiencing as little inconvenience as possible from possible future disruptions.

Hoewel ik tevreden ben over de wijze waarop UWV de recente calamiteiten heeft opgevangen, heb ik UWV gevraagd te bezien op welke wijze kan worden voorkomen dat klanten zo min mogelijk hinder ondervinden van mogelijke toekomstige verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MP Ulenbelt asked about outages of the UWV website and the mijnUWV portal in 2012 and January 2013, their causes, consequences for clients, and whether independent evaluation of UWV systems would be commissioned. Minister Asscher explained the technical causes, listed 2012 outage statistics, described interim measures and an external review, but declined to commission a new independent evaluation.
I am of the view that more (external) advice does not currently contribute to lower outage sensitivity of UWV's systems.
Ik ben van mening dat meer (extern) advies nu niet bijdraagt aan een lagere storingsgevoeligheid van de systemen van UWV.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over het te laat uitbetalen van Werkloosheidswetuitkeringen (WW-uitkeringen) in december 2012

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether WW unemployment benefits for December 2012 were paid late and, if so, how many recipients were affected, why, how recurrence will be prevented, and whether affected people will be compensated for tax changes. Minister Asscher replied that about 59,000 payments were made on 3 January 2013 as the earliest possible date after year-end system closure, that this was not a late payment, that UWV has adjusted its test protocol, and that compensation is not applicable.
It is correct that part of the WW benefit payments for December 2012 was paid in early January 2013.
Het is juist dat een deel van de WW-uitkeringen van december 2012 begin januari 2013 is uitbetaald.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over aanstaande facturen van de product- en bedrijfschappen

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked whether the government knows that product and trade boards are already sending invoices for 2013, when the abolition of the boards will take effect, whether boards should waive levies if they hold reserves, and when the last invoices will be sent. The minister answers that the boards will be abolished as agreed in the coalition agreement, public tasks will move to the ministry from 2014, a legislative process will start, and levies may still be needed until abolition because reserves may not cover long-term obligations.
Until the moment of abolition, the boards constitute administrative bodies with their own board, responsibility and the power to impose levies.
Tot het moment van opheffing vormen de schappen bestuurslichamen met een eigen bestuur, verantwoordelijkheid en de bevoegdheid om heffingen op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het bericht dat leden van AbvaKabo FNV zijn aangehouden in zorginstelling Pleyade"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about police removing AbvaKabo FNV union members and an MP from a care home in the Pleyade group while they tried to distribute union leaflets, and whether the employer violated union rights. The minister said police asked them to leave because they were in or near residents' private rooms rather than for union activity, that unions must coordinate access with employers, and declined to judge the employer's conduct, noting the right to collective action can be limited by a court.
It is not for me to pass judgment on that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over fiscale bevoordeling van overuren door buitenlandse seizoenwerkers

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the arrangement agreed between LTO Nederland and the Tax Authority, allowing overtime pay to be converted into tax-free housing and travel allowances for foreign seasonal workers, reduces tax and premium revenue, distorts competition, encourages overtime, and whether unions were consulted. The minister replied that the Tax Authority's explanation fits existing law, that no revenue is lost because an existing exemption is used, that competition and overtime incentives are not affected, and that consultation with unions was not needed.
This concerns an explanation that fits within the current legal framework and the Tax Authority's current policy.
Het gaat hier om een uitleg die past binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders en het huidige beleid van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over een discriminerende vacature

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked why UWV and the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling could not act against a job advert excluding people on benefits, and what measures would prevent such adverts. The state secretary said exclusion on benefit receipt is not a protected ground, that CGB could act only if it constituted indirect discrimination on a protected ground, and that the government will ask the SER for advice on labour market discrimination.
The cabinet intends to request advice from the Social and Economic Council (SER) on labour market discrimination.
Wel kan ik melden dat het kabinet voornemens is om aan de Sociaal Economische Raad (SER) een advies te vragen over het onderwerp discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de toepassing van PUR-schuim bij de isolatie van begane grondvloeren

MPs Paulus Jansen and Ulenbelt asked about health complaints from PUR foam insulation under ground-floor slabs, inspection oversight, municipal building control, and isocyanate risks. The minister answered that inspectorates have no view of complaint scale, that private certification (BRL 1332) is considered sufficient without extra public checks, and that no evidence yet shows unacceptable risks, though further fire-safety research will be reported later.
To supplement this with random public inspection, I see no reason.
Voor aanvulling daarvan met steekproefsgewijze publieke controle zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de inzet van Ierse en Portugese werkers bij de aanleg van de A2-tunnel

An SP MP asked why Irish and Portuguese workers are used on the A2 tunnel, whether Dutch workers were sought, and whether wages, taxes and pensions are properly handled and inspection launched. The minister replied that the work was tendered EU-wide and subcontracted to an Irish firm, that UWV found insufficient specialised Dutch staff, that the workers hold A1 certificates and are covered by the Dutch CAO, and that the Inspectie SZW and Belastingdienst are already supervising compliance.
The Inspectie SZW and the Belastingdienst have been supervising compliance with the legislation during the A2 tunnel works since early 2012 and will continue to do so until the project is completed.

De Inspectie SZW en de Belastingdienst houden vanaf begin 2012 al toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving bij de uitvoering van de ondertunneling van de A2 en zullen dit blijven doen totdat het project is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over het invoeren van een meldingsplicht voor buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs om de naleving van cabotageregels makkelijker te kunnen controleren

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked the minister whether a registration duty for foreign truck drivers would make cabotage rules easier to enforce, and whether Belgian practice and tax losses justify it. The minister answered that the ILT will first run an inventory study after the WWG amendment takes effect, and only then will consider a registration study, while stating that no evidence yet exists on the scale of violations.
After the ILT study mentioned in the answer to question 1 is completed, I will consider whether a study into the possibilities of a registration duty is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek van de ILT, genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, zal ik bezien of een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden van een registratieplicht wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over misstanden in de kinderopvang in Hoorn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged abuse of children at a Hoorn daycare centre, the GGD report, and whether the municipality acted effectively. The minister said the GGD report is public, the municipality imposed fines since 2005 and issued a directive removing the operators from daily management, and that courts are involved, while noting slow enforcement timelines and a need for focus on group-level pedagogical practice.
Following this case, I note in general that the deadlines applied by municipalities are sometimes on the long side.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus constateer ik in het algemeen dat de door de gemeenten gehanteerde termijnen soms aan de lange kant zijn.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over de cao gemeenteambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why she urged the VNG to keep a wage freeze for municipal employees, whether that was her role, and whether the agreed municipal CAO could be reversed. The minister said she called on the VNG to keep the nullijn for fiscal and signalling reasons, has no formal power to annul the CAO, and that it cannot be undone now barring compelling reasons.
At present I have no formal powers to reverse or annul an agreed CAO accord in the municipalities sector.
Op dit moment heb ik geen formele bevoegdheden om een overeengekomen CAO-akkoord in de sector Gemeenten terug te draaien of te vernietigen.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "Aspergeteelster uit Someren moet ruim een ton betalen"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling ordering an asparagus grower in Someren to pay over one million euros, and about the support and compensation for exploited workers. The minister answered that the ministry had no role in the criminal case, that a EUR 1.098 million in administrative fines had been imposed (some still under appeal), and that fine proceeds go to general funds rather than to workers.
These fine proceeds do not benefit the workers.
Deze boeteopbrengsten komen niet ten goede aan werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over “het verschuiven van de ingangsdatum van de AOW”

An SP MP asked the minister whether pension funds and insurers would keep early-retirement (prepensioen) end dates unchanged after the AOW pension start date was moved, and what steps the government would take to prevent an income gap. The minister said the change is manageable for most people, that individual funds decide whether to adjust, that no overview of which schemes changed exists, and that no concrete government step is planned beyond leaving it to social partners.
An overview of which early-retirement schemes have been adjusted and which have not is not available.
Een overzicht van welke vroegpensioenregelingen aangepast zijn en welke niet is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over WW-uitkering aan ex-SHB werknemers en hun pensioen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether former Rotterdam harbour pool SHB workers, who cannot choose their pension start date, should have their WW unemployment benefit reduced by pension income, and whether this is fair given that companies using part-time WW did not have to repay. The minister answered yes to the offset rule, rejected the comparison, and declined to mediate because the matter is a collective labour arrangement for employers and employees.
It is up to employers and employees to make arrangements about this. As minister I have no role in that whatsoever.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om daar afspraken over te maken. Als minister heb ik daarbij geen enkele rol.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over de uitzending van Pownews aangaande bouwvakkers die ondanks lage temperaturen moeten doorwerken

An SP MP asked the minister whether working in construction at a wind chill below -6 degrees endangers health, whether the cao frost-leave rule is enforced, and whether the frost regulation burdens employers. The state secretary answered that cao parties are responsible, the Arbobesluit leaves safety to employer and employee, enforcement lies with cao parties and courts, and he sees no pressure on compliance.
That is a matter for the cao parties who made agreements on this.
Dat is een zaak van de cao-partijen die hier afspraken over hebben gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de klopjacht op de negroï

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked whether police stopping and detaining cleaners based on their appearance, later judged unlawful by the Raad van State, was justified, what sanctions followed, and why no exploitation investigation or prosecution occurred. The minister answered that the checks were administrative, twelve persons were removed, the Openbaar Ministerie received no related cases, and the Inspectie SZW did not withdraw fines but found none applicable.
The investigation was an administrative-law investigation arising from the administrative task of the Aliens Police.
Het onderzoek is een bestuursrechtelijk onderzoek geweest dat voortvloeit uit de bestuurlijke taak van de Vreemdelingenpolitie.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de contracten van subcontractors die werken voor Post NL

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about a Zembla broadcast on subcontracted parcel couriers working for PostNL, including whether their contracts amount to disguised employment and whether the tax authority agreed special arrangements. The government answered that the contracts are free commercial arrangements, that employment status depends on the facts and can be tested by the Tax Authority or courts, and that it cannot disclose any Tax Authority agreements with specific taxpayers due to confidentiality rules.
However, no information can be provided about any agreements with specific taxpayers.
Over eventuele afspraken met specifieke belastingplichtigen kan echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over ‘Werken met asbest vaak niet veilig’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inspection staffing for asbestos removal, the certifying bodies' performance and the withdrawal of certificates, and whether to replace certification with a licensing requirement. The State Secretary answered that a dedicated 10 fte asbestos inspection team exists, that certifying bodies have been monitored and rules tightened, and that licensing is not planned, while promising a sanctions bill and a joint chain approach.
I do not intend to replace the certification system for asbestos with a licensing system.
Ik ben niet van plan het certificeringstelsel voor asbest te vervangen door een vergunningstelsel.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over mogelijk meer dan 550 kankerverwekkende stoffen op de markt (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether over 550 carcinogenic substances may be illegally on the market and whether they are under-registered under REACH. The state secretary rejects the under-registration claim, explains the gap with the EU classification list, reports few registration violations found by inspectorates, and declines further investigation or EU action.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de crèches leeglopen (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether childcare centres are emptying, why parents cancel care, and how parents on low incomes can keep paying. The minister replied that the Belastingdienst figures still show growth in childcare allowance recipients, that a CPB ex-post analysis is underway, that the FNV survey on parents quitting work is unrepresentative, and that the effects of cuts will be monitored.
The effect of the cuts to childcare allowance in 2012 on the various income groups is being closely monitored; in my view additional research for this is not necessary.
Het effect van de bezuinigingen op de kinderopvangtoeslag in 2012 voor de verschillende inkomensgroepen wordt nauwlettend in de gaten gehouden; extra onderzoek hiervoor is mijns inziens niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Ook ziektegeld op continentaal plat» (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Dutch nationals working on the Dutch continental shelf while living abroad fall under Dutch social security law, and how the state and UWV made an apparent error, and whether sickness benefit will be granted in similar cases. The minister answers that the Wet sociale verzekeringen continentaal plat, in force since 1 January 2012, now extends Dutch social insurance to all continental-shelf workers, without retroactive effect, and that earlier cases fell under the former WAMN with employer-based obligations.
From 1 January 2012, Dutch social insurance applies on the Dutch continental shelf in the same way as for workers in the Netherlands.
Vanaf 1 januari 2012 gelden de Nederlandse sociale verzekeringen op het NCP op dezelfde wijze als voor werknemers die werkzaam zijn op het grondgebied van Nederland.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een ongevalsrapport van de Arbeidsinspectie (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An SP MP asked whether the Labour Inspectorate may adopt, in its accident reports, the findings of employer-commissioned expert firms and whether this creates an appearance of dependence. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate conducts independent investigation, uses all available information including such reports, and that receiving an expert report does not stop it from investigating independently.
Having received a report from an expert firm is of course no reason for the Labour Inspectorate to stop conducting independent and autonomous investigation.
Het hebben ontvangen van een rapport van een expertisebureau is uiteraard geen reden voor de Arbeidsinspectie om geen zelfstandig en onafhankelijk onderzoek meer te doen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aantrekken van Poolse werknemers in de zorg (ingezonden 9 septem

Two SP MPs asked the health and social affairs ministers about recruiting Polish care workers who live in the homes of the people they care for, working around the clock, with questions on labour conditions, BIG registration, training equivalence, exploitation risks and the WHO code. The government answered that employers are primarily responsible for staffing and housing, that EU labour rules and the Waga apply, that the Labour Inspectorate will pilot checks in care, and that the Polish workers in this case mostly do domestic and support work not requiring BIG registration.

In the autumn the Labour Inspectorate will start a pilot in the care sector checking compliance with the Foreign Nationals Employment Act and the Minimum Wage Act, including checks on intermediary agencies.

In het najaar start de Arbeidsinspectie een pilot in de zorgsector naar naleving van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen en de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag, waarbij ook bemiddelingsbureaus gecontroleerd worden.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij (PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die dankzij faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 13 september 2011).

MPs Vermeij and Ulenbelt asked the minister how ex-workers of bankrupt Boekelo Decor who lost early-retirement (VUT) benefits can be protected, and whether the buyer or the German parent can be held liable. The minister answered that VUT schemes are the responsibility of social partners, that the buyer generally does not inherit the bankrupt firm's debts, that the German parent is a separate legal entity not party to the collective agreement, and that creditors must file claims with the curator.
This is a matter of private law.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de chaos bij het UWV (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Social Affairs about reports of chaos at the UWV, prompted by a Nationale ombudsman report on one claimant whose benefits were handled by offices with incompatible ICT systems. The minister acknowledges inadequate communication in that case, says it is not representative, and outlines ICT consolidation from 1 January 2012 and new complex-case teams.
UWV did not communicate properly in this case.
UWV heeft in deze zaak niet goed gecommuniceerd.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het beheer van recreatiepark Patersven (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether temporary agency Exotic Green taking over management of recreation park Patersven, which houses its own migrant workers, was acceptable given its past reputation, and asked about oversight, occupancy limits and protection of other owners. The minister answered that management is governed by private law, that the government cannot set conditions, that the municipality holds enforcement powers under the zoning plan, and that a registry and 24-hour gate are proposed to the owners' association.
The national and municipal governments have no legal authority to set conditions on management and/or to review the private-law provisions and their compliance.
De rijks- en gemeentelijke overheid hebben wettelijk geen bevoegdheid om voorwaarden aan het beheer te stellen en/of om de privaatrechterlijke bepalingen en de naleving daarvan te toetsen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die ondanks faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether early-retirement (VUT) recipients who lose their benefits after their former employer goes bankrupt, and are refused unemployment benefit by UWV, can be helped, including by changing UWV rules. The minister answered that such persons are not unemployed while on full VUT, that VUT is not wage under the WW, that no UWV policy change is possible without amending the WW, and that such cases are rare.
I see no possibilities to reach a solution through consultation with the UWV.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om in overleg met het UWV te komen tot een oplossing.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het alternatieve plan van FNV Bondgenoten voor de pensioenen en AOW (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

SP MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked the minister of Social Affairs whether he would send a letter showing that FNV Bondgenoten's alternative pension and AOW plan leaves a EUR 1.65 billion gap in the ministry's budget. The minister replied that a copy of his letter is attached and placed for inspection with the Central Information Point of the House.

Are you willing to send to the House as soon as possible the letter showing that FNV Bondgenoten's alternative plan for pensions and AOW creates a EUR 1.65 billion gap in the Social Affairs and Employment budget?

Bent u bereid de brief waaruit blijkt dat het alternatieve plan van FNV Bondgenoten voor pensioenen en AOW een gat van € 1,65 miljard slaat in de begroting voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, zo spoedig mogelijk naar de Kamer te sturen?

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Roemenen met Hongaarse achtergrond die hier legaal zouden werken (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked whether a temp agency in Etten-Leur employing Romanians with Hungarian background is legal, how many Romanians hold Hungarian passports, and whether the government will press Hungary over circumventing Dutch work-permit rules. Minister Kamp replied that Hungary's citizenship policy for ethnic Hungarians is a sovereign matter and the Netherlands sees no ground to raise it with Hungary.
How many Romanians hold a Hungarian passport?
Hoeveel Roemenen hebben een Hongaars paspoort?
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de premiepensioeninstelling (PPI) (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the premiepensioeninstelling (PPI), including whether it will shift Dutch pensions from defined benefit to defined contribution and why PPIs focus on the domestic market. The ministers reject the claim that the PPI will cause a shift to DC schemes, say the choice of scheme type is for social partners, and attribute the domestic focus to business decisions and scale considerations.
We favour the best possible quality of pension administration at the sharpest possible price, so that participants and pensioners get as much value as possible for the premium paid.

Wij zijn voor een zo goed mogelijke kwaliteit van pensioenuitvoering tegen een zo scherp mogelijke prijs, zodat de deelnemers en gepensioneerden zoveel mogelijk waarde krijgen voor de ingelegde premie.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Spekman (beiden PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over buitenlandse werknemers bij RWE (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported abuses of foreign workers at RWE's Eemshaven power plant site, including long hours, unsafe conditions, unclear contracts, accidents and underpaid Polish workers, and whether inspections and fines occurred and whether the labour inspectorate should be expanded. The minister answered that the inspectorate inspects roughly weekly, recorded 47 enforcement actions, issued fines, investigated accidents and found no underpayment so far, and judged inspection capacity adequate.
The Labour Inspectorate actively supervises compliance with laws and regulations at RWE's energy plant under construction in the Eemshaven.
De Arbeidsinspectie houdt actief toezicht op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving bij de in aanbouw zijnde energiecentrale van RWE in de Eemshaven.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Liberalisering Europese goederenvervoer (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

Ulenbelt (SP) asked ministers about the effects of freight transport liberalisation, including foreign-registered drivers doing domestic cabotage below minimum wage, weak enforcement of cabotage and posting rules, and penalties for false declarations of employment. The government acknowledged the need to amend the law on cabotage enforcement (bill planned for late 2011), said penalties for missing employment declarations are administrative only, and promised an evaluation of the declaration's effectiveness.
Indeed it is necessary to amend the legislation. The bill will be submitted in the second half of 2011.
Het is inderdaad nodig om de wetgeving aan te passen. Het wetsvoorstel wordt in de tweede helft van 2011 ingediend.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over gebruik van anonieme gegevens op werk.nl door derden (ingezonden 28 februari 2011).

An MP asks why personal data that UWV says are invisible to third parties when a CV is posted anonymously on werk.nl were nonetheless used by third parties, and asks how many warning emails were sent, which firms misused the data and what action was taken. The minister explains that the CV in the case was posted publicly by a work coach without the jobseeker's consent, that UWV has removed it and apologised, that this was a human error rather than a leak, and that the platform's terms restrict use to recruitment and access has been blocked for offending employers.
The public CV of the person concerned has since been removed from Werk.nl by UWV.
Het openbare CV van de betrokkene is inmiddels door UWV van Werk.nl verwijderd.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Pantar-busjes blijven rijden (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Amsterdam is cutting woon-werk transport for Wsw-indicated workers at sheltered workplace Pantar, whether people with a Wsw indication risk dismissal, how many Pantar staff would be dismissed, and whether other sheltered workplaces plan dismissals. The state secretary answered that the choice of transport policy and staffing cuts lies with the municipality of Amsterdam, that the cuts are aimed at no Wsw worker losing their job, that he has no figures on Pantar dismissals, and that he knows of a Rotterdam plan not to renew 212 temporary Wsw contracts.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to choose how it shapes its policy on commuting transport for Wsw employees.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om een keuze te maken op welke wijze zij haar beleid omtrent woon-werkverkeer van Wsw-werknemers vorm geeft.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het advies van de landsadvocaat over pensioenen (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the landsadvocaat's advice on accrued pension rights would be made available to the House, and if not, why not. The minister replied that government policy is not to release landsadvocaat advice to the House or third parties, as it is internal advice in a confidential client relationship.
As a general government policy, advice from the landsadvocaat is not made available for inspection to the House of Representatives nor to third parties.
Als algemene beleidslijn van het kabinet geldt dat adviezen van de landsadvocaat niet aan de Tweede Kamer ter inzage worden aangeboden noch ter beschikking van derden worden gesteld.

Vragen van de leden Ulenbelt (SP), Ortega Martijn (ChristenUnie), Klaver (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over machtsmisbruik, intimidatie en falende leiding bij d

Four MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuse of power, intimidation and failed leadership at the sheltered workplace Pauw Bedrijven, including what workers can do and what measures will prevent such abuses. The state secretary answered that this is a matter for the employer, works council, union and local authorities, that an independent investigation has been commissioned, and that no further measures or known signals elsewhere exist.
This concerns a matter for the implementing organisation and the administrators involved.
Dit betreft een kwestie van de uitvoeringsorganisatie en de betrokken bestuurders.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegankelijkheid van de schuldhulpverlening (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that Alkmaar deregisters residents from the municipal personal records database (GBA) after six months without giving reasons, thereby stalling debt assistance, and whether debt assistance can continue for people with structurally low income. The state secretary declines to judge individual municipal cases, states that debt assistance is currently not a statutory municipal duty so municipalities may set their own criteria, and says a bill would make it a statutory duty with broad accessibility.
From central government I do not intervene in individual cases concerning the implementation of legislation by municipalities.
Ik treed vanuit het Rijk niet in individuele gevallen rond de uitvoering van wetgeving door gemeenten.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten met een Nederlands paspoort van vleesverwerker Vion in Enschede moeten vertrekken (ingezonden 25

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would reverse the reported dismissal of Dutch-passport agency workers at Vion Enschede, start an investigation into CAO compliance, and inspect the agency. The minister replied that the choice of workforce is the company's, that the agency workers are employed by the staffing agency, that CAO enforcement is for social partners with Labour Inspectorate action only on a reasonable suspicion, and that the Labour Inspectorate has received no complaints about the firm.
Insofar as it concerns compliance with CAO or pension agreements, this is a matter for the company and the staffing agencies involved themselves.
Voor zover het gaat om het nakomen van cao- of pensioenafspraken is dit een zaak van het bedrijf en de betrokken uitzendbureaus zelf.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over beleggen van pensioenfondsen in bedrijven die wapens leveren aan Libie (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked whether large pension funds invest in firms supplying arms to Libya, whether this is desirable now that Dutch arms exports there are halted, and whether the minister will discourage such investments. The minister replied that pension law allows prudent investment in arms producers, that such firms no longer get export licences for Libya under the embargo, and that he sees no reason for separate rules for pension funds.
I therefore see no reason to create separate regulation for pension funds that invest in companies exporting military goods.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot het maken van aparte regelgeving voor pensioenfondsen die beleggen in bedrijven die militaire goederen exporteren.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over zijn bezoek aan het recreatiepark Parc Patersven in Zundert (ingezonden 28 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum why no meeting with park residents was planned during his visit to Parc Patersven, why only local CDA representatives were involved, and what he would do with the local CDA's questions about migrant workers. The minister said the visit was invited by the provincial CDA, included a meeting with the park manager and residents' association after which others could speak, that the local CDA's topics would be folded into a broader measures package, and that contact had been made with the mayor who is handling a legalisation process.
After the conversation there was an opportunity for others to put forward their views or other topics.
Na afloop van het gesprek was er gelegenheid voor anderen om hun standpunten of andere onderwerpen naar voren te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het schrappen van de vervoersvoorziening bij Pantar in Amsterdam (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether Pantar Amsterdam may cut the collective transport arrangement for sheltered-employment workers and whether the state can be held to indicated adaptations, including the 31,000 euro per-worker funding and management bonuses. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wsw, that the law does not oblige a transport facility, that indicated adaptations are advisory, and that Pantar's management denied paying bonuses.
National funds for the Wsw are provided annually to individual municipalities.
Rijksmiddelen voor de Wsw worden jaarlijks aan individuele gemeenten verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een havenclub die afwil van «luxe» arbeidsvoorwaarden (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister whether he agreed with Deltalinqs that workers should accept leaner conditions to avoid losing jobs to foreign labour, whether tenders on the Tweede Maasvlakte undercut Dutch collective agreements, and what the government would do to prevent a race to the bottom and check compliance by foreign firms. The minister replied that working conditions are set by social partners, that Deltalinqs is not a party to them, that posted workers have a hard core of Dutch conditions, and that the Arbeidsinspectie inspects about 12,000 employers yearly, with the government not selecting contractors.
It is up to the collective agreement parties to monitor compliance with working conditions as laid down in the collective agreements.
Het is aan cao-partijen om toe te zien op de naleving van arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals vastgelegd in de cao's.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de herkeuringen voor mensen met een SW-indicatie (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether the coalition agreement pledge that current sheltered-work (WSW) employees will not be re-assessed still holds, given that re-assessments are continuing. The State Secretary confirmed the pledge, saying current WSW employees keep their existing rights and obligations and that re-assessments for this group continue under the existing system.
Yes, I am aware of that.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de benadeling van jonggehandicapten die onder de oude regeling vallen ten opzichte van de jonggehandicapten die onder de

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether beneficiaries under the old Wajong scheme are disadvantaged compared with the new scheme, and whether they may choose between schemes. The secretary acknowledged income differences in some bands, said the old-scheme group cannot yet be opened to the new scheme pending monitoring results, and promised a decision after the June 2011 monitor report.

Following the results, a better picture will likely emerge of the effects of the work scheme. On that basis, and taking into account the relevant measures from the coalition agreement, I will decide on opening the work scheme to the other Wajong beneficiaries.

Naar aanleiding van de resultaten zal waarschijnlijk een beter beeld kunnen worden gevormd van de effecten van de werkregeling. Op basis daarvan en rekeninghoudend met de betreffende maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord zal ik een beslissing nemen over de openstelling van de werkregeling voor de overige Wajongers.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over investeringen in kernwapens (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether he would act on a Profundo report showing pension funds invest in firms linked to nuclear weapons, including by engaging funds or using the state's position at the ABP. The minister replied that funds have their own responsibility within legal limits, that no government intervention is warranted, that the pension federation will repeat its survey in 2012, and that he will raise responsible investing with ABP's board without forcing divestment.
That does not alter the fact that he regularly consults with the ABP board about the sustainability of the investment policy.
Dat neemt niet weg dat hij regelmatig met het ABP-bestuur overlegt over de duurzaamheid van het beleggingsbeleid.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over bereikbaarheid van mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl en de juistheid van de gepresenteerde pensioengegevens (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister why the pension website mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl was nearly unreachable at launch, which pension funds were missing, and whether pensions are fully shown. The minister explained the capacity cap and waiting page, that about a dozen funds (about 4,000 entitlements) were not yet connected, and that MPs' own pension schemes fall outside the register, while promising to explore including them.
I have since contacted the Minister of BZK to explore whether the APPA pension statements can also be included in the pension register.
Ik heb inmiddels contact opgenomen met de minister van BZK om te bezien of de mogelijkheid bestaat dat ook de APPA pensioenoverzichten kunnen worden opgenomen in het pensioenregister.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over grote tekorten en ontslagen bij de sociale werkvoorziening (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about budget deficits and staff dismissals at sheltered employment (SW) companies caused by 2011 national spending cuts, requesting figures per company and the reasons. The state secretary said the questions on company-level figures and staffing cannot be answered because the choices are left to municipalities and SW companies, and defended the efficiency cut while denying that outward placement is put on hold.
Deze vragen kan ik niet beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over afwijzing van Smit van de bijstorting in het pensioenfonds van Smit door Boskalis (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Smit's management rejected three offers from Boskalis to top up Smit's pension fund, whether the money went to shareholders, and whether DNB or AFM should investigate and the money be redirected to the fund. The minister confirms the rejections, says the matter is between Boskalis, the pension fund and its bodies with no ministerial role, declines to request an investigation, and notes Boskalis plans a voluntary EUR 30 million top-up.
This is a matter between Boskalis, the board of the Smit pension fund, the accountability body and the participants' council. There is no role for the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
Dit is een zaak tussen Boskalis, het bestuur van het pensioenfonds Smit, het verantwoordingsorgaan en de deelnemersraad. Er ligt geen rol voor de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over ontevredenheid van bedrijfsartsen (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a survey showing dissatisfaction among occupational physicians, including whether professional integrity can be guaranteed in a commercial setting. The state secretary said a joint ministry study is ongoing, due by summer 2011, and that integrity requires effort from practitioners, employers and professional bodies.
The study will be completed before summer 2011.
Het onderzoek wordt voor de zomer van 2011 afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de reiskostenvergoedingen verstrekt door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemers Verzekeringen (UWV) (ingezonden 29 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked whether UWV stopped reimbursing travel costs under 15 km for people without medical limitations from 1 October 2010, why, how much it saves, what alternatives were considered, and whether the minister will reverse it. The state secretary confirmed the harmonised 15 km threshold, explaining it aims at uniform rules across UWV, with only a modest side saving, and that the LCR and VNG were consulted.
Under the new scheme, clients only qualify for travel cost reimbursement if the one-way distance is fifteen kilometres or more.
In de nieuwe regeling komen klanten alleen nog voor vergoeding van reiskosten in aanmerking, indien de enkele reisafstand vijftien kilometer of meer bedraagt.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het Boxmeerse diergeneesmiddelenbedrijf Intervet (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asks the Economics minister whether Intervet's headquarters and research arm may leave the Netherlands after Organon, whether Intervet was raised with Merck's CEO, and what the government will do to keep it and knowledge jobs in the country. The minister says the merger with Merial is undecided, that the Netherlands has been put forward as a headquarters location, and that the government will not intervene in company decisions but will work on a Life Sciences policy and inform parliament via a progress report.
Because of the sale of Intervet to Schering Plough in 2007 and the merger of Merck and Schering Plough, responsibility for these activities and informing stakeholders lies with the Merck group.

Door de verkoop van Intervet aan Schering Plough in 2007 en de fusie van Merck en Schering Plough ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor deze activiteiten en het informeren van de stakeholders bij het Merck concern.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitspraken van de president-commissaris van Organon (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asked ministers whether MSD had formally informed the supervisory board and works council of Organon BioSciences about closing its R&D department in Oss, and how worker participation and collective dismissal rules apply. The minister answered that the Works Councils Act and Civil Code require advice and supervisory board approval, that MSD has postponed its plans to 31 December 2010, and that a taskforce is exploring a Science Park option.
Article 25 of the Works Councils Act (WOR) requires the employer to request advice from the works council on a proposed decision such as the closure of a company.

Artikel 25 van de Wet op de ondernemingsraden (WOR) bepaalt dat de ondernemer verplicht is over een voorgenomen besluit ten aanzien van bijvoorbeeld de sluiting van een bedrijf advies aan te vragen aan de ondernemingsraad.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over steun aan strijd tegen ontslagen bij Organon (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will support the supervisory board and works council of Organon in their fight against layoffs at the company. The minister replies that the government is responsible only for the legal framework, courts test compliance, and the government stays out of direct company relations, while it does work to preserve activities and jobs.
The government plays no role in the direct contacts between a company and its supervisory board or works council.
De overheid speelt geen rol in de directe contacten tussen een onderneming en haar raad van commissarissen of ondernemingsraad.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over integriteit bij fraudeonderzoek UWV (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister about the integrity of UWV fraud investigations, including supervision, whether other cases were reviewed, whether people abandon appeals for lack of resources, and whether the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen should investigate. The minister answered that UWV has integrity measures and quality checks, found no other related cases so no broader inquiry is planned, saw no evidence of barriers to appeal, and reported that the affected client received compensation and rehabilitation.
I therefore see no reason at this time to have the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen carry out an investigation.
Ik zie daarom nu geen aanleiding om de Inspectie Werk en Inkomen een onderzoek uit te laten voeren.

Vragen van de leden Jansen en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de massale ontduiking van de CAO in de taxibranche (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

SP MPs Jansen and Ulenbelt asked the ministers of Transport and Social Affairs about widespread non-compliance with the collective labour agreement in the taxi sector, including fraud with social premiums, its causes, and possible enforcement. The minister replied that the Sociaal Fonds Taxi is responsible for the data, that inspectorates received no prior signals, that social partners agreed a 15% cap on agency staff, and that SFT imposes back-payments with a 10% penalty, while declining a retrospective study and pointing to social partners and existing enforcement for further action.
A study as referred to I consider neither possible nor necessary.
Een onderzoek zoals bedoeld acht ik niet mogelijk en ook niet nodig.
