Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over behandeling van buitenlandse arbeiders in de Eemsmond (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the treatment of Portuguese workers at a subcontractor, Ha-Sa Insaat, on the RWE-Essent coal plant in the Eemsmond, including whether the company used the knowledge-migrant scheme correctly and whether subcontractors' compliance with labour and tax law is checked. The minister said the labour dispute is for the parties to resolve, that the Arbeidsinspectie is investigating the company's knowledge migrants at the IND's request, and that inspections of the construction sites are intensified.
The investigation into the knowledge migrants of Ha-Sa Insaat Taahhut Sanayi ve Ticaret is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de kennismigranten van Ha-Sa Insaat Taahhut Sanayi ve Ticaret loopt momenteel nog.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt en Van Gerven (beide SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over ontslagen bij MSD in Oss (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would use their influence to prevent or limit job losses at MSD in Oss, meet the company, disclose costs of public support, and intervene with US authorities. The minister replied that government will not intervene in the company's strategic decision, that talks and two working groups are underway to preserve jobs, that cost details of public support are partly confidential, and that the minister has been in contact with MSD leadership including the US CEO.
The government neither wants nor can intervene in the company's strategic decision on the planned efficiency drive, including the sharp downsizing of the Oss site.
De overheid wil en kan niet treden in de strategische beslissing van het bedrijf over de voorgenomen efficiencyslag, waaronder de sterke afslanking van het bedrijf in Oss.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over nog steeds slecht gehuisveste Polen (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether recruitment agencies flout their own housing standards for foreign workers, whether the sector's self-regulation has failed, and whether a licensing system should be introduced. The minister said the sector and municipalities are responsible, described ongoing self-regulation measures and a joint housing norm under discussion, and declined to introduce licensing for now.
It is up to the sector itself to monitor compliance with the housing standards belonging to the quality mark the sector itself established.
Het is aan de branche zelf om toe te zien op de naleving van de huisvestingsnormen behorende bij het door de branche zelf ingestelde keurmerk.

de voortgang op de voorbereiding en implementatie door kinderdagopvang en peuterspeelzalen te monitoren, alsmede mogelijke knelpunten bij de implementatie van de wettelijke eisen, en de Kamer hierover in het najaar van 2017 te rapporteren

Asks the government to launch a public campaign with municipalities so low-income families, schools and organisations know about funds to help children in poverty take part in society.
requests the government, within the Every Child Participates framework and with municipalities, to launch a public campaign

verzoekt de regering om voor 1 juli het vervolgonderzoek van het rapport «Een Onbemind Probleem» uit te voeren

Asks the government to develop, with legal professions and notaries, an integrated approach to neutral information on living arrangements and report to the Chamber by end 2016.
calls on the government, in consultation with legal professionals and notaries, to develop an integrated approach to neutral information on living arrangements
spreekt uit dat de regering, in samenspraak met beroepsgroepen uit de rechtspraktijk en het notariaat, een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkelt voor neutrale leefvormvoorlichting

verzoekt de regering om, binnen een halfjaar met concrete voorstellen te komen over wat er nodig is om het mogelijk te maken dat kinderopvang en onderwijs kunnen worden aangeboden vanuit één organisatie
Motie van het lid Yücel c.s. over een maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse van schuldenbeleid van overheden
Asks the government to commission a social cost-benefit analysis by an expert team of how authorities treat people with debts, including alternatives.
requests the government to have an expert team carry out a social cost-benefit analysis of the different ways authorities deal with people with debts

Motie van het lid Yücel c.s. over ook in 2016 en 2017 mogelijk maken van landelijk geoormerkte armoedemiddelen
Asks the government to keep funding national anti-poverty and debt-prevention projects through earmarked poverty funds in 2016 and 2017.

zendt in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Amendement van de leden Potters en Yücel dat randvoorwaarden voor de onafhankelijkheid van vertrouwenspersonen in de wet opneemt
Amends the youth residence rules so that the appointed child confidant cannot be the holder, its staff, close relatives or the legal guardian, to guarantee independence.
With the additional conditions in this amendment, the independence of the confidant is better secured in the law.
Met de extra randvoorwaarden in dit amendement, wordt de onafhankelijkheid van de vertrouwenspersoon beter geborgd in de wet.
Amendement van het lid Potters c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 dat randvoorwaarden voor de onafhankelijkheid van vertrouwenspersonen in de wet opneemt
Requires that a youth residence's independent client advocate (vertrouwenspersoon) cannot be linked to the facility operator, its staff, volunteers or close family, to secure independence.
Given the important task of the youth residences, the client advocate deserves a strong and independent position.
Gezien de belangrijke opgave van de jeugdverblijven, verdient de vertrouwenspersoon een sterke en onafhankelijke positie.
Amendement van de leden Yücel en Potters ter vervanging van nr. 15 dat een evaluatiebepaling introduceert in het wetsvoorstel
Adds an article requiring the minister to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the youth residence law, to assess whether the framework needs tightening.
within three years after this law takes effect, sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice

zendt in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Amendement van de leden Yücel en Siderius ter vervanging van nr. 8 dat ertoe strekt dat het adviesrecht van de oudercommissie over prijswijzigingen in stand blijft.
Keeps the parent advisory committee's right to advise on childcare price changes by removing the proposed deletion of that right.
In this context it is logical to maintain the advisory right of the parent committee on price.
Het is in dit kader logisch om het adviesrecht van de oudercommissie over de prijs te handhaven.
Motie van het lid Yücel c.s. over geschikte vormen van alternatieve ouderraadpleging
Asks the government, with experts and the sector, to develop suitable forms of alternative parental consultation.
requests the government, in consultation with experts and the sector, to develop suitable forms of alternative parental consultation
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met experts en de sector geschikte vormen van alternatieve ouderraadpleging te ontwikkelen
Motie van de leden Nijboer en Yücel over het aantal vrouwen in de top van financiële instellingen
Asks the government to monitor and report on the number of women in the top of financial institutions before December 2017.
requests the government to monitor the number of women in the top of financial institutions and report
verzoekt de regering, het aantal vrouwen in de top van financiële instellingen te monitoren en rapport uit te brengen
Motie van de leden Azmani en Yücel over geen dubbele kinderbijslag voor kinderen op een moskee-internaat
Asks the government to ensure child benefit is not paid twice for children placed in non-curricular mosque boarding schools.
requests the government therefore to implement or amend the rules for child benefit so that no double child benefit is paid
verzoekt de regering dan ook, de uitvoering van de regels voor het verstrekken van kinderbijslag zodanig in te vullen of te wijzigen dat geen dubbele kinderbijslag wordt verstrekt
Motie van de leden Azmani en Yücel over een afdwingbaar kwaliteitskader voor moskee-internaten
Asks the government to make the quality framework for mosque boarding schools legally enforceable, covering transparency, pedagogical climate and housing, and to prepare a new legal route if needed.
the government is further requested, if it is not possible within existing frameworks to give the quality framework enforceable force, to make this possible through a new legal route
verzoekt de regering voorts, indien het niet mogelijk is binnen bestaande kaders het kwaliteitskader een afdwingbaar karakter te geven, dit mogelijk te maken via een nieuw wettelijk traject
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een tv-programma over internationale kinderontvoering kinderbelangen zou opofferen aan kijkcijfers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the TV programme RTL-Ontvoerd sacrificed children's interests for ratings, including whether the return of abducted children was assessed for their best interests and whether government cooperated with the programme. The State Secretary answered that the Central Authority only gave general information and held talks with the programme's makers, warned about risks of interfering in pending legal cases, and did not verify causal links to children's psychological problems.
In my view it would be too much to qualify this as "cooperation" with the programme.
In mijn ogen is het te zwaar om dit te kwalificeren als «medewerking» aan het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht “veel discriminatie transgenders op werk”

An MP asks the ministers whether reported workplace discrimination against transgender people (40% reported experiencing it) is acceptable and what measures will reduce it, including complaints, prosecution and inspection. The government answers that the survey is not representative but that the group is vulnerable, cites existing action plans, the Inspectorate's antidiscrimination checks of employers, TNN campaigns and the planned repetition of the 2016 campaign, without committing to new legislation beyond the pending Bergkamp bill.
It is indeed worrying that many transgender people face discrimination in the workplace, or do not feel free to be themselves at work.
Het is inderdaad zorgelijk dat veel transgenders te maken hebben met discriminatie op de werkvloer, of niet de ruimte voelen om zichzelf te zijn op het werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vrouwen werken al op jonge leeftijd vaak in deeltijd’

An MP asked the government about reports that young women work part-time more often than men, reducing their economic independence, and what instruments exist to promote it. The minister said the trend is being studied in a joint OCW-SCP project, outlined existing emancipation and employer measures, and said economic independence is a priority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Yücel en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Armsten opgelicht’

MPs Recourt, Yücel and Nijboer asked the ministers about reports that bailiffs at BSR charged duplicate costs to vulnerable debtors, and what oversight, compensation and action would follow. The minister declined to prejudge the pending tuchtrecht case, said BFT oversight is risk-based and sufficient for now, that creditors should be compensated as far as possible via the bankruptcy estate, and that ACM and AFM are acting against malafide collection agencies.
It does not befit me to anticipate a case that is still before the court.
Het past mij niet vooruit te lopen op een zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vaders vinden uitbreiding vaderschapsverlof te krap’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Rutgers study showing fathers find the extension of paternity leave too limited, with many unable to take unpaid parental leave for financial reasons, and about the unequal division of care and work between partners. The Minister answered that the government is promoting a more balanced division of work and care through practical measures, awareness campaigns, a budget tool and the extension of birth leave, but declined to commit to new research or new agreements with sectors beyond existing initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Gemeente Amsterdam betaalt godsdienstles moslimkinderen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether Amsterdam's use of poverty funds to pay for religious lessons for Muslim children is acceptable and how the government will ensure national child-poverty money goes to essentials. The state secretary replied that municipalities are autonomous in poverty policy, that the municipal council is primarily responsible, and that Amsterdam is investigating the lawfulness of the declarations; she also pointed to binding agreements with the VNG on reporting and evaluation.
For any signals about local poverty policy, the municipal council is therefore primarily responsible.
Bij eventuele signalen over lokaal armoedebeleid is derhalve primair de gemeenteraad aan zet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Maij over het bericht dat het COA niks zou doen tegen homo-hatende asielzoekers

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether COA staff fail to intervene against asylum seekers who threaten LGBT residents, and how such conduct is addressed, protected and prevented. The government denies the picture, describes its sanctions, reporting and staff-coordination measures, and sees no reason for additional measures.
The picture that COA staff would not intervene against residents threatening LGBT residents is, however, not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat medewerkers van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) niet zouden ingrijpen richting bewoners die LHBT-bewoners bedreigen herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht 'Crèche paait ouders'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that childcare organisations lure parents with welcome gifts and asked whether the sector should be regulated or given a code of conduct. The minister said parents should choose on quality, welcome gifts are acceptable within the rules, a quality rating for parents is being piloted, and a code of conduct is not considered necessary.
I do not consider a further code of conduct necessary.
Ik vind een verdere gedragscode niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Yücel over een bericht dat de KNWU een onderzoek instelt naar misstanden in de wielersport

Two MPs asked the minister whether she knew of misconduct and intimidation in cycling, including the CIRC report on women's cycling, and what the government was doing about it. The minister said she supports the KNWU-commissioned investigation, points to the existing sports safety action plan and reporting channels, and gave no commitment to a broader government inquiry.
A broad investigation into abuses and intimidation in sport does not seem necessary to me.
Een breed onderzoek naar misstanden en intimidatie in de sport lijkt mij niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘GGD bezorgd over ruim helft kinderdagverblijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Volkskrant report that GGD inspection risk profiles flagged many childcare centres in low-income neighbourhoods, questioning the conclusions, the adequacy of unannounced inspections, quality ratings for parents, and links between neighbourhood income and quality. The minister rejects the newspaper's conclusions, says risk profiles are not quality ratings, commits to a public quality assessment pilot in 2017 and to asking the Inspectorate to examine any income-quality link.
To gain better insight into this, I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to investigate this further together with GGD GHOR Nederland.
Om hier beter zicht op te krijgen zal ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs vragen om dit – samen met GGD GHOR Nederland – verder uit te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de uitzending van Brandpunt over verborgen vrouwen

An MP asked the government about a broadcast on women confined to their homes, whether the number of such women is known, how they are informed, which organisations and Veilig Thuis are involved, and whether they can be helped toward education. The minister answered that the number is unknown and not pursued further, committed to providing information to relevant parties, and pointed to municipalities and existing participation and education programmes.
The number of women who are forcibly confined in their homes is not known.
Het aantal vrouwen dat gedwongen vastzit in huis is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat de nieuwe verlofregeling voor de moeder van een meerling in de praktijk tegenvalt

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the extended 20-week leave for mothers of multiples works in practice, given that some mothers of multiples get less total leave than mothers of singletons after preterm birth. The minister acknowledged the unintended effect and committed to amending the Wet arbeid en zorg, with timing to be communicated later.

Now, however, in practice it appears that women pregnant with multiples in many cases end up with less leave overall than before, which can be regarded as an unforeseen and unintended effect of the scheme, I am prepared to amend the Wet arbeid en zorg on this point.

Nu in de praktijk echter blijkt dat vrouwen bij de zwangerschap van een meerling in veel gevallen per saldo minder verlof genieten dan voorheen, hetgeen als onvoorzien en onbedoeld effect van de regeling kan worden beschouwd, ben ik bereid de Wet arbeid en zorg op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Yücel over het terugtreden van de enige vrouw in de RvB van ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Yücel asked the government about the departure of the only woman on ABN AMRO's management board, the gender diversity shortfall in the financial sector, and what the state as shareholder will do to reach the 30 percent target. The minister answered that the state will press ABN AMRO to nominate a woman, has asked NLFI to discuss diversity measures, and points to the reinstated statutory target and monitoring in 2019.
If a board does not meet the target, I as shareholder request that the company make an effort to nominate a woman.
Indien een raad niet voldoet aan het streefcijfer, vraag ik als aandeelhouder een inspanningsverplichting van de onderneming om een vrouw voor te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de toename van het aantal zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers) in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs asked the government about a rise in self-employed people without staff (zzp'ers) in debt assistance, its causes, access barriers and whether minimum rates should be set. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the trend, said debt assistance is aimed at citizens and that self-employed people can use municipal business support, rejected minimum rates for zzp'ers, and pointed to information initiatives.
Yes. I am already doing so.
Ja. Ik ben daarmee ook reeds doende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch, Yücel en Van Dekken over onveiligheid voor  homo's en lesbiennes

MPs asked the Justice Minister about insecurity for gay men and lesbians in nightlife, reports that incidents were not reported to police, and how reporting rates would be raised. The minister confirmed that 30.2% of gay men and lesbians feel unsafe near nightlife venues, said the police is improving the reporting process and training, and listed a campaign and Roze in Blauw networks to increase reporting.
Reports arising from such incidents must be taken seriously.
Aangiften n.a.v. dergelijke incidenten dienen serieus genomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Yücel over de hoge kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder in rekening kan brengen

MPs Recourt and Yücel asked why bailiff enforcement costs can reach many times the debt, and whether government policy will limit debt build-up and stop commercial creditors from pressing payment during a moratorium. The minister replied that bailiff fees follow fixed tariffs not tied to the claim amount, that a breed moratorium will apply to all creditors including commercial ones, and that the government sees no need to change the tariff system.
The costs a bailiff may charge for official acts are set out in the Decree on tariffs for official acts of bailiffs.
De kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder voor ambtshandelingen in rekening mag brengen, zijn vastgelegd in het Besluit tarieven ambtshandelingen gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake het gebrek aan aandacht over seksuele diversiteit in het onderwijs

MPs Yücel, Vermue and Jadnanansing asked why only 25% of surveyed pupils had lessons on sexual diversity despite mandatory core objectives since 2012, and how inspectorate oversight and teacher training address this, also referring to a motion on citizenship education and a Stichting School en Veiligheid report on teacher colleges. The Minister and State Secretary answered that they await the Inspectorate's forthcoming thematic report before taking a position, that no enforcement against schools has occurred, and that the teacher-training competence profile and curriculum reviews are underway, while rejecting the claim that the training approach is merely voluntary.
We therefore first await the outcomes of this thematic study by the inspectorate, in order to then reach a considered position
Wij wachten daarom eerst de uitkomsten van dit themaonderzoek van de inspectie af, om vervolgens tot een afgewogen standpunt te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de mishandeling van twee homoseksuele mannen in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the government about the assault on two gay men in Morocco, the status of the perpetrators, and whether the government would raise the issue with Moroccan authorities. The minister confirmed shock at the footage, corrected the reported sentences, described the criminalisation of same-sex acts in Morocco as incompatible with international human rights obligations, said the EU had raised the case with Morocco's National Human Rights Council, and described ongoing support for LGBT rights through civil society, but did not commit to a new specific demand to Moroccan authorities.
The cabinet will therefore continue to unreservedly commit itself to the rights of this vulnerable minority.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom onverkort blijven inzetten voor de rechten van deze kwetsbare minderheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Fokke en Yücel over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenis De Karelskamp te Almelo

Three PvdA MPs asked whether prison De Karelskamp in Almelo might be closed, what the status of the reported closure plans is, and whether this would cost jobs in a shrinkage region. The Staatssecretaris answered that DJI is drafting a plan in response to falling capacity needs, that no definitive closure decision has been taken, that shrinkage regions are one weighted factor, and that a political decision will follow after new WODC research and a second opinion.
I have instructed the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI) to develop a plan on how to deal with the declining capacity requirement.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) de opdracht gegeven een plan te ontwikkelen hoe om te gaan met de dalende capaciteitsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Een op de zeven Hagenaars heeft schulden’

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that one in seven residents of The Hague has debts, and about debt relief, financial education and the role of various institutions. The State Secretary acknowledged the economic hardship, pointed to signs of recovery and existing support measures, said the Debt Relief Act is being evaluated with results due by 1 July, and described financial education initiatives and ongoing consultations.
I will send your House the results, including a government response, by 1 July this year.
Ik zal uw Kamer de resultaten inclusief een reactie van het kabinet, uiterlijk 1 juli dit jaar toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Yücel en Volp over het bericht dat Syrische kindbruiden in Nederland uit beeld dreigen te raken

MPs Kuiken, Yücel and Volp asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Syrian child brides risk disappearing from view in the Netherlands, including whether children are vanishing from reception centres and how COA and Nidos protect them. The State Secretary answered that no reports of disappearances of married minor girls are known, that one minor entered wrongly under a residence permit, and described existing monitoring and guardianship arrangements, while a separate investigation into other vanished youths is ongoing.
The National Public Prosecution Service has therefore started an investigation into these young people following signals from COA and Nidos.
Het Landelijk Parket van het OM is dan ook naar aanleiding van de signalen van het COA en Nidos een onderzoek gestart naar deze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vaker betalingsachterstand na slechte financiële opvoeding’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Nibud report linking poor financial upbringing to payment arrears among young people, and what role government, schools, and businesses should play in financial education. The State Secretary endorsed the findings, described shared responsibility of parents and schools, listed existing support for financial education and Wijzer in Geldzaken, and noted that the new curriculum process and sector-led initiatives are underway.
I recognise and endorse the conclusions of the Nibud.
De conclusies van het Nibud herken en onderschrijf ik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Uitgehuwelijkt: ‘Teruggaan betekent mijn dood’

MPs Yücel and Karabulut asked about a report of women forced into marriage while on holiday abroad and what the government does about it. The minister says forced marriage is criminal, cites prosecution options, prevention and awareness campaigns, and an action plan, but says no hard data on the number of cases exists.
It is inherent in the nature of the problem that no hard data are available on this.
Het is inherent aan de aard van de problematiek, dat hierover geen harde gegevens beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jacobi over de handhaving van cao’s

MPs Yücel and Jacobi asked whether all childcare and early-education staff should be paid under the Peuterspeelzaalwerk collective agreement, whether the government monitors salary developments during municipal harmonisation, and what tools it has to enforce collective agreements. The minister answered that several collective agreements apply, that salary agreements are for social partners, and that the Inspectie SZW can investigate enforcement only at the request of social partners, with compliance being primarily their responsibility.
It is up to social partners to make agreements on salaries in the harmonisation of child care facilities.
Het is aan sociale partners om afspraken te maken over de salarissen bij de harmonisatie van de kindvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over 'minder vrouwen aan de top in de zorg'

Two PvdA MPs asked why women are underrepresented in top healthcare management despite forming most of the workforce, and whether diversity could improve quality. The minister answered that the government pursues a 30% target for women in senior government posts, is extending the statutory gender quota for large companies, and will consider a semi-public sector target in the Wbt evaluation, while noting that women hold 38% of healthcare board seats and that care institutions are private employers responsible for their own personnel policy.
The cabinet endorses that this pursuit of diversity should also apply to the sector financed with public funds.
Het kabinet onderschrijft dat dit streven naar diversiteit ook zou moeten gelden voor de met publieke middelen gefinancierde sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over misstanden bij kinderopvang De Sterrenberg in Arnhem

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported serious misconduct and safety problems at childcare centre De Sterrenberg in Arnhem, including its history of inspections and why sanctions were not imposed immediately. The minister answered that municipalities and their GGD inspectors are responsible for supervision and enforcement, outlined the eleven inspections since 2011 and the warnings and instructions issued, and explained the enforcement instruments available to municipalities.
As Minister of SZW, I do not concern myself with specific cases.
Als Minister van SZW ga ik niet over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Asscher: goud in handen bij twee dagdelen kinderopvang’

An MP asked Minister Asscher about his comments on childcare, the timing of a government response to the SER advice on childcare, whether short-term SER proposals will be acted on in this cabinet term, and whether medium- and long-term advice will be carried into the next cabinet. The minister answered that a full cabinet response will be sent before summer 2016, covering both labour participation and child development goals, and that he will consider taking up medium- and long-term recommendations.
I intend to send your House a cabinet response to the SER advice before the summer.
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor de zomer een kabinetsreactie op het SER-advies te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over beloningsonderscheid op hogescholen

MPs Yücel and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding pay-discrimination risks between men and women in universities of applied sciences (hogescholen), and the underrepresentation of women in the highest pay grade. The minister answered that hogescholen are responsible for their own pay policy, pointed to existing works council duties, the Charter Talent naar de Top and the national anti-discrimination action plan, and said the sector is taking up the issue.
Hogescholen are themselves responsible for their pay policy, but I think it is important that the sector takes up this problem.
Hogescholen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beloningsbeleid, maar ik vind het belangrijk dat de sector dit probleem oppakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de eis van de Turkse justitie van levenslange gevangenisstraf voor twee journalisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Turkish prosecution's demand for life imprisonment for two journalists, the charges against them, and the wider trend of journalist arrests in Turkey. The minister said Nigeria... no: the minister said the court must decide, called the demand exceptionally harsh, stressed that press freedom must improve in Turkey, and said the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, while giving only a rough count of about seventeen jailed journalists.
The Netherlands and the EU attach importance to freedom of expression and press freedom in Turkey.
Nederland en de EU hechten aan vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de teruglopende vraag naar kinderopvang onder lagere inkomens

Yücel (PvdA) asked the minister why childcare use fell among lower-income families despite government investment, and about segregation in childcare and the motion on integrated child centres. The minister acknowledged concern, announced a study on low-income childcare use, said causes are not yet clear, and promised a response on the motion before summer 2016.
That is why I intend to conduct a study this spring into the use of childcare among low-income groups.
Daarom ben ik voornemens om dit voorjaar een onderzoek te doen naar het gebruik van kinderopvang onder lage inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat de kinderopvang honderden euro's duurder wordt ondanks hogere toeslag

An MP asks the Minister whether childcare price rises despite higher subsidies undermine the intended affordability for working parents, and asks for an inventory of price increases and a review of maximum hourly rates. The Minister agrees the subsidy aims to lower costs, says providers set their own prices subject to competition and parent committee advice, plans a research study in spring, and declines to intervene now.
I intend to conduct a study this spring into childcare use among low-income groups and the background of possibly declining use.
Ik ben voornemens dit voorjaar een onderzoek te gaan doen naar het gebruik van kinderopvang onder lage inkomens en achtergronden van het mogelijk afnemend gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Bouwmeester en Otwin van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Geldzaken in de praktijk 2015’ van het Nibud

MPs Yücel, Bouwmeester and Otwin van Dijk asked about Nibud findings on debt arrears driven by health costs, low public awareness of financial aid, the role of municipalities and integrated financial desks, and how health-cost compensation is made known and used. The government answered that it monitors low incomes, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and receive extra funding, and that it is running information campaigns on the deductible and health-cost compensation.
In response to this motion I visited the Geldloket in Amersfoort.
In reactie op deze motie ben ik op bezoek geweest bij het Geldloket in Amersfoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de situatie van LHBT’ers in het AZC in Alphen aan den Rijn

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked the State Secretary about bedreigingen and harassment of LGBT asylum seekers in the Alphen aan den Rijn reception centre, the threshold for 'acute emergency' relocation, sanctions on perpetrators, and why no complaints were filed. The State Secretary answered that victims can be moved on request, perpetrators are sanctioned, COA encourages complaints but the group declined to file, and the hunger-strike protocol is adequate.
I want to emphasise that if the safety of a resident is at stake, COA arranges other housing, if the victim wishes so.
Ik wil benadrukken dat, als de veiligheid van een bewoner in het geding is, door het COA andere huisvesting geregeld wordt, als het slachtoffer dat wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het CBS-rapport ‘Armoede en sociale uitsluiting 2015’

An MP asks the State Secretary about the CBS poverty report 2015, including whether the projected small fall in low-income households is a lasting trend and how the structural 100 million euro for poverty reduction reaches households with children. The State Secretary answers that the decline is welcome and hoped to be a lasting trend, describes the municipal use of funds and sports/culture participation measures, and outlines employment and integration measures for groups at higher risk.
I have asked municipalities to pay special attention to children in poverty when intensifying their poverty and debt policy.
Ik heb gemeenten gevraagd om bij de intensivering van hun armoede- en schuldenbeleid speciale aandacht te besteden aan kinderen in armoede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Yücel over het voornemen van het waterschap Delfland de kwijtschelding van de afvalwaterzuiveringsheffing in twee stappen geheel af te schaffen

MPs Jacobi and Yücel asked whether the Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission (kwijtschelding) of the wastewater treatment levy would hurt low-income households and whether national government should intervene. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards are autonomous in remission policy, that consultations with the Unie van Waterschappen took place, and that social minimum safety nets such as bijstand and municipal compensation exist, with no national intervention planned.

At the same time it was established that the individual water boards are themselves responsible for their own remission policy and account for it to the general board of the water board, which is democratically elected.

Tegelijkertijd is vastgesteld dat de individuele waterschappen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun eigen kwijtscheldingsbeleid en dat zij hierover verantwoording afleggen aan het algemeen bestuur van het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen opgroeien in de bijstand

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that more children are growing up on social assistance, and what is being done to prevent child poverty and support children's participation. The state secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the economic crisis and divorce, pointed to work as the main route out of poverty, described municipal child packages and extra funding, and promised to alert municipalities and fund projects.

I will actively draw municipalities' attention in the next collective letter to the findings of the research on experiences with the child package, and call on them to pay special attention to involving children in child-oriented poverty policy and reaching children.

Ik zal gemeenten in de volgende verzamelbrief actief attenderen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de ervaringen met het kindpakket en hen daarbij oproepen om speciale aandacht te besteden aan het betrekken van kinderen bij het kindgericht armoedebeleid en aan het bereiken van kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het weigeren van een stageplaats vanwege de seksuele geaardheid

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the ministers about a reported refusal of an internship because of sexual orientation, and about government support and diversity policy. The minister condemns discrimination, points to the existing action plan on labour-market discrimination, existing complaint channels (College voor de Rechten van de Mens, local anti-discrimination services) and the diversity charter, without assessing the specific case.
The assessment of whether discrimination occurred in this specific case is for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the judge.
De beoordeling of in deze specifieke casus sprake is van discriminatie is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens (College) of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Bijna geen mannen meer werkzaam in de kinderopvang’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether male staff in childcare have nearly disappeared, why, and what action will be taken to increase their numbers. The minister answered that the share of men is low, gave reasons such as parental preference and employer selection, said the national government has not pursued active policy and sees limited room, but committed to equal opportunities and to cooperating on a cultural change in training and recruitment.
I am of the view that men can work in childcare just as well as women.
Ik ben van mening dat mannen net zo goed in de opvang kunnen werken als vrouwen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kuiken over de mogelijkheid tot het inzetten van mensenrechtenambassadeurs op AZC’s

MPs Yücel and Kuiken asked whether human rights ambassadors could be deployed in asylum centres to explain Dutch fundamental values, after reports of threats to religious freedom and safety for vulnerable residents. Minister Asscher answered that COA receives such signals, applies rules on religious practice and discrimination, provides civic information, and is discussing with organisations how to expand this, including the VON proposal.
COA therefore willingly enters into discussion with VON to explore the possible contribution these human rights ambassadors could make.
Het COA gaat daarom graag het gesprek aan met VON om te bespreken welke mogelijke bijdrage de genoemde mensenrechtenambassadeurs kunnen leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yucel over de sociale kloof in de EU

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Bertelsmann Stiftung report showing a widening social gap in the EU, its figures on unemployment and poverty, and the effectiveness of the EU Youth Guarantee for young people. The government answered that the figures match Eurostat and CBS data, that structural reforms and sharing of best practices are the priority, that it is too early to judge the Youth Guarantee's effectiveness, and that the Netherlands performs well on youth unemployment and poverty; it promised a further explanation during the budget debate.
As previously promised, you will receive the further elaboration of the plans before the SZW budget debate.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt u voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW de nadere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de veiligheid van Lesbische, Homoseksuele, Biseksuele en Transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers in opvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked about reports of threats and bullying against LHBT asylum seekers in reception centres and whether protective measures such as separate housing or a trusted person are planned. The State Secretary answered that incidents were few before the surge in arrivals, that COA staff are trained to act as trusted persons, and that separate LHBT housing is not desirable.
I consider it important that all COA staff in the reception centres have sufficient skills to act as a trusted person and therefore see no added value in a separate trusted person.

Ik vind het van belang dat alle COA medewerkers in de opvang voldoende vaardigheden hebben om als vertrouwenspersoon op te treden en zie daarmee geen meerwaarde in een afzonderlijke vertrouwenspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel inzake het bericht dat 'NWO vrouwelijke wetenschappers discrimineert’

An MP asked whether NWO's grant process discriminates against female scientists, citing a study showing women had lower Veni grant success rates in 2010-2012, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges gender inequality and says NWO will pilot bias training and a follow-up study, but declines to judge the study's findings or monitor the measures separately.
Separate monitoring of this subject is not on the agenda.
Aparte monitoring op dit onderwerp is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel inzake het bericht dat het wettelijk streefcijfer voor het aantal vrouwen in de top niet gehaald wordt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the failure to reach the statutory 30% target for women in top management, and why only 7.8% of listed company boards are women. The minister acknowledged the slow progress, described the Impuls Vrouwen naar de Top and related voluntary initiatives, and promised to inform parliament this autumn about next steps and possible measures.
I will inform you this autumn, based on the experiences with the Impuls and the outcomes of the Bedrijvenmonitor, about the next steps and measures to promote more diversity at the top.

Ik zal u aan de hand van de ervaringen met de Impuls en de uitkomsten van de Bedrijvenmonitor dit najaar informeren over de volgende stappen en maatregelen om meer diversiteit aan de top te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over minimagezinnen waarvoor de kosten van mbo-opleidingen voor hun kinderen onbetaalbaar zouden worden

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked whether low-income families can afford mbo school costs now that the WTOS allowance for under-18s was abolished, and whether this forces students to drop out. The minister acknowledges the change makes payment harder, says about 27,000 students previously received WTOS and that the kindgebonden budget increase compensates most, points to school payment plans and local funds, and says municipalities are responsible for local support.
It is true that the income-dependent allowance for education contributions and school costs (WTOS) for parents of children under 18 ceased to exist from school year 2015/2016.
Het klopt dat de inkomensafhankelijke tegemoetkoming in de onderwijsbijdrage en schoolkosten (WTOS) voor ouders met kinderen jonger dan 18 jaar vanaf schooljaar 2015/2016 is opgehouden te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat één op de vier vaders ouderschapsverlof opneemt

MP Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that few fathers take parental leave, and whether the government would act on fathers' limited use of leave and extend paternity leave. The minister said fathers' leave-taking is rising but remains low, that the choice lies with parents, that paternity leave will be extended to 5 paid days with a bill in 2016, and that the SER advice on work and care is pending.
The cabinet has therefore decided to extend paternity leave for partners to 5 days of paid leave.
Het kabinet heeft dan ook besloten om het kraamverlof voor de partners uit te breiden tot 5 dagen betaald verlof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes inzake de homohatende songteksten van de Surinaamse band Hakuna Matata Gang

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked ministers about homophobic lyrics by the Surinamese band Hakuna Matata Gang, whether they would be prosecuted during Dutch tours, and whether Suriname's government would be pressed to withdraw support and promote LGBT rights. The minister replied that the Dutch concerts were cancelled, the video removed, the band dropped the song, and the OM is reviewing a complaint, while Suriname denies financial support and the embassy has raised concerns and funded LGBTI rights work.
The Public Prosecution Service can decide to pursue criminal prosecution if it would turn out that during an event there was incitement to hatred
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan besluiten om tot strafrechtelijke vervolging over te gaan indien zou blijken dat tijdens een evenement sprake is geweest van het aanzetten tot haat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de reportage ’Rust rond de wieg’

MP Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a TV report claiming the Netherlands ranks with Guatemala and Rwanda on parental leave, whether a comparative study was underway, and whether leave should be extended to support infant care. The minister rejected the comparison, pointed to a pending SER advisory report on work and care, said parental leave choice is for parents, and ruled out extending leave or introducing baby leave for now.
I expect to receive the SER's advice at the end of the year.
Ik verwacht het advies van de SER aan het einde van het jaar te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over het bericht dat actiegroep "Zij Is Hier" een pand kraakt voor de opvang van kwetsbare en verborgen vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked about a women's shelter set up by activist group Zij Is Hier in a squatted building in Amsterdam Nieuw West, whether abandoned women with insecure residence status can access municipal shelters, and what measures and human rights ambassadors could provide. The state secretary answered that the municipality could not verify the number of occupants, that eight people were later housed in Nieuw West, that Amsterdam shelter options remain available regardless of residence status, and that trained volunteers could be deployed on rights and referral.
At our request, the municipality of Amsterdam sent us a factual account of the report that an activist group had squatted a building in Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft ons op ons verzoek een feitenrelaas doen toekomen over het bericht dat een actiegroep een pand heeft gekraakt in Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat moeders minder zijn gaan werken door de bezuiniging op de kinderopvang

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that mothers worked less after the childcare subsidy cut, and about the conflicting findings of the CBS and CPB analyses. The minister explained methodological differences, said participation has moved in line with the general population, and promised to inform parliament on any additional measures in the budget.
I will inform you about this during the budget debate.
Ik informeer u hierover bij begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over de dood van de Rotterdamse Yasmeen Dad

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked the ministers about the death of Yasmeen Dad, who lived in isolation, and whether police had signals of her oppression and what help exists for such women. The minister says criminal investigation limits disclosure, refers to police methods for honour-related violence and to the Rotterdam pilot with community key figures, and does not commit to a new investigation.
Beyond that, no statements can be made because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case.
Voor het overige geldt dat geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de vergrote kans op buikgriep bij kinderdagverblijven

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a RIVM/UMC Utrecht study linking childcare centres to higher risk of stomach flu, and what measures would improve hygiene. The minister said hygiene is already part of mandatory risk assessments and GGD inspections, that the RIVM guideline will be revised in 2015 with the sector, and that a possible healthy-childcare quality mark has not yet been decided.
In 2015 the regular revision of the guideline on health risks in a childcare centre or playgroup will take place.
In 2015 zal de reguliere herziening plaatsvinden van de richtlijn «gezondheidsrisico’s in een kindercentrum of peuterspeelzaal»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Karabulut en Yücel over de invordering van belasting- en toeslagschulden door de Belastingdienst

MPs Schouten, Karabulut and Yücel asked whether the Tax Authority's recovery of tax and benefit debts ignores personal circumstances and the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet), pushing people deeper into debt, and how the motion on respecting the subsistence allowance will be implemented. The State Secretary acknowledged the Tax Authority cannot always account for personal circumstances, pointed to payment arrangements and the duty of debtors to act, exempted single parents from set-off against the child budget, and promised to discuss the report's recommendations with the LOSR and inform parliament.
The Tax Authority makes every effort to respect the subsistence allowance in line with the Schouten et al. motion.
De Belastingdienst spant zich maximaal in om conform de motie Schouten c.s. de beslagvrije voet te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een imam tientallen religieuze huwelijken sloot zonder voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk

An MP asked whether an imam who conducted dozens of religious marriages without prior civil marriage, and the mosque board's knowledge of it, would be investigated, and what the government would do about such marriages and the women affected. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service investigated, found five provable cases, and imposed conditional fines, that the government has no overview of how many such marriages occur, and that it will inform parliament on a possible study before the end of 2014 and is strengthening support and awareness measures.
The cabinet has no insight into the scale on which Islamic marriages without a prior civil marriage are concluded.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de schaal waarop islamitische huwelijken, waarbij geen sprake is van een voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk, worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het toezicht op de gastouderopvang

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about inspection of childminding (gastouderopvang), including how often childminders are checked, whether many have never been inspected, and whether safety and quality are adequately guaranteed. The Minister answers that new childminders are inspected before registration and existing ones are checked by risk-based sampling of at least 5% yearly, that an analysis of uninspected new registrants will follow in 2015, and that a bill extending continuous screening is forthcoming.
All new childminders are inspected before registration.
Alle nieuwe gastouders worden vóór registratie geïnspecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over schulden voorkomen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether he knew of CNV union debt-prevention courses for employees, whether he would engage employers and unions on debt prevention and wage garnishment, and whether he would research the effect of financial problems on sickness absence. The State Secretary answered yes to all three, citing sector initiatives such as aviation, subsidies to Hogeschool Utrecht, ongoing talks with Nibud and Divosa, and a 2012 study on sickness absence.
Yes, I am certainly willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de schending van vrouwenrechten in Hongarije

PvdA MPs Maij and Yücel asked the government about a Hungarian police video that appeared to blame victims of sexual assault, and about the state of women's rights in Hungary and the EU. The minister condemned the video's suggestion that victims are responsible, described Hungary's uneven legal protections, and pointed to EU rule-of-law initiatives and a planned discussion in the Council.
The cabinet is working on this within the EU along two tracks.
Het kabinet zet zich hiervoor binnen de EU in langs twee sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het ontslag van een leerkracht vanwege de wisseling naar een ander kerkgenootschap

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether a teacher may be dismissed for switching church affiliation despite respecting the school's founding principles, who granted any dismissal permit, and whether this ground is compatible with the proposed bill on the single-fact construction. The minister answered that the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights found no prohibited discrimination, no dismissal permit was required under the BBA, and that the proposed bill would still permit such religious-based distinctions for religious schools.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over onoplosbare schulden

MPs Yücel and Schouten asked about the Jungmann report on unsolvable debt situations, including eligibility criteria for debt rescheduling, municipal barriers, behavioural factors and alternative help. The state secretary answered that the report's exclusion practices conflict with the Wgs, that municipal help should be client-oriented, and that a broader range of support exists beyond debt rescheduling, with a letter on the debt policy and the land debt register promised for December.
Excluding debtors does not solve the underlying problem.
Het uitsluiten van schuldenaren lost de eigenlijke problematiek niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over discriminerende opmerkingen op internet over Nederlandse profvoetballers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked ministers whether they would act on racist online comments about Dutch professional footballers and whether the victims had filed reports. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has opened a preliminary fact-finding inquiry, that MiND has forwarded five reports, and that he sees no need to direct the players or the KNVB to file complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service is opening a preliminary fact-finding inquiry to assess whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een oriënterend feitenonderzoek in om te beoordelen of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat 2,5 miljoen mensen in Nederland onder de armoedegrens leven

Yücel (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a report claiming 2.5 million people in the Netherlands live below the poverty line, and how this squares with CBS and CPB figures of 1.2 million. Klijnsma answered that the higher figure uses the EU AROPE indicator, that the government's standard low-income measure gives about 1.3 million people, and that she supports an integrated anti-poverty approach with municipalities.
The concept of poverty is not a fixed notion that can best be measured by a single key figure; there are several angles and definitions to gain insight into the different aspects of the problem.

Het begrip armoede is geen vastomlijnd concept dat het beste door middel van één kerncijfer gemeten zou kunnen worden, er zijn meerdere invalshoeken en definities om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende aspecten van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de betrokkenheid van jihadisten  bij onderwijsorganisaties

Two MPs asked ministers about jihadist involvement in a private Arabic-language and Islamic education foundation, including oversight, funding and whether such bodies can be shut down. The government said it finds extremist messaging unacceptable, that the foundation falls outside inspection as non-recognised education, and that it will act if laws are broken, while declining to give details on specific persons or organisations.
No public statements will be made about investigative information on specific persons or organisations.
Over onderzoeksgegevens over specifieke personen of organisaties worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer, Yücel en Hamer over fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Nijboer, Yücel and Hamer asked the State Secretary of Finance about a childcare benefit fraud case, parents facing large repayments and eviction, and whether the Tax Authority recovers from fraudulent providers. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that parents are liable for repayment and can appeal, outlined recovery practices, and said the motion on reducing repayments will be addressed in the next half-year report.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, I cannot discuss individual cases in public.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet in de openbaarheid op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Gambia

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about Gambia's anti-gay bill and deteriorating human rights, including whether he would raise it with Gambia, in the EU and at the UN, and the effect on EU aid. The minister answered that the bill passed parliament and awaits presidential assent, expressed concern, said the EU and the Dutch ambassador have raised it with Gambian authorities, and that Gambia will be reviewed at the UN Universal Periodic Review, with EU aid decisions to be reassessed later.
The cabinet considers that dialogue on the bill can be conducted most effectively at EU level.
Het kabinet vindt dat een dialoog over het wetsvoorstel het meest effectief in EU-verband gevoerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de bonussen van de top van Estro kinderopvang

An MP asked the ministers whether they condemn bonuses paid to Estro childcare's top management shortly before its bankruptcy, and about the pre-pack restructuring and the role of shareholders. The ministers said the curator will examine whether the bonuses can be recovered, and that the curator's findings on the pre-pack and shareholders will be reported to parliament.
The curator will of course investigate this.
De curator van Estro zal dit vanzelfsprekend onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over “verslechterde arbeidsvoorwaarden na de overname van Estro”

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about worsened employment conditions after the Smallsteps takeover of childcare provider Estro, including whether older permanent staff were replaced by young temporary workers and what rights transferred employees have. The minister answered that employees received unchanged terms from Smallsteps, that the transfer-of-undertaking rules do not apply after bankruptcy (a question the courts may decide, as FNV plans litigation), and that the curator is investigating the causes of the bankruptcy with no completion date.
A judgement on this specific situation is reserved for the court, should FNV indeed ask the court for one.
Een oordeel over deze specifieke situatie is voorbehouden aan de rechter mocht deze daarom inderdaad door de FNV worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Yücel over diabeteshandelingen op het kinderdagverblijf

MPs Siderius and Yücel asked the Minister whether parents of children with diabetes face a gap in childcare, since regular daycare staff will not administer insulin and children lack a medical daycare indication, and whether the medical-act classification could be revisited. The Minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to wijkverpleegkundige arrangements, and declined a separate study while awaiting an education-ministry review due in October.
For that reason I see no need to carry out a separate exploration.
Ik zie om die reden geen noodzaak om een aparte verkenning uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de demonstratie van ISIS-aanhangers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports of an ISIS-supporter demonstration in The Hague, including alleged Hitler salutes, racist chants, and a threatened journalist. Minister Opstelten answered that police observed no hate-inciting or offensive texts, that investigations found no Hitler salute, and that prosecution decisions rest with the public prosecutor.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether criminal limits were exceeded in this case.
Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of er in dit geval strafrechtelijke grenzen zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over het bekladden van een huis in Almere

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a house in Almere smeared with swastikas, whether neighbours had been targeted before, whether a complaint was filed, and whether this signals wider intimidation of ethnic minorities, plus election results in Duindorp and Almere Poort. The minister confirmed a police complaint for vandalism, discrimination and insult, found no prior signals in the street, condemned the incident as isolated, and promised to publish a 2013 police registration report on discrimination in August 2014.
For the results of the local elections I refer you to the websites of both municipalities.
Voor de uitslagen van de lokale verkiezingen verwijs ik u naar de websites van beide gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over stelselmatige discriminatie van bewoners in de Haagse wijk Duindorp

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about alleged systematic harassment of migrant-background residents in The Hague's Duindorp district, whether the minister would visit, what measures were taken, and whether similar problems exist elsewhere. The minister answered that the mayor reports no systematic driving-out of residents, that local police, the housing corporation and municipal partners are handling incidents through an integrated approach, and that anti-discrimination policy is a local responsibility with no national overview.
The cabinet does not have a national overview at the level of cities or neighbourhoods of cases of driving out neighbourhood residents on grounds of racial discrimination.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk overzicht op het niveau van steden of wijken van gevallen van het (weg)pesten van buurtbewoners op grond van rassendiscriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de mogelijke postcodediscriminatie bij energiebedrijf Oxxio

Two MPs asked the ministers whether energy company Oxxio's creditworthiness checks and deposit demands amount to postcode discrimination under the Equal Treatment Act, and whether the minister would act against Oxxio or other energy firms. The minister replied that Oxxio does not decide on postcode alone, that the postcode plays only a limited role, that no direct discrimination was found, and that the ACM and the Equal Treatment bodies are the proper channels, so no further steps were planned.
Oxxio states that no increased risk is established on the basis of the postcode alone.
Oxxio geeft aan dat er geen verhoogd risico vastgesteld wordt op basis van enkel de postcode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de integratie van Somaliërs

An MP asked the minister about the poor integration outcomes of Somali Dutch people, the effects of abolishing target-group policy, and whether a dedicated action plan and study support for older refugees are possible. The minister acknowledged the concerning picture, defended the generic integration approach with room for tailored measures, pointed to existing stakeholder meetings, and described municipal and student-finance options.
I recognise the findings of the research and share your view that it shows a worrying picture of the position of Somalis.
Ik herken de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en deel met u dat dit een zorgelijk beeld laat zien van de positie van Somaliërs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over het bericht dat een bedrijf voor een vacature “mensen van Hollandse bodem” zoekt

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a company advertising for staff 'of Dutch soil' and whether this constitutes employment discrimination by origin. The minister called such discrimination unacceptable, explained that vacancy texts fall under the Equal Treatment Act and that assessment rests with the courts or the Equal Treatment Commission, and promised an action plan on labour market discrimination in May.
Whether there is discrimination in this job advertisement is for the judge or the Equal Treatment Commission to assess.
Of er in deze personeelsadvertentie sprake is van discriminatie staat ter beoordeling aan de rechter of het College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Yücel en Kuzu over het niet toelaten van kinderen tot sportverenigingen van op basis van achternamen

MPs asked whether children were refused membership of a Rotterdam football club based on their surname or origin and whether the government would investigate such refusals. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to commission a study of refusal numbers, and said the KNVB had contacted the club and requested a written statement before any further action.
A study into the number of times children are refused on improper grounds is something I will not commission.
Een onderzoek naar het aantal keren dat kinderen op basis van oneigenlijke gronden worden geweigerd, ga ik niet laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Yücel over het voornemen van het concern AKZO om de productieafdeling van de vestiging Deventer naar het buitenland te verplaatsen

MPs Kerstens, Hamer and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to move production from Deventer abroad, costing about 215 jobs, and what the government could do. The minister replied that the decision is a business-economic one the government cannot interfere with, pointed to general business-climate policy and R&D retention in Deventer, and said the ministry had discussed the decision with the company's management.
However, the cabinet cannot interfere in the business-economic decisions of companies.
Het kabinet kan zich echter niet mengen in bedrijfseconomische beslissingen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over de anti-homowetgeving in Oeganda

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked whether the government knew of Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether it opposes it, and how Dutch development aid to Uganda relates to good governance and human rights. The minister confirmed the law, said President Museveni refused to sign it and that the Netherlands pressed for EU action, and described the roughly 23 million euro aid programme, including funds for human rights and the justice sector.
The Dutch cabinet pressed within the EU for joint pressure on the Ugandan government not to approve this law.
Het Nederlandse kabinet heeft binnen de EU aangedrongen op gezamenlijke druk op de Ugandese regering om niet met deze wet in te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over het bericht “India top court reinstates gay sex ban”

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the Indian Supreme Court reinstating the ban on same-sex relations, and whether the Netherlands would raise abolition of the law with India. The minister answered that only parliament can amend the provision (or the government via ordinance with presidential consent), that the EU High Representative already expressed concern, and that the Supreme Court left repeal to parliament, so no concrete step was committed.
The Supreme Court indicated that it is for parliament to possibly revise this provision.
Het Hooggerechtshof heeft aangegeven dat het aan het parlement is om deze bepaling eventueel te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Yücel over het bericht dat werkloze allochtone jongeren niet worden bereikt

MPs Hamer and Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether reports that unemployed migrant youths are not being reached are accurate, how large that group is, and what measures will ensure they find training or work. The minister said the nationally small group of youths without work, school or benefits is about 1.2%, but is markedly higher among migrant youths in the G4, and listed existing programmes and the implementation of a related motion, while declining to answer the questions before the 2014 budget debate.
No, more time was needed to answer.
Nee, voor beantwoording was langer de tijd nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de schending van de rechten van homo- en biseksuelen en transgenders (LGBT) in Iran

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the rights of LGBT people in Iran, citing a report on discriminatory provisions in Iran's penal code and asking whether the Netherlands can directly support Iranian LGBT-rights NGOs. The minister agreed that the penal code discriminates and that it conflicts with international human rights norms, but said direct funding to Iranian NGOs is generally not possible due to Iranian state conditions, and listed indirect measures such as EU and UN diplomacy and project funding.

Providing a direct (financial) contribution to non-governmental organisations (NGOs) in Iran is usually not possible due to the controlling conditions the Iranian government imposes on NGOs that receive support from abroad.

Het leveren van een rechtstreekse (financiële) bijdrage aan niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's) in Iran is meestal niet mogelijk vanwege de controlerende voorwaarden die de Iraanse overheid stelt aan NGO's die steun ontvangen uit het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de afnemende deelname aan inburgering

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp drop in participation in civic integration courses in 2013 after the revised Integration Act, and about how integration obligations are monitored and enforced. The minister acknowledges fewer participants, attributes it to the narrower target group, says full data are not yet available and promises to inform parliament in spring 2014.
At this moment I do not yet have full insight into the number of new civic integration obligees who participate in an integration programme.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen volledig inzicht in het aantal nieuwe inburgeringsplichtigen dat deelneemt aan een inburgeringsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Van Laar over het niet doorgaan van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

MPs Yücel and Van Laar asked about the cancelled first Gay Pride on Curaçao, whether the government imposed last-minute conditions, whether police deemed flags and demonstration items dangerous, and whether Raveneau's letter to church leaders influenced this, and asked the government to press Curaçao on LHBT rights. The minister replied that public order and emancipation policy on Curaçao are autonomous matters, the reasons behind the police conditions are not known to him, and he has received no signals that LHBT rights are not respected, while pointing to the Curaçao government's stated support and the Pink Orange Akkoord funding.
It is up to the government of Curaçao to weigh to what extent additional requirements are needed for organising the Gay Pride in order to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat een pabo-studente geweigerd zou zijn voor een stage bij een Montessori basisschool vanwege het dragen van een hoofddoek

MPs Yücel and Jadnanansing asked whether a Rotterdam pabo student was refused a traineeship at a public Montessori school because she wore a headscarf, and about the wider position of headscarves and dress rules in schools. The state secretary answered that the traineeship ended for other substantive reasons, that the school did discourage the headscarf, that the school board and university agreed the headscarf is not an issue, and explained the case law and the rules for public versus religious schools.
This showed that the student was not refused because of wearing a headscarf, but that the traineeship did not proceed for other, substantive reasons.
Hieruit is gebleken dat de studente niet is geweigerd op grond van het dragen van een hoofddoek, maar dat de stage om andere, inhoudelijke redenen niet is doorgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over het Russische voornemen kinderen weg te halen bij homoseksuele ouders

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister about a Russian bill that would allow children to be removed from homosexual parents, and whether the Netherlands would act on it. The minister confirmed knowledge of the bill, called it objectionable, estimated possibly over 2 million children affected, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue in EU-Russia human rights channels.

At the next Foreign Affairs Council discussion where Russia is on the agenda, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and the pending bill, whose adoption is still uncertain.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking in de RBZ waar Rusland op de agenda staat de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin en het voorliggende wetsvoorstel, waarvan nog onzeker is of het zal worden aangenomen, aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dekken en Yücel over het bericht aangaande de handhaving van de antihomowet tijdens de Olympische Spelen van Sotsji in 2014

MPs Dekken and Yücel asked the government whether it would press NOC*NSF and the EU over Russian sports minister statements that the anti-gay law would apply during the Sochi Olympics, and how Dutch athletes would be protected. The government said participants should not be hindered, that the IOC had received written assurances, and that the matter is under ongoing IOC attention, so it saw no reason to instruct NOC*NSF; it also pointed to EU guidelines and a travel advice note.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to call on NOC*NSF to do so.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen reden om het NOC*NSF hiertoe op te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter.
