The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de Baltic Pride in Litouwen

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Vilnius authorities were effectively blocking the 2013 Baltic Pride march, whether he had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would press the issue at EU level. The minister replied that the dispute concerned venue logistics rather than a ban, that the issue was raised in the EU human rights working group, and that the Netherlands supports LGBT rights through its embassy and EU policy without committing to a specific new step.

There is no ban by the Vilnius municipality on the planned Baltic Pride on 27 July, but there is a dispute between the municipality and the organisers of the Baltic Pride over the location where the Pride will take place.

Er is geen sprake van een verbod van de gemeente Vilnius op de geplande Baltic Pride op 27 juli, maar wel van een geschil tussen de gemeente en de organisatoren van de Baltic Pride over de locatie waar de Pride zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de arrestatie van tientallen mensen tijdens een Gay Pride demonstratie in Rusland

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the foreign minister about police ending a Gay Pride demonstration in St Petersburg and arresting dozens under Russia's new anti-propaganda law, and whether he had raised concerns with Russian counterparts and how Russian civil society could be supported. The minister confirmed the facts, condemned the dispersal, said the government raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and pledged continued support for projects on acceptance and free expression.
The government will keep repeating, in bilateral talks and at EU level, that the new legislation has a stigmatising effect.
Het kabinet zal blijven herhalen, in bilaterale gesprekken en in EU-verband, dat de nieuwe wetgeving een stigmatiserende werking heeft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over het artikel ‘meer kans op een baan met een Nederlandse naam’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a report that job applicants with non-Dutch names are less likely to be invited to interviews, and whether anonymous application should be promoted, with government as a leader. The state secretary found the finding disappointing, noted discrimination must be fought where proven, pointed to a pending SER advisory report, and declined to promote anonymous applications, saying employers bear primary responsibility.
Following this advice, I want to examine whether and what follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies wil ik bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de rol van ondersteunende organisaties bij het sluiten van een religieus kindhuwelijk

An MP asked the government how it reacted to reports that police and Fier Fryslân helped arrange a religious child marriage, and how agencies handling honour-related cases weigh cultural background against law and women's rights. The minister denied that the law was broken, said the police withdrew once safety was no longer at stake, stated that LEC-EGG was not involved in imam marriages, and held that the victim's interest comes first with no concessions to laws that conflict with Dutch law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een moskee in Amsterdam Slotervaart onder ‘Koeweits gezag’ staat

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that a Kuwaiti government-linked official chairs the foundation owning the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam Slotervaart, its foreign funding, its orientation, and whether subsidies or oversight apply. The minister answered that foreign funding of mosques is permitted within integration limits, that the Rijksoverheid gives no subsidy for religious practice, that the Blue Mosque received no municipal subsidy, and that the Openbaar Ministerie and a motion-based study address oversight of foreign financing.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de verdenking van mishandeling op koranscholen in Tilburg

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about suspected physical abuse at Quran schools in Tilburg, whether such incidents are more common at religious schools, and whether teachers using corporal punishment should be sanctioned. The minister reported six signals of possible child abuse at two Quran school organisations, said corporal punishment is not permitted in schools or the social environment, and noted that Quran schools fall outside Inspectorate supervision and that local authorities are responsible for acting on such signals.
For non-formal education, part of children's social environment, it is the responsibility of local authorities to address the institutions concerned when there are signals of physical punishment.

Voor niet-formeel onderwijs, onderdeel van de sociale leefomgeving van kinderen, geldt dat het de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteiten is om bij signalen van fysieke bestraffing betreffende instellingen aan te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het bericht dat allochtone leerlingen vaak niet welkom zijn op een 'witte school'

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether primary schools refuse ethnic minority pupils and what the government will do about it and about school segregation. The state secretary said the small study does not support the conclusion, that OCW has no data showing ethnic background plays a role in admissions, that further research and dialogue with school boards are not needed, and that segregation is tackled locally with quality measures.
No such conclusion can be drawn from the small-scale study.
Uit het kleinschalige onderzoek kan deze conclusie niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de gemeente Venray die in gesprek is met de Marokkaanse overheid over criminele jongeren

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked whether the municipality of Venray has received help from the Moroccan government in tackling criminal youths of Moroccan origin, and whether this is appropriate. The minister replied that the mayor only had informal, informative contacts with Moroccan officials, no agreements were made, that the problem is a Dutch responsibility, and that his ministry has itself provided support.
There is, however, no question of cooperation or assistance in tackling this problem.
Van samenwerking en hulp bij de aanpak van dit probleem is echter geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de oorzaken en voedingsbodem van de radicalisering van bijvoorbeeld de Nederlandse islamitische 
jongens die zich inzetten voor de jihad in Syrië

An MP asked the government about the causes and breeding ground of radicalisation of young Dutch Muslims travelling to Syria for jihad, and whether organisations contribute to it. The minister answered that radical movements such as Sharia4Holland and Behind Bars created environments for radicalisation, that the precise breeding ground is hard to pinpoint, and that returnees are assessed and may receive tailored support, while declining to give specific intelligence on persons or organisations.
I cannot make public statements about specific research data on persons or organisations.
Over specifieke onderzoeksgegevens over personen of organisaties kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel en Kooiman over de bedreiging van enkele jongeren uit Arnhem aan het adres van een stadsgenoot

MPs asked whether a Turkish man who publicly condemned antisemitic remarks by young Turks in Arnhem went into hiding after death threats, and whether the victim was supported and the perpetrators identified. The minister answered that the mayor advised him to stay elsewhere temporarily, police found no concrete threats, no complaint was filed, and the prosecutor opened an investigation into one minor for group insult, leading to a educational sanction.
Police research shows there is no question of concrete threats against the Turkish man or his family.
Uit onderzoek van de politie blijkt dat er geen sprake is van concrete bedreigingen tegen de Turkse man of zijn gezin.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yüçel en Jadnanansing over het optreden van een imam in de aula van een middelbare school in Vlissingen

MPs Yüçel and Jadnanansing asked how a controversial imam came to give a talk in a Vlissingen secondary school hall without the school knowing its content, and whether the school was put in an embarrassing position. The minister answered that the school rents out space without vetting event content, the organising group did not specifically report the speaker, the school will now assess rental requests on content, and the speech is publicly available online.
In future it will also assess rental requests on their content.
In de toekomst verzoeken van verhuur ook inhoudelijk zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over toezicht op de medische kinderopvang

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked about the supervision of medical childcare after reports that no checks are carried out, including screening of staff and the four-eyes principle. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate for Youth Care and the Health Care Inspectorate apply risk-based supervision, that no serious concerns emerged from visits, and that a four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, without committing to new steps.
Taking further steps is not necessary in view of the above.
Het nemen van verdere stappen is gezien bovenstaande niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over ongelijke beloning tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Hamer asked whether unequal pay between men and women is acceptable, what the statistics show for the Netherlands versus the EU and OECD, and which countries have low gaps. The government answered that unequal pay for equal work is unacceptable, referred the question of additional measures to the SER, and cited CBS and Eurostat figures showing a gap of about 13-20 percent depending on sector, with unexplained parts that do not necessarily indicate discrimination.
On 18 February 2013 I asked the SER in an advisory request on discrimination in the labour market which additional actions could help prevent and combat unequal pay.

Ik heb op 18 februari 2013 in een adviesaanvraag over discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt aan de SER gevraagd welke aanvullende acties kunnen bijdragen aan het voorkómen en bestrijden van ongelijke beloning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yücel over moskee-internaten

MPs Azmani and Yücel asked ministers about moskee-internaten (mosque boarding schools), including Rotterdam's fire-safety enforcement, reports of corporal punishment, integration concerns, and whether legal tools exist. The ministers answered that local authorities are responsible, that the Rotterdam fire-safety conclusion is accepted, that a quality framework and supervision proposal will be developed by May, and that no full picture of indirect subsidies exists yet.

Therefore it has been agreed that central government and municipalities, in consultation with the internaten concerned and other parties, will develop a quality framework focusing on, among other things, pedagogical policy, safety and the welfare of children at these boarding schools.

Daarom is afgesproken dat rijk en gemeenten in afstemming met de betrokken internaten en eventuele andere partijen zullen komen tot een kwaliteitskader met aandacht voor onder andere het pedagogisch beleid, de veiligheid en het welzijn van kinderen op deze internaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over oneigenlijk gebruik van de kinderopvangtoeslag

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about reported multi-million euro fraud with childcare allowances in 2009-2010 and why measures announced in 2011 did not prevent it. The minister answered that the measures took effect in 2012, that roughly 40 million euro of fraud had been established with a further 40 million under prosecution, that the effectiveness of the measures cannot be precisely demonstrated, and that no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures at this stage. When I see reason to do so, the House will be informed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen. Wanneer ik daar aanleiding toe zie, zal de Kamer daar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over het bericht ‘Meer Marokkaanse drop-outs'

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked the Minister of Education about a report of rising early school leaving among Moroccan-Dutch youth, the effectiveness of €30 million spent on the targeted approach, and the CPB findings on coaching. The minister answered that the rise was limited to a small group in 22 municipalities, that the rate has since fallen, that the subsidy served broader goals, and that she will continue the regional early-school-leaving approach and report to parliament.
In the meantime the decline in dropouts has resumed, both nationally and in the 22 municipalities.
Inmiddels heeft de daling van de uitval weer doorgezet, zowel op landelijk niveau als in de 22 gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de onmogelijkheid om te slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen

Yücel (PvdA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast showing a candidate repeatedly failing the civic integration exam over a pronunciation error, and asked about failure rates, feedback to candidates, and a hardship clause. Minister Asscher answered with figures on repeat test-takers, announced feedback letters and preparation tips, noted an existing exemption route for candidates showing demonstrable effort, and said he will examine whether human assessors could re-review repeat candidates' spoken test results.

That is why I will examine whether and how the results of a candidate who has failed the Dutch Spoken Language Test several times can also, even when the speech computer directly assessed the answers, still be assessed by human assessors.

Daarom zal ik onderzoeken of en hoe de resultaten van een kandidaat die meerdere malen voor de Toets Gesproken Nederlands is gezakt in Nederland, óók als de spraakcomputer de antwoorden van een kandidaat direct heeft kunnen beoordelen, alsnog door menselijke beoordelaars beoordeeld kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over vrouwen in topfuncties bij universiteiten en hogescholen

Two MPs asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about the low share of women in professorships and top posts at universities and universities of applied sciences, including measures, a 30% target and gender training. The minister answered that universities are autonomous, cited measures such as Talent naar de Top, Aspasia and the LNVH network, said a 30% target is reasonable with tailoring, and noted there is no mandatory gender training.
The Dutch universities are autonomous. The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science does not have figures on women who cannot progress.
De Nederlandse universiteiten zijn autonoom. Het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap beschikt niet over cijfers met betrekking tot vrouwen die niet kunnen doorstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Yücel over de renovatie van woningen door corporatie Eigen Haard

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a housing corporation renovating a flat building for Muslim residents, including whether religious wishes should be funded from guaranteed public loans and whether allocation should avoid segregation. The minister answered that corporations may consider residents' wishes but that housing must not become suitable for only one religious group, that the extra tap cost is minor and pragmatically accepted, and that allocation stays with the top of the waiting list.
It is good that housing corporations take residents' wishes into account. However, this may not lead to homes being suitable only for residence by a single religious or philosophical group.

Het is goed dat woningcorporaties rekening houden met wensen van bewoners. Dit mag er echter niet toe leiden dat woningen enkel nog geschikt zijn voor bewoning door één religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke groep.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de leidster/kind-ratio in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary about the new childcare staff-to-child ratio tool and reports that it was interpreted differently across the sector, and whether the Gunning commission's recommendations are being followed. The minister defended the tool as bringing clarity, said the 81 exceptions were agreed with sector bodies, committed to evaluating the tool six months after entry into force, and noted the four-eyes principle and continuous screening measures.
To assess the effects of the calculation tool on group compositions in practice, I will evaluate the tool six months after it takes effect.
Om te bezien welke gevolgen de rekentool heeft op de groepssamenstellingen in de praktijk zal ik de rekentool een half jaar na inwerkingtreding evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het gebrek aan voortgang van de ambitie om meer vrouwen in topfuncties te benoemen

An MP asked the government why the share of women in top public-sector posts has stagnated and what role government should play in reaching the 30% target. The minister reports a small rise in women among senior civil servants (20% in 2008 to 25.9% in 2012), attributes slow progress largely to cuts, and defers the question of a government role to the incoming cabinet.
Whether and to what extent the government should have an exemplary role in the coming years is a matter for the new cabinet.
Of en in hoeverre de overheid de komende jaren een voorbeeldfunctie moet hebben is een zaak voor het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over discriminatie van vrouwen

An MP asks the state secretary about gender pay gaps and discrimination against pregnant women, citing the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling recommendations and proposed SER agreements. The government answers that existing law is adequate, that enforcement relies on individuals filing complaints, and that it will improve information on rijksoverheid.nl and discuss the issue with the Stichting van de Arbeid, without setting new concrete targets.
The equal treatment legislation system relies on individual persons themselves.
Het systeem van de gelijkebehandelingswetgeving doet een beroep op individuele personen zelf.

m: Amendement van de leden Knops en Günal-Gezer over de verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum
Suspends the decision to relocate the Financieel Service Centrum by shifting budget between defence articles and requiring consultation with the Chamber before a definitive decision.
This relocation is currently planned for spring 2017, despite the adopted motion by Knops and Günal-Gezer asking to reconsider this decision
Deze verhuizing is thans voorzien in het voorjaar van 2017, in weerwil van de aangenomen motie Knops en Günal-Gezer
Motie van het lid Eijsink c.s. over de positie van het militair personeel in wet- en regelgeving
Asks the government to state in explanatory memoranda of labour and financial regulation what the consequences are for military personnel, given their special position.
requests the government, in labour and financial legislation, to state in the explanatory memorandum what the consequences are for military personnel

verzoekt de regering, in wet- en regelgeving die betrekking heeft op werknemers, in het bijzonder arbeidsvoorwaardelijke en financiële wet- en regelgeving, in de memorie van toelichting op te nemen wat de gevolgen zijn voor het militair personeel
Motie van het lid Eijsink c.s. over oriëntatie op de voordelen van meerjarige defensieplannen
States that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could offer benefits in the Dutch context.
states that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could have benefits in the Dutch context
spreekt uit dat de Kamer zich gaat oriënteren of meerjarige defensieplannen ook in de Nederlandse context mogelijke voordelen kunnen hebben
Motie van de leden Günal-Gezer en Vuijk over een jaarlijks overzicht van de prijsbijstellingen militair materieel
Asks the government to report annually in the defence budget on price adjustments for military equipment, their allocation across projects and operating costs, and whether they are adequate.
requests the government to provide annually in the Defence budget an overview of the price adjustment granted
verzoekt de regering om, jaarlijks in de Defensiebegroting een overzicht te geven van de toegekende prijsbijstelling
Motie van de leden Günal-Gezer en Eijsink over het gebruik van het fonds CODEMO door het mkb
Asks the government to report in the budget on applications, decisions and amounts under the CODEMO defence development fund, split by SMEs and large firms.
requests the government to provide insight into the use of the fund
verzoekt de regering, inzicht te geven in het gebruik van het fonds
Motie van de leden Günal-Gezer en Eijsink over geschikte kades voor het afmeren van het bevoorradingsschip JSS
Asks the government for an overview of military and civilian quays in the Netherlands suitable for mooring the 205-metre JSS, with the associated extra costs.
requests the government to provide an overview of the military and civilian quays in the Netherlands suitable for the JSS
verzoekt de regering, een overzicht te geven van de militaire en civiele kades in Nederland die geschikt zijn om de JSS
Amendement van de leden Vuijk en Günal-Gezer over het eenmalig vergroten van het fonds CODEMO
Amendment shifts 5 million euro within the defence investment article to temporarily increase the CODEMO fund, a budget reallocation.
This amendment aims to increase the CODEMO fund once by 5 million euros.
Dit amendement beoogt het fonds CODEMO eenmalig te verhogen met €5 miljoen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het de Günal-Gezer en Eijsink over het artikel ‘Onrust op fregat’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Dutch contribution to NATO surveillance in the Aegean, aimed at people-smuggling networks, should be labelled a 'mission' rather than an 'activity', and whether that labelling carries financial consequences for crews. The minister answered that the deployment falls within the existing task package of standing NATO maritime groups, so it is classed as an activity, that crew receive the normal overtime compensation, and that financial considerations played no role; she declined to re-label it.
The deployment in the Aegean Sea falls within the existing task package of the standing NATO maritime groups.
De inzet in de Egeïsche Zee past binnen het bestaande takenpakket van de staande Navo-vlootverbanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer, Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

Three PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers whether tender specifications for the marine barracks construction could favour regional firms in Zeeland, and why such room is possible in other public tenders but not here. The minister answered that favouring local firms through specification requirements is not permitted under procurement law, and that regional businesses can instead take part via consortia or as subcontractors.
Making room for local businesses in the programme of requirements leads to favouring those businesses and is not permitted.
Ruimte maken voor lokale bedrijven in het programma van eisen leidt tot bevoordeling van deze bedrijven en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

MPs Günal-Gezer and Albert de Vries asked the Defence Minister why the Vlissingen marine barracks tender was structured as an all-in DBFMO contract, which they said sidelined Zeeland firms, and whether regional firms could be guaranteed work. The minister answered that a PPC chose DBFMO for fair competition, that delays stem from added defence requirements and site surveys, that law prevents favouring regional firms, and that the project will create over 1,700 direct jobs.
This method of procurement guarantees fair and free competition, so favouring or disadvantaging companies in a particular region is ruled out.
Deze wijze van aanbesteden garandeert eerlijke en vrije concurrentie, waardoor het bevoordelen of benadelen van bedrijven in een bepaalde regio is uitgesloten.

The theft took place on 27 November 2013.
De diefstal heeft plaatsgehad op 27 november 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het artikel ‘Militair te snel dupe valse aangifte’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about suspending and dismissing soldiers before criminal investigations conclude, withdrawing security clearances (VGB) without completed prosecutions, and compensation for wrongful suspension or dismissal, as well as domestic violence in military families. The Minister answered that dismissal follows an internal investigation that is suspended while criminal proceedings run, that suspension is an order measure fully reversed if no dismissal follows, that VGB is withdrawn only after a relevant conviction with appeal rights, and that no policy change is needed.

Only after the investigation is completed and has led to a conviction for a criminal offence as referred to in the policy rule on judicial antecedents in security screenings, can the decision be taken to withdraw the VGB.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Günal-Gezer over de toename van piraterij aan de Westkust van Afrika

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about rising piracy off West Africa, including requests from Dutch shipping companies, possible use of Vessel Protection Detachments, and international coordination. The ministers answered that coastal states bear primary responsibility within territorial waters, that five VPD requests were rejected, and that the government will study additional measures and raise the issue in EU discussions.
The cabinet wants, in consultation with the shipping sector, to investigate whether additional measures should be taken outside the territorial waters of West African states, such as deploying VPDs.
Het kabinet wil, in overleg met de koopvaardijsector, onderzoeken of er aanvullende maatregelen moeten worden genomen buiten de TTW van West-Afrikaanse staten, zoals de inzet van VPD's.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het bericht ‘Militairen bij het grof vuil gezet’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about a report that soldiers were dismissed by standard letter during reorganisation, and whether personal contact and aftercare were ensured. The minister answered that dismissal follows a long, personal guidance process, that standard letters are used because their text is nearly identical, and that aftercare is guaranteed for 18 months and beyond.
Since the text of such a letter, arising from the legal position, is almost always identical, Defence uses standard dismissal letters automatically generated by the Dienstencentrum Human Resources.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Stultiens over het bedrijf Pluspetrol

MPs Hirsch and Stultiens asked the state secretaries about the OECD NCP final statement on Pluspetrol, including trade support, tax transparency and OECD Guidelines uptake. The government answered that Pluspetrol cannot claim trade-instrument support under fossil-fuel phase-out agreements, that tax secrecy prevents disclosing individual firms' tax data beyond new country-by-country reporting, and that the 2023 target of 90% OECD Guidelines endorsement was missed at 41%.
The cabinet does not see the possibility for the government to make more information public about the tax position of individual taxpayers given the fiscal secrecy obligation.
Het kabinet ziet niet de mogelijkheid om vanuit de overheid meer informatie openbaar te maken over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het weglaten van € 200 miljoen onderwijsbezuinigingen in de laatste OCW begroting

An MP asks why a €200 million education cut (half of the 2025 price adjustment) was dropped from the 2026 OCW budget's cuts table, and whether the total education cuts were fully disclosed. The minister answers that the halving remains in place, was included in the explanation of budget mutations, and provides a table of all cuts including the €171.6 million structural halving.
The nationwide halving of the 2025 price adjustment tranche is not off the table.
De rijksbrede halvering van de prijsbijstelling tranche 2025 is niet van tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de positie van Oekraïense jongeren en jongvolwassenen in het Nederlandse onderwijs

MP Stultiens asks the Minister of Education whether Ukrainian young adults risk becoming a lost generation, and whether the government will set up a financial arrangement such as student finance or a lower tuition fee for Ukrainian students rather than leaving it to institutions. The minister says tuition reduction remains up to institutions, gives counts and cost estimates for student finance and funding, and says the cabinet is exploring a transition document and skills policy without committing to a specific new financial scheme.
The ministry does not have information on how many young adults would want and be able to study, because this depends on several factors.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over informatie over hoeveel jongvolwassenen zouden willen en kunnen studeren, omdat dit afhankelijk is van meerdere factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het schrappen van 80 tot 100 banen door Universiteit Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Utrecht University cutting 80 to 100 jobs and reducing services due to government budget cuts, and about degree programme closures and knowledge loss. The minister replied that universities have broad autonomy over budget and programme decisions, cited multiple causes including falling student numbers and expiring temporary funds, and declined to intervene or commit to new consultations.
Institutions have autonomy over starting, stopping and shaping their education and research.
Instellingen hebben autonomie over het starten, stoppen en het vormgeven van hun onderwijs en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens ver het schrappen van 130 tot 180 banen bij Wageningen Universiteit

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Wageningen University's plan to cut about €80 million, including 130 to 180 jobs, and whether this harms teaching and research quality. The Minister said the university is autonomous, cited falling student numbers and reduced funding as causes, and declined to assess the specific impacts, while pointing to the budget decisions already made.
It is not possible for the ministry to make statements about the consequences of the cuts specifically on the Wageningen education and research climate and the local and regional economy.
Het is voor het ministerie niet mogelijk om uitspraken te doen over de gevolgen van specifiek de bezuinigingen op het Wageningse onderwijs- en onderzoekklimaat en de lokale en regionale economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Dijk, Grinwis en Kouwenhoven over het belastinglek bij Duitse beleggingsfondsen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a tax leak involving German real estate investment funds, including whether the state can still tax past gains and whether a step-up valuation loophole can be repaired. The State Secretary answered each of the 16 questions, stating that taxing past gains with retroactive effect is not justified and that the loophole will not be repaired.
In this case I currently see insufficient justification for measures to bring untaxed value increases from years before 2025 into the corporate tax base after all, that is, with retroactive effect.

Ik zie in het onderhavige geval vooralsnog onvoldoende rechtvaardiging om maatregelen te nemen die onbelaste waardestijgingen die zien op jaren vóór 2025 alsnog (dat wil zeggen met terugwerkende kracht) in de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Van der Lee en Stultiens over de gevolgen van toenemende robotisering voor werkgelegenheid en belastinginkomsten

Greens-Labour MPs asked whether the government sees Mercedes and BMW testing humanoid robots as a sign of labour market change, whether research and tax-base scenarios on robotisation exist, and whether alternative taxes such as a robot tax should be explored. The minister answered that automation is a continuing structural trend rather than a sudden shift, pointed to labour market reforms and lifelong learning plans, and said uncertainty is large, so the tax system should be robust and simple, citing ongoing box 3 and tax reforms.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Stultiens over de berichtgeving waarin bedrijven in een manifest de regering oproepen met voortvarender beleid te komen ter stimulans van de circulaire economie

MPs Gabriëls and Stultiens asked why the circular economy is lagging despite the 2030 targets, following a business manifesto calling for faster government action. The state secretary acknowledged the urgency, pointed to an updated Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie due after the summer, and listed fiscal measures replacing the withdrawn polymer levy, while largely deferring concrete commitments.
The policy measures the cabinet will take will be included in the previously mentioned update of the NPCE.
De beleidsmaatregelen die het kabinet zal nemen zullen worden opgenomen in de eerder genoemde actualisatie van het NPCE.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat de helft van de fiscale hoogleraren belastingrecht een commerciële baan erbij heeft

MP Stultiens asked the ministers about research showing 71 percent of tax law professors hold commercial side jobs, the reasons for variation across universities, whether a side-job freeze should apply, and gender imbalance. Minister Bruins replied that side jobs are not inherently undesirable, that universities and the national integrity code govern them, that a register and an updated code are being prepared, and that setting percentages is for universities.
Professors with side positions are not per se undesirable.
Hoogleraren met nevenfuncties zijn niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Stultiens over hulp aan studenten met een functiebeperking

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Education about uneven support for students with disabilities, the DUO prestatiebeurs scheme, and medical debt forgiveness refusals. The Minister acknowledges growing application numbers, says the decentralised process causes variation, promises research with results by summer 2026, and explains that medical debt forgiveness is reserved for exceptional cases and rejections often stem from missing medical information.
I will therefore investigate this as part of a broader study into tailored provisions for students with support needs.
Dit ga ik daarom onderzoeken als onderdeel van een breder onderzoek naar maatwerkvoorzieningen voor studenten met een ondersteuningsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Stultiens over Onderzoek Lucratiefbelangregeling

MPs Idsinga and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about the lucrative interest regime, under which private equity managers' carried interest is taxed in box 2 at a lower rate than box 1, and about its size, administrability and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that the number of affected taxpayers and the revenue effects cannot be precisely determined, that the regime provides legal certainty and fits neighbouring countries, and that alternatives (box 1 taxation, a higher box 2 rate) are being consulted on, with a further measure planned in the Belastingplan 2026.
It is currently not possible to determine how often taxpayers with a lucrative interest use the substantial-interest variant.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk vast te stellen hoe vaak belastingplichtigen met een lucratief belang gebruikmaken van de aanmerkelijkbelangvariant
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over doorgeslagen marktwerking van studentenfaciliteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the revised 'publiek-privaat' policy rule on investing public funds in private student facilities such as sports centres and canteens reduces access and increases marktwerking. The minister answered that the rule forces no institution to act, that student facility policy is unchanged, and declined to provide a full list of affected centres because institutions do not report at that level of detail.
Dit overzicht kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en De Hoop over de Spaanse heffing op buitenlandse huizenkopers

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether the Netherlands should raise transfer tax to 100% for home buyers from outside the EU, after Spain proposed such a levy. The government answered that non-EU buyers account for only about 0.3% of purchases, so the price effect is minimal, that a 100% rate would cost about 14 million euros per year, raise legal and administrative problems, and that it will not introduce the measure.
In view of the answers to questions 4 and 5, the cabinet is not willing to introduce such a measure.
Gelet op het antwoord op de vragen 4 en 5 is het kabinet niet bereid een dergelijke maatregel in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Pijpelink over dreigende ontslagen bij University College Roosevelt in Middelburg

MPs Stultiens and Pijpelink asked the Minister of Education about job cuts at University College Roosevelt in Middelburg caused by budget reductions, and whether the government would reconsider its cuts and grant Zeeland an exemption from the Wet internationalisering in balans. The minister acknowledged the cuts and personnel effects, stated the institution has spending freedom and is accountable to its works council and supervisory board, declined a general exemption for regions while offering a regional criterion in the law.
Institutions have spending freedom over the funds they receive through funding and are responsible for implementing the cuts carefully.
Instellingen hebben bestedingsvrijheid over de middelen die zij via de bekostiging ontvangen en zijn verantwoordelijk om de bezuinigingen op zorgvuldige wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over de gevolgen van een langdurig ernstig verstoorde verhouding tussen studenten en hun ouders voor de hoogte van de aanvullende studiebeurs

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep interprets too strictly the exemption letting students with unreachable or refusing parents obtain the full supplementary grant, and what support exists for minors. The Minister says he is studying the article and jurisprudence, will inform parliament before summer 2025, notes that about half of loskoppeling requests are granted, and refers to courts' independence.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Nordkamp over tientallen ontslagen en opheffing van meerdere vakgroepen na reorganisatie bij Universiteit Twente

MPs Stultiens and Nordkamp asked the Minister of Education about dismissals and closure of departments at the University of Twente's Faculty of Technical Natural Sciences due to budget cuts, and whether the cuts should be reconsidered. The minister confirmed the reorganisation, said the government considers the cuts realistic and feasible, stated that institutions are responsible for their own choices and accountable to works councils and internal supervision, and mentioned planned changes to funding stability and the WIB law without committing to halt the cuts.
I do not have an exhaustive overview of the intentions of educational institutions regarding dismissal of staff or closure of departments/faculties.
Ik heb geen uitputtend overzicht van de voornemens van de onderwijsinstellingen met betrekking tot ontslag van personeel of opheffing van vakgroepen/faculteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over vermogende Nederlanders die dividendbelasting ontwijken via drielandenpuntconstructies

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about wealthy Dutch emigrants using 'three-country-point' constructions to avoid dividend and corporate tax, and whether penalties rather than only back-tax assessments can be imposed. The government explained how the constructions work, said they are hard to count, noted measures taken and a pending evaluation of fiscal residence rules, but did not commit to new steps beyond existing measures and a planned list of constructions in the Spring Memorandum.
How often such a construction has been applied in practice is difficult to establish.
Hoe vaak een dergelijke constructie in de praktijk is toegepast, is lastig vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en De Hoop over een leegstandsheffing

MPs Stultiens and De Hoop asked about vacant housing in Rotterdam, the number of empty homes, and whether a national or municipal vacancy levy should be introduced. The minister answers that about 30,000 homes are administratively long-term vacant, mostly for explainable reasons, and that she will prepare a bill giving municipalities more powers against vacancy rather than introducing a levy now.
As I indicated in my letter mentioned above, I am adopting these recommendations and am now preparing the drafting of a bill to give municipalities more powers to tackle vacancy.

Zoals ik in mijn bovengenoemde brief heb aangegeven neem ik deze aanbevelingen over en tref ik thans de voorbereidingen voor de uitwerking van een wetsvoorstel om gemeenten meer slagkracht te geven bij de aanpak van leegstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Teunissen en Stultiens over het rapport 'Takers, not makers'

MPs Dijk, Teunissen and Stultiens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the Oxfam report 'Takers, not makers' on billionaire wealth, inheritance, wealth inequality, tax avoidance, global extraction and wealth taxes. The minister rejected the report's framing, arguing Dutch income inequality is low and stable and wealth inequality has fallen, while pointing to box 3 reform, existing tax measures and a planned review of anti-dividend-stripping options, without committing to higher taxes on wealth or inheritance.
This cabinet is not considering further raising the gift and inheritance tax rates for multi-million euro inheritances.
Dit kabinet overweegt niet de tarieven in schenk- en erfbelasting verder te verhogen voor miljoenenerfenissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Stultiens over de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel Wet Internationalisering in Balans op de regio Zeeland

MPs Pijpelink and Stultiens asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the Internationalisation in Balance Act will affect University College Roosevelt and HZ in Zeeland, and how the government will prevent loss of programmes and international students. The Minister says the answers depend on an amendment-Bontenbal that requires a nota van wijziging and a letter to parliament in January, promises regional tailoring via the regional-circumstances criterion, and defends the Act as steering rather than restricting international student flows.

I am currently considering whether and how this criterion should be adjusted, in line with the Bontenbal et al. amendment, to give sufficient room for English-language teaching in regions with specific circumstances such as Zeeland.

Ik bezie op dit moment of en hoe dit criterium moet worden aangepast om – conform het amendement Bontenbal c.s. – voldoende ruimte te geven voor anderstalig onderwijs aan regio's met specifieke omstandigheden, zoals Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de landgoederenvrijstelling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rise in NSW estate registrations, possible tax-avoidance use, who decides on qualification, enforcement, purpose and evaluation of the scheme, and whether misuse measures will be proposed. The State Secretary reported a steady increase in registered estates, denied signals of tax avoidance, described the qualification and control process, and said the next evaluation is planned for 2033 with no new misuse measures foreseen.
No, there are no known signals at RVO, the Tax Authority or the Ministries of Finance and LVVN that this increase is (partly) due to setting up tax avoidance structures.
Nee, er zijn geen signalen bekend bij de RVO, de Belastingdienst noch de Ministeries van Financiën en LVVN dat deze toename (deels) te wijten is aan het opzetten van fiscale ontwijkingsconstructies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het bezuinigingsultimatum van de werknemers in het hoger onderwijs

MP Stultiens asks the Minister of Education whether she knows of the unions' ultimatum threatening collective action over the 1.2 billion euro higher-education cuts, and how the Minister will address the resulting workload pressure and rebuild union trust. The Minister confirms awareness, points to a 78 million euro annual workload-relief contribution through 2031, and says she is willing to talk with the unions and will share her reply with the House.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the unions about the causes of and measures against workload pressure.
Ik ben bereid om met de vakbonden in gesprek te gaan over oorzaken van en maatregelen tegen werkdruk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingontwijkingsconstructies met fiscale aftrekposten

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about tax-avoidance structures using investment deductions (EIA, MIA, Vamil), including whether business partnerships, leasing, debt financing and rulings allow non-entrepreneurs to claim them. The State Secretary answered that the schemes are generic, that usage figures and examples are given, that the Belastingdienst polices abuse, and declined to disclose individual cases citing tax confidentiality, while committing only to investigate publishing anonymised ruling summaries for individuals.
Given the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual cases.
Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the minister's remarks on the Valencia floods in a November 2024 water committee meeting, which questioned the link to climate change, amounted to climate disinformation and undermined government commitments. The government answered that it does not know the Valencia situation, denies sowing doubt on climate change, affirms support for science, and says it will provide reliable information via independent institutions.
No. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management states that he does not know the situation in Valencia and makes no specific statements about the situation and possible explanations.
Nee. De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geeft aan de situatie in Valencia niet te kennen en doet geen specifieke uitspraken over de situatie en de mogelijke verklaringen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Stultiens over het bericht 'Paniek over veiligheid pensioenen APG: kritisch rapport legt problemen bloot'

MPs Kathmann and Stultiens asked the ministers about reported IT vulnerabilities at pension administrator APG and how critical institutions and supervisors such as DNB handle cybersecurity. The government answered that APG has taken mitigating measures under supervision of DNB and AFM, that the minister is not directly involved, and that the forthcoming Cyberbeveiligingswet will impose a risk-management duty on organisations, while declining to disclose supervisory details.
Due to supervisory confidential information, DNB cannot make statements about what share of supervision is devoted to cybersecurity of pension funds.
Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie kan DNB geen uitlatingen doen welk aandeel van het toezicht besteed wordt aan cyberveiligheid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Stultiens over het NRC artikel ‘Methode Laurentien ligt stil: veel gedupeerden van Toeslagenschandaal wachten nog op hulp'

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Stultiens (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether the SGH route for childcare benefit victims has stalled after a NRC report, and what caused delays, including SGH's list of 11 implementation blockages. The State Secretary replied that a new service agreement was reached in summer, that delays stem from SGH's capacity and quality of damage statements, that ministry checks are not described as delay, and that discontinuing the SGH route is not on the table.
The ministry takes SGH's signals seriously.
Het ministerie neemt de signalen van SGH serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de kabinetsreactie op de parlementaire enquête fraude en dienstverlening (PEFD)

MP Stultiens asked why the cabinet has not yet responded substantively to the PEFD enquiry report on the childcare benefits scandal, and whether it will respond to all 19 recommendations before the autumn recess. The minister answers that the cabinet deferred its substantive response to the next cabinet, that a response is being prepared, and that it expects to send it before the Christmas recess.
After the coalition agreement was published on 16 May 2024, the caretaker cabinet chose to leave a substantive cabinet response to the next cabinet.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft na verschijnen van het hoofdlijnenakkoord op 16 mei 2024 ervoor gekozen om een inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie aan het volgende kabinet te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over een herhaling van het toeslagenschandaal

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks whether the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation risks repeating itself, criticising the strict application of debt-takeover rules that exclude informal family debts not yet payable and questioning whether the 'generous' approach is being honoured. The State Secretary defends the debt scheme, says the hardship clause has been applied in about 20 individual cases, and says the government is committed to generous and timely compensation.

Because the hardship clause in article 9.1 of the Childcare Benefits Recovery Act was deliberately included, there is room to depart from a minimalist application and strict interpretation of the law.
Door de opname van de hardheidsclausule in artikel 9.1 Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen (Wht) is er bewust ruimte om af te wijken van een minimalistische toepassing en strikte uitleg van de wet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over het Advies van het college voor de Rechten van de Mens om de discriminatiegrond ‘opleiding’ op te nemen in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling

MPs Stultiens and Tseggai asked the ministers about the Human Rights Institute's advice to add education level as a protected ground under the equal treatment act, and about government support for vocational education. The minister acknowledged the advice, said the government will respond in a cabinet reaction, will study the advice together with the Interior Minister, and will examine socio-economic status as a ground separately.
I will study this advice carefully, together with my colleague the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal dit advies, samen met mijn collega-minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, goed bestuderen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens ver structureel verlieslatende bedrijven

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the discrepancy between a 6% and a 13% share of structurally loss-making companies, the growth and debt patterns of conduit companies, dividend flows, and the EU UNSHELL directive. The State Secretary attributed the difference mainly to different research periods, outlined anti-abuse measures such as the minimum tax and a possible open-norm replacement for the safe harbour, and said Dutch support for UNSHELL continues while agreement remains uncertain.
In the autumn I will inform the House, in the annual monitoring letter on the approach to tax avoidance by multinationals, about the effectiveness of the general interest deduction limitation.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer in de jaarlijkse monitoringsbrief over de aanpak van belastingontwijking door multinationals informeren over de effectiviteit van de generieke renteaftrekbeperking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingverdragen

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax treaties with low-tax jurisdictions Bahrain, Barbados and Panama still block the withholding tax, the three-year renegotiation deadline having lapsed, and about Panama's EU blacklist status and the Netherlands' stance on a UN tax convention. The State Secretary replied that treaties prevail over national law, that renegotiation will restart if Bahrain and Barbados do not introduce a qualifying 9% profit tax, that Panama is cooperating and no deadline is set, and that the Netherlands abstained rather than voted against the UN tax convention terms.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over ontwijking van de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about corporate tax avoidance, including the participation exemption, interest deduction on non-arm's-length loans, and depreciation of goodwill and intangibles. The State Secretary largely defended existing anti-avoidance rules, announced a Belastingplan 2025 measure on the earnings-stripping threshold and further research on dividend stripping, and rejected proposals to raise the participation threshold, restrict interest deductions or ban depreciation of goodwill.
The cabinet will continue this research.
Het kabinet zal dit onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de grote gevolgen van de geplande bezuinigingen op onderzoek en wetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the planned cuts to research and science in the coalition agreement, including the scrapping of sector plans, job losses, the Lisbon 3% R&D target, and the Bestuursakkoord. The minister acknowledged concerns but gave largely non-substantive answers, deferring details to the Regeerprogramma and the Prinsjesdag policy agenda.
At present the cabinet is further elaborating the coalition agreement, including the measures for hbo and wo, in the Regeerprogramma.
Op dit moment werkt het kabinet het hoofdlijnenakkoord, inclusief de maatregelen in het hbo en wo, verder uit in het Regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Tseggai en Kathmann  over opleidingsniveau als risico-indicator voor fraude

MPs asked whether education level (mbo, hbo, wo) was used as a fraud risk indicator, including by DUO, and whether it is ethically justified given government goals to value all forms of education equally. The government acknowledged the former DUO risk profile, said no fraud-related algorithm in the register uses education type, stated that education type is generally an unjustified criterion and that DUO has stopped using it, and referred the broader question to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over Sociale veiligheid TU Delft

MPs Stultiens asked about TU Delft removing an article on social unsafety from its journalism platform under pressure, and about the independence of university media, non-disclosure clauses and social safety in the CAO. The minister regrets the removal, sees no reason for a broad study of press freedom but will press institutions on it, says he has no view on the number of settlement non-disclosure clauses and that an inventory is ongoing, and states social safety is the employers' responsibility under the Arbo law.
I regret that this article was taken offline.
Ik betreur het dat dit artikel offline is gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Maatoug en Dijk over belastingontwijking door de rijkste vrouw van Nederland

MPs Stultiens, Maatoug and Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by the richest woman in the Netherlands, including dividend-free capital repayments, the 5% participation exemption, and micro-company reporting rules. The government condemned tax avoidance but said capital repayments are lawful, declined to quantify or stop the routes, and promised only further study and EU-level work.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Herstel toeslagenaffaire dreigt ongekende strop te worden: nog 5 miljard extra’

MPs Stultiens and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that the childcare benefits scandal recovery could cost an extra 5 billion euros, requesting a breakdown of costs, funding and the reasons for higher compensation under one recovery route. The State Secretary largely deferred answers to a forthcoming letter and evaluation of the new damage route pilot, saying the 5 billion figure is not fixed and that the precise answers could not yet be given.
As previously reported to the House of Representatives, a cabinet decision will soon be taken based on an evaluation of the pilot of this new damage route.
Zoals eerder gemeld aan de Tweede Kamer zal op basis van een evaluatie van de pilot van deze nieuwe schaderoute binnenkort een kabinetsbesluit worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens  over gebrekkig inzicht in juridische duurzaamheidsrisico’s

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about gaps in oversight of legal sustainability risks (climate litigation) by DNB, pension funds and financial institutions, and about how CSDDD article 15 and possible climate rules for the financial sector would apply. The government answered that legal sustainability risks are already part of supervision, that the existing framework leaves room for supervisors, that CSDDD transition plans are an effort obligation, and that decisions on financial-sector climate legislation will be informed to the House around summer.
The supervisory framework and the current legal framework leave sufficient room for supervisors to give content to this.
Het toezichtkader en het huidige juridische kader bieden voldoende ruimte voor toezichthouders om daar invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over te hoge boetes voor studentenreisproducten.

An MP asks about a court ruling that DUO did too little to prevent former students from accruing unnecessary public transport fines after their student travel product should have been stopped, and why it is still not automatic. The minister says DUO is appealing, describes the 30-day blacklist delay and planned OV-pas migration, gives a 2013-2023 fine table, and declines to commit to an investigation or compensation while the case is pending.
I cannot respond to a pending court case.
Ik kan niet reageren op een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en White over het meenemen van de AOW-uitkering naar het buitenland

MPs Stultiens and White asked why AOW pensions can be fully exported to some countries with enforcement treaties but only at the married rate to others, how many people are affected, which countries lack treaties, and whether new treaties are planned. The minister explains that export rules follow the Wet BEU and enforcement treaties, lists about 36 treaty jurisdictions plus EU/EER/Switzerland and Caribbean arrangements, reports roughly 0.04% of AOW recipients are affected, and says a 2015 motion to seek treaties with eight countries has not succeeded because the countries declined negotiation.
Should these countries wish to enter negotiations in the future, a new assessment would have to be made per country on whether that is desirable.
Mochten deze landen in de toekomst alsnog in onderhandeling willen treden dan zal per land een nieuwe weging gemaakt moeten worden over de wenselijkheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het platform ScienceGuide

MP Stultiens asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the closure of the independent science news platform ScienceGuide due to lack of funding is regrettable, whether the government will help secure its future, and whether it will convene talks with the platform and institutions. The Minister regrets the closure, says funding is the responsibility of the institutions and ScienceGuide itself, and declines to convene talks for now.
At present I see no reason to enter into consultations about the continued existence of ScienceGuide.
Momenteel zie ik geen aanleiding om in overleg te treden over het voortbestaan van ScienceGuide.

m: Motie van de leden Six Dijkstra en Michon-Derkzen over in beslag genomen drugs zo snel mogelijk chemisch onbruikbaar en waardeloos maken
Asks the government to promote rendering seized drugs chemically unusable as quickly as possible in the Netherlands.
requests the government to promote that the Netherlands also focuses much more on rendering seized drugs chemically unusable and worthless as quickly as possible
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat ook in Nederland veel meer wordt ingezet op het zo snel mogelijk chemisch onbruikbaar en waardeloos maken van in beslag genomen drugs
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. over meldingen van poortwachters aan de FIU op verzoek anonimiseren
Motion asking that gatekeepers' reports to the FIU can be anonymised in a criminal file at the request of the reporter, provided the report to the FIU itself is not anonymous.
requests the government to ensure that reports by gatekeepers to the FIU can, at the reporter's request, end up anonymised in a criminal file
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat meldingen van poortwachters aan de FIU op verzoek van de melder geanonimiseerd in een strafdossier kunnen belanden
Motie van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Michon-Derkzen over bij drugslabs de daders op laten draaien voor de saneringskosten
Asks the government to make offenders directly pay drug lab clean-up costs by compensation, without bearing on checks on the executive.
offenders should directly reimburse these costs through compensation
daders deze kosten rechtstreeks moeten vergoeden middels een schadevergoeding
Motie van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Diederik van Dijk over het Bpg aanpassen zodat politiegegevens op structurele basis kunnen worden verstrekt aan de Belastingdienst
Asks the government to amend the Police Data Decree so that police data can be provided structurally, not only on request, to the Tax Authority.
requests the government to amend the Bpg so that police data can from now on be provided on a structural basis to the Tax Authority
verzoekt de regering het Bpg zodanig aan te passen dat politiegegevens voortaan op structurele basis kunnen worden verstrekt aan de Belastingdienst
Amendement van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het verhogen van het strafmaximum van vier naar acht jaar
Amendment raising the maximum prison sentence in the Wet wapens en munitie for preparatory acts involving 3D-gun blueprints from four to eight years.
In Article 55, third paragraph, introductory part, 'four years' is replaced by 'eight years'.
In artikel 55, derde lid, aanhef, wordt «vier jaar» vervangen door «acht jaar».
Amendement van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het verhogen van boetecategorieën bij een aantal delicten
Raises the maximum fine category from fourth to fifth for several organised-crime-related offences to allow higher fines.
The amendment gives the judge more scope to impose an appropriate and deterrent fine
Het amendement biedt de rechter meer ruimte om een passende en afschrikwekkende geldboete op te leggen
Motie van de leden Dral en Michon-Derkzen over een snellere notice-and-take-downprocedure bij zeer ernstige privacyinbreuken door deepfakes
Asks the State Secretary to investigate a faster notice-and-takedown procedure for deepfake privacy violations and whether a legal basis and which enforcer should handle it.
asks the State Secretary to investigate how a faster notice-and-takedown procedure can be set up as quickly as possible, within an hour where technically feasible
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris onderzoek te doen naar hoe een snellere notice- and-take-downprocedure zo snel mogelijk en waar technisch mogelijk binnen een uur kan worden ingericht
Motie van het lid Six Dijkstra c.s. over een damage and impact assessment naar welke gegevens mogelijk gelekt zijn
Asks the government for a full damage and impact assessment of which data may have leaked from the NCTV and police CTER cluster and the potential consequences.
requests the government to carry out a full damage and impact assessment, mapping which data may have leaked from the NCTV and the police CTER cluster
verzoekt de regering te komen tot een volledige damage and impact assessment, waarbij in kaart gebracht wordt welke gegevens mogelijk gelekt zijn
Amendement van het lid Michon-Derkzen over een zware voorhang van het inwerkingtredings-kb
Amendment makes the decree bringing the fireworks ban into force subject to a heavy pre-consultation: no proposal for four weeks after submission, and a chamber rejection blocks it.
The proposal for a royal decree referred to in the first paragraph shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen over onderzoeken of reguliere mbo-opleidingen een grotere rol kunnen vervullen bij de na- en bijscholing en toetsing van boa's
Asks the cabinet to investigate whether regular vocational (mbo) colleges could play a larger role in training and testing special investigating officers (boa's).
requests the cabinet to investigate whether regular mbo training courses could play a (larger) role in the further training and testing of boa's
verzoekt het kabinet om te onderzoeken of de reguliere mbo-opleidingen een (grotere) rol kunnen vervullen in de bij- en nascholing en toetsing van de boa's
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen over zich bij de toetsingscriteria van het ontwerpbesluit rekenschap geven van de gevaarzetting van het werk van de groene boa
Motion asks the cabinet to consider the danger faced by green enforcement officers when setting the assessment criteria for weapon permits in the draft decree.
requests the cabinet to review the assessment criteria of the draft decree, taking into account the danger of the green enforcement officer's work
verzoekt het kabinet om de toetsingscriteria van het ontwerpbesluit tegen het licht te houden, waarbij rekenschap wordt gegeven van de gevaarzetting van het werk van de groene boa
Motie van het lid Michon-Derkzen over bevorderen dat er één boa-beroepsorganisatie tot stand komt
Asks the cabinet to promote the creation of a single professional organisation for boa enforcement officers.
requests the cabinet to promote the establishment of one boa professional organisation
verzoekt het kabinet om te bevorderen dat er één boa-beroepsorganisatie tot stand komt
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over boa's nationaal handelingsbevoegd maken onder de Wet seksuele misdrijven
Asks the government to give municipal enforcement officers (boa's) national authority to act under the Sexual Offences Act, beyond the pilot cities.
requests the government to make boa's nationally authorised to act under the Sexual Offences Act
verzoekt de regering boa's nationaal handelingsbevoegd te maken onder de Wet seksuele misdrijven
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Michon-Derkzen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 48 over vermindering van de bezuiniging op het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid
Shifts 178 thousand euro within the budget from an unallocated item to the Security and crime fighting article to keep funding the CCV.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 178 thousand euros
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 178 (x € 1.000)

replacing 'or lawyer' with ', lawyer, journalist or publicist in the context of news gathering'

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het voorkomen van een terroristische aanslag met een drone op politici in België

An MP asked whether a drone-borne jihadist plot against Belgian Prime Minister De Wever signals similar threats in the Netherlands, whether monitoring and counter-drone measures exist, and whether regulation and EU cooperation are adequate. The Minister says the threat of drone attacks has not increased, that counter-drone measures and protocols exist but will not be detailed publicly, that the AIVD cannot confirm ongoing investigations, and that the matter was raised at the October JBZ Council.
For security reasons I never make public statements about this.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik hier in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Geen mobiel bereik in grensstreek: 77-jarige man ligt na val machteloos half uur op de grond’

An MP asked about a report of a 77-year-old man lying helpless for half an hour in a border area with no mobile coverage, and whether poor coverage poses a safety risk and what the government will do. The minister says coverage is generally good, points to existing measures (WiFi calling, roaming redirection, the 112 NL app), reports 46 complaints with only 5 from border municipalities, and sees no reason for additional measures such as emergency poles.
I currently see no reason to take additional measures in addition to this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om in aanvulling hierop maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Moordenaar krijgt na jaren cel en tbs baan in zorgkliniek: ’Hoe kan zo iemand werken met kwetsbare personen?

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Eijk asked why a convicted murderer was given a job in a care clinic and how VOG screening allowed this, and how often such VOG certificates are issued to people with serious violent convictions. The State Secretary says individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy reasons, defends the balancing in VOG decisions and reintegration, and states there is no intention to expand continuous screening or the VOG-P beyond current rules pending a WODC study expected in early 2026.
Because of the protection of personal privacy, I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Burg en Ellian over oproepen tot geweld tijdens het concert van Bob Vylan in Paradiso Amsterdam

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers whether Bob Vylan's concert calls for violence (including cheering the killing of Charlie Kirk and calling for hunting Zionists) should be treated as criminal, how the concert was permitted, whether the UK prosecution affects visas or entry bans, and whether local authorities can prevent further calls to violence. The government answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service must establish what was said, that bans on performances require concrete serious disorder, that entry refusal is possible under the Schengen Borders Code on public order grounds, and that local mayors make their own assessments without commenting on individual cases.
Which statements Bob Vylan made will have to emerge from the police and Public Prosecution Service investigation.
Welke uitingen zijn gedaan door Bob Vylan zal uit het onderzoek van politie en het Openbaar Ministerie moeten blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat het Joods Politienetwerk tijdelijk uit het netwerkoverleg van de politie is gestapt

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Jewish Police Network temporarily leaving the police network consultation because members were repeatedly pressed about Gaza, and about whether Jews are held responsible for Israeli government actions and how police neutrality and protection of the Jewish community are ensured. The minister respects the members' decision, calls it regrettable, says he has no signals that police as a whole contribute to Jewish insecurity, and will investigate any signals of compromised neutrality, while referring to the antisemitism strategy and a debate on 23 September.
Should persons within the organisation be guilty of this, I assume the Chief of Police will address it firmly.
Mochten personen binnen de organisatie zich hier wel schuldig aan maken, dan ga ik er vanuit dat de Korpschef dit stevig aanpakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Six Dijkstra, Kathmann en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘In de strijd tegen deepfakes krijgen Denen copyright op eigen gezicht en stem’

MPs asked whether the government will act on deepfake abuse, including whether big tech platforms should be held responsible and whether Denmark's copyright-on-likeness approach should be adopted. The government answers that existing Dutch law (AVG, DSA, criminal law, portrait rights) is sufficient, that platforms can already be held liable, and that it sees no reason to introduce a copyright on appearance or voice.
The State Secretary for Justice and Security therefore sees no reason to proceed with amending legislation.
