De Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot aanpassing van wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derzkzen over het bericht ‘TikTok-kalifaat lokt piepjonge kinderen in val’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about online jihadist propaganda such as TikTok content reaching minors, whether it is illegal, how the DSA and the ATKM can act, and how schools and coordination can respond. The Minister answers that terrorist content can be removed under the TOI regulation but 'legal yet harmful' content is hard to address given free speech, notes ongoing WODC research, and points to existing prevention, teacher training and coordination efforts.
I share the concerns about this type of content and the impact it can have, particularly on minors.
Ik deel de zorgen rond dit type content en de impact die dit met name kan hebben op minderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘student encampment for Palestine’ op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked about Samidoun's role in a June 2025 student encampment at the University of Amsterdam, whether such organisations should be banned, how the planned terrorism-glorification offence applies to campus protests, and whether universities have guidelines and suspension powers. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that banning organisations is for the courts on a prosecutor's request, that the new offences will depend on circumstances, that universities have a joint protest guideline and can suspend students under the WHW, and that a further letter on organisation bans will follow in autumn 2025.

As you will understand, individual cases cannot be discussed, nor the specific involvement of organisations in demonstrations, because this would encroach on the powers of the local triangle, namely the mayor, the police and the Public Prosecution Service.

Zoals u begrijpt kan er niet op individuele casuïstiek in worden gegaan, zo ook niet waar het gaat over de specifieke betrokkenheid van organisaties bij demonstraties, omdat hiermee in de bevoegdheid van de lokale driehoek, te weten de burgemeester, de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, wordt getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'UvA verhaalt schade bezettingen mei 2024 niet op demonstranten'

MPs Martens-America and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked why the University of Amsterdam did not recover about 1.5 million euros of damage from the May 2024 occupations from the protesters, and what legal and practical obstacles exist to recovering such damage from rioters. The Minister answers that identifying perpetrators in chaotic group situations is often practically impossible, that group liability has conditions, that most damage was covered by insurance, and that institutions decide themselves whether to claim as injured parties, without providing case counts.
Furthermore, as Minister I do not collect data on whether group liability is applicable in riots in higher education.
Voorts verzamel ik als Minister geen gegevens over het wel of niet toepasbaar zijn van groepsaansprakelijkheid bij rellen in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Michon-Derkzen over de brief van de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid ‘Informatiebeveiliging OM’

MPs Buijsse and Michon-Derkzen asked about the Public Prosecution Service's disconnection of its internal systems from the internet after a Citrix vulnerability was exploited, including data theft, backups, court delays, patching and NCSC warnings. The Minister answered that disconnection was unavoidable, no evidence of data manipulation or theft has been found so far, backups are secured, a phased reconnection is underway, and that the investigation into patch timing and audit practice is ongoing.
Disconnecting the Public Prosecution Service from the internet is indeed a serious measure.
Het loskoppelen van het OM van het internet is inderdaad een zware maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over de omstreden en nog altijd actieve sekte Pater Pio

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister about the Pater Pio sect in Twente, including reports of deaths linked to refusal of medical care, child corporal punishment and exorcisms, and why complaints have not stopped the group. The minister says the IGJ can intervene if harm results, that prosecutors have found insufficient evidence or grounds in past complaints, and that a Fier victim helpline launches in summer 2025 with police cooperation still being worked out.
The Fier help point will go live in summer 2025.
Het hulppunt bij Fier zal in de zomer van 2025 live gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de aangekondigde acties van XR in winkelgebieden met het verspreiden van butaanzuur

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about Extinction Rebellion's announced actions spreading butanoic acid in shopping areas, including casualties, whether it counts as terrorism or incitement, preventive search powers, prohibitions, and compensation for shop owners. The minister answered that butyric acid was used in Naaldwijk and Nijmegen with several people affected, condemned its use, left terrorism and incitement judgments to the prosecutor and courts, noted municipalities can designate security risk areas, and explained existing confiscation and damage-recovery routes.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether a (terrorist) offence exists in a given case.
Het is verder aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er in bepaald geval sprake is van een (terroristisch) misdrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Brandweer ziet lastig te blussen branden door ontploffende zonnepanelen toenemen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that firefighters face hard-to-extinguish fires from exploding solar panels, and about installation quality, oversight, and training. The minister answered that the risk is small, relying on TNO/NIPV research, existing municipal and sector oversight, and a planned handbook on hazardous deposition, while declining to tighten oversight or create new protocols.

The limited number of incidents involving solar panels relative to the total number of installations in the Netherlands, and the initiatives by the sector, give me no reason to improve oversight of the quality of solar power installations.

Het beperkt aantal incidenten met zonnepanelen in verhouding tot het totale aantal installaties in Nederland en de initiatieven door de sector geeft voor mij geen aanleiding om het toezicht op de kwaliteit van zonnestroominstallaties te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Michon-Derkzen en Koops over de omgang met een informant van de politie

MPs asked the Justice Minister about a police informant who was detained and could not defend himself after being prosecuted, and whether compensation or legal gaps should be addressed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, citing the need to protect informant identities, and said existing rules adequately cover informants, so no legal gap is seen.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases or on matters concerning whether persons work or have worked as informants for the police and judicial authorities.
Als Minister ga ik niet in op individuele zaken en op zaken die zien op de vraag of personen als informant voor politie en justitie werken of in het verleden hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van der Wal over het bericht ‘Politie en defensie worstelen met 'soevereine' collega's die overheid niet erkennen’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van der Wal asked how many police and defence staff hold sovereign-movement views, whether such staff can be disciplined or removed, and what the government is doing against anti-institutional thinking among employees. The ministers answer that signals are taken seriously, that disciplinary and security-clearance measures exist, that reporting channels are available, and that responsibility is shared across ministries, while declining to give detailed numbers for reasons of confidentiality.
The MIVD, given its statutory duty of secrecy, does not discuss its sources, current knowledge level and/or its modus operandi.
De MIVD gaat gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding, niet in op haar bronnen, het actuele kennisniveau en/of de modus operandi van de dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Helder over storingen in C2000 en eOCS-systemen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Helder asked about outages in the C2000 radio network and eOCS system, including their risk during the NATO summit, back-up options for solo officers, long-term prevention and procurement flexibility. The Minister said fallback arrangements, a second-opinion investigation and four improvement action lines are in place, but gave no firm commitment to push-to-talk changes before the summit.
I will inform the House, through the collective letters on fire services, crisis management and control rooms, about the outcomes of the investigations and experiments.
Ik zal uw Kamer middels de verzamelbrieven brandweerzorg, crisisbeheersing en meldkamers informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en experimenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het opzetten van een kaasfabriek in Marokko met Nederlandse subsidies voor deradicalisering

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked about alleged misuse of Dutch deradicalisation and integration subsidies by Rotterdam foundations, including funding a cheese factory in Morocco, and about the status of prosecution, recovery claims, and radicalisation oversight. The minister answered that the OM prosecuted fraud by the foundations via penal orders, that information sharing with Rotterdam was limited to what the OM judged appropriate, that recovery is limited by a five-year term, and described current prevention policy and evaluation tools.
The OM is currently in discussion with the municipality to determine which information can be shared.
Momenteel is het OM met de gemeente in gesprek om te bezien welke informatie wel kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Michon- Derkzen, Becker en Rajkowski over de komst van omstreden predikers naar de Ramadan Expo in de Jaarbeurs

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Asylum ministers how to keep three controversial preachers with past antisemitic, homophobic and extremist statements from speaking at the Ramadan Expo in Utrecht, and what could be done about the organisers and the venue. The Minister said the three were barred via SIS signalling, that a court suspended this until a decision on objection, that the municipality holds the power over public order and any prohibition, and that prosecution remains possible if speech is criminal.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended these decisions until six weeks after the decision on the objection, with the result that the alerts in the Schengen Information System were removed and the persons can travel to the Netherlands.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter deze besluiten geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar, met als gevolg dat de signaleringen in het Schengeninformatiesysteem verwijderd zijn en personen Nederland in kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij subsidieverlening

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Sneller asked about the use of the Bibob Act in subsidy grants by central government, including RVO's practice, data sharing with municipalities, and LBB advice requests. The minister answers that Bibob use is left to each state body and is risk-based, describes the RVO advisory group and ten LBB requests, and promises further evaluation and updates.
Because of the confidentiality duty in the Bibob Act, the LBB only shares figures on advice requests where they cannot be traced back to individual cases.
Het LBB deelt in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht in de Wet Bibob alleen cijfers over adviesaanvragen als deze cijfers niet te herleiden zijn naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State in de zaak Stichting Femmes For Freedom tegen de burgemeester van Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister how the Council of State ruling in the Femmes For Freedom case against The Hague mayor affects mayors' powers to act against preachers inciting violence against women and non-believers, and about possible legislation and EU/foreign comparisons. The minister agreed such incitement is unacceptable, said the Municipal Act gives no basis for preventive action against preachers, pointed to criminal prosecution by the OM, and promised consultation with VNG and to bills on criminalising glorification of terrorism, expected for internet consultation in spring 2025.
Neither the Municipal Act nor the Public Demonstrations Act provides a basis for preventively restricting the constitutional freedom of expression (due to the ban on censorship).
De Gemeentewet noch de Wet openbare manifestaties bieden de grondslag om preventief de grondwettelijke vrijheid van meningsuiting te beperken (vanwege het verbod op censuur).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Geweld, intimidatie en homofobie – hoe Feyenoord zijn meest gevreesde hooligans dichtbij houdt’

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that Feyenoord keeps its most feared hooligans close, including stadium-ban evasion and possession of stadium keys, and about how bans are enforced nationally. The State Secretary replied that the government leaves local enforcement to the mayor and the local OM-police triangle, offered help if requested, pointed to national programmes and bodies, and said the stadium-key claim was not confirmed while giving ban and enforcement statistics.
It is not appropriate for the national government to intervene here, but if the local authority wishes, I am willing to offer my help.
Het past niet dat de landelijke overheid hier in treedt, maar als het lokale gezag daar prijs op stelt, dan ben ik bereid mijn hulp aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the 'Protest Alliance Watch' stewarding group at pro-Palestinian demonstrations amounts to an illegal 'weerkorps', whether it should be investigated and banned, and whether police tolerate it. The minister declined to judge whether any offence occurred (a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts), said the group is not unusual and that local authorities decide on demonstrations, and offered no new investigation or ban.
Whether certain conduct constitutes a criminal offence, and whether it should be investigated further, is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge.

Het oordeel of bepaald handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict en het oordeel of bepaald handelen nader onderzocht dient te worden is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministier en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over winkelverboden aan criminele overlastgevende asielzoekers

Two VVD MPs asked about shop bans against criminal nuisance-causing asylum seekers: how many were imposed since 2020, whether shopkeepers must serve them personally and translate them, and how reporting of theft and violations can be encouraged. The minister reported rising numbers of individual and collective shop bans, explained that shop bans must be served in person with no legal translation requirement but must be understandable to the suspect, and pointed to police and CCV measures and the existing toolbox.
There is no statutory provision requiring that a shop ban be issued in the native language of the person concerned.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke bepaling die verplicht tot het uitreiken van een winkelverbod in de (moeder)taal van de betrokkene/verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Kisteman over een  reportage over glazenwassers door het tv-programma Radar

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Kisteman asked about a Radar report on rogue window cleaners, including consumer rights, complaint channels, cash payment, sector knowledge, enforcement and whether the Zaanstad licensing approach should be copied. The minister answered that consumers may be required to pay in cash, that Zaanstad's licensing scheme is a municipal matter, that no further sector study is planned, and that no integrated national enforcement campaign is currently running.
The police have no overviews of the number of reports made over the past two years about window cleaners, because no sector-specific overviews are kept.
Bij politie zijn geen overzichten aanwezig van het aantal meldingen dat de afgelopen twee jaar is gedaan over glazenwassers, omdat geen sectorale overzichten worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Michon–Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugscriminelen in hele land actief met hypotheekfraude'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that drug criminals are committing mortgage fraud nationwide, housing Bulgarian migrant workers. The government confirms police reports of roughly 8,000 affected homes, describes enforcement, information-sharing and planned reviews (including Belastingdienst income checks and Kamer van Koophandel measures), but declines to give municipalities a direct role in informing mortgage lenders.

The Minister of Justice and Security will, together with the State Secretary for Fiscal Affairs and the Tax Authority, further explore the effectiveness, efficiency and feasibility of this and then inform the House of the conclusion.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal samen met de Staatssecretaris van Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en uitvoerbaarheid hiervan nader verkennen en vervolgens uw Kamer informeren over de conclusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Rijksmuseum kan niet open: demonstranten Extinction Rebellion blokkeren ingang'

MPs Van der Wal and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security about the blockade of the Rijksmuseum entrance by Extinction Rebellion, including arrests, police capacity, damage claims and sponsor reactions. The government answered that demonstrations are governed locally by the mayor under the Wet openbare manifestaties, reported 33 arrests with one person identified and about 250 police hours, and said the museum decides on damage claims while a WODC study on demonstration law is due in summer 2025.
The mayor is responsible for public order and can set conditions for a demonstration under the Public Manifestations Act.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde en kan voorwaarden stellen aan een demonstratie op basis van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Aanpak drugscriminelen Schiphol loopt vast op privacywetten: ‘Nadenken of criminelen wel zelfde rechten hebben’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that efforts to tackle drug criminals at Schiphol are stalled by privacy rules, including concerns from the Haarlemmermeer mayor about sharing information on organised crime and corruption. The minister answered that a Justice taskforce on data sharing is analysing information-sharing gaps with Schiphol partners, outlined existing reporting routes and information registers, and said no decision has yet been made on whether a dedicated AMvB for Schiphol is needed.
That is why the Justice Ministry's Data Sharing Taskforce, together with the Schiphol partners, is conducting a thorough analysis of these partners' information position.
Daarom maakt de Taskforce gegevensdeling van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid in samenwerking met de partners op Schiphol een grondige analyse van de informatiepositie van deze partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over handel en diefstal van diamanten naar aanleiding van de podcast ‘De Diamantroof’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about diamond theft and trade following the podcast 'De Diamantroof', including traceability systems, background checks, FIU involvement, cross-border cooperation and an international diamond database. The Minister replied that existing measures (heling rules, registration duties, Wwft obligations, Empact cooperation) are sufficient, saw no need for new measures or an international database, and committed to no concrete new steps.
I currently see no reason to come up with additional proposals to further limit the risks of trading in stolen diamonds.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om met extra voorstellen te komen om de risico's op het verhandelen van gestolen diamanten verder te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over politieagenten die Joodse objecten of evenementen niet meer willen beveiligen

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers refuse to protect Jewish sites and events, and how this squares with a neutral police force. The minister replied that police report no known cases, that such refusal is unacceptable, that the cabinet is preparing an antisemitism strategy and funding anti-discrimination programmes, but gave no specific new oversight commitment.
Like the chief of police, I have no understanding for police officers who would not want to guard Jewish objects.
Evenals de korpschef, heb ik geen begrip voor politiemedewerkers die geen Joodse objecten zouden willen bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Michon-Derkzen over het uitrijden van mest met drugsafval door boeren in Baarle-Nassau

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen asked the ministers whether drug waste being spread with manure on Baarle-Nassau fields reflects a wider problem, what tools police and environmental services have, and how municipalities and farmers can be protected. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, the scale of drug-waste dumping is unknown, existing enforcement tools and the Veilig Buitengebied and farmer contact-person initiatives are described, and no cases of food-chain harm are known.
The investigation into the Baarle-Nassau case is still ongoing. It has not yet been established how the drug waste ended up on the field.
Het onderzoek in de casus Baarle-Nassau loopt nog. Er is nog niet vastgesteld hoe het drugsafval op de akker terecht is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie maakt einde aan blokkade sluizen IJmuiden door XR’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a blockade of the IJmuiden locks by Extinction Rebellion that halted shipping to Amsterdam, asking about the legal basis, police capacity, identification, damages, subsidies and whether the law should distinguish peaceful demonstrations from disorderly actions. The government answered that the mayor is responsible for assessing demonstrations, that the Wet openbare manifestaties is considered adequate, that a WODC study and Inspectorate review are underway, and it declined to commit to new legislation pending that research.
The mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations and therefore also for assessing whether a demonstration is peaceful.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van demonstraties en daarmee ook voor de beoordeling of er sprake is van een vreedzame demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Michon-Derkzen over online video’s in treinen voor pornoplatforms

MPs Veltman and Michon-Derkzen asked the government about online videos of people masturbating on trains that are posted on porn platforms, and about enforcement against offenders and platform responsibility. The Secretary of State answered that existing criminal provisions can address the offenders, that NS handles preventive measures and reports on-the-spot cases to police, that platforms are bound by the DSA's notice-and-action duties, and that no new action is planned beyond existing measures.
Therefore I see no need to consult further.
Ik zie daarom ook geen noodzaak om nader in overleg te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk, Helder en Michon-Derkzen over de voorgenomen sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from several parties ask the Minister of Justice and Security why the police plan to close the Wolvega station and replace it with a smaller police post, questioning the decision's basis, its effect on police presence, consultation with local government, and the link to coalition plans for more police presence in neighbourhoods. The Minister answers that station locations are a police responsibility, that the transformation follows a 2015 housing plan aimed at more mobile policing on the street, that no final location has been chosen, and that a new police post is planned by end 2025 with the municipality of Weststellingwerf.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, stay open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over het eindrapport van de Commissie Schneiders, de overdracht van het dossier aan de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en de opvolging v

MPs asked whether the Schneiders Commission should continue monitoring implementation of its 20 recommendations on the Landelijke Eenheid, given union and works council concerns that the transition is unfinished and that oversight passes to the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid. The Minister replied that oversight rests with the police leadership through an internal monitoring process, with Schneiders staying on as adviser and the Inspectie checking quality of task performance, and that no extension of the commission is planned.
Oversight of and direction for implementing the recommendations is the responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the national units.
Toezicht op en sturing geven aan de opvolging van de gedane aanbevelingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de korpsleiding en in het verlengde daarvan de leidingen van de landelijke eenheden.
Antwoord op van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over “recente berichtgeving rond haatimams in Nederland”

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports of hate-preaching imams in the Netherlands, including whether prosecution is underway, whether residence permits can be revoked, funding transparency of Ar-Rahmah, and whether municipalities can prevent such speakers. The government answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that prosecution is for the OM to decide, that revocation is possible only under strict proportionality rules, and that legislation on transparency and informal education oversight is in preparation.
For this reason, it is not appropriate for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Justice and Security to address investigations into individual cases.
Daarom past het ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op onderzoeken naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Tielen over de bijschrijfplicht in de horeca

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Tielen asked about the mandatory listing (bijschrijfplicht) of day managers in hospitality licences, including its purpose, costs, screening tools and municipal practice. The Minister answered that the requirement is kept for hospitality businesses under the Alcohol Act, that the Bibob and good-conduct checks justify it, and that the government is still consulting municipalities and KHN on administrative burden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon- Derkzen over het gebruik van drones door state operators

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Peter de Groot asked why Dutch state operators such as police and fire services may not fly drones beyond visual line of sight, whether EASA rules allow it, and how other countries and commercial operators are treated. The minister answered that state operations are under national rules for certain activities, that BVLOS flights are assessed on risk by the ILT, that a police pilot at Twente Airport is underway, and that a decision on the applicable rules for state operations is expected in Q3 2024.
A decision on the applicable rules for state operations in the Netherlands is expected to be taken in the third quarter of 2024.
Naar verwachting kan in het derde kwartaal van 2024 een besluit worden genomen over de toepasselijke regelgeving voor staatsoperaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Honderden miljoenen aan WMO-fraude: 'Zorgcrimineel heeft vrij spel''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked about a report claiming hundreds of millions in Wmo care fraud, how municipalities supervise providers and pgb spending, screening, Bibob checks, RIEC cooperation, data sharing and Wmo supervision quality. The State Secretary disputes the amounts, says fraud cannot be reliably measured, outlines municipal responsibilities and tools, and points to forthcoming legislation (Wbsrz, Wmo amendment) and a stimulation programme.

I am currently preparing an amendment to the Wmo that sets out further frameworks for the organisation of Wmo supervision, the independent functioning of the supervisor and transparency in supervision, such as publication of supervisory reports.

Momenteel bereid ik een wijziging van de Wmo voor waarin nadere kaders worden gesteld voor de inrichting van het Wmo-toezicht, het onafhankelijk functioneren van de toezichthouder en transparantie in het toezicht, zoals de openbaarmaking van toezichtrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over een conferentie door Hizb ut Tharir in Nederland

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about a March 2024 Hizb ut-Tahrir conference in Amsterdam, its extremist character, visa refusals, the possibility of banning the organisation, and the status of the government's problematic-conduct taskforce. The minister answered that speech crimes can be reported and prosecuted by the police and Openbaar Ministerie, that the AIVD rates the threat as low, that banning is for the prosecutor to decide, and that the taskforce has no legal basis for sharing case information.
The Openbaar Ministerie can ask the court to prohibit and dissolve an organisation under article 2:20 of the Civil Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan de rechter verzoeken een organisatie te verbieden en ontbinden op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot  over het bericht 'Pandeigenaren zijn vernielingen door krakers zat: ‘Met een moker heb ik de deur ingebeukt’'

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Interior ministers about squatting, including whether the 2022 anti-squatting law works, how many squats have been evacuated, whether squatting equals theft, and whether online calls to squat amount to incitement. The minister answered that the law's effectiveness will be assessed in an evaluation due in 2025, that existing criminal tools suffice for now, and that prosecution and courts decide on incitement.
Legislation works as a norm and provides a basis for action.
Wetgeving werkt normerend en biedt een grondslag om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie vindt steeds vaker met AI gemaakte kinderporno: groot probleem’

An MP asked the ministers how far AI-generated child sexual abuse material is increasing, whether platforms and tech firms should remove it, what the EU AI and Digital Services Acts and the Dutch bill on administrative action against online CSAM contribute, and how police handle AI-enabled extortion of young people. The government answered that AI-generated CSAM is punishable and rising but still a small share, that detection and tracing remain hard, and pointed to the DSA, AI Act, the pending bill and reporting facilities.
Although no exact figures are available because the total number of images is not recorded, the TBKK indicates that an increase in AI-generated material is observed.

Hoewel er geen exacte cijfers beschikbaar zijn omdat het totaal aantal afbeeldingen niet wordt geregistreerd, geeft het Team ter bestrijding van Kinderpornografie en Kindersekstoerisme (TBKK) aan dat er wel een toename van AI-gegenereerd materiaal wordt waargenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet moet alerter zijn op spionage met Chinese scanners bij douane’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government should reconsider using Nuctech scanners at Dutch customs given espionage risks, and why Nuctech has not been excluded as other countries did. The state secretary answered that a TNO-led study found current use does not endanger national security, that a retest is underway because of planned algorithm integration, and that the government will share results around summer recess.
The conclusions of the TNO-led study were submitted to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
De conclusies van het onderzoek onder regie van TNO zijn vertrouwelijk aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Geen straf voor milieuactivisten die Meisje met de parel besmeurden: te ingrijpend, zegt hof'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers about a court ruling that convicted climate activists for defacing the Girl with a Pearl Earring without imposing punishment, and about related questions on sentencing statistics, compensation for pre-trial detention, the chilling effect on free expression, cassation, museum damage costs, heritage protection, sentencing guidelines and demonstration law. The minister answered that the court found the act punishable, gave statistics on verdicts without sentence, said compensation is for the court to decide, that the prosecution did not appeal, and that existing safety protocols and sector talks are sufficient, promising only a forthcoming letter on demonstrations.
The Public Prosecution Service has not lodged an appeal in cassation.
Het OM heeft geen cassatie ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Roep in Amsterdam om weren Samidoun kopstuk'

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked whether Amsterdam or the national government can ban Samidoun-linked speaker Mohamed al Khatib from events in the Netherlands, given his alleged membership of a banned terrorist organisation. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the IND found insufficient grounds for exclusion, that local authorities cannot impose a ban on the closed event, and that the government will keep monitoring the risks.

On the basis of the available information, there is insufficient ground in this case to conclude that the person's individual conduct constitutes a genuine, present and sufficiently serious threat to a fundamental interest of society.

Op basis van de beschikbare informatie is er in deze zaak onvoldoende grond om te concluderen dat het persoonlijk gedrag van betrokkene een werkelijke, actuele en voldoende ernstige bedreiging voor een fundamenteel belang van de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Helder over het bericht 'Kwam agent Robert-Jan om het leven bij politiewerk? Nee, zegt stichting (en dus komt zijn naam niet op monument)'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police officer Robert-Jan Hartman's name is not on the national police memorial, despite the chief constable's request. The Minister answered that the foundation's independent board decides on inclusion, that it judged the team-building activity was not 'in the line of duty', and that the Minister has no power to decide, though she understands the families' wish.
The decision to also include his name in the Tuin van Bezinning, however, is not for me, nor for the chief constable.
Het besluit om zijn naam ook op te nemen in de Tuin van Bezinning is echter niet aan mij, noch aan de korpschef.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Sneller, Michon-Derkzen, Kuik, Mutluer en Temmink over agressie en geweld tegen beroepsgroepen met een publieke functie

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA, GroenLinks-PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reporting, prosecution, sentencing and prevention of aggression and violence against public-service workers. The minister answers that reporting should be made mandatory in practice through employer norms, that no reliable national picture exists, and that existing protocols, WODC research and Weerbaar Bestuur initiatives are being used, while leaving primary employer responsibility with organisations.
A reliable national picture of aggression and violence against officials with a public task is lacking.
Een betrouwbaar landelijk beeld van agressie en geweld tegen functionarissen met een publieke taak ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Hof geeft uithalers van drugscontainers taakstraf in plaats van cel'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that gave drug-container 'uithalers' community service instead of prison, and whether this undermines the uithalerswet, with questions on arrest and prosecution figures, comparison with other EU states, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister answered that courts judge case by case, that the law has deterrent and investigative value, that numbers and sentences are reported, and that a comparative study will depend on consultations with the criminal justice partners.
In the upcoming half-yearly letter on organised and undermining crime I will explain how I am implementing this motion.
In de aankomende halfjaarbrief georganiseerde en ondermijnende criminaliteit licht ik toe hoe ik uitvoering geef aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Na tientallen vrouwen, willen nu ook IS-mannen terugkeren naar Nederland'

The MP asks whether the 25 male foreign fighters held in Syrian Kurdish camps have been prosecuted, their dual nationality and entry dates, whether Dutch nationals face cases, how evidence is secured, whether tougher sentences and GVM measures will be sought, and whether the House will be consulted on repatriations. The minister answers that most detainees have not yet been prosecuted, some were convicted in absentia, dual nationality is partly relevant, a bill raising the maximum sentence for terrorist participation is planned, the House is informed of repatriation decisions, and GVM requests are for prosecutors and courts to decide without a registered count.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Aartsen en Erkens over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

Three VVD MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that drug gangs were offering 'help' to Limburg hospitality businesses struggling after the 2021 floods, covering compensation, prevention, RIEC analysis, information sharing and cross-border criminal approaches. The minister answered that affected hospitality entrepreneurs awaited no pending compensation decision, described existing prevention campaigns and cooperation, and said no specific sector analysis or concrete RIEC signals existed.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Rondtrekkende bendes vaker betrokken bij diefstallen in Nederland'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aartsen asked the Justice Minister about reports that travelling criminal gangs are increasingly involved in thefts, including the share of non-Dutch suspects, cooperation with European and non-European countries, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, Europol's role and prevention measures. The minister answered in detail that suspect data is limited, that a 25 percent figure applies only to cases where a suspect is identified, that existing cooperation and information-sharing mechanisms are adequate, and that the mobile banditry approach is now embedded in the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen.
Yes, I will also address the progress of the approach to mobile banditry in the next half-yearly report.
Ja, ik zal in het volgende halfjaarbericht ook ingaan op de voortgang van de aanpak van mobiel banditisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over de stichting de Vrienden van XR

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about the Stichting Vrienden van XR, its alleged role funnelling money to Extinction Rebellion, government subsidies to related organisations, its ANBI status, and civil liability for disruptive actions. The Minister answered that the government has no subsidy relationship with XR or the foundation, that ANBI status is assessed neutrally by the tax authority, and that civil liability for unlawful acts is for courts to decide.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to assess such statements.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om hier in de beoordeling te treden van dergelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Boerenorganisatie LTO wil dat dierenextremisten worden gestraft: 'Bijna elke dag insluipingen''

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about reports that farm organisation LTO wants animal-rights extremists punished for stable occupations and break-ins, and whether current law and police registration are adequate. The Minister of Justice answered that existing offences (trespass and unlawful entry) can be prosecuted, that a separate police classification for such incidents is currently undesirable, and that follow-up steps such as talks with the sector and a review of earlier agreements are being considered.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht aantal getroffen websites met ernstig kindermisbruik in twee jaar tijd verdubbeld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that websites containing serious child sexual abuse material doubled over two years, and about Dutch hosting providers involved, cooperation with the IWF and hosters, and the timing of the bill on administrative enforcement. The minister answered that the Netherlands' share of such material fell from 41% to 32%, described the self-regulation regime and the planned ATKM authority, and committed to sending the bill to parliament, which was done on 12 June.
I sent the bill on administrative enforcement against online child pornography to your House on 12 June.
Ik heb het wetsvoorstel bestuursrechtelijke aanpak online kinderpornografisch materiaal op 12 juni jl. naar uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over de sekte La Luz Del Mundo

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the La Luz Del Mundo sect, its Den Haag presence, victim support, a central reporting point and a Belgian knowledge centre. The minister answered that police have no information warranting criminal action, that victims can be supported by existing services, and that a broader review of victim help and a reporting point is pending in a separate letter.
I refer you to the aforementioned letter of 30 June.
Ik verwijs u naar voornoemde brief van 30 juni.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘’Ene na het andere geldwisselkantoor gesloten na explosies: wat is er gaande bij Suri-Change?’’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about municipalities closing nine Suri-Change money exchange locations after explosions and possible criminal links, plus DNB supervision of money transfer organisations, information sharing between municipalities, and the role of mayors and RIECs. The minister declined to comment on the specific company or ongoing investigations, described DNB's risk-based supervision and the sector's integrity challenges, and outlined limited Bibob-based information sharing and the mayor's role in tackling criminal money flows.
I cannot make statements about individual cases or ongoing investigations.
Over individuele casussen of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boer Erik Jan doelwit criminele bendes:” Ze hebben alles gesloopt”

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen (VVD) asked whether GPS theft from farm vehicles by organised, mostly Eastern European gangs is rising, where it occurs, what police and the ministers are doing about it, and how agricultural areas are protected against criminal takeover. The government answered that GPS thefts have risen slightly, concentrated in four regions, and described police prevention, cross-border information exchange, registration databases and ongoing public-private cooperation, while stating these thefts do not qualify as high impact crimes.
In 2023, up to 30 May, around 50 reports or complaints were received of GPS theft from barns, stables or a farmyard.
In 2023 zijn er tot 30 mei ongeveer 50 meldingen of aangiftes ontvangen van diefstal van GPS uit schuren, stallen of van een erf.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met verkeerd geloof aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafistis

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the salafist 'self-appointed police' in mosques and whether intelligence and counterterrorism gaps, imam recruitment from abroad, and information-sharing need tightening. The government answered at length: it says the NCTV lacks a legal basis to process personal data from social media, the bill on casus consultations is needed, soft signals cannot be shared with foreign countries under current law, and it is working on an imam training route and transparency rules, while declining a single legal definition of problematic behaviour.
The NCTV currently has no legal basis for processing personal data and therefore cannot consult social media sources, resulting in a more limited view.
De NCTV heeft op dit moment geen grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens, en kan derhalve geen sociale media-bronnen raadplegen en heeft dus ook beperkter zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over drugs per post

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about drugs sent by post, including a joint police-customs team, cooperation with post and courier firms, an e-learning and a barrier model, and possible liability for companies. The government reports a new joint team (HARP), no registration of seized hard drugs per company, a barrier model ready, no need now for corporate criminal liability, and country data on seizures.
No, that is not known because no registration takes place per courier company.
Nee, dat is niet bekend omdat er geen registratie plaatsvindt per koeriersbedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over demonstraties door Extinction Rebellion

An MP asked the Justice Minister about mass Extinction Rebellion protests at Schiphol, the A12 and Eindhoven Airport, including identification of detainees, use of expedited procedure, prosecution for incitement, and whether the legal framework on protest should be tightened. The minister answered that identification and prosecution are ongoing, that expedited justice was not applied, that the right to demonstrate is protected but not a licence for crime, and that a letter on the Wet openbare manifestaties will follow before summer.
The right to demonstrate, as protected nationally and internationally, I consider a great good.
Het recht op betoging, zoals nationaal en internationaal beschermd, acht ik een groot goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over bescherming van boeren tegen drugscriminaliteit en het tegengaan van ondermijning in het buitengebied.

Two VVD MPs asked how farmers can be protected against drug crime and undermining activity in rural areas, including whether a Brabant model rental contract could be rolled out nationally and how it relates to mayors' powers under Article 13b of the Opium Act. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the risk is real nationwide, describes existing pilots and a model contract, says municipalities should decide how to apply it, and declines to consult the VNG and IPO.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I want to encourage such initiatives and take them further.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid wil ik dergelijke initiatieven stimuleren en verder brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Smals over het bericht 'Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Smals asked why training to become a buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaar (boa) is excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme and whether this deters future boas. The ministers answered that the training is the employer's responsibility, that the government is exploring whether zij-instromers could be funded under STAP, and that recruitment and retention are the job of employers and municipalities.
The cabinet understands that funding boa training with STAP budget could add value for lateral entrants and is willing to examine this further.
Het kabinet begrijpt dat financiering van boa-opleidingen met STAP-budget voor zij-instromers een meerwaarde kan zijn en is bereid dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen inzake het ’Moreel beraad over het klimaat’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a cancelled discussion evening on whether violence should be used to force climate action, the classification of climate activism, the 1980s protest movement, Extinction Rebellion's civil disobedience, police and public prosecution tools against calls to break the law, and whether damages can be recovered from demonstration organisers. The minister condemned calls to violence, said debate is permitted, argued that climate activism is not extremist at present, and described the existing legal and police frameworks for demonstrations, while declining to send a specific police handling framework because none exists as a separate document.
There is no specific policy framework for non-notified climate demonstrations in which people glue or chain themselves in place.
Er is geen specifiek handelingskader voor niet-aangemelde klimaatdemonstraties waarbij mensen zich vastlijmen en vastketenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht ‘IS-vrouwen waren geen brave huismoeders – ze deden in wapens, explosieven en slaven, volgens het OM’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked why IS returnees, repatriated at their own request to attend their trials, are largely absent from substantive hearings, and whether Yazidi victims' rights are thereby harmed. The Minister says the victim-rights law's appearance duty is not yet in force, that courts can order attendance, that trial absence is for judges to decide, and that a new implementation date will be announced in April 2023.

In general terms, I would say it goes against my sense of justice if a suspect of terrorist offences, who deliberately travelled to ISIS territory and was then repatriated to the Netherlands by the Dutch State because they wish to be present in person at their criminal case, were then not present at the substantive hearing of the case.

In algemene zin wil ik aangeven dat het tegen mijn rechtvaardigheidsgevoel ingaat indien een verdachte van terroristische misdrijven, die bewust is uitgereisd naar ISIS-gebied en daarna door de Nederlandse Staat naar Nederland is gerepatrieerd omdat hij/zij in persoon aanwezig wil zijn bij de strafzaak, vervolgens niet bij de inhoudelijke behandeling van de strafzaak aanwezig zou zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Becker over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met ‘verkeerd geloof’ aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafist

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Telegraaf report on self-appointed 'salafist police' intimidating mosques and imams, and about how the state can detect and act against salafist preachers. The government answered that intimidation is unacceptable and that the NCTV, police, municipalities and a taskforce have limited legal grounds, so some tools (data processing, Europol exchange, online removal) remain constrained, while promising legislation and a strategy on online radicalisation.

For the Taskforce on Problematic Behaviour and Undesirable Foreign Financing, and at the request of local authorities, the NCTV provided assessments of individual persons, including salafist preachers.

Ten behoeve van de Taskforce Problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering, alsmede op verzoek van lokale overheden, verstrekte de NCTV duidingen over individuele personen, ook over salafistische aanjagers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over politiesamenwerking tussen de Benelux-landen

An MP asked the Justice minister why the Netherlands has not yet ratified the new Benelux police cooperation treaty, which Belgium and Luxembourg have already approved, and urged speed. The minister explained that the Netherlands is last, that implementing agreements must go through a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure, and that the data protection authority's advice is still pending, while promising to pursue rapid entry into force.

Once the pre-consultation procedure is completed, the Netherlands can deposit the instrument of ratification with the depositary, the Secretary-General of the Benelux Union, and the treaty can enter into force.
Zodra de voorhangprocedure is afgerond kan Nederland de akte van bekrachtiging bij de depositaris – de Secretaris-Generaal van de Benelux Unie – neerleggen en kan het verdrag in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de plaatsing van distikstofmonoxide (lachgas) op Opiumlijst II en de handhaving daarvan

MP Michon-Derkzen asked whether police and the Public Prosecution Service were ready to enforce the nitrous oxide ban on List II of the Opium Act from 1 January 2023, what was needed for effective enforcement, and how enforcement would work if preparations were not complete. The Minister of Justice replied that enforcement against possession already takes place, that an ingroeimodel was agreed with police and prosecutors because of the logistical and safety requirements, that €14 million was structurally allocated, and that other laws are also used in the meantime.
As soon as the results of this further research are known, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de resultaten van dit nader onderzoek bekend zijn zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over “het bericht: OM worstelt met namen Schiphol-betogers: ‘ze hadden geen id bij zich”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that prosecutors struggle to identify Schiphol protesters arrested without ID, including whether sanctions were imposed, what police powers exist to compel identification, and whether incitement training organisers can be pursued. The minister answered that identification investigations are ongoing, detailed how police may hold arrestees and take photos and fingerprints, and said current powers are adequate for now.
In the context of the investigative interest, I cannot currently state how large this group is or how the investigation is being conducted.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang kan ik op dit moment niet aangeven hoe groot deze groep is of op welke wijze het onderzoek wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Mutluer over ‘Het schrijnende tekort aan forensisch artsen’

MPs asked the ministers about the severe shortage of forensic doctors, including how often shifts went unfilled, whether child abuse evidence was lost, and what structural solutions exist. The government reported recurring unfilled shifts in some regions, no known cases of lost child-abuse evidence, a temporary arrangement through 2023 with a sustainable solution still being developed, and that more funding is still being sought.
This despite many forensic doctors already working more shifts than desired.
Dit ondanks dat veel forensisch artsen al meer diensten draaien dan gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ´Ouders omgekomen Bram (12) uit Haaksbergen willen verbod op klaphamer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether klaphamers (homemade metal devices producing loud bangs with chemicals, linked to a fatal accident involving a 12-year-old) are regulated, whether they fall under the fireworks decree, and what oversight exists. The minister answered that no national rules or designated supervisor exist, that municipalities can ban them via local ordinances, and that information will be provided to municipalities around September 2023.
No national figures are available on the number of accidents involving klaphamers.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal ongevallen met klaphamers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer meldingen verwarde personen, maar aanpak moeilijk door privacywet: ‘Je weet niet met wie je te maken hebt.’’

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about rising reports of persons with confused behaviour, data-sharing barriers under privacy law, and whether the national reporting line tracks outcomes. The ministers answered that the national line only forwards callers to regional bodies, that cooperation and data-sharing frameworks are being developed, and that they will keep consulting field partners and the EU on the GDPR.
No, no data is centrally collected on this.
Nee, hierover wordt centraal geen data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Corruptie is bij de Belastingdienst lastig te traceren’

MPs Idsinga and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that corruption at the Tax Authority is hard to trace, since systems do not log which data staff access. The State Secretary admits systems do not log data queries, outlines integrity measures, and says the Minister will raise corruption in the MCAO and inform parliament in later letters.
It is correct that the Tax Authority's computer systems do not record (log) which information employees query, because these systems were not designed to capture such information.
Het klopt dat computersystemen van de Belastingdienst niet registreren (loggen) welke informatie medewerkers opvragen omdat deze systemen niet zijn opgezet om dit soort informatie vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘NL-Alert tijdens storm te laat verstuurd, meldkamer bijna onbereikbaar’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a NL-Alert during storm Eunice was sent about an hour late while the 112 emergency line was overloaded, and what will prevent this in future. The minister confirmed the delay (about 75 minutes in total against a 15-minute target), attributed it mainly to the request going to the LOCC instead of the NCC and to tailoring the message text, and said procedures are being improved and the NIPV recommendations are under consideration.
The target time for sending a NL-Alert is 15 minutes.
De streeftijd voor het verzenden van een NL-Alert bedraagt 15 minuten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Ellian en Bikker over het bericht 'Justitie Den Haag schrapt 53 zaken: Wietkwekers en drugsdealers ontlopen straf'

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Ellian and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Den Haag public prosecution service had requested inadmissibility in 53 old drug-related cases, and whether this signals impunity and why cases were left pending. The minister called it a bad signal, explained the cases were mostly confiscation and older drug cases with no direct victims, that the prosecution service had discretion, and that backlog and capacity measures are underway.
The prosecution service cannot state what the sentencing demand in the cases would have been.
Het OM kan niet aangeven wat de strafeis in de zaken zou zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Zedenrecherche ondanks miljoenen nauwelijks opgeschaald’

A VVD MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that sex-crimes investigation units were barely expanded despite millions in funding, including staffing numbers, regional waiting-time differences, and the financial costs of the new sexual offences law. The minister answered in detail: about 87% of the planned 113 FTE expansion has been realised, a new cost projection is provided, and a chain-wide plan to shorten waiting times is expected by end 2022.
Of the total planned staff increase of 113 FTE, 98.7 FTE has been realised, which is 87%.
Van de in totaal voorziene formatie-ophoging van 113 fte is 98,7 fte gerealiseerd, dat is 87%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het onbenut laten van Bibob-toetsing bij subsidieverlening

MPs Sneller and Michon-Derkzen asked why national ministries, notably RVO and Uitvoering van Beleid SZW, rarely apply the Bibob integrity test when granting subsidies. The minister answers that the test is discretionary, that ministries are in talks to increase its use, that RVO and UVB rely on other controls, and promises an update by the first quarter of 2023.
The Ministry of Justice and Security is engaging with various departments to stimulate the use of the Bibob Act within central government.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (JenV) gaat met verschillende departementen in gesprek om het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij de rijksoverheid te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over de brief ‘Aankondiging van maatregelen ter voorkoming identiteitsfraude’

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked how many officials issued fraudulent identity documents, whether criminal proceedings exist, which municipalities are involved, and what follow-up is planned for affected citizens and personnel integrity. The government says dozens of cases are known, ongoing criminal investigations cannot be detailed, the RvIG will examine procedural deviations with results expected by year end, and it will promote integrity checks and a possible certification register while noting municipalities hold personnel powers.
I cannot provide further information about these investigations.
Over deze onderzoeken kan ik geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked why the minister did not answer earlier questions about the dropping of 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, including a list of the cases and advance notice of such actions. The minister replied that the cases are mostly minor offences, that a detailed list would consume scarce capacity, that he would have informed parliament only when such a sweeping decision is repeated, and that all cases including those with victims are being reassessed.
For this reason I did not ask the Public Prosecution Service to draw up a detailed overview of all cases.
Om deze reden heb ik het OM niet gevraagd om een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle zaken op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten''

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the rising number of drug-containing postal parcels, the legal framework for intercepting them, the role of the police Post Interventie Team versus customs, and cooperation with postal firms and foreign partners. The minister explains customs has intensified post controls, outlines the legal powers, announces a joint police-customs postal team starting this year, and describes ongoing barrier-model and cooperation work.
The postal team will not receive independent powers or tasks but will become a platform for cooperation between police and customs to strengthen investigations.
Het postteam zal geen eigenstandige bevoegdheden of taken krijgen maar wordt een platform waarbinnen wordt samengewerkt tussen politie en douane om de opsporing te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen om jihadisten die in Nederland blijven terwijl paspoort is afgepakt’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that convicted IS terrorists whose Dutch nationality was revoked remain in the Netherlands, and about enforcement, monitoring and reporting duties. The minister answered that of 21 revocations under Article 14(2), only 5 persons have left, mostly due to missing travel documents or non-cooperation, that removal is pursued via detention, reporting duties and possible prosecution, and that the NCTV's coordination role is currently hampered by missing legal basis.
The NCTV cannot currently carry out this task.
Deze taak kan de NCTV momenteel niet uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over de aanpak van illegale boerenacties

An MP asked the Justice Minister how police handle illegal farmer protests, including tractors on motorways without plates and whether offenders are traced afterwards. The minister answered that the law applies equally, set out advisory principles for local authorities, and reported about 700 traffic fines and over a hundred arrests linked to the protests, while stating police cannot separately count protest-related cases.
The police systems have no separate label for farmer protests or for offences involving agricultural vehicles.
In de politiesystemen bestaat geen apart label voor boerenprotesten of voor overtredingen met landbouwvoertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht Drie doden en drie zwaargewonden bij schietpartij in Kopenhagen’

The MP asks about a shooting in Copenhagen, whether a lone-wolf radicalised attacker is possible in the Netherlands, whether services have enough capacity, and how the NCTV's suspended analysis work affects threat assessment and EU information exchange. The minister answers that the Danish case is not treated as terrorism, that the NCTV's analysis is limited pending a bill on processing personal data, and that EU information exchange is only partly affected.
The suspension of the analysis tasks does affect knowledge and information exchange with EU partners.
Het is wel zo dat de opschorting van de analyse taken gevolgen heeft voor kennis- en informatie-uitwisseling met EU-partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie: Schietpartij gayclub Oslo was islamitische terreurdaad’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Oslo gay-club shooting, the LHBTI community's security in the Netherlands, the AIVD's view of jihadist sympathisers, the NCTV's withdrawal from local case consultations, and information exchange with Europol. The minister described the Oslo attack and suspect, said there are currently no concrete signals of heightened risk to LHBTIQ+ people in the Netherlands, and explained that legal limits on personal data currently restrict NCTV's coordination role.
As long as the NCTV cannot or may not process personal data for these analysis and coordination tasks, the NCTV is unable to fulfil all its responsibilities for national security.

Zolang de NCTV voor de uitvoering van deze analyse- en coördinatietaken geen persoonsgegevens kan of mag verwerken is de NCTV niet in staat om al zijn verantwoordelijkheden ten behoeve van de nationale veiligheid waar te kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht “Nelson M. van verboden pedofielenclub Martijn met wapen en kinderporno opgepakt in Mexico’’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister how suspect Nelson M. could travel abroad during a pending child-pornography case and why stricter travel restrictions were not imposed. The minister answered that the court suspended pre-trial detention without finding flight risk, outlined available travel-restriction tools, said choosing measures is for the judge, and declined to comment on the ongoing case.
Regarding an ongoing criminal case, I, as is known, make no statements.
Over een lopende strafzaak doe ik, zoals bekend, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds vaker zelfgeprinte 3D-vuurwapens in onderwereld: ’Op korte afstand dodelijk’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the spread of 3D-printed firearms, extremist interest in them, and the lack of an explicit ban on publishing gun designs are being addressed. The Minister says police and prosecutors see a rise, that a phenomenon study and an international conference are underway, and that the Commission Wet wapens en munitie is examining a ban on distributing designs, with a final report due in October 2022.

That is why I have instructed the Commission on the Weapons and Ammunition Act to also map out the options for preventing the distribution and publication of 3D weapon designs, including banning them.

Daarom heb ik aan de door mij ingestelde Commissie Wet wapens en munitie de opdracht meegegeven om ook de mogelijkheden in kaart te brengen om het verspreiden en publiceren van ontwerpen van 3D-wapens te verhinderen, waaronder het verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that about 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland were dropped due to a shortage of judges, and whether similar sepots would occur in other districts. The Minister confirmed the reports, said the cases are light politierechter matters (no sex or youth cases, VPT cases screened as light), that about 90% will be seponeerd, and that similar large-scale decisions elsewhere are not expected.
The 1,500 cases concern so-called police-judge cases.
De 1.500 zaken betreffen zogenoemde politierechter zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over het verdwijnen van sektesignaal

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would implement the motion for a reporting point for cult signals and why the Sektesignaal point was discontinued. The minister says the motion will be carried out after the Hendriks commission reports on 1 November, police handle cult reports adequately, and cult-related reports at Sektesignaal were fairly stable at around 100 dossiers per year.
I will carry out the motion submitted by your House as intended, so that the functions of the reporting point are housed in the most suitable place.
Ik zal de door uw Kamer ingediende motie conform de bedoeling uitvoeren, zodat de functies van het meldpunt op de meest geschikte plaats worden ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht dat wetgeving doorrijden na een aanrijding aanzienlijk aangescherpt dient te worden

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers whether hit-and-run laws should be tightened after a report by a victims' association, including the 12-hour self-reporting rule, drink-driving detection, prosecution and sentencing figures, and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister says the 2020 law already raised maximum penalties, that the 12-hour rule is meant to encourage self-reporting, that prosecution remains the burden of the public prosecutor, and that the 12-hour rule and tightening will be examined with police and the prosecution service following an adopted motion, but the questions were not answered one by one in time.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Problemen bij kinderzedenzaken: schrijnend tekort aan forensisch artsen'

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about a reported shortage of forensic doctors that delays examinations of minors in sex-crime cases, and about measures to address it. The Minister replies that the shortage is serious, that an interim fix via NFI hiring of FMO covers the 0-12 age group, and that task redistribution pilots, a recruitment campaign and a study on physician assistants are underway, though structural solutions and timelines remain uncertain.
It is very serious that forensic evidence examination of minor victims of sex offences is under pressure due to the shortage of forensic doctors.
Het is zeer ernstig dat het sporenonderzoek bij minderjarige slachtoffers van zedendelicten onder druk staat door het tekort aan forensische artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Hooligans dreigen door georganiseerde vechtpartijen en training politie te overmannen’

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a report that organised hooligan fight groups are becoming more professional and threaten to overpower police, and asks about training, specialist approaches and equipment. The minister confirms the trends, says police are alert to planned fights, promises to ask the police chief to review ME training, and notes ongoing research into whether ME equipment is adequate.
Based on the results of the research, I will ask the police chief to consider whether the training programme needs to be adjusted.
Op basis van de resultaten van het onderzoek zal ik de korpschef vragen te bezien of het trainingsprogramma aangepast moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ´dreiging uit extreemrechtse hoek neemt toe´

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether an extreme-right attack in the Netherlands is plausible, how many extreme-right actors exist, what the NCTV and police are doing online, and when the EU terrorist online content regulation will be implemented. The minister confirms an attack is conceivable, says the total number of extreme-right actors is unknown (several hundred accelerationist sympathisers), notes that NCTV analysis work is limited pending a data-processing bill, and promises further information before the summer recess.
The total number of extreme-right actors in the Netherlands is not known.
