Het totaal aantal rechts-extremisten in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Omstreden Chinese camera’s hangen overal in Nederland, ook bij ministeries'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Chinese Hikvision and Dahua cameras are used at government buildings, including police and ministries, and what security checks apply when procuring them. The government answered that it does not know how many Chinese cameras are in use, that procurement follows general information-security rules with each organisation assessing national-security risks itself, and that a cross-government study into such risks will be carried out.
It is not known how many cameras this specifically concerns.
Het is niet bekend om hoeveel camera's het specifiek gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD schorst speciale eenheid ‘onaanvaardbaar lang'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance ministry about the suspension of the FIOD's Team Specialistische Operaties and a court's finding that the suspension was unacceptably long. The state secretary answered that mediation is ongoing, the suspension was justified by serious circumstances, the FIOD does not intend to dissolve the team, and investigations were not hindered.
In its ruling, the court pointed to an unacceptably long suspension.
In zijn uitspraak heeft de rechter gewezen op een onaanvaardbare lange schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Ambulanceverpleegkundige Laura (39): 'Hij greep me bij mijn nek''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about reports that an ambulance nurse was assaulted, that police initially did not want to take her report, and whether the ELA agreements on violence against public-service workers were followed. The minister says police and prosecutors apply the ELA agreements, that the next evaluation is due in 2024, and that some reporting issues will be discussed with the sector, but declines to comment on the individual case and disputes the claimed doubling of incidents.
As is known, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Tinne (35) niet het eerste slachtoffer 'ontgifting''

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about risks of detox farms using ayahuasca, rising use and providers, prosecutions, and whether penalties should be raised. The minister said there is no data on providers or users, that possession and sale of ayahuasca (DMT) are banned, that prosecution is case-by-case without specific figures, and that a study on drug trade penalties will be shared before year end.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures available on this, because this qualification is not recorded as such in its systems.
Het OM heeft hierover geen cijfers beschikbaar, omdat deze kwalificatie niet als zodanig in de systemen zit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Minhas over het bericht ‘Alarm om agressie op spoor en station’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Minhas asked about rising aggression against rail and public transport staff, including the role of conductors as boa's, their equipment and police response times. The Minister answered that incidents rose (NS 660 to 744, regional transport 787 to 977), outlined the NS request for database access to verify identities, and promised talks with NS and police but gave limited concrete commitments.
To improve the information position of boa's when establishing identity, it is important to give them better access to information so they can carry out their tasks independently.
Om de informatiepositie van boa's te verbeteren bij het vaststellen van de identiteit is het belangrijk hen betere toegang te geven tot informatie voor een zelfstandige taakuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en De Neef over het bericht 'Weer meer incidenten met verwarde personen'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Neef asked about rising police registrations of incidents involving people with confused behaviour (over 100,000 in 2020, 130,184 in 2021) and whether most are care matters rather than police matters, plus what measures and national teams have done, how municipal approaches differ, and whether the Veldhoven model and suggested joint police-care consultations should be adopted. The minister answered that the registration rise is not a clear indicator of growth, outlined ongoing triage pilots and national programmes, and promised to consider the suggestions and inform parliament before summer.

Although I share the concerns about the number of registrations, based on the registration of E33 reports it is not possible to state in general terms what share of these cases actually required care or support.

Hoewel ik de zorgen over het aantal registraties deel, is het op basis van de registratie van E33-meldingen niet mogelijk om in algemene zin aan te geven in welk aandeel van deze gevallen eigenlijk zorg of ondersteuning nodig was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derksen over activiteiten van radicaal extremistische dierenactivisten

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen asked about criminal activities by radical animal-rights extremists (stable occupations, break-ins, arson, smear campaigns, online intimidation), overview of cases and sentences, enforcement roles, legal basis and disclosure of farm data. The minister said no overview is available since there is no specific classification for animal-rights extremism, police remain primarily responsible with an agreed contact point and factsheet, and existing legal grounds suffice, while committing to examine stronger penalties and to send a letter to farm organisations before summer.
It is not possible for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to provide an overview of the past 10 years of such criminal activities on and around agricultural businesses.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van de afgelopen 10 jaar betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten op en rond een agrarisch bedrijf
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht dat veel vandalen de forse schade van de coronarellen niet hoeven te vergoeden

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked whether perpetrators of damage during the 2021 COVID curfew riots are escaping paying compensation, and why enforcement differs between regions. The Minister acknowledges that offenders should pay, reports that about 55 perpetrators have compensation orders totalling roughly €551,000 with €36,700 collected so far, and says that cessation of claims to the state for the Regeling Bedrijvenschade is being examined with the OM, while noting that full recovery will not be possible in all cases.
Figures on criminal-procedure claims for damages orders are not recorded, so it cannot be shown whether there are large differences between regions.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about reports that the FIOD suspended its Team Specialistische Operaties over an allowance dispute, and about the team's role, the cause, and the atmosphere within the FIOD. The Secretary of State declined to give details, citing an ongoing labour and court dispute and the employer's duty of care, while saying investigations continue with partner agencies and that the directorate seeks a swift resolution.
No statement is made on the specific content. The matter is before the court.
Over de specifieke inhoud wordt geen mededeling gedaan. De zaak is onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Gebiedsverboden en mobiele flitspalen: zo wil Haagse VVD verkeersaso’s aanpakken'

MPs Koerhuis and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the ministers about enforcement of traffic rules on municipal roads, the number and use of speed cameras, and how the Public Prosecution Service decides where to place them. The government answered that enforcement is set locally by the tripartite consultation (mayor, police, prosecution), that flitspaal placement follows a published policy framework, and that it will inform the House in early 2022 on new enforcement tools for notorious offenders.
Police deployment for traffic enforcement is determined locally in the tripartite consultation (mayor, police and Public Prosecution Service).
De inzet van de politie op verkeershandhaving wordt lokaal in de driehoek (burgemeester, politie en OM) bepaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Michon-Derkzen over de berichten ‘Verkeerde waterstanden en gebrek aan regie: veel ging mis bij aanpak watersnood Limburg’ en ‘Waterschap was niet voorbereid op watersnood Limbur

MPs Minhas and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about press reports that the Limburg flood response suffered from wrong water-level forecasts and poor coordination, and about the water board's preparedness and the COT evaluation. The minister answered that the water board will implement the COT recommendations, that a flood emergency plan for the Heuvelland is being prepared, and that broader crisis-system reforms and risk mapping are underway, without giving a firm timeline for every point.
The Limburg Water Board is responsible for implementing the recommendations of the COT.
Het Waterschap Limburg is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van het COT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over alternatieve (digitale) wijze waarop het recht op een eerlijk proces geëerbiedigd kan worden bij uitgereisde IS-vrouwen

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the right to a fair trial can be safeguarded for returned IS women, including via video-conferencing, and how the WODC study and ECtHR case law bear on this. The government answered that the study's comparative findings are noted, that a letter on video-conferencing is promised for early 2022, and that a verdragsbasis is needed for trial by video-conference of suspects abroad.
Before the summer recess, the House will receive further information on this.
Voor de zomer ontvangt uw Kamer hierover nadere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over het artikel 'Waar blijft de toegezegde ruimhartige compensatie?'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers about news reports that promised generous flood compensation had not yet arrived, and about payout pace, the definition of generosity, affected areas in Brabant, and talks on turnover loss. The minister replies that payouts of 7.26 million euros had reached 296 recipients by 11 January 2022, that a one-off turnover loss scheme and a crop-plan compensation scheme are being prepared, and that the Dutch government's existing flood-relief measures apply.
It indicated, among other things, that the cabinet will publish a one-off turnover loss scheme for affected entrepreneurs in Limburg in early 2022.
Daarin is onder andere aangegeven dat het kabinet begin 2022 een eenmalige omzetdervingsregeling zal publiceren voor getroffen ondernemers in Limburg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Beelden van misbruik van Marcels dochter blijven rondgaan: ‘Mensen gaan hierdoor kapot’'

An MP asked the Justice minister about the spread of abuse images of a girl, the detectability of child sexual abuse material on the darkweb, the hosting share in the Netherlands, webhoster responsibilities, and EU action. The minister answered at length, describing police and sector measures, the TU Delft monitor, and EU plans, but did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing reporting timelines.
For operational reasons, the investigative methods are not elaborated further.
Vanwege het operationeel belang wordt niet nader ingegaan op de opsporingsmethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Een primeur: in Utrecht mogen handhavers en toezichthouders voortaan een hoofddoek of keppel op’

The MP asks whether the government agrees that authority must be neutral and whether the uniform of municipal enforcement officers (boa's) should permit religious symbols, given motions in several cities. The Minister answers that police must remain lifestyle-neutral, that municipalities as employers decide on boa uniforms, and that he will await municipal consultations and the VNG evaluation before considering national rules, reporting to parliament in spring 2022.
I attach importance to first awaiting the discussions between municipalities and with the VNG and to following their outcomes, as well as the VNG evaluation of the model uniform.
Ik hecht er aan om eerst de gesprekken tussen gemeenten onderling en met de VNG af te wachten en de uitkomsten te volgen, als ook de evaluatie van de VNG inzake het modeluniform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Koerhuis over de brandveiligheid van zonnepanelen

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Koerhuis asked about fire safety of solar panels after a roof fire in Hoofddorp and whether building fire-safety rules for new homes are enforced. The minister answered that municipalities supervise compliance, that the Wkb quality-assurance law is planned for 1 July 2022, that NEN is reviewing standards, and that research on particle deposition from solar-panel fires is ongoing with results expected in early 2022.
It is up to the municipality as competent authority to supervise compliance with the fire-safety regulations that apply to new homes.
Het is aan de gemeente als bevoegd gezag toe te zien op de naleving van de brandveiligheidsvoorschriften die gelden voor nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Rajkowski over het bericht Hoe China met de Nederlandse politie meekijkt

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans and Rajkowski asked whether the Dutch police use Chinese DJI drones, whether this was preceded by a security and privacy risk analysis, and whether the government will act given Chinese cyber and data-access risks. The Minister answers that the police use DJI drones only for routine tasks and not for confidential operations, that a security check and data protection impact assessment were done, that mitigating measures are in place, and that no further investigation is planned.
Given the steps the police have already taken, I see no reason to order an investigation.
Ik zie, gezien de stappen die de politie al heeft gezet, geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Kabinet werkt aan terughalen meer IS-vrouwen'

Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about reports that the cabinet is working to repatriate more IS women, whether the motion on this has been implemented, why there is no cabinet response to a WODC study on videoconferencing in criminal trials, how France, Italy and Switzerland use videoconferencing in terrorism cases, and whether suspects of terrorism offences can be tried by videoconference (citing ECtHR Dijkhuizen v. the Netherlands). Minister Grapperhaus answered that prosecution and accountability in court is the priority, that repatriation is weighed case by case, that the motion will be addressed in a letter of 4 November, that the WODC study is being discussed with stakeholders, and that whether physical presence can be waived is for the judge to decide in each individual case.
Whether the physical presence of a suspect can be waived in a particular individual case is for the judge to decide on the basis of the facts and circumstances of that individual case.

Of van de fysieke aanwezigheid van een verdachte in een bepaald individueel geval kan worden afgezien, is aan de rechter om te bepalen aan de hand van de feiten en omstandigheden van dat individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that vulnerabilities in the 112 emergency call centres remain unresolved six years after inspection recommendations, including governance, staffing, risk management and ICT. The minister answers that the recommendations are endorsed and largely being implemented, that remaining issues are long-term and will be addressed, and points to a governance evaluation due in 2022 and planned consolidation of centres by 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Tekort van ruim 150 miljoen bij politie: ‘Ontzettend pijnlijk juist nu te bezuinigen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported 150+ million euro police budget shortfall for 2021, its causes, the measures needed to stay within budget, and its link to planned investments. The minister answered that the overrun was projected at 80-157 million, a task force produced cost-cutting measures such as a vacancy freeze and purchasing freeze, and an independent follow-up study is due in November.
In November this independent report is expected to be delivered.
In november wordt deze onafhankelijke rapportage naar verwachting opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Achterstand van honderden zedenzaken bij politie Midden-Nederland’

MPs Bikker, Michon-Derkzen and Ellemeet asked about reported backlogs of sexual offence cases at the Midden-Nederland police, the progress of the motion-Klaver capacity funding, support for victims and police staff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that 820 cases nationally (233 in Midden-Nederland) have been pending over six months, that capacity expansion and shortened training are underway with full staffing targeted for 2023, and that victim support and staff welfare measures exist, while acknowledging the backlog persists.
Of course, I will inform your House about progress in this area.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer over de voortgang op dit terrein informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verdachte chauffeur dodelijk ongeval Waalhaven reed eerder motoragent en fietsster aan’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Groot asked about reports that the suspect driver in a fatal Waalhaven crash had earlier struck a police motorcycle officer and a cyclist, and about prosecution, traffic-law classification, recidivism and police motorcycle safety. The Minister said the criminal investigation is ongoing and gave limited details, noting one earlier conviction, one case dismissed, and that police motorcycle training and evaluation are in place.
As there is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter in particular.
Aangezien er sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan ik over deze kwestie in het bijzonder geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Werf, Kuik, Bikker en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the investigation into protection of Peter R. de Vries should be broadened to earlier victims and whether the inquiry commission should be fully independent with an additional criminal-law expert. The minister answered that the Safety Board (OVV) will investigate lessons from protection of the brother, lawyer and confidant of the Marengo witness, and that the broader scope fits an OVV inquiry rather than the previously planned commission, while not doubting the commission members' suitability.

I have asked the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) to take on an investigation into the lessons that can be drawn from the security situations of the brother, the then lawyer and the confidant of the crown witness in the Marengo trial.

Ik heb de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid (OVV) gevraagd om het op zich te nemen in een onderzoek na te gaan welke lessen getrokken kunnen worden uit de beveiligingssituaties van de broer, de toenmalig advocaat en de vertrouwenspersoon van de kroongetuige in het Marengo-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Dit ging mis met NL-Alerts bij de brand in Noordbergum: opnieuw was de computer met een update bezig’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aukje de Vries asked about a NL-Alert failure during a fire in Noardburgum, including whether a system update caused false alerts and how the alert system is protected against outages. The minister denied an update caused it, attributed it to a fault in a control link, explained fallback arrangements and a planned system renewal around 2022, and deferred the future of siren alarms to the next cabinet.
In addition, the control facilities at the control rooms will be checked more thoroughly.
Daarnaast zullen de aansturingsvoorzieningen op de meldkamers extra gecontroleerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over een snelle tegemoetkoming voor gedupeerde ondernemers van de waterschade in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about insurers refusing flood damage claims in Valkenburg and how quickly affected entrepreneurs in Limburg could receive compensation, including whether turnover loss and advances could be covered. The minister answered that the Wts compensation scheme and a ministerial regulation are being prepared, damage can already be reported to RVO, turnover loss from disasters is excluded from the Wts but will be discussed with the region, and advances would slow the process because they also require appraisals.
The ministerial regulation includes the damage area.
In de ministeriële regeling is het schadegebied opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zonnepaneel stoort communicatie van hulpdiensten'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the Justice Minister, about reports that solar installations with non-compliant inverters interfere with the C2000 emergency communication network and aviation/maritime radio. The government acknowledged the problem, said it is being addressed urgently with the supplier and network manager, and explained that Agentschap Telecom supervises EMC compliance and has enforcement powers, including recalls and sanctions.
Agentschap Telecom assesses such situations and has the powers to intervene.
Agentschap Telecom beoordeelt dergelijke situaties en heeft de bevoegdheden om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘EU-leiders willen sancties tegen Wit-Rusland en eisen vrijlating Protasevitsj’

MPs Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would go further than the EU's announced measures against Belarus after the forced landing and arrest of Roman Protasevich, including sanctions on state firms, diplomats, airlines and airspace. The minister answered that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions, sectoral sanctions, a flight ban on Belarusian airlines, and that Dutch law was amended, while further national unilateral measures were judged ineffective.
The cabinet cannot share information on the total number of Belarusian diplomats accredited in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan geen informatie delen over het totaalaantal Belarussische diplomaten dat in Nederland geaccrediteerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Brandweer ontbeert oefenruimte tunnel- en flatbranden: ‘Afreizen naar Zwitserland’

An MP asked whether Dutch firefighters can practise tunnel and high-rise fires domestically, given reports that some regions train in Switzerland. The minister answered that safety regions set their own training programmes, that some regions train abroad for specialist scenarios, and that he lacks data on the number and cost of foreign trainings.
The design of the training programmes is for the safety regions to determine.
De inrichting van de trainingsprogramma's is ter bepaling aan de veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Criminelen infiltreren in rederijen in de Rotterdamse haven'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports of criminals infiltrating shipping companies in the Rotterdam port, including corruption, drop-off smuggling methods, information sharing, staffing of the drugs investigation teams and cooperation with Latin America. Minister Grapperhaus answered at length, describing existing public-private cooperation, an integrated plan under preparation, a WODC study on corruption risks, and information-sharing reforms, while stating that some measures lie outside his or other bodies' powers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Alarm Bouwend Nederland: Belgische gatenweg dreigt'

MPs Peter de Groot and Michon-Derkzen asked the minister about reports of a looming infrastructure maintenance shortfall, bridge and lock disruptions, and municipal budget cuts. The minister disputed the amounts cited, explained budget shifts and maintenance plans, described the status of closures and storms-related outages, and pointed to the next cabinet for longer-term funding decisions.
I do not recognise the amounts mentioned.
De genoemde bedragen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over seksuele intimidatie op scholen: "Het staat vaak niet op het netvlies"’

An MP asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that sexual intimidation in schools is poorly handled, the legal duties schools have, and the outcomes of reports. The minister answered that schools' duties are set by law, that a planned extension of the consultation duty to cover suspicions of intimidation is being prepared, and that data on reports and criminal complaints are partly available.
I do however want to extend this consultation duty, so that schools must also consult the trust inspectorate on suspicions of sexual intimidation.
Ik wil deze overlegplicht echter uitbreiden, zodat scholen ook bij vermoedens van seksuele intimidatie in overleg moeten treden met de vertrouwensinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Bestuurscrisis kostte Avicenna College bijna kwart miljoen euro'

The MP asks how the Avicenna College could spend nearly a quarter million euros on extra pay and interim staff in 2020 without benefiting students, and how this money can be recovered. The minister answers that the Inspectorate found no unlawful spending, that the law did not yet allow recovery of 2020 spending, and that governance and supervisory roles have since been separated.
The inspectorate did not find in its report that there was any unlawful spending.
De inspectie heeft in haar rapport niet geconstateerd dat er sprake was van onrechtmatige uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Miljoenenbonus topman Air France KLM, ondanks recordverlies en staatssteun’

MPs Heinen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether a large bonus for the Air France-KLM chief, despite record losses and state aid, conflicts with state-aid conditions and their own letters suspending bonuses. Minister Hoekstra answered that the bonus is not linked to arranging wage support, that bonuses are unacceptable in this crisis, that the suspension applies to KLM as recipient, and that the European Commission must enforce the Temporary Framework, with the Economic Affairs minister to probe for possible further tightening.
I have informed the company that I am not happy with the suggestion created and that this gives an incorrect picture.
Ik heb aan de onderneming laten weten niet gelukkig te zijn met de gewekte suggestie en dat dit een onjuist beeld geeft.

m: Amendement van het lid Tielen over een voorhang bij het koninklijk besluit tot inwerkingtreding van artikel II
Requires that the royal decree bringing article II into force, extending the hospital-care act to all care, be laid before both chambers for four weeks before it is proposed.
The proposal for a royal decree bringing article II into force shall not be made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit tot inwerkingtreding van artikel II wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van de leden Tielen en Krul over kwaliteit-van-levendata meenemen in het stappenplan over transparantie van kwaliteit
Asks the government to include quality-of-life data in the step plan on transparency of quality of care.
requests the government to also include quality-of-life data when drafting the aforementioned step plan
verzoekt de regering om bij de uitwerking van voornoemd stappenplan ook kwaliteit-van-levendata mee te nemen
Motie van het lid Tielen over prestatiebekostiging op basis van kwaliteit
Asks the government to explain in the health care agreements how performance-based payment on quality contributes to appropriate care.
requests the government to include in the health care agreements how performance-based payment on quality contributes to appropriate care
verzoekt de regering om in de zorgakkoorden mee te nemen op welke manier prestatiebekostiging op basis van kwaliteit bijdraagt aan passende zorg
Motie van de leden Tielen en Bushoff over gesimuleerde cyberaanvallen voor de zorg
Motion asking the government to require simulated cyberattacks for the healthcare sector in a ministerial regulation, following the financial sector model.
requests the government to apply the lessons from the financial sector and include simulated cyberattacks for healthcare in a ministerial regulation

to come up before summer 2018 with an alternative to the differentiated assessments
voor de zomer van 2018 te komen met een alternatief voor de gedifferentieerde beoordelingen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Slagt-Tichelman en Gabriëls over het bericht dat gemeenten een landelijke aanpak voor bestrijdingsmiddelen willen

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister about municipalities' calls for a national approach to pesticides in bulb cultivation, including a statutory spray-free zone and national rules, and about the government's health-in-all-policies approach. The minister answered that a legal framework already exists for municipalities to act locally, that a study on spray-zone width is under way, that the sector is reducing pesticide use voluntarily, and that no national statutory spray-free zone will be introduced.
I agree with the municipality of Midden-Drenthe that this issue is complex, and I endorse the importance of mutual trust and open communication between farmers and residents.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente Midden-Drenthe dat dit vraagstuk complex is, en onderschrijf het belang van onderling vertrouwen en open communicatie tussen agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massaal doden van straathonden in Marokko voor het WK- voetbal

An MP asked the government whether it knows that stray dogs in Morocco are being mass-killed ahead of the 2030 World Cup, whether it will raise this with Morocco, and whether it will press against a draft law criminalising feeding strays. The government replied that the matter is an internal Moroccan affair, that it supports a combined approach to stray dogs rather than mass killing, and that it will not raise the issue bilaterally or at EU level beyond noting Morocco's new national legislation.
This concerns an internal Moroccan matter.
Het betreft hier een interne Marokkaanse aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Paternotte over het bericht ’UEFA gaf clubs in Rusland 10,8 miljoen euro, maar weigerde steun aan Oekraïense clubs’

MPs asked whether the UEFA should stop paying solidarity money to Russian clubs and whether Ukrainian clubs should receive the same support as others, given Russia's war against Ukraine. The government answered that UEFA is not a state body and sanctions compliance is UEFA's responsibility, that it will use informal channels and contact the KNVB, and that UEFA says it never refused Ukrainian clubs but bank blockages prevented payments.
The cabinet will use all available informal channels to bring its position on this matter to the fore and will also be in contact with the KNVB about it.
Het kabinet zal alle beschikbare informele kanalen aangrijpen om zijn standpunt in deze voor het voetlicht te brengen en hierover ook contact hebben met de KNVB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Haage over het besluit van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs judolessen niet langer te erkennen als volwaardige invulling van het bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Haage asked whether the Inspectorate's decision that judo lessons at a Dalton school no longer count as full physical education, despite a qualified teacher, is justified, and whether the ministries will talk to the Judo Bond and what the end of the physical-education subsidy means. The state secretary defended the Inspectorate's position that structural judo cannot meet the core goals alone, declined a direct meeting with one provider, and said ending the subsidy will not reduce physical-education hours.
By structurally offering judo lessons as part of physical education, a school cannot meet the implementation of the core goals.
Met het structureel aanbieden van judolessen als onderdeel van het bewegingsonderwijs kan een school niet voldoen aan de uitvoering van de kerndoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Six Dijkstra over het datalek van medische en persoonlijke gegevens bij het laboratorium van Clinical Diagnostics in Rijswijk

MPs Hertzberger and Six-Dijkstra asked how a hack at the Clinical Diagnostics laboratory exposed medical data of about half a million Dutch citizens, when the government was informed, why the breach was not disclosed sooner, and what minimum data security standards apply. The state secretary answered that independent investigations by BVO NL, the AP and the IGJ are underway, gave a timeline of notifications, stated that the cooperation with the laboratory was suspended, and largely deferred the detailed questions on data minimisation, certification and other laboratories to those ongoing investigations.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) has launched an independent investigation into the exact scope and cause of this hack.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar de exacte omvang en de oorzaak van deze hack.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat sportmedium Sport Knowhow XL wordt overgenomen door Golazo Media

MP Van Nispen asks the government about the takeover of sports media outlet Sport Knowhow XL by Golazo Media, which also publishes other sports titles and runs sports events, and the risks to independence and diversity of sports reporting. Minister Bruins replies that the takeover is between private parties, was not notifiable to the ACM, and that other independent media still cover sports policy, without describing concrete steps.
The takeover concerns an agreement between private media parties.
De overname betreft een overeenkomst tussen private mediapartijen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral, Van den Hil en Tielen over het artikel '‘Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen’; Malafide medewerkers in de jeugdzorg maken misbruik van de positie van kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Dral, Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the State Secretaries about a Telegraaf report that malicious youth-care workers exploit vulnerable youths for crime, and about fraud with EVC certificates and training points in the youth-care register. The government answered that it does not know the numbers, is sampling 274 of about 3,500 EVC-based registrations, has suspended 490 pending applications, and is pursuing wider anti-fraud measures.
Therefore the SKJ started with a sample of 274 files to determine the content and pace of the follow-up on that basis.
Daarom is de SKJ gestart met een steekproef van 274 dossiers om op basis daarvan de inhoud en het tempo van het vervolg te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Gemeente Almelo zeer teleurgesteld na vrijspraak’

An MP asked the health minister how to strengthen criminal prosecution of healthcare fraud after an acquittal of a care provider the Almelo municipality had accused of misusing care funds, and whether a weak point in the rules exists. The minister answered that criminal law requires a higher burden of proof than civil and administrative law, that civil and administrative rulings already ordered repayment, that the Wibz bill and other measures are underway, and that the Ministry keeps no register of such cases.
The Ministry of VWS does not keep a register of court cases against healthcare fraudsters.
Het Ministerie van VWS houdt geen registratie bij van rechtszaken tegen zorgfraudeurs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zorgverleners steeds vaker slachtoffer van agressie van patiënten én hun naasten. ‘Ik durfde niet meer voor de patiënt te zorgen’’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that healthcare workers increasingly face aggression from patients and their relatives, and about progress on their party's anti-aggression plan, the KNMG guideline on ending treatment relationships, motions on anti-aggression programmes and prison sentences, and privacy rules limiting information-sharing between hospitals. The minister acknowledged the problem, reported that most plan points have been implemented or are underway (including an anti-aggression campaign and a planned bill on sentencing exemptions), explained the limited scope of the KNMG guideline and privacy constraints, and referred the motion follow-up to the justice minister.
Aggression against healthcare workers is never acceptable.
Agressie tegen zorgmedewerkers is nooit acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Alleen garantie op gescheurde borstimplantaten als je ze laat vervangen

MPs Tielen and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister about reports that breast implant manufacturers' warranties only cover torn implants if the patient gets replacements, and whether this misleads patients and whether oversight is adequate. The minister said such contract terms are for the civil courts to judge, noted removal may be covered by the basic health package when medically necessary, reported very few complaints, and said she is reviewing the reporting structure for implant complaints.
Ultimately it is for the civil judge (on the claim of the injured party) to decide.
Dat is uiteindelijk aan de civiele rechter (op vordering van de benadeelde).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de uitzending van de Oranjezondag van 9 maart

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about doping oversight, safety and enforcement in Dutch bodybuilding, after three bodybuilding federations stayed outside NOC*NSF and the national doping rules. The state secretary answered that sport bodies bear responsibility for doping rules and events, that legislation would undermine sport autonomy and is not desirable, and that enforcement of the Geneesmiddelenwet by the IGJ is general rather than sport-specific, with a commitment to consult on an independent integrity centre later.
It is not known how many people in the Netherlands do bodybuilding in total, structurally or incidentally, and at amateur or top-sport level.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel mensen in Nederland in totaal, structureel of incidenteel, en op amateurniveau of als topsport, aan bodybuilding doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht: ‘Meer seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag door zorgverleners dan gedacht’

An MP asks the health minister about reports of sexual boundary violations by care workers and the Inspectorate's estimate of their prevalence, reporting thresholds, sanctions and action plans. The government acknowledges the problem and its underreporting, points to existing reporting channels, the national action programme and a government commissioner, and states that the Inspectorate's findings are being incorporated into current policy with a progress update next spring.
Care providers must report sexual boundary-crossing behaviour to the inspectorate.
Zorgaanbieders moeten seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag melden bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Daniëlle Jansen over de documentaire ‘Crowdfunding: vloek of zegen?’ gemaakt door Omroep Gelderland

MPs Tielen and Daniëlle Jansen asked the health minister about a documentary on crowdfunding for stem cell therapy in MS, the status of a promised review of when the therapy can be covered, why other countries use it more, how many patients go abroad, and whether it is clear to patients who qualifies. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut covers the therapy only for very active RRMS since December 2022, that an evaluation with safeguards is ongoing, that it does not track patients going abroad, and that the Zorginstituut can re-assess if new evidence emerges.
It is unknown how many MS patients have gone abroad for stem cell therapy and how many of them were cured after this therapy.
Het is onbekend hoeveel MS-patiënten naar het buitenland zijn gegaan om stamceltherapie te ondergaan en hoeveel van hen zijn genezen na deze therapie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over ontwikkelingen en Europese samenwerking op het gebied van postcovid, mede n.a.v. het bericht ‘Postcovidklinieken boeken eerste resultaten’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about results and expansion of post-COVID expertise centres, referral to primary and secondary care, European cooperation and research overviews. The minister answered that the centres are a first step, further centres will open at academic hospitals, knowledge will later spread to general hospitals and GPs, and that research updates and European network work are ongoing.
In a next state-of-affairs letter on post-COVID I will send your House the report of the IVM.
In een volgende stand van zakenbrief over post-COVID zal ik uw Kamer het rapport van het IVM doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over de ontwikkelingen rondom zelfstandige zorgprofessionals (zzp’ers in de zorg) onder andere zoals beschreven in het artikel van RTL ’In maand tijd ruim 4000 minder zzp

MPs Tielen and Aartsen (VVD) asked ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the drop in self-employed care workers and the enforcement against bogus self-employment, asking for definitions, examples, signals from the sector, and flexibility options such as regional employment and VAT-exempt pools. The ministers answered that the legal test is the Civil Code employment definition applied to all circumstances, that model agreements remain valid until 2029, that the sector has so far reported limited effects, and that they are working with the sector on regional employment models and VAT clarification.
The cabinet will respond in the short term on the case examples drawn up by the LHV, as far as possible before the committee debate on self-employed workers of 3 April.
Over de hiervoor door de LHV opgestelde casuïstiek zal het kabinet op korte termijn reageren, voor zover mogelijk voor het commissiedebat zzp van 3 april a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over de uitzending van De Oranjezondag van 9 maart 2025

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a broadcast suggesting anabolic steroid use is normalised in bodybuilding, and about controls, integrity oversight and the government's role. The State Secretary acknowledged the impression of normalisation, said there is no coordinated oversight because three bodybuilding federations, none under NOC*NSF, have not adopted the national doping rules, and pointed to information programmes by the Dopingautoriteit rather than mandatory regulation.
Specific figures on drug use in bodybuilding are therefore not available to me.
Specifieke cijfers over het middelengebruik in bodybuilding heb ik daarom niet ter beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de paramedische zorg, o.a. naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘De paramedische zorg wankelt’

MP Tielen asks the Minister and State Secretary of Health about unprofitable tariffs for paramedical care, the effects of the DBA law, digital and hybrid care, and the sector's exclusion from the Integraal Zorgakkoord. The State Secretary answers with references to NZa market research, a COPD bundled-payment experiment and ZIN advice, while stating that paramedic tariffs are free-pricing and largely a matter for providers and insurers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Geen 'kerst', maar wel ramadan mét scheiding mannen en vrouwen bij overheidsorgaan'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that the CAK replaced Christmas with a winter party, planned an iftar, and used gender-separated prayer rooms, and asked about its funding and governance. The minister answered that the CAK does not offer separated prayer rooms and still held a Christmas breakfast or lunch, that staff can use internal channels, and that a ministry-wide survey found no separated prayer rooms.
Following the article in HP/De Tijd, I spoke with the CAK's director.
Naar aanleiding van het artikel in HP/DeTijd heb ik gesproken met de bestuurder van het CAK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Rechter doet uitspraak over mondkapjesmiljoenen van Sywert van Lienden’

An MP asked the health minister for his reaction to a news report on a court case against Relief Goods Alliance over face-mask procurement, the role of product quality versus alleged free-of-charge dealing in the lawsuit, and whether crisis clauses should be introduced in procurement. The state secretary answered that the court ruled and the state may appeal, that quality plays no role in the lawsuit (which concerns fraud, error and unlawful conduct by RGA), and that existing emergency procurement rules and standard government purchase conditions are considered sufficient, without proposing a crisis clause.
Afterwards I will inform your House further insofar as this is possible given the procedural position of the State.
Daarna zal ik uw Kamer verder informeren voor zover dit mogelijk is gelet op de procespositie van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Hoe zorginstellingen diplomafraude bestrijden: ‘Kwaadwillenden gaan ingenieus te werk’’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about press reports on diploma fraud in care institutions, including links to financial misuse, patient safety and criminality, and about the Information Hub Care Fraud, a ban on fraudsters returning to care, Bibob integrity checks and a consolidated fraud policy overview. The minister acknowledged the problem, described the three-pronged approach and planned letters, and pointed to the Wbsrz, the warning register and a preliminary talk with the Justice ministry, but gave no full policy overview or first meldingenoverzicht before summer.
Your House will be informed by letter about this approach in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt op korte termijn per brief over deze aanpak geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Zorg Spoedeisende hulp loopt vast door ouderen, maar terug naar huis is vaak ook geen optie’

MPs Tielen and Bevers (VVD) asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about news that emergency departments are clogged by elderly patients who cannot safely return home, and how this relates to the Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) targets and the planned Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg. The ministers answered that they share the concern, cite measures such as strengthened primary care, care coordination, higher short-stay tariffs, a study on returning nursing homes, and monitoring of IZA goals, but could not give quantified effects.
After the first measurement of the monitor expected at the end of spring 2025, we can inform the House about the status of the monitor's outcomes.
Na de 1-meting van de monitor die einde voorjaar 2025 is voorzien, kunnen we uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken op de uitkomsten van de monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Blauwe bessen AH mogelijk besmet met hepatitis A’ en de Kamerbrief daarover

An MP asked whether the NVWA could have detected the hepatitis A contamination in frozen blueberries earlier, and who is responsible for food safety. The State Secretary answered that the batch was not in the NVWA's sampling selection, that producers bear primary responsibility under an EU system that works well, that the NVWA acted quickly once signalled, and that no tightening of rules is currently seen as necessary.
The batch of blueberries that was withdrawn from the market did not fall within the (random sample) selection for analysis under the NVWA's monitoring programme.
De partij blauwe bessen die uit de handel is gehaald, viel niet binnen de (steekproefsgewijze) selectie voor analyse van het monitoringsprogramma van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Kind van ouders met verstandelijke beperking: 'Eigenlijk was ik de ouder'’

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the state secretary about a report on children of parents with intellectual disabilities and the Nu Niet Zwanger programme on childbearing wishes, including registration of KOPP/KOV families and reach to other vulnerable groups. The state secretary answered that the programme is voluntary and not registered by target group, that participating organisations and municipalities are not fully tracked nationally, and that the government is monitoring implementation via the GALA monitor and exploring funding.
This data is not registered nationally.
Deze gegevens worden niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Opleiding die huisartsentekort had kunnen oplossen alweer weg uit Zeeland'

MPs Tielen and Van den Hil asked why a Physician Assistant training pilot in Zeeland is ending early and students must travel to Nijmegen, and how quality of distance education was assessed. The minister said the places were temporary, responsibility for quality lies with the hogeschool, and national PA training places are being expanded as advised by the capacity body.
Responsibility for the implementation and monitoring of the quality of this programme lies with the Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de kwaliteit van deze opleiding ligt bij de Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Wat vrouwen niet mogen weten over hun eigen borsten’

MPs Tielen and Westerveld asked about a Volkskrant article on breast screening for women with dense breast tissue, and whether women's concerns and the option of extra MRI are being taken seriously. The State Secretary says extra MRI capacity is insufficient, that density reporting offers no actionable options, and that he will consult stakeholders and the Health Council on improvements and inform the House.
I find this a difficult dilemma. That is why I will enter into discussion with the parties involved.
Ik vind dit een lastig dilemma. Daarom zal ik in gesprek gaan met betrokken partijen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de postcovidexpertisecentra die per 1 november jl. zijn geopend, zoals aangekondigd in het bericht van de NOS ‘Eerste expertisecentra long covid openen in november’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Health why only three university medical centres (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Maastricht) open post-COVID expertise centres first, why no general hospitals are included, how this fits the needs of hard-hit provinces such as Noord-Brabant, and how expertise will be spread beyond academic hospitals. The Minister answered that UMCs were asked to lead expertise development as the field itself had not organised care adequately, that the start is deliberately small with other UMCs following within months, and that patients are allocated by randomisation from a national waiting list via GPs.
Within a few months the other UMCs in the Netherlands will also open their doors, after which this care will be broadened as quickly as possible to general hospitals and primary care.
Binnen enkele maanden zullen ook de overige umc’s in Nederland de deuren openen, waarna deze zorg zo snel mogelijk wordt verbreed naar de algemene ziekenhuizen en de eerste lijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Experts waarschuwen voor levensgevaarlijke afslankthee: ‘Je speelt echt met je gezondheid’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that slimming tea containing the banned substance sibutramine was sold online, and about enforcement by the NVWA and IGJ. The state secretary answered that the NVWA has acted against sellers, including an arrest and a public warning, while noting that regulating non-EU sellers online is legally difficult and that the company bears primary responsibility.
In such cases the NVWA can have the content removed if it does not comply with the legislation.
De NVWA kan in zulke gevallen wel de inhoud laten verwijderen, indien deze niet aan de wetgeving voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Kamminga over de berichtgeving omtrent mpox-vaccins, o.a. op NU.nl ‘Geen Nederlandse mpox-vaccins naar Afrika vanwege ‘nationale paraatheid’’

MPs Tielen and Kamminga asked the Ministers of Health and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands would not donate its mpox vaccine stock to Africa for national preparedness reasons, and about the stock size, donations, replenishment and expected use. Minister Agema answered that the stock of about 99,700 vaccines is a safety reserve, that donation is not ruled out but is currently declined, that replenishment depends on manufacturer delivery expected in early 2025, and that the Netherlands contributes EUR 3 million to the WHO response plan.
As I indicated earlier, I have decided not to donate mpox vaccines now because the 100,000 vaccines I have are our safety stock and delivery of new vaccines will only take place in 2025.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik besloten nu geen mpox-vaccins doneren omdat de 100.000 vaccins die ik heb onze veiligheidsvoorraad zijn en levering van nieuwe vaccins pas in 2025 plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar klachten over evangelist Tom de Wal, hij geeft intussen Mercedes CLA en Audi A6 weg'

MPs asked whether faith healer Tom de Wal, who reportedly gives away luxury cars, falls under the Wkkgz, whether his title misleads patients, and whether his foundation's ANBI status fits the public-benefit requirement. The minister said the IGJ has no signals of structurally harmful practices, sees no reason to re-evaluate the rules, considers religious healing protected, and explained that ANBI status is neutrally assessed and the tax authority cannot act on such conduct.
However, I have no concrete signals that this is the case in practice.
Ik heb echter geen concrete signalen dat hiervan sprake is in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht Focus minder op BMI, stellen wetenschappers: ‘Buikvet is een veel betere voorspeller van gezondheidsproblemen’

An MP asked why, despite guidelines naming waist circumference alongside BMI, professionals and the public still focus mainly on BMI, and about health literacy and prevention policy. The state secretary said implementation of waist measurement is being pursued through the sector (PON, Care4Obesity, JOGG, Voedingscentrum, GP practice) and existing policy, without new research or policy changes.
Determining quality standards and care content is up to the field itself.
Het bepalen van kwaliteitsstandaarden en zorginhoud is aan het veld zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen niet klaar voor toestroom van patiënten met meerdere ziekten’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that hospitals are not ready for patients with multiple chronic conditions, poor cooperation between specialists, and the status of a motion on medical generalists. The minister acknowledged fragmented care, pointed to IZA agreements, a new FMS guideline and CGS work, but had no national data on specialist cooperation incidents and only promised to raise the issue with IZA parties.
Given the major challenges for this patient group, I will once again bring the need for good organisation around the multimorbid patient to the attention of the relevant IZA parties.

Gegeven de grote uitdagingen die er liggen voor deze patiëntgroep zal ik de noodzaak voor goede organisatie rond de multimorbide patiënt nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de relevante IZA partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de berichten ‘Rechtszaak om zeldzame gebreken coronavaccin AstraZeneca’ en ‘AstraZeneca trekt coronavaccin wereldwijd terug na bekentenis'

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Medical Care about news reports on lawsuits over rare side effects of the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine and the vaccine's global withdrawal, including vaccination numbers, Lareb reports, TTS cases, and information for citizens. The minister answered that about 1.5 million people received at least one AstraZeneca dose, that 20 Lareb reports showed strong signs of TTS, that the information leaflet was updated in March 2021, and that no information is available on the UK lawsuits.
I have no information about lawsuits against AstraZeneca in the United Kingdom.
Ik heb geen informatie over rechtszaken tegen AstraZeneca in het Verenigd Koninkrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Nieuw beeld van daders seksuele uitbuiting: bijna 90 procent heeft migratieachtergrond en ze vallen na straf terug in oud gedrag’

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked about a report on perpetrators of sexual exploitation (predominantly with migration background, reoffending after sentence), including attention to people with mild intellectual disability, the effects of the LVB policy study, attachment problems in youth care, and further research. The state secretary points to the LVB-proof criminal justice agenda, existing youth care guidelines, planned research and the forthcoming reinforced anti-trafficking action plan, without committing to a new specific measure.
Your House was informed by letter of 23 April about, among other things, the recent research of the National Rapporteur
Uw Kamer is per brief van 23 april jl. geïnformeerd over onder meer het recentelijk onderzoek van de Nationaal Rapporteur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Tielen over de bijschrijfplicht in de horeca

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Tielen asked about the mandatory listing (bijschrijfplicht) of day managers in hospitality licences, including its purpose, costs, screening tools and municipal practice. The Minister answered that the requirement is kept for hospitality businesses under the Alcohol Act, that the Bibob and good-conduct checks justify it, and that the government is still consulting municipalities and KHN on administrative burden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Deel huisartsen zwicht voor druk ouders en scholen bij voorschrijven ADHD-medicatie’

MPs Tielen and Van Eijk asked about reports that some GPs yield to parent and school pressure to prescribe ADHD medication, and about diagnosis and prescription trends, the ADHD misuse programme, referrals to specialist mental health care, and medical certificates. The minister says the government takes pressure on GPs seriously, points to 'Meer Tijd voor de Patiënt', the Gezonde Focus programme (focused mainly on students) and tables of diagnoses, prescriptions and referrals, but does not commit to new research on referral growth or to studying doctors' pressure around medical certificates.
I cannot provide an overview of the number of referrals to specialist mental health care since 2010 broken down by age group.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven over het aantal doorverwijzingen naar de specialistische ggz sinds 2010 uitgesplitst naar leeftijdsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Hermans over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about a report that at least 172 people died from taking suicide powder Middel X, and about prevention, registration and legal options. The minister says the research shows diverse victims, keeps the current access-limiting code rather than tightening it, and promises further study, a Wtl evaluation and changes to forensic autopsy powers.
I do not intend to further tighten the threshold-raising policy.
Gelet hierop ben ik niet voornemens om het drempelverhogend beleid verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Drie doden door ‘soms levensgevaarlijke kruiden’, RIVM waarschuwt’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about deaths linked to herbal supplements, the number and composition of supplements on the market, RIVM risk assessments, labelling rules, and enforcement by the NVWA. The minister answered that the market is too broad to count precisely, that three herbs are under RIVM assessment with a national list extension planned after summer 2024, that labelling and enforcement are in place (21 supplements flagged in 2024 so far), and that the #WeetWatJeSlikt campaign should continue.
Because of the broad definition, the many (online) points of sale and the fast-moving market, it is not possible to attach a number to the number of types of food supplements on the market.
Door de brede definitie, de vele (online) verkooppunten en de sterk bewegende markt, is het niet mogelijk een getal te hangen aan het aantal soorten voedingssupplementen dat op de markt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de visie op geneesmiddeleninformatie voor zorgverleners

MP Tielen asked the minister about signals of a restructuring of the medicines information landscape for healthcare professionals, its consequences for providers, the criteria distinguishing generic from direct decision-support information, alternatives if information becomes scarce, and how private platforms are involved. The minister confirmed the planned shift toward specific, directly applicable information for vulnerable groups, said decisions on subsidies will be taken by a new cabinet from 2026, and stated that medicines information remains broadly available.
There is and will be no risk of too little medicines information being available.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van een risico op te weinig geneesmiddeleninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over “Ik bied u mijn oudere handen aan het bed. Maar waarom moet ik dan opnieuw leren rekenen.”

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the health minister about barriers facing older career changers entering care work, including repeated language and maths requirements for mbo training. The minister agreed that entry should be low-threshold, pointed to certificate modules, exemption rules and TAZ programme steps, and promised a progress report before summer.
It is important that entry into care is as low-threshold as possible, while the quality of care is guaranteed.
Het is van belang dat de (zij)instroom in de zorg zo laagdrempelig mogelijk is, waarbij de kwaliteit van zorg gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over npo-radio1-uitzending van Argos van zaterdag 3 februari jl. en het bericht ‘Negens en tienen voor artsen die dat niet verdienen’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about large hospital differences in complication rates after prostate surgery and about making quality data, such as outcomes and patient experiences, transparently available to patients. The minister agreed patients should have this information, pointed to existing agreements and a pending bill on quality registries, and promised to report on short-term steps around summer.
In the coming period I am examining with IZA parties what is possible to provide patients with more information on quality of care in the short term, and I will urge them to do their best in this.
Ik onderzoek komende periode met IZA partijen wat mogelijk is om patiënten op korte termijn van meer informatie over kwaliteit van zorg te voorzien en spoor hen aan hier het optimale in te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de brief ‘Reactie op verzoek om informatie voorafgaand aan het WGO jeugd 29-01-2024 over de invulling van de taakstelling 511 mln op jeugd (36410-XVI-110)’

Tielen (VVD) asks whether a fuller letter with analyses of measures to fill the 511 million euro youth-care savings will follow, why financial clarity is delayed, what varieties of co-payments were examined, and how treatment duration is being addressed. The Staatssecretaris answers that a co-payment is needed, options depend on future political choices by a new cabinet, the savings are a Rijk responsibility not blocking reforms, several co-payment variants were modelled, and a regional study on treatment duration will be shared around summer.
With a co-payment, various design variants are possible to (partly) fill the 511 million euro savings.
Bij een eigen bijdrage zijn verschillende varianten qua vormgeving mogelijk om de besparing van € 511 mln (deels) in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Zeeuwse GGD wil actie van gemeenten tegen lage vaccinatiegraad kinderen’

MP Tielen asks the State Secretary about the low childhood vaccination rates in Zeeland and nationally, the rise in whooping cough, the 'Vol vertrouwen in vaccinaties' approach, the national dialogue scope, municipal responsibility under the revised Public Health Act, and funding flows to GGDs. The State Secretary answers that the rates are concerning but not a sudden collapse, that RIVM research and the SocioVax programme are underway, that municipalities hold primary responsibility, and that VWS holds no overview of municipal spending on vaccination and youth health care.

Given the division of responsibilities between central government and municipalities, VWS has no overview of how the funds municipalities receive via the Municipal Fund are allocated to youth health care organisations.

VWS heeft gelet op de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling tussen Rijk en gemeenten geen overzicht van de verdeling van middelen, die gemeenten via het Gemeentefonds beschikbaar stellen aan JGZ-organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over de zorg en ondersteuning van ALS-patiënten

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked about difficulties ALS patients face obtaining Wmo care, aids and home adaptations, the use of an ALS protocol by municipalities, and access to specialised client support. Minister Helder acknowledged problems, said municipalities have discretion and VWS lacks oversight of protocol use, and promised to encourage dialogue with the VNG, while defending the existing GCO target groups and noting municipalities' statutory duty to provide client support.
I have no insight into the extent to which this protocol is actually used by municipalities.
Ik heb geen zicht op de mate waarin dit protocol daadwerkelijk door gemeenten wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Strien over Het televisieprogramma ‘The Biohack Project’

MPs Tielen and Van Strien asked whether the NPO programme 'The Biohack Project' spreads misleading, unscientific health claims, whether the presenter's commercial interests matter, and whether the NPO ombudsman or the Commissariaat should act. The State Secretary replied that the broadcaster KRO-NCRV is responsible for content, added a disclaimer and re-edited parts, said the NPO journalistic code does not formally apply to entertainment, and that the Commissariaat does not comment on specific signals or possible investigations.
The Commissariaat does not make statements about how signals are handled or about possible investigations into specific programmes.
Over de afhandeling van signalen en over (mogelijke) onderzoeken naar specifieke programma's doet het Commissariaat geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de HPV-vaccinatie bij mensen ouder dan 27 jaar

An MP asked the state secretary about HPV vaccination effectiveness for people over 27, whether they can get vaccinated, how they are informed, vaccine waste and possible alternative uses for surplus vaccines. The state secretary answered that evidence for over-27s is very limited, that they can be vaccinated at their own expense, that no active outreach occurs, and that surplus vaccines are being considered for alternative uses.

Data on vaccinations given outside the national vaccination programme, for example via the GGD, gynaecologist, urologist or GP, are in most cases not provided to the RIVM, so there is very limited insight into these numbers.

Gegevens over vaccinaties gegeven buiten het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma om, bijvoorbeeld via de GGD («Vaccinaties op maat»), de gynaecoloog, de uroloog of de huisarts, worden in de meeste gevallen niet aan het RIVM verstrekt en om die reden is er maar zeer beperkt inzicht in deze aantallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Tielen over de noodzaak om vaardigheden van ziekenhuisprofessionals actueel te houden en de rol van de subsidieregeling Kwaliteitsimpuls personeel ziekenhuiszorg daarin

MPs Paulusma and Tielen asked why no new KIPZ subsidy regulation for 2024 has been published despite the Integraal Zorgakkoord commitment to keep these funds for medical-specialist care, and how the funds and skills-maintenance goal will be secured. The minister says the 2024 extension carries state-aid risks, so the only way to pay out the full 227.5 million euros is an extension that is admittedly unlawful, with a new framework planned for 2025.

The only option I currently see to make the funds available in full in 2024, in line with the IZA agreement, is, given the state-aid risks, to extend the KIPZ subsidy scheme once in a way that is unlawful.

De enige mogelijkheid die ik op dit moment zie om de middelen conform de IZA afspraak in zijn geheel in 2024 beschikbaar te stellen is het, vanwege de risico's op staatssteun, onrechtmatig eenmalig verlengen van de Subsidieregeling KIPZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Deze goedkope jichtpil bleek goed voor hartpatiënten, maar werd gekaapt door een sluwe farmaceut’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that a US pharmaceutical firm repurposed the cheap gout drug colchicine for heart patients after Dutch-funded research, and about measures to prevent such price abuse. The minister answers that regulatory exclusivity cannot be granted for colchicine, supports EU proposals for repurposed drugs, is exploring incentives and contracts, and will talk with stakeholders.
The requested indication I cannot share, as this is commercially confidential information.
De aangevraagde indicatie kan ik niet delen gezien dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie is.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht: ‘Sinds de ingreep kunnen haar ogen niet meer dicht’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Health about a news report on a cosmetic procedure complication, about the number of cosmetic treatments and complications, IGJ follow-up on reports, the status of the cosmetic care quality framework, and patient information. The Minister answers that complication data are not centrally registered, that IGJ handles most reports via advice and selective risk-based inspection, that the steering group on cosmetic care was dissolved in November 2022, and that patients can find information on government and professional websites.
I do not know how many cosmetic procedures are carried out in the Netherlands each year and how many of these lead to complications.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel cosmetische ingrepen jaarlijks in Nederland worden uitgevoerd en hoeveel daarvan tot complicaties leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht 'Abortusklinieken zien vaker jonge vrouwen die anticonceptie wantrouwen'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that abortion clinics see more young women distrusting hormonal contraception, and whether this leads to unwanted pregnancies and how risks of natural methods are communicated. The minister said the trend is unquantified, that GPs have guidelines covering natural methods, that a ZonMw study on reasons for abortion will report in 2024, and listed existing youth information and education measures.
I am not unaware that there is much talk and writing about the (alleged) side effects of hormonal contraception.
Het is mij niet ontgaan dat er veel gesproken en geschreven wordt over de (vermeende) bijwerkingen van hormonale anticonceptie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Paul over het bericht ‘Kinderen wachten soms langer dan jaar op logopedie: Gevolgen worden onderschat’

MPs Tielen and Paul asked the health and education ministers about reported long waiting lists for speech therapy for children, their causes, administrative burden, the link with school advice, and digital options. Minister Kuipers reported rising waiting lists (half of first-line practices with waits over a year in 2022), said data cannot yet be split further, promised to discuss more intensive supervision with the NZa, and pointed to existing initiatives while giving no firm new measures.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision over speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over de berichten 'Jongeren stellen eigen diagnoses via TikTok: ‘Als je dit herkent heb je ADHD’' en 'De TikTok psycholoog is in opkomst: ‘Als je deze vie

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about news reports on young people self-diagnosing mental health conditions via TikTok and on unreliable 'TikTok psychologist' advice, asking for research on consultations, action against medical misinformation and clearer mental health information for youth. The State Secretary said no data are kept on such consultations and that collecting it would burden professionals, pointed to Digital Services Act obligations on platforms, and announced a study this autumn into a more coherent, findable mental health information offer.
In the RTL Nieuws article, the vice-chair of the NIP states that it is not recorded whether young people more often report to the GP as a result of such videos.
In het artikel van RTL nieuws geeft de vicevoorzitter van het NIP aan dat niet wordt bijgehouden of jongeren zich vaker melden bij de huisarts als gevolg van dergelijke video’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend aniossentekort in ziekenhuizen'

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the government about reported shortages of residents-in-training (aniossen) in hospitals, their working hours, employer responsibilities, and the role of physician assistants and nurse specialists. The minister answered that the Capaciteitsorgaan is researching the issue, that intake of PAs and VSs will be expanded from 2025–2026, and that working conditions and employer responsibility are mainly matters between employers and employees, with initiatives under the TAZ programme.

The Capaciteitsorgaan is currently researching the concrete composition of various groups of basic doctors as well as the reasons why basic doctors do or do not progress to certain postgraduate medical training programmes.

Het Capaciteitsorgaan doet op dit moment onderzoek naar de concrete samenstelling van verschillende groepen basisartsen alsmede de redenen voor het wel of niet doorstromen van basisartsen naar bepaalde geneeskundige vervolgopleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Nieuwe Wet Zeggenschap nog onbekend onder zorgmedewerkers'

MPs Tielen and Ellemeet asked the health minister why only 11 percent of care workers know about the new Wet Zeggenschap (decision-making rights for care staff) and how awareness, action plans and subsidy use are being monitored. The minister acknowledges the need for awareness, points to communication, sector bodies, subsidies and a planned monitor from September 2023, and says the effects will become clearer after the subsidy projects end.
To be able to see the effect of the legal amendment in practice, I agree that awareness of the amendment is a prerequisite.
Om het effect van de wetswijziging in de praktijk terug te kunnen zien ben ik het met u eens dat bekendheid met de wetwijziging voorwaardelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Paul en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Ouders eisen verbod op autismebehandeling voor kinderen'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about reports that parents demand a ban on ABA-based autism treatment for children, including the number of providers, complaints, safety oversight and the evidence base. The government answered that ABA covers many varying treatments, that complaints to the IGJ are limited, that it will commission research into effects on young people, but that it does not support a ban.
I will therefore have research carried out into the impact of ABA and treatments containing ABA elements on young people.
Ik ga daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van ABA en behandelingen waar elementen van ABA in zitten op jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Kinderen moeten langer wachten op plekje in ziekenhuis’
