MP Tielen asked the minister about reports that children wait longer for hospital paediatric care, the national average waiting times compared with before, the role of other domains and the role of insurers in waiting-list mediation. The minister answered that average outpatient waiting in paediatrics is 47 days with wide regional variation, that foreign data were not available, that the NZa's follow-up study on insurer proactivity is being prepared, and that several actions to improve waiting-time transparency and mediation have been taken.
I do not have data on the national average number of referrals.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over het landelijk gemiddelde aan verwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Inspectie: te weinig aandacht ziekenhuizen voor bijverdiensten artsen’

An MP asked the health minister about an IGJ finding that hospitals pay too little attention to doctors' side earnings from industry, and about oversight, definitions of abuse, other enforcement bodies and self-regulation. The minister said the IGJ investigation is ongoing, that new rules on gift-giving and transparency will be shared by year end, and that the self-regulation of the medical sector is no longer sufficient, so a larger government role is needed.
I am awaiting the outcome of this investigation before I can assess how the supervision has proceeded.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af, voor ik kan beoordelen hoe het toezicht is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over Het bericht ‘Onderzoek: patiënten blijven medicijnen doorslikken zonder overleg met arts

An MP asks the Health Minister about a Patient Federation survey finding that many long-term medicine users have little contact with a healthcare provider about their medication, and asks about periodic medication reviews, inspection oversight, and the Optimed method. The minister answers that GPs and pharmacists already conduct medication reviews for targeted groups, that the inspectorate will study review quality and report in December 2023, and that agreements on pharmaceutical care will follow from the Integraal Zorgakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'CBG waarschuwt voor aanhoudend tekort diabetesmedicijn Ozempic'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about shortages of Ozempic linked to off-label use as a weight-loss drug and about monitoring of off-label use. The minister said off-label use is not systematically monitored, that the link to shortages is unclear, and that the Inspectorate is acting against illegal online sales.
Likewise, there is no insight into the extent to which off-label use leads to shortages.
Zo is er ook geen inzicht in de mate waarin off-labelgebruik leidt tot tekorten.
Antwoord op de vragen het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Patiënten ziekenhuis Isala kregen hartapparatuur opgedrongen’

An MP asked the minister about reports that Isala hospital patients were pushed into heart devices, probing financial incentives, fraud, reporting channels, medical specialist companies, ICD guidance and European guidelines. The minister acknowledged concern, pointed to planned integrity legislation and NZa monitoring, and largely deferred implementation to professional bodies and the Zorginstituut.
The supervision by the NZa will be expanded with the bill, so that it can act earlier when conflicting interests are handled in a non-integrity manner.
Het toezicht van de NZa zal met het wetsvoorstel worden verruimd, zodat eerder kan worden opgetreden als bij die omgang met tegenstrijdige belangen sprake is van niet integer gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim nadert hoogst gemeten niveau ooit, vooral in de zorg’

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about rising sickness absence in care, its costs, the role of employer good practice, aggression, and the Veerkracht en Zeggenschap subsidy. The minister said costs data are not held, outlined the TAZ programme and employer-focused measures, and promised an update to Parliament before the summer recess.
I do not have figures on the costs of sickness absence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over de kosten van het ziekteverzuim.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Middel X vaker gebruikt na onthulling werkzame stof’

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked the Minister of Health about a report that use of Middel X rose after the active substance was publicised, and about the effectiveness of the industry code on restricting private sales. The Minister answered that a causal link cannot be established, that legal bans are ineffective and risky, that talks with stakeholders continue, and that the code will be evaluated at end 2023.
The Ministry of VWS continues to talk with field partners to explore whether, and if so which, additional options exist to prevent use of these substances for suicide.
Het Ministerie van VWS blijft wel in gesprek met veldpartijen om te verkennen of en zo ja, welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er zijn om het gebruik van deze stoffen voor suïcide te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Pro-Russische DDoS-aanvallers vallen Nederlandse ziekenhuizen aan'

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health and Justice ministers about reported pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Dutch hospitals, their impact on patients and care continuity, the sector's vital-infrastructure status, scrubbing centres, extending Z-CERT to the whole care sector, and sanctions against the perpetrators. The ministers answered that care continuity was not endangered (only hospital websites were briefly unavailable), that the sector's vital designation and a Z-CERT rollout plan will be reported before summer, that scrubbing is up to each organisation, and that sanctions depend on impact and EU unanimity.
The Minister of Health will inform you by letter before summer about the status of designating the healthcare sector as vital.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u uiterlijk voor de zomer per Kamerbrief informeren over de stand van zaken van het aanwijzen van de zorgsector als vitale sector.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen met betrekking tot geneesmiddelentekorten in Nederland, o.a. via het NOS-bericht ‘Medicijnschaarste opgelopen tot recordhoogte, vorig jaar ruim 1500 tekorten’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about rising medicine shortages in the Netherlands, the outdated shortage monitoring data, the causes of shortages (including the preference policy and the Innogenerics situation), patient impact, and European strategy. The Minister answered that the shortage working group continues to meet, that causes are multifactorial and hard to quantify, that the stock norm took effect in January 2023, and that work on EU supply security and domestic production capacity is ongoing.
It is not possible to state precisely what impact this has had on the expansion of medicine stocks.
Het is niet mogelijk om precies aan te geven welke impact dit op de verruiming van de geneesmiddelvoorraden heeft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de kabinetsreactie 'Terugkoppeling IPCR en vervolgproces' van 5 januari 2023

MP Tielen asks the health minister how far EU IPCR encouragements on China travel count as commitments, why the Eerste Kamer must urgently treat the Wet publieke gezondheid amendment, which provisions are needed and whether existing powers already suffice. The minister replies that no binding commitments were made, that the amendment is needed because no legal basis currently allows a testing obligation for travellers from China, and that existing powers in articles 48-57 address ports and airports, not travellers.
At present there is no legal basis for imposing a testing obligation or another collective measure.
Op dit moment ontbreekt een wettelijke grondslag om een testverplichting of een andere collectieve maatregel in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Omtzigt over de kabinetsreactie ‘Bijeenkomst EU Health Security Committee d.d. 29 december’

Two MPs asked the health minister about the EU Health Security Committee meeting of 29 December, China's COVID data sharing, travel testing, surveillance and sequencing, and whether Dutch measures would follow other EU states. The minister answered that the meeting helped coordination, that China's data remain insufficient, that wastewater surveillance around Schiphol was intensified and a pre-departure testing requirement was introduced, while refusing to commit to further measures or to release scenarios in full.
I am of the view that the meeting of 29 December contributed to this.
Ik ben van mening dat de bijeenkomst van 29 december jl. hieraan heeft bijgedragen.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Hoe inhalige cardiologen een zorginfarct veroorzaakten in het Isala-ziekenhuis’

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report on conflicts of interest among cardiologists at Isala hospital, asking about oversight, whether such practices occur elsewhere, and how transparency could be improved. The minister said the situation is worrying, the hospital board intervened, the IGJ sees no current quality risk, and pointed to the Wibz bill, expanded NZa supervision, and a pending decision on transparency measures.

I expect that those involved, for example in hospitals and medical-specialist organisations, are particularly alert to such situations following this reporting and will act and take measures where necessary.

Ik verwacht dat betrokkenen, bijvoorbeeld in ziekenhuizen en medisch-specialistische organisaties, mede naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving extra alert zijn op dit soort situaties en daar waar nodig optreden en maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Nederlanders hebben minder vertrouwen in vaccinaties’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a European survey showing lower Dutch trust in vaccines, and about vaccination rates, youth-group differences, and campaigns. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a planned trust monitor and a RIVM pulse survey, and said it is too early to judge the effect on vaccination uptake.
I attach great importance to vaccinations and to achieving the highest possible vaccination rate.
Ik hecht zeer aan het belang van vaccinaties en het behalen van een zo hoog mogelijke vaccinatiegraad.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Losser testbeleid in ziekenhuizen’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that some hospitals let staff with mild COVID symptoms keep working, and about the reliability of self-tests and the role of care workers and works councils. The minister answered that hospitals may deviate from the RIVM advice under the FMS guideline when care continuity is at risk, that the IGJ can ask boards to justify such decisions, and that the DB advises relaxing testing for care staff.
If there are signals that employers are not acting in line with the guideline, care workers can report this to the IGJ.
Indien er signalen zijn dat werkgevers niet handelen conform de leidraad, dan kunnen zorgmedewerkers een melding doen bij de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Het Transitieteam kreeg lucht van een geheime vaccinatiecampagne’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a satirical article claiming the COVID-19 autumn booster campaign was largely under the radar, and about low booster uptake among people who benefit from it. The minister rejected the 'under the radar' characterisation, citing letters to 7.6 million people, broad media campaigns and 85% awareness, and promised further data and updates on the public dialogue.
I therefore disagree with the characterisation that the autumn vaccination round was 'entirely under the radar'.
Ik ben het daarom niet eens met de kwalificatie dat de najaarsvaccinatieronde «geheel onder de radar» zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Wetenschappers vragen kabinet om steun bij voorbereiding op volgende pandemie'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report urging preparation for future pandemics, including data sharing between researchers, use of care experience in policy advice, wastewater surveillance, and data linkage. The minister acknowledged data-sharing bottlenecks being addressed, rejected the claim that sampling is too sparse, and pointed to ongoing data-linkage plans and the Wegiz, which does not yet cover RIVM.
I recently informed you about the elaboration of the policy programme, for which the KNAW report is an important source of inspiration.
Ik heb u recent geïnformeerd over de uitwerking van het beleidsprogramma, waar het rapport van de KNAW een belangrijke inspiratie voor vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Wasserijen in de problemen, dus de zorg ook'

An MP asks the health minister about the risk that energy-intensive laundries (wasserijen) shutting down due to high energy prices could disrupt hospital care, and what oversight and measures exist. The minister acknowledges the risk, points to zorgverzekeraars' role and the NZa's supervision of their care obligation, and reports that tariffs for 2023 are being updated using the CPB MEV forecast, while answering the concrete monitoring question only by reference to a letter.

As also indicated in the letter of 17 October, in September I made a specific request to the NZa to update all regulated tariffs, budgets and reimbursement amounts for 2023 under the Health Insurance Act and the Long-term Care Act.

Zoals ook in de brief van 17 oktober jl. aangegeven, heb ik in september een specifiek verzoek gedaan aan de NZa om alle gereguleerde tarieven, budgetten en vergoedingsbedragen in de Zorgverzekeringswet en de Wet langdurige zorg voor 2023 te actualiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over draagvlak voor de modernisering van het Geneesmiddelvergoedingssysteem (GVS)

An MP asked the minister about professional opposition to the planned GVS medicine reimbursement modernisation, its cost-benefit balance and how public support is considered. The minister acknowledges critical signals, postpones implementation to 2024, argues structural savings outweigh one-off costs, and commits to continued engagement with stakeholders.
I also ensured timely publication of the new reimbursement limits (in draft), partly at the request of stakeholders.
Ik heb ook gezorgd voor tijdige publicatie van de nieuwe vergoedingslimieten (in concept), mede op verzoek van veldpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Toezichthouder: inhaalzorg na corona blijft een probleem'

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about reports that about 120,000 patients still await postponed treatment and why the waiting lists have not fallen, and about the use of capacity in independent clinics and German hospitals. The minister answered that waiting lists remain high, pointed to staff absence and capacity limits, and listed actions such as waiting-list apps, NZa inspections of insurers, and a review of privacy rules for referral mediation.
I will inform you shortly by letter about the state of affairs regarding postponed care and the progress on the administrative agreements.
Ik informeer u op korte termijn per brief over de stand van zaken uitgestelde zorg en de voortgang op de bestuurlijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Opnieuw problemen bij Philips: sommige maskers gevaarlijk voor mensen met pacemakers'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about new Philips mask problems that may be dangerous for patients with pacemakers, the slow recall of Philips sleep apnea devices in the Netherlands, and trust in medical technology. The Minister answered that IGJ is monitoring Philips' improvement plan, that no Dutch incidents with the masks are known and a replacement option was offered instead of a full recall, and that EU regulations and safety frameworks apply, while stating limited direct influence over the company's operations.
The IGJ is currently intensively monitoring the intended improvements.
De IGJ monitort op dit moment intensief de beoogde verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van der Woude over de bestrijding van het apenpokkenvirus in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister how the mpox response is being run, why vaccination is slow, whether people self-assessing risk can be vaccinated, and about sequencing, treatment supply and communication. The minister answered that the response follows expert advice, that roughly half the target group has been vaccinated, that testing capacity is sufficient, and that treatment supply is limited and reliant on EU cooperation, without committing to new measures.
If the vaccination rate is lower than expected, it will be examined what barriers exist and how these can be reduced.
Als de vaccinatiegraad lager is dan verwacht, wordt gekeken welke drempels er zijn en hoe deze verminderd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht over ‘Commercieel softwarebedrijf schendt jarenlang de privacy van tienduizenden patiënten"

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about a Follow the Money report that a commercial software company had for years breached the privacy of tens of thousands of patients and GP medical confidentiality. The minister answered that the case is known to the ministry, that the Data Protection Authority is examining it, that data-protection rules already apply, and that efforts to improve compliance and the Wegiz bill will address such problems, without committing to new specific measures.
The AP in principle makes no statements about individual reports and cases in the context of possible investigation.
Over individuele meldingen en zaken doet de AP in het kader van eventueel onderzoek in principe geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Mogelijke corruptie in Zwols Isala-ziekenhuis groter dan gedacht’

MPs Tielen and Van Wijngaarden asked about possible corruption at Isala hospital and the roles of internal and external supervisors, reporting channels, further integrity instruments, and the Court of Audit's view on fraud oversight. The minister explained the existing supervisory framework (supervisory boards, NZa, IGJ, Governance Code Zorg 2022), said she has no overview of whipblower-channel numbers, and pointed to a forthcoming letter on the transformation of medical specialist companies.

I do not have an overview of the number of care providers that have a confidential person as a reporting point for deviant behaviour or integrity concerns, nor of the number of reports that reach the external supervisor via such a reporting point.

Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal zorgaanbieders dat beschikt over een vertrouwenspersoon als meldpunt voor afwijkend gedrag of zorg over integriteit dan wel van het aantal meldingen dat via een meldpunt bij de externe toezichthouder terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het artikel 'Website voor registreren coronazelftest van de baan'

An MP asked why the government will not open a reporting portal for positive self-test results, despite OMT advice and the role of such data in monitoring the virus. The minister answered that the portal was dropped due to unreliable representativeness and unclear legal basis, that other surveillance tools suffice, and that the portal could be revisited if needed.
Should a self-reporting portal prove necessary in the future after all, action can still be taken on it.
Mocht een zelfmeldportaal in de toekomst toch nodig blijken te zijn, dan kan hier alsnog op geacteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Niet alleen maar specialisten in het ziekenhuis'

MPs Tielen and Van den Hil asked the health minister about a newspaper report on hospital doctors treating patients outside their specialism, the case for generalist hospital doctors, and funding for that training. The minister said no data exist on multimorbidity cases or on specialists leaving the profession, and that the evaluation did not justify structural funding for the hospital doctor training from the availability contribution.
I do not have data on how often this occurs.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoe vaak dit zich voordoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht 'Medisch toerisme in de lift, maar ingrepen niet zonder risico: Deel van mijn wangen voel ik niet meer

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the health minister about reports of risky cosmetic surgery abroad, including whether intermediary agencies misinforming consumers can be tackled, registration of complications, and consumer information. The minister answered that such agencies fall under IGJ supervision only when they deliver care under the Wkkgz, that civil courts remain open otherwise, that no national registry of foreign complications exists, and that consumers bear responsibility while the government refers them to an online information website.
Travel brokerage and offering websites showing which operations are possible abroad are not care within the meaning of the Wkkgz and therefore also do not fall under IGJ supervision.

Reisbemiddeling en het aanbieden van websites waarop te zien is welke operaties in het buitenland mogelijk zijn, zijn geen zorg in de zin van de Wkkgz en vallen daarom ook niet onder toezicht van de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Zorgpremies schieten omhoog vanaf volgend jaar'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about press reports of sharp health insurance premium rises, the cost picture for households, the causes of rising health spending and premiums, and whether the corona catastrophe scheme affected premiums. The Minister answered that premium estimates are still too uncertain, attributed the increases largely to wage and price growth and health spending, noted that the coalition's savings measures are included, and said low-income households are compensated via the healthcare allowance.
Not much meaningful can yet be said about the premium development in the coming years.
Over de premieontwikkeling in de komende jaren valt nog niet veel zinnigs te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Ook samenleving zelf moet zich voorbereiden op nieuwe coronagolf’

An MP asks the health minister how society and organisations can prepare for a new COVID wave, given the scaled-back testing and contact-tracing tools, and about readiness of GGDs and hospitals. The minister responds that the government has scenario-based preparations, a sectoral approach, scalable testing and vaccination capacity, and a planned advisory report on the CoronaMelder app, but offers limited concrete detail on some points.
As promised to your House, I will further explore the future use of CoronaMelder in combination with self-tests.
Zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer 4 zal ik de toekomstige inzet van CoronaMelder, in combinatie met zelftesten, nader verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Monkeypox cases confirmed in England-latest updates'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about monkeypox cases in England, including notification duties, symptoms, monitoring, sequencing, European coordination and preparedness. The Minister answered all seven questions in substance, describing category A notification, contact tracing, sequencing capacity and EU coordination, without withholding information or committing to a new investigation.
From 21 May, monkeypox has been designated by ministerial regulation as a category A notifiable disease.
Met ingang van 21 mei jl. is apenpokken bij ministeriële regeling aangemerkt als meldingsplichtige ziekte categorie A.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘GGD wil binnen een paar weken duidelijkheid over toekomst test- en prikstraten’

MP Tielen asked the minister about GGD plans for test and vaccination capacity, the Aanpak Najaar 2022 and sequencing of variants. The minister answered that self-tests remain the starting point, outlined vaccination scale-up plans, and promised a letter to parliament in June with further elaboration.
I intend to send parliament a letter in June with a further elaboration on some parts.
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer in juni een brief te sturen met op onderdelen een nadere uitwerking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Door uitblijven coronastrategie komt lockdown weer in beeld’

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a risk of a lockdown from a lack of a corona strategy, the National Care Reserve, sick-leave prevention, workforce efficiency and labour-saving innovation. The minister answered that the reserve is still being developed, that the government will update parliament in summer, and listed existing measures and programmes without giving firm new deadlines or commitments on the substance.
At present the legal, implementation and financial questions of the National Care Reserve (as a public task) are being further worked out.
Op dit moment worden de juridische, de uitvoeringstechnische en de financiële vraagstukken van de Nationale Zorgreserve (als een publieke taak) nader uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht over een mogelijk Europees patiëntendossier

Two MPs from the VVD asked the health minister whether a reported European patient record proposal was behind the postponement of the Wegiz bill and whether it solves any urgent European problem. The minister confirmed the postponement was prompted by the Commission's proposal on a European health data space, stressed it does not create a European patient file, and deferred the appreciation and the stakeholder assessment to a forthcoming BNC fiche.
Under the information agreements, the cabinet will inform the House about its assessment of the proposals by means of a BNC fiche.
De Kamer zal volgens de informatieafspraken geïnformeerd worden door het kabinet over de appreciatie van de voorstellen middels een BNC fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Plan voor aparte covid-ic’s komt niet van de grond’

MPs Tielen and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about reports that plans for separate COVID intensive care units had stalled and about the status of a motion on COVID care capacity. The minister answered that an expert team is advising on concentrating COVID care within a wider review, that a prior pilot was dropped because too few COVID patients were in intensive care, and that the initiators of a Amsterdam pilot own its final report and decide whether to publish it.
The report is the property of the initiators, who decide whether to make it public.
Het verslag is eigendom van de initiatiefnemers, aan wie een oordeel toekomt over het al dan niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Wijngaarden over de beschikbaarheid van 'Middel X'

MPs Tielen and Van Wijngaarden asked the Minister of Health about the availability of the suicide substance 'Middel X' after a police officer fell ill in an Arnhem home where it was found, and about the effectiveness of the 2018-2019 chemical sector code and any illegal market, and whether a 'proeftuin' for the Coöperatie Laatste Wil could be considered. The Minister said the risk to responders is very limited and the substances are not banned, that barrier-raising policy and the voluntary code are in place though effectiveness is hard to quantify, and that the 'proeftuin' request was declined given the demissionary cabinet and current policy.
Yes, I am aware of this.
Ja, hier ben ik bekend mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over medische zorg en vaccinatie t.b.v. vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked the Health Minister and Justice State Secretary how medical care and vaccination for Ukrainian refugees is arranged in other European countries and in the Netherlands, including access for those arriving independently. The minister replied that many EU states link care to existing asylum schemes or adopt special rules, that the ministry coordinates with GGD, GHOR, COA and others, and referred to earlier correspondence on vaccination; care is available via the local GP and COVID vaccination without registration, while costs for non-working, non-asylum Ukrainians are covered by an SOV subsidy limited to basic-package care.
Anyone in the Netherlands who needs acute medical care can go to the local GP, including Ukrainians who arrive on their own.
Iedere persoon in Nederland die acute medische zorg nodig heeft kan zich melden bij de plaatselijke dokter, dus ook Oekraïners die op eigen gelegenheid naar Nederland komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar voor cyberaanval: Wachten totdat het misgaat’

MPs Rajkowski and Tielen asked the health minister about reports that Dutch hospitals remain vulnerable to cyberattacks and that the sector lags behind, including what the IGJ found about information security. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, that data on attacks is not systematically recorded, that the IGJ found over half of inspected hospitals lacked independent NEN 7510 assessments which were then required, and that Z-CERT support and sector measures will be expanded, with a further letter promised.
It is not known exactly how many healthcare institutions were affected by cyberattacks in 2021, 2020 and 2019.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel zorginstellingen in 2021, 2020 en 2019 precies geraakt zijn door cyberaanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Romke de Jong, Tielen en Aartsen over de signalen die zij ontvangen m.b.t. de steunmaatregelen voor zzp’ers

MPs asked whether municipalities impose wealth and viability tests on self-employed applicants for support beyond what the government intends, and about income losses and reskilling. The minister acknowledges reports of excessive information requests, says municipalities have decentralised responsibility and are being asked to limit requests to what is necessary, and largely defends the simplified Bbz scheme without reinstating the earlier TOZO.

Where signals reach the ministry that municipalities are requesting too much information, this is investigated, and if unnecessary information is indeed requested, the VNG is asked to contact the municipality concerned.

Daar waar bij het ministerie signalen binnenkomen dat gemeenten (te)veel informatie zouden uitvragen, wordt dit uitgezocht en als blijkt dat er inderdaad onnodige informatie wordt uitgevraagd, wordt de VNG verzocht contact hierover op te nemen met de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Zieke uitzendkrachten worden ontslagen, terwijl dat wettelijk niet mag’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that sick temporary agency workers are dismissed via the agency clause, despite the statutory ban on dismissal during illness, and about UWV's handling of such cases. The State Secretary answered that the clause may currently be invoked, UWV does not yet change its practice pending a Supreme Court ruling, and that the Commission Regulation of Work's advice to ban it during illness will be considered later, without committing to a proposal now.
The Employee Insurance Agency (UWV) does not yet adjust its implementation practice following the Court of Appeal of The Hague ruling, partly because it is awaiting the Supreme Court ruling.

Het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) past de uitvoeringspraktijk vooralsnog niet aan naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag, mede omdat er gewacht wordt op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Zoveel banen en toch niet aan de bak: voldoe niet aan profiel’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a news report of a 60-year-old long-term unemployed woman rejected for not fitting a 'profile', and whether this masks age, gender or ethnic discrimination. The State Secretary cited research on perceived discrimination, said the government will not yet judge the specific case, pointed to its anti-discrimination action plan and a bill on equal opportunities in recruitment, and described re-integration and training support for older jobseekers.
For now I refrain from an opinion on the appearance of age discrimination in this case, because a complete picture of the facts and circumstances is lacking.
Vooralsnog onthoud ik mij van een opvatting over de schijn van leeftijdsdiscriminatie in de onderhavige casus, omdat een volledig beeld van de feiten en omstandigheden ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Veel laaggeletterden stopten met taal- of rekencursus tijdens corona’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education about a report showing many low-literate adults stopped language or numeracy courses during the coronavirus pandemic, and whether the government would investigate, provide devices, reach out proactively and coordinate better with municipalities. The Minister answered that the report is sufficient so no new study is planned, gave a delayed interim evaluation timeline (end 2022), pointed to existing device initiatives, campaigns, subsidies and cooperation efforts, and said monitoring of course effectiveness is not yet feasible.
At present it is unfortunately not feasible to monitor nationally the effectiveness of matching, because there is not yet uniformity in recording and monitoring the data.
Het is op dit moment helaas niet haalbaar om de effectiviteit van matching landelijk te monitoren, omdat er (nog) geen eenduidigheid is in het vastleggen en monitoren van gegevens.
Antwoord op van het lid Tielen over personeelstekorten en signalen over de werkwijze van UWV met betrekking tot WW’ers die zich om (willen) scholen naar een tekortberoep

MP Tielen asks the minister whether UWV proactively directs WW benefit recipients with limited education or surplus occupations toward short retraining for shortage occupations, how regional mobility teams and employers are involved, what criteria apply to training and exemption from the job-search obligation, and about administrative burdens on training providers. The minister replies that UWV contributes to matching, denies that proactive referral is absent, describes training arrangements, mobility teams, inkoopkader criteria, and data on training budget approvals, and says UWV keeps consulting providers.
I will inform your House in mid-September in more detail about the progress of the rollout of the regional mobility teams.
Ik zal uw Kamer medio september nader informeren over de voortgang van de uitrol van de regionale mobiliteitsteams.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Restaurants dicht door corona maar toch 500 Aziatische koks uit het buitenland gehaald’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that about 500 Asian cooks were brought from abroad under the residence-and-work permit scheme despite restaurant closures, asking for permit numbers, revocations, undocumented cooks, and whether the scheme should be suspended. The Minister gave detailed figures, reported signals of abuse such as payments to intermediaries and fake cook certificates, and announced the scheme will be closed to new cooks while its future is examined.

The proposed change will mean that, while it is examined whether the scheme can revive in a tightened form or be permanently abolished, cooks who are not already lawfully resident in the Netherlands under this scheme can no longer successfully invoke it.

De voorgenomen wijziging zal inhouden dat het, terwijl wordt onderzocht of de regeling in aangescherpte vorm kan herleven of definitief komt te vervallen, niet meer mogelijk is voor koks die niet reeds op grond van deze regeling rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven, om een geslaagd beroep te doen op de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen van ondernemers m.b.t. de derden- en accountantsverklaring bij de vaststelling van de NOW-regeling

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about SME complaints over the costs and complexity of derden- and accountantsverklaringen required to settle NOW wage subsidies, and how many firms are affected. The Minister answered that roughly 10% of NOW1 applicants need an accountant's statement, that the requirement and thresholds are kept with some relief measures, and that the ministry will reduce administrative burdens while retaining controls.
I have not yet received signals that significantly more companies will have to submit an accountant's statement than previously estimated.
Ik heb nog geen signalen ontvangen dat significant meer bedrijven een accountantsverklaring zullen moeten overleggen dan voorheen was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de keuringsstop bij het UWV

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV has effectively stopped carrying out first-year sick-leave assessments (EZWb), leaving thousands of employees and employers in limbo, and asks about backlog size, criteria, damage and remedies. The Minister confirms the backlog (about 23,473 EZWb cases, up 61% on 2020), admits only about 75% of assessments were carried out in early 2021, attributes this to a staff mismatch, and promises a two-year trial of new working methods without a concrete deadline for clearing the backlog.
In 25% of cases employees went through the entire waiting period without an EZWb assessment taking place.
In 25% van de gevallen hebben werknemers de gehele wachttijd doorlopen zonder dat er een EZWb heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Tielen over een bericht op Nu.nl met de titel ‘Sportclubs lopen miljoenen euro’s mis door ‘weeffout’ in NOW regels’

MPs Heerema and Tielen asked whether the NOW 3 wage-subsidy rule, which uses June 2020 as the reference month, unfairly excludes sports clubs and seasonal employers, and whether it can be fixed as was done for NOW 1 and 2. The minister defends June as the reference month to limit abuse and operational risk, says changing it now is not feasible, notes that some sports clubs can claim through the TASO scheme instead, and does not provide the requested data on rejected applications.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over “signalen van kleine werkgevers die recht hebben op compensatie voor de transitievergoeding, maar niet in staat zijn de transitievergoeding vóór te financieren”

MPs Tielen and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small employers unable to prefinance the transition payment (transitievergoeding) for dismissals after long-term illness, and whether UWV could advance compensation. The Minister acknowledged the problems but refused to change the compensation schemes or allow UWV advance payments, citing legal and administrative complications, and said the start date of the illness-based scheme is not yet known.
However, it is not yet possible at this time to indicate when the compensation scheme for business termination due to illness of the employer can enter into force.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven wanneer de compensatieregeling bedrijfsbeëindiging wegens ziekte in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Wiersma over het artikel 'Soms blijkt een diploma van leerfabriek NCOI bitter weinig waard'

MPs Tielen and Wiersma (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a Trouw article on the limited value of NCOI diplomas, the scarcity of modular adult education, NVAO and inspectorate roles, and corona rules for distance learning. The minister answered that flexibilisation measures are underway, that the inspectorate is investigating NCOI's diploma claims with results expected before summer 2021, and that modular accreditation questions are deferred to a later cabinet.
Supervision of compliance with laws and regulations is after all assigned to the inspectorate.
Het toezicht op naleving van wet- en regelgeving is immers belegd bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Palland en Bruins over signalen vanuit de Industriecoalitie m.b.t. de regelingen Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO)

MPs Tielen, Palland and Bruins asked whether the government is aware of the Industriecoalitie's signals that LLO schemes are fragmented, favour surplus sectors over shortage sectors, and are hard to scale or combine with modular training. The minister acknowledged the consultations and defended the existing complementary schemes, promising evaluation and sector-led plans without committing to a structural redesign.
The starting point is that people can receive support depending on their position and needs.
Het uitgangspunt is dat mensen, afhankelijk van hun positie en behoefte, ondersteuning kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers verbaasd over minieme betalingskorting Belastingdienst’

MPs Lodders and Tielen (VVD) asked why the payment discount on the 2021 provisional income tax assessment was almost nil, since it is tied to the temporarily lowered collection interest rate. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the link is set by law, that the Belastingdienst cannot decouple it without a system change not possible before 2023, that the rate returns to 4% from 2022, and that the communication could have explained the reason more clearly in the letter.

It would have been better to state directly in the text, after the sentence 'When paying the total assessment in one go you receive a payment discount of (PM)', why the discount is lower this year than normal.

Het was beter geweest meteen in de tekst, na de zin «Bij betaling in één keer van de totale aanslag krijgt u een betalingskorting van (PM)» aan te geven waarom de betalingskorting dit jaar lager is dan normaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de arbeidsmarkt in Limburg

MPs Tielen and Nijkerken-de Haan asked about support for around 750 VDL Nedcar workers facing dismissal in Limburg, including reemployment, training and regional labour-market coordination. The minister answered that UWV, the regional labour-market partners and staffing agencies are supporting workers, that extra crisis reemployment funds and regional mobility teams are being set up, and that platforms and training schemes are available.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het bericht 'NBBU en SoloPartners dringen er bij zorginstellingen op aan de zorgbonus voor uitzendkrachten en zzp’ers alsnog ter beschikking te stellen'

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether the COVID-19 care bonus is genuinely open to temporary agency workers and self-employed care workers, and whether institutions are being pressed to apply for them. The ministers answer that the bonus is contract-neutral, that GGZ Nederland's earlier advice was a misunderstanding, that about a third of applicant institutions applied for third parties, and that the application window was extended.
The final figures will be compiled in the coming weeks.
De definitieve cijfers worden de komende weken opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Tielen over NL Leert Door

MPs Smeulders and Tielen asked why the NL Leert Door development-advice scheme filled almost 50,000 applications within a day of reopening, what criteria and follow-up data exist, and how to avoid a gap in provision. Minister Koolmees answered that demand is high, an effect evaluation starts in 2021, budget covers 77,000 trajectories, and alternative routes (SLIM, sectoral schemes, a structural scheme from 2022) will fill gaps.
During 2021 an effect evaluation will be started to determine the effects, efficiency and effectiveness of the various measures in the NL Leert Door package.

In de loop van 2021 zal er een effectevaluatie worden gestart om in beeld te brengen wat de effecten, doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid van de verschillende maatregelen uit het pakket NL leert door zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Tielen over het bericht dat de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) de bestuurlijke afspraken over laaggeletterdheid heeft opgezegd

MPs Kwint and Tielen asked why the VNG terminated the administrative agreements on functional illiteracy, whether the budget is adequate, and what this means for quality labels, regional plans and digitalisation. The Minister of Education answers that the budget is supplemented by about €125 million under Tel mee met Taal, that the agreements are too recent to evaluate, that new agreements are being negotiated with municipalities, and that a further letter will follow on quality and the Leesoffensief.
That is why, in implementation of the Tielen-Kwint motion, I am in discussion with municipalities to reach new agreements.
Daarom ben ik, ter uitvoering van de motie Tielen-Kwint, in gesprek met gemeenten om tot nieuwe afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat de scholingspot van 'NL leert door' leeg is

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the 'NL leert door' training scheme ran out of funds and the advice portal closed, and about how training budgets are targeted by education level and shortage sectors. The minister confirmed 22,000 advice applications, said the portal reopens on 1 December 2020, and explained the budget logic and planned communication, without committing to sector or education-level targets.
At this moment there is still no insight into the occupational level of the participants or the sectors in which they work.
Op dit moment is er nog geen inzicht in beroepsniveau van de deelnemers of de sectoren waarin zij werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over terugvordering door het UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about large UWV reclaims of benefits (e.g. a 27,000 euro claim with six weeks to repay), how such overpayments arise and go undetected, repayment terms, protocols, and numbers of claims. The minister answered in detail on claim volumes, the statutory six-week payment term, available payment arrangements and debt relief, and said he is willing to examine extending the one-year repayment term.
I am therefore willing to examine whether it is opportune to extend this term.
Ik ben daarom bereid te bezien of het opportuun is deze termijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat een camping 20.000 UWV-brieven heeft ontvangen voor onbekende Polen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a holiday park received about 20,000 UWV letters for unknown Polish residents, suggesting benefit fraud, and asks whether this points to fraud and why it went unnoticed. The minister explains the misdelivery largely stems from missing house-number additions, describes an ongoing criminal and administrative investigation that prevents disclosure of details, and outlines fraud-prevention measures and a broader address-check programme.
Regarding this ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit – lopende – onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen van bedrijven die vastlopen in de NOW-procedure, terwijl de regeling wel voor hun bedoeld lijkt te zijn

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about businesses that got stuck in the NOW emergency wage subsidy procedure, including startup rules, administrative mismatches and long objection waiting times. The minister said some problems are being fixed, but defended the automated process, rejected a separate counter for hardship cases, and pointed to the objection procedure and UWV monitoring.
Nevertheless, such problems cannot be prevented because it is not possible for UWV to check for every employer from which moment revenue was actually generated.
Het is evenwel niet mogelijk dergelijke problematiek te voorkomen omdat het voor UWV niet mogelijk is om voor elke werkgever na te gaan vanaf welk moment daadwerkelijk omzet is gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het artikel ‘Zzp’er in de zorg niet duurder dan medewerker in loondienst

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether they agree that self-employed (zzp) care workers cost institutions no more than employees, and why the government is negative about zzp'ers, along with questions on care labour shortages, a motion on worker involvement, and a bonus for self-employed workers during COVID-19. The minister answers that cost comparisons rest on unsubstantiated assumptions and that balance between flexible and permanent staff matters, promising further study, a progress report in September, and a bonus application window opening 1 October 2020.
In my view, this balance is currently insufficient.
Naar mijn mening is deze balans er momenteel onvoldoende.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over intensivecare-verpleegkundigen (ic) naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Gelderlander van 18 juli 2020: ‘Ruim 10 procent ic-verpleegkundigen Radboudumc Nijmegen

MPs Tielen and Regterschot (VVD) asked ministers about the high departure rate of intensive care nurses at Radboudumc, whether it is an outlier, and about projected nurse outflow, training places, returning former staff and anaesthesia workers. Minister De Jonge replied that a 10% employer outflow is normal and national, that the figures are not comparable to the reported ones, and pointed to the Capaciteitsplan, retention measures, returning-staff schemes and a pending study and advice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Piek ziekteverzuim zet ondernemers voor het blok'

Conservative MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports of record sick-leave in the first quarter of 2020, asking about non-illness absences, responsibility of employers and social partners for COVID-era work arrangements, premium effects, and costs for SMEs. The minister answered that no central data exist on non-illness absences (a TNO survey is planned), that employers, employees and sector bodies share responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that premiums are only indirectly affected, and that central cost data are unavailable.
There is currently no figure data available on the number of sick notifications and other reasons for being unable to work as a result of the corona crisis.
Er is momenteel echter geen cijfermateriaal beschikbaar van het aantal ziekmeldingen en andere redenen voor het niet kunnen werken als gevolg van de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over een uitspraak van de hoogste Franse rechter over platformorganisatie Uber

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a French Cour de cassation ruling treating Uber drivers as employees, its relation to EU Court case law, comparability with Dutch law, and EU-level engagement. The minister answered that the French ruling resembles Dutch criteria but legal systems differ, that EU developments will be followed, and that the government is pursuing clarity on employee-versus-self-employed status through a consultation, a web module and a forthcoming response to an advisory commission.
The demarcation between employees and self-employed has priority for the cabinet.
De afbakening tussen werknemers en zelfstandigen heeft namelijk prioriteit voor het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over uitspraken van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie m.b.t. grensarbeid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the implications of recent EU Court of Justice rulings, notably Vester, for cross-border workers' disability benefits and pension/income gaps. The Minister answered that UWV will shorten the WIA waiting period where a Vester-type income gap arises, and will consult Belgian and German authorities on age-related gaps, but gave no figures on how many are affected.
No figures are available on the number of cross-border workers resident in the Netherlands who face one of the aforementioned income gaps.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar betreffende het aantal in Nederland woonachtige grensarbeiders dat geconfronteerd wordt met een van de voormelde inkomenshiaten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Utrechtse arbeidsmarkt minder hard geraakt dan andere regio’s'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report saying the Utrecht labour market was less hard hit by COVID-19 than other regions, and asked for regional UWV data, explanations, past research, regional NOW/Tozo use, and regional involvement in support platforms. The minister answered substantively, providing the UWV publication, sector and structural explanations, lessons from past crises, a regional NOW overview, a note that Tozo cannot yet be broken down regionally, and a description of the NLWerktDoor and NL Leert Door platforms.
The use of the Tozo cannot yet be made regionally transparent at this time.
Het gebruik van de Tozo is op dit moment nog niet regionaal inzichtelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Tielen over de toepassing van de NOW bij payrollbedrijven

MPs Van Weyenberg and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the NOW wage subsidy applies to payroll and temp agencies whose workers cannot work because of COVID-19 closures, including dismissal procedures, invoicing of closed-sector clients, and possible contract dissolution. The minister confirmed payroll firms can apply for NOW as employers with 20% or more turnover loss, explained UWV assesses dismissal requests based on conditions at the client, and largely left invoicing and contract issues to the parties themselves, calling on them to talk.
Due to the sector classification used in the wage declaration, it is not possible to determine how many payroll companies have applied for a NOW subsidy.
Door de sectorindeling die in de loonaangifte geldt is het niet mogelijk om na te gaan hoeveel payrollbedrijven een NOW-subsidie hebben aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat keuringen voor de WIA en Wajong telefonisch worden afgehandeld

An MP asked the minister whether UWV disability assessments for WIA and Wajong are being done by phone during the Covid-19 crisis, and whether this risks wrongful decisions and people left without income. The minister answered that most assessments still include a physical consultation with exceptions, that UWV decides substantively where possible and otherwise postpones assessments without advances for WIA claims, and that safeguards include supervision by registered physicians.
To guarantee continuity and income security, UWV chooses where possible to issue substantive decisions.
Om continuïteit en inkomenszekerheid te garanderen kiest UWV er voor om waar mogelijk inhoudelijke besluiten af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over het bericht ‘Vrouwen willen wél meer werken in de zorg: oplossing voor personeelstekort?’

MPs Tielen and Regterschot asked the ministers about a report showing many part-time care workers want more hours, and whether employers and government are doing enough to act on this instead of only recruiting. Minister De Jonge answered that increasing part-time hours is one solution direction, that the government supports the Het Potentieel Pakken foundation, and that a response to the motion on temporary contract-hour expansion will follow in the IBO Deeltijdwerk reaction due this winter.
A response to the motion of MPs Tielen and Van Weyenberg will follow in the cabinet response to the IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Een reactie op de motie van de leden Tielen en Van Weyenberg zal volgen in de kabinetsreactie op het IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de arbeidsproductiviteit van zelfstandigen

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS findings that the growth of self-employed workers lowers labour productivity, and about whether productivity should be measured the same way for firms with employees and for the self-employed. The government answered that productivity is a general efficiency measure, that the slowdown reflects a range of factors such as the end of catch-up growth and weaker investment, and that it has no forecasts for future productivity but will pursue a long-term growth strategy.
Future developments in labour productivity are not mapped.
Toekomstige ontwikkelingen in de arbeidsproductiviteit worden niet in kaart gebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Tielen over de brief getiteld ‘Kamervragen van het lid Van Kent (SP), het lid Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) en het lid Van Weyenberg (D66) over het bericht dat het concurrentiebeding

MPs Wörsdörfer and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how a planned study of non-compete clauses would weigh employer interests against employee freedom, including small innovative firms, and whether it could break down use by sector and function and assess their value qualitatively. The minister confirmed the study will cover both perspectives and possibly sector breakdowns, but said its concrete design was still under discussion with employer and employee organisations.
I have promised your House to examine not only whether more conditions can be attached to the non-compete clause, but also how extensive the problem surrounding the non-compete clause is.

Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd niet alleen te onderzoeken of er meer voorwaarden kunnen worden verbonden aan het concurrentiebeding, maar ook hoe omvangrijk de problematiek rondom het concurrentiebeding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over het artikel 'Vraag naar personeel met mbo-opleiding stijgt snel op banensites'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about a news report on rising demand for mbo-trained workers on job sites, including labour market forecasts, shortage sectors, retraining of jobseekers and the flexible-work link. The minister answered that demand for mbo workers has risen with the economy, described forecasting and retraining instruments, and rejected the idea that mbo graduates are mostly trained for unemployment.
It has never been the case that mbo graduates are in many cases trained for unemployment.
Het is nooit zo geweest dat mbo'ers in veel gevallen worden opgeleid voor werkloosheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de artikelen ‘Data arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden ontbreken massaal bij UWV’ en ‘UWV-manager Astrid Hendriks legt uit hoe de onlinekaartenbak mislukte’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about press reports that data on candidates with work limitations were missing from UWV's candidate finder, and about the tool's failure, including the completeness of candidate profiles and the Mediatest evaluation. The government acknowledges the tool's value as one channel, says profile completeness is an ongoing challenge shared with municipalities, and points to the broader Breed Offensief and Doe agenda measures without a concrete new step on the tool itself.
The report was enclosed with the answers and thereby shared with the House.
Het rapport is meegezonden als bijlage bij de antwoorden en daarmee gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over ‘de Nieuwsuurreportage over arbeidsmigranten’

MPs Tielen and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur report on migrant workers, including inspection complaint figures, enforcement capacity, EU posted-worker rules, and labour market matching. The minister answered that complaints rose from 1182 in 2015 to 1817 in 2018, described inspection priorities and the extra funding, and outlined EU-level and domestic measures while largely restating existing policy.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1182 in 2015 to 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 and 1817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1182 in 2015 naar 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 tot 1817 in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Tielen over het bericht 'Salafistische jongerenwerkers actief in Den Haag'

MPs Peters and Tielen asked the ministers about reports that Salafist youth workers operate in The Hague, including one worker who stopped after police warnings, and whether radical influence on youth is widespread. The government confirmed the case was handled locally with the employer ending the worker's contract, said no grounds exist for a wider inventory or new measures on leaked information, and pointed to existing prevention and partnership efforts.
We are not aware of any signals that would require such an inventory.
Er zijn ons geen signalen bekend die een dergelijke inventarisatie nodig zouden maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over het bericht van Innovo dat iemand die eerder aan de pabo is begonnen niet voor een zijinstroomtraject in aanmerking komt

Three VVD MPs asked whether someone who started but did not finish the pabo (primary teacher training) is blocked from the zij-instroom (career-changer) teaching route, and whether the rule should be lifted. The minister answered that eligibility requires a completed higher education degree, that the person may be able to start a shortened part-time programme, and that he does not intend to change the degree requirement.
I do not intend to change the condition that a career-changer must have a higher education diploma, which appears to be the problem in this situation.
Aan de voorwaarde dat een zijinstromer een ho-diploma moet hebben, wat in deze situatie het probleem lijkt, wil ik niet tornen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Laan-Geselschap over het artikel ‘Speciale opvang voor jihad-kinderen bij terugkeer in Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Parool report on special reception for children returning from IS territory, and whether such children pose a security threat. The government answered that the children are primarily victims, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming did not set up locations, that children are placed in specialised trauma care and observed, and that the youth court decides on protective measures based on multidisciplinary advice.
The RvdK has not set up any locations.
De RvdK heeft geen locaties opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het onderzoek ‘Het bindend studieadvies in het hoger onderwijs’ en de kabinetsreactie daarop

An MP asks whether the Panteia study on the binding study advice (bsa) in higher education used quantitative findings, what evidence supports claims about bsa norms and wrongly dismissed students, and whether the report is suitable for policy. The minister answers that the study was qualitative by design, that she has asked for a follow-up study with results expected in 2020, and that the report still gives a useful picture of how the bsa works.
That is correct. The study aimed to provide insight into the conditions and criteria under which the binding study advice (bsa) is applied and the factors affecting how the bsa works.

Dat klopt. Het onderzoek had tot doel inzicht te geven in de voorwaarden en criteria waaronder het bindend studieadvies (bsa) wordt uitgevoerd en de factoren die van invloed zijn op de werking van het bsa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het overzicht  van de verdeling van het variabele deel van de rijksbijdrage over verschillende studenttypen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the distribution of the variable part of the state funding across student types, including the calculation of per-student amounts and the medical-study workshop budgets. The minister explained the calculation method, the workshop budget structure and accountability by the UMCs, and committed to a cost study while rejecting that medical studies' special status hinders healthcare developments.
I will carry out this cost study and in doing so I also want to pay attention to matters such as the balance between fixed and variable funding
Dit kostenonderzoek ga ik uitvoeren en daarbij wil ik ook aandacht hebben voor zaken als de balans tussen vaste en variabele bekostiging
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het integrale Capaciteitsplan 2016 hoofdrapport van het Capaciteitsorgaan

An MP asked the minister about the 2016 Capacity Plan of the Capaciteitsorgaan, the latest integral advice on medical training capacity, and how intake was set, banded advice was presented, and new developments were incorporated. The minister answered that a new integral advice is due in autumn 2019, that intake was kept at around 2,900 students for political and labour-market reasons, that institutions allocate places among themselves, that the new plan will no longer give a bandwidth, and that the Capaciteitsorgaan is an independent foundation funded by VWS.
In the new capacity plan, the Capaciteitsorgaan will no longer include a bandwidth.
In het nieuwe capaciteitsplan neemt het Capaciteitsorgaan niet langer een bandbreedte op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over recente berichtgeving rondom SAVE Midden-Nederland en Veilig Thuis

MP Tielen asked about reports that parents involved with SAVE Midden-Nederland and Veilig Thuis feel opposed rather than supported, whether combining the referring body and a certifying institution creates conflicts of interest, and how inspectorates supervise these bodies. The minister acknowledged complaints, said the organisational structure is legally permitted, pointed to shared supervision by the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid, and noted that much of the relevant information is not available centrally.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘TU Eindhoven stelt wetenschappelijke vacatures alleen open voor vrouwen’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether TU Eindhoven opening scientific vacancies only to women is a form of discrimination contrary to the Constitution, and about the underlying figures. The Minister answered that the policy is a permissible form of preferential policy, that vacancies open to men after six months without a suitable candidate, that the Equal Treatment Commission (College voor de Rechten van de Mens) rather than the Minister would judge legality, and that the policy does not affect other forms of diversity.
It is not for me to assess whether this TU/e policy complies with all the strict rules on preferential policy.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of dit beleid van de TU/e aan alle strenge regels rond voorkeursbeleid voldoet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van Wijngaarden en Laan-Geselschap over de berichten ‘Tientallen jongeren met grensoverschrijdend gedrag worden niet behandeld’ en ‘Aanhoudingen in Rotterdam voor groepsverkrachtin

Three VVD MPs asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and Health about press reports on untreated youths with sexual boundary-crossing behaviour and group rape by minors in Rotterdam. The government answered that trends in juvenile sex offending are falling, that municipalities are responsible for youth care ordered by courts, and that financial shortfall does not exempt municipalities from their duty.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for the provision of youth care. Financial shortage does not release municipalities from their youth care obligation.
Op grond van de Jeugdwet zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de jeugdhulp. Financiële krapte ontslaat gemeenten niet van hun jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Tielen over de berichten 'Bij hoogleraar B. moesten de vrouwen hakken dragen' en 'Van seksueel wangedrag tot sabotage van je onderzoek'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Justice about press reports of harassment and an unsafe culture at the University of Amsterdam law faculty and academia more broadly. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that the UvA has taken steps such as external investigation, interim management, a review of confidential advisers and a planned ombudsman, while stating that a broader cultural change across academia is needed.
I will examine together with the LNVH and the VSNU which further steps can be taken.
Ik zal samen met het LNVH en de VSNU bekijken welke stappen er verder genomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Internationaal podium voor Nederlandse startups tijdens Academic Startup Competition'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the share of academic startups in the Netherlands compared with other countries, whether Dutch universities are competitive, and what measures are taken to promote academic startups and valorisation. The minister answered that academic startups make up about 13% of Dutch startups, cited OECD and Genome rankings, and referred to existing policy letters and funding measures, without committing to a new concrete step beyond planned valorisation meetings.
There are no unambiguous figures available on the number of academic startups and spin-offs in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen eenduidige cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal academische startups en spin-offs in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Middendorp over de artikelen ‘Molly Russell’s father: cutting, biting, burning — my daughter was shown it all on social media’ en ‘You have amazing ability, Damian Hinds tells te

Two MPs asked the government about UK press reports on the death of a teenager linked to social media content, whether similar Dutch cases are known, whether Dutch research on social media and suicide will be undertaken, and what action will be taken. The minister said no Dutch data on causes of suicide are kept, a 113 Suicide Prevention study on 2017 youth suicides is underway with results expected at year end, and pointed to EU audiovisual rules, media literacy in the curriculum and existing support networks.
In the Netherlands no data are kept on the causes of suicide.
In Nederland worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over de oorzaken van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Tielen, Beertema en Bisschop inzake het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs asked why no new application round was opened for the PhD education experiment, whether the experiment is being used improperly, and how it will be evaluated. The minister answered that no new round was opened because no other universities showed interest, that the evaluation is planned for 2021 with an interim review after three years, and that the number of participants and data gaps are acknowledged.
I am not terminating the experiment either in whole or in part.
Ik beëindig het experiment geheel noch gedeeltelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ook asielzoeker krijgt hulp bij eerwraak’

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government about reports of honour-based violence and threats against asylum seekers in reception centres, including how many cases were recorded, whether perpetrators were removed, and whether residence permits were revoked. The State Secretary answered that COA-registration is limited for safety reasons, that perpetrators can be moved to an EBTL and victims to women's shelters, and that the government will audit social safety in late 2019 and agree with municipalities to fund shelter access for victims awaiting residence decisions.
Quantitative information on the number of reports made to Veilig Thuis is currently not available.
Kwantitatieve informatie omtrent het aantal meldingen gedaan bij Veilig Thuis is op dit moment echter niet voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen inzake ‘Hogescholen stoppen met nationale studentenenquête’

An MP asked the education minister about the Vereniging Hogescholen decision to stop the national student survey (NSE) over privacy-related data problems, and the coding issues. The minister said the NSE is important, that GDPR-related errors make the 2019 data unfit for publication, that she is awaiting an independent CBS study and will inform parliament before summer, and that she is exploring a legal basis for more data delivery.
On the outcomes of the CBS study in relation to the NSE 2019 data, I will inform your House by letter before the summer.
Over de uitkomsten van het CBS-onderzoek in relatie tot de gegevens uit de NSE 2019 zal ik uw Kamer informeren middels een brief voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Mijn grootste fout is dat ik hulp heb gezocht voor mijn kind'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper story on a father's experience with youth protection, including whether parents and children understand the roles of youth protection bodies and whether the Scheiden zonder Schade programme will be effective. The minister acknowledged the stories, said roles are clearly delimited but parents are not always adequately informed, and announced information materials and an update on the programme in spring 2019.
In practice it appears that in some cases parents and children do not feel sufficiently informed.
In de praktijk blijkt dat in sommige gevallen ouders en kinderen zich niet of onvoldoende geïnformeerd voelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Universiteit Utrecht is te wit'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Utrecht University's diversity policy is compatible with rule-of-law values after reports that men and women were seated separately at a student society lecture, and whether the university has rules to exclude events conflicting with those values. The minister answered that the society said seating was free, that gender equality is a core value, that the university's Code of Conduct prohibits discrimination and forced segregation, and that she sees no reason for further action.
Utrecht University has a Code of Conduct that describes the values guiding work and study at the university.
De Universiteit Utrecht heeft een Code of Conduct die de waarden beschrijft die richting geven aan het werken en studeren aan de universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Özdil over de berichtgeving over de Qatarese vestiging van NHL Stenden

MPs Tielen and Özdil asked the Minister of Education about press reports on NHL Stenden's Qatar campus, including an Inspectorate investigation running since October 2018, and whether foreign branch quality and diploma integrity are adequately safeguarded. The Minister said the Inspectorate's report is expected around June and will be sent to parliament, that existing quality safeguards (NVAO accreditation, examination board decisions) apply, and that she will review rules if the investigation warrants it.
I undertake to send this investigation to your House, including my response.
Ik zeg u toe dit onderzoek naar uw Kamer te zullen sturen inclusief mijn reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de Universiteit Utrecht

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a reported Utrecht University diversity plan, including prayer rooms with separate entrances and Islamic holiday calendars, and whether such measures serve education quality. The minister answered that diversity and inclusion are the institution's own responsibility, that the university has no plans for separate entrances or a changed calendar, and that equal admission chances matter.
However, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine how they pay attention to this and which measures they take in this area.
Het is echter aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoe zij hier aandacht aan besteden en welke maatregelen zij op dit gebied nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Universiteiten groeien harder dan verwacht’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education about reports that university and higher vocational enrolment exceeded ministry forecasts, causing budget shortfalls, and about separate forecasting and a reception desk for international students. The Minister confirmed the overruns, said the 2019 budget impact will appear in a supplementary budget, defended the forecasting method as accurate, and promised a separate breakdown of international students in the next reference forecast and talks on a central application desk.
