Forecasting international students has our attention and is being discussed with the Advisory Group on Pupil and Student Forecasts (ALS).
Het ramen van internationale studenten heeft onze aandacht en wordt besproken met de Adviesgroep Leerlingen- en Studentenramingen (ALS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van der Molen over het niet toestaan van een nieuwe aanvraagronde voor het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs Tielen and Van der Molen asked why the interim evaluation of the PhD education experiment is late and why no new application round was opened. The minister replied that the evaluation started in January 2019 with a report due by April 2019, that no other universities showed interest, and that a new round would not automatically increase PhD numbers.
The report of the research is due by April 2019 at the latest.
Het rapport van het onderzoek uiterlijk april 2019 oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Verbetering gebruik meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling bij ggz’

Tielen (VVD) asked the health minister about an Inspectorate finding that some youth mental health institutions believed the child-abuse reporting code did not apply to them. The minister answered that most GGZ institutions are well advanced, that the misunderstanding is wrong since the code covers all clients' risks, and committed to extra inspectorate attention, regional support and an evaluation of the law.
I have asked the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth to pay extra attention this year to supervision of the reporting code for domestic violence and child abuse.
Ik heb de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd gevraagd om dit jaar extra aandacht te besteden aan het toezicht van de meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over anti-integratieve uitspraken rector islamitische universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government how it would respond to statements by the rector of the Islamic University of Rotterdam that followers of Gülen may receive the death penalty, and whether it would use powers under the Wet bescherming namen en graden. The minister condemned the statements, said an independent advisory commission had been asked for advice under the step-by-step procedure, and said she is willing to use the law's options but will await the commission's advice before deciding.
With the commission's advice I will assess whether there is reason to intervene at the IUASR.
Met het advies van de commissie zal ik beoordelen of er aanleiding is om bij de IUASR in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Duitsers willen nieuwe universiteit op grens met Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that German politicians want a new cross-border university near Venlo, and whether Dutch universities can access EU funding for European university networks. The minister said the idea was only briefly mentioned in talks with North Rhine-Westphalia, sees no added value in a new cross-border university, and says Dutch institutions may apply to the Erasmus+ European university networks pilot, which the Commission assesses without member-state involvement.

I therefore in principle see no added value within the system for a new cross-border university, but possibly for cross-border cooperation between existing universities and universities of applied sciences.

Ik zie dus in beginsel geen toegevoegde waarde binnen het bestel voor een nieuwe grensoverschrijdende universiteit, maar mogelijk wel voor grensoverschrijdende samenwerking tussen bestaande universiteiten en hogescholen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de rapportage ‘Eindrapportage verdeling fonds tekortgemeenten’

MP Tielen (VVD) asks the Health Minister about the VNG final report on distributing the 200 million euro Fonds Tekortgemeenten, questioning the use of accountant statements and budgets, the absence of a substantive policy check, the 50%/100% compensation tiers, the large differences between comparable municipalities, and whether the scheme rewards passive policy. The minister replies that the criteria were approved by the VNG general meeting, that accountant statements concern lawfulness rather than policy, that municipalities chose not to test policy for practical reasons, and that a youth benchmark study is underway with results expected in spring 2019, without committing to a successor fund.
That is why other sources of information were also used.
Daarom is ook gebruik gemaakt van andere informatiebronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen dat het registratieproces van gediplomeerde jeugdhulpwerkers bij SKJ te traag is

An MP asked the Minister whether the Kwaliteitsregister Jeugd (SKJ) registration of youth care workers is too slow, and whether this leaves professionals working unregistered and risks quality. The Minister answered that most applications are processed within the six-week term, average processing is five weeks, and that the ministry sees no evidence registration delays prevent meeting the 1 January 2019 deadline, while offering to discuss with SKJ if needed.
At present there are no indications that the processing time from registration to youth and family professional is a bottleneck
Op dit moment zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de doorlooptijd van registratie tot jeugd- en gezinsprofessional een knelpunt is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het rapport 'Inzicht in en verantwoording van onderwijsgelden'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether she shares the Onderwijsraad's conclusion that the NVAO lacks the capacity and expertise for sound financial and quality oversight of study-fund spending, and whether this affects the motion requiring NVAO pre-checks of measurable institutional quality agreements. The minister agreed capacity must be expanded, says agreements with the NVAO are already made, and states the NVAO will also assess measurability of quality agreements.
I share this conclusion of the council and have already made agreements with the NVAO on expanding capacity.
Ik deel deze conclusie van de raad en heb reeds met de NVAO afspraken gemaakt over uitbreiding van de capaciteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Tielen en De Lange over het bericht 'Húsdokter yn oplieding wol graach nei Fryslân, mar mei net'('Huisarts in opleiding wil graag naar Fryslân, maar mag niet')

Three VVD MPs asked why medical faculties restrict GP trainees to stages within their own university region, despite shortages in regions like Friesland, and asked about criteria, overviews and possible talks with HON. Minister Bruins replied that the uniform national allocation procedure already considers shortage regions, that HON is evaluating allowing transfers to shortage areas by Q3 2018, that no study delays were found, and that a LHV-linked study on GP location motives is being set up.
One of the recommendations from that evaluation is to allow transfers to shortage areas under conditions.
Een van de aanbevelingen uit die evaluatie is om overplaatsing naar krimpgebieden onder voorwaarden toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Nieuwe imamopleiding, nu van Milli Görüs'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the planned private imam training by Milli Görüs in Amsterdam will start in September 2018, how it relates to the VU programme, whether Dutch-rooted imams are preferred, and whether civic values and inspection oversight apply to it. The minister replies that the private training falls outside recognised higher education, so the government has no view on its start or content and the Inspectorate has no oversight, while the VU exploration proceeds and the government supports Dutch-rooted imams.
I cannot impose obligations on institutions outside the recognised higher education system.
Ik kan geen verplichtingen opleggen aan instellingen buiten het bestel van erkend hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Hogeschool censureert uit angst voor boze Turken’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether a Saxion university of applied sciences self-censored an article on the Armenian genocide out of fear of Turkish reactions, and whether such censorship occurs at other institutions. The minister replies that the decision was made by the independent magazine's editor-in-chief, not the college board, that no structural self-censorship has been found, and that a new code of conduct addressing self-censorship takes effect on 1 October 2018.
I see no reason for this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Studenten de pineut: OV-kaart te vroeg ongeldig'

An MP asked why the student public transport card is invalid during the regular study week of 16-20 July 2018 in the north of the Netherlands, and whether the period could be aligned with regional study weeks, costed, or compensated. The minister answered that the summer period is a long-standing cost-control measure, that regional alignment would reduce efficiency and require costly system changes, that the contract with carriers sets the payment basis, and that compensating students is administratively burdensome, so no changes were planned.

Precisely because I know there is also a wish in your House to save on the student travel product, I see insufficient reason, given the above, to make changes to the summer period of the student travel product.

Juist omdat ik weet dat er vanuit uw Kamer ook een wens leeft om op het studentenreisproduct te besparen, zie ik als gevolg van het bovenstaande onvoldoende aanleiding om aanpassingen te maken in de zomerperiode van het studentenreisproduct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en El Yassini over de berichten dat in hbo en mbo de ICT-opleidingen verouderd en ondermaats zijn

MPs Tielen and El Yassini asked the minister about press reports that ICT programmes in hbo and mbo are outdated and underperforming, and about the consequences for the labour market. The minister acknowledged the signal, pointed to curriculum renewal via SBB, Dcypher, regional funds and accreditation standards, and said a shortage of ICT workers is a real challenge without a single easy fix.
As I already indicated in my answers to written questions from member Van der Molen (submitted 2 May 2018), I take this signal very seriously.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van der Molen (ingezonden op 2 mei 2018) al aangaf, neem ik dit signaal zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over de voorgenomen sluiting van HOVO in Limburg per 1 mei 2018

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Hogeschool Zuyd's decision to end HOVO (higher education for older people) in Limburg from 1 May 2018, covering its funding, causes, comparisons with other provinces and the government's levers. The minister answered that HOVO is a non-subsidised activity that must be cost-covering, that the decision followed failed attempts to make Limburg's programme self-financing, and that the government has no direct responsibility for non-formal courses, pointing to a forthcoming letter on lifelong learning.
I am not responsible for the course offerings or for ensuring a regionally comprehensive course supply for older people or other target groups.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor het cursorisch aanbod en de zorg voor een regionaal dekkend cursusaanbod voor ouderen of andere doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Betalen per studiepunt houdt studenten binnenboord’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education whether early Windesheim findings on the flexstuderen pay-per-credit experiment are encouraging, whether other institutions can join, and whether an extra intake moment can be created. The Minister called the findings relevant, said more institutions could join if interest is confirmed, but that the experiment is bound by its legal maximum duration.
I will ask the Vereniging Hogescholen (VH) and the Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU) about the potential interest of institutions.
Ik zal bij de Vereniging Hogescholen (VH) en de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU) navraag doen naar de potentiële interesse van instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Tielen over de Nieuwsuurreportage 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Health, Welfare and Sport about a Nieuwsuur report on Roma children exploited in criminal activity, including what is being done about multi-problem families, information sharing between municipalities and abroad, and why some municipalities dropped recommended approaches. The state secretary answered that knowledge has been gathered, that a national adviser has been appointed, and that inter-ministerial and cross-border cooperation exists, but declined to give figures on exploited children and said RvdK does not register ethnicity.
Because children are not registered by ethnicity at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, I cannot say whether or how often Roma children have been placed out of home.
Omdat kinderen bij de RvdK niet worden geregistreerd op etniciteit, kan ik niet aangeven of en hoe vaak Roma kinderen uit huis zijn geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het artikel 'Jeugdpsychiatrie bij gemeente is fout'

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about an article claiming that youth psychiatric care organised by municipalities is failing, and asked whether referrals to specialist youth mental health care are being handled well. The minister agreed that care should be organised close to the child's social environment, said referral data is available through the VNG app rather than broken down by referrer, and promised to talk with municipalities about uniform standards for neighbourhood teams.
Information is however available on youth care use per municipality and per region, including on referrals.
Wel is er informatie beschikbaar over het jeugdhulpgebruik per gemeente en per regio, inclusief over de verwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Cybersecurity hoogleraren vrezen dat Nederland digitaal onder water komt te staan’ en het bijbehorende position paper

MPs Tielen and Rutte asked why the Netherlands invests little in cybersecurity research compared with German centres, whether talent is leaving, and how a knowledge fund and chairs would fit government priorities. The minister replied that cybersecurity is a priority in the coalition agreement and national agenda, that Dutch research is of high quality, and that talks with ministries and stakeholders on a research impulse and a possible institute are ongoing, with a joint letter promised in spring.
I will inform the House about this in the spring through a joint letter with these departments.
Ik zal hierover de Kamer in het voorjaar informeren via een gezamenlijke brief met deze departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Oosten over het artikel 'Opleggen van huisverbod moet vaker en sneller'

MPs Tielen and Van Oosten asked about a call by The Hague's mayor to impose household bans more often and faster, and about hulpverlening follow-up, extensions, and information sharing in domestic violence cases. The minister defends the household ban as an effective tool within a broader safety plan, acknowledges problems organising aid, says extensions are only legal when danger persists, and points to ongoing programmes and existing reporting code.
There are therefore no figures available on this.
Er zijn hierover daarom geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Veldman en Weverling over het bericht ‘Maakbedrijven trekken naar India wegens groeiend gebrek aan Nederlandse ingenieurs’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education about a newspaper report that manufacturing firms are moving to India due to a shortage of Dutch engineers, including expected shortages, number of firms leaving, and how other countries respond. The state secretary and minister answered that a shortage of technical talent is a growing constraint, that no integrated data exist on firms leaving or on the number of jobs lost, and that the government's Techniekpact is a model cited by other countries.
Statistics Netherlands does not keep data on the number of firms leaving the Netherlands.
Er worden (door het CBS) geen gegevens bijgehouden over aantallen bedrijven die uit Nederland vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Registratie kindermishandeling bij veel organisaties niet op orde'

MP Tielen asked the Health Minister whether child abuse registration in youth health care is inadequate and how it will be improved, and about coordination with Veilig Thuis and the role of youth health care. The minister acknowledged the inspectorate's findings, pointed to a sector-led action plan and a planned national programme, and gave mostly general commitments without new binding measures.
I consider complete, correct and better registration of child abuse important so that timely action can be taken on suspicions of and monitoring of child abuse.
Ik vind een volledige, juiste en betere registratie van kindermishandeling belangrijk om tijdig te kunnen acteren bij vermoedens van en het monitoren van kindermishandeling.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘De stand van de Jeugdzorg 2025’ van de Jeugdautoriteit

An MP asks the state secretary about the Youth Authority's report on youth care, including whether young people with stress can be helped by non-youth-care support, the delayed national law defining youth-care scope, and the need for a societal debate on expectations. The secretary largely agrees the system needs narrowing and a broader societal conversation, points to a scope bill planned for consultation early 2026 and a letter before the 2 February 2026 committee debate, but does not give firm new commitments beyond existing reform agenda steps.
I want to put the bill out for consultation as soon as possible, with the aim of doing so early next year.
Ik wil het wetsvoorstel zo spoedig mogelijk in consultatie brengen, het streven is begin volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het ontbreken van verdoving bij late zwangerschapsafbreking

An SGP MP asked the state secretary about the absence of standard fetal anaesthesia in late-term abortions after 24 weeks, the lack of a medical guideline, and comparisons with fetal surgery and early abortion. The state secretary answered that professional norms govern the procedure, that a revised quality standard in draft requires sedation and analgesia for the fetus, that fetal pain science is complex, and that no change to late-abortion policy is planned.
I see no reason to change the policy on late-term abortion.
Ik zie geen reden om het beleid ten aanzien van late zwangerschapsafbreking te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vliegenthart en Moorman over het bericht ‘Reclame Code Commissie geeft pro life-organisatie ‘stevige tik op de vingers’ vanwege misleidende abortusfolder'

MPs Vliegenthart and Moorman asked about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that an anti-abortion organisation's folder was misleading, and what the government would do about misinformation on abortion care in GP waiting rooms. The State Secretary said the government is funding research and strategies against misinformation, that the choice of materials is up to GP practices, and that the RCC is the appropriate body to act, not the ministry.
I have not contacted Kies Leven following the ruling. The Advertising Code Committee is an independent body that oversees compliance with the advertising code.
Ik heb geen contact opgenomen met Kies Leven naar aanleiding van de uitspraak. De Reclame Code Commissie is een onafhankelijk orgaan dat toeziet op naleving van de reclamecode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inzet van sport en bewegen in de aanpak preventie en weerbaarheid jongeren

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security and VWS ministers how sport and exercise can be used in preventing youth crime and strengthening resilience, and whether VWS and sport programmes will be involved. The minister answered that sport is a supporting element rather than a proven standalone intervention, that AJB is the proven example, and that no further intensification is planned.
I therefore see no reason to intensify this further.
Ik zie nu dan ook geen reden om dit verder te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul  en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Coöperatie Laatste Wil komt met nieuwe  levenseindemethode'

MPs Bikker, Krul and Diederik van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the Coöperatie Laatste Wil's new assisted-dying method, its risks for vulnerable people, and possible legal action. The government called the dissemination of suicide methods undesirable, said it is checking whether the activities are criminal under article 294 Sr, declined to confirm any ongoing investigations, and said the prosecutor would act if criminal limits are crossed while the minister sees no reason to use a special instruction power.
In general, the Minister of Justice and Security can neither confirm nor deny whether criminal investigations are ongoing against certain natural or legal persons.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan bevestigen noch ontkennen of tegen bepaalde natuurlijke of rechtspersonen strafrechtelijke onderzoeken lopen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Straatman over het bericht 'Tabakssmokkel en nepsigaretten schaden Nederlandse verkopers'

MPs Krul and Straatman (CDA) asked about reports of rising illegal cigarette trade, smuggling, illegal production, online sales and excise policy. The government answered with survey data, enforcement measures and EU excise harmonisation plans, but made no firm commitments on new accijns increases.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide on changes to the excise duty.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om te besluiten over te gaan tot wijzigingen ten aanzien van de accijns.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending ‘Het therapietrauma’ van Zembla

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Zembla broadcast on short high-intensity trauma therapy at Psytrec, including reports of harm, expert concerns, monitoring, evidence base and inspection follow-up. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ received earlier signals without intervening, is now investigating post-broadcast reports, and that quality and effectiveness are primarily matters for professionals, guidelines and providers, while describing waiting times and planned capacity measures.
The IGJ is currently investigating the reports received and cannot yet say anything about a possible follow-up.
De IGJ onderzoekt de ontvangen meldingen op dit moment en kan nog geen uitspraken doen over een eventueel vervolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over misstanden in de pleegzorg

An MP asked the state secretaries whether, given recent reports of abuse of children in foster and family-home care, supervisory bodies failed to intervene, and what steps will improve screening, monitoring, signalling and protection in youth care. The government answered that the inspectorates are investigating, describes existing screening criteria, child-protection duties and planned reforms, but offers no definitive assessment of the specific case.
What exactly happened in the family home is for the inspectorates to investigate.
Wat er precies is voorgevallen in het gezinshuis, is aan de inspecties om te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schilder en Van Meetelen over het bericht 'Uit huis geplaatste kinderen uit Noord-Nederland jarenlang ernstig mishandeld'

MPs Schilder and Van Meetelen asked the government about abuse of children placed in a Northern Netherlands foster home, possible supervisory failures, the William Schrikker Stichting's repeated involvement in serious incidents, and whether dismissal, prosecution and tougher sanctions would be introduced. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates are investigating and that enforcement and sanctions are for inspectorates, employers, the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declining to pre-empt the outcome and refusing new legislation on dismissal or prosecution.
We will inform your House about the outcomes of the investigation.
Wij zullen uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel 'Pleegkinderen geslagen, aan oren getrokken en door hond gebeten'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about the abuse of foster children in a family home in the north of the Netherlands, the failure of the guardianship agency to detect or act on it, and the position of parents after loss of parental authority. The government answered that it cannot yet judge the case pending inspection investigations, described the supervision framework for family homes, and pointed to a bill strengthening independent oversight of minors under guardianship.
That is why the bill 'Act to strengthen legal protection in youth care' assigns the Child Protection Board an annual evaluation of the wellbeing and safety of these children.

Daarom wordt in het wetsvoorstel «Wet ter versterking van de rechtsbescherming in de jeugdbescherming» de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming belast met een jaarlijkse evaluatie van het welzijn en de veiligheid van deze kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Extra MRI-scan voor vrouwen met dicht borstweefsel, maar pas vanaf 2030’

An SP MP asked why extra MRI screening for women with very dense breast tissue only starts in 2030, whether private clinics' MRI capacity could be used, what legal means exist to compel clinics to make capacity available, and how profiteering could be prevented. The Secretary of State explained that the chosen organisation under the population screening programme (centralised steering, avoiding displacement of care) requires a tender lasting 2-3 years, that private capacity is included through tendering, that no legal power exists to compel clinics, and that tariffs will be market-conform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over belangenverstrengeling door enkele wetenschappers

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about conflicts of interest among scientists who helped shape the obesity debate with disputed figures, and whether commercial influence on policy is a concern. The minister acknowledged the lapses at UMCG, called transparency essential, said existing codes and registers suffice, and declined to link the manifest to the reimbursement decision, while rejecting a national drug fund as a fix for conflicts of interest.

In this case, the University Medical Center Groningen, where the scientists are affiliated, indicated that the researchers did not adhere to the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and that their side positions and possible conflicts of interest should have been disclosed when signing the manifesto.

In dit geval heeft het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMCG), waar de wetenschappers aan verbonden zijn, aangegeven dat de onderzoekers zich niet aan de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschappelijke Integriteit (NGWI) hebben gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het voorkomen van massadonatie

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked the State Secretary for Health about 'mass donation' of sperm, a clinic apparently circumventing donor registration, the adequacy of the law, a European register, and remedies for donor children. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 law caps donor sperm at 12 women via a central Dutch register, that cross-border and private-sphere donations remain outside its reach, and that further measures are being explored with a letter promised in Q1 2026.
I am in discussions with various parties about the possibilities and desirability of taking further measures against the use of donor sperm that is used internationally for more than 12 women.

Ik ben in gesprek met verschillende betrokken partijen over de mogelijkheden en wenselijkheid om nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen het gebruik van donorzaad dat in internationaal verband bij meer dan 12 vrouwen wordt ingezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de Kamerbrief 'Uitvoering van de motie van het lid Daniëlle Jansen c.s. over de verkoop van nicotineproducten vanaf 2028 voorbehouden aan enkel tabaksspeciaalz

MPs Hertzberger and Bruyning asked why the government will not implement the motion to restrict nicotine product sales to specialist tobacco shops from 2028, and whether compensation or cost-benefit estimates were considered. The Secretary of State answered that without funding a compensation scheme is not feasible and risks court annulment, that the earlier 2030/2032 timeline stands, and that he declines to reconsider the decision.
Because the motion does not provide financial resources, including a compensation scheme in the bill is not feasible.
Omdat de motie niet voorziet in financiële middelen is het opnemen van een compensatieregeling in het wetsvoorstel niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over burgermotorverkeersregelaars bij wielerkoersen

MP Mohandis asks the State Secretary of VWS and the Justice Minister about capacity pressures on police motorcycle escorts for cycling races, whether government should structurally fund civilian traffic controllers, the status of the national guideline and the local allocation of police. The government answers that event organisers and the competent local authority are responsible, that structural funding is not a national responsibility, that the guideline subsidy was only recently paid, and that local allocation is deliberately kept with the competent authority.
Responsibility for the safe and orderly conduct of cycling races lies with the organiser of the event.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ordelijk verloop van wielerwedstrijden ligt bij de organisator van het evenement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het afhandelen van de hack op Clinical Diagnostics en de gevolgen voor gedupeerden

MP Kathmann asked the state secretaries about the Clinical Diagnostics data breach affecting cervical cancer screening participants, including the status of measures, notification of victims, phishing risks, helpline availability, causes of the hack and oversight. The government answered that victims were notified in September, that Z-CERT monitoring and an external quickscan are underway, that the cause investigation is ongoing with results expected later, and that IGJ and AP oversight is independent, referring several points to the Openbaar Ministerie.
It is not for me to go into this further; for this I refer to the Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan mij hier nader op in te gaan, hiervoor verwijs ik naar het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over suïcidepreventie

An MP asked the State Secretaries for Health and for Infrastructure about suicide prevention measures at the Merwedebrug, national policy on barriers at dangerous sites, the role of municipalities under the Wet integrale suïcidepreventie, and AI chatbots and suicide risk. The government answered that rail barrier programmes run to 2026, that Rijkswegen has no suicide prevention programme, that municipalities will be supported in defining risk locations, and that AI-specific suicide prevention policy is still being explored.
I endorse the message that AI chatbots must be developed in accordance with applicable regulations so that they are applied responsibly.
Ik onderschrijf de boodschap dat AI-chatbots overeenkomstig geldende regelgeving ontwikkeld moeten worden, zodat zij op een verantwoorde manier worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de gevolgen van het gebruik van lachgas en de handhaving van het lachgasverbod

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers how they will respond to a Radar broadcast on nitrous oxide harms, including care pressure, enforcement of the ban, online sales and European coordination. The minister answered that there are no signals of rising pressure on care, that enforcement appears adequate, and committed to raising a European ban in EU drug working groups.
There are no signals that the enforceability of the ban is in question.
Er zijn geen signalen dat de handhaafbaarheid van het verbod in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de jaarrapportage 2024 Wet afbreking zwangerschap (Wafz)

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the 2024 annual report on the Dutch abortion act, including the stable abortion count, registration gaps, treatment shifts, early abortions, aftercare and contraception. The State Secretary answered each question, explained the causes given by the abortion doctors' association, declined to pursue more aftercare checks, and promised a new unwanted-pregnancy policy letter by mid-November.
I will therefore not steer towards carrying out more aftercare checks.
Ik zal daarom niet aansturen op het uitvoeren van meer nacontroles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘2 op 3 kinderen met gescheiden ouders merken daar jaren later nog gevolgen van’

An MP asked the government about a study finding that two in three children of divorced parents still feel effects in adulthood, and about the scale of divorce, whether policy should aim to reduce divorce, and support options such as relationship therapy and reconciliation. The government answered that parents are primarily responsible, pointed to existing support, the DOnS approach, a child-friendly divorce procedures project, and research on systemic therapy, while declining to set a goal of reducing divorce.
Data are not available on the group of people whose parents were ever divorced.
Gegevens zijn niet beschikbaar van de groep mensen van wie de ouders ooit gescheiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de onderzoeksjournalistiek van Zembla naar de toename van illegale THC-vapes onder scholieren

Two Nieuw Sociaal Contract MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about rising use of illegal THC and synthetic-cannabinoid (spice) vapes among pupils, including health harms, enforcement, penalties, social media liability and possible bans. The government acknowledges serious concern, reports limited structured data and some local incidents, outlines penalties and enforcement responsibilities, and promises a meldpunt and further EU-level work, but declines a general vape ban as contrary to EU law and gives no answer splitting the questions separately.
This means that a general ban on vapes is in breach of European law.
Dit betekent dat het verbieden van vapes in zijn algemeenheid in strijd is met Europees recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over intimiderende demonstraties bij abortusklinieken en scholen

MP Paulusma asked the state secretaries about intimidating demonstrations near abortion clinics and schools, including whether a buffer zone could be legislated and whether data and municipal guidance are needed. The government condemns intimidation but says demonstrations are protected, leaves enforcement to mayors and police, and points to a pending WODC study to be published in November before deciding on further legislation.
After publication of this study it will be considered whether further legislation is desirable.
Na publicatie van dit onderzoek zal worden bezien of nadere wetgeving wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Krul over de uitvoering van de motie Dobbe/Krul over zich ervoor inzetten om de onlineverkoop van vapes te stoppen

Two MPs asked the state secretary why the July 2025 letter on the Dobbe/Krul motion against online vape sales did not address restricting payment and delivery options, and what will be done to stop companies offering them. The state secretary admitted payment and delivery restrictions were not specifically named, pointed to an NVWA arrangement with a delivery firm and a forthcoming action plan with an update due mid-2026, and said answers could not be ready in time for the debate.
Restricting payment and delivery options was indeed not specifically mentioned, but this will be taken into account.
Het beperken van betalings- en bezorgingsmogelijkheden is inderdaad niet specifiek genoemd, maar dit wordt meegenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over RSvirus immunisatie voor alle kinderen in het eerste levensjaar

An MP asked why infants under one year old but born before 1 April 2025 are excluded from the RS-virus immunisation, despite the earlier commitment to cover all infants in their first year. The state secretary answered that the programme starts with babies born from 1 April 2025 because older infants have lower risk, and refused to extend eligibility as this would strain youth health care planning and capacity.
No. Extending the target group to children born before 1 April 2025 is not feasible.
Nee. Het uitbreiden van de doelgroep naar kinderen die vóór 1 april 2025 geboren zijn, is niet uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bikker over het bericht Meisje (3) kan glimlachen en kijkt Peppa Big, maar van rechter mag haar beademing stoppen

MPs Hertzberger and Bikker asked about a court ruling allowing a hospital to stop ventilation for a severely ill three-year-old, and about the criteria for medically futile care, parental rights, reanimation policy and appeal procedures. The minister answered that the hospital's assessment of futility was shared by second opinions, that the court weighed the rights involved, that parents need not be removed from parental authority, and that appeal and review of the court's marginal test are matters for the courts.
It is not for me, as Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, to sit in the judge's chair.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, om op de stoel van de rechter te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Bushoff en Slagt- Tichelman over het bericht dat gemeenten zorgondernemers nauwelijks op criminaliteit toetsen

MPs Westerveld, Bushoff and Slagt-Tichelman asked the state secretary about reports that municipalities rarely screen care providers for criminal links under the Bibob Act, and about the size of care fraud and measures taken. The state secretary acknowledged limited use of Bibob by municipalities, said the size of fraud cannot be reliably estimated, pointed to pilot projects and a DUS-I review due end 2025, and promised a progress update this autumn.
Yes, I recognise the picture that municipalities to date make limited use of the possibilities offered by the Bibob Act to screen care providers.

Ja, ik herken het beeld dat gemeenten tot op heden beperkt gebruik maken van de mogelijkheden die de Wet Bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur (Wet Bibob) biedt om zorgaanbieders te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government is adequately protecting residents from pesticides after a court ruling that the regulator Ctgb and the legislator failed to shield neighbours of lily farms, and what concrete steps will follow. The State Secretary rejected the claim of failure, pointed to the strict EU authorisation framework, ongoing SPARK research, planned spray-zone guidance and an information point for residents, and gave no new binding commitment beyond reintroducing the pesticides bill.
I do not share the view that the legislator or the Ctgb have failed in protecting residents.
Ik deel niet de opvatting dat de wetgever of het Ctgb steken hebben laten vallen in de bescherming van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over het bericht dat atlete Zoë Sedney zich in de steek gelaten voelde door de Atletiekunie na grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een teamgenoot

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked about a report that athlete Zoë Sedney felt abandoned by the Atletiekunie after a teammate's boundary-crossing conduct, including whether the victim was informed and consulted on the perpetrator's return, and about oversight of sports federations, the planned integrity centre, and case durations in sexual offence cases. The government answered that sports federations have a duty of care under the Blauwdruk, that it cannot judge individual cases, and that the Integere Sport Nederland integrity centre is in internet consultation, while case-duration measures are ongoing.
It is not for me as State Secretary to assess individual cases.
Het is als niet aan mij om als Staatssecretaris casuïstiek te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over problemen bij zorgaanbieders vanwege de onduidelijkheid rondom SKJ-registraties

The MP asks whether youth care providers and EVC bureaus acting in good faith are harmed by the uncertainty over SKJ registrations after fraud, and whether children face waiting lists and unsuitable placements, and what the state will do to speed up the registration review. The Secretary of State says the fraud investigation of EVC certificates justifies holding registrations back, that SKJ is reviewing 512 files with extra staff, and that no temporary authorisation will be given until the EVC route is shown to guarantee quality.
That is not known to me. This data is not kept.
Dat is mij niet bekend. Deze data worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het bericht Eén op de vijf horecazaken en supermarkten lapt tabaksverbod aan laars: ’Vapes en sigaretten liggen in achterkamertje in holle bank’

Hertzberger asked the State Secretary about reports that one in five shops and horeca businesses violate the tobacco sales ban, the adequacy of NVWA enforcement powers, and the generational sales ban. The State Secretary said enforcement is risk-based and that fines will rise 50% and first offences fined directly, while promising further measures after an online vape trade study and reports due later this autumn.
To increase compliance and give the NVWA more strength, I am structurally investing 3 million in enforcement.
Om de naleving te verhogen en de NVWA meer slagkracht te geven investeer ik structureel 3 miljoen in de handhaving.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Werkenden zitten bijna 9 uur op een dag, gevolgen zijn zorgwekkend’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that Dutch workers sit about 8.8 hours a day, the health risks, effective ways to change this, and the role of employers and the government. The State Secretary answered that sedentary work is a serious concern, that employers should take a broad approach to encourage movement at work, and that the government supports this through the prevention strategy, the Nederland Beweegt action plan and cooperation with partners.
It is up to the employer to take measures, and up to the employee to actually use the opportunities.
Het is aan de werkgever om maatregelen te nemen, en aan de werknemer om de mogelijkheden ook echt te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de hack op een lab van Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the hack of a laboratory used by Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland, covering notification of affected people, data use, protection measures, oversight and future safeguards. The government answered that about 941,000 participants will be informed, that oversight by the IGJ and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is ongoing, and that the Cyberbeveiligingswet will impose security duties and incident reporting on care providers, but gave no firm dates for the investigations.
As soon as relevant outcomes of the investigations are known, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra relevante uitkomsten van de onderzoeken bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het Handelingsperspectief en veldnorm bij onderbezetting gecertificeerde instellingen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Justice and Security and of Health whether the 'Handelingsperspectief' (a sector-developed emergency protocol for waiting lists at certified youth protection agencies) is legal, whether the Inspectorates were involved, and whether it shields agencies from enforcement and undermines children's rights. The government answers that the Inspectorates were informed but not involved in drafting, that the protocol is not legislation and remains subject to inspection, and that workload has fallen and waiting lists are being monitored.
The inspectorates do act when they find shortcomings at youth protection institutions in tasks the institutions themselves are responsible for and should control.

De inspecties treden wel op als zij bij instellingen in de jeugdbeschermingsketen tekortkomingen constateren op de taken waar de instellingen zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn en zelf grip op behoren te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het artikel ‘Datahack bij laboratorium veel groter, deel gegevens op dark web’

An MP (BBB) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Health about a data hack at laboratory Clinical Diagnostics, with records of about 485,000 cervical screening participants and other patients possibly exposed and some data on the dark web, and about delayed reporting, oversight, and trust in screening. The State Secretary answered that the breach affects about 230,000 additional people, that the AP and IGJ have opened investigations, that the lab has been suspended, and that the Cyberbeveiligingswet will strengthen obligations for care providers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over erkenning van foltering in gesloten jeugdzorg, bescherming van kritische rechters en herbezinning op het ketenpartnerschap binnen de jeugdsector

An MP asks whether the government acknowledges possible torture with painful stimuli in closed youth care after the CPT report, whether judges are being pressured to be less critical, and whether provider–judiciary cooperation compromises judicial independence. The Secretary of State answers that the government does not recognise possible torture, says judges are independent and the government will not intervene, and commits to providers strengthening training and oversight of restraint measures.
The cabinet cannot and will not interfere in how judges conduct themselves.
Het kabinet kan en wil zich niet mengen in de opstelling van rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel Trouw waarin de staatssecretaris het opsluiten van jongeren in de gesloten jeugdzorg weer mogelijk wil maken

An MP asked the state secretaries about a Trouw report that the government wants to re-allow night-time locking of youths in closed youth care, and whether this conflicts with commitments to the CPT on reducing restraint. The government answered that the proposed law would allow night-time room confinement only under strict conditions, individual assessment, and existing legal safeguards, and that it rejects claims of policy inconsistency and of undermining Dutch credibility internationally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over enkele aspecten van de embryo-wetswijzigingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the embryo law amendments, covering the 14-day culture limit, whether research scope restrictions work in practice, CCMO oversight, clinical use of embryonic and iPS stem cells, patents, profit rules, IVG cloning and the new embryo definition. The State Secretary declined to change the 14-day limit because the cabinet is caretaker, and otherwise gave mostly descriptive answers without new commitments beyond noting CCMO could publish clarifications.
Because the cabinet is currently caretaker, I am leaving the substantive response to the advice to the next cabinet.
Omdat het kabinet momenteel demissionair is, laat ik de inhoudelijke reactie op het advies aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccineffectiviteit en vaccinveiligheid

An MP asks the State Secretary about a RIVM-co-authored study suggesting COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness may be overestimated, and about the government's earlier dismissal of an excess-mortality report by Meester, Bakker and Walk. The State Secretary rejects that the RIVM figures were too rosy, states the bias issues were already acknowledged, says the excess-mortality report was not decisive because it is not peer-reviewed, and declines to publicise the study's findings beyond the existing consensus.
I trust that the advice given to me will be adjusted if studies show this to be necessary.
Ik vertrouw erop dat de adviezen aan mij worden aangepast als dat uit studies noodzakelijk blijkt.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Grinwis en Goudzwaard ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het behouden van de geborgde zetels doch met een andere verdeling
Amends the water board law to drop the requirement that a daily board member hold a stakeholder seat and to fix two stakeholder seats per category.
removing the requirement that at least one member of the daily board hold a stakeholder seat and introducing a fixed distribution of stakeholder seats
het schrappen van de eis dat ten minste één lid van het dagelijks bestuur houder is van een geborgde zetel en het introduceren van een vaste verdeling van geborgde zetels
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Goudzwaard over het behoud van de geborgde zetels doch met een andere verdeling
Removes the requirement that a water board's executive committee include a guaranteed-seat member and instead sets a fixed allocation of guaranteed seats among stakeholder categories.
This amendment therefore removes the requirement that at least one member of the executive board must be a representative of a stakeholder category.
Met dit amendement wordt derhalve de eis geschrapt dat ten minste één lid van het dagelijks bestuur vertegenwoordiger moet zijn van een belangencategorie
Motie van het lid Minhas c.s. over een eventuele afschaffing van de geborgde zetels pas na 2023 in werking laten treden
Asks that changes abolishing guaranteed seats in water board elections take effect only after the 2023 water board elections.
to let the adopted amendments take effect after the 2023 water board elections
de aangenomen wijzigingen na de waterschapsverkiezingen van 2023 in werking te laten treden
Motie van het lid Goudzwaard over een substantiële salarisverhoging voor Defensiepersoneel
Asks the cabinet to work toward substantial salary increases for Defence personnel within the new defence budget.
requests the cabinet to work within the new defence budget toward substantial salary increases for Defence personnel
verzoekt het kabinet binnen het nieuwe Defensiebudget toe te werken naar substantiële salarisverhoging voor Defensiepersoneel
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over de intimidatie van klokkenluiders na kritiek op de Omgevingswet

An MP asks the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning what steps follow up on reports of intimidation of civil servants critical of the Omgevingswet, whether the ministry's climate and the DSO progress were presented too favourably, and whether the 1 January 2023 start date is still feasible. The minister says a conversation process with four reporters is underway, denies rosier reporting, and states the 1 January 2023 date remains the starting point with further information promised in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this in more detail in early October.
Ik verwacht begin oktober de Kamer hierover nader te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het bericht dat de Minister inzet op krimp van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, in 15 questions, about the planned reduction of Schiphol flight movements to 440,000 and its effects on the economy, competitors, noise, nitrogen, EU Balanced Approach procedures and legal certainty. The minister answered that the analysis shows 440,000 flights keep Schiphol well connected, that a cap-based norm and a stop to anticipatory enforcement are planned, and that the required EU and environmental procedures are being started, while several answers refer to the Hoofdlijnenbrief and to future procedures.
The cabinet will stop anticipatory enforcement in combination with continuing strict preferential runway use.
Het kabinet zal stoppen met anticiperend handhaven in combinatie met het voortzetten van het strikt preferentieel baangebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over de ILO-uitspraak met betrekking tot de arbeidsvoorwaardelijke eisen voor KLM

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister about an ILO Committee on Freedom of Association ruling finding the Dutch state wrongly failed to consult unions over labour conditions tied to the KLM rescue, and about whether a letter to KLM contradicted public statements on wage conditions. The minister replied that the state imposed no independent labour conditions, that the agreements stay binding until the aid is repaid, and that the ILO report has no legal effect, while largely declining to give details on the staff-reduction savings.
Information on the wage cost savings at KLM is commercially confidential and therefore, insofar as I have any such information, cannot be shared.
Informatie over de besparingen op de loonkosten van KLM is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan daarom, in zoverre ik daar al over beschik, niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het traineren van het onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

An MP asks why the health ministry only acted after the investigators' warning, whether it is obstructing the Deloitte probe into the face-mask deal (including withheld and filtered data and the private emails of a former minister), and whether delays endanger the report. The minister denies a deliberate conflict, says the ministry is cooperating and that the first report may slip to September because of extended hearing periods.
The research bureau submitted a formal request to the ministry asking for the CISO report with the investigation results on the ministry's correspondence.

Het onderzoeksbureau heeft bij het Ministerie van VWS een formeel verzoek ingediend waarin het bureau dit rapport met onderzoeksresultaten van de CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) van VWS opvraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het dreigend belastingdrama voor zzp’ers

An MP asked whether self-employed workers using the fiscal old-age reserve (FOR) are at risk of a large tax bill because they do not set aside money for it, and whether the reserve should be tied to a requirement to save the funds separately. The State Secretary answered that about 300,000 entrepreneurs hold a FOR, that a high tax claim is possible on release, and that the government will propose abolishing the FOR from 2023 in the Tax Plan 2023.
As part of the Tax Plan 2023, it will be proposed to abolish the FOR.
Als onderdeel van het Belastingplan 2023 zal worden voorgesteld de FOR af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over pilot om zorgexpats aan te trekken als deel van de oplossing tegen de personeelstekorten in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about recruiting specialised foreign nurses and whether the Netherlands should copy schemes in the UK and Ireland, plus shortage forecasts and licensing barriers. The minister answered that foreign recruitment is a last resort, that a review of the BIG licensing process is underway, and that no target figure or accelerated scheme will be set.
I will therefore carry out an exploration into how the process can be improved for care organisations that need foreign care staff.
Ik zal daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar hoe het proces kan worden verbeterd voor zorgorganisaties, die behoefte hebben aan buitenlands zorgpersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Goudzwaard en Eppink over Lelystad Airport

MPs Goudzwaard and Eppink asked the minister whether she would withdraw the refusal of Lelystad Airport's nitrogen permit, what grounds underlie it, what changes the airport must make, and how it responds to the threatened lawsuit. The minister answered that the PAS notification was verified and not eligible for legalisation, cited the grounds (emission factor and expanded road traffic area), said the airport must follow a regular permit procedure, and that the objection is still pending with RVO.
I informed the House of Representatives of my judgment on 7 March 2022.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer over mijn oordeel geïnformeerd op 7 maart 2022
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het blokkeren van IC-capaciteit tijdens de coronacrisis

MP Goudzwaard asks whether the health ministry discouraged hospitals from expanding IC capacity during the pandemic, citing disputes over subsidy conditions, legal threats and a possible rejected expansion. The minister denies discouraging expansion, acknowledges disputes with about fourteen hospitals over bed definitions and subsidy terms, and says a corrected bed list was adopted with hospitals given a choice to expand in phase 1, but the answers to the NRC journalist's questions were not available in time.
There was never any advice to cut beds.
Er is nooit geadviseerd bedden te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over "kleine opleiders die buiten de boot vallen omdat ze niet kwalificeren voor het STAP-budget",

MP Goudzwaard (JA21) asked whether the government will widen the STAP training budget to small providers that fail the turnover threshold of certain quality marks, and how large that group is. The ministers answer that STAP is being phased in via selected quality marks and branch organisations, a test framework for new quality marks is expected around summer, the size of the small-provider group cannot be precisely determined, and the issue is being prioritised.
Priority is currently being given to developing the assessment framework so that more quality marks can be given the opportunity to join the STAP training register.
Er wordt op dit moment prioriteit gegeven aan de ontwikkeling van het toetsingskader om meer keurmerken in de gelegenheid te stellen om aan te sluiten op het scholingsregister STAP-budget.

m: Motie van de leden Mei Li Vos en Remco Bosma over onderzoek naar de voorwaarden voor een bestendige concurrende markt
Motion asking the government to study conditions for a sustainable competitive postal market, commission market research on the non-time-critical business post market, and coordinate with the ACM.
calls on the government to investigate which essential conditions must be met to secure a sustainable competitive market in the longer term
roept de regering op, te onderzoeken aan welke essentiële voorwaarden moet zijn voldaan om een bestendige concurrerende markt op de langere termijn te borgen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het dreigende vertrek van onderzoeksafdelingen van veredelingsbedrijven door het uitblijven van support

An MP asked the state secretary about HZPC's threat to move its research department abroad over the lack of government support for new breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas, and about the government's proactive stance, the GMO classification, the risks of the techniques, and the Lodders and Remco Bosma motions. The government answered that it is monitoring the sector, keeps pressing the European Commission for clarity while treating products of new techniques as GMOs in the meantime, stresses that research with these techniques is possible in the Netherlands under conditions, and says it is still looking for a suitable way to organise a public debate.
Pending that, the Netherlands regards products obtained with these techniques as genetically modified organisms (GMOs).
In afwachting hiervan beschouwt Nederland voortbrengselen die met behulp van deze technieken zijn verkregen als genetisch gemodificeerde organismen (ggo's).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over slamming door telecomcowboys

The MP asks whether the minister knows of ACM warnings about slamming of small businesses, what steps have been taken against it, and what the ACM's proposal to extend the signed-contract requirement to businesses means. The minister answers that self-regulation talks among telecom providers are advanced but not yet agreed, that he is considering binding measures if self-regulation fails, and that he is cautious about extending the written-consent requirement to businesses, while promising a letter to parliament by end of March.
That is why I am considering binding measures should self-regulation fail.
Daarom beraad ik mij op mogelijke dwingende maatregelen indien zelfregulering niet slaagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het oponthoud van de aanleg van glasvezel in de provincie Overijssel

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays in fibre-optic broadband rollout in rural Overijssel, including state aid classification, wholesale access obligations, the provincial umbrella scheme and remaining unconnected households. The minister answers that the rules and steps are clear, that CIF has resumed preparations, and that the government will inform parliament about the umbrella scheme around summer, without addressing accountability for the delay itself.
As promised, the House will be informed further about the umbrella scheme around the summer.
Zoals toegezegd wordt de Kamer rond de zomer nader geïnformeerd over de koepelregeling

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het verschenen persbericht met als strekking dat er fouten door Agentschap Telecom zijn gemaakt bij de handhaving van de regiogerichtheidseis bij RadioNL

Parliamentarian Remco Bosma asked the minister whether Agentschap Telecom wrongly enforced the regional-orientation requirement against RadioNL, and how enforcement works. The minister rejected the claim of improper enforcement, described the rules and the disputed criteria, and said a licence reallocation is planned for the end of the year.
In my view, research into compliance with the regional-orientation requirement for RadioNL's programmes was carried out in a careful and proper manner.
Naar mijn oordeel is er op goede en zorgvuldige wijze onderzoek verricht naar de naleving van de regiogerichtheidseis bij de programma's van RadioNL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over vragen aan het Europese Hof van Justitie over GMO-regelgeving

An MP asked the State Secretary about the French Council of State's referral to the EU Court of Justice on GMO rules for gene-edited organisms, and whether such organisms should fall outside GMO regulation. The government answered that CRISPR-Cas9 safety must be assessed case by case, that Netherlands may submit written observations, and that its position is that gene-edited organisms should be treated as GMOs until the Commission decides.
The Dutch government intends to submit observations in line with the earlier cabinet policy line.
De Nederlandse regering is voornemens opmerkingen in te dienen conform eerdere kabinetsbeleidslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het uitblijven van support voor nieuwe veredelingstechnieken

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the EU has not yet clarified whether new plant breeding techniques fall under GMO rules, and why the Dutch government is not pressing harder for their free use. The State Secretary answered that Dutch pressure on the European Commission continues, that the Commission has deferred its response, and that a scientific advisory opinion is expected in the first half of 2017, while stating that the government cannot quantify the economic losses.
The cabinet has repeatedly pressed the European Commission for progress.
Het kabinet heeft bij de Europese Commissie meermalen aangedrongen op voortgang
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Bosman over een nieuwe graaftechniek voor kabels

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new cable-laying techniques, the standard 60 cm burial depth, who can authorise other depths, and liability for damage to cables. The minister replied that no statutory depth exists, that NEN norms are advisory, that municipalities can prescribe depths under the Telecommunicatiewet, and that liability is for the courts to decide under the WION.
There is no statutorily prescribed depth for laying cables.
Voor de aanleg van kabels bestaat geen wettelijk voorgeschreven diepte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Lodders over het inzichtelijk maken van marktbelemmeringen voor de export van agri-producten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the value of the Dutch onion sector, the number of trade missions involving agri-food and horticulture, the effect of the Russian import ban, and how export markets will be expanded. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch onion sector holds a strong world market position, that agri-food was represented on most economic missions in 2015 and 2016, and referred to earlier letters for the broader export strategy without listing concrete new commitments.

At 14 of the 21 economic missions organised by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency in 2015, the Agri & Food and/or Horticulture & Propagation Materials top sectors were represented; in 2016 this was the case at 13 of the 18 economic missions.

Bij 14 van de 21 economische missies die door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland zijn georganiseerd in 2015, waren de topsectoren Agri & Food en/of Tuinbouw & Uitgangsmaterialen vertegenwoordigd, in 2016 bij 13 van de 18 economische missies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over het opwerpen van functionaliteitsbeperkingen van consumentenproducten via firmware updates

MP Remco Bosma (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is lawful for a manufacturer to restrict a consumer electronics product's functionality through a firmware update, citing HP printers rejecting third-party ink. The minister answered that the answer depends on the contract and information provided, that normal use must remain possible even if the consumer declines the update, and that HP announced a corrective firmware update, with the ACM responsible for enforcement.
It is not for me but for the regulator, the ACM in this case, to determine whether there is an infringement.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de toezichthouder, de ACM in dit geval, om te bepalen of er sprake is van een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Remco Bosma over de uitwerking van de Europese Commissie met betrekking tot het voorstel om de roamingkosten binnen de Europese Unie af te schaffen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's proposal to limit abolition of EU roaming charges to 'normal use' (90 days per year, 30 consecutive), and whether this undermines a single European digital market. The minister answered that the proposal was withdrawn, that limits are needed to protect telecom operators and prevent domestic price rises, and that he will await the Commission's new proposal and negotiations on wholesale caps.
The withdrawn proposal of the European Commission elaborated what should be understood as normal use.
Het ingetrokken voorstel van de Europese Commissie werkte uit wat onder normaal gebruik moet worden verstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Bosma over de mislukte overname van PostNL door Bpost

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the failed takeover of PostNL by Belgian Bpost, including state influence, EU rules, the universal postal service and the level playing field. The minister says Bpost's Belgian state ownership is outside his view, the Commission found Belgian compensation compliant with state aid rules, PostNL is a private company, and he is studying the Dutch postal market and will review additional measures.
On the state of affairs and developments in the Dutch postal market, and therefore possible opportunities and risks, I am currently conducting research, as announced earlier this year to your House.
Naar de stand van zaken en ontwikkelingen op de Nederlandse postmarkt, en dus eventuele kansen en risico’s, doe ik momenteel onderzoek, zoals eerder dit jaar in uw Kamer aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Bosma naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Strijd tegen kiloknaller gaat nieuwe ronde in’

MPs Lodders and Bosma asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal welfare group Wakker Dier changing its definition of 'kiloknaller' (cheap-meat promotions), which produced a 40 percent rise in such promotions in 2015. The State Secretary said Wakker Dier may adapt its definition but must communicate the change clearly to avoid misleading consumers, and that the public debate concerns the desirability of such promotions rather than the definition used.
It is not desirable that Wakker Dier misleads consumers.
Het is echter niet gewenst dat Wakker Dier consumenten op het verkeerde been zet.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake het bericht ‘Student met handicap voelt zich verloren in het hoger onderwijs’ (nieuwe versie)

MP Özdil asked the Minister of Education about support for students with disabilities in higher education, including variation between institutions and municipalities and a call for an action plan on information and guidance. The minister said the 2016 student survey shows improved satisfaction, pointed to institutional autonomy and municipal discretion over study allowances, and committed to talks with stakeholders and an update on the action plan in spring 2018.
I am willing to enter into discussions with VNG, VH, VSNU, Handicap + Studie, ISO and LSVB about support for students with a disability.
Ik ben bereid in gesprek te gaan met VNG, VH, VSNU, Handicap + Studie, ISO en LSVB over de ondersteuning voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Kuik over de begeleiding van functiebeperkte studenten die te kort schiet

MPs Van der Molen and Kuik asked the ministers about the 2017 annual report on students with disabilities, uneven support across institutions, the inspectorate's role, and implementation of the UN disability convention. The minister replied that institutions are broadly adequate, that an Inspectorate study is underway with results expected spring 2018, and that a motion-based action plan is being worked out.
Furthermore, I can inform you that the inspectorate is currently conducting a study into the accessibility of higher education for students with a disability.
Verder kan ik u berichten dat de inspectie momenteel een onderzoek uitvoert naar de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de grote zorgen van Uneto-VNI over schreeuwende tekorten aan mensen met technische opleidingen

An MP asked the education minister about Uneto-VNI's concerns over shortages of technically trained workers, including closures of technical vmbo programmes and teacher quality. The ministers acknowledge the mismatch, point to the Techniekpact and the EUR 100 million technical vmbo investment, and say they expect regional cooperation to address teacher shortages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Raan over het bericht dat olie- en gasbedrijven het Nederlandse onderwijs beïnvloeden

MPs Kwint and Van Raan asked the Minister of Education whether oil and gas companies influence Dutch schools, citing a report on fossil-industry teaching materials, and whether such materials should be banned. The Minister saw no reason to believe pupils are targeted, said schools are responsible for choosing materials, and refused a ban because the teaching materials market is free.
I have no reason whatsoever to assume that pupils are being 'bombarded' by oil and gas companies with arguments 'from the fossil industry'.
Ik heb daarbij geen enkele aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat leerlingen door olie- en gasbedrijven «worden bestookt» met argumenten «van de fossiele industrie».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdamse werkgevers hun neus ophalen voor MBO’ers

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about a report that Amsterdam employers demand too high qualifications from MBO graduates, and whether this disadvantages low-educated and other groups. Minister Asscher answered that the labour market is improving, that the evidence on higher requirements is qualitative and contested, and pointed to existing policy instruments without committing to a new concrete step.
The UWV gives no quantitative substantiation here, so there is no indication of the size of this difference.
Het UWV geeft hierbij geen cijfermatige onderbouwing, waardoor er geen indicatie voorhanden is van de omvang van dit verschil.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over 'Het nut van onderwijsovereenkomsten in het mbo'

An MP asked the Minister of Education why vocational colleges (mbo) alone must use written education agreements with students, whether this adds value, and whether student rights could instead be secured in the WEB. The minister acknowledged signals that the written form adds little, promised a study into alternatives that protects student rights while limiting administrative burden, and said the study would be sent before year end.

I will examine whether this conclusion is correct and if so, how else the legal relationship between institution and student can be shaped so that on the one hand legal protection and the student's position relative to the institution are maintained

Ik zal onderzoeken of deze conclusie juist is en zo ja, op welke andere wijze de rechtsbetrekking tussen instelling en student kan worden vormgegeven zodat enerzijds de rechtsbescherming en de positie van de student ten opzichte van de instelling in stand blijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake de verslechterde positie van promovendi

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the PNN monitor showing worsening terms for PhD candidates, including a rise in short or part-time contracts, and whether the government will act on its recommendations. The Minister disputes that working conditions have worsened, argues the data covers only contract form and duration, and says promotion work should fit within the contract period while committing only to continued dialogue and to cao-based measures.
I am always willing to exchange views with those involved about the career prospects of PhD candidates.
Ik ben altijd bereid om met betrokkenen van gedachten te wisselen over de loopbaanperspectieven van promovendi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het besluit van de Provincie Noord-Brabant om vanaf 2018 een half miljoen te bezuinigen op de philharmonie zuidnederland

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Noord-Brabant's decision to cut half a million euro from the Philharmonie zuidnederland from 2018, including whether the province contacted the minister on its own in April 2017 and how this fits with the Raad voor Cultuur's advice to coordinate policy. The minister says the shared funding responsibility makes the unilateral cut disappointing, confirms the April call concerned development of the orchestra and not a cut, and says she has invited all subsidy partners to a bestuurlijk overleg.
I therefore find it disappointing that one of the subsidy partners is implementing a cut at such short notice without administrative consultation with the other subsidy providers.
Ik vind het daarom teleurstellend dat één van de subsidiepartners zonder bestuurlijk overleg met de andere subsidiegevers op zo’n korte termijn een bezuiniging doorvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de kamernood onder studenten in veel steden hoog is

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked ministers about reports of severe student housing shortages, growth of international students, possible homelessness and displacement of Dutch students, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged shortages mainly in the Randstad, argued the government does not steer international student numbers for financial reasons, said it cannot confirm homelessness data, and deferred funding and levy changes to a future cabinet.
No specific figures are available on any displacement of Dutch students searching for a room by international students.
Er zijn geen specifieke cijfers beschikbaar over eventuele verdringing van Nederlandse studenten die op zoek zijn naar een kamer door buitenlandse studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Özdil over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse studenten slapen noodgedwongen in azc's, op campings of in hotels’

Green Left MPs asked ministers about reports that foreign students were sleeping in asylum centres, campsites and hotels due to a shortage of student housing. The government attributes the problem to rising international and Dutch student numbers and tight housing markets, says institutions and municipalities are responsible, and promises ongoing consultations and monitoring without concrete new measures.
We are already in discussion with various knowledge institutions, Kences, the VH and the VSNU to gain more insight into the specific task regarding housing for international students

Wij zijn reeds in gesprek met verschillende kennisinstellingen, Kences, de VH en de VSNU om meer inzicht te krijgen in de specifieke opgave die er ligt voor de huisvesting van internationale studenten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Studeren vanuit een camper’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government recognises that housing shortages affect Dutch as well as international students in student cities, asked for per-city shortage and construction figures, and asked whether the problem is addressed beyond city boundaries. The minister acknowledges shortages in many student cities, gives a 2016 monitor table and construction projections per city, and says only that some cities look beyond their boundaries (Amsterdam via a coalition appeal).
No exact figures per student city can be given.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen per studentenstad te geven.
