Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake het bericht dat het ROC West-Brabant onwettig lesgeld vraagt

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that ROC West-Brabant charges students more than the legal tuition fee when they are not financially attractive to the institution, and about related funding and stapelen issues. The Minister called it unacceptable and a single incident by one manager, said no amounts were billed after intervention, promised the Inspectorate and MBO Raad will be asked to watch for similar cases, and defended the cascade funding model as balanced.
To prevent such an undesirable situation, I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to pay extra attention to this during its regular supervision.
Om een dergelijke ongewenste situatie te voorkomen zal ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken om hier tijdens het reguliere toezicht extra op te letten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht in de Volkskrant van 22 augustus jl. “Fraudejagers ministerie neuzen honderden keren in ov-chipkaarten”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how DUO checks and selects students for home visits and OV-card data use for fraud detection, given privacy law and a court ruling that the data use lacked legal basis. The minister answered that DUO acts within the Wet studiefinanciering, data protection law and ECHR Article 8, that home visits follow a protocol, and that the ruling is under appeal so no further comment is given.
An appeal has been lodged against this ruling with the Central Appeals Tribunal. Since this case is before the court, I cannot make further statements on it at this time.
Tegen deze uitspraak is hoger beroep aangetekend bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Aangezien deze zaak onder de rechter is, kan ik hierover op dit moment geen nadere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de afname van het aantal vrouwen in bestuurlijke topfuncties

An MP asks the minister about the decline in women on boards of listed companies and the non-realisation of the 30% target, and whether a statutory quota will be introduced before 2020. The minister acknowledges slow progress, points to a monitoring report due later, and defers any decision on a quota until then while noting self-regulation may be insufficient.
I therefore await the publication of the new corporate monitor in December.
Ik wacht daarom het verschijnen van de nieuwe bedrijvenmonitor in december af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het door DUO onnodig uitvragen van geslacht van (nieuwe) partner

Two D66 MPs asked why the student allowance form for scholieren (over-18 secondary pupils) asks for the sex of a parent's new partner, which they considered unnecessary. The minister attached the forms, explained that partner income is needed for the supplementary allowance and sex is used as a check on the citizen service number, and said DUO would assess the cost of a system change before a decision that will be left to her successor.
I have therefore asked DUO whether it is possible in the short term to adapt the system so that stating sex on the form is no longer necessary.
Ik heb dan ook bij DUO navraag gedaan of het op korte termijn mogelijk is het systeem zodanig aan te passen dat het opgeven van het geslacht op het formulier niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht 'Een groeiend aantal basisartsen moet wachten op een vervolgopleiding'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Özdil asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports that a growing number of newly graduated basic doctors cannot obtain a specialist training place, and whether government was steering this gap. The minister answered that there is no entitlement to a vervolgopleiding, that current intake is judged sufficient for most specialties, that a Capacity Council scenario analysis is pending, and that no measures are currently planned.
In assessing what is sufficient, the projections of the Capacity Council play an important role.
Bij de beoordeling van de vraag wat voldoende is, spelen de ramingen van het Capaciteitsorgaan 3 een belangrijke rol.
Vragen van het lid Futselaar (SP) aan de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het sluiten van studiecentra van de Open Universiteit (ingezonden 2 augustus 2017).

MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education whether the Open University's planned closure of study centres in Alkmaar, Breda, Den Haag and Emmen, despite negative advice from the works and student councils, is acceptable given lifelong learning goals and the 1996 explanatory memorandum. The Minister replied that the closures follow from digitalisation, that the college of governors is legally competent to decide, that online education and exam accommodations mitigate access concerns, and that she will not intervene in the decision.
Decision-making on closing study centres is an independent responsibility and competence of the OU's college of governors, which I as Minister cannot and will not intervene in.
De besluitvorming over sluiting van studiecentra is een eigenstandige verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid van het cvb van de OU, waar ik als Minister niet in kan en wil treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul inzake het bericht dat een mbo-student vanwege een spoedkeizersnede haar examens niet kon maken en daardoor het hele studiejaar over moet doen

MPs Kwint and Van den Hul asked whether a mbo student who missed her exams after an emergency caesarean and must repeat the whole year reflects a gap in rules protecting pregnant and student-parent students, and whether the minister will act on the adopted motion calling for a right to pregnancy leave and individual exam programmes. The minister answered that institutions can already offer tailored support, that the student must repeat the year as she missed too much, that consultations with stakeholders are ongoing with a handreiking and a letter to parliament planned for autumn, and saw no reason to intervene in this case.
I still hold the view that the legal position of student mothers and pregnant students is well secured in laws and regulations.
Ik ben nog steeds van mening dat de rechtspositie van studerende moeders en zwangere studenten goed geborgd is in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar inzake het bericht 'studenten weg vanwege collegegeldschuld'

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked about reports that students drop out over tuition debt, and about a proposal to pay benefits directly to institutions, and whether the government would collect national figures and change DUO's administration. The Minister rejected direct tuition payments to institutions for now, citing administrative costs, pointed to hogeschool coaching and municipal debt relief, and promised to await a research project before deciding.
Institutions are not obliged to report this information and I therefore do not have national total figures.
Instellingen zijn niet verplicht deze informatie te rapporteren en ik beschik derhalve niet over landelijke totaalcijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over ‘dat seksuele voorlichting op scholen niet voldoet’

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that sex education in schools is inadequate, including inspectorate findings that many schools do nothing on sexual boundary-crossing behaviour, and whether schools can be compelled to meet core objectives and whether the duty should extend to upper secondary and vocational students. The government answered that schools have freedom in choosing methods, will improve information on intervention effectiveness, notes the inspectorate can impose sanctions for non-compliance, and says it will not extend the curriculum requirements beyond what is already in place.
If a school does not give effect to statutory requirements, the inspectorate will instruct the school to bring its education into line with them.
Als een school geen invulling geeft aan wettelijke eisen, zal de inspectie de school opdracht geven het onderwijs daar alsnog mee in overeenstemming te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Beckerman en Gijs van Dijk over werkbezoek aan de Reede van Texel waar historische scheepswrakken uit de 16e, 17e en 18e eeuw in de zeebodem dreigen te vergaan en over het congres ‘SO

MPs from CDA, SP and PvdA asked whether the government will act on the erosion of historic shipwrecks in Dutch coastal waters, including a programmatic approach requested by coastal provinces, a bigger role for volunteer divers, adjusted working-conditions rules for diving, and a national maritime archaeology museum. The minister acknowledged the erosion problem, said talks with the provinces aim for initial agreements by end 2017 and a proposal in spring 2018, committed to consulting amateur diving associations on an exemption, said the working-conditions rules will be examined with the Social Affairs minister, and argued that maritime heritage is already displayed across several museums.
We have agreed to reach initial agreements by the end of 2017.
We hebben afgesproken om voor het einde van 2017 tot eerste afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, Bruins en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Onderwijsinspectie uitleg wil over fouten in het vwo-eindexamen Frans

MPs asked the Minister about teacher complaints over errors in the VWO French final exam and whether the College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) fixed them via correction-guideline additions and normering. The State Secretary answered that CvTE handled 95 signals, issued a correction-guideline addition changing three questions, and that the Inspectie found the handling correct, while declining to judge the signals substantively.
I myself do not enter into the substantive assessment or evaluation of signals about central examinations.
Zelf treed ik niet in de inhoudelijke beoordeling of waardering van signalen over centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over monumenten in het aardbevingsgebied

An MP asked the ministers whether the NAM has bought listed farmhouses and other heritage buildings in the Groningen earthquake area, what will happen to them, and how unlisted characteristic buildings are protected from demolition. The minister answered that NAM owns eight listed monuments plus 74 objects in total, that municipalities are still inventorying characteristic buildings, and that protection runs through zoning plans and a heritage programme, without committing to new state powers.
At this moment it is not known whether this portfolio also contains characteristic and/or defining buildings.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend of zich in deze portefeuille ook beeldbepalende en/of karakteristieke gebouwen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de banden tussen het onderwijs en de fossiele brandstofindustrie

An MP asks the Education Minister about ties between schools and fossil fuel companies, including misleading classroom materials, sponsorship rules, and curriculum involvement. The government says schools are responsible for their own partnerships and materials, the sponsorship covenant is adequate, and it will evaluate the covenant in 2018 but does not intend to ban fossil fuel firms from schools.
It is not for us to assess whether teaching material conflicts with the covenant.
Het is niet aan ons om te beoordelen of lesmateriaal in strijd is met het convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inzet van 70-plussers

An MP asked whether the age limit of 70 for DUO exam surveillants (and whether governments can set age limits for employing 70-plussers) bars valued staff, and whether exceptions or a broader review are possible given the higher AOW age. The state secretary confirmed the 70 limit applies to CvTE/DUO exam staff, said it is not a uniform government rule, and agreed to have the CvTE explore adjusting the limit, with a report to parliament by end 2017.
I am willing to have the CvTE explore whether there are possibilities to adjust this age limit.
Ik ben bereid om het CvTE te laten verkennen of er mogelijkheden zijn om deze leeftijdsgrens aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht Nederland moet ook Duitse diploma’s erkennen

Three CDA MPs asked the education minister about calls for mutual recognition of Dutch and German (NRW) diplomas, cross-border vocational programmes and Euregio schools. The minister said recognition in higher education is largely settled, that trust in vocational (mbo) diplomas is still lacking, that bilateral and Benelux talks continue, and that new cross-border mbo programmes would require legislative change only once internationalisation policy matures.
Our policy starting point is that mutual acceptance of diplomas in higher education is well arranged, through earlier EU and Benelux actions.
Ons beleidsuitgangspunt daarbij is dat de wederzijdse acceptatie van diploma's in het hoger onderwijs goed geregeld is, door eerdere acties van de EU en de Benelux.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Kwint over het bericht dat de schrijfvaardigheid van kinderen achteruit holt

MPs Futselaar and Kwint asked whether children's handwriting is deteriorating and whether schools and teacher training neglect handwriting instruction. The State Secretary answered that the 2012 Cito survey found no significant decline since 1999, that handwriting practice remains common, and that the curriculum question will be addressed by new development teams.
I therefore have no reason to assume that the handwriting development of pupils in primary school is deteriorating.
Ik heb daarom geen reden aan te nemen dat de handschriftontwikkeling van leerlingen op de basisschool achteruit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over opleidingen die studenten nog steeds laten betalen voor verplichte excursies, educatieve games of andere onderdelen van het studieprogramma

An MP asked the minister how she would respond to reports that universities and universities of applied sciences still charge students for compulsory excursions and educational games without offering free alternatives, and whether inspectors should fine the institutions. The minister replied that the inspectorate has contacted the institutions, several have pledged to stop charging or improve information, remaining cases are under discussion, and the inspectorate can in the extreme case impose a fine.
If additional costs are attached to a part of the programme, the student must be offered a free alternative.
Als aan een onderdeel van de opleiding extra kosten zijn verbonden, moet de student een kosteloos alternatief worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de filmrollen van de geheime dienst die mogelijk betrekking hebben op de 'affaire Sanders'

An SP MP asked why microfilm rolls transferred from the intelligence service to the National Archives in 2001 have not been digitised, whether their quality is deteriorating, and whether they will be digitised and their contents made public. The minister replied that digitisation is not required unless the material condition demands it, that microfilms can last 200 to 500 years, that AIVD and the Archives are now studying how to digitise them, and that public access is restricted until 2025 for privacy reasons.

When the archive of the Bureau Nationale Veiligheid was transferred to the National Archives, a restriction on public access to the entire archive until 2025 was imposed to respect the privacy of those involved.

Bij het overbrengen van het archief van Bureau Nationale Veiligheid naar het Nationaal Archief is, met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkenen, een beperking aan de openbaarheid van het hele archief gesteld tot 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over het artikel "Scholen steken voor onderwijs bedoelde miljoenen in de kachel"

Two MPs asked the government whether it is undesirable that school boards spend education funds on cleaning, maintenance and energy, and whether it will act on school energy use and building sustainability. The State Secretary answered that lump-sum funding gives school boards freedom of spending, that primary school finances are sound, and pointed to existing energy rules and a subsidy scheme for school sustainability advice.
School boards themselves weigh whether to spend more or less on materials or personnel.
Schoolbesturen maken zelf de afweging om meer of minder middelen uit te geven aan materieel of personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een regionaal kwalitatief, dekkend en toegankelijk aanbod van voortgezet onderwijs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MP Van den Hul asked the state secretary about the Inspectorate's plan to place Zwin College under adjusted financial supervision due to falling pupil numbers, the consequences, and the government's role in securing secondary education in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate may require a recovery plan, rejected the consultant's advice as unconvincing, and said a robust joint plan is expected by mid-October with ministry support.
I have already informed those involved in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen that I will support the taskforce, which will work on developing a plan over the coming weeks and months, where necessary and desired.
Ik heb de betrokkenen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen al laten weten dat ik de taskforce, die de komende weken en maanden bezig gaat om een plan te ontwikkelen, waar nodig en waar gewenst ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat stageplekken soms ‘verkapte werkplekken zijn, waar je geen cent voor krijgt’

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked the ministers whether internships are sometimes disguised regular jobs without pay, how often complaints occur, whether complaints are reported to SBB and the Inspectorate, what the rules on allowances are, and whether a study or safeguards are needed. The minister answers that abuse occurs mainly after graduation, that a sector analysis is underway, that complaints are few and under-reported, that the Inspectorate handles individual reports but does not mediate them, and that no extra study of in-school internships is needed.
To better map the extent of internship abuse after graduation in problem sectors, the Minister of SZW is having a study carried out.
Om de omvang van stagemisbruik na afstuderen in probleemsectoren beter in beeld te brengen laat de Minister van SZW een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de huisvestingsplannen van Horizon College en Regio College in Purmerend

An MP asked the education minister why the ministry and inspectorate oppose the shared housing plans of two Purmerend vocational colleges, whether public housing finance rules block it, and why the ministry did not comment when the plans were submitted in 2015. The minister said talks are ongoing, cited the WEB rules on efficient use of funds, said ministry review of the 2015 loan application covered only collateral and not the plans' legality or efficiency, and promised a study of obstacles.
To gain better insight into possible obstacles posed by current laws and regulations to shared housing, I will have a study carried out this year in the (v)mbo and ho sectors.
Om beter zicht te krijgen op eventuele belemmeringen van de huidige wet- en regelgeving bij gedeelde huisvesting laat ik nog dit jaar een onderzoek uitvoeren in de sectoren (v)mbo en ho.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de classificatie van transpersonen binnen de aankomende International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11)

An MP asked the ministers whether transgender classification in the draft ICD-11 should move out of the mental disorders chapter, and whether the government would support the proposal and end the categorisation of transgender identity as a mental or behavioural disorder. The minister agreed that gender identity should not be treated as an illness, said she would convey her position to the WHO-FIC and TNN and ask to be kept informed, but did not commit to a formal endorsement or a fixed position on the WHO process.
I will bring my position to the attention of the WHO-FIC with the request to convey this position to the WHO.
Ik zal mijn standpunt in deze onder de aandacht brengen van het WHO-FIC met het verzoek dit standpunt in te brengen bij de WHO
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat docenten van het Zandvlietcollege in Den Haag Geert Wilders en de PVV demoniseren

An MP from the PVV asked the Education Minister whether teachers at a Den Haag school who allegedly compared Geert Wilders to Hitler were indoctrinating pupils, and whether the school board should be pressed to stop it and the teacher removed. The State Secretary answered that the school denies the account, no signals or inspection reports confirm it, no talks with the board are planned, and removing the teacher is not warranted.
I see no reason to hold a conversation with the board of this school.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een gesprek met het bestuur van deze school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de combinatie studie en mantelzorg funest is voor studiesucces in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the education minister whether universities, universities of applied sciences and vocational colleges adequately accommodate students who are also caregivers, and whether flexible arrangements should be promoted and funded. The minister found no signals of structural under-support, acknowledged that caregiver students fall behind in their studies, and pointed to the flexstudy experiment as a step toward flexibility while leaving the specific measures to institutions.

I have therefore asked the umbrella organisations (the Vereniging Hogescholen and the VSNU) whether they have received signals indicating that institutions insufficiently take account of caregiver students.
Ik heb daarom aan de koepelorganisaties (de Vereniging Hogescholen en de VSNU) gevraagd of zij signalen hebben ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Waarom moeten studenten betalen voor een bestuursjaar?'

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that students serving as full-time student board members must still pay tuition despite not studying, and whether institutions should proactively grant the tuition exemption created by their amendment. The minister answered that the exemption is optional and left to institutional boards and works-council agreements, that the 87% figure refers to 53 of 61 full-time student board members, and that she will alert student organisations and sector associations and reports on the flexstuderen experiment.
The board makes arrangements with the works council on how the board grants are filled in.
Het bestuur maakt met de medezeggenschap afspraken over de invulling van de bestuursbeurzen.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over dagelijkse ramadanlezingen op de website van ‘Instituut Dar el Huda’

PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch public primary school hosting daily Ramadan lectures on a mosque institute's website is acceptable, whether similar cases exist, and whether harsh measures or closure of Islamic schools will be taken. The government replied that the lectures are a rental of a room in the evening by an outside foundation, not a school activity, that no violation of law exists so no measures are warranted, and that closing Islamic schools would violate constitutional freedoms of religion and education.
It is not recorded whether rooms in buildings housing a school are rented out and what these rooms are then used for.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden of ruimtes in gebouwen waar een school in is gevestigd worden verhuurd en waar deze ruimtes dan voor worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Fokker-opleiding is failliet, studenten zitten in onzekerheid’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether a macro-efficiency review had led to ending a Fokker/parts-certification course at VTOC, and why quality and student demand were not weighed. The minister replied that no decision was taken by the ministry; an independent advisory committee (CMMBO) advised ROC Aventus to phase out its aviation maintenance courses, Aventus adopted this, and students are being helped to finish their degrees elsewhere.
I have asked Aventus, as the body responsible for vocational education for these students, to ensure that students can complete their education.
Ik heb Aventus als verantwoordelijke voor het mbo-onderwijs aan deze studenten gevraagd om te zorgen dat studenten hun opleiding kunnen afronden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat drie Leidse hoogleraren twintig jaar lang een schrikbewind hebben gevoerd op het Instituut Pedagogische Wetenschappen van de Universiteit Leiden

An MP asked whether the Minister would press the University of Leiden to dismiss three professors accused of running a reign of terror at an institute for twenty years, and whether governance failures were to blame. The Minister answered that the university board has already taken action, including an investigation and a new scientific director, and that employment matters are the employer's responsibility, so she will not intervene.
I do not share this view. The Executive Board of Leiden University and the Faculty Board of the Faculty of Social Sciences took action some time ago
Ik deel deze mening niet. Het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit Leiden en het Faculteitsbestuur van de faculteit Sociale Wetenschappen hebben al een tijd geleden actie ondernomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Vertrek hoogleraren Universiteit Leiden geëist om schrikbewind'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports of a climate of fear at a Leiden University institute and whether the problem was known earlier. The minister answered that working climate is a matter between employer and employees, that the university board has already acted, and that she will take no further steps.
The working climate at a university institute department is a matter between employer and employee.
Het werkklimaat bij de afdeling van een instituut van een universiteit is een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar inzake het bericht dat de Groningse Universiteitskrant geen volledig onafhankelijke journalistiek kan bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Groningen university newspaper can be fully independent, after reports of pressure to soften critical articles about the university board's Yantai plans. The minister answered that editorial independence is guaranteed by the statutes and an editorial council, that the editorial council found no censorship though the editor-in-chief acted clumsily, and that she sees no reason for new legislation or further investigation.
They judged that there was no question of censorship.
Zij oordeelde dat er geen sprake was van censuur.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Kwint over het bericht van fraude met tentamens door mbo-docenten op ROC Zadkine in Rotterdam

Kwint (SP) asked whether pressure on schools to award diplomas quickly and in large numbers raises the risk of exam fraud by vocational teachers at ROC Zadkine. Minister Bussemaker condemned the conduct as unacceptable and said she knows of no link between the funding method and fraud risk.
A link between the way institutions are funded and the risk of committing fraud is not known to me.
Een verband tussen de wijze van bekostiging van instellingen en het risico op het plegen van fraude is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over de kwaliteit van lokale media

MPs Van Raak and Kwint asked the government about the decline of local journalism, its role in democratic oversight of municipalities, the funding of local media, and municipal communications staff. The state secretary answered that declining advertising revenue drives media cuts rather than the 2017 public broadcasting cut, that a separate fund for local journalism is not warranted given existing subsidies, and that municipalities may communicate as they wish.
You will receive the research outline before the summer recess.
U ontvangt de onderzoeksopzet voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kwint en Beckerman over archeologische topvondsten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman asked the minister about archaeological top finds whose costly follow-up research may be unaffordable for municipalities, and about extending the 2015 one-off fund, an excess-cost scheme and funding for maritime and synthesis research. The minister said the regular costs are borne by initiators, rejected reinstating the excess-cost scheme, and will decide on the fund's continuation after an evaluation due by 1 September 2017, deferring cost estimates.
I will inform the House about this before 1 September 2017.
Ik zal uw kamer hierover voor 1 september 2017 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er een halvering van de zendtijd dreigt voor onderzoeksprogramma's

An SP MP asked whether the government shares concern over a proposed halving of airtime for investigative programmes at the public broadcaster and whether a fund for (regional) investigative journalism should be created. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO is independent in programming, that it is not cutting investigative journalism but prioritising quality, and that no new fund is needed since the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Journalistiek already exists.
I will not ask the NPO to make different choices in its programming.
Ik zal de NPO niet vragen om andere keuzes in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de stijging van het aantal naaktfoto's en filmpjes van jongeren

MP Kuiken asked the Education and Justice ministers about the rise in sexting among youth, the normalisation of the practice, the lack of education on it, and when new sex-crime legislation would arrive. The government replied that schools must teach sexuality and resilience, that new sexting programmes and a barrier model are being developed, that the panel figures are not recognised, and that a bill is expected for consultation in summer 2017.
It is expected that a bill modernising sex-crime legislation will be ready for consultation in the summer of this year.
Naar verwachting zal een wetsvoorstel tot modernisering van de zedenwetgeving in de zomer van dit jaar gereed zijn voor consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat InHolland lerarenopleidingen afstoot en gaat doorverwijzen naar de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

MP Kwint asked the minister about InHolland's plan to phase out its teacher-training programmes and refer students to the Hogeschool van Amsterdam, and about the broader teacher shortage, including Germans teachers. The minister answered that the government is monitoring the transfer, that a teacher-shortage plan is underway, and that she will discuss the matter with the sector bodies, while the works council's complaint about being informed too late was acknowledged with apologies from the college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over enkele berichten over de plannen van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) voor een campus in Yantai, China

An MP asked the education minister about the University of Groningen's preparations for a campus in Yantai, China, including costs of about two million euro, a trip for the university council, and whether the plans would be reconsidered after parliamentary concerns about academic freedom. The minister replied that the campus must be privately financed, that approval under a forthcoming law and AMvB will be required, that there has been no substantive contact with the university since the debate, and that the trip costs (within a 700,000 euro budget) are privately funded.
It is not for me to dictate to institutions how they spend private funds, as long as they transparently report the separation between the public and private money flows.

Het is niet aan mij om aan instellingen op te leggen waaraan zij de private middelen wel of niet besteden, zolang zij transparant verslag leggen van de scheiding tussen de publieke en private geldstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat ruim 300 studenten de Hogeschool Rotterdam hebben verlaten vanwege openstaande collegegeldschulden

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the 306 students who left Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences in September over unpaid tuition debts, and about the causes, national figures, and whether tuition costs or direct DUO payment should change. The Minister acknowledged the seriousness, cited existing legal rules and the tuition credit, said no national figures exist, pointed to debt-relief support, and rejected changes to the WHW for direct payment.

My officials will consult with the colleagues from SZW and with the NVVK, the trade association for debt relief and social banking, to examine how to ensure this vulnerable group finds the way to debt relief.
Mijn ambtenaren zullen samen met de collega's van SZW in overleg treden met de NVVK, de branchevereniging voor schuldhulpverlening en sociaal bankieren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht studenten weg vanwege collegegeldschuld

An MP asked the education minister about reports that about 300 students at Hogeschool Rotterdam were removed for unpaid tuition, and whether DUO could pay the tuition credit directly to institutions. The minister confirmed the figures, said no national data exist, rejected direct payment to institutions for administrative and motivational reasons, and pointed to debt counselling, while accepting that a law change would be needed.

My officials will consult with colleagues at SZW and with the NVVK, the trade association for debt counselling and social banking, to examine how this vulnerable group can find its way to debt counselling and receive appropriate support.

Mijn ambtenaren zullen samen met de collega’s van SZW in overleg treden met de NVVK, de branchevereniging voor schuldhulpverlening en sociaal bankieren, met als doel te bezien hoe we ervoor kunnen zorgen dat deze kwetsbare groep de weg naar de schuldhulpverlening vindt en passende ondersteuning krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in Indonesië twee homoseksuele mannen vandaag 85 stokslagen hebben gekregen en 141 mannen in een 'homosauna' zijn gearresteerd

The MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knew of the caning of two gay men in Aceh and the arrest of 141 men in a Jakarta 'homosauna', what steps the government had taken, and how it would press Indonesia to stop such treatment. The minister confirmed the events, described the diplomatic steps taken (the human rights ambassador's visit, an EU demarche, and a planned EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue) and said the government would continue to raise concerns about LHBTI rights bilaterally and in the EU.
The Netherlands will bilaterally and within the EU, in regular contacts with the Indonesian government, voice its concern about the situation of LHBTI persons in Indonesia
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband in reguliere contacten met de Indonesische overheid zijn zorg uitspreken over de situatie van LHBTI's in Indonesië
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat er studenten zijn die twee opleidingen volgen, maar geen twee diploma’s ontvangen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that students following two specialisations within one master's programme receive only one diploma, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that one programme yields one certificate with a diploma supplement showing the tracks, that institutions may choose broad or narrow programmes, and that the CROHO register may be modernised to add information on tracks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over voortzetting en verharding van de ontgroeningsrituelen bij studentenverenigingen

An MP asked the education minister about reports of escalating hazing rituals at student associations, including abuse, humiliation and sexism, and whether institutions are reporting incidents transparently and whether sanctions should be used. The minister called such signals serious, said institutions must act and be transparent, rejected financial or legal sanctions in favour of norm-setting, and committed to appointing confidential contact persons and continuing to press institutions.
I find it worrying if it indeed appears that educational institutions do not have a full picture of the excesses occurring at student associations and are not taking sufficient action against them.
Ik vind het zorgwekkend als inderdaad blijkt dat onderwijsinstellingen geen volledig beeld hebben van voorkomende excessen bij studentenverenigingen en daar onvoldoende tegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de afhandeling van onrechtmatig afgegeven bindende studieadviezen

An MP asked the minister how institutions should remedy unlawfully issued binding study advices (BSA) and whether students who missed appeal deadlines should be informed and readmitted. The minister said institutions should treat affected students generously and that students may appeal refusals, but declined to intervene in disputes between institutions and students and to judge liability or the duty to inform.
I do not intervene in disputes between institutions and students.
Ik treed niet in geschillen tussen instellingen en studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het uitzendbureau Maandag het lerarentekort commercieel probeert te exploiteren

MP Kwint asked the minister whether staffing agency Maandag's practice of offering teacher lease cars and permanent contracts, including to unqualified teachers, amounts to commercially exploiting the teacher shortage, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary replied that schools are responsible for recruitment, that the government monitors unqualified teaching and will examine any monopoly position with the competition authority if warranted, but it does not intend to change the legal exceptions for unqualified teachers.
I am not aware of the situation as you describe it.
Ik ben niet bekend met de situatie zoals u die omschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het evenement 'VOC-Dag' van Bataviawerf

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Bataviawerf 'VOC-Dag' event, whether colonial crimes such as slavery are sufficiently addressed by government-funded initiatives and school curricula, and whether the VOC period should be treated as a black chapter. The Minister answered that Bataviawerf is an independent foundation responsible for its own programme, that government-funded institutions cover the negative sides of the VOC, and that slavery is already part of the formal curriculum.
I intend to support a coordination point, to be housed at NiNsee, so that attention to the history of slavery and its effects can be better aligned, made accessible and made durably visible.

Ik ben voornemens een coördinatiepunt te ondersteunen, bij het NiNsee onder te brengen, waarmee de aandacht voor het slavernijverleden en de doorwerking ervan beter kunnen worden afgestemd, ontsloten, en duurzaam zichtbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over taalgebruik op de lerarenopleidingen

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether teacher-training colleges tolerate poor Dutch-language skills among trainee teachers and whether schools in Rotterdam South have teachers without perfect Dutch. The minister answered that high language standards apply, that schools' boards are responsible for competent staff, and that she sees no reason to call colleges to account.
I have no reason to call the VH and the teacher-training colleges to account on this point.
Ik heb geen reden om de VH en de lerarenopleidingen op dit punt aan te spreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de helft van de Vlaamse promovendi kampt met psychische gezondheidsklachten

Opposition MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Flemish and Dutch surveys showing high rates of mental health complaints among PhD candidates warrant large-scale national research and what she will do about workload. The minister acknowledged the findings, placed primary responsibility with universities and their workload plans, and declined to commit to a national study.

I see it as the responsibility of the institutions to determine whether national research is needed into possible work-related mental health complaints among their employees in general and among PhD candidates in particular.

Ik zie het als de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen om te bepalen of een landelijk onderzoek nodig is naar eventuele werkgerelateerde psychische gezondheidsklachten onder hun werknemers in het algemeen en onder promovendi in het bijzonder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de overseksualisering van kinderen

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked about the Council of Europe's concern over the sexualisation of children, the role of media and advertising regulation, and whether sanctions via the Advertising Code Committee are adequate. The state secretary answered that existing youth-protection rules, education on sexuality, and self-regulation (RCC, NICAM) are sufficient for now, that a Dutch monitoring study is pending, and that OCW will raise modernisation of youth-protection rules with RCC and NICAM.
In contacts with the Advertising Code Committee (RCC) and the Netherlands Institute for the Classification of Audiovisual Media (NICAM), the Ministry of OCW will raise this matter.
In de contacten met de Reclame Code Commissie (RCC) en het Nederlands Instituut voor de Classificatie van Audiovisuele Media (NICAM) zal het Ministerie van OCW dit ter sprake brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Overheid moet oog hebben voor shariarecht’

PVV MPs asked whether the government should resist sharia influence, given a university chair studying good parts of sharia law, and asked who funds it. The minister answered that Dutch public order limits foreign law and that existing private international law rules are sufficient, without naming the chair's funder in detail.
The application of foreign law in the Netherlands and the recognition of legal facts or relationships established abroad always find their limit in Dutch public order.

De toepassing van buitenlands recht in Nederland en de erkenning van in het buitenland tot stand gekomen rechtsfeiten of rechtsverhoudingen vinden echter altijd hun grens in de Nederlandse openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Van der Molen inzake numeri fixi bij technische universiteiten

MPs Duisenberg and Van der Molen asked the minister about numerus fixus places at technical universities, the number of students turned away, and funding pressure on research. The minister answered that about 91 students could not enter their first-choice technical programme in 2016/17, that 2017/18 figures are not yet known, and that the investment fund proposal falls outside what a demissionary minister should take a position on.
Whether there will actually be a large over-enrolment in the eight TU programmes with a numerus fixus in academic year 2017–2018, I cannot say now.
Of er daadwerkelijk sprake zal zijn van een grote overinschrijving van de acht TU-opleidingen met een numerus fixus in collegejaar 2017–2018, kan ik nu niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat kinderen en jongeren steeds slechter lezen

MP Kwint asked the minister how she views a report claiming one in ten pupils in group 8 and one in three MBO-2 students do not sufficiently master Dutch, and whether a growing low-literacy generation is acceptable. The minister disputes the report's picture, citing low failure rates on the Centrale Eindtoets and stable PISA results, while describing existing and planned measures such as the Tel mee met Taal programme and a summer 2017 proposal on reading performance.
I have taken note of this report.
Ik heb kennis genomen van dit rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht “Laaggeletterdheid kost 1 miljard”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report that low literacy costs 1 billion euro, the rising number of low-literate youths, and whether more earmarked funding is needed. The minister answered that the cost increase reflects a broader target-group definition, noted the budget increase to about 75 million euro per year, and promised a progress report and further studies later in the year.
In the autumn I will inform you of the results and in a letter address the follow-up approach to low literacy.
In het najaar zal ik u informeren over de resultaten en in een brief ingaan op de vervolgaanpak van laaggeletterdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over techniekopleidingen die ingehaald worden door nieuwe ontwikkelingen

An MP (Wiersma, VVD) asks the Minister of Education whether vocational technical training is keeping pace with labour market needs and whether private providers should be publicly funded via demand financing; he also asks about the shortage of technical teachers and whether mbo should move to accreditation. The Minister answers that the mbo has been made more responsive through reforms and a regional investment fund, rejects private demand-financed providers and accreditation, and calls on employers to offer more apprenticeships and internships.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) op de vingers heeft getikt over schulden van studenten

An SP MP asked the Education Minister how to respond to the National Ombudsman's criticism of DUO's communication on student debts, and whether the government should stop the student travel product automatically. The minister said DUO's communication is being improved, an independent study into automatic termination of the travel product is under way with results expected in autumn 2017, and she rejects the claim that the loan system worsened student debt.
I welcome the concrete recommendations from the National Ombudsman's investigation, because I too attach great value to good and up-to-date information on debts and payment arrears.
Ik ben blij met de concrete aanbevelingen uit het onderzoek van de Nationale ombudsman, want ook ik hecht grote waarde aan goede en eigentijdse informatie over schulden en betalingsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Torenhoge boetes door niet stopzetten van studentenreisproduct’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Nationale ombudsman's report on fines imposed on former students who failed to cancel their public transport card, and whether DUO should stop reminders, referrals to bailiffs and CJIB, and how it will handle outdated email addresses and minors. The Minister rejected the claim that operators profit at students' expense, declined to halt referrals while the automatic-cancellation study runs, and deferred the remaining questions to a reply to the ombudsman's report before summer.
No, I see no reason to do so.
Nee, ik zie daartoe geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over selectiecriteria in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about master's selection criteria in higher education, including whether programmes that only select students from outside their own university are counted as selective and why language tests are excluded. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate's definitive report and her response will follow shortly, defined selective programmes, and said the discrepancy and the question of quality uncertainty are being discussed with the universities and student bodies.
In the short term I will send the House the definitive report of the Inspectorate and my response to it.
Op korte termijn stuur ik uw Kamer het definitieve rapport van de inspectie en mijn reactie hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over promotiefraude aan de Tilburg University

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about alleged fraud by former dean Arie de Ruijter at Tilburg University, including payments to relatives' companies, the incentive effects of the promotion bonus, the quality of PhDs supervised, and his side jobs and salary. The minister answers that the Inspectorate investigated, the university reported the case to the prosecutor, the Hol committee found no scientific fraud, the promotion parameter is being capped, and that side-job and salary questions fall outside her ministry's remit.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education (IvhO) to conduct an investigation.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (IvhO) gevraagd om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het artikel ‘Wapens bij bestuurslid imamschool’

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports of fraud, weapons possession and people smuggling involving a board member of the Islamic University of Europe, and whether the Inspectorate and the minister can act, including on the institution's misleading use of the name 'university'. The minister condemned the conduct, said the Inspectorate's investigation is ongoing without a firm timeline, outlined intervention powers (warning, then withdrawal of degree-awarding authority), and committed to bringing the Name and Degree Protection Act into force by 1 June 2017 with fines as a sanction.
I will share the Inspectorate's conclusions with your House in due course.
Ik zal de conclusies van de inspectie te zijner tijd met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Studenten betalen 93 miljoen euro boete aan OV-bedrijven'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that students pay large fines to public transport companies for not stopping their student travel product on time, and what the status is of the legislation and motions on this. The minister confirmed about 93.6 million euros went to transport companies as compensation, said fines are the responsibility of the (former) student, and reported improvements to communication and an ongoing study into automatic termination, with a novelle to follow.
I understand that it is very annoying for (former) students to have to pay such a fine.
Ik begrijp dat het voor (oud-)studenten heel vervelend is om zo’n boete te moeten betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de christelijke studentenvereniging Navigators niet in aanmerking komt voor een bestuursbeurs bij de Haagse Hogeschool

An MP asked the minister whether it was right that the Haagse Hogeschool denied a board grant and student-association recognition to the Christian student association Navigators, and whether this amounted to unequal treatment on religious grounds. The minister replied that Navigators fails the institution's conditions (open access to all students and alignment with the institution's emancipation-oriented basis, given its evangelising statutes), that religion is not the basis of the decision, and that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens could be consulted.
I do not see that the Haagse Hogeschool makes a distinction on the basis of religion.
Ik zie niet dat de Haagse Hogeschool onderscheid maakt naar godsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het feit dat voor de zoveelste keer een zelfmoord wordt gepleegd ten gevolge van sexting

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about a suicide linked to sexting and bullying, asking about school responsibility, investigation, victim support, internet providers, the Dutch Data Protection Authority budget, the Kindertelefoon, and legal action. The state secretary answered that school anti-bullying duties and sexting education exist, that a police investigation is ongoing, and that IP-address identification is increasingly unreliable, while stating that bullying itself is not a crime.
The police are currently investigating this case both online and offline.
De politie is op dit moment zowel online als offline bezig met een onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over onrecht als gevolg van de invoering van het leenstelsel voor studenten

An SP MP asked the minister about child benefit ending for parents when minors start higher education, arguing it turns into a student debt and deters ambitious youths, and asked whether the loan system should be reversed. The minister replied that studiefinanciering replaces child benefit, that the change is not unequal or deterring, that the monitor shows 62% of students used the loan, and that the loan system will not be reversed.
It is not being considered to adjust the system.
Er wordt niet overwogen het systeem aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de stijging van de studieschuld

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that student debt has risen sharply since 2015, and about its link to social background, repayment rates and the state debt. The Minister says debt rose from 15.8 to 17.6 billion euro, that the 17.9 billion figure is an ISO estimate consistent with the ministry's budget, and promises updated monitor data in May.
I expect to be able to send you this report in May.
Ik verwacht u deze rapportage in mei te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake hogescholen en universiteiten die onrechtmatige studiekosten in rekening brengen bij studenten.

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions charging students extra mandatory fees beyond tuition, tied to study credits, is unlawful, and what the Minister will do about it. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said such charges are undesirable and that the Inspectorate has been asked to assess them with enforcement if needed, and committed to working with the ISO and reviewing the rules with institutional bodies.
The ISO has since sent me the inventory and it was then shared with the Inspectorate of Education. I have asked the inspectorate to assess this.
Het ISO heeft mij de inventarisatie inmiddels doen toekomen en deze is vervolgens gedeeld met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs. Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over hogescholen en universiteiten die onrechtmatige studiekosten in rekening brengen bij studenten

The SP MP asks the Minister of Education why universities and universities of applied sciences still charge students unlawful study costs and what will be done to enforce the rules. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate will act if unlawful fees are found, has received the ISO inventory, and will discuss information provision with the sector associations.
Should it turn out that an institution indeed charges study costs unlawfully, the Inspectorate will hold the institution to account and take enforcement action where necessary.
Mocht blijken dat een instelling inderdaad onterecht studiekosten in rekening brengt, dan zal de inspectie de instelling daarop aanspreken en zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht “veel discriminatie transgenders op werk”

An MP asks the ministers whether reported workplace discrimination against transgender people (40% reported experiencing it) is acceptable and what measures will reduce it, including complaints, prosecution and inspection. The government answers that the survey is not representative but that the group is vulnerable, cites existing action plans, the Inspectorate's antidiscrimination checks of employers, TNN campaigns and the planned repetition of the 2016 campaign, without committing to new legislation beyond the pending Bergkamp bill.
It is indeed worrying that many transgender people face discrimination in the workplace, or do not feel free to be themselves at work.
Het is inderdaad zorgelijk dat veel transgenders te maken hebben met discriminatie op de werkvloer, of niet de ruimte voelen om zichzelf te zijn op het werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over de mogelijkheid voor (pleeg)kinderen om het inkomen van ouders bij een aanvullende beurs buiten beschouwing te laten

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how DUO assesses requests to disregard parental income for supplementary student grants in cases of severed contact or serious conflict, including what documentation is required and whether requiring students to describe private conflicts is acceptable. The minister answered that DUO needs a range of evidence depending on the situation, that students may need to provide personal statements, that DUO can depart from professional statements, and that decisions follow the legal framework and internal work instructions.
The framework on which DUO bases a decision consists of the legal framework, made up of statutes and regulations and their explanatory notes.
Het afwegingskader op basis waarvan DUO een beslissing neemt wordt gevormd door het wettelijk kader, bestaande uit de wet- en regelgeving en de daarbij behorende toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Weyenberg over jonge vrouwen die vaak in deeltijd werken

MPs Dijkstra and Van Weyenberg asked about young women working part-time more often than men, its causes, its long-term effects on economic independence, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that causes are not yet clear and are being studied in a joint OCW/SCP project, and points to existing awareness and budgeting initiatives and general part-time work rules, without committing to new legislation.
The causes are not yet clear now; that is precisely the subject of the research.
De oorzaken zijn nu nog niet duidelijk, dat is juist onderwerp van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het artikel "Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman hekelt regeloerwoud in mbo"

MPs Siderius (SP) asked the Minister of Education about the Amsterdam Children's Ombudsman's findings that mbo vocational colleges have complex complaint procedures that leave students stuck, including cases of a chronically ill student charged tuition and a pregnant student unilaterally deregistered. The Minister disputes that the findings apply nationally, points to existing complaint-law reforms and the Inspectorate's enforcement powers, and says no nationwide scale-up is needed.
The Amsterdam Children's Ombudsman's research specifically concerns the complaint procedures of the mbo institutions ROC van Amsterdam and ROC TOP.
Het onderzoek van de Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman gaat specifiek over de klachtenprocedures van de mbo-instellingen ROC van Amsterdam en ROC TOP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat mbo-scholen veel tijd kwijt zijn aan het wegwerken van taal- en rekenachterstanden bij hun studenten

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education about reports that MBO schools spend much time remedying students' language and arithmetic deficiencies, and whether holding pupils back is discouraged. The minister acknowledged the concern, stated that schools decide on retention themselves with alternatives like summer schools, promised a further analysis and possible additional measures, but did not have data on individual school lesson cancellations.
I do not have the data on lesson cancellations at individual schools.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens over lesuitval van individuele scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over een knokpartij tussen hooligans van Feyenoord en AZ

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about a staged fight between Feyenoord and AZ hooligans, whether crimes were committed, and whether the state tolerates such violence. Minister Blok answered that the public prosecutor has opened an investigation, that such violence is criminal and unacceptable, and that research into hooligan fights is underway with results expected before summer.
The public prosecution services of Alkmaar and Rotterdam have started an investigation.
Het OM Alkmaar en het OM Rotterdam zijn een onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a junior UvA researcher on a jihad study had posted online statements praising jihadist fighters, and whether this warrants prosecution and a response from the university. The government condemned the statements, said the UvA disavowed them, declined to comment on individual prosecutions, and treated the methodological debate as a matter of academic freedom outside ministerial involvement.
As your House knows, the Minister of Security and Justice does not make statements about individual (criminal) cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet doet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie geen mededelingen over individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

PVV MPs asked whether a report that a UvA jihad researcher expressed support for IS fighters is used in prosecutions of Syria travellers, and what will be done to stop alleged misuse of education, and whether returnees can be barred. The government said the prosecution has no knowledge of the report being used in court, that academic quality is for the academic community to judge, and that it will act only against clear discrimination or calls to armed jihad; on travellers it described existing prosecution, monitoring and new nationality-revocation powers.
It is for the academic community to assess and qualify the scholarly character of research.
Het is aan de academische gemeenschap om het wetenschappelijk karakter van onderzoek te beoordelen en te kwalificeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het behoud van de unieke stripverzameling Matla, de grootste collectie stripverzameling in Nederland (170.000 boeken en tijdschriften), die gereed staat voor overdracht naar de

An MP asked the minister whether the government would help finance the purchase of the Matla comic book collection by the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, to prevent it being sold to private owners, and what would happen if no agreement on price is reached. The minister acknowledged the collection's cultural value, referred the MP to the Mondriaan Fonds for possible funding, and declined to speculate on consequences of a failed acquisition.

There is little point in anticipating the ongoing negotiations between the KB and potential sponsors from the cultural field or speculating on possible consequences if the KB cannot acquire the collection.

Het heeft weinig zin vooruit te lopen op de lopende onderhandelingen tussen de KB en potentiële sponsoren uit het culturele veld en te speculeren op eventuele consequenties als de KB de collectie niet kan verwerven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante over prijzige stoomcursussen voor aankomende studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether expensive commercial 'stoomcursussen' preparing students for selection days create inequality and what the government will do about selection in higher education. The minister agreed they are undesirable, said schools and institutions should prepare students and that numerus fixus programmes fell from 199 to 91, and pointed to LOB reforms and access initiatives without committing to new binding measures.
I find it very undesirable when candidate students feel the need to use such commercial steam courses.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst wanneer kandidaat-studenten de noodzaak ervaren gebruik te moeten maken van dergelijke commerciële stoomcursussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de uitvoering van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about implementation of the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), including the government's stance on a CEDAW Committee recommendation to compensate self-employed women who gave birth in 2005, sexism, intersex and transgender care, abortion pill rules, sex work registration, and a conference. The government answered most questions by restating its positions, citing pending Centrale Raad van Beroep cases, and promising to inform parliament of outcomes.
Several procedures are currently pending before the Central Appeals Tribunal. The cabinet is waiting for those rulings.
Er lopen nu enkele procedures bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Die uitspraken wacht het kabinet af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het uitroepen van regenboogprovincies

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about provinces Drenthe, Groningen and Gelderland launching a joint anti-discrimination and LGBT acceptance policy with rainbow municipalities, and whether such support and a regional rainbow covenant could be offered. The Minister confirmed the initiative, welcomed Drenthe's regional coordination role, pointed to existing national resources (Movisie, IDAHOT week, PinkLink) and said she is positive about a provincial rainbow covenant.
I am positive about a rainbow covenant with the provinces.
Ik ben positief over een regenboogconvenant bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Maij over het bericht dat het COA niks zou doen tegen homo-hatende asielzoekers

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether COA staff fail to intervene against asylum seekers who threaten LGBT residents, and how such conduct is addressed, protected and prevented. The government denies the picture, describes its sanctions, reporting and staff-coordination measures, and sees no reason for additional measures.
The picture that COA staff would not intervene against residents threatening LGBT residents is, however, not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat medewerkers van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) niet zouden ingrijpen richting bewoners die LHBT-bewoners bedreigen herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht van 29 november 2016 dat kansenongelijkheid op middelbare scholen de afgelopen jaren is toegenomen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report claiming educational inequality in secondary schools has grown, and whether private tutoring worsens it, and whether the government will commit to research on shadow education and fund school-based support. The government says the report came from a private research bureau, that the evidence on private tutoring is mixed, that it accepts the duty to provide high-quality support but parents may still choose private help, and that it will commission research on shadow education and report to parliament.
Are you willing to start research into the extent and implications of shadow education, including on the black market?
Bent u bereid om een onderzoek te starten naar de omvang en implicaties van het schaduwonderwijs, ook op de zwarte markt?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de problemen van agrarische ondernemers in de Oudebildtdijk

MPs Rutte, Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked whether designating the Oude and Nieuwe Bildtdijken as a protected village landscape (beschermd dorpsgezicht), including about 2,500 hectares of farmland, would restrict farmers' operations, and whether the farmland should be excluded. Minister Bussemaker replied that the designation is based on cultural-historical values, does not aim to block farming, leaves the existing zoning plan in force, and that she sees no reason to reconsider or exclude farmland, while offering a protocol with the municipality and province and awaiting a pending Council of State appeal.

I have already indicated to the municipality of Het Bildt and the province of Fryslân that I am willing to draw up, together with them and the agricultural sector, a protocol on agricultural business operations in relation to the status of the protected village landscape.

Ik heb de gemeente Het Bildt en de provincie Fryslân al aangegeven bereid te zijn om samen met hen en de agrarische sector een protocol op te stellen over de agrarische bedrijfsvoering in relatie tot de status van het beschermd dorpsgezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over financiering van de ambtsopleidingen per 1 januari 2017

An MP asks whether the government's plan to channel structural funding for religious ambtsopleidingen through the VU is wise, given weak accountability and doubts about the content of Islamic training. The minister answers that the funding change clarifies arrangements and reduces administrative burden, that accountability now runs through VU annual reports, and that she supports training imams in Dutch democratic values, without halting the funding.
I have also indicated that I will evaluate this change in five years.
Ook heb ik aangegeven dat ik deze wijziging over vijf jaar zal evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over het bericht 'Vrouwenquotum voor bedrijven is zwaktebod'

An MP asks the Education minister whether she suggested fining companies that miss the 30% female board target and whether this amounts to a de facto quota, and how that fits her view that quotas are a last resort. The minister says companies must comply with the comply-or-explain rule, that fines could be justified if they fail to report, that the approach is self-regulation, and that sanctions will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet bestuur en toezicht.
If companies do not comply with what the law requires, in my view that could justify a fine.
Als bedrijven zich niet houden aan wat de wet vraagt, zou dat mijns inziens een boete kunnen rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inmenging in kerkelijke vieringen door de gemeente Eindhoven

An SGP MP asked whether the municipality of Eindhoven was pressuring the Catharina church parish over its services by tying organ maintenance to changes in worship, and whether this breached the state's duty to stay out of church affairs. The minister answered that the 1974 loan agreement governs use of the church, that maintenance is a statutory duty of the owner independent of the agreement, that government must not interfere in internal church matters, and that he will not intervene in the parties' agreements.
Every owner of a national monument is required under the Heritage Act to carry out the maintenance necessary for its preservation.
Iedere eigenaar van een rijksmonument is in het kader van de Erfgoedwet verplicht het voor de instandhouding noodzakelijke onderhoud te plegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Pechtold over het bericht dat de koninklijke familie heimelijk erfgoed heeft verkocht zonder dit eerst aan Nederlandse musea aan te bieden

MPs Monasch and Pechtold asked about reports that the royal family secretly sold heritage (an atlas and the painting Boschbrand) without first offering it to Dutch museums. The minister answered that the sales were private transactions within existing law, that the export permit followed the normal review, and that the works were private property, without committing to new action.
It concerns a private matter. This sale between private parties took place in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het betreft een privéaangelegenheid. Deze verkoop tussen particulieren is tot stand gekomen in overeenstemming met de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Asante over het vertrek van een leerling van het Waterlant College

MPs Vermue and Asante asked about a pupil who left Waterlant College after reportedly being the only white pupil in his class and facing bullying, and about segregation and parental involvement in schools. The state secretary called the situation undesirable, said the Inspectorate has been in contact with the school and will discuss the case with the governing body, and pointed to existing anti-bullying duties and support tools without committing to a new investigation.
Following earlier contact with the school management, the inspectorate will discuss this case with the competent authority of Waterlant College in the short term.
In vervolg op het eerdere contact met de schoolleiding zal de inspectie deze zaak op korte termijn bespreken met het bevoegd gezag van het Waterlant College.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over dubbele kinderbijslag voor uitwonende minderjarige leerlingen die een beroepsopleiding volgen die op weinig plekken in Nederland wordt aangeboden

An SP MP asked whether the list of rare vocational courses qualifying for double child benefit for students living away from home for education should be widened, including Media Management and Music Industry Professional. The minister replied that the under-10-institutions criterion is applied as set, that the lists are updated annually, that the two courses were excluded for 2016-2017 because they had more than 10 institutions in 2015, and that hardship cases are handled by the SVB.

The courses Media Management and Music Industry Professional are not included in the annex to the Regulation on double child benefit for educational reasons for the 2016-2017 school year because on 1 October 2015 these courses had participants enrolled at 10 institutions.

De opleidingen Media Management en Music Industry Professional zijn niet opgenomen in de bijlage bij de Regeling dubbele kinderbijslag om onderwijsredenen voor het schooljaar 2016–2017 omdat voor deze opleidingen op 1 oktober 2015 op 10 instellingen deelnemers stonden ingeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante inzake het aanbod van psychische hulp voor studenten

Two MPs asked the ministers whether student psychological help is adequately provided and facilitated across higher education institutions, and whether taboos and access barriers are being addressed. The minister answered that institutions decide staffing, that national norms are unnecessary, that all universities offer psychological help, and that regular mental health care and open institutional culture are the proper routes.
It is up to the institutions themselves to decide how many student psychologists they appoint.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoeveel studentpsychologen zij aanstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ree over het artikel ‘Diploma’s zonder examens’ uit het Dagblad van het Noorden

MP Van der Ree asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report that students at Alfa-College in Groningen received diplomas without completing all exams, and about unrest at one location. The Minister answered that no diplomas were wrongly issued, that the Inspectorate is investigating and monitoring the institution, and that the problems appear to be an incident rather than structural, with a bill on exam committees submitted.
On 14 November 2016 the Inspectorate visited the location and discussed the current situation with the Executive Board.
Op 14 november 2016 heeft de inspectie de locatie bezocht en met het College van Bestuur de actuele situatie besproken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het persbericht van Promovendi Netwerk Nederland (PNN) dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) wettelijke regels overtreedt bij deelname aan het experiment met promotiestud

An MP asked the Minister of Education about allegations that the University of Groningen broke rules in joining the promovendi experiment (shorter PhD tracks, excess intake, a financial reserve memo, and a possible side deal on a continuation scheme). The Minister rejected the allegations, saying the university complied with the Besluit and that the memo reflected only an early view of some officials and not the board's position.
The RUG has not violated the rules for participation in the experiment.
De RUG heeft de regels voor deelname aan het experiment niet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf  over de actieve bemoeienis van de minister van Sociale Zaken met Zwarte Piet

PVV MPs asked why the Minister of Social Affairs is involved in the Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet debate, which other feasts he engages with, who attended his round table and why a declaration was requested. The minister answered that the government sees a role in facilitating respectful dialogue but rejects a state ban, and listed the round-table participants and said the declaration originated with the participants.
The cabinet is of the view that a state ban on Zwarte Piet is not the way out.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een verbod op Zwarte Piet van staatswege niet de uitweg is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over het artikel ‘Schoolbestuur, waar is uw jaarrekening?’

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked about a press report finding that many school boards do not publish their annual reports, despite agreements in the Good Governance Code, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary confirms the problem, says the government will amend sector laws and the reporting regulation to require publication if the agreements are not kept, and refers to the Inspectorate's forthcoming report.
