Afterwards, further instructions on publishing the full annual report, consisting of the board report, the financial statements and other relevant documents, will be given in the Regulation on Education Annual Reporting.

Daarna worden in de Regeling Jaarverslaggeving Onderwijs nadere aanwijzingen omtrent de openbaarmaking van het gehele jaarverslag, bestaand uit zowel het bestuursverslag, de jaarrekening en overige relevante stukken gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over gesubsidieerde anti-Zwarte Piet-activisten

An MP asked the minister whether deBuren, a Dutch-Flemish cultural centre, should lose its subsidy for its political stance against Zwarte Piet, and whether the minister would stop funding it. The minister answered that deBuren is an independent organisation mandated to host debate, that controversy alone is no reason to withdraw funding, and that the subsidy will continue.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schier eindeloze nasleep van de calamiteit in mei 2007 in het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMC Groningen), waarbij Jelmer Mulder buitengewoon ernstige en onherste

MP Leijten and Van Gerven ask the ministers about the long-running legal dispute after the 2007 UMC Groningen calamity that left baby Jelmer Mulder with severe brain damage, questioning the IGZ's handling, the hospital's conduct in court, and whether the minister can direct the hospital to settle. The minister replies that the IGZ report cannot be published, that the IGZ has apologised and offered compensation, that civil liability is for the civil court, and that the IGZ cannot use its Wkkgz instruction power to force settlement of a civil claim.
The IGZ report of 14 July 2011, as well as the IGZ report of 6 December 2010 withdrawn by the IGZ, is not public.
Het rapport van de IGZ van 14 juli 2011, evenals het door de IGZ ingetrokken rapport d.d. 6 december 2010, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht "Veel verborgen leed bij ex-AC-ers"

An MP asked the education minister about reports that gifted-education students from the closed Aloysius College in The Hague were left without adequate continuation, and whether the motion asking for quality to be preserved was honoured. The state secretary answered that about 90 percent of students got their first-choice school, that funding followed the students and an extra amount went to Zandvliet College, that the inspectorate raised no quality concerns, and that gifted education continues for grade 7 and 8 pupils.
As indicated earlier in this answer, there was no complete takeover of the gifted education department.
Zoals eerder in deze beantwoording aangegeven is er geen sprake geweest van een volledige overname van de afdeling «gifted education».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het ontbreken van schoolboeken op een school in Bonaire

An MP asked whether the VWO school Liseo Bonairiano on Bonaire still lacked textbooks for several subjects, what caused it, whether other schools were affected, and how equal education standards are guaranteed across the Dutch Caribbean. The Staatssecretaris answered that late sea delivery of books caused shortages, teachers used self-made materials so no lesson time was lost, all books are now present, no other schools report problems, and a second education agenda for Caribbean Netherlands is being signed.
The board of the Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is responsible for ordering and keeping the books in stock.
Het bestuur van de Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is verantwoordelijk voor het bestellen en op voorraad hebben van de boeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante over Mantelzorgende studenten

Two MPs asked the state secretary and education minister about carer students' stress, dropout and support by institutions and municipalities. The government answered that support is case-by-case via study advisers and hardship funds, pointed to municipal duties under the Wmo 2015, and described a flexible-study experiment, without committing to new national programmes.
In a letter to the aldermen I will ask for attention to this.
In een brief aan de wethouders zal ik hier aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het persbericht van Promovendi Netwerk Nederland dat 10% van alle promovendi een dubieuze aanstelling aangeboden krijgt

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers about a PNN press release claiming 10% of PhD candidates receive dubious short or part-time contracts that may evade the Wwz. The minister replied that such contracts are lawful, reflect tailored PhD tracks, and that she will keep talking with PNN and send a letter on careers.
The PNN research concerns vacancy texts.
Het onderzoek van het Promovendi Netwerk Nederland (PNN) heeft betrekking op vacatureteksten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Lespakketten over Zwarte Piet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a municipality (Maassluis) was distributing controversial lesson packs on Zwarte Piet to primary schools, including a quiz with racist-tinged questions, and whether the mayor should be urged to stop. The state secretary replied that the municipality only helped connect schools with an outside foundation, that schools decide their own teaching materials, that the government takes no position on the origins of Piet, and that it would not intervene.
No lesson packs are distributed to primary schools from the municipality of Maassluis.
Vanuit de gemeente Maassluis worden geen lespakketten onder basisscholen verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over de identiteitsverklaring van het Hoornbeeck College

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Hoornbeeck College's identity declaration, requiring membership of one of six churches and acceptance of only the Statenvertaling, conflicts with the WEB's limits on refusing admission. The Minister answered that the institution may ask prospective students to respect its foundation, that the 2013 amendment unintentionally removed the option for levels 3-4 which the 2017 law restores, and that complaints can go to the college's complaints committee or a court, with the Inspectorate possibly investigating after 1 August 2017.
An aspirant student can also submit the decision of the Hoornbeeck College to the court.
Ook kan een aspirant-student het besluit van het Hoornbeeck College voorleggen aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Yücel over het terugtreden van de enige vrouw in de RvB van ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Yücel asked the government about the departure of the only woman on ABN AMRO's management board, the gender diversity shortfall in the financial sector, and what the state as shareholder will do to reach the 30 percent target. The minister answered that the state will press ABN AMRO to nominate a woman, has asked NLFI to discuss diversity measures, and points to the reinstated statutory target and monitoring in 2019.
If a board does not meet the target, I as shareholder request that the company make an effort to nominate a woman.
Indien een raad niet voldoet aan het streefcijfer, vraag ik als aandeelhouder een inspanningsverplichting van de onderneming om een vrouw voor te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de TU Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked the minister whether TU Eindhoven had excluded the religious student association Ichthus Eindhoven from a board grant on religious grounds, in conflict with equal-treatment law. The minister answered that the TU/e has reconsidered its initial plan, that Ichthus may apply for a grant assessed under the existing criteria, and that religious identity is not a ground for exclusion but also not a reason for support.
I am of the view that the criteria in the TU/e policy framework ensure equal treatment.
Ik ben van mening dat de criteria in het beleidskader van de TU/e een gelijke behandeling borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Duisenberg over het bericht dat bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht opnieuw royaal hebben gedeclareerd

MPs Van Dijk and Duisenberg asked the minister whether Utrecht University board members' lavish declarations (luxury hotels, business-class flights) after stricter rules were introduced are acceptable, and whether the accountant's reports were acted on. The minister replied that the inspectorate will investigate the accountant's flagged shortcomings and the declarations deviating from the regulation, will report by spring 2017, and that new uniform declaration rules apply from 2017.

The inspectorate will carry out further investigation into the shortcomings and will therefore examine the declarations and allowances to Utrecht University board members that deviate from the declaration regulation.

De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de tekortkomingen en zal dan ook de declaraties en vergoedingen aan bestuurders van de Universiteit Utrecht in ogenschouw nemen die afwijken van het declaratiereglement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht dat TU Eindhoven zich nu ook genoodzaakt voelt om voor vier studies een numerus fixus in te stellen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about TU Eindhoven's plan to introduce numerus fixus for four programmes, and whether this, together with other technical programmes' caps, reflects funding problems and a shortage of technical graduates. The Minister said TU Eindhoven will only examine numerus fixus for 2018-2019, denied a tripling of caps, explained the funding model, rejected claims about per-student costs and falling budgets, and placed part of the responsibility for graduates' career choices on employers while agreeing to talks with universities and industry.
Question 11: Are you willing to hold talks with universities and representatives from the top sectors to seek a solution? Answer 11: Yes.
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om gesprekken aan te gaan met universiteiten en afgevaardigden vanuit de topsectoren om een oplossing te zoeken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ree inzake De impact van automatisering op het Nederlandse onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report on the impact of automation on Dutch education, including whether study programmes should be assessed for labour-market efficiency and what will be done about students choosing programmes with poor job prospects. The minister agreed technological change will reshape jobs, pointed to existing vocational and higher-education measures (macrodoelmatigheid policy, study-choice information, career guidance), but gave no new commitments beyond planned letters.
The ten-point plan "attack on dropout" was responded to in the earlier-mentioned letter on career guidance dated 26 September.
Op het tienpuntenplan «aanval op uitval» is met de eerder genoemde Kamerbrief Loopbaanoriëntatie en -begeleiding van 26 september jl. gereageerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over de berichten “De bangalijst van Vindicat”, “Vindicat gaat door stof en stuurt 13 leden naar huis” en “Studentencorps Vindicat schorst makers ‘bangalijst’”

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Vindicat student corps 'bangalijst', a list ranking women in a degrading way, and whether the university board and victims should act. The Minister called the list a deep privacy violation and sexual intimidation, asked the university board to consider action against the association, and said she would report on sector consultations and school safety rules in the emancipation debate.
That is why I have also asked the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen for clarification and asked the executive board to consider steps against the student association.
Daarom heb ik ook opheldering gevraagd bij de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen en het college van bestuur gevraagd zich te beraden op stappen tegen de studentenvereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake ontgroeningen door studentenverenigingen van studenten aan universiteiten en hogescholen

An MP asked the education minister how she views the hazing (ontgroening) practices of student associations at Groningen and Amsterdam, whether the Groningen university's initial response and the association's culture are acceptable, and whether she will force universities to impose harsher sanctions. The minister condemned the incidents, said the university and the Hanzehogeschool have agreed hazing must end, spoke with the national association council, and said she will keep discussing sanctions with institutions without committing to binding measures.
I expect them to act firmly against student associations where such unacceptable incidents take place.
Ik verwacht dat zij stevig optreden tegen studentenverenigingen waar dergelijke ontoelaatbare incidenten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat promotiestudenten volgens arbeidsrechtsadvocaten een arbeidscontract kunnen eisen

MPs Van Meenen and Van Dijk asked whether PhD students can enforce an employment contract in court, as some labour lawyers claim, and what this means for the experiment with PhD education. The minister answered that the employment relationship depends on actual practice, that the universities shape this themselves, and that any case where a PhD student became an employee would be considered in the evaluation of the experiment.
If the court rules that there is no PhD student but an employee-PhD candidate, the rules applicable to employee-PhD candidates apply.
Als de rechter oordeelt dat geen sprake is van een promotiestudent, maar van een werknemer-promovendus, dan gelden de voor de werknemer-promovendus geldende regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake Studiefinanciering bij een schakeljaar

An MP asks whether students on bridging programmes (schakeltrajecten) that are not counted as full-time education can be denied student finance by DUO, and how this is justified. The minister answers that such programmes are not accredited degree programmes, are self-funded like other contract education, and students can use savings, work, parental support or living at home; a ResearchNed study on their number is pending and will be sent in early 2017.
These programmes are not accredited courses and do not lead to a diploma, but facilitate progression.
Deze trajecten zijn geen geaccrediteerde opleidingen en leiden niet op tot een diploma, maar faciliteren doorstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht ‘Geen gedeeltelijke herbouw van het Genneperhuis’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether partial physical rebuilding of the Genneperhuis ruin in Gennep should be ruled out, and about its heritage status, the Keverberg precedent and RCE cooperation. The Minister answered that the RCE advised that rebuilding would overly damage the monument's archaeological and historical value, so it is not an option, but alternatives such as limited visualisation or a virtual presentation could be discussed.
Over the implementation of these alternatives, one can certainly talk.
Over de uitvoering van deze alternatieven valt zeker te praten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen inzake het bericht ‘berger plundert oorlogsgraf’ in de Telegraaf van 21 september 2016

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a Terschelling salvage diver plundered the WWI wreck HMS Queen Mary, whether Dutch law can act against it, and what the government will do. The minister says Dutch law does not apply outside Dutch jurisdiction, so the Netherlands cannot act itself, and that the UK would have to act against its own nationals or pursue the Panamanian flag state.
The wreck in question, however, lies in an area far outside the jurisdiction of the Netherlands. Article 5.1 of the Heritage Act therefore does not apply here.
Het betreffende scheepswrak ligt echter in een gebied ver buiten de jurisdictie van Nederland. Artikel 5.1 van de Erfgoedwet is hier dus niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘FME: numerus fixus is omgekeerde wereld’

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister why technical universities are introducing a numerus fixus despite past extra funding and the Techniekpact goal of more technical students. The minister answered that quality comes first, that a temporary numerus fixus can be justified, that institutions are autonomous, and that she will keep talking with the technical universities.
This first of all fits with the autonomy of the institutions themselves to shape their own (financial) policy well.
Het past in de eerste plaats bij de autonomie van de instellingen zelf om hun eigen (financiële) beleid goed vorm te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat weinig Nederlanders werk vinden in Duitsland

MPs from ChristenUnie and CDA asked about a report that few Dutch people seek work in Germany, and about the Actieteam grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid, INTERREG funding and cross-border information points. The minister acknowledges untapped cross-border job potential, describes ongoing Actieteam work with results promised in Q1 2017, and notes that border information point funding is temporary with an SZW evaluation planned for 2018.
As far as can now be seen, the cabinet will inform you of the results of the Actieteam by the first quarter of 2017 at the latest.
Naar het zich nu laat aanzien, wordt u uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal 2017 door het kabinet geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het Actieteam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Mohandis over problemen in de doorstroom vmbo-mbo

MPs Vermue and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about vmbo graduates under 16 being refused entry to mbo, allegedly due to funding rules, incomplete files or weak motivation, leaving them at home without education. The minister denied that funding depends on age, explained the legal admission rules and leerplicht exemptions, said she lacks data on how many students are affected, and pointed to a bill granting a right of admission to mbo.
However, I do not have information that can confirm or deny the extent to which this actually occurs.
Ik beschik echter niet over informatie die kan bevestigen of ontkennen in hoeverre dit ook daadwerkelijk voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de politie in Istanbul leden van de Gay Pride-organisatie heeft gearresteerd

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knew the official reason for Istanbul police arresting Gay Pride organisers, and how it would respond to Turkey's treatment of LGBTI rights. The ministers answered that Turkish authorities gave no official reason, that the government regrets the cancelled Pride but accepts possible security motives, and that it funds LGBTI projects in Turkey and raises the issue in EU accession talks.
The Turkish authorities have not given an official explanation for why these people were briefly detained.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben geen officiële verklaring gegeven waarom deze mensen korte tijd zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over diploma-erkenning in Duitsland

MP Straus asked the Minister of Education about recognition of Dutch vocational diplomas in Germany, the motion to negotiate with German states, and timelines. The Minister said recognition problems are limited to about 150 regulated professions, ongoing bilateral talks with North Rhine-Westphalia and Lower Saxony are under way with expert working groups, and no deadline can yet be given.
Work is being done hard on implementing the motion. I cannot yet name a deadline, because I cannot decide this alone.
Er wordt hard gewerkt aan de uitvoering van de motie. Een deadline kan ik nog niet noemen, omdat ik dit niet alléén kan beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake Nijmegen wil eerste universitaire PABO starten

An MP asked the education minister about plans by Radboud University Nijmegen to launch a university teacher-training route for primary education, and whether the government supports it. The minister answered that she welcomes it as a complement to existing routes, that the programme is targeted for September 2017 subject to national approval tests, and that it aligns with the 2014-2020 sector agreement's goal of more academically trained teachers.
I am positive about the development of the university teacher-training programme.
Ik sta positief tegenover de ontwikkeling van de universitaire pabo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat basisscholen waarschuwen voor een groot lerarentekort

An MP asked the minister about reports of a looming primary school teacher shortage, including causes, effects on other sectors, quality and workload, and whether salaries and funding should rise. The government answered that a shortfall of about 7,000 FTE is expected by 2024 due to retirements, falling graduate numbers and rising pupil numbers, and pointed to existing investment, sector agreements and recruitment initiatives without committing to new funding.
We will inform the House in autumn 2016 by letter about the most recent state of affairs on the education labour market.
Wij zullen uw Kamer in het najaar van 2016 via een brief informeren over de meest recente stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake protest tegen het bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA)

MP Van Dijk asked the minister about protests against the joint UvA/HvA board, including calls for separation, the appointment procedure, and board-member combinations of roles. The minister rejected the claim that cooperation failed, noted the planned split is being discussed with the university community, and stated that the Raad van Toezicht chair remains in place after the UvA board resigned.
Before definitive steps are taken, the Executive Board rightly wishes first to discuss its line with the education community.
Voordat er definitieve stappen worden gezet wil het College van Bestuur terecht eerst haar lijn bespreken met de onderwijsgemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de omstreden benoeming van de voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA)

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether the reappointment of the Raad van Toezicht chair of the University of Amsterdam without consulting the works councils was lawful and why councils could not advise on the candidate's profile. The minister replied that the procedure followed the WHW, that the appointment was lawful per a Stibbe legal opinion, and that she will ensure councils get a chance to review profiles in future reappointments, and noted the board has since resigned and a new board was appointed.

In future reappointments of all members of the Raad van Toezicht of public universities, I will ensure that the works councils also get the chance to assess whether the profile on which they advised at the first term is still current.

Ik zal ik me er bij toekomstige herbenoemingen van alle leden van de Raad van Toezicht van de openbare universiteiten van vergewissen dat de medezeggenschap ook de kans heeft gekregen om te bezien of het profiel van de Raad van Toezicht waarover bij de eerste termijn is geadviseerd nog actueel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de studies in het Engels wordt aangeboden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the report that over half of university programmes are taught in English, and whether this undermines Dutch as a scientific language and the WHW article 7.2 duty to teach in Dutch. The Minister answered that internationalisation justifies English-taught programmes, that the KNAW is conducting an exploration of language policy, and that she does not accept commercially driven English teaching but will await the KNAW report before further steps.
I do not accept that universities teach in English purely and solely for commercial reasons.
Ik accepteer niet dat universiteiten puur en alleen uit commerciële overwegingen onderwijs in het Engels geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het archief van de MH17

An MP asks the government about the archiving of MH17 crisis documents, including whether emails were lost, why interview transcripts and evaluations were withheld, and the status of the JIT and prosecution strategy. The minister answers that no separate hotspot list exists, that archive transfers have not yet taken place, that interview transcripts remain confidential to protect research validity, and that some evaluations and prosecution strategy details are still in progress.
This promised confidentiality weighs very heavily for me in considering not sending the report to your House.
Deze toegezegde vertrouwelijkheid weegt voor mij zeer zwaar bij de afweging om het verslag niet aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het Onderwijsaccountantsprotocol 2016

An SP MP asked the education and economic affairs ministers why the 2016 accountant protocol limits procurement checks above EU thresholds to administrative organisation and internal control, and how this fits with the earlier growth model. The minister replied that full checks were never required, that the lighter scope was chosen to reduce burden and respond to accountants' objections, and that oversight remains via the accountant's reporting, the civil courts and the Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts.
Because I am responsible for making a workable audit protocol available to the institutional accountants, I chose to heed their objections and opted for a less burdensome form of control.

Omdat ik ervoor verantwoordelijk ben een uitvoerbaar controleprotocol aan de instellingsaccountants beschikbaar te stellen, heb ik ervoor gekozen gehoor te geven aan hun bezwaren en gekozen voor een minder zware vorm van controle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over huur- en verhuurconstructie van de stichting Calibris

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Inspectorate's finding of conflict of interest in the rent and lease arrangement between Stichting Calibris and Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport warrants clawing back state funds or other action. The Minister acknowledged the conflict of interest but declined to conclude misuse of funds, said recovery was not appropriate or legally possible against the foundation, and stated that such arrangements are not objectionable if transparency and conflict prevention are properly arranged.

The Inspectorate notes in its report that the former director of the KBB was also a board member of Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport, raising the question of whether one natural person can safeguard the opposing interests of tenant and landlord.

De inspectie constateert in haar rapport dat de voormalige directeur van het kenniscentrum beroepsonderwijs bedrijfsleven (KBB) tevens bestuurder was van de Stichting Ondersteuningsfonds Zorg, Welzijn en Sport en dat dit de vraag oproept in hoeverre één natuurlijke persoon in staat is de tegengestelde belangen van huurder en verhuurder te waarborgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het hoge collegegeld voor een tweede studie

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether high institutional tuition fees for a second degree are unaffordable, why second-degree enrolment has fallen, and whether fees should be capped at the statutory rate. The Minister says the government enables students to pursue second degrees via financing schemes, that enrolment has stabilised since 2013, that institutions must be transparent on fee levels with a list of non-transparent institutions provided, and that she rejects equalising fees to the statutory rate, though she will press institutions on transparency and may consider maximum fees if they fall short.
I will seriously hold to account the institutions that have failed to comply and raise this again with the Vereniging Hogescholen and VSNU.
Ik zal de instellingen die in gebreke zijn gebleven daar ernstig op aanspreken en dit ook nogmaals aan de orde stellen bij de Vereniging Hogescholen en VSNU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk en Rog over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in de financiële steun aan studenten met een beperking

MPs Bruins, Van Dijk and Rog asked the Minister of Education about reports of large differences in support for students with disabilities, including poor information provision and differences in municipal individual study allowances. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to information duties and a forthcoming letter to parliament, and said that municipal allowance differences reflect local policy freedom while deferring the allowance question to the state secretary of Social Affairs.
This autumn I will send a letter to the House in response to the motion by member Van Meenen et al.
Dit najaar stuur ik een brief aan de Kamer in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over een symposium over de Israëlische veiligheidsindustrie

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a symposium on the Israeli security industry, reportedly co-supported by the University of Amsterdam, raised antisemitism concerns and whether public funds were involved. The Minister declined to draw conclusions about a debate not yet held, said the UvA is not involved in organising or funding it, and saw no reason to consult the UvA.
No. The UvA has informed me that it is not involved in the organisation and financing of this symposium.
Nee. De UvA heeft mij te kennen gegeven niet betrokken te zijn bij de organisatie en financiering van dit symposium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het signaal dat steeds minder ROC’s bereid zijn om Eerder Verworven Competenties (EVC’s) te beoordelen

The VVD MP Lucas asks whether vocational colleges (ROCs) are refusing to assess prior-learning certificates (EVCs) and whether a convenant and a transition to a validation route are causing confusion, along with questions on fees, Servicepunt support and language/maths test recognition. Minister Bussemaker answers that no such instruction exists, that a transition to a two-route validation system is underway with Servicepunt support for two years, that the convenant is still being finalised, and that there are no standard EVC fees.
I have asked the Servicepunt Examinering to support educational institutions in recognising prior acquired competences for two years from the beginning of 2016.
Ik heb het Servicepunt Examinering gevraagd om vanaf begin 2016, gedurende twee jaar, onderwijsinstellingen te ondersteunen bij de erkenning van eerder verworven competenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over het bericht ‘Van Gogh hult zich in nevel’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports on the Van Gogh Museum, including subsidy use, reserves in the OCW earmarked fund, untaxed profits, and a refused FOIA request. The minister answered that subsidy was not used for other purposes, the reserve method is reasonable, tax matters are between the museum and the tax authority, and the FOIA refusal rests on harm to competitive interests, while offering the documents for confidential inspection.
As an interested party, the Van Gogh Museum must be able to rely on business-confidential or otherwise competitively sensitive information remaining confidential.
Als belanghebbende moet het Van Gogh Museum erop kunnen vertrouwen dat bedrijfsvertrouwelijke of anderszins concurrentiegevoelige informatie vertrouwelijk blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het bericht “Arjo Klingens van rockband 'De Staat' geeft € 1 miljoen subsidie aan zichzelf”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a rock band's manager, Arjo Klingens, secured over one million euros in subsidy for the band, questioning whether a rock band should receive such funding and whether procedures were breached. The minister replied that the funding was assessed by independent committees, Klingens was not involved in the assessment, the Fonds Podiumkunsten acted with integrity, and no recovery of the money is warranted.
Arjo Klingens was not involved in assessing the application of De Staat or other applications under the multi-year activity subsidy scheme 2017–2020.
Arjo Klingens is niet betrokken geweest bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag van De Staat of andere aanvragen binnen de regeling subsidie meerjarige activiteiten 2017–2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de berichten ‘Ophef om subsidie De Staat’ en ‘Ophef over dubbelrol manager De Staat’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the four-year grant of 236,200 euro per year awarded by the Fonds Podiumkunsten to the band De Staat, including selection, amount, accountability and whether the band's manager, who is also an adviser to the Fund, influenced the decision. The Minister responded that the grant followed the approved scheme and independent committee assessments, that the manager had no role, and that there is no reason for repayment.
The manager of the band was in no way involved in the assessment of De Staat's grant application or of other applications for multi-year activity subsidies 2017–2020.
De manager van de band is geenszins betrokken geweest bij de beoordeling van de subsidieaanvraag van De Staat of van andere aanvragen voor een meerjarige activiteitensubsidie 2017–2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de intimidatie en doodsbedreiging aan het adres van een homostel

Two MPs asked the ministers about intimidation and death threats against a gay couple in Amsterdam, including whether police advised them not to file a complaint and whether non-Western minorities are overrepresented in anti-gay violence. The minister condemned the threats, said police encouraged mediation but that a discrimination complaint should always be recorded, rejected the statistical framing, and pointed to existing action plans and a planned protocol with partners.
A complaint of discrimination must always be recorded under the Discrimination Directive.
Een aangifte van discriminatie dient volgens de Aanwijzing Discriminatie altijd opgenomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen onderzoekstijd verliezen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked the minister whether pregnant female researchers lose research time because temporary contracts are not extended, despite UWV pregnancy benefits, and what will be done about the low share of female professors. The minister answered that UWV pay is a general scheme meant to compensate wages, that universities are asked to use it flexibly, that the Wwz four-year chain rule is adequately flexible, and that she will ask universities how they will address the problem and monitor progress.
I consider the problem for female researchers urgent and will ask the universities how they concretely shape possible solutions.
Ik vind de problematiek voor vrouwelijke onderzoekers urgent en zal de universiteiten vragen hoe zij concreet vorm geven aan mogelijke oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat er problemen zouden zijn bij de Groninger Buitenschool

An MP asked the state secretary about reported problems at the Groninger Buitenschool, a school for pupils with internalising behavioural and psychiatric problems, including parental complaints about care and the classroom environment. The state secretary said the inspectorate rated the education as adequate, is monitoring the board's improvement measures, and declined an independent investigation for now, citing the board's actions.
The inspectorate is following the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een blinde vrouw die werd gediscrimineerd door het ROC in Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the ROC Nijmegen's refusal to admit a blind woman to VAVO education, which the Human Rights Board found to be discrimination, has consequences, whether the school had grounds to claim undue burden, and whether a proposed admission right would help. The minister declined to attach consequences as she is not a party, said the burden question is for the courts, noted the school's duty for reasonable adjustments under the WGB/hcz, and said the proposed admission right does not cover VAVO but that disability-based refusal is already prohibited.
Since I am not a party to this case, I do not attach any consequences to it.
Aangezien ik geen partij ben in deze zaak verbind ik hier geen consequenties aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de Technische Universiteit (TU) Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked whether TU Eindhoven withdrew support from the Christian student association Ichthus and whether this breaches equal treatment law. The minister replied that support criteria are based on a policy note with no religious criterion, that the university reconsidered after talks, and that equal treatment questions should go to the College voor de rechten van de mens.
It is for the TU Eindhoven to shape the policy for supporting student associations.
Het is aan de TUe om vorm te geven aan het beleid voor ondersteuning van studentenverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de ontevredenheid rond flexibele werkplekken in de nieuwbouw van de Hogeschool Utrecht

An MP asked the minister about staff and student dissatisfaction with flexible workspaces in the new Hogeschool Utrecht building and whether this shows the need for stronger participation rights. The minister said the college of governors is responsible for housing and staff policy, that staff and students were involved and evaluations are ongoing, and that changes are being implemented without committing to new state action.
The executive board of an institution is responsible for both housing and personnel policy.
Het college van bestuur van een instelling is verantwoordelijk voor zowel de huisvesting als het personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen bij de Hogeschool Utrecht (HU)

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about governance problems at Hogeschool Utrecht, including a hostile work climate, centralisation, hired change managers, unusual bonuses and inspection of integrity. The minister answered that the institution's own and PwC investigations found no indications of irregularities, that the choices are the institution's responsibility, and that the Inspectorate is following up on rate-cap issues.
Because of the confidential nature of the investigations and the privacy-sensitive information in the reports, the reports were not made public.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de onderzoeken en de privacy gevoelige informatie in de rapporten, zijn de rapporten niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht 'Mbo-student negatief over lessen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about survey findings that many MBO students feel unchallenged, find lessons not useful, and find purchased teaching materials underused, plus questions on work-placement satisfaction and school costs. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to existing measures such as shortened MBO-4 programmes, quality agreements, a bill giving student councils advice rights over school costs, and linked work-placement pay to improvement plans.
In the House of Representatives there is a bill before it giving student councils advisory rights over an institution's school-costs policy.
In de Tweede Kamer ligt het wetsvoorstel voor waarin studentenraden adviesrecht krijgen op het schoolkostenbeleid van een instelling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermue over een mbo-school die stopt met beschermde stageplaatsen voor studenten met een lichamelijke beperking, gedragsproblemen of een moeilijke thuissituatie

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermue asked why Scalda, a vocational college, is ending funding for Inceptio, a student company giving placements to students with disabilities, behavioural problems or difficult home situations, and what this means for placements in Zeeland. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own support choices within their budgets, that extra funding is available, and that she would support regional arrangements without committing to a specific solution.
Institutions are free to make choices in how they shape this additional support.
Instellingen zijn vrij om keuzes te maken in de manier waarop zij deze (extra) ondersteuning vormgeven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens ‘VU-VUMC discrimineerde twaalf oudere medewerkers op grond van leeftijd bij de ontslagaanzegging in het kader van een reorg

MP Krol asked the ministers about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that VU-VUmc discriminated against twelve older employees by age in dismissal notices during a reorganisation, including a chairman's remark about cheaper younger researchers and the government's response to the ruling. The minister declined to give a substantive judgment, stressed that discrimination assessment is for the courts and the College, noted that College rulings are not binding and that the VU is a private law body where UWV preventive review applies since July 2015, and took no concrete action.
It is not for me to pass a substantive judgment on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake de toename van fraudegevallen op hogescholen en universiteiten en de wijze waarop instellingen hiermee omgaan

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the rise in reported exam fraud at universities and universities of applied sciences, and whether institutions do enough to prevent it, including reuse of old exams, unreported cases, and unclear rules. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate reports more fraud reports without knowing the cause, that examination boards have strengthened and most have fraud rules, but that monitoring of compliance is a gap, and that a follow-up inspection will be held in a few years.
I do not consider the approach of the University of Groningen to be in conflict with the applicable legislation in this area.
Ik vind de handelwijze van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen niet strijdig met de vigerende wetgeving op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen over vernieuwing in vmbo’

An MP asked the minister about a survey showing serious concerns among vmbo staff over the reform's implementation, including teacher retraining and underqualified teachers. The state secretary acknowledged the challenges, pointed to a transitional measure allowing schools until 2021 to bring teachers up to the required qualification, and described the support infrastructure, budget and training offers.
I have a transitional measure in preparation that gives schools room until 1 August 2021 to retrain existing teachers to an appropriate qualification.
Daarom heb ik een overgangsmaatregel in voorbereiding die scholen de ruimte biedt tot 1 augustus 2021 de zittende docenten te scholen naar een passende bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over het bericht van de stichting Hart van Homo’s: “Nieuwe organisatie voor homoseksuele jongeren”

An MP asks the Education, Culture and Science Minister why a subsidy goes to Hart van Homo's, whose vision seemed to promote celibacy for gay youth, and whether it should be stopped. The minister defends the subsidy as support for LHBT emancipation within orthodox-Christian communities, notes the organisation's wording was revised, and sees no reason to stop it.
I have examined that and see no reason to stop the subsidy prematurely.
Ik heb dat onderzocht en zie geen aanleiding tot voortijdig stopzetten van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de belangenverstrengeling van belastinghoogleraren

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about the affiliations of tax professors with accountancy and law firms, conflicts of interest, lobbying influence on tax policy, and a register of side jobs. The government answered that such side jobs are acceptable under the Dutch research code, that transparency is required through university websites, that consultation and advice paragraphs are used, and that it sees no need for a national register.
It is the responsibility of civil servants, the cabinet and MPs to reach balanced judgments based on available information and by listening to the views of parties involved.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ambtenaren, het kabinet en Kamerleden om op basis van beschikbare informatie en door te luisteren naar geluiden van betrokken partijen tot afgewogen oordelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Topdocenten kraken onderwijs Nederlandse universiteiten’ inzake de lage leskwaliteit van een grote groep docenten in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that many higher-education lecturers teach poorly and value research over teaching, and about how institutions improve teaching quality and the Basic Teaching Qualification (BKO). The minister acknowledges the research-over-teaching pattern, points to universities' autonomy and existing tools such as appraisal cycles and professionalisation offers, and says she will discuss teacher professionalisation with institutions.
Universities, however, are autonomous and determine their own education and HR policy themselves.
Universiteiten zijn echter autonoom en bepalen zelf hun onderwijs- en HR-beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “Ondanks onderhandelaarsakkoord cao PO blijft WWZ ongelijkheid”

An MP asks why the WWZ labour law reforms apply to private (bijzonder) primary schools but not public (openbaar) ones, and whether this conflicts with financial equality under the Constitution. The Secretary of State answers that the difference stems from the civil-law versus civil-service employment regimes, that the cao evaluation is planned for spring 2017, that she will not intervene in collective bargaining, and that a pending bill on normalising civil servants' legal status could resolve the gap.
I respect the freedom of negotiation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toegang van leerlingen met een beperking uit het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs tot de REA topklas in Leiden

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is desirable that vso graduates with vmbo-tl diplomas can no longer enter the REA topklas at ROC Leiden due to cuts, and about the consequences for their schooling, plus questions on passend onderwijs gaps in mbo. The minister answered that support is the responsibility of mbo institutions and regional partners, that no decision has yet been taken on the REA topklas, that no shortfall in funding is seen, and that monitoring of passend onderwijs will continue.
As I already indicated, I find it important that students receive appropriate support to successfully complete a mbo programme.
Zoals ik al aangaf vind ik het belangrijk dat studenten passende ondersteuning krijgen om succesvol een mbo-opleiding af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gerommel met een rapport over de daling van het aantal studenten als gevolg van het leenstelsel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that a monitoring report on falling student intake under the loan system was delayed and reworked, and whether the government was concealing that lower-income and other disadvantaged groups show the largest drops. The minister answered almost every question by referring to the policy response accompanying the monitoring report sent to the Chamber on 18 April 2016, and said the report was consulted with sector and student organisations.
I refer you for my nuanced judgement on developments in enrolment in higher education to the policy response to the monitoring report that I sent to the House of Representatives on 18 April 2016.

Ik verwijs u voor mijn genuanceerde oordeel over de ontwikkelingen in de instroom in het hoger onderwijs naar de beleidsreactie bij de monitorrapportage die ik de Tweede Kamer op 18 april 2016 heb toegestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de mishandeling van twee homoseksuele mannen in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the government about the assault on two gay men in Morocco, the status of the perpetrators, and whether the government would raise the issue with Moroccan authorities. The minister confirmed shock at the footage, corrected the reported sentences, described the criminalisation of same-sex acts in Morocco as incompatible with international human rights obligations, said the EU had raised the case with Morocco's National Human Rights Council, and described ongoing support for LGBT rights through civil society, but did not commit to a new specific demand to Moroccan authorities.
The cabinet will therefore continue to unreservedly commit itself to the rights of this vulnerable minority.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom onverkort blijven inzetten voor de rechten van deze kwetsbare minderheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend tekort aan hoogopgeleide verpleegkundigen'

MPs Lucas and Schut-Welkzijn (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Health about a report on a shortage of highly educated nurses, including unfunded training, co-financing for demand-driven funding experiments, mbo training requirements versus BIG rules, and ways to make nursing more attractive. The ministers answered that funded and unfunded institutions complement each other, that demand-driven funding experiments are delayed in care, that an independent facilitator and a commission will be set up, that interpretation room exists in hours rules, and listed several measures to address shortages mainly in community and elderly care.
By Prinsjesdag at the latest I will inform your House about the state of affairs.
Uiterlijk op Prinsjesdag zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over het ontzeggen van een tolkvoorziening aan een dove student aan een Hogeschool

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why a deaf unemployed student at Fontys was denied a Dutch Sign Language interpreter for having reached age 30, and whether the WOOS age limit should be dropped in line with the new student loan system. The government defends the age-30 limit as a shift of individual responsibility, points to UWV and municipal routes for interpreter funding, and promises a policy response with OCW and VWS by summer.
From age 30 there is a question of individual responsibility.
Vanaf 30 jaar is er sprake van een individuele verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een door de school in de steek gelaten geïntimideerde homo-leerling

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a gay pupil was moved out of class after bullying and whether the school yielded to homophobia, and what the minister will do. The minister denies the reported framing, says the placement was pedagogical and not a punishment, cites the school safety law, sexuality curricula and an ongoing inspectorate study, and calls the asylum comparison inapt.
In general terms I believe victims should not be relocated, but perpetrators should be punished.
In algemene zin ben ik van mening dat slachtoffers niet herplaats moeten worden, maar daders gestraft moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk inzake de toegankelijkheid van hoger onderwijs voor dove 30+ studenten

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked whether the ministry's age-30 cutoff for sign-language interpreters in higher education leaves deaf students over 30 unequally treated, and how this fits the UN disability convention. The minister replied that responsibility shifts to the individual after 30, that no unequal situation exists, that UWV or municipalities may fund an interpreter under conditions, and pointed to earlier answers for further options.
From the age limit of 30 years, responsibility for education rests with the individual and no longer with the Ministry of OCW.
Vanaf de leeftijdsgrens van 30 jaar komt de verantwoordelijkheid voor onderwijs bij de persoon te liggen en niet meer bij het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Rog, Beertema en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'Leidse Greentower is in 2018 klaar

MPs asked the minister whether ROC Leiden's contribution to a bicycle parking garage near the Leiden square was capped, how it relates to earlier agreements on the square, and why the Chamber had not yet been informed. The minister answered that a 2014 agreement caps ROC Leiden's share at EUR 788,000 excluding VAT, with the municipality covering any excess, but that negotiations on the final amount are still ongoing and the Chamber will be informed once clarity exists.
At this moment the negotiations are still ongoing. As soon as I have clarity on this, I will inform you about it.
Op dit moment lopen de onderhandelingen nog. Zodra ik hier duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Veldman over het artikel ‘Financiële zorgen Fort Pannerden vanwege monumentstatus’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the proposed expansion of the monument status of Fort Pannerden, which the municipality of Lingewaard says could hinder sustainable exploitation, was necessary and whether it could be scaled back. The Minister defended the expansion as needed for the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie's UNESCO nomination, rejected the municipality's concerns, but said she would consider a smaller historical boundary and decide in June 2016.
In response to this advice, I want to consider adjusting the current proposal so that the proposed historical boundary of the fort is brought in line with the current situation.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies wil ik een aanpassing van het huidige voorstel overwegen om de voorgestelde historische begrenzing van het fort in lijn te brengen met de actuele situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht dat het slecht gesteld is met de online vindbaarheid van beleidsstukken van de gemeente Maastricht

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked ministers about reports that online findability of Maastricht municipal policy documents was poor, and whether this affects other municipalities, what municipalities and the government are doing to improve access, and how the Open Government bill and archive programme relate. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own web presentation, no monitoring of this specific issue takes place, and he supports open government but does not favour the information register proposed in the initiative bill.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for the way they present themselves on the internet.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de wijze waarop zij zich op internet presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de problemen in de uitbesteding van leerlingen door scholen voor het voortgezet onderwijs (vo-scholen) aan het voortgezet algemeen volwassen onderwijs

MP Siderius asked the minister about vo schools refusing to outsource pupils to adult secondary education (vavo) based on grade thresholds or age, and about related problems with vmbo-havo transfer rules. The minister answered that outsourcing is not an enforceable right, that vo schools remain primarily responsible for minors, and that no statutory change to the transfer code is currently planned, with monitoring results to follow later.
Outsourcing a vo pupil to a vavo institution is not a right a pupil can invoke at all times.
Het uitbesteden van een vo-leerling aan een vavo-instelling is geen recht waarop een leerling zich te allen tijde kan beroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie bij het zoeken van stageplaatsen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about reports that vocational students, especially girls wearing headscarves and boys of Moroccan background, face discrimination when seeking internships, and what schools, employers and the government will do. The minister acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, announced City Deal measures, a study with the SBB, and said students can report discrimination, though no formal parliamentary-oversight change is proposed.
Discrimination in finding an internship is unacceptable and unacceptable.
Discriminatie bij het vinden van een stage is onaanvaardbaar en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk inzake de benoeming van  bestuurders aan de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA).

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the appointment procedure for new UvA executive board members, which excluded students and staff from real influence and leaked, and about the resignation of a board member linked to a dispute over splitting the UvA and HvA, and whether the supervisory board should explain this. The Minister replied that co-determination bodies were involved and agreed on the procedure and that the candidates' confidential process is acceptable, that the supervisory board decides jointly on the cooperation, and that she will not intervene in the dialogue between the works council and the supervisory board.
I have no intention of intervening in this conversation.
Ik heb geen intentie om in dit gesprek te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Cegerek over de financiering van de restauratie van de Eusebiuskerk in Arnhem

MPs Monasch and Cegerek asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about funding for restoring the Eusebius church in Arnhem, including past state subsidies, Brim maintenance subsidy eligibility, and the provincial role. The minister answered that the church is important, outlined subsidy history, explained that Brim covers only maintenance and that provinces manage restoration funds, and said a joint approach will be discussed after an inventory due before summer.
It is important to get an overall picture of cases that may pose a bottleneck for provinces, as is currently the case with the Eusebius.
Het is van belang om een totaalbeeld te krijgen van gevallen die mogelijk een knelpunt kunnen zijn voor provincies, zoals dat nu het geval is met de Eusebius.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Tellegen over het bericht "Asielzoekers randden 18-jarige aan tijdens stapnacht

MPs Van Miltenburg and Tellegen asked the government how it responds to reports of sexual assaults on a young woman by asylum seekers, how victims are supported and given copies of reports, and whether police register and prosecute such assaults. The minister answered that all sexual offences are condemned and pursued, victims receive support through Slachtofferhulp Nederland and forthcoming sexual violence centres, and police and prosecutors treat all reports without distinguishing by origin of offenders.
I see no reason to change this approach as a result of the events in Cologne.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze werkwijze als gevolg van de gebeurtenissen in Keulen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de nijpende situatie van Lesbische, Homo-, Biseksuelen en Transgenders (LHBT's) in Indonesië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dijkstra asked the government about rising hostility toward LGBT people in Indonesia, including declarations of war by militant groups and stigmatising remarks by ministers. The minister answered that the Netherlands is monitoring the situation, raised concerns with Indonesian ministers, supports NGO and HIV programmes, and will raise human rights in the EU-Indonesia dialogue.
The cabinet shares the view that the stigmatisation of and negative statements about LGBT people are undesirable.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de stigmatisering van en negatieve uitspraken over LHBT's onwenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat stagiairs de dupe zijn van failliete winkelketens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether vocational students (mbo) whose work placements were at bankrupt retail chains risk failing to graduate, and what support and coulance would be offered. The minister answered that roughly 600 students were affected, that nearly all have since been placed, that SBB supports the search for new placements, and that no further binding measures towards employers are currently seen as necessary.
A breakdown of the number of students per bankrupt retail chain cannot be given, because the number of available and lapsed placements changes very dynamically.
Een specificatie van het aantal studenten per failliete winkelketen is niet te geven, omdat het aantal beschikbare en vervallen bpv-plaatsen erg dynamisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Rog over studenten in verzet tegen NS

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares unions' view that NS blames overcrowded trains on education and whether students are being consulted about off-peak travel plans. The government rejects the blame framing, says NS is responsible for capacity, that no negotiations exist but exploratory talks are ongoing, and that students will be involved in follow-up talks.
NS cannot and will not unilaterally refuse students in the peak hours.
NS kan niet en zal niet eenzijdig studenten weigeren in de spits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het inzetten van de subsidieregeling praktijkleren voor de meest kwetsbare leerlingen

An MP asks why the practical-learning subsidy scheme excludes pupils in vso and praktijkonderwijs, whether it should be extended to them, and why pro pupils are not automatically in the disability employment register. The Minister confirms the exclusion, says she is willing to examine extending the scheme to vso, pro and vmbo entry programmes, and explains that pro pupils generally have better job prospects so they are not automatically registered.
I am therefore willing to examine whether it is desirable to extend the scheme to other groups.
Ik ben daarom bereid te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is de regeling uit te breiden naar andere groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het interview 'Alle politieke partijen moeten Wilders aanvallen'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the dean of the NSOB, Paul Frissen, should be removed from his posts after calling Wilders's statements a danger to democracy and suggesting they encourage demonisation. The minister says the remarks fall under freedom of expression and academic freedom, that disputes belong before a court, and rejects calls for action against Frissen.
These are important legal principles in our system.
Dit zijn belangrijke rechtsbeginselen in ons stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Kerstens over de beloningen in dienstverlenende non-profit organisaties in het onderwijs

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Education about reported salaries of top executives at education-serving non-profit organisations, some above the minister's pay, and whether these fit the WNT pay cap and whether organisations publish annual accounts. The minister replied that the salaries were within the 2014 norm, that the WNT applies uniformly, that transitional rules explain remaining excesses, and that she has urged transparency and compliance.
I attach importance to this transparency and closely monitor compliance with it.
Ik hecht aan deze transparantie en houd de naleving daarvan nauwlettend in het oog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over de arbeidsmarktkansen van onderwijsassistenten en lerarenondersteuners

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the Minister of Education about declining graduate numbers, weak labour-market prospects and recruitment for education assistants and teacher assistants, including the pabo transfer pathway and vocational guidance. The minister answered with DUO data, noted schools decide on hiring, referred to the 50 million euro Herfstakkoord investment and existing mbo guidance and labour-market duty-of-care rules, but gave no new prognoses.
No figures are available on the number of education assistants and teacher assistants working in education.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal onderwijsassistenten en lerarenondersteuners dat werkzaam is in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake het bericht dat de pabo "steeds witter wordt"

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that teacher-training (pabo) intake is becoming whiter, given sharp drops in intake and in students of non-Western origin after stricter admission requirements. The minister acknowledged the drop, attributed it largely to the new entry requirements, and outlined support tracks, diversity measures and funding compensation without committing to a formal oversight change.
I will follow developments around a 'teach-nasium' with interest and, when it takes shape, inform the House in the annual progress report on the Teacher Agenda.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen rondom een «teach-nasium» met belangstelling volgen en wanneer dit vorm krijgt uw Kamer hierover informeren in de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage Lerarenagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het misbruik van studiefinanciering

MPs Mohandis and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Education about students receiving study grants without actually studying, as reported by the NOS. The minister said DUO holds no data on such students, that mbo institutions do not recognise a massive problem, and that attendance monitoring will be improved and the phenomenon investigated further.
As previously reported, I will investigate how often young people receive study financing without following education and what motives play a role.
Zoals reeds eerder gemeld ga ik onderzoeken hoe vaak het voorkomt dat jongeren wel studiefinanciering ontvangen maar geen onderwijs volgen en welke motieven daarbij een rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over "misleidende informatie van opleidingen over de arbeidsmarktpositie van hun afgestudeerden"

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about study programmes presenting misleading labour-market outcomes for graduates, and about abuse of internships. The minister acknowledges an error in the Studie in Cijfers indicator, promises a repaired version, and says internship abuse will be examined based on concrete reports.
It is regrettable that this happened, because the study fact sheet was only recently established.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat dit gebeurd is, want de studiebijsluiter is pas recent tot stand gekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de boete voor het niet tijdig stopzetten van het studentenreisproduct

An MP asks the Minister of Education about fines of 97 euro per half month imposed on former students who fail to stop their student transport product in time, and whether automatic termination could be used instead. The Minister acknowledges the signals, says automatic termination is desirable but technically not possible for now, outlines DUO's information channels, and promises research into students' motives and a discussion with student organisations before summer.
These signals have given rise to further research into the motives of (former) students for not stopping their travel product on time.
Deze signalen hebben aanleiding gegeven nader onderzoek te doen naar de motieven van (oud-)studenten om hun reisproduct niet tijdig stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het bericht dat opleidingen studenten verkeerd voorlichten over arbeidsmarktkansen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions misinform students about labour market prospects, and whether they will fix the study guide, add an alumni monitor, improve study choice guidance, and consider an arbeidsmarktfixus. The minister acknowledged the error in the study guide, promised a corrected version and general update, agreed to explore alumni monitoring, and rejected an arbeidsmarktfixus for now while reviewing macro-efficiency policy.
I regret, like Studiekeuze123 and the VSNU, that this error was made.
Ik betreur, net als Studiekeuze123 en de VSNU, dat deze fout is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het onderbrengen van private initiatieven bij bestaande BRIN-nummers

MP Lucas asked the minister about private initiatives being placed under existing BRIN numbers of vocational colleges, including a 40% overhead deduction arrangement between ROC Amsterdam and Urban Act, and about the difficulty of obtaining a BRIN number for new vocational providers. Minister Bussemaker replied that no definitive arrangement exists, that such overhead deductions would not appear to fit the legal framework, that existing rules allow private activities only if they benefit publicly funded education, and that procedures for new providers will be reviewed in a separate letter.
Creating a business model by renting out their BRIN number and deducting a percentage of funding as overhead does indeed seem not to fit within the legal framework.
Het via de «verhuur» van hun BRIN-nummer een verdienmodel creëren door een percentage van de bekostiging af te romen voor «overhead» lijkt mij inderdaad niet te passen binnen de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toegang tot de entreeopleiding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether vmbo graduates who are not yet socially-emotionally ready should be allowed into entry-level (mbo-1) programmes, and why the former route was closed. The minister replied that vmbo graduates are cognitively able to start at mbo level 2, that support for students with social-emotional problems is funded through existing schemes, and that entry-level programmes are reserved for students lacking level-2 prerequisites.
Students with a vmbo diploma do not belong in an entry-level programme, given the capabilities shown by their prior education.
Leerlingen met een vmbo-diploma horen niet thuis in een entreeopleiding, vanwege de uit hun vooropleiding gebleken capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake de aanpak van radicalisering op scholen

An MP asked the education minister how teachers lacking guidance on radicalisation in schools can be supported, how the motion on uprooted youth was implemented, how teacher training prepares for radicalisation and critical thinking, and how vocational education will strengthen civic education. The minister answered that schools and boards are primarily responsible, pointed to support from the School en Veiligheid foundation, outlined curriculum and EKB changes for critical thinking, and gave no information on withholding.
This is in the first place the responsibility of school leaders and board members.
Dit is in de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van schoolleiders en bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het binden en bijscholen van werkloze leraren

An MP asked the education minister about proposals from a parents' organisation to keep unemployed teachers in the profession through paid employment with retained benefits and retraining. The state secretary answered that unemployment figures are published quarterly, outlined existing retraining and re-integration options, and said the parents' proposals are not feasible under current benefit rules.
The suggestions, however, are not feasible for the reasons mentioned above.
De suggesties zijn om bovengenoemde redenen echter niet uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders inzake het bericht 'Vrije dag Suikerfeest bespreekbaar voor Amsterdamse schoolbesturen'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic celebrations such as Eid al-Fitr (Suikerfeest) should be excluded from Dutch schools and whether replacing Western holidays threatens national culture. The State Secretary answered that schools decide on celebrations themselves, that schools may use a four-day week up to seven times a year with parental consent, and rejected the assimilation framing and any intention to block Islamic events.
A school itself decides whether, and in which cases, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Een school bepaalt zelf of, en in welke gevallen, op school vieringen of herdenkingen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Van der Staaij over voorlichting aan asielzoekers in Nederland

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Van der Staaij asked whether information for asylum seekers in reception centres is limited to LHBT groups, whether incidents involving asylum seekers are registered, whether incidents are more frequent in emergency reception locations, and whether an independent confidential person should be appointed. The minister answered that COA is consulting on broader information covering Christians, atheists and other minorities, that incidents are not registered by asylum status or sexual orientation, that the data do not show more incidents in larger locations, and that the government sees no added value in a separate confidential person.
The sexual orientation of a resident is not registered in COA's systems.
De seksuele gerichtheid van een bewoner wordt in de systemen van het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake het weren van journalisten bij informatieavonden over azc's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the exclusion of journalists from information evenings on asylum centres threatens press freedom and what measures the government will take. The state secretary said municipalities weigh safety and space against openness, that press freedom is protected but restrictions must be proportionate, and that municipalities must account for their choices to their councils.
Municipalities have their own responsibility to make a proportionate assessment between safety and openness when organising information evenings.
Gemeenten hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid om bij de organisatie van informatieavonden een proportionele afweging te maken tussen veiligheid en openheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Meenen inzake het intrekken van het instemmingsrecht op de faculteitsbegroting door de faculteitsraad

MPs Mohandis and Van Meenen asked whether the Leiden executive board's withdrawal of faculty-level consent rights over the faculty budget undermines student influence. The minister answers that no formal withdrawal occurred, that consent on budget outlines applies at institutional level in principle, and that she sees no reason to intervene with the board or other institutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kuiken over de moeilijke positie van LHBT in de asielopvang

MPs Gesthuizen and Kuiken asked about a reported suicide attempt by a gay asylum seeker in Alphen aan den Rijn linked to LHBT insecurity, reports of abuse of LHBT residents in reception centres, low reporting of crimes, and whether separate shelter or a dedicated contact person should be provided. The Secretary of State said the resident was moved at his own request, rejected a separate inquiry, said discrimination is not tolerated and the COA will pursue perpetrators, declined separate categorical shelter and a dedicated LHBT contact person, and promised a letter by March 2016 on stricter enforcement plus a study meeting to improve information on rights and reporting.
I therefore see no reason to have a further investigation carried out into the circumstances.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een nader onderzoek te laten doen naar de toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het weren van journalisten bij een informatieavond over een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) in de Noord-Oostpolder

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police barring journalists from an information evening on an asylum centre in Noordoostpolder, and home visits to critical residents, unduly restrict press freedom and intimidate citizens. Minister Plasterk said press freedom is protected, noted the matter is before the court and so declined to judge the case, and placed responsibility for proportionate decisions with municipalities accountable to their councils.
The specific situation in Noordoostpolder has now been submitted to the court. For that reason I will not make a further statement on it.
