De specifieke situatie in de Noordoostpolder is inmiddels voorgelegd aan de rechter. Om die reden doe ik hierover verder geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper Van Dijk over studieschuld als nieuwe restschuld en zieke werknemers als gevolg van schuld

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether student debt reduces mortgage capacity, can be concealed when applying for a mortgage, causes problem debts among workers, and whether sickness absence linked to financial problems will be investigated and addressed. The government answered that student loans are weighted lower than consumer credit in mortgage assessments, that lenders' duty of care and applicants' disclosure duty suffice, that repayment is income-contingent with debt forgiveness after 35 years, and that it will await TNO research results and develop a website for employers on financial problems.
To verify the amount of the student debt, and thus as proof, the former student can simply print an overview from mijnDUO.
Ter verificatie van de hoogte van de studieschuld en dus als bewijsstuk, kan de oud-student eenvoudigweg een overzicht vanuit mijnDUO uitdraaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat scholen steeds vaker een VOG vragen om moeilijke leerlingen te weren

MPs Volp and Jadnanansing asked whether schools increasingly require a certificate of good conduct (VOG) to exclude difficult students, and whether youths with criminal records are blocked from education and internships as a result. The government answered that the qualitative study cannot support claims about trends or numbers, that no data exist on schools requiring VOGs, and that it intends to address the issue through communication, local initiatives and further research, with a letter to parliament planned for mid-2016.
No figures exist on educational institutions that require their students to obtain a VOG, or that otherwise discourage people with a criminal record from enrolling in a course or study.

Er bestaan geen cijfers van onderwijsinstellingen die hun studenten om een VOG vragen, of personen met een justitieel verleden anderszins ontmoedigen om zich in te schrijven voor een opleiding of studie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over beloningsonderscheid op hogescholen

MPs Yücel and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding pay-discrimination risks between men and women in universities of applied sciences (hogescholen), and the underrepresentation of women in the highest pay grade. The minister answered that hogescholen are responsible for their own pay policy, pointed to existing works council duties, the Charter Talent naar de Top and the national anti-discrimination action plan, and said the sector is taking up the issue.
Hogescholen are themselves responsible for their pay policy, but I think it is important that the sector takes up this problem.
Hogescholen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beloningsbeleid, maar ik vind het belangrijk dat de sector dit probleem oppakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over universiteiten en hogescholen die de Wet werk en zekerheid ontduiken met knutselcontracten

MPs asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences use combined permanent-plus-temporary 'knutselcontracten' to evade the Wwz and whether this breaches the cao, and what the government will do. The minister says the cao and Wwz have already curbed such contracts, that cao compliance is for the parties and courts, and that the government agrees permanent contracts should be the norm, while noting some combinations will remain legitimate.
It is not for us to judge whether these contracts comply with the provisions of the cao, but for the cao parties themselves and ultimately the courts.
Het is niet aan ons om te oordelen of deze contracten in overeenstemming zijn met de bepalingen uit de genoemde cao maar aan cao-partijen zelf en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Van Meenen (D66) aan de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Brandbrief over ban op «zesjesstudenten» (ingezonden 15 januari 2016).

D66 MP Van Meenen asks Minister Bussemaker whether stricter admission criteria for master's programmes after the abolition of the doorstroommaster risk a race between universities, and what the minister will do to protect access. The minister replies that she sees no reason to expect such a race, notes only a small share of programmes use qualitative criteria, promises to discuss the signal with the Inspectorate, and says she does not expect to need her power to designate master's programmes for bachelor graduates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat selectie aan de poort allochtonen dupeert

An MP asked the Education Minister whether selection at the entrance of higher-education programmes disadvantages non-Western, lower-achieving and male students, and whether this conflicts with a motion against extra admission requirements. The minister acknowledges the inspectorate's findings of modest differences, attributes them partly to sector choice, says no new selection instruments will be added, and promises further monitoring, regional cooperation and discussions with stakeholders.
In line with the Klaver/Mohandis motion, I will therefore not further expand the number of selection instruments.
In lijn met de motie Klaver/Mohandis 3 zal ik het aantal selectie-instrumenten dus ook niet verder uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Slowaakse overheid geen Nationaal Actieplan LHBTI gelijkheid aanneemt

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Slovak government dropping its national LGBTI equality action plan, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch-Maltese-Slovak EU presidency trio. The minister confirmed awareness, said the trio statement on gender equality remains intact and that the Netherlands will seek Council conclusions backing the Commission's LGBTI action plan, without new concrete steps.
I will continue to work for improving the position of LGBTI people in Europe.
Ik blijf mij inspannen voor de verbetering van de positie van LHBTI in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op kunst en cultuur

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about municipal cuts to arts and culture, linked to cuts in the municipal fund, and whether this undermines national cultural investment and regional spread. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous in setting cultural spending, that national investment of 18.6 million euros is planned for 2017-2020, and that she monitors the accessibility of cultural facilities without committing to new action.
Municipalities are autonomous in determining their own spending on culture.
Gemeenten zijn autonoom in het bepalen van hun eigen uitgaven aan cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jasper van Dijk inzake de inkomenspositie van popmuzikanten

MPs Van Dekken and Van Dijk asked the Minister about falling incomes of pop musicians, fees paid by subsidised pop venues, and royalties from streaming platforms. The Minister called the findings worrying, deferred advice from the Raad voor Cultuur, said fee-setting is the sector's responsibility while referring subsidy conditions to municipalities, and pointed to pending EU copyright work and a forthcoming pop policy letter.
I have asked the Raad voor Cultuur to advise me on how to deploy the EUR 2 million earmarked for improving artists' position on the labour market.
Ik heb de Raad voor Cultuur gevraagd mij te adviseren over de inzet van de € 2 miljoen euro
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dure kaartjes voor concerten

An SP MP asked ministers about very high resale prices for Adele concert tickets, Seatwave's booking fees, and links between primary seller Ticketmaster and resale site Seatwave, asking whether the government would intervene or investigate. The government answered that prices reflect scarcity and are free, that the matter has been referred to the ACM which enforces consumer and competition law, and that no separate investigation is needed.
The ACM is among other things authorised to supervise compliance with the Competition Act and consumer legislation.
De ACM is onder meer bevoegd om toezicht te houden op de naleving van de Mededingingswet en consumentenwetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma inzake mbo-opleidingen die jaarlijks tientallen studenten met psychische of lichamelijke beperkingen niet toelaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the Minister of Education whether tens of students with psychological or physical disabilities are refused entry to vocational (mbo) courses each year and do not get needed support, and how the government responds to complaints and to the Kinderombudsman's findings. The Minister says complaints exist but cannot tell how many refusals are disability-related, stresses institutions' legal duty to provide support, and promises talks with the MBO Raad and JOB plus a bill giving qualified students a right to admission.
I am working on a bill that will give students who have the right prior education the right to admission to mbo.
Ik werk aan een wetsvoorstel waarmee studenten die over de juiste vooropleiding beschikken het recht op toelating tot het mbo krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het bericht 'Mbo-opleidingen weren leerlingen met een beperking'

An MP asks the education minister about reports that mbo colleges refuse students with disabilities, including whether such refusals occur and what will change. The minister answers that complaints are received but cannot be quantified or verified, that refusing students on grounds of disability is unlawful, and that a right of admission to mbo is planned from 2017 along with a complaints procedure.
I therefore cannot state how many young people have been refused entry to an mbo course because of a psychological or physical disability.
Ik kan daarom niet aangeven wat het aantal jongeren is dat vanwege een psychische of lichamelijke beperking is afgewezen voor een mbo-opleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over het artikel 'Groepsaansprakelijkheid bij onrechtmatige daad: Het blijft een bijzonder leerstuk'

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether damages from the Maagdenhuis and Bungehuis occupations can be recovered from the occupiers, citing an insurance trade article. The Minister answered that recovery is impractical because perpetrators cannot be identified without investigating innocent students and staff, that the UvA and insurer concluded recovery is unlikely, and that the insurer paid out in full, so no concrete further action is planned.
I do not have this information. Nor is it for me to disclose confidential business information of the insurer.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Het is ook niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens van de verzekeraar openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat veel eindexamenkandidaten onvoldoende kennis hebben over het leenstelsel en het aangaan van schulden

MP Bruins asked the Minister of Education whether she shares concern that exam candidates lack knowledge about student loans and debt, and what DUO and the government will do to improve information. The minister rejects the concern as overstated, points to ongoing information campaigns, a new budgeting tool and cooperation with Nibud, and commits to improving flexible repayment facilities.
I do not share the concern.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer inzake het bieden van veilige opvang aan LHBT-asielzoekers en statushouders

An MP asked about a Zaanstad project supporting LHBT asylum seekers and refugees, and whether a letter to Regenbooggemeenten encouraged separate Amsterdam-style shelter for LHBT asylum seekers. The minister answered that the letter was informative only, that the Amsterdam emergency shelter was an exceptional case, that perpetrators of discrimination should be prosecuted or relocated, and that a policy tightening on asylum permit revocation was announced.
The Cabinet will inform the House shortly by letter about COA's efforts on this point.
Het Kabinet zal uw Kamer op korte termijn middels een brief te informeren over de inzet van COA op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de huisvesting van twee mbo-instellingen in Purmerend

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the reasons for two Purmerend vocational colleges building a new EUR 14.5 million campus instead of using the existing Spinnekop building, the guarantee for a loan, and whether central oversight or a financial approval test should be introduced. The Minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own housing, that the WEB does not require prior approval of such investments, that the Spinnekop does not meet joint-housing requirements, that no guarantee could be given for an extra loan, and that she will not introduce a mandatory financial approval test but will encourage peer review and knowledge sharing.
Vocational education institutions are themselves responsible for their housing.
Mbo-instellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over een stagetekort voor nieuwe verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether a shortage of internship places is blocking growth in nursing training, and what hogescholen and the government will do about it. The government answered that internship places have grown faster than student numbers, that regional initiatives under the Zorgpact are underway, and that it will keep stimulating them without announcing a new concrete measure.
That is why it is good that initiatives are being developed at regional level.
Daarom is het goed dat op regionaal niveau initiatieven tot stand komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat een hoger loon voor leraren in de Randstad niet helpt om leraren voor het onderwijs te behouden

An MP asked the Education Minister about a report that higher pay for teachers in the Randstad does not help retain them, and why 7 percent still leave. The state secretary replied that the CPB found no retention effect from the salary scale policy in secondary education, though slightly more teachers stayed in the Randstad and in-service training rose, and outlined measures such as teaching bursaries and HRM support to address shortages.
The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) found no effect that strengthening the salary scale mix kept more teachers in secondary education.
Het Centraal Plan Bureau (CPB) heeft geen effect gevonden dat door de versterking van de functiemix er meer leraren behouden blijven in het voorgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Marcouch inzake het bericht dat er voor een docent geen ruimte op school is om te bidden

MPs Ypma and Marcouch asked whether a praying teacher being unwelcome at a Rijswijk public school sends children the message that their identity is unwelcome and pushes families toward separate religious schooling. The State Secretary said the school states it is open to all, that such exclusion would be unacceptable if it occurred, that schools must ensure social safety, and that public and denominational schools coexist.
I cannot assess whether in this case the teacher was indeed not welcome.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of het in deze zaak inderdaad zo is dat de docent niet welkom was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Duisenberg over de Wet werk en zekerheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister why the Wet werk en zekerheid prevents young researchers from carrying out their grant-funded research at their own university, and whether the law will be amended. The Minister attributes the problem to the growth of project funding, notes that the cao Universiteiten limits chained temporary contracts to four years, and says that UWV or mutual consent can end open-ended contracts when projects finish, so no amendment is planned and the issue will be raised with the VSNU.
We therefore see no reason to amend the Wwz, more specifically the so-called chain provision.
Wij zien dan ook geen aanleiding om de Wwz, meer in het bijzonder de zogenoemde ketenbepaling, aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake bedrijven die streefcijfers voor topvrouwen niet halen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister why companies are missing the gender targets for women in boards and why there are no sanctions for failing to explain shortfalls in annual reports. The minister acknowledged slow progress, promised to intensify voluntary self-regulation with business and monitor closely, and said sanctions could be considered at the Wbt evaluation if compliance does not improve.
If this does not lead to results, the evaluation of the Wbt will consider whether sanctions on this point can be included in the Wbt.
Indien dit niet tot resultaat leidt, zal bij de evaluatie van de Wbt worden bezien of op dit punt sancties in de Wbt kunnen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake de protesten van zwarte racisten tegen Zwarte Piet

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about protests against Zwarte Piet and the Black Panthers, and whether measures would protect children from such protests. The minister answered that some protesters wore black clothing, there is no known indication they identify with the Black Panthers, and everyone may demonstrate against Zwarte Piet.
Everyone in the Netherlands is free to demonstrate against the use of Zwarte Piet.
Het staat een ieder in Nederland vrij om te demonstreren tegen de inzet van Zwarte Piet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het weigeren van een stageplaats vanwege de seksuele geaardheid

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the ministers about a reported refusal of an internship because of sexual orientation, and about government support and diversity policy. The minister condemns discrimination, points to the existing action plan on labour-market discrimination, existing complaint channels (College voor de Rechten van de Mens, local anti-discrimination services) and the diversity charter, without assessing the specific case.
The assessment of whether discrimination occurred in this specific case is for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the judge.
De beoordeling of in deze specifieke casus sprake is van discriminatie is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens (College) of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat cijfers in de universitaire studiebijsluiter een vertekend beeld geven

An MP asked whether universities can choose which employment figures from studiekeuze123 they use in study fact sheets, and whether these give a distorted picture of job prospects. The minister replied that the figures are fixed and identical for all programmes, that the indicator is a national average, and that she sees no need to act or contact studiekeuze123.
Studie in cijfers is a fixed pdf format that is identical for all hbo or wo programmes.
Studie in cijfers is een vast pdf-formaat dat identiek is voor alle hbo-opleidingen dan wel wo-opleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over de belemmeringen van BBL-trajecten als gevolg van sectorfondsen

An MP asked whether the sector training fund and sector plan for transport and logistics unfairly favour BBL pupils placed through the sector institute STL over those placed through other temp agencies. The minister replied that STL is not a temp agency, that the funding is open to all approved training firms, and that the sector social partners chose this placement model.

The subsidy from the sector's training and development fund (SOOB) and the co-financing from the sector plan benefit all approved training companies in the transport and logistics sector that offer work placements to BBL pupils.

De subsidie uit het Opleidings- en Ontwikkelingsfonds van de sector (SOOB) en de cofinanciering uit het sectorplan komen ten goede aan alle erkende leerbedrijven in de sector Transport en Logistiek die BBL-leerlingen een leerwerk plaats bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch inzake de onevenwichtige spreiding van cultuursubsidies over het land

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the concentration of a Mondriaan Fonds heritage grant in the Randstad and Amsterdam, and whether the Minister would address the imbalance. The Minister confirmed the figures (14 of 20 grants in the Randstad, 47% of applicants and grants in the Randstad across all Mondriaan schemes), said she did not share the surprise given these proportions, and promised a separate letter on regional distribution of arts subsidies.
I asked your House to put your questions on paper. I will then send your House a letter answering these questions.
Ik heb uw Kamer gevraagd uw vragen op papier te zetten. Vervolgens stuur ik uw Kamer een brief met een antwoord op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake het bericht 'Gülen runt nieuw lectoraat Inholland'

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that the Gülen movement runs a new lectorate at Inholland via the business association Hogiaf, and whether this is desirable and whether the school knew Hogiaf's background. The minister answered that Inholland guarantees the lectorate's independence, that the school will consider ending the cooperation if members actively promote Gülen ideology, and that the government has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, with a parliamentary motion for further research pending.
The Dutch government does not have an overview of organisations operating under, or affiliated with, the Gülen movement.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt niet over een overzicht van organisaties die opereren onder, of gelieerd zijn aan, de Gülen-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de opening van een nevenvestiging van de RUG in China

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about the RUG's planned campus in Yantai, China, including costs, private financing, tuition, diploma rules, and medezeggenschap involvement. The Minister answered that the plan is still being developed, no business case has been approved, private funds only are allowed, and she will intervene if plans prove inadequate.
If I doubt the desirability of this initiative, or if it appears that the plans are insufficiently safeguarded in quality or financially, I will intervene.
Indien ik twijfel aan de wenselijkheid van dit initiatief, of wanneer het ernaar uit ziet dat de plannen kwalitatief of financieel onvoldoende geborgd zijn, zal ik ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie van jongeren bij het vinden van een bijbaan of stageplaats

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked ministers about discrimination against young people, including migrant youth, when seeking part-time jobs or internships, and about the measures taken. The minister acknowledged that discrimination is unacceptable and that migrant youth need more applications for internships, described programmes such as the City Deal, Werkakkoorden and training initiatives, and said the anti-discrimination action programme would be updated in early 2016.
The revision of the action programme will work across specific policy tracks.
De herijking van het actieprogramma zal overkoepelend werken ten aanzien van specifieke beleidstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) de Roemernorm omzeilt door uitzendkrachten twee weken naar huis te sturen

Green Left MP Voortman asked whether the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) is evading the Roemer norm (a cap on temporary agency workers) by sending agency staff home for two weeks, and whether other ministries and bodies do the same and whether DUO will be addressed. The government answered that it sees no reason to conclude DUO is concealing a breach, no reason to investigate other bodies, and no reason to address DUO, referring to earlier answers to Van Raak.
Do you share the view that DUO is trying to conceal by this means that it is breaching the agreed percentage of flexible workers?
Vraag 1 Deelt u de mening dat DUO hiermee probeert te verhullen dat het de gemaakte afspraken over het percentage flexwerkers schendt?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het misbruik dat DUO maakt van de Roemernorm

MP Van Raak asked whether DUO's handling of the Roemer norm (capping external staffing at 10% of personnel costs) was a pretext to send temporary agency workers home while keeping expensive top consultants, and how the minister would intervene. The minister denied any such intent, explained that DUO cut 18 external advisers and limited agency rostering for December due to seasonal patterns and leave, and stated that DUO treats agency workers as valued staff.
That is not the case. In enforcing the Roemer norm at DUO, all categories of external staff were examined.
Daarvan is geen sprake. Bij de handhaving van de Roemernorm door DUO is naar alle categorieën externen gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Van Dekken over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten die bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werken twee weken onbetaald thuis moeten blijven

PvdA MPs Vermeij and Van Dekken asked whether DUO temporary agency workers were being sent home unpaid for two weeks, and whether this was acceptable. The minister denied that workers were sent home unpaid, explaining that agency staff were rostered only where needed and that many took leave, while committing to gradually reduce flexible staffing under a union agreement.
Sending home employees without a permanent contract is not the case.
Van naar huis sturen van medewerkers zonder vast contract is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff inzake het bericht 'Universiteiten gebruiken keuzecheck om student af te wijzen'

MP Grashoff asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether universities misuse the study choice check (studiekeuzecheck) to deter students with negative advice from enrolling, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the check is not a selection tool, that tardily registered students cannot be refused on its basis, that only isolated signals of misuse exist (one already resolved, one forwarded to the inspectorate), and that she will keep monitoring and repeat the reminder to prospective students.
Universities of applied sciences and universities may not refuse students who registered by 1 May on the basis of the results of the study choice check.
Hogescholen en universiteiten mogen studenten die zich uiterlijk op 1 mei hebben aangemeld, niet weigeren vanwege de resultaten van de studiekeuzecheck.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat vrouwen nog steeds minder verdienen dan mannen

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the ministers how they react to reports that women still earn less than men for equal work, why women over 35 earn less, what the pay gaps are, what agreements exist with social partners, and what role the government sees for itself. The ministers answer that pay discrimination is unacceptable, that much of the gap stems from different labour-market positions, cite CBS findings and ongoing actions and studies, and promise further updates in early 2016.
Nowadays it is not explainable that it still occurs that women earn less than men for equivalent work.
Het is heden ten dage niet uit te leggen dat het nog altijd voorkomt dat vrouwen minder verdienen dan mannen voor gelijkwaardig werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'De kortingsregeling voor een studie aan de Open Universiteit'

The MPs asked whether Surinamese students living in Suriname are excluded from the Open Universiteit's collegegeld discount while Surinamese students in the Netherlands are eligible, and whether the discount should be extended to them. The minister denied the exclusion, explaining that since 2013 residence no longer matters for the statutory fee, so Surinamese students in Suriname can qualify, and she agreed that they should be able to.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch inzake de aanwijzing van Professionele Organisaties voor Monumentenbehoud

An MP asked the Education, Culture and Science minister about the POM status for heritage organisations, including the rejection of Alde Fryske Tjerken, the falling AOM status, volunteer impact, administrative burden and evaluation. The minister said the criteria are stricter to raise professionalism, reported application numbers, and promised to keep the scheme largely unchanged until 2018 with an evaluation around 2017.

I have asked the Council to advise me on how things have gone so far and how the Council, the designated POMs and the Cultural Heritage Agency can work together to help more organisations reach the level needed to qualify as POM.

Ik heb de Raad gevraagd om mij te adviseren over de gang van zaken tot dusver en hoe de Raad, de aangewezen POM's en de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed, zich in kunnen spannen om meer organisaties het niveau te laten bereiken om als POM gekwalificeerd te kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht 'Stafmedewerker Haagse Hogeschool krijgt 4 ton mee'

An MP asked the Education Minister about reports that a staff member of The Hague University of Applied Sciences received a severance payment of 4 million euros. The minister said the inspectorate found no basis for enforcement under the WNT pay cap because the person was not a top official, though the payment conflicts with the spirit of the law, and the cabinet plans to extend the WNT to all employees.
From this information the inspectorate regrettably had to conclude that there is no reason for enforcement under the WNT, because this is not a top official within the meaning of the WNT.
Uit deze informatie heeft de inspectie helaas moeten concluderen dat er geen reden is voor handhaving op grond van de WNT, want het gaat niet om een topfunctionaris in de zin van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jasper van Dijk inzake het artikel Moslimrector opnieuw onder vuur, nu om haattweets

MPs Duisenberg and Van Dijk asked whether the Inspectorate will visit the Islamic University of Rotterdam again and whether the rector's renewed controversial tweets breach his agreements with the minister. The minister confirmed the Inspectorate visit, said the rector's statements breach the agreements and undermine trust, and announced a bill allowing recognition to be withdrawn for discriminatory statements by board members.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het artikel Moslimrector opnieuw onder vuur, nu om haattweets

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the Raad van Toezicht of the Islamic University of Rotterdam refuses to distance itself from the rector's statements and tweets, and about the board's role and the rector's voting advice to Turks in the Netherlands. The Minister answered that the board has not publicly disavowed the statements, that she finds the board's response inadequate, that the rector's voting advice is inappropriate, and that she has repeatedly urged the board to take measures.
The inspectorate and I have repeatedly urged the Raad van Toezicht to show that the IUR does subscribe to the principles of the Dutch rule of law by distancing itself from the rector's statements.

Ik en ook de inspectie hebben er bij de Raad van Toezicht meerdere malen op aangedrongen te laten zien dat de IUR de principes van de Nederlandse rechtsstaat wel degelijk onderschrijft door afstand te nemen van de uitspraken van de rector
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het vergoeden van een doventolk door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why people over 30 are denied a sign-language interpreter for study, and how that fits with policy easing study for older adults. The government explains the 30-year limit for education funding, notes that UWV can fund interpreters for work-related training under conditions, and says a study has been started.
The outcome of the consultation is that a study will be started on behalf of the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Health, Welfare and Sport, and Social Affairs and Employment.

Uitkomst van het overleg is dat er in opdracht van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), het Ministerie van VWS en het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) een onderzoek wordt gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel inzake het bericht dat 'NWO vrouwelijke wetenschappers discrimineert’

An MP asked whether NWO's grant process discriminates against female scientists, citing a study showing women had lower Veni grant success rates in 2010-2012, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges gender inequality and says NWO will pilot bias training and a follow-up study, but declines to judge the study's findings or monitor the measures separately.
Separate monitoring of this subject is not on the agenda.
Aparte monitoring op dit onderwerp is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het bericht dat masteropleidingen 'zesjesstudenten' gaan weren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether master programmes excluding students with bachelor grades below a seven is acceptable and whether bachelor graduates can always find a master place. The minister defended the abolition of pre-entry master rights and the allowance of quality criteria, said the Inspectorate will monitor access, and promised intervention powers if bachelor graduates are shut out.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education (hereafter: Inspectorate) to monitor this.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: Inspectie) gevraagd dit te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met het passend onderwijs op het mbo

An SP MP asked the minister about problems with passend onderwijs in mbo, including a student removed after four weeks, budget dilution for students needing support, and exam flexibility. The minister said implementation is not causing major problems, that the budget is unchanged, and that individual cases should be resolved between institution and student, offering a study on exam flexibility.
This data is not known. Mbo institutions are themselves responsible for the support they provide within the framework of passend onderwijs.
Deze gegevens zijn niet bekend. Mbo-instellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning die ze bieden in het kader van passend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over leerlingen die kleine vakken thuis volgen achter de computer

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked whether a Liemers College arrangement letting pupils follow small subjects such as philosophy online at home, due to school shrinkage, is acceptable and how quality and compulsory-education rules are safeguarded. The State Secretary said the school's own professionals and parents decide, that distance learning can count as lesson time under the Leerplichtwet if integrated and approved by the works council, and gave no new concrete commitments.
Distance learning can be regarded as instruction time and therefore as lesson time within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act, if this benefits the quality or accessibility of education.
Afstandsonderwijs kan gezien worden als onderwijstijd en daarmee ook als lestijd in de zin van de Leerplichtwet, als dit de kwaliteit of toegankelijkheid van het onderwijs ten goede komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken op Twitter van een persoon die werkzaam is bij een onderwijsinstelling

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers about a discriminatory tweet by a school employee, rising internet discrimination reports, and whether a racism register, educational measure, and stronger reporting channel would be introduced. The government answered that online speech is protected within legal limits, cited rising MiND reports, announced an expert meeting with platforms and promised to report results in the budget debate, but rejected a racism register and a new educational measure.
I am not in favour of a separate racism register as advocated by MPs Kuzu and Öztürk.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een apart racismeregister zoals dat wordt voorgestaan door de leden Kuzu en Öztürk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat éénvijfde van de oud-studenten wanbetaler is

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers whether one in five former students being in arrears on student loan repayment is worrying, what measures will prevent further debt, and whether enforcement and the draagkracht scheme work as intended. The minister answered that arrears are varied (many small), that the share has stayed around 20 percent, that new measures and stricter enforcement are being used, and that the government does not expect the new loan system to produce more defaulters, but no new concrete commitments beyond existing monitoring were given.
It is correct that 20.6 percent of former students with a repayment obligation have a payment arrear (as of 1 June 2015).
Het klopt dat 20,6 procent van de oud-studenten met een terugbetaalverplichting een betalingsachterstand heeft (stand per 1 juni 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel inzake het bericht dat het wettelijk streefcijfer voor het aantal vrouwen in de top niet gehaald wordt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the failure to reach the statutory 30% target for women in top management, and why only 7.8% of listed company boards are women. The minister acknowledged the slow progress, described the Impuls Vrouwen naar de Top and related voluntary initiatives, and promised to inform parliament this autumn about next steps and possible measures.
I will inform you this autumn, based on the experiences with the Impuls and the outcomes of the Bedrijvenmonitor, about the next steps and measures to promote more diversity at the top.

Ik zal u aan de hand van de ervaringen met de Impuls en de uitkomsten van de Bedrijvenmonitor dit najaar informeren over de volgende stappen en maatregelen om meer diversiteit aan de top te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een anti-Westerse en anti-Israëlische docent

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Education about a trainee civics teacher whose views on the West, Israel and refugees were reported. The Secretary of State answered that the views do not belong in education, that the school found no evidence of such views being passed to pupils, that the person has since left the school, and that the statements were made in a private capacity.
Statements that run counter to the fundamental values of our democratic constitutional state do not belong in education.
Uitspraken die ingaan tegen de fundamentele waarden van onze democratische rechtsstaat, horen niet thuis in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over denigrerende uitspraken over studenten

An SP MP asked the Education Minister to explain and justify her remarks about students choosing university boards, her views on board appointments and the Amsterdam Maagdenhuis protest. The minister replied that student and staff involvement in board appointments will be strengthened through the Versterking Bestuurskracht bill, while defending expertise-based selection and rejecting claims of arrogance.

I consider it important that teachers and students get a greater role in choosing those board members, which is why I am arranging in the Strengthening Governance bill that they have a say in the profile and appointment of board members.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat docenten en studenten bij de keuze van die bestuurders een grotere rol krijgen, daarom regel ik in wetsvoorstel Versterking Bestuurskracht dat zij inspraak krijgen in de profielschets en de benoeming van bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Rog over de oproep om de slopers van het maagdenhuis aan te pakken

MPs Duisenberg and Rog asked the Minister of Education whether the damage from the Maagdenhuis occupation should be recovered from the vandals, including via group liability, and why the costs and deductible were handled as they were. The minister answered that the motion was considered executed, that group liability and tracing the perpetrators were judged unlikely to succeed and burdensome, and that she would not disclose the insurance contract details.
It is not for me to make confidential business information about the insurance agreement between the UvA and the insurer public.
Het is niet aan mij om vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens over de tussen de UvA en de verzekeraar afgesloten verzekeringsovereenkomst openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een antisemitisch schoolboek

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the education minister how she views antisemitic claims in a secondary-school history supplement on the Middle East and whether such material belongs in Dutch schools. The state secretary replied that the ministry does not judge individual textbooks, that the publisher revised some content after consultation with critics, and that teachers and experts should ensure historical objectivity.
It is not for me to establish the objectivity of historical sources used in teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de objectiviteit vast te stellen van historische bronnen die in lesmethoden worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over hoge extra opleidingskosten voor mbo-leerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about high additional costs for mbo students and whether they can become barriers to enrolment, including cost information by programme and support for parents. The minister answered that enrolment may not depend on contributions beyond tuition, that schools must inform students in advance and offer payment arrangements, and that the Inspectorate and the MBO Raad will be engaged, with a bill giving student councils advisory rights on school costs.
Thousands of mbo programmes are offered. This makes it very difficult to request this information for each individual mbo programme and keep it up to date.
Er worden duizenden mbo-opleidingen aangeboden in mbo. Dit maakt het erg lastig om per individuele mbo-opleiding deze informatie op te vragen, en actueel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over onbereikbaar zijn van duur MBO voor kinderen van minima

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that expensive MBO vocational education is out of reach for children of low-income families, with some schools redirecting pupils who cannot pay to other options or to Leergeld foundations. The minister says the situation is unwelcome, that schools may require only tuition and not other fees, that the inspectorate monitors school-cost policy, and that she will ask the MBO Raad to promote instalment payment schemes and report back to parliament.
I will inform your House of this in writing.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover schriftelijke informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over minimagezinnen waarvoor de kosten van mbo-opleidingen voor hun kinderen onbetaalbaar zouden worden

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked whether low-income families can afford mbo school costs now that the WTOS allowance for under-18s was abolished, and whether this forces students to drop out. The minister acknowledges the change makes payment harder, says about 27,000 students previously received WTOS and that the kindgebonden budget increase compensates most, points to school payment plans and local funds, and says municipalities are responsible for local support.
It is true that the income-dependent allowance for education contributions and school costs (WTOS) for parents of children under 18 ceased to exist from school year 2015/2016.
Het klopt dat de inkomensafhankelijke tegemoetkoming in de onderwijsbijdrage en schoolkosten (WTOS) voor ouders met kinderen jonger dan 18 jaar vanaf schooljaar 2015/2016 is opgehouden te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over ouders die steeds vaker financiële hulp nodig hebben om de kosten voor school en sport te dekken

An SP MP asked why 68,619 children depend on charity such as Stichting Leergeld to cover school and sport costs, and whether voluntary parental contributions should be capped or reported. The State Secretary answered that schools must offer free alternatives for compulsory activities, that voluntary contributions are the shared responsibility of schools and parents monitored by the inspectorate, and that no cap or national reporting is planned.
From school year 2012/2013 supervision of compliance with school costs and voluntary parental contributions has been included in the inspectorate's regular supervision.
Vanaf het schooljaar 2012/2013 is het toezicht op de naleving van de schoolkosten en vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Pabo's lopen leeg, tekort basisschoolleraren dreigt'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education why mandatory entrance tests for teacher training colleges (pabo's) were introduced without prior notice to pupils, whether the entry quality truly rises, when students learn of admission, how funding will compensate for falling intake, and what measures prevent future drops. The minister defended the tests as raising entry quality, said the late admission timing was acceptable, stated she is in talks with the sector on temporary funding compensation, and declined further measures for now while awaiting intake figures in early 2016.
At this moment I am not considering any measures.
Op dit moment overweeg ik geen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder en Verhoeven over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief

MPs from VVD, SP, CDA and D66 asked the minister why the Nationaal Archief's digitisation of national archives is being in-sourced to the Belastingdienst rather than tendered, despite a parliamentary motion and the Commission of Procurement Experts' advice against it. The minister defends in-sourcing as lawful internal shared services, citing cost, logistics and business-case reasons, while acknowledging the earlier letter wording on loan of scanners was unfortunate and deferring answers pending a research report.
Reversing the in-sourcing of the work, as the motion requests, would lead to a further delay of, expected, at least one year.
Terugdraaien van de inbesteding van de werkzaamheden, zoals de motie vraagt, leidt tot een verdere vertraging van, naar verwachting, minimaal een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake de verhuizing van SLO van Enschede naar Utrecht

MPs Rog and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why SLO is moving its seat from Enschede to Utrecht, citing regional employment dispersal policy and a board letter claiming the ministry strongly favoured Utrecht. The minister answered that the move is SLO's own strategic decision, denied having expressed a preference for Utrecht beyond noting its logic, declined to intervene or write to SLO, and said no statutory-change approval basis exists to refuse.
I have not expressed a preference for Utrecht because, as previously answered on this subject, I am not responsible for it.
Ik heb geen voorkeur voor Utrecht uitgesproken omdat zoals eerder geantwoord over dit onderwerp, ik daar niet over ga.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake de berichten 'Rijk in de fout met licentie voor Wijnbergschool' en 'Patstelling op De Berg'

An MP from the CDA asked the Education Minister why a VSO (secondary special education) licence was granted to De Wijnberg despite an existing nearby school, and whether this created harmful competition and financial strain in North Limburg. The State Secretary answered that the WEC law obliges granting such expansions when capacity need is shown, that the regional situation is being addressed by a national project leader, and that the government will not cover the financial shortfall.
The WEC, however, offers no room to refuse on policy grounds.
De WEC biedt echter geen ruimte om op beleidsmatige gronden af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het artikel "ROC Leiden gered van faillissement"

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the rescue of ROC Leiden from bankruptcy, governance and oversight of mbo institutions, wage-benefit rules, macro-efficiency of provision, and how bankruptcies and the curator's role relate to the minister's system responsibility. The minister answered at length, defending autonomy and institutional responsibility, pointing to an ongoing review committee reporting by 15 October 2015, and largely declining formal new powers or changes to the bankruptcy framework.
I would then gladly enter into discussion with your House.
Ik ga daarna graag met uw Kamer in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de buitensporige declaraties van bestuurders van de hogeschool Windesheim

An MP asked the Minister of Education about excessive expense claims (88,000 euro, mostly travel) by board members of Windesheim university of applied sciences, whether they were lawful, and whether a uniform sober expense code should be drawn up. The Minister answered that existing rules require sober, transparent claims, that the Inspectorate of Education is investigating, that the supervisory board is responsible for oversight, and that she will consider stricter rules after the investigation's outcome.
I have now instructed the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the expense claims of board members in higher education.
Inmiddels heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs opdracht gegeven het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de berichten “Top Universiteit Utrecht knoeit met dienstauto” en ”Overtreedt Universiteit Utrecht de Balkenendenorm”?

An MP asked the minister whether Utrecht University's board chair received a company car with chauffeur used for private purposes and salary above the WNT pay cap, and about tax treatment and oversight. The minister answered that the 2014 WNT overshoot was recovered and repaid, a taxable benefit was settled for one member, and the inspectorate has been asked to investigate declaration behaviour in higher education.
In addition, I have meanwhile asked the inspectorate to conduct an investigation into the declaration behaviour of board members in higher education.
Daarnaast heb ik de inspectie inmiddels gevraagd om een onderzoek naar het declaratiegedrag van de bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over de hoge declaraties bij Hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education about very high expense claims by two Windesheim university of applied sciences board members and whether the board model and oversight by the supervisory board have failed. The Minister said existing expense rules and public disclosure apply, the Inspectorate is investigating claims across institutions, and rules may be tightened after its findings, while rejecting the claim that the board model has failed.
I have now instructed the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the expense claims of board members in higher education.
Inmiddels heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs opdracht gegeven het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders in het hoger onderwijs te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de verhuizing van de Stichting Leerplanontwikkeling (SLO)

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education whether the government still pursues dispersal of government-funded jobs, whether SLO's move from Enschede to Utrecht is wise, and whether OCW has effectively endorsed the move and the use of SLO's equity built from subsidies. The minister answers that the move is a board decision with no legal grounds for OCW to refuse, that the reserves are lawfully built, and that the advisory request is an internal document not shared with parliament.
It is not a public document and I therefore cannot share it with the House.
Het is geen openbaar stuk en ik kan het dus niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over mbo-scholen die probleemjongeren blijven weigeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether vulnerable youths are routinely refused entry to mbo vocational colleges, following a broadcast, and whether the institutions acted carefully. The Minister denied a general pattern, pointed to complaint and mediation routes for refused youths, and referred to forthcoming legislation granting a right of admission.
A vocational college cannot simply refuse a young person.
Een mbo-instelling kan een jongere niet «zomaar» weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht "Studenten lenen graag, alleen niet voor de studie"

Member Rog (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a report that many students borrow from DUO to offset the loss of the basic grant, partly to save for later, and whether incentives in the loan system encourage excessive borrowing, its effect on the loan repayment rate and the budget, and whether conditions will be changed. The Minister acknowledged that students may borrow about two-thirds of the lost grant, argued that borrowing beyond need is not very advantageous, said leiding behaviour will be monitored and that action will be taken if signals warrant it, but declined to commit to changing loan conditions.
Should the government receive other signals, it will act according to the circumstances of the case.
Mocht de regering andere signalen krijgen, dan zal ze naar bevind van zaken handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes inzake de homohatende songteksten van de Surinaamse band Hakuna Matata Gang

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked ministers about homophobic lyrics by the Surinamese band Hakuna Matata Gang, whether they would be prosecuted during Dutch tours, and whether Suriname's government would be pressed to withdraw support and promote LGBT rights. The minister replied that the Dutch concerts were cancelled, the video removed, the band dropped the song, and the OM is reviewing a complaint, while Suriname denies financial support and the embassy has raised concerns and funded LGBTI rights work.
The Public Prosecution Service can decide to pursue criminal prosecution if it would turn out that during an event there was incitement to hatred
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan besluiten om tot strafrechtelijke vervolging over te gaan indien zou blijken dat tijdens een evenement sprake is geweest van het aanzetten tot haat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het veelvuldig gebruik van flexcontracten door de UvA

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Amsterdam's heavy reliance on flexible, temporary contracts in the Faculty of Humanities and whether this conflicts with the CAO and the Wet Werk en Zekerheid. The minister answered that the UvA has a 10-point plan and a working group on temporary contracts, denied that two-thirds of staff are flex workers, said the CAO and labour law must be complied with, and declined to start talks with the UvA.
From the Executive Board of the UvA I have understood that the provisions in the CAO universiteiten and other laws and regulations must be fully complied with.
Van het College van Bestuur van de UvA heb ik begrepen dat de bepalingen in de CAO universiteiten en andere wet- en regelgeving volledig dienen te worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat er grote onrust is onder schoonmakers van de Roeterseilandcampus (Universiteit van Amsterdam)

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports of unrest among cleaning staff at the UvA Roeterseiland campus after a new contract with cleaning firm Hago, raising workload, intimidation, procurement quality and possible Arbowet violations. The minister says the UvA and the contractor are in constructive talks with staff, has added temporary cleaners and more time, sees no basis yet to judge Arbowet breaches, and says the Inspectorate would investigate any complaints received.
If the Inspectorate SZW receives complaints from the works council about violations of the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW will investigate these complaints.
Als de Inspectie SZW klachten ontvangt van de OR vanwege overtredingen van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, dan zal de Inspectie SZW deze klachten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Meenen over het bericht UvA probeert CAO te omzeilen

MPs Voortman and Van Meenen asked whether the University of Amsterdam planned to circumvent the new collective labour agreement by avoiding conversion of temporary contracts into permanent ones, as suggested in a leaked email. The minister answered that the executive board rejects such circumvention, will comply with the CAO and Wwz in letter and spirit, and has created an individual-rights ombudsperson whose opinions are binding, while noting the email was one employee's idea rather than university policy.
The Executive Board of the UvA has explicitly distanced itself from the idea that it plans to circumvent the new CAO Universiteiten.
Het College van Bestuur van de UvA (CvB) heeft laten weten nadrukkelijk afstand te nemen van het idee dat het van plan is de nieuwe CAO Universiteiten te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog inzake het bericht 'Verplicht archeologisch onderzoek'

CDA MPs asked whether a fire victim in Alkmaar must pay about 60,000 euro for mandatory archaeological excavation before rebuilding, and whether the 'polluter pays' principle can be applied to victims. The minister confirmed the amounts (halved by the municipality from 120,000), explained that municipalities set conditions via the environmental permit, and said the RCE will report on insurers' practice by 31 December 2015.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to carry out an exploration of insurers' conduct in these cases and report to me by 31 December 2015.
Aan de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed heb ik gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de handelwijze van verzekeraars in deze gevallen en mij hier voor 31 december 2015 over te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over allochtone studenten die volgens de stagemonitor minder stagevergoeding krijgen en vaker moeten solliciteren voor ze een stageplek vinden

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether the National Internship Monitor shows that students with foreign-born parents receive lower internship pay, must apply more often, and get lower grades, and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what institutions and employers should do. The minister answers that the monitor shows more applications and lower pay for this group but cannot establish systematic differences or discrimination given sample and confounder gaps, acknowledges possible discrimination as a serious concern, and points to existing policy programmes and a forthcoming ROA study without committing to new concrete action.
On the basis of this monitor I cannot establish whether allochtone students are discriminated against in internships.
Op basis van deze monitor kan ik niet vast stellen of allochtone studenten worden gediscrimineerd bij stages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het groot manifest der Nederlandse taal

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Grand Manifesto against English-language instruction in higher education, the share of English-taught master's and bachelor's programmes, and how article 7.2 WHW is monitored and enforced. The minister acknowledged the importance of Dutch as a science language, defended English-taught programmes where justified, said the Inspectorate can investigate if needed, and promised to return on reflection with the sector.
I will consult with the VSNU and the VH on how that reflection can be stimulated.
Ik zal met de VSNU en de VH overleggen op welke wijze die reflectie kan worden gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het kader van het studievoorschot

An MP asked the minister about whether universities were presenting budget outlines to works councils (instemmingsrecht op hoofdlijnen) and about the sector-wide 200 million euro pre-investment under the study-fee reform. The minister said universities were implementing the consultation duty, that details are left to institutions, and that she will report on pre-investments at year end.

Following signals that some universities do not submit the main lines of the budget to the works council, I made inquiries, among others, with the University of Amsterdam, the VU and the University of Groningen.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van signalen dat er universiteiten zijn die de hoofdlijnen van de begroting niet voorleggen aan de medezeggenschap, onder andere navraag gedaan

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Jasper van Dijk, Rog en Bisschop inzake de berekeningen van de VSNU dat het studievoorschot bij lange na geen 1 miljard euro oplevert en de komende tien jaar zelfs nauwelijks ext

MPs Schouten, Van Dijk, Rog and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education about VSNU calculations showing the student tuition-investment package yields far less than 1 billion euro and barely adds investment over ten years. The minister replied that up to 1 billion euro becomes available by 2026, that institutions will pre-invest 200 million euro yearly in 2015-2017, and that the investment will vary by institution, with details reported only at sector level.
I expect institutions to make the allocation of their pre-investments transparent and to discuss them well internally.
Ik verwacht van de instellingen dat zij de bestemming van de voorinvesteringen inzichtelijk maken en intern goed bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het inschrijfgeld voor een master aan de Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam

An MP asks whether the Erasmus University Rotterdam may charge a 100 euro application fee for master's programmes, and whether this breaches the principle that Dutch bachelor graduates pay only tuition. The minister confirms the principle, says the university deviates from it, and says a general administrative order will clarify rules on fees, though no investigation of other universities is planned.
I will provide the institutions with further clarification of the statutory principle
Ik zal de instellingen voorzien van een nadere toelichting op het wettelijke uitgangspunt

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van de ov-jaarkaart en de gevolgen hiervan voor grote gezinnen met kinderen die de vooropleiding volgen van ballet- en dansopleidingen en conservatoria

MP Dik-Faber asks whether the replacement of the OV Jaarkaart by OV Vrij raises costs sharply for large families with children in dance and music pre-training, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answers that most families benefit, that NS will contact the roughly 405 multi-sibling-pass holders to advise them, that the concession was not breached, and that no evidence shows families abandoning training for cost reasons.
Reasonably, NS as an independent company cannot be expected to fully grant all wishes.
Redelijkerwijs kan niet van NS als zelfstandig bedrijf verwacht worden dat alle wensen onverkort gehonoreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake het artikel "Subsidie? We helpen je graag verder", over de gang van zaken rond subsidieverstrekking aan de Gay Krant

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether ministry officials rewriting subsidy applications for the Gay Krant was lawful and how many such cases occur each year. The Minister answered that technical assistance on incomplete applications is lawful under the Awb, that rewriting applications is not an official's task, and that the ministry does not record how each application was handled.
Rewriting a subsidy application is not among the tasks of an official.
Het (her)schrijven van een subsidieaanvraag behoort niet tot de taken van een ambtenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Verplichte opgraving na nieuwjaarsbrand Alkmaar kost modezaak 60.000 euro'

MPs Van Veen and Rudmer Heerema asked the minister whether mandatory archaeological excavation after a New Year's fire in Alkmaar, costing a shop owner 60,000 euro, reflects absurd legislation and whether insurers cover such costs. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion and tools to limit costs, that the law does not mandate excavation, that the Alkmaar municipality chose full excavation, and that the RCE will report on insurer practice by 31 December 2015.
I have no overview of which insurers do and do not cover archaeological soil investigation when rebuilding after fire or other calamity.
Ik heb geen overzicht over welke verzekeraars wel en niet archeologisch bodemonderzoek bij herbouw na brand of andere calamiteit vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Rector Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam ziet Joods Armeens complot tegen Erdogan en AKP'

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about inflammatory statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam and what oversight bodies and the ministers would do. The minister says she has lost confidence in the rector, that the inspectorate's enhanced supervision continues, and that she will use a planned legal power to act once the bill takes effect, which is expected late this year.
At present I myself have no legal means to take further measures.
Zelf heb ik op dit moment geen juridische middelen om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over nieuwe uitspraken van de rector van de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam (IUR)

An MP asked the Minister of Education about repeated controversial statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam (IUR) and what the government would do if the governing board did not distance itself. The minister answers that the statements are unacceptable, that supervision by the inspectorate remains tightened, that the NVAO is assessing accreditation, and that she is preparing legislation to withdraw legal-person status where institutions fail to promote social responsibility.
I urgently asked the Supervisory Board and the foundation board to take measures.
Ik heb de Raad van Toezicht en het stichtingsbestuur dringend verzocht om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Van Dekken over het in vaste dienst nemen van payrollers door DUO

Two MPs asked the ministers whether DUO's decision to end payroll contracts for 19 workers, who will remain employed by Randstad Payroll Solutions, was reasonable and consistent with the Wwz, and how it fits the motion on regional employment. The ministers confirmed the contracts are ended, cited DUO's digitisation and budget cuts, said DUO will help with redeployment, and promised a regional employment overview in the autumn.
Randstad Payroll Solutions will ensure new work for these employees.
Randstad Payroll Solutions zal zorgen voor nieuw werk voor deze medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Bestuur gaat te ver, vinden Leidse studenten’

An MP asked the education minister about student criticism at Leiden University of its binding study advice (bsa) experiment in the second year, and whether this lacks support in the participation council. The minister answers that the university board is in ongoing dialogue with students, that the experiment will be evaluated internally and by the minister in 2018, and that she sees no reason to halt it.
I see no reason to halt this ongoing experiment prematurely.
Voor het voortijdig staken van dit lopende experiment zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Ark over het beter rekening houden in het familierecht met kinderen en volwassenen die leven met een intersekse conditie

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Ark asked about the population size of people with intersex conditions, whether people should not face pressure to register a sex, and whether the Staatscommissie Familierecht should examine allowing people not to register a sex. The minister agreed sex registration has lost legal weight, promised to consider steps to reduce burdens, and said he would ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether sex can be dropped from parenthood legislation.
I am willing to ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether it is possible and desirable to omit the mention of sex from parenthood legislation.

Ik ben bereid de Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap te vragen om te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk en wenselijk is om in de wetgeving over het ouderschap af te zien van vermelding van het geslacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels’

D66 MPs asked whether apprenticeship (BBL) contracts are exempt from the chain-employment rule and the transition payment, and how the transition payment affects training places. The minister answered that BBL contracts are exempt from the new chain rule, that they are not exempt from the transition payment but employers may deduct training costs under a new decree, and that the effect on training places will be monitored.
This has partly led the cabinet to decide, by general administrative order, that training costs may be deducted from the transition payment.
Dat heeft er mede toe geleid dat het kabinet heeft besloten om bij amvb te bepalen dat kosten van de opleiding in mindering kunnen worden gebracht op de transitievergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels'

MPs Lucas and Anne Mulder asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) under the new dismissal rules would discourage employers from offering learn-work places (leerwerkplekken) in vocational education, and whether apprentices should be excluded. The government answered that the payment applies in principle to apprentices, but employers may deduct training costs from it under an order in council, and it promised to consult social partners on collective agreements and to evaluate a pilot combined learning route.
At the same time, it is of course not intended that the introduction of the transition payment leads to fewer learn-work places being offered.
Tegelijkertijd is het uiteraard niet de bedoeling dat de introductie van de transitievergoeding leidt tot het aanbieden van minder leerwerkplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de voorgenomen verhuizing van de SLO naar Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Education and Economic Affairs ministers whether SLO's planned move of 120 staff from Enschede to Utrecht is acceptable, given its state funding and the Chamber's past preference for spreading government-funded jobs, and whether the minister would talk with SLO about staying in Enschede. The minister answered that the move has negligible regional employment effects, that SLO is a private-law body whose location decision requires only formal ministerial consent that the minister sees no grounds to withhold, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
A possible conversation with SLO about its location could arise within the subsidy relationship between OCW and SLO.
Een eventueel gesprek met SLO over haar vestigingsplaats zou aan de orde kunnen zijn in het kader van de subsidierelatie tussen OCW en SLO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de financiële problemen bij onderzoeksinstituut NIOZ en de gevolgen voor NIOZ-Yerseke

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked about NIOZ's financial problems and the reported plan to close the Yerseke branch and move staff to Texel, questioning the government's commitment to Zeeland. The Secretaries answer that the financial problems are real, that options including concentration on Texel are being studied with regional parties, that no irreversible decisions have been taken, and that a broader regional knowledge strategy is under review.
There is currently intensive consultation with the province and the municipality, and no irreversible decisions have yet been taken.
Er is inmiddels intensief overleg met de provincie en de gemeente en er zijn nog geen onomkeerbare besluiten genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat twee oud-bestuurders van de VU een gouden handdruk meekrijgen

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the minister whether severance payments of about two million euros to two former VU Amsterdam board members, including a salary continuation for former chair Smit, were acceptable and how exorbitant payouts could be stopped. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found the payments compliant with transitional law under the WNT, that a 2,125 euro overpayment was repaid, that a moral appeal was made, and that she has no legal basis to stop the payments.

Following this report and the amount of the severance arrangement stated in the 2013 annual report, I asked the Inspectorate to test the relevant severance arrangements of the two former board members against the WNT.

Naar aanleiding van dit bericht en de hoogte van de vertrekregeling zoals vermeld in het jaarverslag 2013 heb ik de Inspectie verzocht om de desbetreffende vertrekregelingen van de twee oud-bestuurders te toetsen aan de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semi publieke sector (WNT).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over studenten in vreemdelingendetentie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether students who occupied the Maagdenhuis and were held in immigration detention, some for up to nine months, were misused under immigration law and should be released. The state secretary answered that the students were released once their identity was confirmed, that the court awarded modest damages for unlawful detention but found no misuse of powers, and that police and officer training will be adjusted.
The court, however, did not rule that there was a misuse of powers.
De rechter heeft echter niet geoordeeld dat sprake is van misbruik van bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over kunstaankopen op de veilingmarkt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Rijksmuseum acted adequately when it bought a Jan Asselijn painting at TEFAF for 1,200,000 euro after a similar work sold for 760,355 euro at auction months earlier, and how museum purchasing and the Governance Code Cultuur are supervised. The Minister answered that museums bear primary responsibility for purchases, that the Rijksmuseum acted adequately after restoration and private fundraising, and that no extra accountability beyond regular reporting is needed.
I see no reason for extra accountability on this beyond the regular annual reporting by museums and the Mondriaan Fund.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor extra verantwoording daarvan naast de reguliere jaarverantwoording door musea en het Mondriaan Fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Hachchi en Bergkamp over de waarschuwing voor digitale dementie bij decentrale overheden

MPs Schouw, Hachchi and Bergkamp asked the ministers about warnings from local and regional officials that digital records risk being poorly preserved, and whether archive law and powers are sufficient. The government says existing archive law shows no gaps, points to a Ictu baseline study and to strategic information consultation (SIO) as the remedy, and declines to accelerate the AIDO project for lack of resources.
There are indeed no indications that the legal frameworks in archive regulations lead to shortcomings.
Er zijn inderdaad geen indicaties dat de wettelijke kaders in de Archiefregelgeving tot tekortkomingen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Monasch over de dreigende 'digitale dementie' in het openbaar bestuur

MPs Oosenbrug and Monasch asked whether the government shares mayors' concerns about 'digital dementia' in public administration, meaning the risk that digital records of government action are poorly archived and lost, and what oversight and responsibility exist for archiving at all levels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described archiving initiatives (e-depot, Archief 2020, AIDO) and said provinces oversee municipalities' and water boards' archiving under the Gemeentewet, while the ministers' responsibility is limited to the legal framework.
The management of digital documents is not arranged in such a way that their findability is guaranteed.
Het beheer van digitale documenten is niet dusdanig geregeld dat de terugvindbaarheid daarvan gegarandeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over de onheuse bejegening van Israël in de geschiedenismethode ''Geschiedeniswerkplaats vmbo-kgt 4 examenboek'' van Noordhoff Uitgevers

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister and State Secretary of Education whether a Dutch vmbo history textbook presents Israel unfairly and fuels anti-Semitism. The State Secretary declined to judge the specific textbook, stating that publishers and teachers are responsible for balanced content, while noting that objections from Israel exist and that the Israeli education minister had raised concerns.
Nevertheless, it is not for me to assess a teaching method on its substance, and I will therefore neither approve nor disapprove of it.
Desalniettemin is het niet aan mij om een lesmethode inhoudelijk te beoordelen en ik ga deze dan ook niet goed- of afkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Beertema over de kosten van asielzoekers

PVV MPs Fritsma and Beertema asked for the total 2014 cost of asylum seekers, including IND, COA, DT&V, legal aid, subsidies and education for asylum-seeker children. The government answered with itemised figures from the Justice and Education budgets, totalling roughly 0.9 billion euro, and noted that data on children without residence rights is not available.
Specific data on children without residence rights are not available and therefore cannot be provided.
Specifieke gegevens over kinderen zonder verblijfsrecht zijn niet beschikbaar en kunnen dan ook niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel ‘Einde dreigt voor winkelcentrum bij school’

An MP asked whether the Tobacco Act should allow a vocational school's shopping centre to sell tobacco as part of student training, after fines and a sales ban.
