The state secretary answered that the shopping centre counts as part of the school under the Act, so tobacco sales are prohibited, and that no legal change is planned because the school can train students in retail without selling tobacco.
I see no need to amend the laws and regulations so that students at De Rooi Pannen can sell tobacco in this shopping centre as part of their training.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om de wet- en regelgeving zodanig aan te passen dat studenten op De Rooi Pannen in het kader van hun opleiding tabak kunnen verkopen in dit winkelcentrum
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat er drie ultraorthodoxe sjeiks uit België in Utrecht komen spreken

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that three ultra-orthodox Islamic preachers from Belgium would speak in Utrecht, including whether a preacher had a criminal conviction, the visa status of speakers, the foundation alFitrah's role and its recognition as a training company, and its subsidies and ANBI status. The government answered that free speech is protected and the event was not licensable, that the preacher named was not present and visa/criminal information could not be checked under the Schengen rules, that alFitrah is recognised as a training company only by the vocational education centre and the placement is being reassessed, and that the foundation received no subsidies and has no ANBI status.
Requesting this information is only possible insofar as it is in the interest of combating future criminal offences
Het opvragen van deze informatie kan alleen voor zover dat in het belang is ter bestrijding van toekomstige strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over (financieel) wanbeleid van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Education about alleged financial mismanagement at the University of Amsterdam, including its listing on a US monitoring list, rising debt, low solvency, housing policy, and a blacklist of activist students sent to staff. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate monitors finances without seeing acute continuity risks, that works councils may request information, that the board has promised independent inquiries, and that the board's conduct is a matter for the Supervisory Board.
The Executive Board has given the works councils room to set up independent committees that investigate finances and housing, as well as governance and participation.

Antwoord 14 Het College van Bestuur van de UvA heeft de medezeggenschapsraden de ruimte gegeven om onafhankelijke commissies in te stellen die onderzoek doen naar financiën en huisvesting én bestuur en medezeggenschap bij de UvA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) voornemens is om extra te bezuinigen op het onderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Education about the UvA's projected deficits of up to 83 million euros, possible education cuts, and derivatives losses that the inspectorate had not flagged. The minister answered that the UvA is drafting a future plan, that the inspectorate sees no acute continuity risk, that existing derivatives oversight is adequate, and that she has talked with the executive board and will keep monitoring.
I am of the opinion that the current financial supervision by the inspectorate regarding derivatives is adequate.
Ik ben van mening dat het huidige financieel toezicht door de inspectie met betrekking tot derivaten toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groeiende roep om het aftreden van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit van Amsterdam

MP Jasper van Dijk asks the minister about calls for the Executive Board of the University of Amsterdam to resign, the cost of the Maagdenhuis occupation, planned budget cuts tied to real estate, and whether students and staff have formal means to remove the board. The minister answers that the medezeggenschap rightly raised concerns leading to the chair's resignation, that the Raad van Toezicht holds the power to appoint and dismiss, and that the medezeggenschap's role is formally recognised, with the Versterking Bestuurskracht bill strengthening its say in appointments.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over financiële steun aan het ROC Leiden

An MP asks the minister whether the ministry will financially support ROC Leiden and ID College, for what purpose, how much, and why the February letter did not mention it. The minister confirms up to €40 million from the mbo macro budget, conditional and phased, to keep education going and improve quality, and says a commission is examining the housing decisions.
I will provide the funds under strict conditions and in phases.
Ik zal de middelen onder strikte voorwaarden en gefaseerd verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over herhaaldelijke censuur bij de Vrije Universiteit (VU) in Amsterdam

An MP asks the minister about the VU university refusing a room for a lecture on the Armenian genocide, which it judged one-sided, and whether this threatens academic freedom. The minister answers that the VU acted under its neutral room-booking rules, not censorship, and declines to intervene or raise the matter with the university board.
I therefore see no reason to consult with the VU on this matter.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hierover met de VU in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel “Armeense genocide-ontkenner Justin McCarthy geeft lezing aan VU”

MP Rog (CDA) asked the Education Minister whether a university student association's invitation to genocide denier Justin McCarthy for a lecture on the Armenian genocide centenary was acceptable, and whether Turkish state funding was involved. The minister answered that the VU withdrew the room because the event was a one-sided lecture rather than a debate, that the organiser was responsible, that no proof of Turkish state funding was found, and that she saw no reason to intervene.
I consider this a matter for the university and the student association themselves.
Ik acht dit een zaak van de universiteit en de studentenvereniging zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren betreffende het bericht ‘Taalgebruik gaat student opbreken’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that students at Utrecht University struggle with Dutch language skills, and whether a negative binding study advice should follow inadequate language proficiency. The Minister said the university invests in intensive teaching and embeds language skills in the curriculum, declined to provide an overview of institutions, rejected a uniform negative binding study advice norm, and listed existing language policy measures.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op culturele instellingen

Mr Monasch (PvdA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the cancellation of concerts by HET Symfonieorkest signals financial distress, whether cultural institutions are drawing down reserves and struggling to raise private income, and how successful institutions will be supported under new subsidy allocation. The Minister answered that continuity of the orchestra is not at risk, that institutions are responsible for adapting their activities, that quick-scans of institutions' finances will be published in June, and that cultural policy guidelines will follow.
This spring, before the cultural policy guidelines letter is published, I will have two quick-scans carried out.
Dit voorjaar laat ik, nog voor de uitgangspuntenbrief cultuur verschijnt, twee quick-scans uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over Passend onderwijs in het mbo

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education whether the Albeda College structure class for autistic students may disappear for lack of funding, and how passend onderwijs in mbo is financed and monitored. The Minister says the college will offer the class next year, that no signals of funding shortages were received, and that institutions decide themselves how to spend the lump-sum funds without monitoring of activities.
I have not received any signals that such initiatives are threatened with disappearance due to a lack of funding.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat dergelijke initiatieven dreigen te verdwijnen door een gebrek aan financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht "Remove Paul Kruger statue within 7 days, or else: EFF"

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked about an EFF ultimatum to remove the Paul Kruger statue in South Africa, including whether the Dutch embassy would act to protect it and whether the Culture Minister would seek UNESCO listing. The government answered that the matter is internal to South Africa, that the embassy has taken no action since no Dutch persons or property are involved, and that South African authorities decide on heritage and on responding to the EFF.
This concerns an internal South African matter in which no Dutch persons or property are involved.
Het betreft hier een interne Zuid-Afrikaanse zaak waarbij geen Nederlandse personen of bezittingen betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mohandis over de hernieuwde plannen voor experimenten op honden door de Universiteit Maastricht

MPs Van Dekken and Mohandis asked whether Maastricht University's renewed plans for dog experiments on pacemaker research, suspended last year, were reasonable, including the ethics committee's approval and alternatives. The government replied that the research is not yet resumed, an external commission is reviewing the internal approval procedure first, the DEC's approval meets the legal requirements, and no further inquiry is planned.
Maastricht University has indicated that the internal procedures that led to approval of this animal experiment will be evaluated by an external committee.
De Universiteit Maastricht heeft aangegeven dat de interne procedures die hebben geleid tot de goedkeuring van deze dierproef geëvalueerd zullen worden door een externe commissie.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rutte (beiden VVD) aan de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief (ingezonden 1

MPs Ziengs and Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the National Archives runs the tender for 16 book scanners that will be placed with the Tax Authority, and why digitisation of state archives is being insourced rather than tendered to market firms. The Minister replied that the scanners are state property placed at the Tax Authority, that the in-house arrangement was chosen for practical, quality and cost reasons and in line with coalition policy, and that the Tax Authority's Heerlen unit is a shared government service provider.
The submitted offers from suppliers of scanning equipment contain market-sensitive, confidential information that cannot be made public in this context.
De ingediende offertes van leveranciers van scanapparatuur bevatten marktgevoelige, vertrouwelijke informatie die in dit verband niet publiek gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Duisenberg over de aanpak van radicalisering en de rol van het onderwijs, en de gezamenlijke verklaring van de EU-onderwijsministers in Parijs van 17 maart 2015

Two VVD MPs asked why radicalisation is framed within school social safety, why the minister signed the EU education ministers' Paris declaration without consulting parliament, and why the declaration omits explicit condemnation of radical ideology and EU democratic values, and who is responsible for follow-up. The minister answered that the approach is an integrated, sector-specific one, that parliament was informed in advance and a debate is offered, that the preamble stresses shared EU values, and that follow-up goes to the OJCS Council with subsidiarity as the guiding principle.
Your House was informed in advance of my intention to attend the conference in Paris to sign the declaration.
Uw Kamer is vooraf geïnformeerd over mijn voornemen om bij de conferentie in Parijs aanwezig te zijn om daar de verklaring te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

MPs Van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers whether excessive service fees added to concert and event tickets, including a claim of 56,000 euro per week for website maintenance and fees for printing one's own ticket, are acceptable, and whether a cap or all-in ticket should be introduced. The minister replied that pricing and fees are for market parties, that existing consumer-information and unfair-practice rules and the ACM's oversight are sufficient, and that a cap is undesirable.
Determining the height of the service fees is up to market parties.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van de servicekosten is aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

An SP MP asked the state secretary to respond to a BON study claiming schools underspend on teachers under the lump-sum funding system, and to explain rising support staff shares and the use of 150 and 650 million euro akkoord funds for teacher hiring. The state secretary rejects that lump-sum causes fewer teachers, says schools have autonomy and monitoring runs through sector agreements and the inspectorate, and declines to measure the effect of specific funds on teacher numbers.
It is not possible to indicate which euro was spent on what, or whether schools would have made different choices had they not received this money.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven welke euro precies waaraan is besteed en of scholen andere keuzes gemaakt hadden als ze dit geld niet ontvangen hadden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg inzake het bericht "The age of mooc: gratis online toponderwijs wordt door bedrijven én universiteiten ingekocht"

An MP asked the education minister about MOOCs being bought by universities and firms, and whether they could be integrated into the curriculum, recognised, and kept as a national ambition. The minister answered that institutions may integrate MOOCs as long as examination boards guarantee quality, that certificates are issued by institutions, and that she remains committed to open online higher education and a subsidy scheme.
I am willing to engage with the education sector if I receive signals of obstacles to integrating MOOCs and other forms of online education into the curriculum.
Ik ben bereid om het gesprek met het onderwijsveld aan te gaan, als ik signalen krijg van belemmeringen om mooc's en andere vormen van online onderwijs te integreren in het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de ongerijmde VN-beschuldiging aan het adres van Israël inzake vrouwenrechten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the UN Commission on the Status of Women singles out Israel in an annual resolution, and why states such as Iran and Sudan sit on it. The minister answered that the Palestinian women resolution is the only country-specific one, that the EU abstained, that the Netherlands considers country-specific resolutions out of place in the CSW, and that it has called for the resolution to be phased out.
For that reason, the EU member states, including the Netherlands, have advocated phasing out this resolution from the CSW.
De EU-lidstaten, inclusief Nederland, hebben om die reden gepleit voor uitfasering van deze resolutie uit de CSW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over censuur bij de Vrije Universiteit

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Vrije Universiteit's refusal to provide a room for a critical debate on Palestine amounts to censorship and an infringement of academic freedom, and whether the minister will act. The minister answers that the university withheld the room over concerns about a sense of exclusion, not as censorship, that external parties had no influence, and that the minister considers the matter a matter between the university and the student group.
I consider this a matter between the VU and the SRP.
Ik vind dit een zaak tussen de VU en de SRP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het inschrijfgeld voor een master

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether universities may charge application fees to master's applicants, especially selective ones, and whether there is a legal basis for such fees. The Minister said such fees are acceptable only for applicants without a Dutch bachelor's diploma, must not exceed actual costs, and that no action against institutions is needed.
The legal starting point is that students in principle pay no contributions other than tuition fees.
Het wettelijke uitgangspunt is immers dat studenten in beginsel geen andere eigen bijdragen betalen dan het collegegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat er een scheidingsmuur wordt gebouwd bij het Goudse moskeecomplex

Two MPs asked whether a dividing wall at the Gouda mosque complex, to block visual contact between mosque visitors and women, undermines gender equality and sends the wrong signal, and what the government will do. The minister replied that equality is a core value, that the separation is a local design request from co-tenants, that the mosque has offered to shrink, and that the matter is a local responsibility, and he rejected the view that newcomers must adapt or leave.
This is and remains a local responsibility.
Dit is en blijft een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een mogelijke terugkeer van het standenonderwijs

An MP asked the education minister whether it is true that rich and poor pupils rarely meet at school and whether Dutch education functions as an emancipation engine, and asked what steps are taken to improve teacher quality. The minister answered that data on segregation by parental income are insufficient, pointed to existing measures against educational disadvantage, outlined the teacher-quality agenda, and said the CBS study will be repeated in 2016.
At present there is insufficient data available to assess whether there is an increasing segregation by parental income in education.
Op dit moment zijn er onvoldoende gegevens beschikbaar om te beoordelen of er sprake is van een toenemende segregatie naar inkomen van de ouders in het onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Bergkamp over het Filmfonds, de stimulering van de productie van televisieseries in Nederland en oneerlijke concurrentie uit het buitenland

MPs Monasch and Bergkamp asked whether TV series such as Homeland could be supported by the Netherlands Film Production Incentive and whether foreign incentives create an unfair playing field. The minister answered that series are not eligible because extending the scheme would crowd out film funding within the current 20 million euro budget, and that she will consult the Filmfonds and others after the Raad voor Cultuur advice.
Extra budget for the scheme is not available.
Extra budget voor de regeling is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna twee op de drie docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs getuige zijn van moslimdiscriminatie in de klas

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked about a report finding that 61% of secondary school teachers witnessed discrimination of Muslims in class, its rural-urban pattern, and whether more education on homosexuality and Islam is needed. The minister says discrimination is taken seriously, points to existing support tools (SLO, Centrum School en Veiligheid, teacher training efforts) and an ITS study on teacher needs, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een Rijksmonument in Rotterdam mogelijk onherstelbaar is beschadigd

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Rotterdam national monument may be irreparably damaged by renovation work by an Angolan consulate contractor, including whether municipal enforcement is possible. The minister answered that diplomatic inviolability means the municipality cannot enforce against the consulate, said the government does not track which monuments house embassies or consulates, and described existing information channels for new owners.
Dutch authorities therefore cannot take enforcement action against the consulate-general, nor can the consulate be entered without the consul's permission.
Er kan dus door de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet handhavend worden opgetreden ten aanzien van het consulaat-generaal, noch kan het consulaat betreden worden zonder toestemming van de consul.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Rutte inzake het bericht "Opeens wit: ophef over verfbeurt consulaat Angola" over het verven van het Rijksmonument in Rotterdam, waarin het consulaat van Angola is gevestigd

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the painting of a listed Rotterdam building housing Angola's consulate without a permit, and whether the consulate could be held liable. The minister answered that no permit was granted, that the building is not foreign territory, that the municipality is the competent authority, and that talks on restoration are ongoing.
Supervision of compliance with procedures for changes to national monuments is in principle not the responsibility of the national government but of municipalities.
Het toezicht op de naleving van de procedures voor wijzigingen aan rijksmonumenten ligt in beginsel niet bij de rijksoverheid maar bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het ondersteunen van Jiddisch

An MP asked whether the Cheider Jewish school in Amsterdam receives state, provincial or municipal funding for teaching Yiddish, and whether the government meets its obligations under the European Charter for regional and minority languages. The state secretary answered that Cheider gets no specific funding for Yiddish but receives extra funding as an exception school, that the Charter imposes no financial obligations, and that only Frisian receives dedicated national support.
I have no insight into the spending of the province and the municipality.
Op de uitgaven van de provincie en de gemeente heb ik geen zicht

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Mohandis over de aanpak van radicalisering en de handelingsverlegenheid van scholen om de actualiteit naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenissen in Parijs bespreekbaar te maken in d

MPs Marcouch and Mohandis asked how the government addresses radicalisation and why schools struggle to discuss the Paris attacks in class, including training, teaching materials and teacher education. The minister answers that schools are expected to act on their civic mandate, that training and portals exist, that a Jihadism intervention team is being discussed with municipalities, and that further studies and reports will follow.
We will return to this in the spring when we report on progress on citizenship education.
Wij zullen hier nader op ingaan als we in het voorjaar rapporteren over de voortgang op burgerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het bericht ‘Bijna klaar maar diploma ver weg’

An MP asked the education minister about several hundred MBO nursing students who faced extra required teaching hours after a change in hour norms, and whether the inspectorate and accreditation could have caught it. The minister answered that a solution was reached with the health ministry and inspectorate, that ROC Leiden no longer needs to extend the course, and that accreditation would not have helped in this case.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises the statutory professional requirements.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs houdt toezicht op de wettelijke beroepsvereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de “EUPE affaire”

The MP Van Dijk asks the minister whether EUPE was closed for poor quality, whether affected students were helped into replacement programmes and housing, and whether students' tuition (about 10,000 euro, frozen under a judicial seizure) should be refunded. The minister confirms the closure under the WHW, says only a limited number of students transferred, states that the refund is a matter between student and institution, and lists tightened rules on referent recognition, student conduct codes and accreditation as remedies.

The institution did not comply with what the law required regarding quality assurance, education, examinations and entry requirements, and providing the Minister with the necessary information about the institution.

De instelling voldeed niet aan hetgeen in de wet bepaald was omtrent de kwaliteitszorg, het onderwijs, de examens en de vooropleidingseisen en het verstrekken van de nodige inlichtingen aan de Minister omtrent de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de kwaliteit van het middelbaar agrarisch onderwijs in Noord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary and Education Minister about complaints from farmers and parents over the quality of agricultural vocational education in Northern Netherlands, including basic skills and contact hours. The government answered that quality is the institution's primary responsibility, pointed to improvement plans and inspection follow-up at AOC Terra, and declined further inspection research.
Determining the educational content and methodology of vocational training is the primary responsibility of the institution.
De bepaling van de onderwijsinhoud en -methodiek van beroepsopleidingen is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder inzake cao-belemmeringen van bbl-leerwerkplekken

MPs Lucas and Mulder asked whether sectoral collective agreement provisions on pay for bbl apprentices (vocational learning-work route) hinder the number of apprenticeship places, and what the minister would do about it. The minister replied that employers should agree pay with apprentices where needed, that she respects the social partners' agreements, listed measures to expand apprenticeship places, and gave figures on agreements and places.
As indicated in my response to questions 2 and 3, it is up to the social partners to make agreements on this.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 2 en 3 is het aan de sociale partners om hier afspraken over te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bezetting van het Bungehuis van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the occupation of the Bungehuis (later Maagdenhuis) at the University of Amsterdam, the protesters' demands for democratic board elections, a new funding model and real input on faculty plans, and the board's refusal to negotiate without conditions. Minister Bussemaker replied that the occupation is primarily a matter between the UvA board and occupiers, that she supports dialogue, that governance and funding questions are discussed through existing bodies and reforms, and that a court-set fine was legitimate.
The occupation of the Bungehuis and now the Maagdenhuis and the negotiations about it are in principle a matter between the UvA board and the occupiers.
De bezetting van het Bungehuis en nu het Maagdenhuis en de onderhandelingen daarover zijn in principe een zaak tussen het bestuur van de UvA en de bezetters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de gemeente Amsterdam onwettige eisen heeft gesteld bij een huisvestingsaanvraag door een school voor bijzonder onderwijs

MP Kuzu asked the minister about reports that Amsterdam demanded board control over an Islamic school (SIO) as a condition for housing, contrary to law and the Onderwijsraad advice, and whether the municipality ignores a court ruling. The state secretary answered that the municipality dropped those conditions, a new decision is in preparation, the government sees no need for new measures against municipalities, and an inspectorate investigation of the SIO board will follow when funding is decided.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voortgaande anti-homogeweld in Amsterdam

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Security and Justice about rising anti-gay violence in Amsterdam, including the share of non-Western suspects and whether funds should go to prosecution instead of dialogue projects. The government answered that reporting and reduced tolerance explain the figures, that every incident is unacceptable, and that it pursues criminal enforcement alongside prevention, education and awareness campaigns.

For the cabinet, every violent incident is one too many, and the message is clear that aggressive behaviour towards LGBT people is unacceptable and will be firmly addressed, regardless of the perpetrator's background.

Voor het kabinet is ieder geweldsincident er één te veel, en is de boodschap duidelijk dat agressief gedrag jegens LHBT's onacceptabel is en hard wordt aangepakt – los van de achtergrond van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over censuur bij stripmuseum

PVV MPs Bosma and Wilders asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a municipal council should interfere with exhibition content at a local comic museum, and about the planned Charlie Hebdo cartoon and calls for its removal. The minister answered that government should not interfere in artistic programming except where public order and safety are at stake, stressed free expression and mutual respect, and declined to take sides in the Dordrecht debate.
The government should not interfere with the substantive, artistic programming of a cultural institution.
De overheid heeft zich niet te bemoeien met de inhoudelijke, artistieke programmering van een culturele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de merkwaardige vorm van bestuurlijke samenwerking tussen ROC Amsterdam en ROC Flevoland, door middel van de juridische figuur van een koepelstichting

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the joint governance arrangement between ROC Amsterdam and ROC Flevoland via a umbrella foundation, questioning whether it complies with the WEB and the merger test. The Minister answered that the arrangement is in conflict with the law in practice, that the Inspectorate found no change and will not re-examine it, and that the institutions have been given two years to dismantle it, with the harmonisation bill expected around summer.
The cooperation is organised in such a way that there is de facto action in violation of article 9.1.4, second paragraph, last sentence of the Vocational Education Act (WEB).
De samenwerking is zo ingericht dat er de facto sprake is van handelen in strijd met artikel 9.1.4, tweede lid, laatste volzin van de Wet educatie beroepsonderwijs (WEB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de dreigende teloorgang van kleinschalige, specialistische opleidingen

Van Meenen (D66) asks the Minister of Education why there is still no clarity on the future of the Dutch HealthTec Academy's small specialist vocational programmes, why the review of a national vocational institution is delayed, and what will happen to students and courses such as Onderwerkmaker, Schoenhersteller and Orthopedische Technieken. Minister Bussemaker says the consultation with stakeholders takes longer than planned, promises a letter to parliament in February with proposals, says her aim is to continue the programmes, and places first responsibility for current students on the regional colleges.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Nederland financierde conferentie die Gezinssynode 2014 wilde beïnvloeden'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the government funded a conference aimed at influencing the 2014 family synod, and whether subsidising such church-related activity is acceptable. The minister replied that the subsidy supports a European umbrella of Christian LGBT groups as part of emancipation policy, that the government does not seek to influence church affairs, and that no subsidies go to Islamic countries.
There is no question of the government trying to exert influence on church affairs.
Er is geen sprake van dat de overheid invloed probeert uit te oefenen op kerkelijke aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat universiteiten geen inzage willen geven in de opbouw van het collegegeld voor de tweede studie

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether universities will disclose how the institutional tuition for second degrees is built up, following reports of opaque fees and a court ruling that such fees can be tested by civil courts. The Minister says the institutions must justify the fees clearly, announces a review of transparency and a dialogue with the universities and colleges, and rejects capping the fees for now.
I have pointed out to the institutions that the Executive Board must provide clear information on this, both to the participation bodies and to students.
Ik heb de instellingen erop gewezen dat het College van Bestuur hierover duidelijke informatie moet geven, zowel aan de medezeggenschap als aan studenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Meer studenten voor omstreden Islamitische Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education about the Islamic University of Rotterdam: graduate numbers, student financing, foreign funding, and the rector's inflammatory statements about Turkish-Dutch EP candidates. The Minister said oversight was being tightened via the Inspectorate and NVAO, a bill on civic responsibility for unfunded institutions is planned, and the foreign-funding question is under a WODC study due in 2015.
My legal options to intervene are limited because it concerns unfunded institutions.
Mijn juridische mogelijkheden om in te grijpen zijn beperkt daar het gaat om een niet-bekostigde instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Azmani over het kort geding dat is aangespannen door twee vrouwen tegen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Duisenberg and Azmani asked about a summary-proceedings lawsuit by two women against the Islamic University of Rotterdam, the grounds for expelling students from non-funded programmes, and whether the institution's conduct should affect its accreditation. The minister answered that civil law governs non-funded institutions, that the court ordered the students reinstated, and that the Inspectorate and NVAO are conducting enhanced supervision and a visitation, with new legislation planned.
I have asked the Inspectorate to proceed with what in practice amounts to enhanced supervision.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd om over te gaan tot wat in de praktijk neerkomt op verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Bergkamp over het artikel ‘culturele topinstellingen worstelen met regels bij aantrekken van talent van buiten EU’

Two D66 MPs asked why cultural institutions such as the Rijksmuseum, Concertgebouworkest and Nationaal Ballet struggle to hire non-EU talent under work-permit rules, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The minister defended the EU-first principle but acknowledged that the arts need international talent, pointed to existing lower salary thresholds for performing arts, said he would consult the museum sector, and offered talks with the orchestra and ballet, reporting back to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nevenfuncties van hoogleraren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about professors' secondary (including commercial) positions, the transparency of disclosure, and conflicts of interest arising from endowed chairs and valorisation policy. The Minister answered that university-industry ties are welcome if transparent and academically independent, that VSNU reports nearly all professors now disclose their side activities, and that a national register is unnecessary since responsibility lies with professors and universities.
I do not detect that universities want to evade the desire for openness.
Ik bespeur niet dat universiteiten de wens tot openbaarheid willen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanpak van topinkomens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why university executives are exempt from the 2015 WNT pay cap, why the exemption was granted late, and whether all executives will comply. The minister says 2015 is a transition year for university boards because of their ties to university medical centres, a justification the minister partly refers to a joint letter from the Interior Minister and states that the cap applies to all other OCW institutions.
In 2015 I will apply the set maximums to all OCW institutions and, where necessary, take enforcement action.
In 2015 zal ik ten aanzien van alle OCW-instellingen de vastgestelde maxima toepassen en zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het bericht ‘Kunstwereld buigt voor radicalen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she shared outrage that an artist's freedom of expression was curtailed by fear of Muslims, whether she would give the artist Theourgos shelter at her ministry, and why the arts world supposedly stays silent on such cases. The minister answered that free expression is guaranteed within the rule of law, that exhibition decisions rest with museum professionals, that threats can be reported to the police, and that the arts sector does speak out on political matters.
In our current laws and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een vrouwenquotum

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a possible gender quota for company top positions, whether she threatened one, and whether it is discriminatory and infringes freedom. The minister said a quota is a last resort to be avoided, that companies must show notable progress next year, and that she is closely monitoring compliance with reporting duties under the Wet Bestuur en Toezicht.
If this does not happen, political pressure to introduce a quota will increase.
Gebeurt dit niet, dan zal de politieke druk toenemen om met een quotum te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de schending van vrouwenrechten in Hongarije

PvdA MPs Maij and Yücel asked the government about a Hungarian police video that appeared to blame victims of sexual assault, and about the state of women's rights in Hungary and the EU. The minister condemned the video's suggestion that victims are responsible, described Hungary's uneven legal protections, and pointed to EU rule-of-law initiatives and a planned discussion in the Council.
The cabinet is working on this within the EU along two tracks.
Het kabinet zet zich hiervoor binnen de EU in langs twee sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rog over het bericht ‘UvA wil geesteswetenschappen radicaal omgooien’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that the University of Amsterdam plans a radical restructuring of its humanities, including the disappearance of several small language programmes, and about the link with new investments under the student loan system. The Minister answered that the faculty's plans are still under discussion, that small programmes should be weighed by the universities themselves, and that the cuts stem from falling student numbers rather than from the study-finance investments.
I therefore have no insight into how the sector agreement in higher education relates to the cut at the UvA Faculty of Humanities
Ik heb daarom geen inzicht hoe de sector afspraak in het wo zich verhoudt tot de bezuiniging bij de Faculteit der Geesteswetenschappen van de UvA
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jasper Van Dijk over het plan van de UvA om te bezuinigen op de faculteit Geesteswetenschappen

MP Jasper Van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Amsterdam's plans to cut the Humanities faculty, including possible job losses, property speculation, reduction of master's programmes, risks of diluted teaching, the closure of unique programmes, works council involvement and future student numbers. Minister Bussemaker answered that the UvA is still discussing its plans, that the university has assured her there is no property speculation, that the choice of programmes is for universities themselves, and that she will monitor the situation and talk with the UvA if problems arise.
I consider it important that the UvA conducts this discussion openly and carefully and takes the time for it.
Ik vind het van belang dat de UvA deze discussie open en zorgvuldig voert en daar de tijd voor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de dreigende teloorgang van alfastudies

An MP asked the education minister about threatened cuts to humanities (alfa) programmes at the University of Amsterdam, the UvA holding company structure and whether student and staff participation is adequate. The minister answered that the faculty plans are still at discussion stage, denied that the holding routes teaching funds or sidelines the works council, and said she will discuss a plan with VSNU and others to protect unique language programmes.
I am of the view that the current regulations sufficiently guarantee transparency regarding the money flows within higher education.
Ik ben van mening dat de huidige regelgeving voldoende transparantie garandeert betreffende de geldstromen binnen het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht vermeende vriendjespolitiek op het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

An MP asked the Education Minister about alleged cronyism at her ministry, including subsidies to organisations led by former officials and a former official rehired at triple hourly rate. The minister said subsidy records do not track applicants' political or civil-service background, pointed to accountability reviews and an Audit Dienst Rijk check finding no spending outside rules, and rejected the suggestion of systemic abuse.
Subsidy grants are not separately recorded to show whether the applicant, on behalf of the organisation, is a former politician, official or minister.
Er wordt bij subsidieverleningen niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of de aanvrager, namens de organisatie, een voormalig politicus, ambtenaar of bewindspersoon is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over omstreden subsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about alleged favouritism and questionable subsidies to Stichting Lezen & Schrijven, including its size, use of funds, communications staff, effectiveness and the reclaim of a subsidy from Stichting Vrienden van de Gaykrant. The minister rejected the allegations, cited an independent evaluation supporting the programme, and reported that the Gaykrant subsidy of EUR 206,833 is being fully reclaimed after the audit opinion was withdrawn.
I am reclaiming this entire amount.
Dit gehele bedrag vorder ik terug.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het COC-voorstel om op scholen 'onzijdige' toiletten te introduceren

An MP asked the education minister whether she opposed the COC's proposal for gender-neutral school toilets and whether it would cut the COC's subsidy as a result. The minister declined to object to the campaign, stressed that the action concerns dialogue with schools on transgender pupils' problems, and refused to cut the subsidy.
No, I do not consider the COC's action to draw attention to the position of transgender pupils at school undesirable.
Nee, ik vind de actie van het COC om aandacht te vragen voor de positie van transgenderleerlingen op school niet onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over het verbod voor studenten van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) om voor stage of studie af te reizen naar Afrika

MPs Van Laar and Mohandis asked the ministers whether they know of the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences ban on student internships and study trips to Africa, and whether they agree that Africa should not be treated as one region. The minister acknowledged the ban is not absolute, agreed that per-country risk assessment is better, and said institutions set their own policy while the government advises following the Foreign Affairs travel advice without issuing binding national guidelines.
It is up to the institutions themselves to determine their policy in this matter; I will not draw up national guidelines on this.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om in hierin hun beleid te bepalen, ik zal daarover geen landelijke richtlijnen opstellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat de omstreden wetenschapper Diederik Stapel, die in 2011 werd geschorst voor grootschalige wetenschapsfraude, weer werkt als docent bij Fontys Academy for Creat

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether Diederik Stapel, suspended in 2011 for large-scale fraud, was hired as a guest lecturer at Fontys Academy for Creative Industries, and whether the minister would act against it. The minister replied that Fontys is responsible for its own staffing, that Stapel was a freelance guest speaker with no curriculum role, and that no action by the minister is warranted.
The institutions are responsible for the content of their education, their personnel policy and their reputation.
De instellingen zijn verantwoordelijk voor de invulling van hun onderwijs, hun personeelsbeleid en reputatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het buigen van de kunstwereld voor islamitische radicalen

MPs asked whether the government shares concern that an artist's work was not exhibited out of fear of Muslim radicals, and what measures will protect freedom of expression. The minister answered that artistic choices belong to museum professionals, that concrete threats can be reported to police, that he sees no concrete evidence of extremists undermining artistic expression, and that current law adequately guarantees freedom of expression.
In our current legislation and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat over de hele wereld onderwijsinstellingen voorzorgsmaatregelen nemen tegen ebola, in tegenstelling tot Nederland

An MP asked the Education Minister whether she was aware of concerns at Dutch schools about Ebola, whether she accepted responsibility for student welfare, and whether flights from affected areas should be halted and arriving pupils quarantined. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said she is in close contact with colleagues, and deferred to the health minister's Ebola policy letter, calling those measures adequate.
In my view, the measures set out therein are adequate and sufficient.
Naar mijn mening zijn de daarin vermelde maatregelen adequaat en afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over de tekortschietende financiering van Wageningen UR

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked whether the 2% cap on annual funding changes for Wageningen UR, set in 2001, disadvantages the institution compared with other universities, and whether the rule should be reconsidered. Minister Kamp answered that the cap avoids sharp budget fluctuations, that the rule will be included in a government review of funding for Economic Affairs and OCW education with results feeding into the 2016 budget, and that compliance with the top-income norm is monitored.

This arrangement will be included in the study the cabinet is starting into education funded by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and education funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Onderhavige regeling wordt betrokken in het onderzoek dat het kabinet start naar onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het onderwijs bekostigd door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over “verwarring en onjuistheden in de investeringsbrief van OCW”

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius (SP) asked the Education Minister about alleged errors and confusion in the OCW investment letter, including the claimed 500-euro professionalisation budget, the 1.2 billion investment figure, the effect of the wage freeze, and where Herfstakkoord money went. The Minister and State Secretary largely reject the criticism, state that the budget is at school level rather than personal, that the money is partly reallocated existing funds, and that school boards are monitored; they acknowledge the wording could have been clearer.
The wording about the personal budget in the letter could have better matched the wording in the collective agreement.
De formulering rondom het persoonlijk budget in de brief had beter kunnen aansluiten op de formulering in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van een succesvolle opleiding voor kwetsbare leerlingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about ROC Midden Nederland's plan to scrap a successful vocational programme for vulnerable learners, and whether the board ignored its works council and student council. The Minister replied that the college will not discontinue the programme but continue it as XL Entree in a broader bbl and bol form, with a cooperation agreement to be signed on 20 November and consultation of the works and student councils planned.
ROCMN has assured me that the elaboration will be submitted to both the works council and the student council.
ROCMN heeft mij verzekerd dat de uitwerking zal worden voorgelegd aan zowel de ondernemingsraad als de studentenraad.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de subsidieregeling praktijkleren (ingezonden 14 oktober 2014).

MP Lucas (VVD) asked the Minister of Education about the transport sector's complaints over clawbacks of the former training wage-cost reduction, ROC compliance, and the new practical-learning subsidy scheme's administration, handling and exclusion of temp agencies. The minister answered that payment arrangements and standard supervision apply, the new scheme is progressing with budget largely claimed, and the evaluation will consider the points raised.
I earlier committed to MP Jadnanansing (PvdA) to take industry suggestions into account and to adjust the subsidy scheme if this proves necessary.
Ik heb eerder het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) toegezegd suggesties van het bedrijfsleven mee te nemen en indien dit noodzakelijk blijkt, de subsdieregeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het bericht dat WVA wordt teruggevorderd bij transportbedrijven

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked why the Belastingdienst is reclaiming the education wage-tax discount (AV Onderwijs) from transport firms, and how education quality and eligibility are checked. The minister answered that about 36 firms face recovery for €3.5 million, that the Belastingdienst verifies WVA conditions while the Inspectie judges education quality, and that recovery cannot be repaired retroactively.
At 36 companies the AV onderwijs has been reclaimed, for a total amount of about €3.5 million.
Bij 36 bedrijven heeft terugvordering van de AV onderwijs plaatsgevonden, voor een totaalbedrag van circa € 3,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Meenen over naheffingen door de Belastingdienst over de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs

The MP asks the Minister of Education about tax back-assessments on the education wage-tax reduction (afdrachtvermindering onderwijs), including criteria, sums recovered, affected sectors, the Tax Authority's expertise, and the impact on good-faith firms. The Minister answers that back-assessments follow national enforcement of the rules, that about 70 million euro has been assessed with 80 million more announced, and that payment arrangements are available, but she declines to say how much will actually be collected or to assign expertise beyond the Tax Authority's own checks.
To what extent these assessments actually lead to payment cannot be stated at this time.
In hoeverre deze aanslagen daadwerkelijk tot betaling leiden is op dit moment niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over een nauwelijks bezocht showtje van een gesubsidieerde Zwarte-Pietheater

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a performance by artist Quincy Gario at the Stedelijk Museum, attended by few paying visitors, cost taxpayers money and why the minister listens to such an artist rather than to popular support for Zwarte Piet. The minister answered that the museum is independently run since 2006 and responsible for its own programming, and that she does not intervene in individual artists' work.
The museum has been independent since 1 January 2006 and is itself responsible for programming exhibitions and performances.
Het museum is per 1 januari 2006 verzelfstandigd en is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de programmering van tentoonstellingen en performances.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het een rommeltje is met de beloning van hbo-bestuurders

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether some hbo (higher vocational) executives still earn more than the WNT pay cap allows, whether contracts signed after the WNT took effect breach it, and how the sector's pay code and salary-class rules will be enforced. The Minister replied that the first WNT reporting on 2013 pay is still being analysed and will be sent by year-end, that sector self-regulation is being monitored, that all onderwijsbestuurders have been under the WNT since 2013 with the Inspectie van het Onderwijs enforcing it, and that a moral appeal to executives produced positive responses from ten of eleven.
At the end of this year the first WNT report will be sent to your House.
Eind van dit jaar zal de eerste WNT-rapportage aan uw Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wetenschapsselectie van de NWO is ontmoedigende farce’

An SGP MP asked the minister whether NWO's grant selection, where many proposals of similar quality are rejected, is wasteful and whether lottery or direct institutional funding should be considered. The state secretary rejected the premise, defended peer review as the international norm, opposed lottery selection, and said the Toekomstvisie Wetenschap will address interdisciplinary proposals and NWO governance.
I consider it important that a qualitative assessment takes place and that it is argued why a proposal is granted or rejected.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er een kwalitatieve beoordeling plaatsvindt en dat wordt beargumenteerd waarom een voorstel wordt gehonoreerd of afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Wetenschapsselectie van de NWO is ontmoedigende farce’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that NWO's research selection is a discouraging farce, including staffing and overhead, a liquidity problem leading to a change in payment schedules to universities, and the value of NWO. The State Secretary answered that the 470 FTE involved in selection is not overhead of 2700 FTE, that overhead is about 6.7% of spending, and that the payment rhythm change does not reduce funding or the number of grants.
The planned volume of grant allocations to researchers (and through them to universities) remains the same.
Het voorziene volume aan subsidietoekenningen aan de onderzoekers (en via hen aan de universiteiten) blijft gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het gegeven dat er een ‘Pietoverleg’ zal plaatsvinden

Two MPs asked the government about a reported meeting on Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet, which organisations attended, and whether the government would oppose the 'Zwarte Piet' criticism and accept the political-correctness pressure. The minister listed the attending organisations, stated that the feast is a societal tradition with no government rule on how it is celebrated, and said the government appeals to everyone's responsibility rather than imposing terms.
There is no law, guideline or other form of obligation imposed by the government regarding the way the Sinterklaas feast is celebrated.
Er is geen sprake van een wet, richtlijn of andere vorm van verplichting die door de overheid wordt opgelegd als het gaat om de wijze waarop het Sinterklaasfeest wordt gevierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ark over homoacceptatie en Coming Out Day

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about LGBT acceptance in the workplace, the KNVB acceptance plan, and whether a round table could coordinate an action around IDAHO. The Minister welcomed these initiatives, promised a midterm emancipation review and a round table before year end with a report to the House.
I aim to hold the round table meeting before the end of this year. I will inform the House of Representatives about its outcomes.
Ik streef ernaar de rondetafelbijeenkomst voor het einde van dit jaar te houden. Ik zal de Tweede Kamer over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over het bericht dat een bestuurder de scholenkoepel LMC heeft opgelicht

MPs Van Dijk and Siderius asked whether the EUR 460,000 embezzled by a former LMC school board chair will be recovered and whether schools will suffer financial harm, and how financial oversight in Dutch education is organized given recent fraud cases. The State Secretary answered that the board and supervisory board are pursuing maximum recovery but the final amount is unknown pending legal proceedings, that the existing financial oversight framework is adequate though fraud cannot always be prevented, and that individual investigations cannot be disclosed for reasons of investigation and privacy.
The content of cases cannot be disclosed in the interest of the investigation and the privacy of those involved.
Over de inhoud van zaken kan in het belang van het onderzoek en de privacy van de betrokkenen geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de veel te linkse publieke omroep

An MP asks the State Secretary about the Raad voor Cultuur's view that public broadcasting is too left-leaning and whether the government will correct this and dismantle the current broadcasting system. The State Secretary disputes the premise citing audience and monitoring research, promises a forthcoming policy letter on public media, and rejects dismantling.
I do stand for an independent and pluriform public broadcaster.
Ik sta wel voor een onafhankelijke en pluriforme publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over ROC’s die kwetsbare jongeren weigeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether ROC vocational colleges refuse vulnerable students to avoid inspection penalties for dropout, and what the government will do about it. The minister said there is no central registry, collected about 130 signals, will have the Ombudslijn mbo register refusals, says financial incentives reward admitting students, and will investigate cases and address institutions while the Inspectorate handles reports.
Because I want clear insight into the situation, I will instruct the Ombudslijn mbo to register reports of refused young people as a central point.
Omdat ik graag scherp zicht wil op de situatie, ga ik de Ombudslijn mbo opdracht geven als centraal punt de meldingen van geweigerde jongeren te gaan registeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mbo-leerlingen die geweigerd worden op ROC’s

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Education whether MBO colleges refuse students under financial incentives, how many students are refused, and how the government will prevent this. The Minister denies that the funding system structurally rewards refusal, says refused students with unjustified grounds will be followed up by the Inspectorate, and commits to having the Ombudslijn MBO register all refusal reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de minister van mening blijft dat studiepunten afgepakt mogen worden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether her view that study credits may be taken away is consistent with the law and its legislative history, which he argued restrict credit expiry to exceptional, outdated-knowledge cases. The Minister maintained that Article 7.13(2)(k) WHW allows institutions to limit the validity of exams for study-progress reasons, citing a CBHO ruling, and that the wording of the law is decisive.
The text of the law is leading.
De tekst van de wet is leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Internationaal verdrag botst met leenstelsel’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the government is breaching the UN International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights by making higher education more expensive rather than progressively free, and whether it will refrain from giving effect to the covenant or seek advice on it before abolishing the basic grant. The minister denied any breach while access is guaranteed, said the covenant has been in force for decades and is not up for debate, and justified the abolition of the basic grant as enabling a quality boost.
I see no reason, nor do I have any need, to call into question the operation of this covenant, which has been in force for many decades.
Ik zie geen enkele aanleiding noch heb ik enige behoefte de werking van dit verdrag dat reeds vele decennia in werking is ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het achterblijvende gebruik van de subsidieregeling praktijkleren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether employers find the apprenticeship subsidy scheme too complex and whether fewer internship places are being offered to mbo students. The minister says she has heard no signals of complexity, that 14,000 employers filed 92,000 applications with the full budget disbursed, and promises a first monitoring report in the 2015 budget debate.
For the 2015 OCW budget debate, your House will receive the first report with more detailed information on use of the subsidy scheme.
Voor de OCW- begrotingsbehandeling 2015 ontvangt uw Kamer de eerste rapportage met meer gedetailleerde informatie over het gebruik van de subsidieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over de vernieuwde islamitische gebedsruimte op de Vrije Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's reopened Islamic prayer room, which they said enables gender segregation and undermines integration, should be grounds for cutting its funding. The Minister replied that universities decide their own diversity policy, that the VU bars gender segregation, that other religions are also accommodated, and that she sees no reason to end funding.
No. Whether and how a university gives shape to its diversity policy is a matter for the university itself. The government has no role in this.
Neen. Of en hoe een universiteit invulling geeft aan haar diversiteitsbeleid is een zaak van de universiteit zelf. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermeij over het bericht dat er banen verdwijnen voor mbo-niveau 2 en 3 leerlingen

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermeij asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a news report that 500,000 MBO level 2 and 3 jobs would disappear permanently, and how education and labour market links would be ensured. The minister rejected the claim as poorly supported, acknowledged technological and globalisation pressure on middle-skilled jobs, and pointed to labour market information, the study guide, the macro-efficiency bill and a planned career-route experiment as responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bosma over stappen van het Openbaar Ministerie tegen GeenStijl

MPs Helder and Bosma asked whether criminal investigations into GeenStijl photos reflect unequal treatment compared with the 'Dood aan de Joden' case, and whether free speech is safe under this cabinet. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service assesses each case on its merits, that both were examined, and that free speech was not breached criminally.
Each case is assessed by the Public Prosecution Service on its own merits.
Iedere zaak wordt door het Openbaar Ministerie op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het alsnog doorvoeren van de bètafusie tussen de UvA en de VU

An MP asks the minister whether UvA and VU boards secretly agreed to cluster their science faculties despite the works council rejecting a merger, and whether works councils should have consent rights over such decisions. The minister denies a fusion agreement was made, says a working document was attached for information, acknowledges confusion caused, and states that instemmingsrecht over this subject is not legally required.
The fact that the executive board did submit its intended decision to the joint meeting for consent in this case, I view positively.
Het feit dat het CvB zijn voorgenomen besluit in dit geval wel ter instemming aan de gezamenlijke vergadering heeft voorgelegd, waardeer ik in dit verband positief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat steeds meer studenten problemen hebben met hun studieschuld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that more former students struggle to repay their study debt, the effect of the planned loan system (studievoorschot) on debt levels, and the UK and Scottish experience. The minister said the draagkracht scheme use rose from 7% to 9% due to recession and automatic assessment, that debt will rise under the reform but the reform is socially balanced with softened repayment terms, and that the effects will be monitored; she declined to comment on UK and Scottish policy as outside her responsibility.
I would therefore like to limit myself to answering the questions about that system.
Ik wil mij dan ook beperken tot de beantwoording van de vragen over dat stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Wolbert over stagetekort voor studenten Medische hulpverlening

MPs Mohandis and Wolbert asked about a shortage of internship places for Medical Assistance (Medisch hulpverlener) students and whether the profession would be BIG-registered. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said it is primarily the responsibility of hospitals, and said registration decision is being prepared with an expected answer after the summer.
The civil-servant preparation for the decision-making by the Minister of VWS has meanwhile been set in motion.
De ambtelijke voorbereiding voor de besluitvorming door de Minister van VWS is inmiddels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Hogeschool Saxion wordt gekort op het budget omdat te weinig studenten op tijd afstuderen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the ministry set a 68% bachelor graduation target for Saxion, threatening budget cuts, and whether this creates a perverse incentive. The minister replied that Saxion itself chose the 68% target, that budget consequences apply to missed prestatieafspraken ambitions from 2017, and that a focus on graduation rate alone is not rewarding for institutions.
The article wrongly suggests that the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science determined that Saxion's bachelor graduation rate must be 68% in 2015.
In het artikel wordt ten onrechte gesuggereerd, dat het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap heeft bepaald dat het bachelor-rendement bij Hogeschool Saxion in 2015 68% moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het bestuur van Hogeschool Inholland misstanden onder de pet houdt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that the Inholland University board and Supervisory Board mishandled a student whistleblower's complaints, and whether an independent investigation would be ordered. The Minister acknowledged shortcomings in the institution's responsiveness, said the Supervisory Board ran the internal investigation under the institution's whistleblower rules, and refused to order or conduct an independent inquiry, pointing to internal complaint procedures and the College van Beroep.
I cannot prevent this matter from ending unsatisfactorily for one or more parties.
Ik kan niet voorkomen dat deze kwestie voor een of meer partijen onbevredigend afloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het bericht dat de Haagse Hogeschool maatregelen neemt bij tentamens naar aanleiding van de fraude die aan het licht kwam

The PVV MP Beertema asked the Minister of Education whether she knows of the Haagse Hogeschool measures after exam fraud, which fraud occurred, its consequences, who is responsible, whether students proctor exams, and whether the minister will ensure the investigations get to the bottom of it. The minister answers that investigations are ongoing, seven students were expelled for prior knowledge of exams, a complaint of exam theft was filed, exam processes will be redesigned, and the Inspectorate will monitor the recommendations.
The Inspectorate of Education will monitor compliance with the recommendations from the investigations.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal toezien op de naleving van de aanbevelingen uit de onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Mohandis inzake het bericht dat studenten van de Haagse Hogeschool tentamens vooraf kunnen inzien

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister of Education about reports that students at the Haagse Hogeschool could view exams in advance, possibly for four years, and whether such fraud was being investigated and prevented. The Minister answered that an investigation found no evidence of exam fraud in the ICT courses, that seven students with prior knowledge of exams were expelled and reported, that the wider investigation continues, and that institutions themselves are responsible for preventing fraud.
This investigation is still ongoing and has been extended with the latest signal regarding fraud (July 2014).
Dit onderzoek loopt nog en is uitgebreid met het laatste signaal met betrekking tot fraude (juli 2014).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het weigeren van studiefinanciering voor een master na een gecombineerde bacheloropleiding Pabo (HBO) en Pedagogische Wetenschappen (WO)

An MP asked why students who completed a combined HBO Pabo and WO Pedagogical Sciences bachelor in nominal time are denied a performance grant for a master, and whether the minister would make an exception. The minister refused any exception, stating students have four years of entitlement, pointed to funded professional masters and teacher grants, and said the current rules remain unchanged for next year.
I do not want to make an exception to the existing regulations for the group of academic Pabo students.
Ik wil voor de groep studenten van de academische pabo geen uitzondering maken op de bestaande regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat de Vrije Universiteit (VU) onderzoek gaat doen naar mogelijke datafraude in wetenschappelijk werk van econome Karima Kourtit

An MP asked the minister whether the VU's handling of allegations of data fraud in econometrician Karima Kourtit's work, and her PhD defence going ahead, was acceptable, and whether raw data would be reviewed first. The minister answered that the VU conducted several internal inquiries, concluded the thesis was defensible, and that the university is autonomous, so the minister relied on those findings and did not intervene.
I point out that the university is fully autonomous in its decision-making.
Ik wijs er daarbij op dat de universiteit in haar besluitvorming volledig autonoom is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over naheffingen door de Belastingdienst over de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs

Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education about tax authority recovery actions over misuse of the education wage-tax reduction (afdrachtvermindering onderwijs), including whether the tax authority assesses education quality without the Inspectorate. The minister answered that the Tax Authority only checks procedural and administrative requirements, that quality is the Inspectorate's responsibility, and that about 550 employers were corrected for roughly 47 million euro.
The Tax Authority checks the procedural and administrative requirements imposed on a (vocational) education programme.
