De Belastingdienst controleert de procedurele en administratieve vereisten die aan een (mbo) opleiding worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over studiefinanciering voor jihadstrijders

MP Van Klaveren asked whether jihadist fighters receive student finance, how many and how much, whether all such benefits should be stopped permanently, and whether students in proliferation-sensitive fields could pose a risk. The minister confirmed that some departed Dutch jihadists received student finance, that it has been stopped for all known cases, that social benefits were stopped in some dozens of cases, and described the export-control style ministerial exemption procedure for proliferation-sensitive studies, but gave no numbers or amounts.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not provide information on specific cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een deel van de Nederlandse jihadstrijders in Syrië studiefinanciering ontvangt

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked whether the minister knows of reports that some Dutch jihadists in Syria receive student finance, and whether she will stop it by general administrative order. The minister confirmed the reports, said student finance is stopped immediately in concrete cases, and that the cases are now stopped, but declined to name any cases.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de verdubbeling van geweld tegen homo's

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported doubling of violence against gay people (based on police-registered incidents rising from 623 to 1,143) is accurate, whether police will make combating anti-gay violence a top priority, and whether the rise is linked to the growing influence of Islam. The government answered that the figures cover all registered discrimination incidents based on sexual orientation, not only violence, that police anti-violence work remains a top priority and will be pursued in the 2015-2018 security agenda, and it rejected the link to Islam.
Yes, tackling violence is and remains a top priority of the police.
Ja, de aanpak van geweld is en blijft een topprioriteit van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over de financiële degelijkheid van ontvangers van subsidie uit het Filmfonds

Rutte (VVD) asked whether the Filmfonds should check financial soundness of subsidy recipients after a film crew went unpaid, and whether the cash rebate decision should be reconsidered. Minister Bussemaker answered that the Filmfonds' contribution was small and for finishing only, that wage obligations lie with the producer, and that existing eligibility rules suffice without changing the cash rebate arrangement.

The Netherlands Film Fund has organised its structure and regulations, including the cash rebate regulation, so that it gains insight into the costs and financing of the film and the applicant's financial position at the time the application is submitted.

Het Nederlands Filmfonds heeft zijn organisatie en reglementen, inclusief het reglement Stimuleringsmaatregel Filmproductie in Nederland dat de «cash rebate» regelt, zo ingericht dat er inzicht wordt verkregen in de kosten en financiering van de film en in de financiële positie van de aanvrager op het moment van het indienen van de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘vergrijzing transport levert baankansen op’

MPs Kuiken and Jadnanansing asked about logistics sector labour shortages, whether school leavers are choosing logistics careers, and whether enough workers are being recruited and retrained. The government answered that the sector itself must attract workers, pointed to a sector plan with 30 million euro of training measures and 1,250 extra driver trainees, and said vacancies are not above average.
It is up to the sector itself to present itself as an attractive employer and to entice young people to choose a career in logistics.
Het is aan de sector zelf om zich een aantrekkelijk werkgever te tonen en jongeren te verleiden om te kiezen voor een carrière in de logistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘In Nederland studerende Saoediër opgepakt in Kenia’

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands contributes to the education of students from Islamic countries such as Saudi Arabia, and whether such students should be barred or expelled after a Saudi student was arrested in Kenya. The minister answered that internationalisation policy does not distinguish by religion, declined to comment on the individual case, and refused to bar or expel students from Islamic countries.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het opheffen van ICIN (Netherlands Heart Institute) door de Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW)

An MP asks how cardiovascular research would continue after ICIN is dissolved by the KNAW, and whether the dissolution followed due process (Awb consultation, works council advice, financial analysis, a transitional arrangement). The minister says research continues within the UMCs with some added coordination burden, deems long-term damage limited, and declines substantive answers on procedure and legality because the matter is before the courts.
Because the matter is before the court, we are very reticent in answering these questions.
Omdat de zaak onder de rechter is zijn wij zeer terughoudend in de beantwoording van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het nieuwsbericht “Zelfstandigen niet voor de klas”

An MP asked the ministers whether the Tax Authority is actively questioning the self-employed status of freelance teachers in education, how it decides who counts as self-employed, and whether this threatens practical expertise in classrooms. The government answered that status is judged case by case under law and case law, that talks with education federations aim for national criteria, and that genuine self-employment will be protected while sham arrangements are tackled.
The Tax Authority is continuously in discussion with clients and their interest organisations about when self-employed persons without staff meet the criteria for self-employment.
De Belastingdienst is voortdurend in gesprek met opdrachtgevers en hun belangenorganisaties over de vraag wanneer zzp'ers aan de criteria voor zzp'er-schap voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat mbo-scholen onterecht schoolkosten in rekening blijven brengen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Meenen (D66) asked the minister of Education about reports that vocational schools charge unlawful extra fees for mandatory activities, including a 600 euro trip, debt collection for voluntary contributions, and 70 complaints to JOB. The minister condemns it, says the inspectorate now checks school costs and will demand remedies, and restates the legal rule that only tuition may be mandatory and other contributions must be voluntary and clearly communicated.
Since September 2012, all regular inspections by the Inspectorate of Education examine school costs.
Sinds september 2012 wordt bij alle reguliere onderzoeken van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) naar schoolkosten gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een ‘Nederlandse’ terreurstudent

Van Klaveren asked whether a Saudi terror suspect studying in the Netherlands, allegedly linked to Al-Shabaab, was known to the intelligence services and should be denied entry, have his studies ended and his student finance reclaimed. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, but explained that IND can refuse or withdraw residence permits on the basis of an AIVD report without a criminal conviction, and that non-EEA students receive no Dutch student finance.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake Het bericht ‘Grootschalige fraude door eerstejaars economie Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether first-year economics students at the UvA committed large-scale fraud on weekly online progress tests by logging into two browsers at once, and how many were affected and what will be done. The Minister answers that the progress tests were invalidated, fifteen students failed the course as a result, individual review requests are handled by the examination board, no further sanctions were imposed, and institutions are tightening software and testing procedures.
The UvA established that fifteen students (out of the 870 who took the exam) received a failing grade because the half bonus point was removed.
De UvA heeft vastgesteld dat vijftien studenten (van de 870 studenten die deelnamen aan het tentamen) een onvoldoende hebben gehaald door het wegvallen van het halve bonuspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Duisenberg over het bericht “Bestuur Universiteit Utrecht declareert 24 mille aan onkosten”

An MP asked whether the Utrecht University board's EUR 24,000 in expense claims (dinners at starred restaurants, foreign trips) was justified and whether austerity should be anchored in the governance code. The minister answered that the sum covers three board members' claims over three years, that only seven meals cost EUR 470 in 2012 and none were at starred restaurants, that international trips serve strategic partnerships, and that existing expense rules and accountant checks are sufficient, so no further tightening is planned.
I see no reason to anchor the austerity any further.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de versobering nog verder te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de minister de Tweede Kamer verkeerd zou hebben geïnformeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether her March 2014 letter misinformed parliament about universities invalidating exams to encourage timely graduation, and whether the WHW makes exams unlimited in validity. The minister rejected the claim of error, maintained that institutions may limit exam validity under art. 7.13(2)(k) WHW, and declined to issue a rectification.
There is therefore no question of an error, and I see no reason for a rectification.
Van een vergissing is dan ook geen sprake en daarom zie ik geen aanleiding voor een rectificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lucas over het bericht dat MBO scholen nee moeten verkopen

MPs Straus and Lucas asked the Minister of Education about reports that MBO schools must turn away students due to shortages of internship places. The minister acknowledged shortages in some sectors, placed responsibility on employers and schools, and said new study guides and quality agreements would address the issue rather than direct intervention.
I therefore make an urgent appeal to businesses to take their responsibility to combat youth unemployment.
Ik doe dan ook een klemmend beroep op het bedrijfsleven om zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen om jeugdwerkloosheid tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat MBO scholen nee moeten verkopen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether MBO schools are refusing students and introducing numerus fixus due to a shortage of internship and apprenticeship places, and what measures will address it. The Minister confirmed some schools use numerus fixus, stated that limiting intake is justified when no internships exist, said the shortage is partly temporary and regional, and pointed to existing regional approaches and the studiebijsluiter, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over de plannen rond ArtEZ en het functioneren van de Raad van Toezicht en het College van Bestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked about ArtEZ's plans to relocate or close programmes, the excessive pay of the interim chair of the Executive Board, a board member's business link with the interim chair's firm, and the Supervisory Board's functioning. The minister says the plans must improve quality, the Inspectorate is investigating the Wnt pay breach, the conflict of interest was checked and found acceptable, and governance matters are for the institution itself.
At the end of 2013 I informed ArtEZ that I regret that the remuneration of the interim chair of the Executive Board may exceed the norm.
Eind 2013 heb ik ArtEZ laten weten dat ik het betreur dat de bezoldiging van de interim-voorzitter van het College van Bestuur (CvB) de norm mogelijk overschrijdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het ICIN

An MP asked the minister whether the KNAW's decision to close the ICIN Netherlands Heart Institute, as a way to meet a budget cut, was consistent with the ministry's earlier letter and whether the ministry would intervene by suspending the decision or funding a bridge amount. The minister answered that the KNAW is an autonomous body free to allocate its funds, that no suspension is warranted, and that the cardiology research continues in the academic hospitals.
The KNAW is however an autonomous organisation and the KNAW is in principle free to allocate the funds it receives from OCW, other than the specific subsidies, as it sees fit.
De KNAW is echter een autonome organisatie en het staat de KNAW in principe vrij de middelen die zij van OCW ontvangt, anders dan de specifieke subsidies, naar eigen inzicht te alloceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Tijd dringt voor nieuwe studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that many prospective students had not yet registered before the new 1 May deadline, and whether DigiD delays and information provision were adequate. The minister answered that registrations are rising sharply, that extensive information campaigns have been run, and that she will monitor the situation and take further communication steps before drawing a final balance after 1 May.
Studielink only provides information on the actual number of applications submitted in Studielink, without distinguishing between final-year secondary school students and switchers.
Studielink geeft alleen informatie over het feitelijke aantal ingediende aanmeldingen in Studielink, zonder onderscheid te maken tussen eindexamenkandidaten en switchers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over het rapport van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs inzake de kwaliteit van schoolleiders

An MP asked the education minister how to interpret the Inspectorate's finding that school leaders fall short of their profession's own competence standards, and what training and quality measures will follow. The state secretary answered that leaders generally function adequately, that a school leaders' register, a professional profile, training accreditation and extra professionalisation budgets are being pursued, and that the effects are not yet measurable.
The inspection research shows that the quality of school leaders is related to the quality of lessons.
Het inspectieonderzoek toont aan dat de kwaliteit van schoolleiders samenhangt met de kwaliteit van lessen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over allochtone homohaters uit Amersfoort

MPs asked the ministers about reports that a gay man in Amersfoort was driven out of his neighbourhood by harassment from young men, and whether mass immigration and Islamisation hinder gay emancipation and whether perpetrators should be expelled or punished more harshly. The ministers condemned discrimination, said perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected, rejected expulsion of Dutch nationals, and listed existing local and national support measures without new concrete commitments.
Perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected.
Daders moeten worden aangepakt en slachtoffers beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat opleidingen verpleging razend populair zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked the government about the popularity of nursing degrees amid job losses in healthcare, the shortage of internship places, and whether numerus fixus admission limits are acceptable. The minister says intake is still growing, temporary solutions have been found for internships, a meeting with nursing schools is planned, and that restricted intake is acceptable as regional planning.

VWS and OCW are planning a meeting with the representatives of the HBO nursing programmes, in which among other things the situation regarding internship places for the coming academic year will be discussed.
VWS en OCW plannen een afspraak met de vertegenwoordiging van de hbo-verpleegkunde opleidingen, waarin onder meer de situatie rond de stageplaatsen voor het komende studiejaar aan de orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat jonge criminelen van 12 tot 23 jaar binnenkort als straf naar school gestuurd kunnen worden

PVV MPs asked whether the government accepts that compulsory education as a penalty for young offenders aged 12 to 23 undermines school safety and whether it is a real intervention. The minister said the bill, which is pending advice from the Council of State, gives a basis to bring such youths into education and that a full debate will follow after submission, without detailing the research basis.
On the justification of the bill and what is necessary for its proper implementation, we would be glad to hold the debate with you after it is submitted to your House.
Over de onderbouwing van het wetsvoorstel en hetgeen voor een goede uitvoering daarvan noodzakelijk is, voeren wij na indiening bij uw Kamer graag het debat met u.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Inspectie wil geld terug van ROC's’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that the Education Inspectorate wants money back from vocational colleges (ROCs) whose apprenticeship programmes failed legal requirements, and whether this amounts to improper claims on public funds. The minister answered that no final decisions have been taken yet, that the institutions can respond to the proposed recovery under the General Administrative Law Act, and that she intends to set funding lower and recover the amounts, though she declined to name the institutions or give totals.
At present a number of institutions have received a proposed decision from the Education Inspectorate to recover funds.
Op dit moment heeft een aantal instellingen van de Onderwijsinspectie (hierna: inspectie) een voorgenomen besluit tot terugvordering ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over een open brief van de Evangelische Hogeschool

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Education whether she will respond to an open letter from the Evangelische Hogeschool about uncertainty over the student loan system and provide clarity before 1 May, and whether she has followed up on a promised meeting with institutions offering gap years. The Minister says a new integral proposal on the social loan system will be presented before summer 2014, that the promised meeting will be scheduled once there is more clarity, and that the question on students' decision-making timing is answered in her reply to question 2.
I have promised your House that I will present a new integral proposal to the House before the summer of 2014.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd nog voor de zomer van 2014 een nieuw integraal voorstel aan de Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Huisjesmelker van het Jaar 2014

An SP MP asks the ministers about the 2014 Huisjesmelker van het Jaar award, the enforcement against landlords exploiting student tenants, a national rental permit scheme, fire and installation safety checks, and the student housing shortfall. Minister Blok responds that gemeenten already have enforcement tools, that a Woningwet amendment strengthening municipal enforcement is pending, that a national permit scheme is unnecessary, that safety oversight is for municipalities to decide, and that the 16,000-unit student housing target is on schedule and sufficient.
The cabinet is therefore committed to combating landlord exploitation, including by amending legislation and expanding municipalities' enforcement instruments.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om huisjesmelkerij tegen te gaan, onder meer door wetgeving aan te passen en het handhavingsinstrumentarium van gemeenten uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over extra kosten voor studenten bovenop het collegegeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about extra fees students must pay beyond tuition for activities needed to earn credits, and why this persists despite a legal prohibition. The Minister confirmed the rule that such costs are generally not allowed for compulsory activities, said institutions must offer free alternatives, and pointed to the ISO and Inspectorate for follow-up while stating that student complaint-channel information needs improvement.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to look into this.
Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de bescherming van maritiem historisch erfgoed naar aanleiding van het bericht dat de SS Rosalie is verkocht en zal worden versleept naar Turkije

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the historic steamship SS Rosalie, subsidised by the Mondriaan Fund, could be sold and towed to Turkey, and whether its export could be halted or the sale price disclosed. The minister answered that no return condition applied, the price is a private matter, the export licence was lawfully granted after the Erfgoedinspectie raised no objection, and suspending the export is not legally possible.
I do not see it as my task to disclose the sale price, of which I am in any case not aware, as it was determined by a private transaction.
Ik zie het niet als mijn taak om de hoogte van de verkoopprijs, waar ik overigens niet van op de hoogte ben, en die door een particuliere transactie is bepaald, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Stille crisis in mbo’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about financial problems at ROC Leiden, including which decisions caused them, what measures are being taken, and how similar problems will be prevented. The Minister confirmed ROC Leiden is under heightened supervision due to a liquidity problem tied to a new building and complex financing, commissioned an external financial study, asked the Inspectorate to investigate governance, and promised to report back once results are known.

In addition, with the interests of ROC Leiden's students in mind, I have asked the Inspectorate to start an investigation under Article 15 of the Education Supervision Act, examining the governance conduct at ROC Leiden.

Daarnaast heb ik, met het oog op de belangen van de studenten van ROC Leiden, de inspectie verzocht een onderzoek te starten als bedoeld in artikel 15 van de Wet op het onderwijstoezicht waarbij gekeken zal worden naar het bestuurlijk handelen bij ROC Leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Dure tentamens in Leiden’

An MP asked whether Dutch universities may charge students fees for late registration for exams and whether this is lawful. The minister answered that no legal basis exists for such charges, that institutions must set reasonable, clearly communicated registration deadlines, and that exam registration may be separate from course registration.
There is no legal basis for charging costs when students register late for an exam.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag voor het in rekening brengen van kosten indien studenten zich te laat inschrijven voor een tentamen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Duisenberg over Duits in de grensregio

MPs Straus and Duisenberg asked the education minister about shortages of German teachers, recruiting German teachers, and the role of German in border-region vocational education. The minister answered that shortages are a regional matter, that a German-teacher training programme and a small pilot already exist, and that she opposes replacing English with German in mbo, instead encouraging border institutions to use existing flexibility.
I have therefore, by letter, called on mbo institutions in the border regions to make greater use of the possibilities the mbo system offers them.
Ik heb daarom met een brief de mbo-instellingen in de grensregio's opgeroepen meer gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die het mbo-stelsel hen biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rutte en Aukje de Vries over de monumentenstatus Bildtdijken

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Bildtdijken should be designated a protected village view, whether the municipal council's opinion should be decisive, and whether protection would harm local businesses and employment. The minister said the decision awaits renewed consultation with the province and municipality, that the municipality already manages the area well, and that protection would not necessarily hinder the economy.
I am awaiting this consultation before I make a decision on the nomination.
Ik wacht dit overleg af alvorens ik een besluit neem over de voordracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de negatieve gevolgen van de geldverdelingssystematiek bij de VU voor goede bèta-opleidingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the funding allocation at the VU that threatens good beta programmes and whether student councils have advisory or consent rights over it. The Minister said budget allocation is the university board's responsibility, cited the WHW advisory powers of the university council, and said no signals of students being unable to finish programmes had reached her.
I cannot intervene in the substantive choices made or being made and in the conclusions attached to the consultation that has taken place or is taking place.
Ik kan niet treden in de inhoudelijke keuzes die daarbij zijn of worden gemaakt en de conclusies die aan het gevoerde overleg zijn of worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Nederlandse homostellen niet langer Russische kinderen kunnen adopteren

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Russia's 2014 decree blocking adoptions by same-sex married couples and unmarried persons from countries allowing same-sex marriage affects Dutch applicants, and whether the Netherlands would support them before the European Court of Human Rights. The government answered that Russia-Netherlands adoption cooperation has never existed so effects are limited, and that intervention in ECHR cases would be assessed case by case and only in exceptional situations.
Whether the Netherlands will support any Dutch couples will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
Of Nederland eventuele Nederlandse stellen zal bijstaan zal per zaak worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Aukje de Vries, Jacobi en De Rouwe over het behoud van de monumentenstatus molen “Windlust”

MPs asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had advised against keeping the monument status of the Windlust windmill in Burum after a 2012 fire, on what criteria, and why it differs from the Schultehuis in Meppel. The minister answered that the agency started a delisting procedure because 95% of the mill was destroyed, that the municipality advised retaining status, and that a final decision awaits the Raad voor Cultuur's advice.
I will make a final decision on the monument status after receiving both advices.
Ik neem een definitief besluit over de monumentenstatus nadat ik beide adviezen heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het hoge collegegeld voor een tweede studie

An SP MP asked the education minister why universities charge up to 20,000 euro for a second degree, whether self-regulation has failed, whether that is a fair price in a crisis, and whether she will cap these fees as promised during the 2013 debate. The minister replied that fees vary widely, that she sees no reason to cap them, and that she will monitor fees, contact institutions with outliers, and examine how institutions inform students.
On the basis of this information, I see no reason to cap institutional tuition fees.
Op basis van deze informatie zie ik geen aanleiding het instellingscollegegeld te maximeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte inzake kortingsacties voor boeken

MP Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the fixed book price rules, which limit discount promotions, are overly bureaucratic and should be loosened or reconsidered. The Minister denied that the Commissariat must approve discounts, said the rules aim at preserving a varied book supply rather than maximizing sales, and promised to address possible loosening in the evaluation report to parliament before the summer.
I will return to this in my evaluation report that I will send to the States General before the summer.
Ik kom hierop terug in mijn evaluatieverslag dat ik de Staten-Generaal vóór de zomer zal toezenden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gebrekkige medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Utrecht University board bypassed the works council in revising master programmes, and whether the WHW was followed, whether a trend of sidelining councils exists, and how councils' rights will be protected. The Minister denies that the council was bypassed, sees no WHW violation, sees no trend, points to the 2014 governance evaluation and a student council monitor, and states the legal framework is in order, so no new legislation is planned.
The press release shows that the works council was not bypassed in the decision to revise the programme offering.
Uit het persbericht blijkt dat de medezeggenschap niet gepasseerd is bij de beslissing om het opleidingsaanbod te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel ‘Cao in Onderwijs niet rechtsgeldig’

An MP asked whether the education sector collective labour agreements (cao) are legally valid, given doubts about the employer and union bodies signing them. The state secretary answered that education cao terms do flow into individual contracts via declaration, that the VO-raad acts within its statutory mandate, and that the Wet op de loonvorming may be revisited.

I will consult with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment to see whether the decentralisation of collective pay setting in education and developments in labour law give cause to adapt the Wage Formation Act to these developments.

Ik zal in overleg met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid bezien of de decentralisatie van de arbeidsvoorwaardenvorming die in het onderwijs heeft plaatsgevonden en de ontwikkelingen in het arbeidsrecht, aanleiding geven om de Wet op de loonvorming aan deze ontwikkelingen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat scholen geld overhouden

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools were holding unspent funds (about 300 million euros) and whether this should be spent on education, and how much was underspent by sector in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that positive results do not necessarily mean money is being hoarded, gave 2012 sector figures, said 2013 figures are not yet available, and noted that the inspectorate monitors institutions with high reserves.
An incidental positive result does not by definition mean that the sectors are 'holding on to' money.
Een incidenteel positief resultaat betekent niet per definitie dat de sectoren geld «overhouden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Klein over het bericht “School doet er alles aan om van oudere leraar af te raken”

MPs Mohandis and Klein asked the Minister of Education whether schools push older teachers out for financial reasons and whether the government will protect older teachers and their competence. The Minister rejects the claim that older teachers are disproportionately dismissed, points to UWV unemployment inflow figures, and says personnel policy and cao rules are the responsibility of schools and cao parties, promising only a new senior scheme to be elaborated at the cao table.
Conducting good personnel policy is the responsibility of the schools themselves.
Het voeren van een goed personeelsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de telsystematiek voor educatiebudgetten

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how education budgets for municipalities are calculated, including the definition and counting of educational trajectories and whether different counting methods lead to unequal budget distribution. The Minister answered that budgets are based on four indicators, that municipalities and regional vocational colleges (roc's) define and count trajectories themselves within broad policy freedom, and that a uniform definition and new regional allocation system are being prepared in a bill for 2015.
Municipalities and roc's make mutual agreements on the content of the offered educational trajectories, for example regarding the number of teaching hours.
Gemeenten en roc's maken onderling afspraken over de invulling van de aangeboden educatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld met betrekking tot het aantal onderwijsuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over levenslange gevangenisstraf voor homo's in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government condemns Uganda's bill imposing life imprisonment for homosexuality and whether all development aid to Uganda should stop. The minister called the bill a violation of fundamental human rights, said it is too early to assess consequences since the president had not signed it, and argued that keeping aid lets the Netherlands keep pressing for non-discrimination.
Stopping development aid makes it harder to exert pressure and keep attention locally on the principle of non-discrimination.
Het stopzetten van ontwikkelingshulp maakt het moeilijker om druk uit te oefenen en de aandacht lokaal op het principe van non-discriminatie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de onrechtmatige benoeming van een lid van de Raad van Toezicht van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the appointment of a Senate PvdA member to the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences supervisory board was unlawful under the institution's statutes, and what the Minister would do about it. The Minister said she had no role in appointing supervisory board members of such institutions, that the appointment was consistent with the WHW, that the statutes were amended, and that she saw no grounds for action.
I have no involvement in the appointment of a member of the supervisory board of a special institution, such as the HvA
Ik heb geen bemoeienis met de benoeming van een lid van de raad van toezicht van een bijzondere instelling, zoals de HvA
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de bescherming van rijksmonumenten in het aardbevingsgebied van Noord Oost Groningen

An MP asked ministers about damage to listed monuments in the Groningen earthquake zone and who enforces the ban on destroying protected monuments. The government said enforcement under the Monumentenwet lies with municipalities, while a provincial taskforce and a joint agreement with NAM aim to coordinate repair and prevention.
The current Article 11(1) of the Monumentenwet 1988 places enforcement with the lower government.
Het huidige artikel 11, eerste lid, van de Monumentenwet 1988 legt de handhaving bij de lagere overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de berichten dat er opnieuw sprake lijkt te zijn van grootschalige fraude door een wetenschapper

MPs asked the minister about reports of repeated plagiarism and self-citation by a researcher at the VU and what should be done about publication pressure and self-policing by universities. The minister said it is premature to call it fraud, that the VU is investigating, that the KNAW will advise on citation rules, and that the existing system of institutional self-correction works sufficiently.
I find it premature to speak of fraud.
Ik vind het voorbarig om te spreken van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de voortgaande islamisering van het universitaire onderwijs

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a VUmc workshop on treating patients of the other sex and related Islam-linked activities at a Dutch university are acceptable and whether measures will be taken against 'Islamisation' of higher education. The minister answered that the event is a legitimate diversity activity within institutional autonomy, that education remains accessible and lawful, and that she will take no measures.
I do not intend to take measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat een leerling mogelijk is doodgepest op de Horeca Vakschool Rotterdam

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a 16-year-old may have been driven to suicide by bullying at a Rotterdam school, including the gap between the father's claims and the school's denial and whether anti-bullying protocols are applied in practice. The answers say an independent inquiry into the school is underway, a bill requiring anti-bullying programmes, a bullying coordinator and monitoring is planned, and bullies can already be punished under criminal law.
The school's board has announced it will commission an independent inquiry to see whether any signals were missed.
Het bestuur van de school heeft aangekondigd een onafhankelijk onderzoek uit te laten voeren om te kijken of er geen signalen zijn gemist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Salaris bestuurder mbo wordt afhankelijk van aantal studenten'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about a report that vocational college (mbo) board salaries would depend on student numbers, and whether this encourages enlarging institutions, how the salary bands work, and how this relates to a motion for a collective labour agreement and to rules in other education sectors. The Minister answered that the sector's self-regulatory pay code uses student numbers as a guiding framework under the statutory WNT maximum, that boards of supervision are responsible for applying it, that a table of salary bands is provided, and that the code will be monitored with possible future ministerial regulation.
The supervisory boards are responsible for applying and enforcing the norms.
De raden van toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor toepassing en handhaving van de normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht “Hulp mentor bij studiekeus allochtone jongere”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Link2Work project for jongeren, which they described as aimed at allochtone youth, discriminates against autochthonous youth, and demanded an apology and its termination. Minister Asscher replied that Link2Work is open to all youth needing extra help in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, makes no distinction by ethnicity or origin, and that many participants are expected to have a migrant background due to the population of those cities.
No distinction is made on the basis of ethnicity or origin.
Er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar etniciteit of afkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het aantal laaggeletterden snel stijgt

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister about reports that functional illiteracy is rising quickly, including labour-market shortages, the role of women, and measures for 45-65 year olds. The minister replied that the Action Plan on Functional Illiteracy, municipal adult-education funding, pilots and a motion-backed €5 million annually address the issue, with no sign of executive power or oversight being at stake.
Women are unfortunately overrepresented among functionally illiterate people.
Vrouwen zijn helaas oververtegenwoordigd onder laaggeletterden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “French parliament says free software is a priority in education”

MP Rog (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether open source software is used exclusively in education in Spain, Portugal and Iceland, whether lessons can be drawn for the Netherlands from France, and how open standards and platform-independence rules are complied with. The minister replied that open source is used but not exclusively, that schools are primarily responsible for procurement given freedom of education, that open-standards 'comply-or-explain' rules could be applied better, and that she will talk with stakeholders and may consult other ministers if accessibility does not improve.
I will engage in discussions with various parties over the coming months to examine whether and what opportunities the use of open source offers in this changing context.
Ik zal de komende maanden met verschillende partijen het gesprek aangaan om te kijken of en welke kansen de inzet van open source biedt in deze veranderende context.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat homostellen hun kind niet kunnen erkennen

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether married gay men can be prevented from recognising an unborn child they fathered with an unmarried woman, given differing municipal practice under Article 1:204(1)(e) of the Civil Code. The State Secretary agreed there is no good reason for unequal treatment, explained that a 2013 amendment removes the provision (planned for 1 April 2014), and said municipalities apply the law individually.
From the standpoint of equal treatment, however, there is no good reason to continue giving the man married to a woman other than the mother a different position from a man married to a man.

Er is vanuit het oogpunt van gelijke behandeling evenwel geen goede reden om de met een andere vrouw dan de moeder gehuwde man een andere positie te blijven laten innemen dan de met een man gehuwde man.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jongeren vragen om meer klimaatonderwijs’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Beertema asked the State Secretary whether climate education promoted through youth representatives is appropriate, given the lack of proof of human influence and the parliamentary inquiry's call for schools to focus on core tasks. The State Secretary answered that the IPCC science is clear, climate education is already embedded in the curriculum, and schools decide how to organise it, without committing to any new action.
Subsequently, it is up to schools how they organise and shape education and which methods and teaching materials they wish to use.
Vervolgens is het aan scholen hoe zij het onderwijs inrichten en vormgeven en welke methoden en leermiddelen zij daarbij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Aantal laaggeletterden stijgt snel’

MP Klein (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Education about a report that functional illiteracy is rising fast among older adults, and whether targeted action, funding and links to unemployment and poverty are planned. The Minister said the policy covers all age groups, pointed to the Action Plan, Taal voor het Leven pilots and existing funding, and said decisions on targeting older adults would await evaluations, without committing to a specific older-adult measure.
Beyond these activities, I am not undertaking any additional action aimed specifically at the older age group.
Naast deze activiteiten onderneem ik geen extra actie gericht op de groep ouderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een dreigend tekort aan vakmensen

The MP asks the Minister of Education about the decline in youth choosing craft vocational training, the risk of shortages of skilled workers, and what will be done to attract youth to these trades. The Minister states that the falling interest is a matter of youth choice and sector responsibility, notes that enrolment in the listed courses has risen overall, points to pilots, the Techniekpact and the Focus op Vakmanschap plan, and promises to inform Parliament in spring after the MBO tour.
Parliament will be informed in the spring about the outcomes of this tour.
Uw Kamer zal in het voorjaar over de uitkomsten van deze tour worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verbod op de intocht van Zwarte Piet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a view that Dutch traditions such as Zwarte Piet should be protected against multicultural objections, and what it will do given moves to ban the Piet arrival and remove Piet from schools. The minister answered that the Sinterklaas celebration is a matter for society and local committees and schools, and declined to take national action.
The arrival is a local matter. School boards are free to celebrate festivities and shape them as they see fit.
De intocht is een lokale aangelegenheid. Schoolbesturen zijn vrij om naar eigen inzicht feesten te vieren en deze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over regionale opleidingscentra die autisten weren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether regional vocational colleges deliberately exclude students with autism, which would conflict with their duty of care, and whether the equal-treatment law is enforced. The minister said the Inspectorate will investigate the complaints and the College for Human Rights may too, while stating that many students with autism do study in vocational education and that institutions must make reasonable adjustments or refer students to a more suitable programme.
The reports are for me a reason to have further investigation carried out by the Inspectorate of Education.
De meldingen zijn voor mij aanleiding tot het laten doen van nader onderzoek door de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Meenen over de Amsterdamse inspectie

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked whether Amsterdam's municipal Kwaliteitsbureau, which inspects school quality alongside the national inspectorate, is an unwelcome extra layer and a limit on school freedom. The Secretary of State replied that participation is voluntary, the bureau is independent, the inspectorate's judgement remains decisive, and the bureau costs about EUR 600,000 a year, to be evaluated after four years.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht “Hoogleraren stapelen bijbanen op”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that professors accumulate side jobs and how this affects independence and conflicts of interest. The minister said side-job numbers are the responsibility of universities, that transparency is ensured via public profile pages, and that the Dutch research integrity code applies.
Numbers of side functions of professors are not kept by the ministry.
Aantallen nevenfuncties van hoogleraren worden niet door het ministerie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nevenfuncties van hoogleraren

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about disclosure of professors' side jobs, citing high rates of side functions and commercial ties, and asked whether the disclosure code should be tightened. The minister replied that universities publish side functions on professor profile pages, that a sector check found near-complete compliance, and declined to tighten the code or restrict side jobs.
I therefore cannot send you such a report.
Ik kan u een dergelijke rapportage dus niet toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Hamer over het bericht dat er 280.000 potentiële stageplaatsen onbenut blijven

MPs Jadnanansing and Hamer asked the Minister of Education about a report that 280,000 potential internship places remain unused, the risk of an internship shortage raised by SBB, and why small firms and self-employed people rarely take interns. The minister answered that the stage and apprenticeship offensive is working, that self-employed people face no legal barriers but must meet quality criteria, that a practice-learning subsidy starts in January 2014, and that she opposes loosening quality requirements for training firms.
I am willing to examine whether such collaborations can make it easier for self-employed people to offer an internship or work-placement.
Ik ben bereid om te onderzoeken of dergelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ervoor kunnen zorgen dat het eenvoudiger wordt voor zzp'ers om een stage of leerwerkbaan aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de crisis in de archeologie

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the crisis in commercial archaeology, job losses, budgets since 2003, municipal shortfalls in staff and policy, and whether a follow-up to the Odyssee pilot will be pursued. The Minister attributes the sector's trouble to the economic downturn, reports budgets and a pending employment study, says municipalities are primarily responsible and have more discretion, and points to Rijksdienst support programmes and the 'Oogst voor Malta' follow-up.
At this moment I do not have exact figures on employment.
Op dit moment heb ik geen exacte cijfers over de werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over de opbouw en verdeling van het onderzoeks-budget uit de 1e geldstroom per universiteit

MP Lucas asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the 'percentages onderzoek' component of first-stream research funding is allocated by historical agreements rather than strategic or quality criteria, and why shares differ sharply between universities, correlating with degree and PhD numbers and founding dates. The Minister answers that the percentages are set by ministerial regulation and changed for substantive reasons, that the variation reflects past policy measures and institution-specific additions, denies that founding date drives allocation, and says the interdepartmental research policy review may consider the allocation criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over de mogelijke sluiting van de Saint James School of Medicine op Bonaire

Two MPs asked whether the Saint James School of Medicine on Bonaire must close by 2015 because it fails Dutch inspection requirements, and what efforts and options exist to prevent closure. The minister answered that the school never received Dutch accreditation, withdrew its higher-education procedure, and therefore lost ECFMG recognition, while acknowledging some economic impact and noting that the government had already extended the deadline.
The medical school chose, after the investigation under the new programme assessment, to withdraw its application for that assessment.
De medical school heeft ervoor gekozen na het onderzoek in het kader van de toets nieuwe opleiding, de aanvraag voor die toets in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Ojik over het weren van lesbiënnes, homo’s en bi’s in de Golfstaten

Two Green Left MPs asked whether they condemn a reported Kuwaiti proposal for Gulf states to subject visa applicants to sex testing that would target transgender people, and whether they would raise it diplomatically. The minister said the proposal conflicts with equal treatment and the government's values, that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners, and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Ark over het op het laatste moment verplaatsen van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

Two VVD MPs asked why the Curaçao Gay Pride venue was changed at the last moment, whether this affects freedom of assembly, and how LGBT safety and expression are guaranteed on Curaçao. The minister answered that public order is an autonomous Curaçao matter whose considerations are unknown to him, that only one MP's letter was received, and that no signals of unsafety were received.
It is up to the Curaçao government to weigh whether additional requirements for organizing the Gay Pride are necessary to maintain public order and safety.

Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride om daarmee de openbare orde en veiligheid te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Van Laar over het niet doorgaan van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

MPs Yücel and Van Laar asked about the cancelled first Gay Pride on Curaçao, whether the government imposed last-minute conditions, whether police deemed flags and demonstration items dangerous, and whether Raveneau's letter to church leaders influenced this, and asked the government to press Curaçao on LHBT rights. The minister replied that public order and emancipation policy on Curaçao are autonomous matters, the reasons behind the police conditions are not known to him, and he has received no signals that LHBT rights are not respected, while pointing to the Curaçao government's stated support and the Pink Orange Akkoord funding.
It is up to the government of Curaçao to weigh to what extent additional requirements are needed for organising the Gay Pride in order to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het zorgwekkende rendementsdenken in het hoger onderwijs

Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education about a study finding that binding study advice (BSA) does not work, about limits on the validity of exam results at Leiden and Windesheim, and about Hogeschool De Kempel's four-attempt exclusion rule. The Minister rejected the study's conclusions as limited, said the institutional validity limits are for institutions to set, and noted that De Kempel withdrew its rule as contrary to law.
I have no reason to assume that this institutional task will be placed in a different light by the above measures.
Ik heb geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat deze taak van de instelling in een ander perspectief komt te staan met bovenstaande maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het leenstelsel ook voor de masterstudent met een jaar wordt uitgesteld

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about reports that the student loan system would also be postponed by a year for master's students, and about the consequences for institutions and the Education Agreement financing. The minister said she is not in favour of further postponement, that the master's loan bill is pending with a 1 September 2014 start, and that the 119 million euro figure is not directly tied to the loan system.
Unlike GroenLinks, I am for the time being not in favour of further postponement of the loan system.
Ik ben anders dan GroenLinks vooralsnog geen voorstander van verder uitstel van het leenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat een pabo-studente geweigerd zou zijn voor een stage bij een Montessori basisschool vanwege het dragen van een hoofddoek

MPs Yücel and Jadnanansing asked whether a Rotterdam pabo student was refused a traineeship at a public Montessori school because she wore a headscarf, and about the wider position of headscarves and dress rules in schools. The state secretary answered that the traineeship ended for other substantive reasons, that the school did discourage the headscarf, that the school board and university agreed the headscarf is not an issue, and explained the case law and the rules for public versus religious schools.
This showed that the student was not refused because of wearing a headscarf, but that the traineeship did not proceed for other, substantive reasons.
Hieruit is gebleken dat de studente niet is geweigerd op grond van het dragen van een hoofddoek, maar dat de stage om andere, inhoudelijke redenen niet is doorgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het gebrek aan stageplekken voor duizenden mbo-leerlingen

An MP asked the education minister about nearly 3,000 vocational students lacking internship places and possibly being unable to graduate, and about the quality of stages found through 'creative' solutions. The minister said the 3,000 figure refers to reports to a complaints desk, that over half had a placement by end-September, and that the government and SBB are pursuing a regional internship offensive, while the school's duty of care is to support students in finding placements.
If 3,000 students could not graduate due to a lack of internship places, I would consider that a serious matter.
Als 3.000 studenten niet zouden kunnen afstuderen vanwege het gebrek aan stageplekken, zou ik dat een ernstige zaak vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat studenten van Inholland problemen ervaren bij het afronden van hun studie

MPs Mohandis, Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Inholland's tightened graduation requirements are leaving students unable to finish, and what compensation is available. The minister answered that Inholland's extra support measures are adequate, that she does not expect large numbers to be stranded, and that students can seek support from the profileringsfonds or claim damages under general law.
I consider the measures taken by Hogeschool Inholland (see my answer to question 2 above) sufficient.
Ik acht de maatregelen die zijn getroffen door Hogeschool Inholland (zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 2 hierboven) voldoende.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dreigende vernietiging van de collectie van het Tropeninstituut

An MP asks the ministers whether the KIT library collection, with nearly 70% of its post-1950 holdings at risk of destruction, is adequately protected, and questions their earlier pledge to keep the collection available to the public. The minister says the pre-1950 part, treated as heritage, will move to Leiden University Library, while for the post-1950 part insufficient interest exists to maintain a library function and KIT remains responsible for negotiating transfers.
That is why I am very pleased that the pre-1950 collection is coming under the management of Leiden University Library and will therefore remain accessible.
Daarom ben ik zeer verheugd dat de pre-1950 collectie in beheer komt bij de universiteitsbibliotheek Leiden en daardoor toegankelijk blijft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht “Oud hoogleraar Bax schuldig aan wetenschappelijk wangedrag”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the finding that former professor Bax committed scientific misconduct, including the consequences for supervised PhD students, why earlier warnings and checks did not detect it, whether sector measures would have caught it, what integrity steps were taken, and whether criminal complaint would be filed. The minister answered that the PhD students face no consequences, that the VU will have the report translated and notify journals and registries, that the VU is responsible for any criminal complaint, and that institutions have reformed integrity policy.
The Vrije Universiteit has decided to have the Baud committee report translated into English and sent to the journals in which the articles appeared.
De Vrije Universiteit heeft besloten het rapport van de commissie Baud in het Engels te vertalen en te doen toekomen aan de tijdschriften waarin deze zijn verschenen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over bezwaren tegen het Sinterklaasfeest

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Sinterklaas celebration is part of Dutch culture, whether objections to it should be disregarded, and whether the Amsterdam arrival with Zwarte Piet will go ahead. The minister answered that the feast is part of Dutch culture with differing views coexisting, did not recognise the portrayal of a 'go-away' mentality, and said the arrival is a local matter in which the national government has no role.
The arrival of Sinterklaas is a local matter. The national government has no involvement in it.
De intocht van Sinterklaas is een lokale aangelegenheid. Het Rijk heeft daar geen bemoeienis mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over gevolgen van de cultuurbezuinigingen

An SP MP asked Minister Bussemaker about the effects of cultural budget cuts, including podium groups closing, job losses, more freelancers, reduced new productions, and rising marketisation. The minister said the Fonds Podiumkunsten made hard choices, sponsorship impact is still unclear, she sees no threat to continuity, and she does not see a process of marketisation and impoverishment.
I do not believe that a process of marketisation and impoverishment is underway.
Ik ben niet van mening dat er een proces van vermarkting en verschraling gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende vernietiging van de collectie van het Tropeninstituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the threatened destruction of most of the Tropeninstituut library collection is compatible with her earlier promise to keep the collection accessible, and what she will do to save it. The minister answered that the pre-1950 heritage part is protected and placed under Leiden University, that the post-1950 part is being rehoused in parts with other institutions, and that temporary storage is not a solution.
This amount is not known to me.
Dit bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tabakslobby in Nederland

An SP MP asked three ministers about tobacco industry lobbying, the use of industry-funded research and Philip Morris-commissioned STAR reports, and conflicts of interest. The government answered that industry-commissioned studies are reviewed on usefulness, that the STAR reports were confidential but the latest was published, and that it does not track professors' tobacco-industry ties beyond disclosed side positions.
I am not free to provide these reports to the House without the consent of the commissioning party.
Het staat mij niet vrij deze rapporten zonder toestemming van de opdrachtgever aan de Kamer te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver over seksuele vorming en de seksuele gezondheid van jongeren

MPs Voortman and Klaver asked the ministers about condom use, STI rates among young people, and whether schools and parents should do more sexual education. The government answered that schools' role is set by attainment targets and school-level choices, that GGDs run prevention campaigns, and that no new school-specific measures are planned.
However, schools themselves decide on which topics and in what way they involve parents in their children's education.
Scholen bepalen echter zelf bij welke onderwerpen en op welke manier zij ouders betrekken bij het onderwijs van hun kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mislukte fusie tussen de Universiteit van Amsterdam en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about the failed UvA-HvA 'fusion', its costs, whether the institutions can be split, and a planned VU-UvA merger. The Minister answered that the UvA-HvA arrangement is not a legal merger, that the institutions are autonomous, that splitting the shared board and facilities is legally possible, and that the evaluation is for the institutions to publish.
It is up to the institutions involved to decide whether to make such an evaluation public and when.
Het is aan de betrokken instellingen om een dergelijke evaluatie al dan niet openbaar te maken en te bepalen wanneer dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over belangenverstrengeling bij het Fonds voor de Podiumkunsten

An MP asked the minister whether conflicts of interest at the Fonds voor de Podiumkunsten, where artists on the board or advisory committees may gain subsidy, are real and what will be done. The minister denies that the court found artists received more subsidy for sitting on these bodies, notes the 2010 court finding of insufficient safeguards, and describes the 2011 rule tightening (independent chair, stricter integrity rules, uniform scoring and fuller reasoning).
The ministry-approved house rules of the Fonds Podiumkunsten provide that an adviser does not take part in the meeting(s) of a subsidy round if he has a personal interest in an application.

In het door het ministerie goedgekeurde huishoudelijk reglement van het Fonds Podiumkunsten is geregeld dat een adviseur niet deelneemt aan de vergadering(en) in een subsidieronde als hij een persoonlijk belang heeft bij een aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat het tekort aan mbo-stageplekken overdreven zou zijn

MP Smaling asked the minister whether claims of a shortage of vocational (mbo) internship places were exaggerated, whether SBB's subsidy depends on shortage figures, and how data consistency will be ensured. The minister replied that SBB receives no structural or shortage-linked subsidy, that she trusts SBB's integrity, and that SBB will reflect on past shortage reports in its October stage barometer.
I have asked SBB to look back in the next barometer in October, alongside its outlook on the chance of internships in the future.
Ik heb de SBB gevraagd in de eerstvolgende barometer van oktober a.s. naast een beschouwing over de kans op stage in de toekomst, ook terug te blikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren gratis stage lopen

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the growing number of unpaid internships taken by young graduates displaces paid work, whether employers can avoid paying minimum wage, and whether such employers should be tackled. The minister answered that unpaid internships are not displacement since places are additional, that interns need not receive minimum wage because learning is central, and that employers are not obliged to pay internship allowances; he pointed to the SBB internship offensive instead.
There is no displacement because it generally concerns additional places.
Er is geen sprake van verdringing omdat het doorgaans gaat om additionele plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ROC's diploma's hebben verstrekt voor opleidingen die onder de maat zijn

An MP asked the education minister about reports that some regional vocational colleges (ROCs) issued diplomas for substandard courses, and whether supervision by boards had failed. The minister said several ROCs and private institutions were found deficient, that most institutions comply, that the Inspectorate has issued warnings and will enforce recovery of unlawfully received funding, and pointed to tightened rules and a planned subsidy scheme replacing the training tax relief.
Courses of insufficient quality are under intensified supervision by the Education Inspectorate.
Opleidingen van onvoldoende kwaliteit staan onder geïntensiveerd toezicht van de Onderwijsinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat de universiteit Leiden een bindend studieadvies in gaat voeren voor unieke opleidingen

An MP asks the Education Minister whether Leiden University's participation in the binding study advice (BSA) experiment, which reportedly includes unique programmes, breaches the agreed exclusion of unique programmes and the Chamber's conditions. The minister replies that unique programmes are excluded, that the programmes concerned have alternatives elsewhere, and sees no reason to exclude them from the experiment.
I currently see no reason to exclude the programmes in question from participation in the experiment.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de onderhavige opleidingen van deelname aan het experiment uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de omvang van het vermeend oneigenlijk gebruik van de afdrachtvermindering onderwijs (WVA)

An MP asked the education minister how large the alleged improper use of the education wage-tax reduction (WVA) is, and why the planned EUR 200 million cut appears to exceed that abuse. The minister replied that no reliable estimate of excess tax relief exists, that a new study is not opportune, and that the cut restores the original budget level rather than targeting abuse.
Data on this are not available.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smaling inzake het bericht dat jonge onderwijzers in grote getale werkloos raken

MP Smaling asked the minister about reports that young primary teachers are losing their jobs and being re-hired on temporary contracts, raising concerns about teacher shortages and loss of young talent. The state secretary answered that hiring and dismissal is the responsibility of school boards, cited Court of Audit data showing the share of flexible contracts falling, and pointed to a 3,000-job plan and a sector plan under consultation.
Hiring and dismissing teachers is the responsibility of the relevant school board.
Het aannemen en ontslaan van leerkrachten is de verantwoordelijkheid van het desbetreffende schoolbestuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht “DUO niet goed beveiligd”

An MP asked the Minister of Education about Auditdienst Rijk findings that DUO's information security plan was incomplete and that DUO faces ongoing risks, including the lack of a business continuity plan and weak tactical security management. The minister replied that security management is operational, that the audit advice is being followed through a task force, and that the audit body will assess progress in its 2013 report.
The ADR advice concerns improving tactical security management and drawing up a business continuity plan (BCP).
Het ADR-advies betreft de verbetering van het tactisch securitymanagement en het opstellen van een bedrijfscontinuïteitsplan (BCP).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dekken en Yücel over het bericht aangaande de handhaving van de antihomowet tijdens de Olympische Spelen van Sotsji in 2014

MPs Dekken and Yücel asked the government whether it would press NOC*NSF and the EU over Russian sports minister statements that the anti-gay law would apply during the Sochi Olympics, and how Dutch athletes would be protected. The government said participants should not be hindered, that the IOC had received written assurances, and that the matter is under ongoing IOC attention, so it saw no reason to instruct NOC*NSF; it also pointed to EU guidelines and a travel advice note.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to call on NOC*NSF to do so.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen reden om het NOC*NSF hiertoe op te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de anti-homowet in Rusland

An SP MP asked whether the government condemns Russia's anti-gay propaganda law, what concrete action it takes, and whether it supports a boycott of the Sochi Olympics. The government calls the law discriminatory, says it raises concerns with Russia, will push for an EU position at the Foreign Affairs Council, and opposes a boycott while supporting athletes' freedom of expression.

In the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the EU-Russia Summit, the cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.

Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen en bevorderen dat over de anti-homopropagandawet een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt zal worden ingenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een overschot dat ontstaat van studenten die zijn opgeleid voor de kinderopvang

An MP asked the education minister whether a surplus of about 14,000 graduates from childcare training would arise by 2015, and why vocational colleges keep training students for childcare despite job losses there. The minister denied a graduate surplus, citing that a staff surplus differs from a graduate surplus, announced the School-ex 2.0 support programme and better labour-market information, and said future childcare labour demand cannot be predicted.
The School-ex 2.0 programme has recently started.
Het programma School- ex 2.0 is onlangs gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht het bericht dat scholen leerlingen met een zorgvraag weigeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools are refusing students with support needs (e.g. autism) ahead of the 2014 funding change and whether the equalisation of care funds creates perverse incentives. The minister denies the signals, says the Inspectorate is following up on about 100 reports, argues decentralised funding is more efficient, and refuses to suspend equalisation, pointing students to the Equal Treatment Act and the Human Rights Commission.
The inspectorate has made a follow-up appointment with Start Foundation in September to gain more insight into this problem.
De inspectie heeft een vervolgafspraak met Start Foundation gemaakt in september om meer zicht te krijgen op deze problematiek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over het artikel “Kabinet herijkt onderzoekgeld”

An MP asked about a planned interdepartmental policy review (IBO) of scientific research funding and how Parliament would be involved. The ministers answered that no formal assignment has been issued yet, the review will be budget-neutral, the final report and cabinet response will be sent to the House, and the assignments will accompany the Miljoenennota.
No formal assignment has yet been given for carrying out an IBO on scientific research.
Er is formeel nog geen opdracht gegeven voor de uitvoering van een IBO naar wetenschappelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over het plan van een imam-opleiding op het Ibn Ghaldoun

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Turkish-linked imam training programme at the Ibn Ghaldoun school, funded in part by the Diyanet network, should be allowed and whether public money is involved. The state secretary answered that the school is funded only for secondary education, that the imam training is paid for by a foundation and not public funds, that freedom of religion and educational choice apply, and that the inspectorate's investigation into the school's governance will determine its future.
Ibn Ghaldoun is funded by the national government for providing education within the meaning of the Secondary Education Act.
Het Ibn Ghaldoun wordt door het Rijk bekostigd voor het verzorgen van onderwijs in de zin van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitzending 'Beveiliging Nederlandse musea weinig verbeterd'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a broadcast saying museum security has changed little since the Kunsthal art theft, and whether museums share risk-reduction discussions and budget levels. The minister answered that security is a core museum task covered by integral safety plans overseen by the Erfgoedinspectie, that sector consultations take place, and that cost shares cannot be precisely determined.
The costs of security cannot be unambiguously determined.
De kosten voor beveiliging zijn niet eenduidig te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Keijzer over discriminatie van zwangere vrouwen op de werkvloer
