MPs Heerma and Keijzer asked about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens finding that 45% of pregnant or new-mother workers had possibly discriminatory experiences, and whether the government would act. The minister replied that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to information provision and an SER advisory request due late 2013, and said pregnancy discrimination will be considered in the work-and-care summit.
Following this advice it will be considered whether, and if so which, follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies zal worden bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Steve Jobsscholen

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned Steve Jobs schools, including whether minimum knowledge standards, teacher supervision and quality norms are met and whether the new model risks becoming a failed experiment. The state secretary answered that schools have pedagogical freedom within legal limits, that the inspectorate will apply extra supervision, that the schools must meet the same quality requirements, and that a possible AMvB on flexible instruction time is being explored.
The inspectorate will therefore carry out extra supervision of the Steve Jobs schools.
De inspectie zal dan ook extra toezicht houden op de Steve Jobsscholen.

Vragen van de leden Keijzer (CDA) en Bergkamp (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over de toekomst van de collectie van het Geldmuseum in Utrecht (ingezonden 8 juli 2013).

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked why the Finance Ministry ended its relationship with the Geldmuseum, what the collection costs and who will fund it, why the Finance working group's plan was not pursued, and what happens to the collection and building. The minister answers that the owners are in talks on a shared vision, closure followed the conclusion that continuity was no longer guaranteed, and future costs and collection arrangements are still under study, to be reported to the Chamber later.
No statements can yet be made about the amount of savings to be realised over time, because future storage and management of the collection, and its costs, are still being examined.

Over de hoogte van de op termijn te realiseren besparingen kunnen echter nog geen uitspraken gedaan worden, omdat toekomstige opslag en beheer van de collectie, alsmede de kosten hiervan, nog nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over onderzoek onder voortijdig schoolverlaters m.b.t. preventie en begeleiding van deze groep

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the ROA study of early school leavers, including whether the finding that many feel no one tried to help them is worrying and whether policy should be tightened. The minister answers that the approach has halved early school leaving, that schools can do more on intake, guidance and attendance, and that she will keep pressing schools on these points.
I will continue to hold schools and institutions to account on these points.
Ik blijf scholen en instellingen op deze punten aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken en De Boer over het verdwijnen van de unieke collectie typemachines van de schrijver W.F. Hermans naar het buitenland

MPs asked the minister why W.F. Hermans' typewriter collection was allocated to a Belgian bookshop, whether museum rules leave a gap allowing such export, and what tools exist to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister defended the selection process, said the collection stays accessible in the Dutch-language area, stated that museum self-regulation rather than a gap explains the outcome, promised Erfgoedwet rules on state disposal of heritage, and rejected using the Wet tot behoud van cultuurbezit in this case.
I intend to regulate further, in the Heritage Act, the process by which governments, important owners of collections, dispose of cultural objects.
Ik ben voornemens in de Erfgoedwet het proces van afstoten van cultuurvoorwerpen door overheden, belangrijke eigenaars van collecties, nader te regelen
Antwoord vragen Venrooy-van Ark over het reddingsplan voor het Tropenmuseum

An MP asked the education and foreign trade ministers about the rescue plan for the Tropenmuseum, including its merger conditions, budgets, funding sources and whether it amounts to a cut for culture and development aid. The minister confirmed the merger and collection-transfer conditions, gave budget figures and funding splits, but declined to commit to post-2016 funding and said the rescue is a cut for development cooperation.
I cannot make any commitment for after the current subsidy period, for any institution whatsoever.
Ik kan geen toezegging doen voor na de huidige subsidieperiode, voor welke instelling dan ook.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een kwart van vrouwelijke co-assistenten seksueel wordt geïntimideerd

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that a quarter of female medical trainees (co-assistenten) face sexual intimidation, and why few report it. The minister says such intimidation is unacceptable, points to hospital CAO rules, sector action plans and a planned NFU review, and says the data on other training tracks are not available.
We do not have this information.
Wij beschikken niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de rol van ondersteunende organisaties bij het sluiten van een religieus kindhuwelijk

An MP asked the government how it reacted to reports that police and Fier Fryslân helped arrange a religious child marriage, and how agencies handling honour-related cases weigh cultural background against law and women's rights. The minister denied that the law was broken, said the police withdrew once safety was no longer at stake, stated that LEC-EGG was not involved in imam marriages, and held that the victim's interest comes first with no concessions to laws that conflict with Dutch law.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat één op de vijf stagiairs wordt uitgescholden

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about reports that one in five interns is verbally abused during placements, and about the adequacy of internship supervision, placement numbers and responsibility for them. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to institutions' legal duty to supervise interns and to monitoring of placement quality by the inspectorate, and said businesses and schools must act, with a broader policy response left to them.
We will therefore monitor per institution whether the supervision of placements is of sufficient quality.
We gaan daarom per instelling monitoren of de begeleiding van stages van voldoende kwaliteit is.
Antwoord vragen Rog inzake het artikel 'OCW schendt Techniekpact'

An MP asked the education minister whether budget cuts to subsidies undermine the Techniekpact, including Centres of Expertise and innovation centres, and why these were cut. The minister denied that the Techniekpact is violated, said technology priorities were spared, and pointed to her earlier letter on the subsidy cuts.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Mohandis over de kosten van kamerverhuur

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked about the high cost of student rooms in Amsterdam and Utrecht, the norm rent used for student housing, and how many extra student rooms are needed beyond the national action plan. The minister answered that rents are set by free contract with limited tenant remedies via the rent commission, that housing shortages are tied to tight local markets, and that the action plan's additional units are considered sufficient with private landlords expected to expand supply.
In rent law for residential accommodation, the principle of contractual freedom applies in principle.
In het huurprijzenrecht voor woonruimte geldt in beginsel contractvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Gemeenten houden geld voor onderwijsachterstanden in portemonnee’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether municipalities leave funds for educational disadvantage unspent, and why around €40 million is recovered to the state treasury instead of being reinvested in education. The state secretary answered that the funds may only be used for school classes and pre-school education, that €37.5 million was reclaimed from 155 municipalities for 2006–2010, that municipalities cited start-up problems and strict criteria, and that under budget rules the recovered sums flow back to the treasury and cannot be reallocated in 2013.
Municipalities that did not spend the funds on educational disadvantage have since been subject to a recovery of the money.
Bij gemeenten die de middelen niet hebben besteed aan onderwijsachterstanden heeft inmiddels een terugvordering plaats gevonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Jasper van Dijk over de toekomst van de Tropenmuseum

MPs Monasch and Jasper van Dijk asked ministers whether the future of the Tropenmuseum is at risk, how the KIT budget cuts and 90 job losses affect it, and which ministry should fund it after 2013. The ministers answered that the KIT subsidy ended under earlier decisions, a transition grant of 15.3 million was given for 2013 with 7.5 million earmarked for the museum, the KIT is responsible for its own plans and cut allocation, and post-2013 funding talks with Amsterdam and the ministries are ongoing.
Responsibility for distributing the cuts across the different departments lies with the KIT.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de verdeling van de bezuinigingen over de verschillende afdelingen ligt bij het KIT.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het feit dat studenten problemen ervaren tijdens hun stage

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about student interns facing bullying and weak supervision, citing a 2013 stage monitor showing supervision rated only barely sufficient and one in five students reporting harassment. The minister called the findings serious and said schools must ensure supervision and teachers need adequate time, but left concrete improvements to schools and employers, seeing no direct role for herself.
I do not see a role for myself here in the first instance.
Ik zie hier in eerste instantie geen rol voor mijzelf weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht dat veel jongeren een opleiding met gering baanperspectief volgen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that many young people enrol in vocational courses with poor job prospects, and about measures such as linking funding to graduates' labour-market success and improving study guidance. The minister acknowledged the signal, argued the FNV indicator is incomplete, and announced a tighter labour-market-prospects duty, performance agreements and a future power to revoke courses.
I intend to make the existing labour-market-prospects duty more results-oriented.
Ik ben voornemens om de bestaande zorgplicht arbeidsmarktperspectief meer resultaatgericht te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jadnanansing over de onnodige verstrekking van GBA-uittreksels voor de leerlingenadministratie op scholen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jadnanansing asked why schools still demand unnecessary GBA extracts from parents for enrolment, citing cost and municipal workload figures. The minister says the figures are a modelling exercise not verified by government, that some schools still ask for extracts, and that he will contact schools, accountants and parents and recheck with municipalities at year-end.
The government itself has not researched the number of GBA extracts issued for school enrolment, so the correct figures are not known to me.
Er is door de overheid zelf geen onderzoek gedaan naar het aantal verstrekte GBA-uittreksels ten behoeve van inschrijving in het onderwijs, derhalve zijn de juiste cijfers mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen bij de VU

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education about problems at the VU, including alleged over-marketisation of higher education, supervision failures, and tension between staff and the board. The Minister rejected the claim of systemic marketisation, said supervisory bodies need adequate time, promised further analysis via the Inspectorate and a letter on governance, and will report to parliament after the Inspectorate's conclusion around mid-July.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Duisenberg over de kwaliteit van de Harvard Universiteit

An MP asked the education minister why DUO needs up to 8 to 12 weeks to assess Harvard's quality before granting student finance, arguing this is too slow for a student's deadline and that Harvard's excellence should make such a check quick. The minister answered that the maximum is 8 weeks plus 4 weeks at DUO, that actual processing averaged about 24 working days, that the assessment is complex and involves double testing, and that the procedure is adequate and gives students sufficient certainty.
In practice it has turned out that the investigation has also not taken more than a few days.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat het onderzoek ook niet meer dan enkele dagen in beslag heeft genomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over “Bumpy start for Pan European MOOCs”

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked the education minister about reports of a bumpy start for the pan-European MOOC platform OpenupEd, and about US and Dutch online-learning participation figures. The minister answered that Dutch higher education has large opportunities in ICT-supported and open online learning, cited SURF, Wikiwijs and EU initiatives, and promised a policy letter in autumn 2013 on MOOCs and possible regulatory barriers.
I have promised your House to send a policy letter on this in the coming autumn.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd hierover in het komend najaar een beleidsbrief te sturen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de subsidieregeling ter vervanging van de Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the education minister about the replacement subsidy for the abolished Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs, its timing, employment effects and the EUR 200 million cut. The minister answered that contours were sent to parliament that day, the scheme starts 1 January 2014, and the budget will be targeted to support apprenticeships and reduce youth unemployment.
Today you receive the promised letter with the outlines of the scheme.
Vandaag ontvangt u de toegezegde brief met de contouren van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over het bericht “Signaal onderwijsminister onjuist”

MPs Rog and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether her figures on unemployment among graduates of the animal care vocational programme were accurate, and whether her portrayal misrepresented career prospects after the course. The minister defended her use of ROA data, acknowledged the CBS pilot and planned improvements, and said she would look forward to more reliable CBS figures on labour-market position.
I did not want to use these CBS data, because the CBS establishes the labour-market position fairly shortly after graduation and only on an annual basis.
Ik heb deze gegevens van het CBS niet willen gebruiken, omdat het CBS vrij kort na diplomering en alleen op jaarbasis de arbeidsmarktpositie vaststelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat ruim zesduizend studenten boetes krijgen wegens het aflopen van het recht op reizen met het OV

An MP asked the minister of Education about reports that over six thousand students face fines for not stopping their public transport pass after leaving education, and why the fine was raised. The minister explained the stopping procedure, the reminders and communication sent to students, the reason for the fine increase, and said she will ask student organisations for suggestions to improve communication.
I will ask student organisations what suggestions they have for improving the communication.
Ik zal studentenorganisaties vragen welke suggesties zij hebben voor verbetering van de communicatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat Iraanse studenten worden gediscrimineerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Iranian students are excluded from some courses despite a Supreme Court ruling, and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the nuclear knowledge embargo implementation will be revised before summer, that 13 exemption requests were filed with 7 refused, and that she sees no reason to apologise or compensate.

We intend to work with the higher education institutions in the short term toward a comprehensive revision of the national implementation of the UN knowledge embargo, so as to address both the Supreme Court ruling and UN Security Council Resolution 1737.

Wij zijn voornemens om in overleg met de Hoger Onderwijs instellingen op korte termijn te komen tot een integrale herziening van de nationale uitwerking van het VN-kennisembargo, zodat tegemoet wordt gekomen aan zowel het arrest van de Hoge Raad als de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresolutie 1737.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de anti-Westerse opvattingen binnen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether the Islamic University of Rotterdam receives state subsidies and whether its rector's and teachers' views, which they called incompatible with Western norms on gender, sexual orientation and apostasy, justify withdrawing accreditation and barring its graduates from government chaplaincy work. The minister answered that the university receives no state funding, that the cited statements date from over ten years ago and were personal, that the programmes are accredited with no reason to withdraw accreditation, and that she does not share the view that Islamic chaplains trained there should be barred from government service.
The relevant programmes at the IUR are accredited and I see no need to withdraw these accreditations.
De betreffende opleidingen aan de IUR zijn geaccrediteerd en ik zie geen noodzaak om deze accreditaties in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Bestuurlijke crisis bij VU- rapport velt hard oordeel over onderwijs’?

An MP asked the education minister about reported governance turmoil at the Vrije Universiteit, including a dispute between its deans and supervisory board, a critical internal commission finding that the education vision was insufficiently concrete, and the effect on a planned merger of science faculties with the University of Amsterdam. The minister said she had no substantive view on the dispute, is being informed by the Inspectorate, and that the merger is a matter for the two institutions.
I am having the Inspectorate keep me informed of further developments, partly on the basis of additional information it is gathering from the VU.
Ik laat mij door de IvhO informeren over verdere ontwikkelingen, mede op basis van nadere informatie die door haar bij de VU wordt ingewonnen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Vermeij en Albert de Vries (over de planontwikkeling van een recreatiepark nabij Fort Benoorden Spaarndam)

MPs Vermeij and De Vries asked the ministers about plans for bungalows at Fort Benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam, and whether the national government should be involved. The minister said the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had studied the plans and found no harm to the World Heritage value, that the province is the lead on the project and can request advice from the College van Rijksadviseurs which the government would support, and that the alternative plan from a heritage foundation is a matter for the province.
A request from the province of Noord-Holland I will support and submit to the college.
Een verzoek van de provincie Noord-Holland zal ik steunen en voorleggen aan het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over verkeerde registraties in het CRIHO

An MP asked the education minister about students whose completed non-teaching, non-care degrees were wrongly registered in CRIHO, forcing them to pay institutional rather than statutory tuition for a second teaching or care study. The minister acknowledged the cause lies in past hogeschool practice, said the situation is not a flaw in the law, and declined to restore statutory tuition, leaving a solution to the hogescholen.
No. I am of the view that the institutions involved are responsible for a financial solution to this problem, and I have confidence that they will succeed.
Nee. Ik ben van mening dat de betrokken hogescholen verantwoordelijk zijn voor een financiële oplossing voor deze problematiek en ik heb er vertrouwen in dat zij daarin zullen slagen.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht “ziekenhuizen mogen abortus niet weigeren”

Two MPs asked the health and education ministers about a minister's radio remarks on abortion and a hospital board's decision to offer abortion, including whether conscientious objectors are protected under the Termination of Pregnancy Act. The government answered that the law protects non-participation, that hospital decision-making and ethics committee involvement are internal matters, and that it expects conscientious objectors' position to be sufficiently secured.
I regard this as an internal matter.
Ik zie dit als een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yüçel en Jadnanansing over het optreden van een imam in de aula van een middelbare school in Vlissingen

MPs Yüçel and Jadnanansing asked how a controversial imam came to give a talk in a Vlissingen secondary school hall without the school knowing its content, and whether the school was put in an embarrassing position. The minister answered that the school rents out space without vetting event content, the organising group did not specifically report the speaker, the school will now assess rental requests on content, and the speech is publicly available online.
In future it will also assess rental requests on their content.
In de toekomst verzoeken van verhuur ook inhoudelijk zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de cijfers en feiten rond schuldenlast van studenten bij het sociaal leenstelsel

An MP asked the minister of Education about the debt burden of students under the proposed social loan system, and whether the BKR's warnings about debt, interest rates and registration are accurate. The minister rejects the BKR's figures as partly incorrect, argues the system is a mix of grants and loans with income-contingent repayment, and says BKR registration is unnecessary.
The BKR supports its argument with several factual inaccuracies.
Het BKR onderbouwt zijn betoog met meerdere feitelijke onjuistheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over selectie aan de poort bij steeds meer universitaire studies, naar aanleiding van het antwoord op eerdere vragen d.d. 22 maart 2013

An MP asks the minister how her earlier position that capacity limits are not used to select the best students squares with statements by universities that selection at the gate improves study success and meets performance targets. The minister answers that selection needs an objective reason, that selection is not a tool to raise instruction quality, and that law faculties' capacity limits are not yet shown to be necessary given available places.
There must be an objective reason for selection. I will come with criteria to assess that reason, as I announced in the bill 'Quality in Diversity'.
Er moet wel een objectieve aanleiding zijn voor de selectie. Ik kom met criteria om die aanleiding te kunnen beoordelen, zoals ik heb aangekondigd in het wetsvoorstel «Kwaliteit in Verscheidenheid».
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over Europese subsidies die het stierenvechten in stand houden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether EU agricultural and cultural subsidies sustain bullfighting in Spain, including bull breeding, arena upkeep, and whether such subsidies should be withheld. The government answered that EU cultural funds do not finance arenas, bull breeding is not a separate EU subsidy category, and animal welfare and spending of national funds are member-state responsibilities, while promising only to support future welfare rules.
Fighting bulls do not form a separate category in relation to EU subsidies.
Vechtstieren vormen geen aparte categorie in relatie tot EU-subsidies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over selectie in het mbo

An MP asked the education minister whether selection at the gate by mbo institutions is undesirable, given that vmbo diplomas grant access, and how many students are refused. The minister rejects the Expertisecentrum Beroepsonderwijs's concern, cannot yet quantify refusals, and says the Inspectie will monitor and a stricter admission duty may be considered if the problem grows.
At this moment the information needed to answer your question is lacking.
Op dit moment ontbreekt de informatie om uw vraag te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over ongelijke beloning tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Hamer asked whether unequal pay between men and women is acceptable, what the statistics show for the Netherlands versus the EU and OECD, and which countries have low gaps. The government answered that unequal pay for equal work is unacceptable, referred the question of additional measures to the SER, and cited CBS and Eurostat figures showing a gap of about 13-20 percent depending on sector, with unexplained parts that do not necessarily indicate discrimination.
On 18 February 2013 I asked the SER in an advisory request on discrimination in the labour market which additional actions could help prevent and combat unequal pay.

Ik heb op 18 februari 2013 in een adviesaanvraag over discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt aan de SER gevraagd welke aanvullende acties kunnen bijdragen aan het voorkómen en bestrijden van ongelijke beloning.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Jasper van Dijk over kinderen die noodgedwongen bij hun ouders moeten aankloppen ondanks een ontbrekende band of voogdij

SP MPs asked whether students who cannot ask a parent without custody or a parent who is absent or refuses to pay can qualify for the supplementary grant, and how many are affected. The minister explained the existing 'weigerachtige of onvindbare ouders' rule, saw no need for further research or a new solution, and noted the rule will be abolished under the coalition agreement, with a hardship clause under study.
It is not registered how many students with parents who have been removed or deprived of parental authority do not receive a supplementary grant based on parental income.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel studenten met ouders die uit het gezag zijn ontheven of ontzet op basis van het inkomen van de ouders geen aanvullende beurs krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de toename van het aantal opleidingen met selectie aan de poort (ingezonden 31 januari 2013).

An MP asks the education minister whether the rise in higher-education programmes using selection at the gate (from 43 to 74), including capacity limits used as a back door to selection and joint capacity agreements among law faculties, is acceptable and in line with the coalition agreement. The minister replies that the increase is expected to be limited to programmes with more applicants than places, that selection is allowed only under objective grounds, that she will monitor for misuse and speak to institutions if needed, and that the law faculties' capacity agreements are not cartel formation.
Furthermore, I will closely monitor whether capacity limitation is nonetheless used to select improperly.
Verder zal ik scherp in de gaten houden of capaciteitsbeperking toch gebruikt wordt om oneigenlijk te selecteren.
Vragen van het lid Van Meenen (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over selectie aan de poort bij steeds meer universitaire studies (ingezonden 31 januari 2013).

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the education minister about the growing use of selection at the gate for university programmes and whether capacity limits are being used as a back door to selection. Minister Bussemaker answered that selection will only occur where applications exceed places, that she does not see capacity limits as a back door, that selection should not be used to raise teaching quality, and that she will monitor misuse and set criteria for objectively justified selection.

I will closely monitor the use of the back route through the VSNU, the HBO council and, where necessary, individual institutions, and hold them to account if capacity limits are used when quality is not under pressure.

Gebruik van de sluiproute zal ik scherp in de gaten houden door de VSNU, de HBO-raad en zonodig individuele instellingen aan te spreken op het hanteren van een capaciteitsbeperkingen als de kwaliteit niet onder druk staat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het tekort aan leraren wiskunde en Nederlands, naar aanleiding van het artikel daarover in de Volkskrant van 1 maart 2013

An MP asked the education minister about the reported shortage of mathematics and Dutch teachers and its consequences for pupils. The minister accepted the CentERdata/VOION projections of a future shortage and described regional projects, a 100 million euro programme and a possible mobility centre to address it.
Work is currently under way to address the projected future shortages.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan de ondervanging van geraamde toekomstige tekorten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de eis dat Nederland betaalt voor Turkse les op school

MPs Van Klaveren and Beertema asked whether the government agrees that a migrant organisation demanding Turkish-language lessons in Dutch schools at taxpayers' expense is absurd, and whether it will urge members to speak Dutch at home and leave for Turkey if they want Turkish lessons. The State Secretary replied that OALT was abolished in 2004 and that the matter is before the court so he will not comment further, while stressing that Dutch-language skills matter and that the ministers will work with migrant organisations, including Turkish ones, on improving children's Dutch.
Since the matter is now before the court, I will refrain from further comment.
Aangezien het nu onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij verder van commentaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een nieuwe bètafaculteit van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Vrije Universiteit (VU)

An SP MP asks the minister about a plan by the UvA and VU to merge their science faculties into one Amsterdam Faculty of Science, its governance, whether it falls under the merger test, whether staff and students are consulted, reduced bachelor programmes, and whether funds could go to a costly building project. The minister endorses the plan, says it is not a legal merger and so not subject to the merger test, says staff and students will be consulted via the works councils, and says the institutions alone are responsible for housing and spending.
The envisaged cooperation is not an administrative or institutional merger within the meaning of the law and therefore does not qualify for a merger test.
De beoogde samenwerking is geen bestuurlijke of instellingsfusie in de zin van de wet en komt daarom niet in aanmerking voor een fusietoets.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met tentamens bij de HvA (HvA)

An SP MP asks the education minister about exam mishaps at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences (HvA), including second-year students grading first-year exams and a cancelled MIC exam, and what consequences, investigation and legislative remedies follow. The minister regrets the incidents, outlines remedial test dates, internal investigation and planned procedural improvements, notes the Inspectorate will hold a governance meeting with the HvA, and says the bill on quality safeguards does not directly address these specific problems.
The Inspectorate will hold an administrative meeting with the HvA to also establish whether the institution is sufficiently "in control" in resolving these problems.
De Inspectie zal een bestuurlijk gesprek met de HvA voeren om ook vast te stellen of de hogeschool voldoende «in control» is bij het oplossen van deze problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over de bijdrage aan Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch city becoming European Capital of Culture 2018 could count on a 20 million euro national contribution, whether no promises had been made to candidate cities, and whether the national government should distance itself from or withdraw the bid. The minister replied that no promises were made to the Eindhoven alderman, that the size of any national contribution was not yet known, that provinces and municipalities decide how to spend their funds, and that the Netherlands agreed to the EU title in 1999.
No commitments have been made to the Eindhoven alderman.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen aan de Eindhovense wethouder gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de financiële positie van Landstede MBO

MP Jadnanansing asked the minister whether Landstede MBO's board is right that its finances are sound and whether the institution could face the same fate as Amarantis, and asked about quality problems flagged by the inspectorate. The minister declined to equate the two cases, rejected the board's view that the accommodation burden is unavoidable, and said the inspectorate is closely monitoring Landstede under heightened financial and quality supervision with a meeting planned.
Landstede is under adjusted financial supervision due to elevated risk.
Landstede staat onder aangepast financieel toezicht wegens verhoogd risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over boetes voor buitenlandse studenten wegens vermeend ontbreken ziektekostenverzekering

MPs Mohandis and Bouwmeester asked whether foreign students are wrongly fined by the CVZ for allegedly lacking health insurance and how to prevent this. The minister explains that students under 30 who work alongside their studies are rightly insured under Dutch rules, while exchange and non-publicly funded students are wrongly contacted because current administration cannot screen them, and says the communication is being improved and the group may be narrowed further.
In addition, I am examining the possibilities to further limit the group of international students who are currently wrongly contacted.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de groep internationale studenten die nu onterecht worden aangeschreven nog verder te beperken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat buitenlandse studenten onterecht een aanmaning voor een zorgverzekering ontvangen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked whether foreign students were wrongly sent demands to take out Dutch health insurance, with fines, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that students registered with DUO are not targeted, that students who work alongside their studies are rightly insured, that fines are withdrawn or refunded once students respond, and that the government will improve communication and an English-language form but will not exempt students with small jobs.
If the student responds to the CVZ or SVB after the letter, no fine is imposed at all.
Als de student na de aanschrijving van het CVZ reageert naar het CVZ of de SVB, dan wordt er in het geheel geen boete opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop inzake beëindiging opleiding Hebreeuwse en Joodse studies

An SGP MP asked the education minister whether small programmes such as Hebrew and Jewish Studies at Leiden, which is discontinuing it, are being cut without proper weight given to their unique value, and what responsibility the government bears. The minister replied that the choice is the university's, that small programmes are not to be cut as such, and that Hebrew remains available as a minor at Leiden and as a programme at Amsterdam, so no gap requires talks with Leiden.
I therefore do not get the impression that, from a national perspective, undesirable white spots are arising in the programme offer.
Ik heb daarom niet de indruk dat, vanuit een landelijk perspectief bezien, ongewenste witte vlekken in het opleidingenaanbod ontstaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smits over de ontstane problemen bij ROC’s door de nieuwe verdeling van de educatiegelden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about problems at regional vocational colleges (ROCs) caused by the new distribution of adult education funds, including the criteria for 2012 and 2013 allocations and compensation. The Minister answered that no redistribution of the 2013 budget is legally possible, that the criteria changed from 2013 to outcome-based measures, that no compensation decision has been made yet, and that a reaction to the 'Educatie op een kruispunt' report is expected in spring 2013.
I aim to respond in spring 2013.
Ik streef ernaar in het voorjaar 2013 met een reactie te komen.
Antwoord vragen Mohandis over het onderzoek ‘Teacher evaluations and pupil achievement: Evidence from classroom observation’ van het Centraal Planbureau

An MP asked the education minister about a CPB study linking classroom observation of teachers to pupil achievement, and whether observation methods could improve teacher quality and inspectorate assessments. The state secretary said the method is promising and will be used in coaching and the Nationaal Onderwijs Akkoord, but rejected making teacher quality a larger part of inspectorate school assessments, leaving that role to school leaders and boards.
I do not share that view. The inspectorate assesses teacher quality at risk schools.
Ik deel die mening niet. De inspectie beoordeelt de lerarenkwaliteit bij risicoscholen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Beertema over de ziekmeldingen van islamitische leerlingen met carnaval

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic objections to carnival can justify children staying away from school, whether parents should be fined, and whether the Netherlands has a Judeo-Christian and humanist tradition excluding Islam. The minister answered that such objections are no legal ground for leave or exemption under the Compulsory Education Act, that prosecution is for the courts, and that he rejects excluding Islam from the national tradition.
Objections to carnival do not constitute grounds for which leave and/or an exemption from compulsory education can be granted.
Bezwaren tegen carnaval vormen geen grond waarvoor verlof en/of een vrijstelling van de leerplicht kan worden verleend.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Bergkamp over een tax shelter voor de filmindustrie

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about introducing a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry, its prevalence in the EU, its design, and its effects on competitiveness and Dutch post-production firms. The government answered that it does not intend to introduce a tax shelter because it conflicts with its simplification agenda, and gave limited figures on foreign spending and bankruptcies while saying the effects on public finances are unknown.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens een tax shelter voor de Nederlandse filmindustrie te introduceren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Wolbert en Ziengs over het verklaren van Ruinerwold tot een beschermd dorpsgezicht door de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

Three MPs asked why the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed designates Ruinerwold as a protected village view despite opposition from the municipal council and the province, and what this means for economic development and solar panels. The minister explains the designation procedure, that municipal and provincial advice plays an important role but cultural-historical values are leading, and that the municipality decides on permits without blocking development or renewable energy.
The cultural-historical values are leading in the designation procedure, but the advice of the municipal council and Provincial Executive plays an important role in the weighing towards the decision.
De cultuurhistorische waarden zijn bij de aanwijzingsprocedure leidend, maar de adviezen van de gemeenteraad en van Gedeputeerde Staten spelen een belangrijke rol bij de afweging tot het besluit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de Russische anti-homowet

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign and education ministers about a Russian bill banning public speech on homosexuality, and whether the Netherlands would protest and protect LGBT rights. Minister Timmermans said the bill is discriminatory and harmful, that the concern was conveyed to the Russian ambassador, raised at the EU level and in a planned visit, and that Dutch funding for LGBT projects in Russia continues.
On 1 February I had my concerns conveyed to the Russian ambassador.
Op 1 februari heb ik mijn zorgen aan de Russische ambassadeur laten overbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de vertrekkend bestuursvoorzitter van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum een zeer royale ontslagregeling heeft getroffen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that the outgoing Erasmus MC board chair negotiated a generous severance package, including continued salary to 2015, a personal allowance, a mobile phone, laptop and first-class NS season ticket. The minister answered that the arrangement's basis under the CAO is incorrect since the chair was not covered by the CAO, that such a generous arrangement is too generous, but that the WNT cannot yet normalise professor pay.
In my view that is an incorrect reference.
Mijns inziens is dat een onterechte verwijzing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de cookiemuur van de Publieke Omroep niet rechtsgeldig is

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the government how it would respond to the CBP's criticism of the public broadcaster NPO's cookie wall, which denies access to sites for users who refuse tracking cookies, and what steps it would take. The state secretary said OPTA and the CBP are responsible for enforcement, that the government will consult the NPO within a month on alternatives, and that tracking cookies are not needed for basic site functions.
It is up to OPTA to judge the lawfulness of the NPO's conduct in light of the cookie provision.
Het is dus aan OPTA om een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de NPO in het licht van de cookiebepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over het bericht ‘Meer Marokkaanse drop-outs'

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked the Minister of Education about a report of rising early school leaving among Moroccan-Dutch youth, the effectiveness of €30 million spent on the targeted approach, and the CPB findings on coaching. The minister answered that the rise was limited to a small group in 22 municipalities, that the rate has since fallen, that the subsidy served broader goals, and that she will continue the regional early-school-leaving approach and report to parliament.
In the meantime the decline in dropouts has resumed, both nationally and in the 22 municipalities.
Inmiddels heeft de daling van de uitval weer doorgezet, zowel op landelijk niveau als in de 22 gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over het faillissement van De Pier op Scheveningen

An MP asked the minister about the bankruptcy of the Pier Vastgoed company and whether De Pier in Scheveningen, a post-war landmark, could be preserved by granting it national monument status, and about the land-lease arrangements. The minister said there is no route to national monument status because the building fails the criteria on integrity and condition, and that the Rijk has no responsibility for preservation or demolition beyond its lease terms.
I see no possibility of preserving De Pier at national level.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheid om De Pier van rijkswege te behouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het rapport Maatschappelijke effecten afschaffing ov-studentenkaart

An MP asked the minister of Education about the Panteia/Significance report on the effects of abolishing the free public transport card for students, including extra costs, housing, transport demand, and traffic. The minister answered that the report assumes no replacement arrangement, that a new alternative will be designed with transport companies and other ministries, and that the report's negative effects are premature.
What form the arrangement will take exactly and which effects will occur is still unknown.
Welke vorm het arrangement precies krijgt en welke effecten zich zullen voordoen, is nog onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Mohandis over vrouwen in topfuncties bij universiteiten en hogescholen

Two MPs asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about the low share of women in professorships and top posts at universities and universities of applied sciences, including measures, a 30% target and gender training. The minister answered that universities are autonomous, cited measures such as Talent naar de Top, Aspasia and the LNVH network, said a 30% target is reasonable with tailoring, and noted there is no mandatory gender training.
The Dutch universities are autonomous. The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science does not have figures on women who cannot progress.
De Nederlandse universiteiten zijn autonoom. Het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap beschikt niet over cijfers met betrekking tot vrouwen die niet kunnen doorstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat monumentenorganisaties de Kamer oproepen niet mee te gaan in de afstoot van monumenten door het Rijk

An MP asked the minister whether heritage organisations' concerns about the State selling Rijksmonumenten are justified and what safeguards exist after sale. The minister rejected the concerns, said heritage is adequately protected by law, and disclosed a list of 34 monuments selected for possible sale, to be published once the sale starts.
To ensure the care and transparency of the process, the overview will be made public once the public sale can begin.
Om de zorgvuldigheid en transparantie van het proces te waarborgen zal het overzicht publiekelijk bekend worden gemaakt als de openbare vervreemding van start kan gaan.
Antwoord vragen Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk over de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een beperking

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the education minister about accessibility of higher education for students with disabilities, citing a report that rated it poorly and asking why vocational institutions score lower and what target to set. The minister answered that satisfaction (3.3 of 5) is sufficient and improving, that she will await the longitudinal study due in spring 2013 and will consult partners if warranted, but declined to set a numerical target.
I consider the accessibility of higher education for this group of students very important.
Ik vind de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor deze groep studenten heel belangrijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake het bericht ‘Binnenkort geen timmerman meer te vinden’

An MP asked the education minister about reports of fewer technology lessons in secondary education and a shortage of skilled tradespeople. The state secretary replied that schools have discretion over lesson hours, cited existing targets and funding for technology, and said the critical teacher survey would be taken into account in the upcoming Techniekpact.
I do not have the precise data on the number of hours schools in secondary education spend on technology.
Ik beschik niet over de precieze gegevens over het aantal uren dat scholen in het voortgezet onderwijs besteden aan techniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toestand van het VOC-archief in Jakarta

An MP asked the education and culture minister about the deteriorating condition of the VOC archive in Jakarta and what the government would do to improve it. The minister said the archive is partly damaged by ink corrosion but stabilised since repackaging, that cooperation with Indonesia continues, and that digitisation and conservation will be pursued under a 2013-2016 programme with a new plan expected in spring.
Within the Shared Cultural Heritage programme 2013-2016, emphasis will shift to increasing accessibility and use of colonial archives through digitisation.
Binnen het programma voor Gedeeld Cultureel Erfgoed 2013–2016 komt de nadruk te liggen op vergroting van toegankelijkheid en gebruik van koloniale archieven door middel van digitalisering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rog over het onderzoek in de affaire Jansen Steur

Three CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers whether the scientific work of neurologist Jansen Steur should be examined, why no body had reviewed it earlier, and about his publications and drug-trial involvement. The minister agreed the reasoning on unreliable research is sound, explained that the IGZ halted its probe after the criminal investigation was dropped, and promised to consult Medisch Spectrum Twente and the KNAW on reviewing the publications.
I will first consult with the former employer of Mr Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, on the design and results of the study into publications set up by that institution.

Er zal door mij eerst met de voormalige werkgever van de heer Jansen Steur, Medisch Spectrum Twente, overlegd worden over opzet en resultaten van het door deze instelling opgezette onderzoek naar publicaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Smits inzake pesten bij kinderen van 4 tot 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the state secretary about bullying programmes, budgets, effectiveness, inter-policy coordination, the government's role, school sanctions and school safety monitoring. The government answered at length, describing programmes and budgets, noting evaluations are not yet complete, promising a plan of action in March, and reporting that no clear trend in bullying has been found.
The studies from the Onderwijs Bewijs action programme have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken uit het actieprogramma Onderwijs Bewijs zijn nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de waarde van een diploma naar aanleiding van een LOOT-programma

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether diplomas from LOOT elite-athlete programmes, with exemptions, carry the same value as regular diplomas, after a turnster was refused entry to a Saxion course because an exemption in economics left her deficient. The government answered that LOOT diplomas are full entry qualifications, that the refusal followed the course's own specific prerequisite, that the evaluation is due in summer 2013, and that no other similar cases are known.
Yes, that is correct. Pupils following an adapted programme in secondary education under the LOOT licence policy rule can obtain a full final diploma.

Leerlingen die een aangepast programma volgen op het middelbaar onderwijs in het kader van mijn Beleidsregel verstrekking Loot-licentie voortgezet onderwijs 1 , kunnen een volwaardig einddiploma verwerven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Smits en Karabulut over het bericht dat de pilot “In de buurt naar school“ in de gemeente Tilburg is stopgezet

MPs Smits and Karabulut asked the ministers about the city of Tilburg ending its 'In de buurt naar school' pilot against school segregation and whether the national government still funds integration in schools. The state secretary replied that Tilburg decided itself, that national pilot subsidies were phased out in 2011, that the government sees segregation as undesirable but prioritises quality and language support, and that municipalities retain local discretion.
The national government has no power to assess the content of the municipality's policy.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen bevoegdheid tot het beoordelen van het inhoudelijk beleid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het promoten van het bereiden van houtsnippen voor consumptie

An MP asked the ministers whether the public broadcaster's cooking of woodcock, which is protected in the Netherlands, promotes illegal hunting, and whether trade and import should be banned. The government answered that broadcasters are responsible for their content, that woodcock may legally be hunted and traded if obtained lawfully abroad, and declined to investigate, ban imports or monitor trade.
The Media Act provides that the public broadcaster is itself responsible for the form and content of its programmes.
In de Mediawet is opgenomen dat de publieke omroep zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de vorm en inhoud van zijn programma’s.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat veel jonge docenten moeilijker aan het werk kunnen komen

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether falling employment for young, newly graduated teachers in primary and secondary education is a concern and what policy response is planned. The minister answers that regional shortages and surpluses exist, that graduates still find jobs fairly quickly nationally, and that cross-regional cooperation and an impulse plan for teachers are being pursued.
Where regional bottlenecks arise, I take measures.
Waar er op regionaal niveau knelpunten ontstaan neem ik maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het manipuleren van burgemeestersbenoemingen en het lekken van geheime stukken

An MP asked whether reconstructions of past mayoral appointments were accurate, whether ignoring selection committee recommendations was common, and how secret appointment files leaked to a journalist. The government answered that the former procedure gave the minister room for its own judgment, declined to assess the historical appointments, and said access was blocked after a misplaced disclosure affecting eight persons' files.
The restrictions on public access to the files transferred to the National Archives were imposed to respect the personal privacy of those concerned.
De beperkingen op de openbaarheid van de dossiers die zijn overgedragen aan het Nationaal Archief zijn gesteld vanwege de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het door Red Bull gesponsorde onderzoek aan Universiteit Utrecht

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether Universiteit Utrecht's publication of positive results on an energy drink sponsored by Red Bull (300,000 euro) creates a conflict of interest, and what the KNAW will do about openness and sponsor influence. The state secretary replied that the KNAW has no direct role, that sponsored research is disclosed via declarations of interest, that the university ordered an integrity review, and that the government awaits the KNAW advice on trust and integrity before acting.
I am awaiting the KNAW recommendations in its advice on trust and integrity before acting on this.
Ik wacht hiervoor de aanbevelingen van de KNAW af in het advies over vertrouwen en integriteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansingh betreffende een dreigend tekort aan ervaren praktijkdocenten in het beroepsonderwijs

An MP asked the education minister about a predicted shortage of experienced vocational practice teachers and whether specialist-knowledge training is adequate. The minister disagreed that practice knowledge is lacking, said a study on the MBO labour market is underway, and promised a letter on strengthening teacher training.
I will send you a letter in the coming days announcing measures to strengthen training for teachers in vmbo and mbo.
Ik stuur u één dezer dagen een brief waarin ik maatregelen aankondig om de opleiding voor leraren in het vmbo en mbo te versterken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen die ontstaan als de OV-studentenkaart wordt afgeschaft

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether abolishing the student OV travel card would reduce college attendance, harm education quality, raise student costs and deter study choices, and whether the government would investigate these effects. The minister replied that free travel ends in 2016 but students get discounts and a loan for remaining travel costs, that attendance matters, that the study-choice risk is overstated, and that details would follow in a forthcoming letter on the student finance proposals.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake de aansluiting van hbo'ers op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the education minister about a report finding that higher vocational (hbo) graduates are insufficiently connected to the labour market, and whether concrete improvements would be pursued. The minister replied that the connection is adequate according to student and employer ratings, that existing strategic agenda and coalition measures already address it, and that no additional action is currently needed.
I note that the connection of hbo with the labour market is sufficient.
Ik constateer dat de aansluiting van het hbo op de arbeidsmarkt voldoende is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake mbo-scholen die stagiairs onvoldoende begeleiden

An MP asked the education minister whether a pilot showed Amsterdam vocational students get too little help finding internships and too little supervision during them, and whether schools failing at this would be held accountable. The minister said the pilot's evidence is limited but a signal, schools must improve supervision, a national monitor per institution is being commissioned, and institutions will be called to account.
I expect educational institutions to seriously work on better supervision.
Ik verwacht van onderwijsinstellingen dat ze serieus werk maken van een betere begeleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over gesubsidieerde grootverdieners in de toneelsector

PVV MPs asked the minister whether artistic leaders Ivo van Hove and Jan Versweyveld of Toneelgroep Amsterdam earn above the Balkenende norm and whether salaries will be capped and disclosed in subsidy conditions. The minister answered that neither exceeds the norm, so salaries are not published, and that existing WOPT/WNT rules apply without new subsidy conditions.
Since the salary does not exceed the norm, the salary is not made public.
Aangezien het salaris niet boven de norm uitkomt, wordt het salaris niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt over derivaten in het onderwijs

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked the education minister about the value of derivatives used by education institutions, whether a 270 million euro loss was taken from education funds, and whether such use should be banned, as well as sanctions for open positions and a ROC West-Brabant criticism. The minister answered that swaps hedge interest risk at lower cost given Basel III, that the negative value is not a realised loss, that she will not ban derivatives but will tighten rules, and that the inspectorate's report was accurate though nuanced by ROC West-Brabant.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over “het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen schoonmakers uit het zicht wil houden”.

Two MPs asked ministers whether the University of Groningen's plan to have cleaners work only when no one is present, and sanctions against a cleaner, were acceptable under the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag. The minister reports that the university, union and cleaning firms reached an agreement that keeps working hours, lifts sanctions and commits the university to sign the Code, but largely declines to take further action against the board.
I am pleased that the RUG, as client, together with the other partners, has reached this agreement.
Ik ben verheugd over het feit dat de RUG als opdrachtgever, samen met de andere partners, tot dit akkoord is gekomen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Oosenbrug (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over ict-onderwijs in het hoger beroepsonderwijs en op de universiteit (ingezonden 15 oktober 2012).

MPs Jadnanansing and Oosenbrug asked whether inadequate ICT education will cost jobs and whether the minister will meet education providers and the firms named in a news report to fix the mismatch between education and the labour market. The minister answered that the matter belongs with the CIO Platform and the sector, pointed to existing covenants and advisory committees, and gave no commitment to a new meeting or report.
It is important that education institutions, together with business, take action and, if necessary, I will urge them to do so.
Het is belangrijk dat onderwijsinstellingen, samen met het bedrijfsleven, actie ondernemen en, indien nodig, zal ik ze daartoe aansporen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over de studenten OV-chipkaart

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why students cannot use the temporary replacement and refund arrangements available to other OV-chipkaart holders, and whether one uniform scheme could be created. The minister replied that student data protection rules prevent carriers from verifying students, so the differences remain, though the government judges the refund process not unduly complicated.
For privacy reasons, individual carriers may never have access to students' personal data.
Om privacyredenen zullen individuele vervoerders nooit over de persoonsgegevens van studenten mogen beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de bestuursvoorzitter van de Universiteit Leiden die met behoud van salaris met sabbatical gaat

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister whether a university board chair receiving about two million euros in salary during a 14-month paid sabbatical is acceptable, and what the government will do about such schemes. The minister said she needs more information from the university before judging, that she recovers amounts exceeding the WNT pay norm, and that the WNT is a sufficiently strong instrument.
As soon as I have received this information and have been able to form a judgment, I will inform you of my decision.
Zodra ik deze informatie heb ontvangen en ik mij een oordeel heb kunnen vormen, zal ik u informeren over mijn besluit.

An MP asks whether half of the elderly-care physicians at Zorgbalans leaving signals they cannot guarantee resident safety, whether the law makes physicians ultimately responsible, whether incidents have occurred, and what action will be taken. The state secretary acknowledges the departures, reports strained communication between management and specialists being addressed with external support, explains that the care provider's board bears ultimate responsibility under the Kwaliteitswet and that the Wet BIG reserves certain acts for physicians, reports no incident notifications, and says the Inspectie will be asked to monitor developments.
I have asked the Inspectorate to keep me informed of the developments.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd mij van de ontwikkelingen op de hoogte te houden.

An MP asks the health minister about a report that an elderly woman was left on a commode all night because the alarm was out of reach and not checked at night, asking whether this is a mere incident and why the Inspectorate took no action. The state secretary confirms the incident is shocking, says the institution and complaints committee are still investigating, and explains the Inspectorate acted under its guidelines, referring non-serious complaints to the provider's complaints committee.
The Inspectorate acted in accordance with the Guidelines for IGZ reports as published in the State Gazette 2007, 101.
De Inspectie heeft gehandeld conform de Leidraad meldingen IGZ zoals gepubliceerd in Staatscourant 2007, 101.

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about a survey showing care workers want higher pay and more time with patients, and why the PVV's counter-budget proposals were not adopted. The government replied that pay is a matter for social partners, that pay restraint is appropriate in the economic crisis, that quality of care is monitored by the inspectorate, and that the budget alternatives were already debated.
The cabinet is of the view that wage moderation is precisely what is called for in this time of economic crisis.
Het kabinet is over loonsverhoging van mening dat juist loonmatiging aan de orde is in deze tijd van economische crisis.

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health why it took 18 months for the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) to start unannounced inspections, why the government now calls Winnersway's conduct unacceptable after praising progress, and whether AWBZ funds will be reclaimed. The state secretary replied that the IGZ already inspects unannounced in addition to announced visits, that Winnersway was given chances to improve before a temporary closure under the Kwaliteitswet Zorginstellingen, and that the FIOD-ECD and the curator will be informed about possible further steps.
Both the Minister and I have already indicated in earlier debates that the IGZ will visit unannounced.
Zowel de Minister als ik hebben u in eerdere debatten al aangegeven dat de IGZ onaangekondigd op bezoek zal gaan.

MP Agema asks the state secretary for Health whether her approach to female genital mutilation (FGM), which relies on contracts signed by parents, is naive, and argues that prosecution and denaturalisation are the only answer, questioning subsidies to organisations linked to FGM. The state secretary, with the Justice minister, rejects the naivety charge, says the policy is to inform at-risk parents about the law and harm, states FGM is serious assault and should be prosecuted where possible, confirms subsidies to FSAN and VON, and points to a letter already sent on the contract.
FGM is a form of serious assault, and its perpetrators should be prosecuted and punished where possible.
VGV is een vorm van zware mishandeling, en plegers daarvan dienen waar mogelijk vervolgd en gestraft te worden.

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that disabled residents were put under the shower with clothes on, and why an institution rated high-risk on five aspects by the Inspectorate was given another chance. The state secretary agreed the situation is troubling, said the institution was ordered to improve by 1 February 2010, and announced unannounced inspections and enforcement under the Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen if risks remain.
The institution has been ordered by the IGZ to make improvements by 1 February 2010.
De instelling is door de IGZ gesommeerd voor 1 februari 2010 verbeteringen aan te brengen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceulemans over personen die ten onrechte als gedupeerde zijn aangemerkt en gecompenseerd in het kader van de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how many people were wrongly classed as victims and compensated in the childcare benefits scandal, whether recovery of compensation will occur, and what the status is of the Auditdienst Rijk investigation. The State Secretary answered that the audit examines only the completeness and correctness of the mailing records, that compensation will not be reclaimed except in cases of evident fraud, and that the findings will be sent to Parliament with his response once the investigation is completed, without giving a figure for the number or cost of wrongful compensation.
Once the investigation is completed, I will send the Chamber the investigation report, including my response.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond zal ik de Kamer het onderzoeksrapport, inclusief mijn reactie, doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceulemans en Boomsma over het over de Nederlandse grens zetten van onderschepte personen bij grenscontroles door de Duitse autoriteiten

JA21 MPs Ceulemans and Boomsma asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about people intercepted at German border checks and pushed back to the Netherlands, including whether 'cold' transfers occur, how their status is verified, incidents in border municipalities, and measures to address them. The minister confirmed bilateral transfer arrangements apply to both warm and cold transfers, that the KMar does not record the type of transfer, that contact with Bundespolizei occurs, and that the KMar has raised transfer practices, including onward travel facilitation, with the German side.
The Royal Netherlands Marechaussee (KMar) does not record whether people refused by Germany are transferred by a 'warm' or a 'cold' transfer.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) registreert niet of door Duitsland geweigerde personen worden overgedragen middels een «warme» overdracht of een «koude» overdracht.
